===== app\api\accounting\ledger\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET(request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);

    const from = searchParams.get("from") || "";
    const to = searchParams.get("to") || "";
    const accountId = searchParams.get("accountId") || "";
    const type = searchParams.get("type") || "";
    const search = searchParams.get("search") || "";

    // Validate filters before querying PostgreSQL.
    if (accountId && !/^\d+$/.test(accountId)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Invalid account ID." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (
      (from && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(from)) ||
      (to && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(to))
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Invalid date filter." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (from && to && from > to) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Start date must not exceed end date." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const accountsResult = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        account_id,
        account_code,
        account_name,
        account_type,
        opening_balance,
        current_balance,
        is_active,
        is_group
      FROM chart_of_accounts
      WHERE is_active = TRUE
      ORDER BY account_code
    `);

    const result = await pool.query(
      `
      WITH all_posted_lines AS (
        SELECT
          je.journal_id,
          je.journal_number,
          je.journal_date,
          je.reference_type,
          je.reference_id,
          je.description AS journal_description,
          jel.journal_line_id,
          jel.account_id,
          ca.account_code,
          ca.account_name,
          ca.account_type,
          jel.description AS line_description,
          COALESCE(jel.debit, 0)::numeric AS debit,
          COALESCE(jel.credit, 0)::numeric AS credit,

          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(ca.account_type, '')) IN
                ('LIABILITY', 'LIABILITIES', 'EQUITY',
                 'REVENUE', 'INCOME', 'INCOME/REVENUE')
              THEN COALESCE(jel.credit, 0) - COALESCE(jel.debit, 0)
              ELSE COALESCE(jel.debit, 0) - COALESCE(jel.credit, 0)
            END
          ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY jel.account_id
            ORDER BY
              je.journal_date,
              je.journal_id,
              jel.journal_line_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
          ) AS running_balance

        FROM journal_entries je
        INNER JOIN journal_entry_lines jel
          ON jel.journal_id = je.journal_id
        INNER JOIN chart_of_accounts ca
          ON ca.account_id = jel.account_id
        WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(je.status, '')) = 'POSTED'
      )

      SELECT *
      FROM all_posted_lines
      WHERE ($1 = '' OR journal_date >= $1::date)
        AND ($2 = '' OR journal_date <= $2::date)
        AND ($3 = '' OR account_id = $3::integer)
        AND ($4 = '' OR UPPER(COALESCE(reference_type, '')) = UPPER($4))
        AND (
          $5 = ''
          OR journal_number ILIKE '%' || $5 || '%'
          OR COALESCE(journal_description, '') ILIKE '%' || $5 || '%'
          OR COALESCE(line_description, '') ILIKE '%' || $5 || '%'
          OR account_name ILIKE '%' || $5 || '%'
          OR account_code ILIKE '%' || $5 || '%'
          OR COALESCE(reference_type, '') ILIKE '%' || $5 || '%'
        )
      ORDER BY journal_date DESC, journal_id DESC, journal_line_id DESC
      LIMIT 2000
      `,
      [from, to, accountId, type, search]
    );

    const rows = result.rows;

    const totals = rows.reduce(
      (sum, row) => {
        sum.debit += Number(row.debit || 0);
        sum.credit += Number(row.credit || 0);
        return sum;
      },
      { debit: 0, credit: 0 }
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      accounts: accountsResult.rows,
      transactions: rows,
      totals,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("ACCOUNTING LEDGER ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load financial ledger.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}


===== app\api\accounts\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

const ALLOWED_ACCOUNT_TYPES = [
  "ASSET",
  "LIABILITY",
  "EQUITY",
  "REVENUE",
  "EXPENSE",
];

// =====================================================
// HELPERS
// =====================================================

function parseParentId(value) {
  if (
    value === null ||
    value === undefined ||
    value === ""
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const id = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return id;
}

function parseNumber(value, defaultValue = 0) {
  if (
    value === null ||
    value === undefined ||
    value === ""
  ) {
    return defaultValue;
  }

  return Number(value);
}

function parseBoolean(value, defaultValue = false) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null) {
    return defaultValue;
  }

  if (typeof value === "boolean") {
    return value;
  }

  if (typeof value === "string") {
    return value.toLowerCase() === "true";
  }

  return Boolean(value);
}

// =====================================================
// GET ALL ACCOUNTS
// =====================================================

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        account_id,
        account_code,
        account_name,
        account_type,
        parent_account_id,
        opening_balance,
        current_balance,
        is_active,
        is_group,
        is_cash_bank,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      FROM chart_of_accounts
      ORDER BY account_code ASC
    `);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      accounts: result.rows,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "GET /api/accounts ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load accounts.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// =====================================================
// CREATE ACCOUNT
// =====================================================

export async function POST(request) {
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const accountCode = String(
      body.account_code || ""
    ).trim();

    const accountName = String(
      body.account_name || ""
    ).trim();

    const accountType = String(
      body.account_type || ""
    )
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

    const parentAccountId = parseParentId(
      body.parent_account_id
    );

    const openingBalance = parseNumber(
      body.opening_balance,
      0
    );

    const isActive = parseBoolean(
      body.is_active,
      true
    );

    const isGroup = parseBoolean(
      body.is_group,
      false
    );

    const isCashBank = parseBoolean(
      body.is_cash_bank,
      false
    );

    // =====================================================
    // VALIDATION
    // =====================================================

    if (!accountCode) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Account code is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!accountName) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Account name is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (
      !ALLOWED_ACCOUNT_TYPES.includes(
        accountType
      )
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Invalid account type. Allowed values: ASSET, LIABILITY, EQUITY, REVENUE, EXPENSE.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(openingBalance)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Opening balance must be a valid number.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (
      body.parent_account_id !== null &&
      body.parent_account_id !== undefined &&
      body.parent_account_id !== "" &&
      parentAccountId === null
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Invalid parent account.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // TRANSACTION
    // =====================================================

    await client.query("BEGIN");

    // =====================================================
    // CHECK DUPLICATE CODE
    // =====================================================

    const duplicateResult = await client.query(
      `
      SELECT account_id
      FROM chart_of_accounts
      WHERE account_code = $1
      LIMIT 1
      `,
      [accountCode]
    );

    if (duplicateResult.rows.length > 0) {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            `Account code ${accountCode} already exists.`,
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // VALIDATE PARENT
    // =====================================================

    if (parentAccountId !== null) {
      const parentResult = await client.query(
        `
        SELECT
          account_id,
          account_code,
          account_name,
          is_group
        FROM chart_of_accounts
        WHERE account_id = $1
        LIMIT 1
        `,
        [parentAccountId]
      );

      if (parentResult.rows.length === 0) {
        await client.query("ROLLBACK");

        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            message:
              "Selected parent account does not exist.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      if (!parentResult.rows[0].is_group) {
        await client.query("ROLLBACK");

        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            message:
              "Parent account must be a Summary Account.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // INSERT ACCOUNT
    // =====================================================

    const result = await client.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO chart_of_accounts (
        account_code,
        account_name,
        account_type,
        parent_account_id,
        opening_balance,
        current_balance,
        is_active,
        is_group,
        is_cash_bank,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      )
      VALUES (
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        $5,
        $5,
        $6,
        $7,
        $8,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )
      RETURNING
        account_id,
        account_code,
        account_name,
        account_type,
        parent_account_id,
        opening_balance,
        current_balance,
        is_active,
        is_group,
        is_cash_bank,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      `,
      [
        accountCode,
        accountName,
        accountType,
        parentAccountId,
        openingBalance,
        isActive,
        isGroup,
        isCashBank,
      ]
    );

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: true,
        message:
          "Account created successfully.",
        account: result.rows[0],
      },
      { status: 201 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    try {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");
    } catch {}

    console.error(
      "POST /api/accounts ERROR:",
      error
    );

    if (error.code === "23505") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Account code already exists.",
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    if (error.code === "23503") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Selected parent account does not exist.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (error.code === "23514") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Account data violates a database constraint.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to create account.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

// =====================================================
// UPDATE ACCOUNT
// =====================================================

export async function PUT(request) {
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    // =====================================================
    // ACCOUNT ID
    // =====================================================

    const accountId = Number(
      body.account_id
    );

    if (
      !Number.isInteger(accountId) ||
      accountId <= 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Invalid account ID.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // FORM DATA
    // =====================================================

    const accountCode = String(
      body.account_code || ""
    ).trim();

    const accountName = String(
      body.account_name || ""
    ).trim();

    const accountType = String(
      body.account_type || ""
    )
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

    const parentAccountId = parseParentId(
      body.parent_account_id
    );

    const openingBalance = parseNumber(
      body.opening_balance,
      0
    );

    const isActive = parseBoolean(
      body.is_active,
      true
    );

    const isGroup = parseBoolean(
      body.is_group,
      false
    );

    const isCashBank = parseBoolean(
      body.is_cash_bank,
      false
    );

    // =====================================================
    // VALIDATION
    // =====================================================

    if (!accountCode) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Account code is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!accountName) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Account name is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (
      !ALLOWED_ACCOUNT_TYPES.includes(
        accountType
      )
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Invalid account type. Allowed values: ASSET, LIABILITY, EQUITY, REVENUE, EXPENSE.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(openingBalance)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Opening balance must be a valid number.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (
      body.parent_account_id !== null &&
      body.parent_account_id !== undefined &&
      body.parent_account_id !== "" &&
      parentAccountId === null
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Invalid parent account.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // START TRANSACTION
    // =====================================================

    await client.query("BEGIN");

    // =====================================================
    // GET EXISTING ACCOUNT
    // =====================================================

    const existingResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT
          account_id,
          account_code,
          account_name,
          account_type,
          parent_account_id,
          opening_balance,
          current_balance,
          is_active,
          is_group,
          is_cash_bank
        FROM chart_of_accounts
        WHERE account_id = $1
        FOR UPDATE
        `,
        [accountId]
      );

    if (existingResult.rows.length === 0) {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Account not found.",
        },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    const existing =
      existingResult.rows[0];

    // =====================================================
    // PREVENT SELF PARENT
    // =====================================================

    if (
      parentAccountId !== null &&
      parentAccountId === accountId
    ) {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "An account cannot be its own parent.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // CHECK CHILDREN
    // =====================================================

    const childrenResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS child_count
        FROM chart_of_accounts
        WHERE parent_account_id = $1
        `,
        [accountId]
      );

    const childCount = Number(
      childrenResult.rows[0]
        .child_count || 0
    );

    // =====================================================
    // CANNOT REMOVE SUMMARY STATUS
    // IF ACCOUNT HAS CHILDREN
    // =====================================================

    if (
      !isGroup &&
      childCount > 0
    ) {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "This account has child accounts. It must remain a Summary Account until all child accounts are moved.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // CHECK DUPLICATE CODE
    // =====================================================

    const duplicateResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT account_id
        FROM chart_of_accounts
        WHERE account_code = $1
          AND account_id <> $2
        LIMIT 1
        `,
        [
          accountCode,
          accountId,
        ]
      );

    if (duplicateResult.rows.length > 0) {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            `Account code ${accountCode} already exists.`,
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // VALIDATE PARENT
    // =====================================================

    if (parentAccountId !== null) {
      const parentResult =
        await client.query(
          `
          SELECT
            account_id,
            account_code,
            account_name,
            is_group
          FROM chart_of_accounts
          WHERE account_id = $1
          LIMIT 1
          `,
          [parentAccountId]
        );

      if (parentResult.rows.length === 0) {
        await client.query("ROLLBACK");

        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            message:
              "Selected parent account does not exist.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      if (!parentResult.rows[0].is_group) {
        await client.query("ROLLBACK");

        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            message:
              "Parent account must be a Summary Account.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // PREVENT CIRCULAR HIERARCHY
    // =====================================================

    let checkParentId =
      parentAccountId;

    const visitedParents =
      new Set();

    while (checkParentId !== null) {
      if (
        visitedParents.has(
          checkParentId
        )
      ) {
        await client.query("ROLLBACK");

        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            message:
              "Circular account hierarchy detected.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      visitedParents.add(
        checkParentId
      );

      if (
        checkParentId === accountId
      ) {
        await client.query("ROLLBACK");

        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            message:
              "You cannot move an account under one of its own children.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const parentChainResult =
        await client.query(
          `
          SELECT parent_account_id
          FROM chart_of_accounts
          WHERE account_id = $1
          LIMIT 1
          `,
          [checkParentId]
        );

      if (
        parentChainResult.rows.length === 0
      ) {
        break;
      }

      checkParentId =
        parentChainResult.rows[0]
          .parent_account_id;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // OPENING BALANCE
    // =====================================================

    const oldOpeningBalance =
      Number(
        existing.opening_balance || 0
      );

    const oldCurrentBalance =
      Number(
        existing.current_balance || 0
      );

    const openingDifference =
      openingBalance -
      oldOpeningBalance;

    /*
      Example:

      Old Opening = 100
      New Opening = 150

      Difference = +50

      Old Current = 500
      New Current = 550
    */

    const newCurrentBalance =
      oldCurrentBalance +
      openingDifference;

    // =====================================================
    // UPDATE ACCOUNT
    // =====================================================

    const updateResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        UPDATE chart_of_accounts
        SET
          account_code = $1,
          account_name = $2,
          account_type = $3,
          parent_account_id = $4,
          opening_balance = $5,
          current_balance = $6,
          is_active = $7,
          is_group = $8,
          is_cash_bank = $9,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE account_id = $10
        RETURNING
          account_id,
          account_code,
          account_name,
          account_type,
          parent_account_id,
          opening_balance,
          current_balance,
          is_active,
          is_group,
          is_cash_bank,
          created_at,
          updated_at
        `,
        [
          accountCode,
          accountName,
          accountType,
          parentAccountId,
          openingBalance,
          newCurrentBalance,
          isActive,
          isGroup,
          isCashBank,
          accountId,
        ]
      );

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        "Account updated successfully.",
      account:
        updateResult.rows[0],
    });
  } catch (error) {
    try {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");
    } catch {}

    console.error(
      "PUT /api/accounts ERROR:",
      error
    );

    if (error.code === "23505") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Account code already exists.",
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    if (error.code === "23503") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Selected parent account does not exist.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (error.code === "23514") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Account data violates a database constraint.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message:
          "Failed to update account.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

===== app\api\audit-logs\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET(request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);

    const page = Math.max(
      Number(searchParams.get("page") || 1),
      1
    );

    const limit = Math.min(
      Math.max(
        Number(searchParams.get("limit") || 20),
        1
      ),
      100
    );

    const search = searchParams.get("search") || "";
    const action = searchParams.get("action") || "";
    const moduleName = searchParams.get("module") || "";

    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

    const values = [];
    const conditions = [];

    if (search) {
      values.push(`%${search}%`);

      conditions.push(`
        (
          username ILIKE $${values.length}
          OR description ILIKE $${values.length}
          OR module ILIKE $${values.length}
        )
      `);
    }

    if (action) {
      values.push(action);
      conditions.push(
        `action = $${values.length}`
      );
    }

    if (moduleName) {
      values.push(moduleName);
      conditions.push(
        `module = $${values.length}`
      );
    }

    const where =
      conditions.length > 0
        ? `WHERE ${conditions.join(" AND ")}`
        : "";

    const countResult = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS total
      FROM audit_logs
      ${where}
      `,
      values
    );

    const total = countResult.rows[0].total;

    values.push(limit);
    values.push(offset);

    const result = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        audit_id,
        user_id,
        username,
        action,
        module,
        record_id,
        description,
        old_data,
        new_data,
        ip_address,
        user_agent,
        created_at
      FROM audit_logs
      ${where}
      ORDER BY created_at DESC
      LIMIT $${values.length - 1}
      OFFSET $${values.length}
      `,
      values
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      logs: result.rows,
      pagination: {
        page,
        limit,
        total,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("AUDIT LOG ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load audit logs.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

===== app\api\auth\customers\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_code,
        c.customer_name,
        c.phone,
        c.email,
        c.address,
        c.opening_balance,
        c.credit_limit,
        c.is_active,
        c.created_at,

        COALESCE(
          (
            SELECT SUM(si.total_amount)
            FROM sales_invoices si
            WHERE si.customer_id = c.customer_id
          ),
          0
        ) AS total_sales,

        COALESCE(
          (
            SELECT SUM(sp.amount)
            FROM sales_payments sp
            WHERE sp.customer_id = c.customer_id
          ),
          0
        ) AS total_paid

      FROM customers c
      ORDER BY c.customer_id DESC
    `);

    const customers = result.rows.map((customer) => ({
      ...customer,
      customer_balance:
        Number(customer.opening_balance) +
        Number(customer.total_sales) -
        Number(customer.total_paid),
    }));

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      customers,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("CUSTOMERS GET ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load customers.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const {
      customerCode,
      customerName,
      phone,
      email,
      address,
      openingBalance,
      creditLimit,
      isActive,
    } = body;

    if (!customerCode || !customerName) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Customer code and customer name are required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const result = await pool.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO customers (
        customer_code,
        customer_name,
        phone,
        email,
        address,
        opening_balance,
        credit_limit,
        is_active
      )
      VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8)
      RETURNING *
      `,
      [
        customerCode,
        customerName,
        phone || null,
        email || null,
        address || null,
        Number(openingBalance) || 0,
        Number(creditLimit) || 0,
        isActive !== false,
      ]
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: true,
        message: "Customer created successfully.",
        customer: result.rows[0],
      },
      { status: 201 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("CUSTOMER POST ERROR:", error);

    if (error.code === "23505") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Customer code already exists.",
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to create customer.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

===== app\api\auth\login\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";
import pool from "@/lib/db";
import { createToken } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const username =
      typeof body.username === "string" ? body.username.trim() : "";
    const password = body.password;
    const companyId =
      body.companyId === undefined ||
        body.companyId === null ||
        body.companyId === ""
        ? null
        : Number(body.companyId);

    if (
      !username ||
      typeof password !== "string" ||
      !password ||
      (companyId !== null &&
        (!Number.isSafeInteger(companyId) || companyId <= 0))
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Enter a valid username and password.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const result = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        u.user_id,
        u.full_name,
        u.username,
        u.email,
        u.is_active AS user_is_active,
        uc.company_id,
        uc.role_id,
        uc.company_password_hash,
        c.company_name,
        c.is_active AS company_is_active,
        r.role_name
      FROM users u
      JOIN user_companies uc
        ON uc.user_id = u.user_id
      JOIN companies c
        ON c.company_id = uc.company_id
      JOIN roles r
        ON r.role_id = uc.role_id
      WHERE LOWER(u.username) = LOWER($1)
        AND ($2::integer IS NULL OR uc.company_id = $2)
        AND (
          r.company_id IS NULL
          OR r.company_id = uc.company_id
        )
      ORDER BY uc.company_id
      `,
      [username, companyId]
    );

    const matchingUsers = [];

    for (const user of result.rows) {
      if (
        !user.user_is_active ||
        !user.company_is_active ||
        !user.company_password_hash
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      const passwordMatches = await bcrypt.compare(
        password,
        user.company_password_hash
      );

      if (passwordMatches) {
        matchingUsers.push(user);
      }
    }

    if (matchingUsers.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Invalid username, password, or company access.",
        },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    if (companyId === null) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          code: "COMPANY_SELECTION_REQUIRED",
          message: "Select the company you want to access.",
          companies: matchingUsers.map((user) => ({
            company_id: user.company_id,
            company_name: user.company_name,
          })),
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    const user = matchingUsers[0];

    const loginClient = await pool.connect();

    try {
      await loginClient.query("BEGIN");

      await loginClient.query(
        `
    UPDATE users
    SET last_login = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE user_id = $1
    `,
        [user.user_id]
      );

      await loginClient.query(
        `
    INSERT INTO user_login_history (user_id, company_id)
    VALUES ($1, $2)
    `,
        [user.user_id, user.company_id]
      );

      await loginClient.query("COMMIT");
    } catch (error) {
      await loginClient.query("ROLLBACK");
      throw error;
    } finally {
      loginClient.release();
    }

    // const token = await createToken({
    //   user_id: user.user_id,
    //   username: user.username,
    //   role_id: user.role_id,
    //   role_name: user.role_name,
    //   company_id: user.company_id,
    // });

    const token = await createToken({
      userId: user.user_id,
      username: user.username,
      roleId: user.role_id,
      roleName: user.role_name,
      companyId: user.company_id,
    });

    const response = NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "Login successful.",
      user: {
        userId: user.user_id,
        fullName: user.full_name,
        username: user.username,
        roleName: user.role_name,
        companyId: user.company_id,
        companyName: user.company_name,
      },
    });

    response.cookies.set("erp_token", token, {
      httpOnly: true,
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
      sameSite: "lax",
      maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24,
      path: "/",
    });

    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Login error:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Server error during login.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

===== app\api\auth\my-permissions\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const user = await getCurrentUser();

    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "Unauthorized" },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const result = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        p.permission_key,
        rp.can_view,
        rp.can_create,
        rp.can_update,
        rp.can_delete
      FROM permissions p
      LEFT JOIN role_permissions rp
        ON rp.permission_id = p.permission_id
       AND rp.role_id = $1
      ORDER BY p.permission_key
      `,
      [user.roleId]
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        permissions: result.rows.map((row) => ({
          permission_key: row.permission_key,
          can_view: row.can_view === true,
          can_create: row.can_create === true,
          can_update: row.can_update === true,
          can_delete: row.can_delete === true,
        })),
      },
      {
        headers: {
          "Cache-Control": "no-store",
        },
      }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("My permissions API error:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { message: "Unable to load permissions" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createHash } from "crypto";
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function POST(request) {
  let db;

  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const token = typeof body.token === "string" ? body.token : "";
    const newPassword =
      typeof body.newPassword === "string" ? body.newPassword : "";

    if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(token)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "This reset link is invalid or expired." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (newPassword.length < 12 || newPassword.length > 128) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "Your new password must be between 12 and 128 characters." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const tokenHash = createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");
    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 12);

    db = await pool.connect();
    await db.query("BEGIN");

    const tokenResult = await db.query(
      `SELECT reset_id, user_id, company_id
       FROM password_reset_tokens
       WHERE token_hash = $1
         AND company_id IS NOT NULL
         AND used_at IS NULL
         AND expires_at > NOW()
       FOR UPDATE`,
      [tokenHash]
    );

    if (tokenResult.rowCount === 0) {
      await db.query("ROLLBACK");

      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "This reset link is invalid, expired, or already used." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const reset = tokenResult.rows[0];

    const updateResult = await db.query(
      `UPDATE user_companies uc
       SET company_password_hash = $1
       FROM users u, companies c
       WHERE uc.user_id = $2
         AND uc.company_id = $3
         AND u.user_id = uc.user_id
         AND c.company_id = uc.company_id
         AND u.is_active = TRUE
         AND c.is_active = TRUE
       RETURNING uc.user_id`,
      [passwordHash, reset.user_id, reset.company_id]
    );

    if (updateResult.rowCount === 0) {
      await db.query("ROLLBACK");

      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "This account or company is no longer active." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // Consume every outstanding reset link for this user/company pair.
    await db.query(
      `UPDATE password_reset_tokens
       SET used_at = NOW()
       WHERE user_id = $1
         AND company_id = $2
         AND used_at IS NULL`,
      [reset.user_id, reset.company_id]
    );

    await db.query("COMMIT");

    return NextResponse.json({
      message: "Your company password has been changed. You can now log in.",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (db) {
      await db.query("ROLLBACK").catch(() => {});
    }

    console.error("Password reset completion failed:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { message: "Unable to reset the password. Please try again." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    db?.release();
  }
}

===== app\api\auth\password-reset\request\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function POST(request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const username =
      typeof body.username === "string" ? body.username.trim() : "";
    const companyId = Number(body.companyId);

    if (!username || !Number.isInteger(companyId) || companyId < 1) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "Enter a username and select a valid company." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // Check that this active user belongs to the selected active company.
    const accountResult = await pool.query(
      `SELECT
         u.user_id,
         u.username,
         u.full_name,
         u.email,
         uc.company_id,
         c.company_name
       FROM users u
       INNER JOIN user_companies uc
         ON uc.user_id = u.user_id
       INNER JOIN companies c
         ON c.company_id = uc.company_id
       WHERE LOWER(u.username) = LOWER($1)
         AND uc.company_id = $2
         AND u.is_active = TRUE
         AND c.is_active = TRUE
       LIMIT 1`,
      [username, companyId]
    );

    // Use the same public response for unknown accounts to reduce
    // account enumeration. Do not disclose whether a username exists.
    const genericMessage =
      "If the account matches this company, the reset request will be reviewed by the administrator.";

    if (accountResult.rowCount === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ message: genericMessage });
    }

    const account = accountResult.rows[0];

    const superAdminUrl = process.env.SUPER_ADMIN_API_URL?.replace(/\/+$/, "");
    const sharedSecret = process.env.CLIENT_DATA_API_SECRET;
    const clientId = Number(process.env.LICENSE_CLIENT_ID);

    if (
      !superAdminUrl ||
      !sharedSecret ||
      !Number.isInteger(clientId) ||
      clientId < 1
    ) {
      console.error("Password reset request integration is not configured.");
      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "Password reset requests are temporarily unavailable." },
        { status: 503 }
      );
    }

    const description = [
      "Password reset requested from the company login page.",
      `Username: ${account.username}`,
      `Company: ${account.company_name}`,
      `Company ID: ${account.company_id}`,
      `User ID: ${account.user_id}`,
      "No email address was provided. Verify the requester's identity before approval.",
    ].join("\n");

    const superAdminResponse = await fetch(
      `${superAdminUrl}/api/public/support-requests`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "x-client-data-secret": sharedSecret,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          clientId,
          companyId: account.company_id,
          requesterUserId: account.user_id,
          category: "password_reset",
          companyName: account.company_name,
          requesterName: account.full_name || account.username,
          requesterEmail: account.email || null,
          subject: "Company password reset request",
          description,
        }),
        cache: "no-store",
      }
    );

    if (!superAdminResponse.ok) {
      const errorText = await superAdminResponse.text().catch(() => "");
      console.error(
        "Super Admin rejected password reset request:",
        superAdminResponse.status,
        errorText.slice(0, 500)
      );

      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "The request could not be forwarded. Please try again later." },
        { status: 502 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ message: genericMessage });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Password reset request API failed:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { message: "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

===== app\api\cash-bank\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        j.journal_id,
        j.journal_number,
        j.journal_date,
        j.description,
        l.journal_line_id,
        l.account_id,
        a.account_code,
        a.account_name,
        l.debit,
        l.credit
      FROM journal_entries j
      INNER JOIN journal_entry_lines l
        ON l.journal_id = j.journal_id
      INNER JOIN chart_of_accounts a
        ON a.account_id = l.account_id
      WHERE a.is_cash_bank = TRUE
      ORDER BY
        j.journal_date DESC,
        j.journal_id DESC,
        l.journal_line_id DESC
    `);

    let balance = 0;

    const transactions = result.rows.map((row) => {
      const debit = Number(row.debit) || 0;
      const credit = Number(row.credit) || 0;

      balance += debit - credit;

      return {
        ...row,
        debit,
        credit,
        balance,
      };
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      transactions,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("CASH BANK GET ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load cash/bank transactions.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request) {
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const {
      accountId,
      transactionType,
      date,
      amount,
      referenceNumber,
      description,
    } = body;

    if (!accountId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Cash/Bank account is required." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!["RECEIPT", "PAYMENT"].includes(transactionType)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Invalid transaction type." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!date) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Date is required." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const transactionAmount = Number(amount);

    if (!Number.isFinite(transactionAmount) || transactionAmount <= 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Amount must be greater than zero." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    await client.query("BEGIN");

    // Make sure selected account exists and is a cash/bank account.
    const accountResult = await client.query(
      `
      SELECT
        account_id,
        account_code,
        account_name,
        account_type,
        is_active,
        is_group,
        is_cash_bank
      FROM chart_of_accounts
      WHERE account_id = $1
      `,
      [accountId]
    );

    const account = accountResult.rows[0];

    if (!account) {
      throw new Error("Selected account does not exist.");
    }

    if (!account.is_active) {
      throw new Error("Selected account is inactive.");
    }

    if (account.is_group) {
      throw new Error(
        `"${account.account_name}" is a group account. Please select a posting account.`
      );
    }

    if (!account.is_cash_bank) {
      throw new Error(
        `"${account.account_name}" is not configured as a Cash/Bank account.`
      );
    }

    /*
      Receipt:
        Cash/Bank  DEBIT
        Other      CREDIT

      Payment:
        Other      DEBIT
        Cash/Bank  CREDIT

      For the Cash/Bank transaction itself, we create the
      corresponding journal entry with a temporary
      "General Expenses" / "General Income" counterpart.

      This is suitable for basic standalone cash/bank
      transactions. Later we can connect receipts/payments
      directly to customers, suppliers and invoices.
    */

    let counterpartResult;

    if (transactionType === "RECEIPT") {
      counterpartResult = await client.query(
        `
        SELECT account_id, account_name
        FROM chart_of_accounts
        WHERE account_code = '4100'
          AND is_active = TRUE
        LIMIT 1
        `
      );
    } else {
      counterpartResult = await client.query(
        `
        SELECT account_id, account_name
        FROM chart_of_accounts
        WHERE account_code = '5200'
          AND is_active = TRUE
        LIMIT 1
        `
      );
    }

    const counterpart = counterpartResult.rows[0];

    if (!counterpart) {
      throw new Error(
        transactionType === "RECEIPT"
          ? "Sales Revenue account (4100) was not found."
          : "General Expenses account (5200) was not found."
      );
    }

    const journalNumber = `CB-${Date.now()}`;

    const journalResult = await client.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO journal_entries
      (
        journal_number,
        journal_date,
        reference_type,
        description,
        status
      )
      VALUES ($1, $2, 'CASH_BANK', $3, 'POSTED')
      RETURNING *
      `,
      [
        journalNumber,
        date,
        description?.trim() ||
          `${transactionType === "RECEIPT" ? "Cash receipt" : "Cash payment"}${
            referenceNumber ? ` - ${referenceNumber}` : ""
          }`,
      ]
    );

    const journal = journalResult.rows[0];

    if (transactionType === "RECEIPT") {
      // Cash/Bank Debit
      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO journal_entry_lines
        (
          journal_id,
          account_id,
          description,
          debit,
          credit
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 0)
        `,
        [
          journal.journal_id,
          account.account_id,
          description?.trim() || "Cash receipt",
          transactionAmount,
        ]
      );

      // Revenue Credit
      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO journal_entry_lines
        (
          journal_id,
          account_id,
          description,
          debit,
          credit
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 0, $4)
        `,
        [
          journal.journal_id,
          counterpart.account_id,
          description?.trim() || "Cash receipt",
          transactionAmount,
        ]
      );
    } else {
      // Expense Debit
      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO journal_entry_lines
        (
          journal_id,
          account_id,
          description,
          debit,
          credit
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 0)
        `,
        [
          journal.journal_id,
          counterpart.account_id,
          description?.trim() || "Cash payment",
          transactionAmount,
        ]
      );

      // Cash/Bank Credit
      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO journal_entry_lines
        (
          journal_id,
          account_id,
          description,
          debit,
          credit
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 0, $4)
        `,
        [
          journal.journal_id,
          account.account_id,
          description?.trim() || "Cash payment",
          transactionAmount,
        ]
      );
    }

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: true,
        message: "Cash/Bank transaction saved successfully.",
        journal,
      },
      { status: 201 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query("ROLLBACK");

    console.error("CASH BANK POST ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message:
          error.message || "Failed to save cash/bank transaction.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const validTypes = ["RECEIPT", "PAYMENT"];

// Get available cash and bank accounts, plus possible
// counter accounts for the Cash In / Cash Out form.
export async function GET() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        account_id,
        account_code,
        account_name,
        account_type,
        is_active,
        is_group,
        is_cash_bank
      FROM chart_of_accounts
      WHERE is_active = TRUE
      ORDER BY account_code
    `);

    const accounts = result.rows;

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      cashAccounts: accounts.filter(
        (account) =>
          account.is_cash_bank === true &&
          account.is_group === false
      ),
      counterAccounts: accounts.filter(
        (account) =>
          account.is_cash_bank !== true &&
          account.is_group === false
      ),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Cash movement accounts error:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to load accounts." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// Create a Cash In (RECEIPT) or Cash Out (PAYMENT) journal entry.
export async function POST(request) {
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const {
      accountId,
      counterAccountId,
      transactionType,
      amount,
      date,
      description,
      referenceNumber,
    } = body;

    const cashAccountId = Number(accountId);
    const otherAccountId = Number(counterAccountId);
    const transactionAmount = Number(amount);

    if (
      !Number.isInteger(cashAccountId) ||
      cashAccountId <= 0 ||
      !Number.isInteger(otherAccountId) ||
      otherAccountId <= 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Select a valid cash/bank account and counter account." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (cashAccountId === otherAccountId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Cash/bank account and counter account must be different." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!validTypes.includes(transactionType)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Transaction type must be RECEIPT or PAYMENT." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(transactionAmount) ||
      transactionAmount <= 0 ||
      !Number.isFinite(Math.round(transactionAmount * 100) / 100) ||
      Math.round(transactionAmount * 100) / 100 !== transactionAmount
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Enter a valid amount with up to two decimal places." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!date || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(date))) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "A valid transaction date is required." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!description || !String(description).trim()) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Please enter a description." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    await client.query("BEGIN");

    // Lock both accounts and verify they are active leaf accounts.
    const accountResult = await client.query(
      `
        SELECT
          account_id,
          account_code,
          account_name,
          account_type,
          is_active,
          is_group,
          is_cash_bank
        FROM chart_of_accounts
        WHERE account_id = ANY($1::integer[])
        ORDER BY account_id
        FOR UPDATE
      `,
      [[cashAccountId, otherAccountId]]
    );

    if (accountResult.rows.length !== 2) {
      throw new Error("One or both selected accounts do not exist.");
    }

    const cashAccount = accountResult.rows.find(
      (account) => account.account_id === cashAccountId
    );

    const counterAccount = accountResult.rows.find(
      (account) => account.account_id === otherAccountId
    );

    if (
      !cashAccount.is_active ||
      cashAccount.is_group ||
      !cashAccount.is_cash_bank
    ) {
      throw new Error("Select an active cash or bank ledger account.");
    }

    if (
      !counterAccount.is_active ||
      counterAccount.is_group ||
      counterAccount.is_cash_bank
    ) {
      throw new Error("Select an active, non-cash/bank counter account.");
    }

    const journalNumber = `CB-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(
      Math.random() * 1000
    )}`;

    const prefix =
      transactionType === "RECEIPT" ? "Cash In" : "Cash Out";

    const fullDescription = `${prefix}: ${String(description).trim()}`;

    // Create the journal header.
    const journalResult = await client.query(
      `
        INSERT INTO journal_entries (
          journal_number,
          journal_date,
          reference_type,
          description,
          status
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, 'CASH_BANK', $3, 'POSTED')
        RETURNING journal_id, journal_number
      `,
      [journalNumber, date, fullDescription]
    );

    const journal = journalResult.rows[0];

    // Receipt: debit cash/bank, credit counter account.
    // Payment: debit counter account, credit cash/bank.
    const lines =
      transactionType === "RECEIPT"
        ? [
            {
              accountId: cashAccountId,
              description: fullDescription,
              debit: transactionAmount,
              credit: 0,
            },
            {
              accountId: otherAccountId,
              description: fullDescription,
              debit: 0,
              credit: transactionAmount,
            },
          ]
        : [
            {
              accountId: otherAccountId,
              description: fullDescription,
              debit: transactionAmount,
              credit: 0,
            },
            {
              accountId: cashAccountId,
              description: fullDescription,
              debit: 0,
              credit: transactionAmount,
            },
          ];

    for (const line of lines) {
      await client.query(
        `
          INSERT INTO journal_entry_lines (
            journal_id,
            account_id,
            description,
            debit,
            credit
          )
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
        `,
        [
          journal.journal_id,
          line.accountId,
          line.description,
          line.debit,
          line.credit,
        ]
      );

      // Update the account's current balance using its normal balance.
      // Assets/expenses: debit increases the balance.
      // Liabilities/equity/revenue: credit increases the balance.
      const account = accountResult.rows.find(
        (item) => item.account_id === line.accountId
      );

      const debitNormal = ["ASSET", "EXPENSE"].includes(
        String(account.account_type).toUpperCase()
      );

      const balanceChange = debitNormal
        ? line.debit - line.credit
        : line.credit - line.debit;

      await client.query(
        `
          UPDATE chart_of_accounts
          SET
            current_balance = COALESCE(current_balance, 0) + $1,
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
          WHERE account_id = $2
        `,
        [balanceChange, line.accountId]
      );
    }

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: true,
        message:
          transactionType === "RECEIPT"
            ? "Cash In recorded successfully."
            : "Cash Out recorded successfully.",
        journalId: journal.journal_id,
        journalNumber: journal.journal_number,
      },
      { status: 201 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query("ROLLBACK");

    console.error("Cash movement error:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error.message || "Failed to record cash movement." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}
