===== app\api\internal\support\accounts\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { timingSafeEqual } from "crypto";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function reply(data, status = 200) {
  return NextResponse.json(data, {
    status,
    headers: {
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
      Pragma: "no-cache",
    },
  });
}

function secretsMatch(expected, supplied) {
  if (
    typeof expected !== "string" ||
    typeof supplied !== "string" ||
    !expected ||
    !supplied
  ) return false;

  const a = Buffer.from(expected, "utf8");
  const b = Buffer.from(supplied, "utf8");

  return a.length === b.length && timingSafeEqual(a, b);
}

export async function GET(request) {
  if (!secretsMatch(
    process.env.CLIENT_DATA_API_SECRET,
    request.headers.get("x-client-data-secret")
  )) {
    return reply({ success: false, message: "Unauthorized." }, 401);
  }

  try {
    const params = new URL(request.url).searchParams;
    const rawCompanyId = params.get("companyId");

    if (rawCompanyId === null) {
      const result = await pool.query(
        `SELECT company_id, company_name
         FROM companies
         WHERE is_active = TRUE
         ORDER BY company_name`
      );

      return reply({ success: true, companies: result.rows });
    }

    if (!/^[1-9]\d*$/.test(rawCompanyId)) {
      return reply({ success: false, message: "Invalid company ID." }, 400);
    }

    const companyId = Number(rawCompanyId);

    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(companyId)) {
      return reply({ success: false, message: "Invalid company ID." }, 400);
    }

    const companyResult = await pool.query(
      `SELECT company_id
       FROM companies
       WHERE company_id = $1 AND is_active = TRUE
       LIMIT 1`,
      [companyId]
    );

    if (!companyResult.rowCount) {
      return reply({ success: false, message: "Active company not found." }, 404);
    }

    const usersResult = await pool.query(
      `SELECT
         u.user_id,
         u.full_name,
         u.username,
         u.email,
         uc.role_id,
         r.role_name
       FROM user_companies uc
       INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = uc.user_id
       INNER JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = uc.role_id
       WHERE uc.company_id = $1
         AND u.is_active = TRUE
         AND (r.company_id IS NULL OR r.company_id = uc.company_id)
       ORDER BY u.full_name, u.username`,
      [companyId]
    );

    return reply({ success: true, users: usersResult.rows });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Internal account listing failed:", {
      message: error.message,
      code: error.code,
    });

    return reply({ success: false, message: "Unable to load client accounts." }, 500);
  }
}


===== app\api\internal\support\password-reset\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  randomBytes,
  createHash,
  timingSafeEqual,
} from "crypto";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function jsonResponse(data, status = 200) {
  return NextResponse.json(data, {
    status,
    headers: {
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
      Pragma: "no-cache",
    },
  });
}

function secretsMatch(expected, supplied) {
  if (
    typeof expected !== "string" ||
    typeof supplied !== "string" ||
    !expected ||
    !supplied
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(expected, "utf8");
  const suppliedBuffer = Buffer.from(supplied, "utf8");

  return (
    expectedBuffer.length === suppliedBuffer.length &&
    timingSafeEqual(expectedBuffer, suppliedBuffer)
  );
}

function getConfiguredAppUrl() {
  const configuredUrl = process.env.CLIENT_APP_URL;

  if (!configuredUrl) {
    throw new Error("CLIENT_APP_URL is not configured.");
  }

  const appUrl = new URL(configuredUrl);

  if (
    !["http:", "https:"].includes(appUrl.protocol) ||
    appUrl.username ||
    appUrl.password ||
    appUrl.search ||
    appUrl.hash
  ) {
    throw new Error("CLIENT_APP_URL is invalid.");
  }

  if (
    process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" &&
    appUrl.protocol !== "https:"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Production reset links must use HTTPS."
    );
  }

  // Preserve any configured application base path.
  appUrl.pathname = `${appUrl.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/`;

  return appUrl;
}

export async function POST(request) {
  // Authenticate the Super Admin server-to-server request.
  const expectedSecret = process.env.CLIENT_DATA_API_SECRET;
  const suppliedSecret = request.headers.get(
    "x-client-data-secret"
  );

  if (!secretsMatch(expectedSecret, suppliedSecret)) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Unauthorized.",
      },
      401
    );
  }

  let db;
  let transactionStarted = false;

  try {
    let body;

    try {
      body = await request.json();
    } catch {
      return jsonResponse(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "A valid JSON request body is required.",
        },
        400
      );
    }

    const userId = Number(body?.userId);
    const companyId = Number(body?.companyId);

    if (
      !Number.isSafeInteger(userId) ||
      userId < 1 ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(companyId) ||
      companyId < 1
    ) {
      return jsonResponse(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "A valid user and company are required.",
        },
        400
      );
    }

    let appUrl;

    try {
      appUrl = getConfiguredAppUrl();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Password reset URL configuration error:", {
        message: error.message,
      });

      return jsonResponse(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Client application URL is missing or invalid. Check CLIENT_APP_URL in .env.local.",
        },
        500
      );
    }

    // Confirm that the user belongs to this active company.
    // The current database uses integer IDs for these tables.
    const accountResult = await pool.query(
      `SELECT
         u.user_id,
         u.username,
         u.full_name,
         uc.company_id
       FROM users AS u
       INNER JOIN user_companies AS uc
         ON uc.user_id = u.user_id
       INNER JOIN companies AS c
         ON c.company_id = uc.company_id
       WHERE u.user_id = $1
         AND uc.company_id = $2
         AND u.is_active = TRUE
         AND c.is_active = TRUE
       LIMIT 1`,
      [userId, companyId]
    );

    if (accountResult.rowCount === 0) {
      return jsonResponse(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "The user does not belong to this active company.",
        },
        404
      );
    }

    // Generate a cryptographically secure, single-use token.
    // Never store the original token in PostgreSQL.
    const rawToken = randomBytes(32).toString("hex");

    const tokenHash = createHash("sha256")
      .update(rawToken, "utf8")
      .digest("hex");

    db = await pool.connect();

    await db.query("BEGIN");
    transactionStarted = true;

    // Serialize token creation for this user/company pair.
    // PostgreSQL advisory locks accept two signed 32-bit integer keys.
    await db.query(
      `SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock($1::integer, $2::integer)`,
      [userId, companyId]
    );

    // Invalidate existing unused tokens for this user/company.
    await db.query(
      `UPDATE password_reset_tokens
       SET used_at = NOW()
       WHERE user_id = $1
         AND company_id = $2
         AND used_at IS NULL`,
      [userId, companyId]
    );

    // Insert the new token with a 30-minute expiry.
    // reset_id is assumed to be generated by the database.
    await db.query(
      `INSERT INTO password_reset_tokens (
         user_id,
         company_id,
         token_hash,
         expires_at,
         created_at,
         used_at
       )
       VALUES (
         $1,
         $2,
         $3,
         NOW() + INTERVAL '30 minutes',
         NOW(),
         NULL
       )`,
      [userId, companyId, tokenHash]
    );

    await db.query("COMMIT");
    transactionStarted = false;

    // Build the link after the database transaction succeeds.
    const resetPageUrl = new URL("reset-password", appUrl);
    resetPageUrl.searchParams.set("token", rawToken);

    return jsonResponse({
      success: true,
      message: "Reset link generated.",
      resetUrl: resetPageUrl.toString(),
      expiresInMinutes: 30,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (db && transactionStarted) {
      try {
        await db.query("ROLLBACK");
      } catch (rollbackError) {
        console.error("Password reset rollback failed:", {
          message: rollbackError.message,
          code: rollbackError.code,
        });
      }

      transactionStarted = false;
    }

    // Diagnostic details go to the server terminal only.
    // Never expose database internals or the token to the caller.
    console.error(
      "Internal password reset generation failed:",
      {
        message: error.message,
        code: error.code,
        detail: error.detail,
        constraint: error.constraint,
        table: error.table,
        column: error.column,
        where: error.where,
      }
    );

    return jsonResponse(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Unable to generate the reset link.",
      },
      500
    );
  } finally {
    db?.release();
  }
}

===== app\api\internal\support\password-reset\direct\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { timingSafeEqual } from "crypto";
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function jsonResponse(data, status = 200) {
  return NextResponse.json(data, {
    status,
    headers: {
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
      Pragma: "no-cache",
    },
  });
}

function secretsMatch(expected, supplied) {
  if (
    typeof expected !== "string" ||
    typeof supplied !== "string" ||
    !expected ||
    !supplied
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  const a = Buffer.from(expected, "utf8");
  const b = Buffer.from(supplied, "utf8");

  return a.length === b.length && timingSafeEqual(a, b);
}

export async function POST(request) {
  // Only an authorized server-to-server request may reset passwords.
  if (
    !secretsMatch(
      process.env.CLIENT_DATA_API_SECRET,
      request.headers.get("x-client-data-secret")
    )
  ) {
    return jsonResponse(
      { success: false, message: "Unauthorized." },
      401
    );
  }

  let body;

  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return jsonResponse(
      { success: false, message: "Invalid JSON request." },
      400
    );
  }

  const userId = Number(body?.userId);
  const companyId = Number(body?.companyId);
  const newPassword = body?.newPassword;

  if (
    !Number.isSafeInteger(userId) ||
    userId < 1 ||
    !Number.isSafeInteger(companyId) ||
    companyId < 1
  ) {
    return jsonResponse(
      { success: false, message: "Valid user and company IDs are required." },
      400
    );
  }

  if (
    typeof newPassword !== "string" ||
    newPassword.length < 12 ||
    newPassword.length > 128
  ) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "The new password must be 12â€“128 characters long.",
      },
      400
    );
  }

  let db;

  try {
    // Hash the password on the server; never store it as plain text.
    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 12);

    db = await pool.connect();
    await db.query("BEGIN");

    // Lock the company-specific membership row while changing credentials.
    const account = await db.query(
      `SELECT
         u.user_id,
         uc.company_id
       FROM users u
       INNER JOIN user_companies uc
         ON uc.user_id = u.user_id
       INNER JOIN companies c
         ON c.company_id = uc.company_id
       WHERE u.user_id = $1
         AND uc.company_id = $2
         AND u.is_active = TRUE
         AND c.is_active = TRUE
       FOR UPDATE OF uc`,
      [userId, companyId]
    );

    if (account.rowCount === 0) {
      await db.query("ROLLBACK");

      return jsonResponse(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "The user does not belong to this active company.",
        },
        404
      );
    }

    // This is the password field checked by the existing company login.
    const updated = await db.query(
      `UPDATE user_companies
       SET company_password_hash = $1
       WHERE user_id = $2
         AND company_id = $3
       RETURNING user_id`,
      [passwordHash, userId, companyId]
    );

    if (updated.rowCount !== 1) {
      throw new Error("Company password update did not affect one row.");
    }

    // Invalidate outstanding reset links for this same account/company.
    await db.query(
      `UPDATE password_reset_tokens
       SET used_at = NOW()
       WHERE user_id = $1
         AND company_id = $2
         AND used_at IS NULL`,
      [userId, companyId]
    );

    await db.query("COMMIT");

    console.info("Support password reset completed", {
      userId,
      companyId,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    return jsonResponse({
      success: true,
      message: "Password updated successfully.",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (db) {
      try {
        await db.query("ROLLBACK");
      } catch {}
    }

    console.error("Direct support password reset failed:", {
      message: error.message,
      code: error.code,
    });

    return jsonResponse(
      { success: false, message: "Unable to reset the password." },
      500
    );
  } finally {
    db?.release();
  }
}


===== app\api\items-ledger\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(request) {
    try {
        const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);

        const productId = searchParams.get("productId");
        const fromDate = searchParams.get("fromDate");
        const toDate = searchParams.get("toDate");
        const locationParam = searchParams.get("location");

        // Treat empty string and "All Locations" as no location filter
        const location =
            locationParam &&
            locationParam !== "All Locations"
                ? locationParam.trim()
                : "";

        // --------------------------------------------------
        // VALIDATION
        // --------------------------------------------------

        if (!productId) {
            return NextResponse.json(
                {
                    success: false,
                    message: "Product ID is required.",
                },
                { status: 400 }
            );
        }

        if (!fromDate || !toDate) {
            return NextResponse.json(
                {
                    success: false,
                    message:
                        "From Date and To Date are required.",
                },
                { status: 400 }
            );
        }

        if (fromDate > toDate) {
            return NextResponse.json(
                {
                    success: false,
                    message:
                        "From Date cannot be greater than To Date.",
                },
                { status: 400 }
            );
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------
        // PRODUCT
        // --------------------------------------------------

        const productResult = await pool.query(
            `
            SELECT
                product_id,
                sku,
                product_name,
                unit,
                minimum_stock
            FROM products
            WHERE product_id = $1
            `,
            [Number(productId)]
        );

        if (productResult.rows.length === 0) {
            return NextResponse.json(
                {
                    success: false,
                    message: "Product not found.",
                },
                { status: 404 }
            );
        }

        const product = productResult.rows[0];

        // --------------------------------------------------
        // TRANSACTION QUERY
        // --------------------------------------------------

        let transactionQuery = `
            SELECT
                inventory_transaction_id,
                product_id,
                transaction_date,
                transaction_type,
                transaction_number,
                location,
                uom,
                memo,
                transaction_rate,
                old_rate,
                actual_rate,
                new_rate,
                receive_quantity,
                receive_rate,
                receive_amount,
                issue_quantity,
                issue_rate,
                issue_amount
            FROM inventory_transactions
            WHERE product_id = $1
              AND transaction_date >= $2::DATE
              AND transaction_date <= $3::DATE
        `;

        const transactionParams = [
            Number(productId),
            fromDate,
            toDate,
        ];

        if (location) {
            transactionQuery += `
                AND TRIM(location) = TRIM($4)
            `;

            transactionParams.push(location);
        }

        transactionQuery += `
            ORDER BY
                transaction_date ASC,
                inventory_transaction_id ASC
        `;

        console.log(
            "ITEMS LEDGER QUERY:",
            transactionQuery
        );

        console.log(
            "ITEMS LEDGER PARAMS:",
            transactionParams
        );

        const transactionsResult =
            await pool.query(
                transactionQuery,
                transactionParams
            );

        // --------------------------------------------------
        // OPENING BALANCE
        // --------------------------------------------------

        let openingQuery = `
            SELECT
                COALESCE(
                    SUM(
                        COALESCE(receive_quantity, 0)
                        -
                        COALESCE(issue_quantity, 0)
                    ),
                    0
                ) AS opening_quantity
            FROM inventory_transactions
            WHERE product_id = $1
              AND transaction_date < $2::DATE
        `;

        const openingParams = [
            Number(productId),
            fromDate,
        ];

        if (location) {
            openingQuery += `
                AND TRIM(location) = TRIM($3)
            `;

            openingParams.push(location);
        }

        const openingResult =
            await pool.query(
                openingQuery,
                openingParams
            );

        let openingQuantity =
            Number(
                openingResult.rows[0]
                    ?.opening_quantity
            ) || 0;

        // --------------------------------------------------
        // PERIOD TRANSACTIONS
        // --------------------------------------------------

        const periodRows =
            transactionsResult.rows;

        // --------------------------------------------------
        // OPENING BALANCE TRANSACTION
        //
        // An OPENING BALANCE on the From Date should
        // become opening stock and should not be counted
        // again as a period receipt.
        // --------------------------------------------------

        const openingBalanceRows =
            periodRows.filter(
                (row) =>
                    String(
                        row.transaction_type || ""
                    )
                        .trim()
                        .toUpperCase() ===
                    "OPENING BALANCE"
            );

        if (
            openingBalanceRows.length > 0
        ) {
            const openingBalanceQuantity =
                openingBalanceRows.reduce(
                    (sum, row) => {
                        const receive =
                            Number(
                                row.receive_quantity
                            ) || 0;

                        const issue =
                            Number(
                                row.issue_quantity
                            ) || 0;

                        return (
                            sum +
                            receive -
                            issue
                        );
                    },
                    0
                );

            openingQuantity +=
                openingBalanceQuantity;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------
        // RUNNING TOTAL
        // --------------------------------------------------

        let runningTotal =
            openingQuantity;

        let receivedQuantity = 0;
        let issuedQuantity = 0;

        let receiveAmount = 0;
        let issueAmount = 0;

        const transactions = [];

        for (const row of periodRows) {
            const transactionType =
                String(
                    row.transaction_type || ""
                )
                    .trim()
                    .toUpperCase();

            const isOpeningBalance =
                transactionType ===
                "OPENING BALANCE";

            const receiveQuantity =
                Number(
                    row.receive_quantity
                ) || 0;

            const issueQuantity =
                Number(
                    row.issue_quantity
                ) || 0;

            const rowReceiveAmount =
                Number(
                    row.receive_amount
                ) || 0;

            const rowIssueAmount =
                Number(
                    row.issue_amount
                ) || 0;

            // ----------------------------------------------
            // Don't count opening balance twice
            // ----------------------------------------------

            if (!isOpeningBalance) {
                receivedQuantity +=
                    receiveQuantity;

                issuedQuantity +=
                    issueQuantity;

                receiveAmount +=
                    rowReceiveAmount;

                issueAmount +=
                    rowIssueAmount;

                runningTotal +=
                    receiveQuantity -
                    issueQuantity;
            }

            transactions.push({
                inventory_transaction_id:
                    row.inventory_transaction_id,

                product_id:
                    row.product_id,

                transaction_date:
                    row.transaction_date,

                transaction_type:
                    row.transaction_type,

                transaction_number:
                    row.transaction_number,

                location:
                    row.location,

                uom:
                    row.uom,

                memo:
                    row.memo,

                transaction_rate:
                    Number(
                        row.transaction_rate
                    ) || 0,

                old_rate:
                    Number(
                        row.old_rate
                    ) || 0,

                actual_rate:
                    Number(
                        row.actual_rate
                    ) || 0,

                new_rate:
                    Number(
                        row.new_rate
                    ) || 0,

                receive_quantity:
                    receiveQuantity,

                receive_rate:
                    Number(
                        row.receive_rate
                    ) || 0,

                receive_amount:
                    rowReceiveAmount,

                issue_quantity:
                    issueQuantity,

                issue_rate:
                    Number(
                        row.issue_rate
                    ) || 0,

                issue_amount:
                    rowIssueAmount,

                running_total:
                    runningTotal,
            });
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------
        // RESPONSE
        // --------------------------------------------------

        return NextResponse.json(
            {
                success: true,

                product: {
                    product_id:
                        product.product_id,

                    sku:
                        product.sku,

                    product_name:
                        product.product_name,

                    unit:
                        product.unit,

                    minimum_stock:
                        Number(
                            product.minimum_stock
                        ) || 0,
                },

                opening_quantity:
                    openingQuantity,

                closing_quantity:
                    runningTotal,

                transactions,

                totals: {
                    opening_quantity:
                        openingQuantity,

                    received_quantity:
                        receivedQuantity,

                    issued_quantity:
                        issuedQuantity,

                    receive_amount:
                        receiveAmount,

                    issue_amount:
                        issueAmount,

                    current_stock:
                        runningTotal,
                },
            },
            {
                headers: {
                    "Cache-Control":
                        "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate",
                },
            }
        );
    } catch (error) {
        console.error(
            "ITEMS LEDGER GET ERROR:",
            error
        );

        return NextResponse.json(
            {
                success: false,
                message:
                    "Failed to load items ledger.",
                error:
                    error.message,
            },
            { status: 500 }
        );
    }
}

===== app\api\journal-entries\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

// =====================================================
// GET JOURNAL ENTRIES
//
// GET /api/journal-entries
// GET /api/journal-entries?id=1
// =====================================================

export async function GET(request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const id = searchParams.get("id");

    // ===================================================
    // GET SINGLE JOURNAL
    // ===================================================

    if (id) {
      const journalId = Number(id);

      if (
        !Number.isInteger(journalId) ||
        journalId <= 0
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            message: "Invalid journal ID.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const journalResult = await pool.query(
        `
        SELECT
          j.journal_id,
          j.journal_number,
          j.journal_date,
          j.description,
          j.reference_type,
          j.reference_id,
          j.status,
          j.created_at,

          COALESCE(
            SUM(ji.debit),
            0
          ) AS total_debit,

          COALESCE(
            SUM(ji.credit),
            0
          ) AS total_credit

        FROM journal_entries j

        LEFT JOIN journal_entry_lines ji
          ON ji.journal_id = j.journal_id

        WHERE j.journal_id = $1

        GROUP BY
          j.journal_id
        `,
        [journalId]
      );

      if (journalResult.rows.length === 0) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            message: "Journal entry not found.",
          },
          { status: 404 }
        );
      }

      // =================================================
      // GET JOURNAL LINES
      // =================================================

      const linesResult = await pool.query(
        `
        SELECT
          ji.journal_line_id,
          ji.journal_id,

          ji.entity_name,

          ji.account_id,
          ji.description,
          ji.debit,
          ji.credit,

          a.account_code,
          a.account_name

        FROM journal_entry_lines ji

        INNER JOIN chart_of_accounts a
          ON a.account_id = ji.account_id

        WHERE ji.journal_id = $1

        ORDER BY
          ji.journal_line_id ASC
        `,
        [journalId]
      );

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        journal: journalResult.rows[0],
        lines: linesResult.rows,
      });
    }

    // ===================================================
    // GET ALL JOURNALS
    // ===================================================

    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        j.journal_id,
        j.journal_number,
        j.journal_date,
        j.description,
        j.reference_type,
        j.reference_id,
        j.status,
        j.created_at,

        COALESCE(
          SUM(ji.debit),
          0
        ) AS total_debit,

        COALESCE(
          SUM(ji.credit),
          0
        ) AS total_credit

      FROM journal_entries j

      LEFT JOIN journal_entry_lines ji
        ON ji.journal_id = j.journal_id

      GROUP BY
        j.journal_id

      ORDER BY
        j.journal_id DESC
    `);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      journals: result.rows,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "JOURNAL GET ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message:
          "Failed to load journal entries.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// =====================================================
// CREATE JOURNAL
// POST /api/journal-entries
// =====================================================

export async function POST(request) {
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const {
      journalNumber,
      journalDate,
      description,
      referenceType,
      referenceId,
      items,
    } = body;

    // ===================================================
    // VALIDATE LINES
    // ===================================================

    if (
      !items ||
      !Array.isArray(items) ||
      items.length < 2
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "At least two journal lines are required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    let totalDebit = 0;
    let totalCredit = 0;

    for (const item of items) {
      const debit =
        Number(item.debit) || 0;

      const credit =
        Number(item.credit) || 0;

      if (!item.accountId) {
        throw new Error(
          "Every journal line requires an account."
        );
      }

      if (debit > 0 && credit > 0) {
        throw new Error(
          "A journal line cannot contain both debit and credit."
        );
      }

      if (debit <= 0 && credit <= 0) {
        throw new Error(
          "Every journal line must have a debit or credit amount."
        );
      }

      totalDebit += debit;
      totalCredit += credit;
    }

    // ===================================================
    // CHECK BALANCE
    // ===================================================

    if (
      Math.abs(
        totalDebit - totalCredit
      ) > 0.01
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `Journal is not balanced. Debit: ${totalDebit.toFixed(
          2
        )}, Credit: ${totalCredit.toFixed(
          2
        )}`
      );
    }

    await client.query("BEGIN");

    // ===================================================
    // JOURNAL NUMBER
    // ===================================================

    let finalJournalNumber =
      journalNumber?.trim();

    if (!finalJournalNumber) {
      finalJournalNumber =
        `JV-${Date.now()}`;
    }

    // ===================================================
    // CHECK DUPLICATE NUMBER
    // ===================================================

    const existing =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT journal_id
        FROM journal_entries
        WHERE journal_number = $1
        `,
        [finalJournalNumber]
      );

    if (existing.rows.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        "Journal number already exists."
      );
    }

    // ===================================================
    // CREATE JOURNAL
    // ===================================================

    const journalResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO journal_entries (
          journal_number,
          journal_date,
          description,
          reference_type,
          reference_id,
          status
        )
        VALUES (
          $1,
          COALESCE($2::DATE, CURRENT_DATE),
          $3,
          $4,
          $5,
          'POSTED'
        )
        RETURNING *
        `,
        [
          finalJournalNumber,
          journalDate || null,
          description || null,
          referenceType || null,
          referenceId || null,
        ]
      );

    const journal =
      journalResult.rows[0];

    // ===================================================
    // INSERT JOURNAL LINES
    // ===================================================

    for (const item of items) {
      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO journal_entry_lines (
          journal_id,
          entity_name,
          account_id,
          description,
          debit,
          credit
        )
        VALUES (
          $1,
          $2,
          $3,
          $4,
          $5,
          $6
        )
        `,
        [
          journal.journal_id,

          // ENTITY NAME
          item.entityName?.trim() || null,

          item.accountId,

          item.description?.trim() || null,

          Number(item.debit) || 0,

          Number(item.credit) || 0,
        ]
      );
    }

    // ===================================================
    // RECALCULATE ACCOUNT BALANCES
    // ===================================================

    await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE chart_of_accounts a
      SET
        current_balance =
          a.opening_balance +
          COALESCE(
            (
              SELECT
                SUM(
                  ji.debit - ji.credit
                )
              FROM journal_entry_lines ji

              INNER JOIN journal_entries j
                ON j.journal_id =
                   ji.journal_id

              WHERE
                ji.account_id =
                  a.account_id

                AND j.status =
                  'POSTED'
            ),
            0
          ),

        updated_at =
          CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      `
    );

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: true,
        message:
          "Journal entry created successfully.",
        journal,
      },
      { status: 201 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    try {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");
    } catch {}

    console.error(
      "JOURNAL POST ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message:
          error.message ||
          "Failed to create journal entry.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

// =====================================================
// UPDATE JOURNAL
// PUT /api/journal-entries
// =====================================================

export async function PUT(request) {
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const journalId =
      Number(body.journalId);

    const {
      journalNumber,
      journalDate,
      description,
      referenceType,
      referenceId,
      items,
    } = body;

    // ===================================================
    // VALIDATE JOURNAL ID
    // ===================================================

    if (
      !Number.isInteger(journalId) ||
      journalId <= 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Invalid journal ID.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // ===================================================
    // VALIDATE ITEMS
    // ===================================================

    if (
      !items ||
      !Array.isArray(items) ||
      items.length < 2
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "At least two journal lines are required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    let totalDebit = 0;
    let totalCredit = 0;

    for (const item of items) {
      const debit =
        Number(item.debit) || 0;

      const credit =
        Number(item.credit) || 0;

      if (!item.accountId) {
        throw new Error(
          "Every journal line requires an account."
        );
      }

      if (debit > 0 && credit > 0) {
        throw new Error(
          "A journal line cannot contain both debit and credit."
        );
      }

      if (debit <= 0 && credit <= 0) {
        throw new Error(
          "Every journal line must have a debit or credit amount."
        );
      }

      totalDebit += debit;
      totalCredit += credit;
    }

    // ===================================================
    // CHECK BALANCE
    // ===================================================

    if (
      Math.abs(
        totalDebit - totalCredit
      ) > 0.01
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `Journal is not balanced. Debit: ${totalDebit.toFixed(
          2
        )}, Credit: ${totalCredit.toFixed(
          2
        )}`
      );
    }

    await client.query("BEGIN");

    // ===================================================
    // CHECK JOURNAL
    // ===================================================

    const existingJournal =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT *
        FROM journal_entries
        WHERE journal_id = $1
        FOR UPDATE
        `,
        [journalId]
      );

    if (
      existingJournal.rows.length === 0
    ) {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Journal entry not found.",
        },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    // ===================================================
    // CHECK DUPLICATE JOURNAL NUMBER
    // ===================================================

    const finalJournalNumber =
      journalNumber?.trim() ||
      `JV-${Date.now()}`;

    const duplicate =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT journal_id
        FROM journal_entries
        WHERE journal_number = $1
          AND journal_id <> $2
        LIMIT 1
        `,
        [
          finalJournalNumber,
          journalId,
        ]
      );

    if (duplicate.rows.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        "Journal number already exists."
      );
    }

    // ===================================================
    // UPDATE JOURNAL HEADER
    // ===================================================

    const journalResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        UPDATE journal_entries
        SET
          journal_number = $1,

          journal_date =
            COALESCE(
              $2::DATE,
              CURRENT_DATE
            ),

          description = $3,

          reference_type = $4,

          reference_id = $5,

          status = 'POSTED'

        WHERE journal_id = $6

        RETURNING *
        `,
        [
          finalJournalNumber,
          journalDate || null,
          description || null,
          referenceType || null,
          referenceId || null,
          journalId,
        ]
      );

    const journal =
      journalResult.rows[0];

    // ===================================================
    // DELETE OLD LINES
    // ===================================================

    await client.query(
      `
      DELETE FROM journal_entry_lines
      WHERE journal_id = $1
      `,
      [journalId]
    );

    // ===================================================
    // INSERT UPDATED JOURNAL LINES
    // ===================================================

    for (const item of items) {
      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO journal_entry_lines (
          journal_id,
          entity_name,
          account_id,
          description,
          debit,
          credit
        )
        VALUES (
          $1,
          $2,
          $3,
          $4,
          $5,
          $6
        )
        `,
        [
          journalId,

          // ENTITY NAME
          item.entityName?.trim() || null,

          item.accountId,

          item.description?.trim() || null,

          Number(item.debit) || 0,

          Number(item.credit) || 0,
        ]
      );
    }

    // ===================================================
    // RECALCULATE ALL ACCOUNT BALANCES
    // ===================================================

    await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE chart_of_accounts a
      SET
        current_balance =
          a.opening_balance +
          COALESCE(
            (
              SELECT
                SUM(
                  ji.debit - ji.credit
                )
              FROM journal_entry_lines ji

              INNER JOIN journal_entries j
                ON j.journal_id =
                   ji.journal_id

              WHERE
                ji.account_id =
                  a.account_id

                AND j.status =
                  'POSTED'
            ),
            0
          ),

        updated_at =
          CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      `
    );

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        "Journal entry updated successfully.",
      journal,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    try {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");
    } catch {}

    console.error(
      "JOURNAL PUT ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message:
          error.message ||
          "Failed to update journal entry.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

===== app\api\ledger\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET(request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const accountId = searchParams.get("accountId");

    if (!accountId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Account ID is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const result = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        j.journal_id,
        j.journal_number,
        j.journal_date,
        j.description AS journal_description,

        l.journal_line_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.description AS line_description,
        l.debit,
        l.credit,

        a.account_code,
        a.account_name,
        a.account_type

      FROM journal_entry_lines l

      INNER JOIN journal_entries j
        ON j.journal_id = l.journal_id

      INNER JOIN chart_of_accounts a
        ON a.account_id = l.account_id

      WHERE l.account_id = $1

      ORDER BY
        j.journal_date ASC,
        j.journal_id ASC,
        l.journal_line_id ASC
      `,
      [accountId]
    );

    let runningBalance = 0;

    const transactions = result.rows.map((row) => {
      const debit = Number(row.debit) || 0;
      const credit = Number(row.credit) || 0;

      // Display running balance using debit - credit.
      runningBalance += debit - credit;

      return {
        ...row,
        debit,
        credit,
        balance: runningBalance,
      };
    });

    const account = result.rows[0]
      ? {
          account_id: result.rows[0].account_id,
          account_code: result.rows[0].account_code,
          account_name: result.rows[0].account_name,
          account_type: result.rows[0].account_type,
        }
      : null;

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      account,
      transactions,
      totals: {
        debit: transactions.reduce(
          (sum, row) => sum + row.debit,
          0
        ),
        credit: transactions.reduce(
          (sum, row) => sum + row.credit,
          0
        ),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("LEDGER GET ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load ledger.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

===== app\api\password-reset\request\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function POST(request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const username =
      typeof body.username === "string" ? body.username.trim() : "";
    const companyId = Number(body.companyId);

    if (!username || !Number.isInteger(companyId) || companyId < 1) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "Enter your username and select your company." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // Find the active user in the selected company.
    // Email is intentionally not required.
    const result = await pool.query(
      `SELECT
         u.user_id,
         u.username,
         u.full_name,
         uc.company_id,
         c.company_name
       FROM users u
       INNER JOIN user_companies uc
         ON uc.user_id = u.user_id
       INNER JOIN companies c
         ON c.company_id = uc.company_id
       WHERE LOWER(u.username) = LOWER($1)
         AND uc.company_id = $2
         AND u.is_active = TRUE
         AND c.is_active = TRUE
       LIMIT 1`,
      [username, companyId]
    );

    // Do not reveal whether a username exists.
    const genericMessage =
      "If the account matches this company, your request has been sent for administrator review.";

    if (result.rowCount === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ message: genericMessage });
    }

    const account = result.rows[0];

    const superAdminUrl = process.env.SUPER_ADMIN_API_URL?.replace(/\/+$/, "");
    const sharedSecret = process.env.CLIENT_DATA_API_SECRET;
    const clientId = Number(process.env.LICENSE_CLIENT_ID);

    if (
      !superAdminUrl ||
      !sharedSecret ||
      !Number.isInteger(clientId) ||
      clientId < 1
    ) {
      console.error(
        "Password reset integration requires SUPER_ADMIN_API_URL, CLIENT_DATA_API_SECRET and LICENSE_CLIENT_ID."
      );

      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "Password reset requests are not configured yet." },
        { status: 503 }
      );
    }

    const description = [
      "Manual password reset request from the company login page.",
      `Username: ${account.username}`,
      `User ID: ${account.user_id}`,
      `Company: ${account.company_name}`,
      `Company ID: ${account.company_id}`,
      "No email address was supplied.",
      "Verify the user's identity before approving this request.",
    ].join("\n");

    const response = await fetch(
      `${superAdminUrl}/api/public/support-requests`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "x-client-data-secret": sharedSecret,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          clientId,
          companyId: account.company_id,
          requesterUserId: account.user_id,
          category: "password_reset",
          companyName: account.company_name,
          requesterName: account.full_name || account.username,
          requesterEmail: null,
          subject: "Company password reset request",
          description,
        }),
        cache: "no-store",
      }
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
      const errorDetails = await response.text().catch(() => "");

      console.error(
        "Super Admin password reset request failed:",
        response.status,
        errorDetails.slice(0, 300)
      );

      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "The request could not be forwarded. Please try again." },
        { status: 502 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ message: genericMessage });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Password reset request error:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { message: "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}


===== app\api\payable\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        s.supplier_id,
        s.supplier_code,
        s.supplier_name,
        s.phone,

        s.opening_balance,

        COALESCE(
          SUM(p.total_amount),
          0
        ) AS total_purchases,

        COALESCE(
          SUM(pp.amount),
          0
        ) AS total_paid,

        (
          s.opening_balance
          +
          COALESCE(
            SUM(p.total_amount),
            0
          )
          -
          COALESCE(
            SUM(pp.amount),
            0
          )
        ) AS payable

      FROM suppliers s

      LEFT JOIN purchases p
        ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id

      LEFT JOIN purchase_payments pp
        ON pp.supplier_id = s.supplier_id

      GROUP BY
        s.supplier_id

      ORDER BY
        s.supplier_name
    `);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      payables: result.rows,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "PAYABLE GET ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message:
          "Failed to load payables.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

===== app\api\permissions\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import pool from "@/lib/db";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth";
import { hasPermission } from "@/lib/permissions";


// =========================================================
// GET PERMISSIONS FOR ROLE
// =========================================================

export async function GET(request) {
  try {
    const user =
      await getCurrentUser();

    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "Unauthorized" },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const allowed =
      await hasPermission(
        user.roleId,
        "user_rights",
        "view"
      );

    if (!allowed) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          message:
            "You do not have permission.",
        },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }

    const {
      searchParams,
    } = new URL(
      request.url
    );

    const roleId =
      searchParams.get(
        "roleId"
      );

    if (!roleId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          message:
            "roleId is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const result =
      await pool.query(
        `
        SELECT
          p.permission_id,
          p.permission_key,
          p.permission_name,
          p.module,
          p.description,

          COALESCE(
            rp.can_view,
            FALSE
          ) AS can_view,

          COALESCE(
            rp.can_create,
            FALSE
          ) AS can_create,

          COALESCE(
            rp.can_update,
            FALSE
          ) AS can_update,

          COALESCE(
            rp.can_delete,
            FALSE
          ) AS can_delete

        FROM permissions p

        LEFT JOIN role_permissions rp
          ON rp.permission_id =
             p.permission_id

         AND rp.role_id = $1

        ORDER BY
          p.module,
          p.permission_id
        `,
        [roleId]
      );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      permissions:
        result.rows,
    });

  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        message:
          "Failed to load permissions.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}


// =========================================================
// UPDATE ROLE PERMISSION
// =========================================================

export async function PUT(request) {
  try {
    const user =
      await getCurrentUser();

    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "Unauthorized" },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const allowed =
      await hasPermission(
        user.roleId,
        "user_rights",
        "update"
      );

    if (!allowed) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          message:
            "You do not have permission.",
        },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }

    const body =
      await request.json();

    const {
      roleId,
      permissionId,
      canView,
      canCreate,
      canUpdate,
      canDelete,
    } = body;

    if (
      !roleId ||
      !permissionId
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          message:
            "Role and permission are required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    await pool.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO role_permissions
      (
        role_id,
        permission_id,
        can_view,
        can_create,
        can_update,
        can_delete
      )
      VALUES
      (
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        $5,
        $6
      )

      ON CONFLICT
      (
        role_id,
        permission_id
      )

      DO UPDATE SET

        can_view =
          EXCLUDED.can_view,

        can_create =
          EXCLUDED.can_create,

        can_update =
          EXCLUDED.can_update,

        can_delete =
          EXCLUDED.can_delete,

        updated_at =
          CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      `,
      [
        roleId,
        permissionId,
        Boolean(canView),
        Boolean(canCreate),
        Boolean(canUpdate),
        Boolean(canDelete),
      ]
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        "Permission updated successfully.",
    });

  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        message:
          "Failed to update permission.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

===== app\api\permissions\current\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const user = await getCurrentUser();

    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "Unauthorized", permissions: [] },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    if (!user.roleId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "User role not found", permissions: [] },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }

    const result = await pool.query(
      `
        SELECT
          p.permission_id,
          p.permission_key,
          COALESCE(rp.can_view, FALSE) AS can_view,
          COALESCE(rp.can_create, FALSE) AS can_create,
          COALESCE(rp.can_update, FALSE) AS can_update,
          COALESCE(rp.can_delete, FALSE) AS can_delete
        FROM permissions p
        LEFT JOIN role_permissions rp
          ON rp.permission_id = p.permission_id
          AND rp.role_id = $1
        ORDER BY p.permission_id
      `,
      [user.roleId]
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        permissions: result.rows,
      },
      {
        status: 200,
        headers: {
          "Cache-Control": "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate",
        },
      }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("GET /api/permissions/current error:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        message: "Unable to load current user permissions",
        permissions: [],
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}


===== app\api\pos\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

async function fetchFromInternalApi(path) {
  const { headers } = await import("next/headers");
  const requestHeaders = await headers();

  const host =
    requestHeaders.get("x-forwarded-host") ||
    requestHeaders.get("host");

  if (!host) {
    throw new Error("Unable to determine the application host.");
  }

  const protocol =
    requestHeaders.get("x-forwarded-proto") ||
    (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" ? "https" : "http");

  return fetch(`${protocol}://${host}${path}`, {
    cache: "no-store",
    headers: {
      cookie: requestHeaders.get("cookie") || "",
    },
  });
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const [productsResponse, customersResponse, warehousesResponse] =
      await Promise.all([
        fetchFromInternalApi("/api/products"),
        fetchFromInternalApi("/api/customers"),
        fetchFromInternalApi("/api/warehouses"),
      ]);

    const [productsData, customersData, warehousesData] =
      await Promise.all([
        productsResponse.json(),
        customersResponse.json(),
        warehousesResponse.json(),
      ]);

    if (
      !productsResponse.ok ||
      !customersResponse.ok ||
      !warehousesResponse.ok
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Failed to load POS data." },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      products: Array.isArray(productsData)
        ? productsData
        : productsData.products || [],
      customers: Array.isArray(customersData)
        ? customersData
        : customersData.customers || [],
      warehouses: Array.isArray(warehousesData)
        ? warehousesData
        : warehousesData.warehouses || [],
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("POS GET ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, message: "Unable to load POS data." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const {
      customerId,
      warehouseId,
      invoiceDate,
      discount = 0,
      tax = 0,
      notes = "Created from POS",
      items,
      receivedAmount = 0,
      accountId = null,
      paymentMethod = "CASH",
      referenceNumber = null,
    } = body;

    const validCustomerId = Number(customerId);
    const validWarehouseId = Number(warehouseId);
    const parsedDiscount = Number(discount);
    const parsedTax = Number(tax);
    const parsedReceivedAmount = Number(receivedAmount);

    if (
      !Number.isInteger(validCustomerId) ||
      validCustomerId <= 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Please select a valid customer." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (
      !Number.isInteger(validWarehouseId) ||
      validWarehouseId <= 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Please select a valid warehouse." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Add at least one product." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (items.length > 500) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Too many items in one sale." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(parsedDiscount) ||
      parsedDiscount < 0 ||
      !Number.isFinite(parsedTax) ||
      parsedTax < 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Invalid discount or tax amount." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(parsedReceivedAmount) ||
      parsedReceivedAmount < 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Received amount must be zero or greater." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    let validPaymentAccountId = null;

    if (
      accountId !== null &&
      accountId !== undefined &&
      accountId !== ""
    ) {
      validPaymentAccountId = Number(accountId);

      if (
        !Number.isInteger(validPaymentAccountId) ||
        validPaymentAccountId <= 0
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { success: false, message: "Please select a valid cash/bank account." },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }
    }

    if (parsedReceivedAmount > 0 && !validPaymentAccountId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Select a cash/bank account to record the received payment.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const cleanItems = items.map((item) => {
      const rawSubProductId = item.subProductId;

      return {
        productId: Number(item.productId),
        subProductId:
          rawSubProductId === null ||
          rawSubProductId === undefined ||
          rawSubProductId === ""
            ? null
            : Number(rawSubProductId),
        quantity: Number(item.quantity),
        unitPrice: Number(item.unitPrice),
        discount: Number(item.discount || 0),
        tax: Number(item.tax || 0),
      };
    });

    for (const item of cleanItems) {
      if (
        !Number.isInteger(item.productId) ||
        item.productId <= 0 ||
        (item.subProductId !== null &&
          (!Number.isInteger(item.subProductId) ||
            item.subProductId <= 0)) ||
        !Number.isFinite(item.quantity) ||
        item.quantity <= 0 ||
        !Number.isFinite(item.unitPrice) ||
        item.unitPrice < 0 ||
        !Number.isFinite(item.discount) ||
        item.discount < 0 ||
        !Number.isFinite(item.tax) ||
        item.tax < 0
      ) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            message: "One or more sale items contain invalid values.",
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }
    }

    const invoicePayload = {
      customerId: validCustomerId,
      warehouseId: validWarehouseId,
      invoiceDate: invoiceDate || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      discount: parsedDiscount,
      tax: parsedTax,
      notes: String(notes ?? "Created from POS"),
      items: cleanItems,

      // These fields are handled inside the sales-invoice transaction.
      receivedAmount: parsedReceivedAmount,
      accountId: validPaymentAccountId,
      paymentMethod: String(paymentMethod || "CASH").trim().toUpperCase(),
      referenceNumber:
        referenceNumber === null ||
        referenceNumber === undefined ||
        String(referenceNumber).trim() === ""
          ? null
          : String(referenceNumber).trim(),
    };

    const { headers } = await import("next/headers");
    const requestHeaders = await headers();

    const host =
      requestHeaders.get("x-forwarded-host") ||
      requestHeaders.get("host");

    if (!host) {
      throw new Error("Unable to determine the application host.");
    }

    const protocol =
      requestHeaders.get("x-forwarded-proto") ||
      (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" ? "https" : "http");

    const invoiceResponse = await fetch(
      `${protocol}://${host}/api/sales-invoices`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          cookie: requestHeaders.get("cookie") || "",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(invoicePayload),
        cache: "no-store",
      }
    );

    const result = await invoiceResponse.json();

    return NextResponse.json(result, {
      status: invoiceResponse.status,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("POS POST ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: error.message || "Failed to process the POS sale.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT category_id, category_name, description, is_active,
             created_at, updated_at
      FROM product_categories
      ORDER BY category_name ASC
    `);

    return NextResponse.json(result.rows);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("GET product categories:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to load product categories." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const name = String(body.category_name ?? "").trim();
    const description = String(body.description ?? "").trim();
    const isActive = body.is_active ?? true;

    if (!name) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Category name is required." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (name.length > 100) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Category name cannot exceed 100 characters." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (typeof isActive !== "boolean") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Invalid active status." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const result = await pool.query(
      `INSERT INTO product_categories
        (category_name, description, is_active)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
       RETURNING *`,
      [name, description || null, isActive]
    );

    return NextResponse.json(result.rows[0], { status: 201 });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code === "23505") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "This category already exists." },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    console.error("POST product categories:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to create category." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}


===== app\api\product-categories\import\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import * as XLSX from "xlsx";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

function normalizeHeader(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[_-]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
}

function parseBoolean(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") {
    return true;
  }

  if (typeof value === "boolean") return value;

  const normalized = String(value).trim().toLowerCase();

  if (["true", "1", "yes", "active"].includes(normalized)) {
    return true;
  }

  if (["false", "0", "no", "inactive"].includes(normalized)) {
    return false;
  }

  throw new Error(`Invalid Is Active value: ${value}`);
}

export async function POST(request) {
  let client;

  try {
    const formData = await request.formData();
    const file = formData.get("file");

    if (!file || typeof file.arrayBuffer !== "function") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Please select an Excel or CSV file." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const extension = file.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase();

    if (!["xlsx", "csv"].includes(extension)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Only .xlsx and .csv files are supported." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "File size must not exceed 5 MB." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
    const workbook = XLSX.read(buffer, { type: "buffer" });
    const firstSheet = workbook.Sheets[workbook.SheetNames[0]];

    if (!firstSheet) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "The uploaded file contains no worksheet." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(firstSheet, {
      defval: "",
      raw: false,
    });

    if (rows.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "The spreadsheet contains no data rows." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const errors = [];
    let imported = 0;
    let skipped = 0;
    const seenNames = new Set();

    client = await pool.connect();
    await client.query("BEGIN");

    for (let index = 0; index < rows.length; index++) {
      const rowNumber = index + 2;
      const row = {};

      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(rows[index])) {
        row[normalizeHeader(key)] = value;
      }

      const categoryName = String(
        row["category name"] ??
          row["category"] ??
          row["category name *"] ??
          ""
      ).trim();

      const description = String(row["description"] ?? "").trim();

      let isActive;

      try {
        if (!categoryName) {
          throw new Error("Category Name is required.");
        }

        if (categoryName.length > 100) {
          throw new Error("Category Name cannot exceed 100 characters.");
        }

        const duplicateKey = categoryName.toLowerCase();

        if (seenNames.has(duplicateKey)) {
          throw new Error("Duplicate category name in the spreadsheet.");
        }

        seenNames.add(duplicateKey);

        isActive = parseBoolean(
          row["is active"] ?? row["active"] ?? ""
        );
      } catch (error) {
        errors.push(`Row ${rowNumber}: ${error.message}`);
        skipped++;
        continue;
      }

      try {
        await client.query("SAVEPOINT category_row");

        const result = await client.query(
          `INSERT INTO product_categories
             (category_name, description, is_active)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
           ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
           RETURNING category_id`,
          [categoryName, description || null, isActive]
        );

        if (result.rowCount === 0) {
          await client.query("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT category_row");
          errors.push(
            `Row ${rowNumber}: "${categoryName}" already exists or conflicts with a database constraint.`
          );
          skipped++;
        } else {
          imported++;
        }

        await client.query("RELEASE SAVEPOINT category_row");
      } catch (error) {
        await client.query("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT category_row");
        await client.query("RELEASE SAVEPOINT category_row");

        errors.push(`Row ${rowNumber}: ${error.message}`);
        skipped++;
      }
    }

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: `Imported ${imported} categories; skipped ${skipped}.`,
      imported,
      skipped,
      errors,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (client) {
      try {
        await client.query("ROLLBACK");
      } catch {}
    }

    console.error("Product category import error:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Category import failed. Check the server terminal and database schema." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client?.release();
  }
}

===== app\api\product-units\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET(request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const productId = searchParams.get("productId");
    const warehouseId = searchParams.get("warehouseId");
    const barcode = searchParams.get("barcode");

    const values = [];
    const conditions = [];

    if (productId) {
      values.push(productId);
      conditions.push(`pu.product_id = $${values.length}`);
    }

    if (warehouseId) {
      values.push(warehouseId);
      conditions.push(`w.warehouse_id = $${values.length}`);
    }

    if (barcode) {
      values.push(barcode.trim());
      conditions.push(`pu.barcode = $${values.length}`);
    }

    const where = conditions.length
      ? `WHERE ${conditions.join(" AND ")}`
      : "";

    const result = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        pu.unit_id,
        pu.product_id,
        pu.unit_name,
        pu.barcode,
        pu.conversion_factor,
        pu.is_base_unit,
        p.sku,
        p.product_name,
        w.warehouse_id,
        w.warehouse_name,
        COALESCE(us.quantity, 0) AS quantity
      FROM product_units pu
      JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pu.product_id
      CROSS JOIN warehouses w
      LEFT JOIN unit_stock us
        ON us.unit_id = pu.unit_id
       AND us.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
      ${where}
      ORDER BY p.product_name, pu.is_base_unit DESC, pu.unit_name, w.warehouse_name
      `,
      values
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      units: result.rows,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("PRODUCT UNITS GET ERROR:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, message: "Failed to load packaging units." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request) {
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const productId = Number(body.productId);
    const unitName = String(body.unitName || "").trim();
    const barcode = String(body.barcode || "").trim() || null;
    const conversionFactor = Number(body.conversionFactor);

    if (
      !Number.isInteger(productId) ||
      !unitName ||
      !Number.isFinite(conversionFactor) ||
      conversionFactor <= 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Select a product, enter a unit name, and use a conversion factor greater than zero.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    await client.query("BEGIN");

    const product = await client.query(
      "SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE product_id = $1",
      [productId]
    );

    if (product.rowCount === 0) {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Product not found." },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    const result = await client.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO product_units
        (product_id, unit_name, barcode, conversion_factor, is_base_unit)
      VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, FALSE)
      RETURNING *
      `,
      [productId, unitName, barcode, conversionFactor]
    );

    await client.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO unit_stock (unit_id, warehouse_id, quantity)
      SELECT $1, warehouse_id, 0
      FROM warehouses
      ON CONFLICT (unit_id, warehouse_id) DO NOTHING
      `,
      [result.rows[0].unit_id]
    );

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: true,
        message: "Packaging unit created.",
        unit: result.rows[0],
      },
      { status: 201 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query("ROLLBACK");
    console.error("PRODUCT UNIT CREATE ERROR:", error);

    if (error.code === "23505") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "This barcode or unit name already exists for the product.",
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, message: "Failed to create packaging unit." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}
