===== app\api\purchase-payments\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function getPurchaseStatus(paidAmount, totalAmount) {
    if (paidAmount <= 0) return "UNPAID";
    if (paidAmount >= totalAmount) return "PAID";
    return "PARTIAL";
}

function errorResponse(message, status = 500) {
    return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message },
        { status }
    );
}

// =====================================================
// GET: LOAD PURCHASE PAYMENT HISTORY
// =====================================================
export async function GET() {
    try {
        const result = await pool.query(`
            SELECT
                pp.payment_id,
                pp.payment_number,
                pp.purchase_id,
                p.purchase_number,
                pp.supplier_id,
                s.supplier_code,
                s.supplier_name,
                pp.payment_date,
                pp.amount,
                pp.payment_method,
                pp.reference_number,
                pp.notes,
                pp.created_at
            FROM purchase_payments pp
            INNER JOIN purchases p
                ON p.purchase_id = pp.purchase_id
            INNER JOIN suppliers s
                ON s.supplier_id = pp.supplier_id
            ORDER BY pp.payment_id DESC
        `);

        return NextResponse.json({
            success: true,
            payments: result.rows,
        });
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("PURCHASE PAYMENTS GET ERROR:", error);

        return errorResponse(
            "Failed to load purchase payments.",
            500
        );
    }
}

// =====================================================
// POST: CREATE PURCHASE PAYMENT
// =====================================================
export async function POST(request) {
    let client;

    try {
        const body = await request.json();

        const {
            paymentNumber,
            purchaseId,
            paymentDate,
            amount,
            paymentMethod,
            referenceNumber,
            notes,
        } = body;

        if (!purchaseId) {
            return errorResponse(
                "Purchase is required.",
                400
            );
        }

        const paymentAmount = Number(amount);

        if (
            !Number.isFinite(paymentAmount) ||
            paymentAmount <= 0
        ) {
            return errorResponse(
                "Payment amount must be greater than zero.",
                400
            );
        }

        client = await pool.connect();

        await client.query("BEGIN");

        const purchaseResult = await client.query(
            `
                SELECT
                    purchase_id,
                    supplier_id,
                    total_amount,
                    paid_amount,
                    balance_amount
                FROM purchases
                WHERE purchase_id = $1
                FOR UPDATE
            `,
            [purchaseId]
        );

        if (purchaseResult.rows.length === 0) {
            throw new Error("Purchase not found.");
        }

        const purchase = purchaseResult.rows[0];
        const balanceAmount = Number(purchase.balance_amount);

        if (paymentAmount > balanceAmount) {
            throw new Error(
                `Payment cannot exceed the remaining purchase balance of ${balanceAmount.toFixed(2)}.`
            );
        }

        const finalPaymentNumber =
            paymentNumber?.trim() || `PPAY-${Date.now()}`;

        const paymentResult = await client.query(
            `
                INSERT INTO purchase_payments (
                    payment_number,
                    purchase_id,
                    supplier_id,
                    payment_date,
                    amount,
                    payment_method,
                    reference_number,
                    notes
                )
                VALUES (
                    $1,
                    $2,
                    $3,
                    COALESCE($4::DATE, CURRENT_DATE),
                    $5,
                    $6,
                    $7,
                    $8
                )
                RETURNING *
            `,
            [
                finalPaymentNumber,
                purchase.purchase_id,
                purchase.supplier_id,
                paymentDate || null,
                paymentAmount,
                paymentMethod || "CASH",
                referenceNumber || null,
                notes || null,
            ]
        );

        const newPaidAmount =
            Number(purchase.paid_amount || 0) + paymentAmount;

        const newBalance = Math.max(
            Number(purchase.total_amount) - newPaidAmount,
            0
        );

        await client.query(
            `
                UPDATE purchases
                SET
                    paid_amount = $1,
                    balance_amount = $2,
                    status = $3,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE purchase_id = $4
            `,
            [
                newPaidAmount,
                newBalance,
                getPurchaseStatus(
                    newPaidAmount,
                    Number(purchase.total_amount)
                ),
                purchase.purchase_id,
            ]
        );

        await client.query("COMMIT");

        return NextResponse.json(
            {
                success: true,
                message: "Purchase payment recorded successfully.",
                payment: paymentResult.rows[0],
            },
            { status: 201 }
        );
    } catch (error) {
        if (client) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK").catch(() => {});
        }

        console.error("PURCHASE PAYMENT POST ERROR:", error);

        if (error.code === "23505") {
            return errorResponse(
                "Payment number already exists.",
                409
            );
        }

        return errorResponse(
            error.message || "Failed to record purchase payment.",
            500
        );
    } finally {
        client?.release();
    }
}

// =====================================================
// PUT: EDIT EXISTING PURCHASE PAYMENT
// =====================================================
export async function PUT(request) {
    let client;

    try {
        const body = await request.json();

        // Accept common ID field names used by edit forms.
        const paymentId =
            body.paymentId ??
            body.payment_id ??
            body.id;

        const {
            paymentNumber,
            purchaseId,
            paymentDate,
            amount,
            paymentMethod,
            referenceNumber,
            notes,
        } = body;

        if (!paymentId) {
            return errorResponse(
                "Payment ID is required to edit a payment.",
                400
            );
        }

        if (!purchaseId) {
            return errorResponse(
                "Purchase is required.",
                400
            );
        }

        const paymentAmount = Number(amount);

        if (
            !Number.isFinite(paymentAmount) ||
            paymentAmount <= 0
        ) {
            return errorResponse(
                "Payment amount must be greater than zero.",
                400
            );
        }

        const finalPaymentNumber = paymentNumber?.trim();

        if (!finalPaymentNumber) {
            return errorResponse(
                "Payment number is required.",
                400
            );
        }

        client = await pool.connect();

        await client.query("BEGIN");

        // Lock the payment so two edits cannot modify it simultaneously.
        const existingResult = await client.query(
            `
                SELECT *
                FROM purchase_payments
                WHERE payment_id = $1
                FOR UPDATE
            `,
            [paymentId]
        );

        if (existingResult.rows.length === 0) {
            throw new Error("Purchase payment not found.");
        }

        const oldPayment = existingResult.rows[0];
        const oldPurchaseId = Number(oldPayment.purchase_id);
        const newPurchaseId = Number(purchaseId);
        const oldAmount = Number(oldPayment.amount);

        // Lock both purchases in consistent ID order.
        const purchaseIds = [
            ...new Set([oldPurchaseId, newPurchaseId]),
        ].sort((a, b) => a - b);

        const purchasesResult = await client.query(
            `
                SELECT
                    purchase_id,
                    supplier_id,
                    total_amount,
                    paid_amount,
                    balance_amount
                FROM purchases
                WHERE purchase_id = ANY($1::int[])
                ORDER BY purchase_id
                FOR UPDATE
            `,
            [purchaseIds]
        );

        const purchases = new Map(
            purchasesResult.rows.map((purchase) => [
                Number(purchase.purchase_id),
                purchase,
            ])
        );

        const oldPurchase = purchases.get(oldPurchaseId);
        const newPurchase = purchases.get(newPurchaseId);

        if (!oldPurchase) {
            throw new Error("Original purchase not found.");
        }

        if (!newPurchase) {
            throw new Error("Selected purchase not found.");
        }

        // Check for a duplicate payment number, excluding this payment.
        const duplicateResult = await client.query(
            `
                SELECT payment_id
                FROM purchase_payments
                WHERE payment_number = $1
                  AND payment_id <> $2
                LIMIT 1
            `,
            [finalPaymentNumber, paymentId]
        );

        if (duplicateResult.rows.length > 0) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");

            return errorResponse(
                "Payment number already exists.",
                409
            );
        }

        const samePurchase =
            oldPurchaseId === newPurchaseId;

        // When editing the same purchase, add back the old payment
        // before checking whether the new amount fits its balance.
        const availableBalance =
            Number(newPurchase.balance_amount) +
            (samePurchase ? oldAmount : 0);

        if (paymentAmount > availableBalance) {
            throw new Error(
                `Payment cannot exceed the available purchase balance of ${availableBalance.toFixed(2)}.`
            );
        }

        // Update the payment details.
        const updatedPaymentResult = await client.query(
            `
                UPDATE purchase_payments
                SET
                    payment_number = $1,
                    purchase_id = $2,
                    supplier_id = $3,
                    payment_date = COALESCE($4::DATE, CURRENT_DATE),
                    amount = $5,
                    payment_method = $6,
                    reference_number = $7,
                    notes = $8
                WHERE payment_id = $9
                RETURNING *
            `,
            [
                finalPaymentNumber,
                newPurchaseId,
                newPurchase.supplier_id,
                paymentDate || null,
                paymentAmount,
                paymentMethod || "CASH",
                referenceNumber || null,
                notes || null,
                paymentId,
            ]
        );

        if (samePurchase) {
            // Recalculate using the original paid amount, replacing
            // the old payment amount with the edited amount.
            const updatedPaidAmount =
                Number(oldPurchase.paid_amount || 0) -
                oldAmount +
                paymentAmount;

            const totalAmount = Number(oldPurchase.total_amount);
            const updatedBalance = Math.max(
                totalAmount - updatedPaidAmount,
                0
            );

            await client.query(
                `
                    UPDATE purchases
                    SET
                        paid_amount = $1,
                        balance_amount = $2,
                        status = $3,
                        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE purchase_id = $4
                `,
                [
                    updatedPaidAmount,
                    updatedBalance,
                    getPurchaseStatus(
                        updatedPaidAmount,
                        totalAmount
                    ),
                    oldPurchaseId,
                ]
            );
        } else {
            // Remove the old payment amount from the original purchase.
            const oldPaidAmount = Math.max(
                Number(oldPurchase.paid_amount || 0) - oldAmount,
                0
            );

            const oldTotal = Number(oldPurchase.total_amount);
            const oldBalance = Math.max(
                oldTotal - oldPaidAmount,
                0
            );

            await client.query(
                `
                    UPDATE purchases
                    SET
                        paid_amount = $1,
                        balance_amount = $2,
                        status = $3,
                        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE purchase_id = $4
                `,
                [
                    oldPaidAmount,
                    oldBalance,
                    getPurchaseStatus(oldPaidAmount, oldTotal),
                    oldPurchaseId,
                ]
            );

            // Apply the edited payment to the newly selected purchase.
            const newPaidAmount =
                Number(newPurchase.paid_amount || 0) +
                paymentAmount;

            const newTotal = Number(newPurchase.total_amount);
            const newBalance = Math.max(
                newTotal - newPaidAmount,
                0
            );

            await client.query(
                `
                    UPDATE purchases
                    SET
                        paid_amount = $1,
                        balance_amount = $2,
                        status = $3,
                        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE purchase_id = $4
                `,
                [
                    newPaidAmount,
                    newBalance,
                    getPurchaseStatus(newPaidAmount, newTotal),
                    newPurchaseId,
                ]
            );
        }

        await client.query("COMMIT");

        return NextResponse.json({
            success: true,
            message: "Purchase payment updated successfully.",
            payment: updatedPaymentResult.rows[0],
        });
    } catch (error) {
        if (client) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK").catch(() => {});
        }

        console.error("PURCHASE PAYMENT PUT ERROR:", error);

        if (error.code === "23505") {
            return errorResponse(
                "Payment number already exists.",
                409
            );
        }

        return errorResponse(
            error.message || "Failed to update purchase payment.",
            500
        );
    } finally {
        client?.release();
    }
}


===== app\api\purchases\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

const ACCOUNTS = {
  INVENTORY: 7,
  ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE: 9,
};

// ============================================================
// GET PURCHASES
// ============================================================

export async function GET(request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const purchaseId = searchParams.get("id");

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // SINGLE PURCHASE
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (purchaseId) {
      const purchaseResult = await pool.query(
        `
        SELECT
          p.purchase_id,
          p.purchase_number,

          p.supplier_id,
          s.supplier_code,
          s.supplier_name,

          p.warehouse_id,
          w.warehouse_code,
          w.warehouse_name,

          p.purchase_date,
          p.subtotal,
          p.discount,
          p.tax,
          p.total_amount,
          p.paid_amount,
          p.balance_amount,
          p.status,
          p.notes,
          p.created_at,
          p.updated_at

        FROM purchases p

        INNER JOIN suppliers s
          ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id

        INNER JOIN warehouses w
          ON w.warehouse_id = p.warehouse_id

        WHERE p.purchase_id = $1
        `,
        [purchaseId]
      );

      if (purchaseResult.rows.length === 0) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            message: "Purchase not found.",
          },
          { status: 404 }
        );
      }

      const purchase = purchaseResult.rows[0];

      const itemsResult = await pool.query(
        `
        SELECT
          pi.purchase_item_id,
          pi.purchase_id,
          pi.product_id,
          pr.sku,
          pr.product_name,
          pi.quantity,
          pi.unit_cost,
          pi.discount,
          pi.tax,
          pi.line_total,
          pr.unit
        FROM purchase_items pi
        INNER JOIN products pr
          ON pr.product_id = pi.product_id
        WHERE pi.purchase_id = $1
        ORDER BY pi.purchase_item_id ASC
        `,
        [purchaseId]
      );

      purchase.items = itemsResult.rows;

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        purchase,
      });
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // ALL PURCHASES
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        p.purchase_id,
        p.purchase_number,

        p.supplier_id,
        s.supplier_code,
        s.supplier_name,

        p.warehouse_id,
        w.warehouse_code,
        w.warehouse_name,

        p.purchase_date,
        p.subtotal,
        p.discount,
        p.tax,
        p.total_amount,
        p.paid_amount,
        p.balance_amount,
        p.status,
        p.notes,
        p.created_at,
        p.updated_at

      FROM purchases p

      INNER JOIN suppliers s
        ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id

      INNER JOIN warehouses w
        ON w.warehouse_id = p.warehouse_id

      ORDER BY p.purchase_id DESC
    `);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      purchases: result.rows,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("PURCHASES GET ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load purchases.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// ============================================================
// POST - CREATE PURCHASE
// ============================================================

export async function POST(request) {
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const {
      purchaseNumber,
      supplierId,
      warehouseId,
      purchaseDate,
      discount,
      tax,
      notes,
      items,
    } = body;

    // ========================================================
    // BASIC VALIDATION
    // ========================================================

    if (!supplierId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Supplier is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!warehouseId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Warehouse is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "At least one purchase item is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    await client.query("BEGIN");

    // ========================================================
    // SUPPLIER
    // ========================================================

    const supplierResult = await client.query(
      `
      SELECT
        supplier_id,
        supplier_code,
        supplier_name
      FROM suppliers
      WHERE supplier_id = $1
        AND is_active = TRUE
      `,
      [supplierId]
    );

    if (supplierResult.rows.length === 0) {
      throw new Error("Supplier not found or inactive.");
    }

    const supplier = supplierResult.rows[0];

    // ========================================================
    // WAREHOUSE
    // ========================================================

    const warehouseResult = await client.query(
      `
      SELECT
        warehouse_id,
        warehouse_code,
        warehouse_name
      FROM warehouses
      WHERE warehouse_id = $1
        AND is_active = TRUE
      `,
      [warehouseId]
    );

    if (warehouseResult.rows.length === 0) {
      throw new Error("Warehouse not found or inactive.");
    }

    const warehouse = warehouseResult.rows[0];

    // ========================================================
    // PREPARE ITEMS
    // ========================================================

    let subtotal = 0;

    const preparedItems = [];

    for (const item of items) {
      const productId = Number(item.productId);
      const quantity = Number(item.quantity);
      const unitCost = Number(item.unitCost) || 0;
      const itemDiscount = Number(item.discount) || 0;
      const itemTax = Number(item.tax) || 0;

      if (!productId) {
        throw new Error("Invalid product selected.");
      }

      if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0) {
        throw new Error(
          "Product quantity must be greater than zero."
        );
      }

      if (!Number.isFinite(unitCost) || unitCost < 0) {
        throw new Error(
          "Purchase cost cannot be negative."
        );
      }

      if (itemDiscount < 0 || itemTax < 0) {
        throw new Error(
          "Discount and tax cannot be negative."
        );
      }

      const productResult = await client.query(
        `
        SELECT
          product_id,
          product_name,
          unit,
          cost_price,
          is_active
        FROM products
        WHERE product_id = $1
        `,
        [productId]
      );

      if (productResult.rows.length === 0) {
        throw new Error(
          `Product ${productId} not found.`
        );
      }

      const product = productResult.rows[0];

      if (!product.is_active) {
        throw new Error(
          `Product "${product.product_name}" is inactive.`
        );
      }

      const lineTotal =
        quantity * unitCost -
        itemDiscount +
        itemTax;

      if (lineTotal < 0) {
        throw new Error(
          `Invalid total for product "${product.product_name}".`
        );
      }

      subtotal += lineTotal;

      preparedItems.push({
        productId,
        productName: product.product_name,
        unit: product.unit || "PCS",
        quantity,
        unitCost,
        discount: itemDiscount,
        tax: itemTax,
        lineTotal,
      });
    }

    // ========================================================
    // TOTAL
    // ========================================================

    const purchaseDiscount =
      Number(discount) || 0;

    const purchaseTax =
      Number(tax) || 0;

    if (
      purchaseDiscount < 0 ||
      purchaseTax < 0
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Discount and tax cannot be negative."
      );
    }

    const totalAmount =
      subtotal -
      purchaseDiscount +
      purchaseTax;

    if (totalAmount < 0) {
      throw new Error(
        "Purchase total cannot be negative."
      );
    }

    // ========================================================
    // PURCHASE NUMBER
    // ========================================================

    let finalPurchaseNumber =
      purchaseNumber?.trim();

    if (!finalPurchaseNumber) {
      finalPurchaseNumber =
        `PUR-${Date.now()}`;
    }

    const existingPurchase =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT purchase_id
        FROM purchases
        WHERE purchase_number = $1
        `,
        [finalPurchaseNumber]
      );

    if (existingPurchase.rows.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        "Purchase number already exists."
      );
    }

    // ========================================================
    // CREATE PURCHASE
    // ========================================================

    const purchaseResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO purchases (
          purchase_number,
          supplier_id,
          warehouse_id,
          purchase_date,
          subtotal,
          discount,
          tax,
          total_amount,
          paid_amount,
          balance_amount,
          status,
          notes
        )
        VALUES (
          $1,
          $2,
          $3,
          COALESCE($4::DATE, CURRENT_DATE),
          $5,
          $6,
          $7,
          $8,
          0,
          $8,
          'UNPAID',
          $9
        )
        RETURNING *
        `,
        [
          finalPurchaseNumber,
          supplierId,
          warehouseId,
          purchaseDate || null,
          subtotal,
          purchaseDiscount,
          purchaseTax,
          totalAmount,
          notes || null,
        ]
      );

    const purchase =
      purchaseResult.rows[0];

    // ========================================================
    // INSERT ITEMS + STOCK + INVENTORY
    // ========================================================

    for (const item of preparedItems) {
      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO purchase_items (
          purchase_id,
          product_id,
          quantity,
          unit_cost,
          discount,
          tax,
          line_total
        )
        VALUES (
          $1,
          $2,
          $3,
          $4,
          $5,
          $6,
          $7
        )
        `,
        [
          purchase.purchase_id,
          item.productId,
          item.quantity,
          item.unitCost,
          item.discount,
          item.tax,
          item.lineTotal,
        ]
      );

      const stockResult =
        await client.query(
          `
          SELECT
            stock_id,
            quantity
          FROM stock
          WHERE product_id = $1
            AND warehouse_id = $2
          FOR UPDATE
          `,
          [
            item.productId,
            warehouseId,
          ]
        );

      if (stockResult.rows.length > 0) {
        await client.query(
          `
          UPDATE stock
          SET
            quantity = quantity + $1,
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
          WHERE product_id = $2
            AND warehouse_id = $3
          `,
          [
            item.quantity,
            item.productId,
            warehouseId,
          ]
        );
      } else {
        await client.query(
          `
          INSERT INTO stock (
            product_id,
            warehouse_id,
            quantity
          )
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
          `,
          [
            item.productId,
            warehouseId,
            item.quantity,
          ]
        );
      }

      const runningResult =
        await client.query(
          `
          SELECT
            COALESCE(
              SUM(
                COALESCE(receive_quantity, 0)
                -
                COALESCE(issue_quantity, 0)
              ),
              0
            ) AS running_quantity
          FROM inventory_transactions
          WHERE product_id = $1
            AND location = $2
          `,
          [
            item.productId,
            warehouse.warehouse_name,
          ]
        );

      const oldQuantity =
        Number(
          runningResult.rows[0]
            .running_quantity
        ) || 0;

      const newQuantity =
        oldQuantity + item.quantity;

      const receiveAmount =
        item.quantity * item.unitCost;

      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO inventory_transactions (
          product_id,
          transaction_date,
          transaction_type,
          transaction_number,
          location,
          uom,
          memo,
          transaction_rate,
          old_rate,
          actual_rate,
          new_rate,
          receive_quantity,
          receive_rate,
          receive_amount,
          issue_quantity,
          issue_rate,
          issue_amount,
          running_quantity
        )
        VALUES (
          $1,
          COALESCE($2::DATE, CURRENT_DATE),
          'VENDOR BILL',
          $3,
          $4,
          $5,
          $6,
          $7,
          $7,
          $7,
          $7,
          $8,
          $7,
          $9,
          0,
          0,
          0,
          $10
        )
        `,
        [
          item.productId,
          purchaseDate || null,
          finalPurchaseNumber,
          warehouse.warehouse_name,
          item.unit,
          `Purchase from ${supplier.supplier_name}`,
          item.unitCost,
          item.quantity,
          receiveAmount,
          newQuantity,
        ]
      );
    }

    // ========================================================
    // ACCOUNTING JOURNAL
    // Dr Inventory
    // Cr Accounts Payable
    // ========================================================

    const journalNumber =
      `PUR-JRN-${purchase.purchase_id}`;

    const journalResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO journal_entries (
          journal_number,
          journal_date,
          reference_type,
          reference_id,
          description,
          status
        )
        VALUES (
          $1,
          COALESCE($2::DATE, CURRENT_DATE),
          'PURCHASE',
          $3,
          $4,
          'POSTED'
        )
        RETURNING journal_id
        `,
        [
          journalNumber,
          purchaseDate || null,
          purchase.purchase_id,
          `Purchase ${finalPurchaseNumber} from ${supplier.supplier_name}`,
        ]
      );

    const journalId =
      journalResult.rows[0]
        .journal_id;

    // Inventory Debit

    await client.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO journal_entry_lines (
        journal_id,
        account_id,
        description,
        debit,
        credit,
        party_type,
        party_id
      )
      VALUES (
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        0,
        NULL,
        NULL
      )
      `,
      [
        journalId,
        ACCOUNTS.INVENTORY,
        `Inventory received from ${supplier.supplier_name}`,
        totalAmount,
      ]
    );

    // Accounts Payable Credit

    await client.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO journal_entry_lines (
        journal_id,
        account_id,
        description,
        debit,
        credit,
        party_type,
        party_id
      )
      VALUES (
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        0,
        $4,
        'SUPPLIER',
        $5
      )
      `,
      [
        journalId,
        ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE,
        `Payable to ${supplier.supplier_name}`,
        totalAmount,
        supplierId,
      ]
    );

    // ========================================================
    // ACCOUNT BALANCES
    // ========================================================

    await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE chart_of_accounts
      SET
        current_balance =
          current_balance + $1,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE account_id = $2
      `,
      [
        totalAmount,
        ACCOUNTS.INVENTORY,
      ]
    );

    await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE chart_of_accounts
      SET
        current_balance =
          current_balance + $1,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE account_id = $2
      `,
      [
        totalAmount,
        ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE,
      ]
    );

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    // ========================================================
    // RETURN COMPLETE PURCHASE
    // ========================================================

    const completePurchaseResult =
      await pool.query(
        `
        SELECT
          p.purchase_id,
          p.purchase_number,
          p.supplier_id,
          s.supplier_code,
          s.supplier_name,
          p.warehouse_id,
          w.warehouse_code,
          w.warehouse_name,
          p.purchase_date,
          p.subtotal,
          p.discount,
          p.tax,
          p.total_amount,
          p.paid_amount,
          p.balance_amount,
          p.status,
          p.notes,
          p.created_at,
          p.updated_at
        FROM purchases p
        INNER JOIN suppliers s
          ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
        INNER JOIN warehouses w
          ON w.warehouse_id = p.warehouse_id
        WHERE p.purchase_id = $1
        `,
        [purchase.purchase_id]
      );

    const completePurchase =
      completePurchaseResult.rows[0];

    const itemsResult =
      await pool.query(
        `
        SELECT
          pi.purchase_item_id,
          pi.purchase_id,
          pi.product_id,
          pr.sku,
          pr.product_name,
          pi.quantity,
          pi.unit_cost,
          pi.discount,
          pi.tax,
          pi.line_total,
          pr.unit
        FROM purchase_items pi
        INNER JOIN products pr
          ON pr.product_id = pi.product_id
        WHERE pi.purchase_id = $1
        ORDER BY pi.purchase_item_id ASC
        `,
        [purchase.purchase_id]
      );

    completePurchase.items =
      itemsResult.rows;

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: true,
        message:
          "Purchase created successfully. Stock, Items Ledger and Accounting Ledger updated.",
        purchase:
          completePurchase,
      },
      { status: 201 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    try {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");
    } catch {}

    console.error(
      "PURCHASE POST ERROR:",
      error
    );

    if (error.code === "23505") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Purchase number already exists.",
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message:
          error.message ||
          "Failed to create purchase.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// PUT - EDIT PURCHASE
// ============================================================

export async function PUT(request) {
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const {
      purchaseId,
      purchaseNumber,
      supplierId,
      warehouseId,
      purchaseDate,
      discount,
      tax,
      notes,
      items,
    } = body;

    // ========================================================
    // VALIDATION
    // ========================================================

    if (!purchaseId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Purchase ID is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!supplierId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Supplier is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!warehouseId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Warehouse is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "At least one purchase item is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    await client.query("BEGIN");

    // ========================================================
    // LOCK OLD PURCHASE
    // ========================================================

    const oldPurchaseResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT *
        FROM purchases
        WHERE purchase_id = $1
        FOR UPDATE
        `,
        [purchaseId]
      );

    if (oldPurchaseResult.rows.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(
        "Purchase not found."
      );
    }

    const oldPurchase =
      oldPurchaseResult.rows[0];

    // ========================================================
    // PURCHASE NUMBER
    // ========================================================

    let finalPurchaseNumber =
      purchaseNumber?.trim();

    if (!finalPurchaseNumber) {
      finalPurchaseNumber =
        oldPurchase.purchase_number;
    }

    const duplicateResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT purchase_id
        FROM purchases
        WHERE purchase_number = $1
          AND purchase_id <> $2
        `,
        [
          finalPurchaseNumber,
          purchaseId,
        ]
      );

    if (duplicateResult.rows.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        "Purchase number already exists."
      );
    }

    // ========================================================
    // NEW SUPPLIER
    // ========================================================

    const supplierResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT
          supplier_id,
          supplier_code,
          supplier_name
        FROM suppliers
        WHERE supplier_id = $1
          AND is_active = TRUE
        `,
        [supplierId]
      );

    if (supplierResult.rows.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(
        "Supplier not found or inactive."
      );
    }

    const supplier =
      supplierResult.rows[0];

    // ========================================================
    // NEW WAREHOUSE
    // ========================================================

    const warehouseResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT
          warehouse_id,
          warehouse_code,
          warehouse_name
        FROM warehouses
        WHERE warehouse_id = $1
          AND is_active = TRUE
        `,
        [warehouseId]
      );

    if (warehouseResult.rows.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(
        "Warehouse not found or inactive."
      );
    }

    const warehouse =
      warehouseResult.rows[0];

    // ========================================================
    // OLD PURCHASE ITEMS
    // ========================================================

    const oldItemsResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT
          pi.*,
          pr.product_name,
          pr.unit
        FROM purchase_items pi
        INNER JOIN products pr
          ON pr.product_id = pi.product_id
        WHERE pi.purchase_id = $1
        `,
        [purchaseId]
      );

    const oldItems =
      oldItemsResult.rows;

    // ========================================================
    // PREPARE NEW ITEMS
    // ========================================================

    let subtotal = 0;

    const preparedItems = [];

    for (const item of items) {
      const productId =
        Number(item.productId);

      const quantity =
        Number(item.quantity);

      const unitCost =
        Number(item.unitCost) || 0;

      const itemDiscount =
        Number(item.discount) || 0;

      const itemTax =
        Number(item.tax) || 0;

      if (!productId) {
        throw new Error(
          "Invalid product selected."
        );
      }

      if (
        !Number.isFinite(quantity) ||
        quantity <= 0
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "Product quantity must be greater than zero."
        );
      }

      if (
        !Number.isFinite(unitCost) ||
        unitCost < 0
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "Purchase cost cannot be negative."
        );
      }

      if (
        itemDiscount < 0 ||
        itemTax < 0
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "Discount and tax cannot be negative."
        );
      }

      const productResult =
        await client.query(
          `
          SELECT
            product_id,
            product_name,
            unit,
            cost_price,
            is_active
          FROM products
          WHERE product_id = $1
          `,
          [productId]
        );

      if (productResult.rows.length === 0) {
        throw new Error(
          `Product ${productId} not found.`
        );
      }

      const product =
        productResult.rows[0];

      if (!product.is_active) {
        throw new Error(
          `Product "${product.product_name}" is inactive.`
        );
      }

      const lineTotal =
        quantity * unitCost -
        itemDiscount +
        itemTax;

      if (lineTotal < 0) {
        throw new Error(
          `Invalid total for product "${product.product_name}".`
        );
      }

      subtotal += lineTotal;

      preparedItems.push({
        productId,
        productName:
          product.product_name,
        unit:
          product.unit || "PCS",
        quantity,
        unitCost,
        discount:
          itemDiscount,
        tax:
          itemTax,
        lineTotal,
      });
    }

    // ========================================================
    // NEW TOTAL
    // ========================================================

    const purchaseDiscount =
      Number(discount) || 0;

    const purchaseTax =
      Number(tax) || 0;

    if (
      purchaseDiscount < 0 ||
      purchaseTax < 0
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Discount and tax cannot be negative."
      );
    }

    const totalAmount =
      subtotal -
      purchaseDiscount +
      purchaseTax;

    if (totalAmount < 0) {
      throw new Error(
        "Purchase total cannot be negative."
      );
    }

    // ========================================================
    // PRESERVE PAYMENTS
    // ========================================================

    const paidAmount =
      Number(oldPurchase.paid_amount) || 0;

    const balanceAmount =
      Math.max(
        totalAmount - paidAmount,
        0
      );

    let status = "UNPAID";

    if (paidAmount >= totalAmount) {
      status = "PAID";
    } else if (paidAmount > 0) {
      status = "PARTIAL";
    }

    // ========================================================
    // REVERSE OLD STOCK
    // ========================================================

    for (const oldItem of oldItems) {
      const oldStockResult =
        await client.query(
          `
          SELECT
            stock_id,
            quantity
          FROM stock
          WHERE product_id = $1
            AND warehouse_id = $2
          FOR UPDATE
          `,
          [
            oldItem.product_id,
            oldPurchase.warehouse_id,
          ]
        );

      if (
        oldStockResult.rows.length === 0
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          `Stock record not found for product ${oldItem.product_id}.`
        );
      }

      const oldStock =
        Number(
          oldStockResult.rows[0].quantity
        ) || 0;

      const newStock =
        oldStock -
        Number(oldItem.quantity);

      if (newStock < 0) {
        throw new Error(
          `Cannot edit purchase because stock for "${oldItem.product_name}" has already been used by another transaction.`
        );
      }

      await client.query(
        `
        UPDATE stock
        SET
          quantity = $1,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE stock_id = $2
        `,
        [
          newStock,
          oldStockResult.rows[0].stock_id,
        ]
      );
    }

    // ========================================================
    // REVERSE OLD ACCOUNTING BALANCES
    // ========================================================

    await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE chart_of_accounts
      SET
        current_balance =
          current_balance - $1,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE account_id = $2
      `,
      [
        Number(oldPurchase.total_amount) || 0,
        ACCOUNTS.INVENTORY,
      ]
    );

    await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE chart_of_accounts
      SET
        current_balance =
          current_balance - $1,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE account_id = $2
      `,
      [
        Number(oldPurchase.total_amount) || 0,
        ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE,
      ]
    );

    // ========================================================
    // DELETE OLD INVENTORY TRANSACTIONS
    // ========================================================

    await client.query(
      `
      DELETE FROM inventory_transactions
      WHERE transaction_type = 'VENDOR BILL'
        AND transaction_number = $1
      `,
      [oldPurchase.purchase_number]
    );

    // ========================================================
    // DELETE OLD JOURNAL
    // ========================================================

    const oldJournalResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        SELECT journal_id
        FROM journal_entries
        WHERE reference_type = 'PURCHASE'
          AND reference_id = $1
        `,
        [purchaseId]
      );

    for (
      const journal of
        oldJournalResult.rows
    ) {
      await client.query(
        `
        DELETE FROM journal_entry_lines
        WHERE journal_id = $1
        `,
        [journal.journal_id]
      );

      await client.query(
        `
        DELETE FROM journal_entries
        WHERE journal_id = $1
        `,
        [journal.journal_id]
      );
    }

    // ========================================================
    // DELETE OLD PURCHASE ITEMS
    // ========================================================

    await client.query(
      `
      DELETE FROM purchase_items
      WHERE purchase_id = $1
      `,
      [purchaseId]
    );

    // ========================================================
    // UPDATE PURCHASE HEADER
    // ========================================================

    await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE purchases
      SET
        purchase_number = $1,
        supplier_id = $2,
        warehouse_id = $3,
        purchase_date = COALESCE($4::DATE, CURRENT_DATE),
        subtotal = $5,
        discount = $6,
        tax = $7,
        total_amount = $8,
        paid_amount = $9,
        balance_amount = $10,
        status = $11,
        notes = $12,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE purchase_id = $13
      `,
      [
        finalPurchaseNumber,
        supplierId,
        warehouseId,
        purchaseDate || null,
        subtotal,
        purchaseDiscount,
        purchaseTax,
        totalAmount,
        paidAmount,
        balanceAmount,
        status,
        notes || null,
        purchaseId,
      ]
    );

    // ========================================================
    // INSERT NEW ITEMS + STOCK + INVENTORY
    // ========================================================

    for (
      const item of preparedItems
    ) {
      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO purchase_items (
          purchase_id,
          product_id,
          quantity,
          unit_cost,
          discount,
          tax,
          line_total
        )
        VALUES (
          $1,
          $2,
          $3,
          $4,
          $5,
          $6,
          $7
        )
        `,
        [
          purchaseId,
          item.productId,
          item.quantity,
          item.unitCost,
          item.discount,
          item.tax,
          item.lineTotal,
        ]
      );

      // ----------------------------------------
      // ADD NEW STOCK
      // ----------------------------------------

      const stockResult =
        await client.query(
          `
          SELECT
            stock_id,
            quantity
          FROM stock
          WHERE product_id = $1
            AND warehouse_id = $2
          FOR UPDATE
          `,
          [
            item.productId,
            warehouseId,
          ]
        );

      if (
        stockResult.rows.length > 0
      ) {
        await client.query(
          `
          UPDATE stock
          SET
            quantity = quantity + $1,
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
          WHERE product_id = $2
            AND warehouse_id = $3
          `,
          [
            item.quantity,
            item.productId,
            warehouseId,
          ]
        );
      } else {
        await client.query(
          `
          INSERT INTO stock (
            product_id,
            warehouse_id,
            quantity
          )
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
          `,
          [
            item.productId,
            warehouseId,
            item.quantity,
          ]
        );
      }

      // ----------------------------------------
      // RUNNING INVENTORY
      // ----------------------------------------

      const runningResult =
        await client.query(
          `
          SELECT
            COALESCE(
              SUM(
                COALESCE(receive_quantity, 0)
                -
                COALESCE(issue_quantity, 0)
              ),
              0
            ) AS running_quantity
          FROM inventory_transactions
          WHERE product_id = $1
            AND location = $2
          `,
          [
            item.productId,
            warehouse.warehouse_name,
          ]
        );

      const oldQuantity =
        Number(
          runningResult.rows[0]
            .running_quantity
        ) || 0;

      const newQuantity =
        oldQuantity +
        item.quantity;

      const receiveAmount =
        item.quantity *
        item.unitCost;

      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO inventory_transactions (
          product_id,
          transaction_date,
          transaction_type,
          transaction_number,
          location,
          uom,
          memo,
          transaction_rate,
          old_rate,
          actual_rate,
          new_rate,
          receive_quantity,
          receive_rate,
          receive_amount,
          issue_quantity,
          issue_rate,
          issue_amount,
          running_quantity
        )
        VALUES (
          $1,
          COALESCE($2::DATE, CURRENT_DATE),
          'VENDOR BILL',
          $3,
          $4,
          $5,
          $6,
          $7,
          $7,
          $7,
          $7,
          $8,
          $7,
          $9,
          0,
          0,
          0,
          $10
        )
        `,
        [
          item.productId,
          purchaseDate || null,
          finalPurchaseNumber,
          warehouse.warehouse_name,
          item.unit,
          `Purchase from ${supplier.supplier_name}`,
          item.unitCost,
          item.quantity,
          receiveAmount,
          newQuantity,
        ]
      );
    }

    // ========================================================
    // CREATE NEW JOURNAL
    // ========================================================

    const journalNumber =
      `PUR-JRN-${purchaseId}`;

    const journalResult =
      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO journal_entries (
          journal_number,
          journal_date,
          reference_type,
          reference_id,
          description,
          status
        )
        VALUES (
          $1,
          COALESCE($2::DATE, CURRENT_DATE),
          'PURCHASE',
          $3,
          $4,
          'POSTED'
        )
        RETURNING journal_id
        `,
        [
          journalNumber,
          purchaseDate || null,
          purchaseId,
          `Purchase ${finalPurchaseNumber} from ${supplier.supplier_name}`,
        ]
      );

    const journalId =
      journalResult.rows[0]
        .journal_id;

    // Inventory Debit

    await client.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO journal_entry_lines (
        journal_id,
        account_id,
        description,
        debit,
        credit,
        party_type,
        party_id
      )
      VALUES (
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        0,
        NULL,
        NULL
      )
      `,
      [
        journalId,
        ACCOUNTS.INVENTORY,
        `Inventory received from ${supplier.supplier_name}`,
        totalAmount,
      ]
    );

    // Payable Credit

    await client.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO journal_entry_lines (
        journal_id,
        account_id,
        description,
        debit,
        credit,
        party_type,
        party_id
      )
      VALUES (
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        0,
        $4,
        'SUPPLIER',
        $5
      )
      `,
      [
        journalId,
        ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE,
        `Payable to ${supplier.supplier_name}`,
        totalAmount,
        supplierId,
      ]
    );

    // ========================================================
    // ADD NEW ACCOUNT BALANCES
    // ========================================================

    await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE chart_of_accounts
      SET
        current_balance =
          current_balance + $1,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE account_id = $2
      `,
      [
        totalAmount,
        ACCOUNTS.INVENTORY,
      ]
    );

    await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE chart_of_accounts
      SET
        current_balance =
          current_balance + $1,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE account_id = $2
      `,
      [
        totalAmount,
        ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE,
      ]
    );

    // ========================================================
    // COMMIT
    // ========================================================

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    // ========================================================
    // GET UPDATED PURCHASE
    // ========================================================

    const updatedPurchaseResult =
      await pool.query(
        `
        SELECT
          p.purchase_id,
          p.purchase_number,

          p.supplier_id,
          s.supplier_code,
          s.supplier_name,

          p.warehouse_id,
          w.warehouse_code,
          w.warehouse_name,

          p.purchase_date,
          p.subtotal,
          p.discount,
          p.tax,
          p.total_amount,
          p.paid_amount,
          p.balance_amount,
          p.status,
          p.notes,
          p.created_at,
          p.updated_at

        FROM purchases p

        INNER JOIN suppliers s
          ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id

        INNER JOIN warehouses w
          ON w.warehouse_id = p.warehouse_id

        WHERE p.purchase_id = $1
        `,
        [purchaseId]
      );

    const updatedPurchase =
      updatedPurchaseResult.rows[0];

    const updatedItemsResult =
      await pool.query(
        `
        SELECT
          pi.purchase_item_id,
          pi.purchase_id,
          pi.product_id,
          pr.sku,
          pr.product_name,
          pi.quantity,
          pi.unit_cost,
          pi.discount,
          pi.tax,
          pi.line_total,
          pr.unit
        FROM purchase_items pi
        INNER JOIN products pr
          ON pr.product_id = pi.product_id
        WHERE pi.purchase_id = $1
        ORDER BY pi.purchase_item_id ASC
        `,
        [purchaseId]
      );

    updatedPurchase.items =
      updatedItemsResult.rows;

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message:
        "Purchase updated successfully. Stock, Items Ledger and Accounting Ledger updated.",
      purchase:
        updatedPurchase,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    try {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");
    } catch {}

    console.error(
      "PURCHASE PUT ERROR:",
      error
    );

    if (error.code === "23505") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message:
            "Purchase number already exists.",
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message:
          error.message ||
          "Failed to update purchase.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

===== app\api\receivable\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_code,
        c.customer_name,
        c.phone,

        c.opening_balance,

        COALESCE(
          SUM(si.total_amount),
          0
        ) AS total_sales,

        COALESCE(
          SUM(si.paid_amount),
          0
        ) AS total_paid,

        (
          c.opening_balance
          +
          COALESCE(
            SUM(si.total_amount),
            0
          )
          -
          COALESCE(
            SUM(si.paid_amount),
            0
          )
        ) AS receivable

      FROM customers c

      LEFT JOIN sales_invoices si
        ON si.customer_id = c.customer_id

      GROUP BY
        c.customer_id

      ORDER BY
        c.customer_name
    `);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      receivables: result.rows,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "RECEIVABLE GET ERROR:",
      error
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message:
          "Failed to load receivables.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

===== app\api\reports\balance-sheet\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.account_code,
        a.account_name,
        a.account_type,

        COALESCE(SUM(l.debit), 0) AS debit,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.credit), 0) AS credit

      FROM chart_of_accounts a

      LEFT JOIN journal_entry_lines l
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id

      LEFT JOIN journal_entries j
        ON j.journal_id = l.journal_id
        AND j.status = 'POSTED'

      WHERE a.account_type IN (
        'ASSET',
        'LIABILITY',
        'EQUITY'
      )

      GROUP BY
        a.account_id,
        a.account_code,
        a.account_name,
        a.account_type

      ORDER BY
        a.account_type,
        a.account_code
    `);

    const assets = [];
    const liabilities = [];
    const equity = [];

    let totalAssets = 0;
    let totalLiabilities = 0;
    let totalEquity = 0;

    for (const row of result.rows) {
      const debit = Number(row.debit);
      const credit = Number(row.credit);

      let balance = 0;

      if (row.account_type === "ASSET") {
        balance = debit - credit;

        assets.push({
          ...row,
          balance,
        });

        totalAssets += balance;
      }

      if (row.account_type === "LIABILITY") {
        balance = credit - debit;

        liabilities.push({
          ...row,
          balance,
        });

        totalLiabilities += balance;
      }

      if (row.account_type === "EQUITY") {
        balance = credit - debit;

        equity.push({
          ...row,
          balance,
        });

        totalEquity += balance;
      }
    }

    // Calculate current period profit.
    const profitResult = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        COALESCE(
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN a.account_type = 'REVENUE'
                THEN l.credit - l.debit
              WHEN a.account_type = 'EXPENSE'
                THEN -(l.debit - l.credit)
              ELSE 0
            END
          ),
          0
        ) AS net_profit

      FROM journal_entry_lines l

      INNER JOIN journal_entries j
        ON j.journal_id = l.journal_id

      INNER JOIN chart_of_accounts a
        ON a.account_id = l.account_id

      WHERE j.status = 'POSTED'
    `);

    const netProfit =
      Number(profitResult.rows[0]?.net_profit) || 0;

    const totalEquityWithProfit =
      totalEquity + netProfit;

    const liabilitiesAndEquity =
      totalLiabilities + totalEquityWithProfit;

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,

      assets,
      liabilities,
      equity,

      totals: {
        totalAssets,
        totalLiabilities,
        totalEquity,
        netProfit,
        totalEquityWithProfit,
        liabilitiesAndEquity,
        difference:
          totalAssets - liabilitiesAndEquity,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("BALANCE SHEET ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load Balance Sheet.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

===== app\api\reports\customer-ledger\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET(request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);

    const fromDate = searchParams.get("fromDate");
    const toDate = searchParams.get("toDate");
    const customerId = searchParams.get("customerId");

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // VALIDATION
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    if (!fromDate) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "From Date is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!toDate) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "To Date is required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!customerId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Please select a customer.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (fromDate > toDate) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "From Date cannot be greater than To Date.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // GET CUSTOMER
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    const customerResult = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        customer_id,
        customer_code,
        customer_name,
        opening_balance
      FROM customers
      WHERE customer_id = $1
      `,
      [customerId]
    );

    if (customerResult.rows.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Customer not found.",
        },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    const customer = customerResult.rows[0];

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // OPENING BALANCE BEFORE FROM DATE
    //
    // Opening Balance
    // + Previous Invoices
    // - Previous Payments
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    const openingResult = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        COALESCE(c.opening_balance, 0)
        +
        COALESCE(
          (
            SELECT SUM(si.total_amount)
            FROM sales_invoices si
            WHERE si.customer_id = c.customer_id
              AND si.invoice_date < $1
          ),
          0
        )
        -
        COALESCE(
          (
            SELECT SUM(sp.amount)
            FROM sales_payments sp
            WHERE sp.customer_id = c.customer_id
              AND sp.payment_date < $1
          ),
          0
        ) AS opening_balance
      FROM customers c
      WHERE c.customer_id = $2
      `,
      [fromDate, customerId]
    );

    let runningBalance = Number(
      openingResult.rows[0]?.opening_balance || 0
    );

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // GET INVOICES
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    const invoiceResult = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        invoice_id,
        invoice_number,
        invoice_date,
        total_amount,
        notes
      FROM sales_invoices
      WHERE customer_id = $1
        AND invoice_date >= $2
        AND invoice_date <= $3
      ORDER BY
        invoice_date ASC,
        invoice_id ASC
      `,
      [customerId, fromDate, toDate]
    );

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // GET PAYMENTS
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    const paymentResult = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        payment_id,
        payment_number,
        payment_date,
        amount,
        payment_method,
        reference_number,
        notes
      FROM sales_payments
      WHERE customer_id = $1
        AND payment_date >= $2
        AND payment_date <= $3
      ORDER BY
        payment_date ASC,
        payment_id ASC
      `,
      [customerId, fromDate, toDate]
    );

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // COMBINE TRANSACTIONS
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    const transactions = [];

    // Invoices = DEBIT

    invoiceResult.rows.forEach((invoice) => {
      transactions.push({
        transaction_date: invoice.invoice_date,
        transaction_number: invoice.invoice_number,
        reference_no: "",
        memo: invoice.notes || "Sales Invoice",
        debit: Number(invoice.total_amount || 0),
        credit: 0,
        transaction_type: "INVOICE",
        transaction_id: invoice.invoice_id,
      });
    });

    // Payments = CREDIT

    paymentResult.rows.forEach((payment) => {
      transactions.push({
        transaction_date: payment.payment_date,
        transaction_number: payment.payment_number,
        reference_no: payment.reference_number || "",
        memo:
          payment.notes ||
          payment.payment_method ||
          "Customer Payment",
        debit: 0,
        credit: Number(payment.amount || 0),
        transaction_type: "PAYMENT",
        transaction_id: payment.payment_id,
      });
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // SORT TRANSACTIONS
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    transactions.sort((a, b) => {
      const dateA = new Date(a.transaction_date);
      const dateB = new Date(b.transaction_date);

      if (dateA.getTime() !== dateB.getTime()) {
        return dateA.getTime() - dateB.getTime();
      }

      return Number(a.transaction_id) - Number(b.transaction_id);
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // RUNNING BALANCE
    //
    // Debit  = +
    // Credit = -
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    const ledger = transactions.map((transaction) => {
      runningBalance =
        runningBalance +
        Number(transaction.debit || 0) -
        Number(transaction.credit || 0);

      return {
        ...transaction,
        running_total: runningBalance,
      };
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // TOTALS
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    const totalDebit = ledger.reduce(
      (sum, row) => sum + Number(row.debit || 0),
      0
    );

    const totalCredit = ledger.reduce(
      (sum, row) => sum + Number(row.credit || 0),
      0
    );

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // RESPONSE
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,

      customer: {
        customer_id: customer.customer_id,
        customer_code: customer.customer_code,
        customer_name: customer.customer_name,
      },

      from_date: fromDate,
      to_date: toDate,

      opening_balance: Number(
        openingResult.rows[0]?.opening_balance || 0
      ),

      total_debit: totalDebit,
      total_credit: totalCredit,

      closing_balance: runningBalance,

      ledger,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("CUSTOMER LEDGER ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to generate customer ledger.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

===== app\api\reports\payments\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const sales = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        p.payment_id,
        p.payment_number,
        p.payment_date,
        'RECEIPT' AS transaction_type,
        c.customer_name AS party_name,
        p.amount,
        p.payment_method,
        p.reference_number,
        p.notes
      FROM sales_payments p
      INNER JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
      ORDER BY p.payment_date DESC, p.payment_id DESC
    `);

    const purchases = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        p.payment_id,
        p.payment_number,
        p.payment_date,
        'PAYMENT' AS transaction_type,
        s.supplier_name AS party_name,
        p.amount,
        p.payment_method,
        p.reference_number,
        p.notes
      FROM purchase_payments p
      INNER JOIN suppliers s
        ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
      ORDER BY p.payment_date DESC, p.payment_id DESC
    `);

    const payments = [
      ...sales.rows,
      ...purchases.rows,
    ].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        new Date(b.payment_date) -
        new Date(a.payment_date)
    );

    const summary = {
      totalReceipts: sales.rows.reduce(
        (sum, row) => sum + Number(row.amount),
        0
      ),

      totalPayments: purchases.rows.reduce(
        (sum, row) => sum + Number(row.amount),
        0
      ),
    };

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      summary,
      payments,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("PAYMENT REPORT ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load payment report.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

===== app\api\reports\profit-loss\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.account_code,
        a.account_name,
        a.account_type,

        COALESCE(SUM(l.debit), 0) AS debit,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.credit), 0) AS credit

      FROM chart_of_accounts a

      INNER JOIN journal_entry_lines l
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id

      INNER JOIN journal_entries j
        ON j.journal_id = l.journal_id

      WHERE j.status = 'POSTED'
        AND a.account_type IN ('REVENUE', 'EXPENSE')

      GROUP BY
        a.account_id,
        a.account_code,
        a.account_name,
        a.account_type

      ORDER BY
        a.account_type,
        a.account_code
    `);

    const revenue = [];
    const expenses = [];

    let totalRevenue = 0;
    let totalExpenses = 0;

    for (const row of result.rows) {
      const debit = Number(row.debit);
      const credit = Number(row.credit);

      let amount;

      if (row.account_type === "REVENUE") {
        amount = credit - debit;

        revenue.push({
          ...row,
          amount,
        });

        totalRevenue += amount;
      } else {
        amount = debit - credit;

        expenses.push({
          ...row,
          amount,
        });

        totalExpenses += amount;
      }
    }

    const netProfit = totalRevenue - totalExpenses;

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      revenue,
      expenses,
      totals: {
        totalRevenue,
        totalExpenses,
        netProfit,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("PROFIT LOSS ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load Profit & Loss.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

===== app\api\reports\purchases\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET(request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);

    const from = searchParams.get("from");
    const to = searchParams.get("to");

    const params = [];
    let dateCondition = "";

    if (from) {
      params.push(from);
      dateCondition += ` AND purchase_date >= $${params.length}`;
    }

    if (to) {
      params.push(to);
      dateCondition += ` AND purchase_date <= $${params.length}`;
    }

    const summary = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)::int AS invoice_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) AS subtotal,
        COALESCE(SUM(discount), 0) AS discount,
        COALESCE(SUM(tax), 0) AS tax,
        COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS total_purchase,
        COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS paid_amount,
        COALESCE(SUM(balance_amount), 0) AS balance_amount
      FROM purchase_invoices
      WHERE 1=1
      ${dateCondition}
      `,
      params
    );

    const suppliers = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        s.supplier_id,
        s.supplier_code,
        s.supplier_name,
        COUNT(p.purchase_id)::int AS invoice_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(p.total_amount), 0) AS total_purchase,
        COALESCE(SUM(p.paid_amount), 0) AS paid_amount,
        COALESCE(SUM(p.balance_amount), 0) AS balance_amount
      FROM suppliers s
      INNER JOIN purchase_invoices p
        ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
      WHERE 1=1
      ${dateCondition}
      GROUP BY
        s.supplier_id,
        s.supplier_code,
        s.supplier_name
      ORDER BY total_purchase DESC
      LIMIT 10
      `,
      params
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      summary: summary.rows[0],
      topSuppliers: suppliers.rows,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("PURCHASE REPORT ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load purchase dashboard.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET(request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);

    const from = searchParams.get("from");
    const to = searchParams.get("to");

    const params = [];
    let dateCondition = "";

    if (from) {
      params.push(from);
      dateCondition += ` AND invoice_date >= $${params.length}`;
    }

    if (to) {
      params.push(to);
      dateCondition += ` AND invoice_date <= $${params.length}`;
    }

    const summaryResult = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)::int AS invoice_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) AS subtotal,
        COALESCE(SUM(discount), 0) AS discount,
        COALESCE(SUM(tax), 0) AS tax,
        COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS total_sales,
        COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS paid_amount,
        COALESCE(SUM(balance_amount), 0) AS balance_amount
      FROM sales_invoices
      WHERE 1=1
      ${dateCondition}
      `,
      params
    );

    const statusResult = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        status,
        COUNT(*)::int AS count,
        COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount
      FROM sales_invoices
      WHERE 1=1
      ${dateCondition}
      GROUP BY status
      ORDER BY status
      `,
      params
    );

    const customerResult = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_code,
        c.customer_name,
        COUNT(i.invoice_id)::int AS invoice_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(i.total_amount), 0) AS total_sales,
        COALESCE(SUM(i.paid_amount), 0) AS paid_amount,
        COALESCE(SUM(i.balance_amount), 0) AS balance_amount
      FROM customers c
      INNER JOIN sales_invoices i
        ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
      WHERE 1=1
      ${dateCondition}
      GROUP BY
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_code,
        c.customer_name
      ORDER BY total_sales DESC
      LIMIT 10
      `,
      params
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      summary: summaryResult.rows[0],
      status: statusResult.rows,
      topCustomers: customerResult.rows,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("SALES REPORT ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load sales dashboard.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
