===== app\api\support-requests\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

const CATEGORIES = new Set([
  "password_reset",
  "account_unlock",
  "company_access",
  "new_company",
  "technical_support",
  "data_recovery",
  "license_renewal",
  "feature_request",
  "other",
]);

// Load only companies assigned to the logged-in user.
export async function GET() {
  try {
    const user = await getCurrentUser();

    if (!user?.userId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Please log in first." },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const result = await pool.query(
      `SELECT DISTINCT c.company_id, c.company_name
       FROM user_companies uc
       JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = uc.company_id
       JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = uc.role_id
       WHERE uc.user_id = $1
         AND c.is_active = TRUE
         AND (r.company_id IS NULL OR r.company_id = uc.company_id)
       ORDER BY c.company_name`,
      [user.userId]
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      companies: result.rows.map((row) => ({
        companyId: row.company_id,
        companyName: row.company_name,
      })),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Support companies GET error:", error.message);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Unable to load companies. Check the server terminal." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// Submit a request to the central Super Admin.
export async function POST(request) {
  try {
    const user = await getCurrentUser();

    if (!user?.userId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Please log in first." },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const body = await request.json();

    const companyId = Number(body.companyId);
    const category = String(body.category || "").trim();
    const subject = String(body.subject || "").trim();
    const description = String(body.description || "").trim();

    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(companyId) || companyId < 1) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Select a valid company." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!CATEGORIES.has(category)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Select a valid request type." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!subject || subject.length > 200) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Subject is required and must be at most 200 characters." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!description || description.length > 10000) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Description is required and must be at most 10,000 characters." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // Confirm company membership and obtain trusted user/company details.
    const membershipResult = await pool.query(
      `SELECT
         c.company_id,
         c.company_name,
         u.user_id,
         u.full_name,
         u.email
       FROM user_companies uc
       JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = uc.company_id
       JOIN users u ON u.user_id = uc.user_id
       JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = uc.role_id
       WHERE uc.user_id = $1
         AND uc.company_id = $2
         AND c.is_active = TRUE
         AND u.is_active = TRUE
         AND (r.company_id IS NULL OR r.company_id = uc.company_id)
       LIMIT 1`,
      [user.userId, companyId]
    );

    if (membershipResult.rowCount === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "You do not have access to this company." },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }

    const membership = membershipResult.rows[0];
    const clientId = Number(process.env.LICENSE_CLIENT_ID);
    const superAdminUrl = process.env.SUPER_ADMIN_API_URL;
    const secret = process.env.CLIENT_DATA_API_SECRET;
    console.log("Support configuration check:", {
  clientIdIsValid:
    Number.isSafeInteger(clientId) && clientId > 0,
  superAdminUrlLoaded: Boolean(superAdminUrl),
  secretLoaded: Boolean(secret),
});

    if (
      !Number.isSafeInteger(clientId) ||
      clientId < 1 ||
      !superAdminUrl ||
      !secret
    ) {
      console.error("Support integration environment variables are missing.");

      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Support service is not configured." },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    const response = await fetch(
      `${superAdminUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/api/public/support-requests`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "x-client-data-secret": secret,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          clientId,
          companyId: membership.company_id,
          companyName: membership.company_name,
          requesterUserId: membership.user_id,
          requesterName: membership.full_name,
          requesterEmail: membership.email,
          category,
          subject,
          description,
        }),
        cache: "no-store",
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000),
      }
    );

    const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

    if (!response.ok) {
      console.error("Super Admin support API error:", response.status, data);

      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: data.error || "Super Admin rejected the request." },
        { status: response.status >= 500 ? 502 : response.status }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Support request POST error:", error.message);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Unable to process your request. Check the server terminal." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}


===== app\api\unit-stock\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET(request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const productId = searchParams.get("productId");
    const warehouseId = searchParams.get("warehouseId");

    const values = [];
    const conditions = [];

    if (productId) {
      values.push(productId);
      conditions.push(`pu.product_id = $${values.length}`);
    }

    if (warehouseId) {
      values.push(warehouseId);
      conditions.push(`w.warehouse_id = $${values.length}`);
    }

    const where = conditions.length
      ? `WHERE ${conditions.join(" AND ")}`
      : "";

    const result = await pool.query(
      `
      SELECT
        pu.unit_id,
        pu.product_id,
        pu.unit_name,
        pu.barcode,
        pu.conversion_factor,
        pu.is_base_unit,
        p.sku,
        p.product_name,
        w.warehouse_id,
        w.warehouse_name,
        COALESCE(us.quantity, 0) AS quantity
      FROM product_units pu
      JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pu.product_id
      CROSS JOIN warehouses w
      LEFT JOIN unit_stock us
        ON us.unit_id = pu.unit_id
       AND us.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
      ${where}
      ORDER BY p.product_name, w.warehouse_name, pu.is_base_unit DESC, pu.unit_name
      `,
      values
    );

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, stock: result.rows });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("UNIT STOCK GET ERROR:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, message: "Failed to load packaging stock." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request) {
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const warehouseId = Number(body.warehouseId);
    const fromUnitId = Number(body.fromUnitId);
    const toUnitId = Number(body.toUnitId);
    const quantity = Number(body.quantity);

    if (
      !Number.isInteger(warehouseId) ||
      !Number.isInteger(fromUnitId) ||
      !Number.isInteger(toUnitId) ||
      fromUnitId === toUnitId ||
      !Number.isFinite(quantity) ||
      quantity <= 0
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Select different source and destination units, a warehouse, and a positive quantity." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    await client.query("BEGIN");

    const units = await client.query(
      `
      SELECT unit_id, product_id, unit_name, conversion_factor
      FROM product_units
      WHERE unit_id = ANY($1::int[])
      ORDER BY unit_id
      FOR UPDATE
      `,
      [[fromUnitId, toUnitId]]
    );

    if (units.rowCount !== 2 || units.rows[0].product_id !== units.rows[1].product_id) {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Both units must belong to the same product." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const fromUnit = units.rows.find((unit) => unit.unit_id === fromUnitId);
    const toUnit = units.rows.find((unit) => unit.unit_id === toUnitId);

    const fromStock = await client.query(
      `
      SELECT quantity FROM unit_stock
      WHERE unit_id = $1 AND warehouse_id = $2
      FOR UPDATE
      `,
      [fromUnitId, warehouseId]
    );

    const toStock = await client.query(
      `
      SELECT quantity FROM unit_stock
      WHERE unit_id = $1 AND warehouse_id = $2
      FOR UPDATE
      `,
      [toUnitId, warehouseId]
    );

    if (fromStock.rowCount === 0 || toStock.rowCount === 0) {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Stock records not found for this warehouse." },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    if (Number(fromStock.rows[0].quantity) < quantity) {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: `Not enough ${fromUnit.unit_name} in this warehouse.` },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const convertedQuantity =
      quantity *
      Number(fromUnit.conversion_factor) /
      Number(toUnit.conversion_factor);

    await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE unit_stock
      SET quantity = quantity - $1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE unit_id = $2 AND warehouse_id = $3
      `,
      [quantity, fromUnitId, warehouseId]
    );

    await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE unit_stock
      SET quantity = quantity + $1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE unit_id = $2 AND warehouse_id = $3
      `,
      [convertedQuantity, toUnitId, warehouseId]
    );

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "Stock converted successfully.",
      sourceQuantity: quantity,
      destinationQuantity: convertedQuantity,
      destinationUnit: toUnit.unit_name,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query("ROLLBACK");
    console.error("UNIT STOCK CONVERSION ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, message: "Failed to convert stock." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}


===== app\api\unit-stock\adjust\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function POST(request) {
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const unitId = Number(body.unitId);
    const warehouseId = Number(body.warehouseId);
    const quantity = Number(body.quantity);
    const type = body.type;

    if (
      !Number.isInteger(unitId) ||
      !Number.isInteger(warehouseId) ||
      !Number.isFinite(quantity) ||
      quantity <= 0 ||
      !["INCREASE", "DECREASE"].includes(type)
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Provide a unit, warehouse, positive quantity, and valid adjustment type." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    await client.query("BEGIN");

    const result = await client.query(
      `
      SELECT quantity
      FROM unit_stock
      WHERE unit_id = $1 AND warehouse_id = $2
      FOR UPDATE
      `,
      [unitId, warehouseId]
    );

    if (result.rowCount === 0) {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "Stock record not found." },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    const currentQuantity = Number(result.rows[0].quantity);

    if (type === "DECREASE" && currentQuantity < quantity) {
      await client.query("ROLLBACK");
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message: "The adjustment exceeds available stock." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const operator = type === "INCREASE" ? "+" : "-";

    const updated = await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE unit_stock
      SET quantity = quantity ${operator} $1,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE unit_id = $2 AND warehouse_id = $3
      RETURNING quantity
      `,
      [quantity, unitId, warehouseId]
    );

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "Packaging stock adjusted successfully.",
      quantity: updated.rows[0].quantity,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query("ROLLBACK");
    console.error("UNIT STOCK ADJUSTMENT ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, message: "Failed to adjust packaging stock." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT unit_id, unit_code, unit_name, description, is_active,
             created_at, updated_at
      FROM units_of_measure
      ORDER BY unit_code ASC
    `);

    return NextResponse.json(result.rows);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("GET units:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to load units of measure." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const code = String(body.unit_code ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
    const name = String(body.unit_name ?? "").trim();
    const description = String(body.description ?? "").trim();
    const isActive = body.is_active ?? true;

    if (!code || !name || code.length > 30 || name.length > 100) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Provide a valid unit code and unit name." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (typeof isActive !== "boolean") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Invalid active status." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const result = await pool.query(
      `INSERT INTO units_of_measure
        (unit_code, unit_name, description, is_active)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
       RETURNING *`,
      [code, name, description || null, isActive]
    );

    return NextResponse.json(result.rows[0], { status: 201 });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code === "23505") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "This unit code already exists." },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    console.error("POST unit:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to create unit." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}


===== app\api\units-of-measure\import\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import * as XLSX from "xlsx";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

function normalizeHeader(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[_-]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
}

function parseBoolean(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") {
    return true;
  }

  if (typeof value === "boolean") {
    return value;
  }

  const normalized = String(value).trim().toLowerCase();

  if (["true", "1", "yes", "active"].includes(normalized)) {
    return true;
  }

  if (["false", "0", "no", "inactive"].includes(normalized)) {
    return false;
  }

  throw new Error(`Invalid Is Active value: ${value}`);
}

export async function POST(request) {
  let client;

  try {
    const formData = await request.formData();
    const file = formData.get("file");

    if (!file || typeof file.arrayBuffer !== "function") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Please select an Excel or CSV file." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const extension = file.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase();

    if (!["xlsx", "csv"].includes(extension)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Only .xlsx and .csv files are supported." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "File size must not exceed 5 MB." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
    const workbook = XLSX.read(buffer, { type: "buffer" });
    const sheet = workbook.Sheets[workbook.SheetNames[0]];

    if (!sheet) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "No worksheet found in the uploaded file." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, {
      defval: "",
      raw: false,
    });

    if (!rows.length) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "The spreadsheet contains no data rows." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const errors = [];
    const seenCodes = new Set();
    let imported = 0;
    let skipped = 0;

    client = await pool.connect();
    await client.query("BEGIN");

    for (let index = 0; index < rows.length; index++) {
      const rowNumber = index + 2;
      const row = {};

      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(rows[index])) {
        row[normalizeHeader(key)] = value;
      }

      const unitCode = String(
        row["unit code"] ?? row["code"] ?? ""
      ).trim().toUpperCase();

      const unitName = String(
        row["unit name"] ?? row["name"] ?? ""
      ).trim();

      const description = String(row["description"] ?? "").trim();

      try {
        if (!unitCode) {
          throw new Error("Unit Code is required.");
        }

        if (!unitName) {
          throw new Error("Unit Name is required.");
        }

        if (unitCode.length > 30) {
          throw new Error("Unit Code cannot exceed 30 characters.");
        }

        if (unitName.length > 100) {
          throw new Error("Unit Name cannot exceed 100 characters.");
        }

        const normalizedCode = unitCode.toLowerCase();

        if (seenCodes.has(normalizedCode)) {
          throw new Error(
            `Duplicate Unit Code "${unitCode}" in the spreadsheet.`
          );
        }

        seenCodes.add(normalizedCode);

        const isActive = parseBoolean(
          row["is active"] ?? row["active"] ?? ""
        );

        await client.query("SAVEPOINT unit_row");

        // Check existing unit codes without relying on ON CONFLICT.
        const existing = await client.query(
          `SELECT unit_id
           FROM units_of_measure
           WHERE LOWER(unit_code) = LOWER($1)
           LIMIT 1`,
          [unitCode]
        );

        if (existing.rowCount > 0) {
          await client.query("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT unit_row");
          await client.query("RELEASE SAVEPOINT unit_row");

          errors.push(
            `Row ${rowNumber}: Unit Code "${unitCode}" already exists.`
          );
          skipped++;
          continue;
        }

        await client.query(
          `INSERT INTO units_of_measure
             (unit_code, unit_name, description, is_active)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)`,
          [unitCode, unitName, description || null, isActive]
        );

        await client.query("RELEASE SAVEPOINT unit_row");
        imported++;
      } catch (error) {
        try {
          await client.query("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT unit_row");
          await client.query("RELEASE SAVEPOINT unit_row");
        } catch {
          // The row may have failed before its savepoint was created.
        }

        errors.push(`Row ${rowNumber}: ${error.message}`);
        skipped++;
      }
    }

    await client.query("COMMIT");

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: `Imported ${imported} units. Skipped ${skipped}.`,
      imported,
      skipped,
      errors,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (client) {
      try {
        await client.query("ROLLBACK");
      } catch {
        // Ignore rollback errors.
      }
    }

    console.error("Units of Measure import error:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Unit import failed. Check the server terminal and database schema.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  } finally {
    client?.release();
  }
}

===== app\api\users\route.js =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";
import pool from "@/lib/db";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth";
import { hasPermission } from "@/lib/permissions";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const runtime = "nodejs";

// =====================================================
// PERMISSIONS
// =====================================================

async function canManageUsers(membership, action) {
    return (
        String(membership.role_name).toUpperCase() === "ADMIN" ||
        await hasPermission(membership.role_id, "users", action)
    );
}

// =====================================================
// GET /api/users
// Returns users with their company memberships,
// company logos, company locations, and assigned roles.
// =====================================================

export async function GET() {
    try {
        const currentUser = await getCurrentUser();

        if (!currentUser?.userId) {
            return NextResponse.json(
                { success: false, message: "Unauthorized." },
                { status: 401 }
            );
        }

        // Get the companies the current user can manage.
        const membershipsResult = await pool.query(
            `
            SELECT
                uc.company_id,
                uc.role_id,
                r.role_name
            FROM user_companies uc
            INNER JOIN users u
                ON u.user_id = uc.user_id
            INNER JOIN companies c
                ON c.company_id = uc.company_id
            INNER JOIN roles r
                ON r.role_id = uc.role_id
            WHERE uc.user_id = $1
              AND u.is_active = TRUE
              AND c.is_active = TRUE
            ORDER BY uc.assigned_at, uc.company_id
            `,
            [currentUser.userId]
        );

        const allowedCompanyIds = [];

        for (const membership of membershipsResult.rows) {
            if (await canManageUsers(membership, "view")) {
                allowedCompanyIds.push(membership.company_id);
            }
        }

        if (allowedCompanyIds.length === 0) {
            return NextResponse.json(
                {
                    success: false,
                    message:
                        "You do not have permission to view users in your companies.",
                },
                { status: 403 }
            );
        }

        // IMPORTANT:
        // Each result row represents one user-company membership.
        // Company fields use explicit aliases so they cannot be
        // confused with the user's own location or other fields.
        const result = await pool.query(
            `
            SELECT
                u.user_id,
                u.full_name,
                u.username,
                u.email,
                u.location AS user_location,
                u.is_active,
                u.last_login,
                u.created_at,

                uc.role_id,
                r.role_name,

                c.company_id,
                c.company_name,

                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(BTRIM(c.logo_url), ''),
                    NULLIF(BTRIM(c.logo_path), '')
                ) AS company_logo_url,

                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(BTRIM(c.location), ''),
                    NULLIF(BTRIM(c.city), ''),
                    NULLIF(BTRIM(c.address), '')
                ) AS company_city

            FROM user_companies uc

            INNER JOIN users u
                ON u.user_id = uc.user_id

            INNER JOIN companies c
                ON c.company_id = uc.company_id

            INNER JOIN roles r
                ON r.role_id = uc.role_id

            WHERE uc.company_id = ANY($1::int[])
              AND c.is_active = TRUE

            ORDER BY
                u.user_id DESC,
                c.company_name ASC,
                c.company_id ASC
            `,
            [allowedCompanyIds]
        );

        return NextResponse.json(
            {
                success: true,
                companyId: null,
                companyIds: allowedCompanyIds,
                users: result.rows,
            },
            {
                status: 200,
                headers: {
                    "Cache-Control": "no-store",
                },
            }
        );
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("GET USERS ERROR:", error);

        return NextResponse.json(
            {
                success: false,
                message: "Failed to load users.",
            },
            { status: 500 }
        );
    }
}

// =====================================================
// POST /api/users
// Create a user and assign them to the current user's
// first active company, preserving existing behavior.
// =====================================================

export async function POST(request) {
    let client;

    try {
        const currentUser = await getCurrentUser();

        if (!currentUser?.userId) {
            return NextResponse.json(
                { success: false, message: "Unauthorized." },
                { status: 401 }
            );
        }

        client = await pool.connect();
        await client.query("BEGIN");

        const membershipResult = await client.query(
            `
            SELECT
                uc.company_id,
                uc.role_id,
                r.role_name
            FROM user_companies uc
            INNER JOIN users u
                ON u.user_id = uc.user_id
            INNER JOIN companies c
                ON c.company_id = uc.company_id
            INNER JOIN roles r
                ON r.role_id = uc.role_id
            WHERE uc.user_id = $1
              AND u.is_active = TRUE
              AND c.is_active = TRUE
            ORDER BY uc.assigned_at, uc.company_id
            LIMIT 1
            `,
            [currentUser.userId]
        );

        const membership = membershipResult.rows[0];

        if (!membership) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");

            return NextResponse.json(
                {
                    success: false,
                    message:
                        "No active company is assigned to your account.",
                },
                { status: 400 }
            );
        }

        if (!(await canManageUsers(membership, "create"))) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");

            return NextResponse.json(
                {
                    success: false,
                    message:
                        "You do not have permission to create users.",
                },
                { status: 403 }
            );
        }

        const companyId = membership.company_id;
        const body = await request.json();

        const fullName =
            typeof body.fullName === "string"
                ? body.fullName.trim()
                : "";

        const username =
            typeof body.username === "string"
                ? body.username.trim()
                : "";

        const email =
            typeof body.email === "string"
                ? body.email.trim().toLowerCase()
                : "";

        const location =
            typeof body.location === "string"
                ? body.location.trim()
                : "";

        const password = body.password;
        const roleId = Number(body.roleId);

        if (
            !fullName ||
            fullName.length > 150 ||
            !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,100}$/.test(username) ||
            (email &&
                !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) ||
            location.length > 255 ||
            typeof password !== "string" ||
            password.length < 8 ||
            !Number.isSafeInteger(roleId) ||
            roleId <= 0
        ) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");

            return NextResponse.json(
                {
                    success: false,
                    message:
                        "Enter a valid name, username, email, location, password of at least 8 characters, and role.",
                },
                { status: 400 }
            );
        }

        const duplicate = await client.query(
            `
            SELECT user_id
            FROM users
            WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER($1)
               OR (
                    $2::text IS NOT NULL
                    AND LOWER(email) = LOWER($2)
               )
            LIMIT 1
            `,
            [username, email || null]
        );

        if (duplicate.rows.length) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");

            return NextResponse.json(
                {
                    success: false,
                    message:
                        "Username or email already exists. Use company access to assign an existing user.",
                },
                { status: 409 }
            );
        }

        const roleResult = await client.query(
            `
            SELECT role_id, role_name
            FROM roles
            WHERE role_id = $1
              AND (company_id IS NULL OR company_id = $2)
            LIMIT 1
            `,
            [roleId, companyId]
        );

        if (!roleResult.rows.length) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");

            return NextResponse.json(
                {
                    success: false,
                    message:
                        "Selected role is not available for this company.",
                },
                { status: 400 }
            );
        }

        const selectedRoleName = String(
            roleResult.rows[0].role_name
        ).toUpperCase();

        if (
            String(membership.role_name).toUpperCase() !== "ADMIN" &&
            ["ADMIN", "SUB_ADMIN"].includes(selectedRoleName)
        ) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");

            return NextResponse.json(
                {
                    success: false,
                    message:
                        "Only an ADMIN can create ADMIN or SUB_ADMIN accounts.",
                },
                { status: 403 }
            );
        }

        const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(password, 12);

        const userResult = await client.query(
            `
            INSERT INTO users (
                full_name,
                username,
                email,
                location,
                password_hash,
                role_id,
                company_id,
                is_active,
                created_at,
                updated_at
            )
            VALUES (
                $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7,
                TRUE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
            RETURNING
                user_id,
                full_name,
                username,
                email,
                location,
                role_id,
                company_id,
                is_active,
                created_at
            `,
            [
                fullName,
                username,
                email || null,
                location || null,
                passwordHash,
                roleId,
                companyId,
            ]
        );

        const user = userResult.rows[0];

        await client.query(
            `
            INSERT INTO user_companies (
                user_id,
                company_id,
                role_id
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id, company_id)
            DO UPDATE SET role_id = EXCLUDED.role_id
            `,
            [user.user_id, companyId, roleId]
        );

        await client.query("COMMIT");

        return NextResponse.json(
            {
                success: true,
                message: "User created successfully.",
                user,
            },
            { status: 201 }
        );
    } catch (error) {
        if (client) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK").catch(() => {});
        }

        console.error("CREATE USER ERROR:", error);

        if (error.code === "23505") {
            return NextResponse.json(
                {
                    success: false,
                    message: "Username or email already exists.",
                },
                { status: 409 }
            );
        }

        return NextResponse.json(
            {
                success: false,
                message: "Failed to create user.",
            },
            { status: 500 }
        );
    } finally {
        client?.release();
    }
}


===== app\api\users\company-access\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import pool from "@/lib/db";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth";
import { hasPermission } from "@/lib/permissions";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function parseId(value) {
    const id = Number(value);
    return Number.isSafeInteger(id) && id > 0 ? id : null;
}

function jsonError(message, status = 400) {
    return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, message },
        {
            status,
            headers: {
                "Cache-Control": "no-store",
            },
        }
    );
}

function jsonSuccess(data, status = 200) {
    return NextResponse.json(data, {
        status,
        headers: {
            "Cache-Control": "no-store",
        },
    });
}

async function readJson(request) {
    try {
        return await request.json();
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

/**
 * Return active companies accessible to a user.
 * The client argument allows use with either pool or a transaction client.
 */
async function getAllowedCompanies(client, userId) {
    const result = await client.query(
        `
        SELECT
            c.company_id,
            c.company_name,
            c.location,
            c.city,
            c.state_province,
            c.province,
            c.country,
            c.address,
            c.postal_code,
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(BTRIM(c.location), ''),
                NULLIF(BTRIM(c.city), ''),
                NULLIF(BTRIM(c.address), '')
            ) AS company_city,
            c.is_active,
            actor_role.role_name AS your_role
        FROM user_companies uc
        INNER JOIN companies c
            ON c.company_id = uc.company_id
        LEFT JOIN roles actor_role
            ON actor_role.role_id = uc.role_id
        WHERE uc.user_id = $1
          AND c.is_active = TRUE
        ORDER BY c.company_name ASC, c.company_id ASC
        `,
        [userId]
    );

    return result.rows;
}

async function getAvailableRoles(client, companyIds) {
    if (!companyIds.length) {
        return [];
    }

    const result = await client.query(
        `
        SELECT
            role_id,
            role_name,
            description,
            is_system_role,
            company_id
        FROM roles
        WHERE company_id IS NULL
           OR company_id = ANY($1::int[])
        ORDER BY role_name ASC, role_id ASC
        `,
        [companyIds]
    );

    return result.rows;
}

/**
 * GET /api/users/company-access
 * Optional query parameter: ?userId=123
 */
export async function GET(request) {
    try {
        const currentUser = await getCurrentUser();

        if (!currentUser) {
            return jsonError("Unauthorized.", 401);
        }

        const allowed = await hasPermission(
            currentUser.roleId,
            "users",
            "view"
        );

        if (!allowed) {
            return jsonError(
                "You do not have permission to view user access.",
                403
            );
        }

        const url = new URL(request.url);
        const rawUserId = url.searchParams.get("userId");
        let targetUserId = null;

        if (rawUserId !== null) {
            targetUserId = parseId(rawUserId);

            if (!targetUserId) {
                return jsonError("Invalid user ID.");
            }
        }

        // This query includes location and address from companies.
        const companies = await getAllowedCompanies(
            pool,
            currentUser.userId
        );

        const companyIds = companies.map((company) =>
            Number(company.company_id)
        );

        if (companyIds.length === 0) {
            return jsonSuccess({
                success: true,
                companies: [],
                assignments: [],
            });
        }

        const roles = await getAvailableRoles(pool, companyIds);

        const companiesWithRoles = companies.map((company) => ({
            ...company,
            roles: roles.filter(
                (role) =>
                    role.company_id == null ||
                    Number(role.company_id) ===
                        Number(company.company_id)
            ),
        }));

        let assignments = [];

        if (targetUserId !== null) {
            const targetResult = await pool.query(
                `
                SELECT u.user_id
                FROM users u
                WHERE u.user_id = $1
                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM user_companies target_uc
                      INNER JOIN user_companies actor_uc
                          ON actor_uc.company_id =
                             target_uc.company_id
                      WHERE target_uc.user_id = u.user_id
                        AND actor_uc.user_id = $2
                  )
                LIMIT 1
                `,
                [targetUserId, currentUser.userId]
            );

            if (targetResult.rows.length === 0) {
                return jsonError(
                    "User not found in your accessible companies.",
                    404
                );
            }

            const assignmentResult = await pool.query(
                `
                SELECT
                    uc.user_id,
                    uc.company_id,
                    uc.role_id,
                    r.role_name
                FROM user_companies uc
                INNER JOIN roles r
                    ON r.role_id = uc.role_id
                INNER JOIN user_companies actor_uc
                    ON actor_uc.company_id = uc.company_id
                   AND actor_uc.user_id = $2
                WHERE uc.user_id = $1
                ORDER BY uc.company_id ASC
                `,
                [targetUserId, currentUser.userId]
            );

            assignments = assignmentResult.rows;
        }

        return jsonSuccess({
            success: true,
            companies: companiesWithRoles,
            assignments,
        });
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("GET COMPANY ACCESS ERROR:", error);

        return jsonError("Failed to load company access.", 500);
    }
}

/**
 * POST /api/users/company-access
 * Assign an existing user to a company.
 */
export async function POST(request) {
    let client;
    let transactionStarted = false;

    try {
        const currentUser = await getCurrentUser();

        if (!currentUser) {
            return jsonError("Unauthorized.", 401);
        }

        const allowed = await hasPermission(
            currentUser.roleId,
            "users",
            "update"
        );

        if (!allowed) {
            return jsonError(
                "You do not have permission to assign company access.",
                403
            );
        }

        const body = await readJson(request);

        if (!body) {
            return jsonError("Request body must contain valid JSON.");
        }

        const identifier =
            typeof body.identifier === "string"
                ? body.identifier.trim()
                : "";

        const companyId = parseId(body.companyId);
        const roleId = parseId(body.roleId);

        if (!identifier || !companyId || !roleId) {
            return jsonError(
                "Username or email, company, and role are required."
            );
        }

        client = await pool.connect();

        await client.query("BEGIN");
        transactionStarted = true;

        const actorCompanies = await getAllowedCompanies(
            client,
            currentUser.userId
        );

        const allowedCompanyIds = new Set(
            actorCompanies.map((company) =>
                Number(company.company_id)
            )
        );

        if (!allowedCompanyIds.has(companyId)) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");
            transactionStarted = false;

            return jsonError(
                "You can assign users only to active companies you belong to.",
                403
            );
        }

        const userResult = await client.query(
            `
            SELECT user_id, username, is_active
            FROM users
            WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER($1)
               OR (
                    email IS NOT NULL
                    AND LOWER(email) = LOWER($1)
               )
            LIMIT 1
            FOR UPDATE
            `,
            [identifier]
        );

        if (userResult.rows.length === 0) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");
            transactionStarted = false;

            return jsonError(
                "No existing user was found with that username or email.",
                404
            );
        }

        const targetUser = userResult.rows[0];
        const targetUserId = Number(targetUser.user_id);

        if (targetUserId === Number(currentUser.userId)) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");
            transactionStarted = false;

            return jsonError(
                "You cannot assign company access to your own account.",
                400
            );
        }

        if (!targetUser.is_active) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");
            transactionStarted = false;

            return jsonError(
                "This user is inactive. Activate the account first.",
                400
            );
        }

        const roleResult = await client.query(
            `
            SELECT role_id, role_name
            FROM roles
            WHERE role_id = $1
              AND (
                  company_id IS NULL
                  OR company_id = $2
              )
            LIMIT 1
            `,
            [roleId, companyId]
        );

        if (roleResult.rows.length === 0) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");
            transactionStarted = false;

            return jsonError(
                "The selected role is not available for this company.",
                400
            );
        }

        await client.query(
            `
            INSERT INTO user_companies (
                user_id,
                company_id,
                role_id
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id, company_id)
            DO UPDATE SET role_id = EXCLUDED.role_id
            `,
            [targetUserId, companyId, roleId]
        );

        await client.query("COMMIT");
        transactionStarted = false;

        // Return the full company location in the POST response too.
        const companyResult = await pool.query(
            `
            SELECT
                company_id,
                company_name,
                location,
                city,
                state_province,
                province,
                country,
                address,
                postal_code,
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(BTRIM(location), ''),
                    NULLIF(BTRIM(city), ''),
                    NULLIF(BTRIM(address), '')
                ) AS company_city
            FROM companies
            WHERE company_id = $1
            `,
            [companyId]
        );

        return jsonSuccess({
            success: true,
            message: "User assigned to the company successfully.",
            assignment: {
                user_id: targetUserId,
                username: targetUser.username,
                ...companyResult.rows[0],
                role_id: roleId,
                role_name: roleResult.rows[0].role_name,
            },
        });
    } catch (error) {
        if (client && transactionStarted) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK").catch(() => {});
        }

        console.error("POST COMPANY ACCESS ERROR:", error);

        if (error.code === "23503") {
            return jsonError(
                "The selected company, user, or role does not exist.",
                400
            );
        }

        return jsonError(
            "Failed to assign user to the company.",
            500
        );
    } finally {
        client?.release();
    }
}

/**
 * PUT /api/users/company-access
 * Replaces assignments only within the acting user's active
 * company memberships. Assignments in other companies are preserved.
 */
export async function PUT(request) {
    let client;
    let transactionStarted = false;

    try {
        const currentUser = await getCurrentUser();

        if (!currentUser) {
            return jsonError("Unauthorized.", 401);
        }

        const allowed = await hasPermission(
            currentUser.roleId,
            "users",
            "update"
        );

        if (!allowed) {
            return jsonError(
                "You do not have permission to update user access.",
                403
            );
        }

        const body = await readJson(request);

        if (!body) {
            return jsonError("Request body must contain valid JSON.");
        }

        const targetUserId = parseId(body.userId);
        const assignments = body.assignments;

        if (!targetUserId) {
            return jsonError("A valid user ID is required.");
        }

        if (Number(currentUser.userId) === targetUserId) {
            return jsonError(
                "You cannot change your own company access.",
                400
            );
        }

        if (!Array.isArray(assignments)) {
            return jsonError("Assignments must be an array.");
        }

        const normalizedAssignments = [];
        const seenCompanyIds = new Set();

        for (const item of assignments) {
            if (!item || typeof item !== "object") {
                return jsonError(
                    "Each assignment must include a company and role."
                );
            }

            const companyId = parseId(item.companyId);
            const roleId = parseId(item.roleId);

            if (!companyId || !roleId) {
                return jsonError(
                    "Every assignment needs a valid company ID and role ID."
                );
            }

            if (seenCompanyIds.has(companyId)) {
                return jsonError(
                    "A company can only appear once in the assignments."
                );
            }

            seenCompanyIds.add(companyId);
            normalizedAssignments.push({ companyId, roleId });
        }

        client = await pool.connect();

        await client.query("BEGIN");
        transactionStarted = true;

        const actorCompanies = await getAllowedCompanies(
            client,
            currentUser.userId
        );

        const actorCompanyIds = new Set(
            actorCompanies.map((company) =>
                Number(company.company_id)
            )
        );

        if (actorCompanyIds.size === 0) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");
            transactionStarted = false;

            return jsonError(
                "You do not belong to any active company.",
                403
            );
        }

        for (const assignment of normalizedAssignments) {
            if (!actorCompanyIds.has(assignment.companyId)) {
                await client.query("ROLLBACK");
                transactionStarted = false;

                return jsonError(
                    "You can assign users only to companies you belong to.",
                    403
                );
            }
        }

        const targetResult = await client.query(
            `
            SELECT u.user_id, u.is_active
            FROM users u
            WHERE u.user_id = $1
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM user_companies target_uc
                  INNER JOIN user_companies actor_uc
                      ON actor_uc.company_id =
                         target_uc.company_id
                  WHERE target_uc.user_id = u.user_id
                    AND actor_uc.user_id = $2
              )
            FOR UPDATE OF u
            `,
            [targetUserId, currentUser.userId]
        );

        if (targetResult.rows.length === 0) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");
            transactionStarted = false;

            return jsonError(
                "User not found in your accessible companies.",
                404
            );
        }

        if (!targetResult.rows[0].is_active) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK");
            transactionStarted = false;

            return jsonError(
                "This user is inactive. Activate the account first.",
                400
            );
        }

        for (const assignment of normalizedAssignments) {
            const roleResult = await client.query(
                `
                SELECT role_id
                FROM roles
                WHERE role_id = $1
                  AND (
                      company_id IS NULL
                      OR company_id = $2
                  )
                LIMIT 1
                `,
                [assignment.roleId, assignment.companyId]
            );

            if (roleResult.rows.length === 0) {
                await client.query("ROLLBACK");
                transactionStarted = false;

                return jsonError(
                    `The selected role is not available for company ID ${assignment.companyId}.`,
                    400
                );
            }
        }

        const manageableCompanyIds = [...actorCompanyIds];
        const submittedCompanyIds = normalizedAssignments.map(
            (item) => item.companyId
        );

        // Remove only assignments in manageable companies that were omitted.
        // Other company memberships are untouched.
        await client.query(
            `
            DELETE FROM user_companies
            WHERE user_id = $1
              AND company_id = ANY($2::int[])
              AND NOT (company_id = ANY($3::int[]))
            `,
            [
                targetUserId,
                manageableCompanyIds,
                submittedCompanyIds,
            ]
        );

        for (const assignment of normalizedAssignments) {
            await client.query(
                `
                INSERT INTO user_companies (
                    user_id,
                    company_id,
                    role_id
                )
                VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
                ON CONFLICT (user_id, company_id)
                DO UPDATE SET role_id = EXCLUDED.role_id
                `,
                [
                    targetUserId,
                    assignment.companyId,
                    assignment.roleId,
                ]
            );
        }

        await client.query("COMMIT");
        transactionStarted = false;

        // Include the complete location fields in the saved response.
        const savedResult = await pool.query(
            `
            SELECT
                uc.user_id,
                uc.company_id,
                c.company_name,
                c.location,
                c.city,
                c.state_province,
                c.province,
                c.country,
                c.address,
                c.postal_code,
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(BTRIM(c.location), ''),
                    NULLIF(BTRIM(c.city), ''),
                    NULLIF(BTRIM(c.address), '')
                ) AS company_city,
                uc.role_id,
                r.role_name
            FROM user_companies uc
            INNER JOIN companies c
                ON c.company_id = uc.company_id
            INNER JOIN roles r
                ON r.role_id = uc.role_id
            WHERE uc.user_id = $1
              AND uc.company_id = ANY($2::int[])
            ORDER BY c.company_name ASC, c.company_id ASC
            `,
            [targetUserId, manageableCompanyIds]
        );

        return jsonSuccess({
            success: true,
            message: "Company access updated successfully.",
            assignments: savedResult.rows,
        });
    } catch (error) {
        if (client && transactionStarted) {
            await client.query("ROLLBACK").catch(() => {});
        }

        console.error("PUT COMPANY ACCESS ERROR:", error);

        if (error.code === "23503") {
            return jsonError(
                "A selected company or role no longer exists.",
                400
            );
        }

        return jsonError(
            "Failed to update user access.",
            500
        );
    } finally {
        client?.release();
    }
}

===== app\api\warehouses\route.js =====
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import pool from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        warehouse_id,
        warehouse_code,
        warehouse_name,
        location,
        description,
        is_active,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      FROM warehouses
      ORDER BY warehouse_id DESC
    `);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      warehouses: result.rows,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("WAREHOUSE GET ERROR:", error);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        message: "Failed to load warehouses.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    const {
      warehouseName,
      warehouseCode,
      location,
      description,
      isActive,
    } = body;

    if (!warehouseName || !warehouseCode) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          message:
            "Warehouse name and code are required.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const result = await pool.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO warehouses (
        warehouse_name,
        warehouse_code,
        location,
        description,
        is_active
      )
      VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
      RETURNING *
      `,
      [
        warehouseName,
        warehouseCode,
        location || null,
        description || null,
        isActive !== false,
      ]
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: true,
        message: "Warehouse created successfully.",
        warehouse: result.rows[0],
      },
      { status: 201 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("WAREHOUSE POST ERROR:", error);

    if (error.code === "23505") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          message: "Warehouse code already exists.",
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        message: "Failed to create warehouse.",
        error: error.message,
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
