            title="Cash / Bank Account"
            description="Identify this account as a cash or bank account."
            icon={Landmark}
          />
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function AccountRow({
  account,
  level,
  searchActive,
  expandedAccounts,
  onToggle,
  onAddChild,
  onEdit,
}) {
  const hasChildren = Boolean(account.children?.length);
  const isExpanded =
    searchActive || expandedAccounts.has(Number(account.account_id));

  return (
    <div className="w-full" key={account.account_id}>
      <div className="border-b border-slate-100 bg-white transition-colors hover:bg-blue-50/40 dark:border-slate-800/80 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/20">
        <div
          className="flex min-h-[76px] items-center px-5 py-3"
          style={{ paddingLeft: `${20 + level * 28}px` }}
        >
          <div className="mr-3 flex w-7 shrink-0 justify-center">
            {hasChildren ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onToggle(account.account_id)}
                className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-500 transition hover:border-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:border-blue-700 dark:hover:bg-blue-950 dark:hover:text-blue-300"
                aria-label={isExpanded ? "Collapse account" : "Expand account"}
              >
                {isExpanded ? (
                  <ChevronDown size={16} />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronRight size={16} />
                )}
              </button>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-600" />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="w-[150px] shrink-0">
            <span className="inline-flex rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
              {account.account_code || "-"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 pr-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {account.is_group ? (
                <FolderOpen
                  size={16}
                  className="shrink-0 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"
                />
              ) : (
                <CircleDollarSign
                  size={16}
                  className="shrink-0 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                />
              )}

              <span
                className={
                  account.is_group
                    ? "font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                    : "font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200"
                }
              >
                {account.account_name}
              </span>

              {account.is_group && (
                <span className="inline-flex rounded-full border border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-violet-700 dark:border-violet-800 dark:bg-violet-950/50 dark:text-violet-300">
                  Summary
                </span>
              )}

              {account.is_cash_bank && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-cyan-200 bg-cyan-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-cyan-700 dark:border-cyan-800 dark:bg-cyan-950/40 dark:text-cyan-300">
                  <Landmark size={11} />
                  Cash/Bank
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
              Account ID: {account.account_id}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="w-[120px] shrink-0">
            <span
              className={`inline-flex rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wide ${getTypeStyle(account.account_type)}`}
            >
              {account.account_type}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="w-[130px] shrink-0 text-right">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
              {formatMoney(account.opening_balance)}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="w-[140px] shrink-0 text-right">
            <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              {formatMoney(account.current_balance)}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="w-[100px] shrink-0 text-center">
            {account.is_active !== false ? (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                Active
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-400" />
                Inactive
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="ml-4 flex w-[220px] shrink-0 items-center justify-end gap-2">
            {account.is_group && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onAddChild(account)}
                title={`Add a child account under ${account.account_name}`}
                className="inline-flex h-9 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 transition hover:border-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/40"
              >
                <Plus size={14} />
                Child
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onEdit(account)}
              title={`Edit ${account.account_name}`}
              className="inline-flex h-9 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-3.5 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-blue-700 active:scale-[0.98] dark:bg-blue-600 dark:hover:bg-blue-500"
            >
              <Pencil size={13} />
              Edit
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {hasChildren && isExpanded && (
        <div className="relative">
          <div
            className="absolute bottom-0 top-0 w-px bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700"
            style={{ left: `${34 + level * 28}px` }}
          />
          {account.children.map((child) => (
            <AccountRow
              key={child.account_id}
              account={child}
              level={level + 1}
              searchActive={searchActive}
              expandedAccounts={expandedAccounts}
              onToggle={onToggle}
              onAddChild={onAddChild}
              onEdit={onEdit}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function AccountsPage() {
  const [accounts, setAccounts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({ ...emptyForm });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);

  const [editingAccount, setEditingAccount] = useState(null);
  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState({ ...emptyForm });
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(false);

  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [expandedAccounts, setExpandedAccounts] = useState(new Set());

  const loadAccounts = useCallback(async (showLoader = true) => {
    try {
      if (showLoader) setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const response = await fetch("/api/accounts", {
        cache: "no-store",
      });
      const data = await readApiResponse(response);
      const loadedAccounts = normalizeAccounts(data);

      setAccounts(loadedAccounts);
      return loadedAccounts;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("LOAD ACCOUNTS ERROR:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load accounts.");
      return [];
    } finally {
      if (showLoader) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function initialLoad() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/accounts", {
          cache: "no-store",
        });
        const data = await readApiResponse(response);

        if (!cancelled) {
          setAccounts(normalizeAccounts(data));
          setError("");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setError(err.message || "Failed to load accounts.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    }

    initialLoad();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  function handleFormChange(event) {
    const { name, value, type, checked } = event.target;
    setForm((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      [name]: type === "checkbox" ? checked : value,
    }));
  }

  function handleEditChange(event) {
    const { name, value, type, checked } = event.target;
    setEditForm((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      [name]: type === "checkbox" ? checked : value,
    }));
  }

  function resetAddForm() {
    setForm({ ...emptyForm });
  }

  function cancelAddForm() {
    if (saving) return;

    setShowForm(false);
    resetAddForm();
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
  }

  function openAddForm() {
    resetAddForm();
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    setShowForm(true);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  }

  function findAccount(accountId, accountList = accounts) {
    return accountList.find(
      (account) => Number(account.account_id) === Number(accountId)
    );
  }

  function getParentName(parentAccountId) {
    if (!parentAccountId) return "No Parent";
    const parent = findAccount(parentAccountId);

    return parent
      ? `${parent.account_code} - ${parent.account_name}`
      : "No Parent";
  }

  function expandParentChain(accountId, accountList = accounts) {
    const idsToExpand = [];
    let currentId = Number(accountId);
    const visited = new Set();

    while (currentId && !visited.has(currentId)) {
      visited.add(currentId);
      const account = accountList.find(
        (item) => Number(item.account_id) === currentId
      );

      if (!account) break;
      if (account.is_group) idsToExpand.push(Number(account.account_id));
      if (!account.parent_account_id) break;

      currentId = Number(account.parent_account_id);
    }

    setExpandedAccounts((previous) => {
      const next = new Set(previous);
      idsToExpand.forEach((id) => next.add(id));
      return next;
    });
  }

  async function saveAccount(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (saving) return;

    if (!form.accountCode.trim()) {
      setError("Account code is required.");
      return;
    }

    if (!form.accountName.trim()) {
      setError("Account name is required.");
      return;
    }

    const openingBalance = Number(form.openingBalance || 0);

    if (!Number.isFinite(openingBalance) || openingBalance < 0) {
      setError("Opening balance must be a valid non-negative number.");
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/accounts", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          account_code: form.accountCode.trim(),
          account_name: form.accountName.trim(),
          account_type: form.accountType,
          parent_account_id: form.parentAccountId || null,
          opening_balance: openingBalance,
          is_active: form.isActive,
          is_group: form.isSummary,
          is_cash_bank: form.isCashBank,
        }),
      });

      const data = await readApiResponse(response);
      const createdAccount = data.account;
      const updatedAccounts = await loadAccounts(false);

      if (createdAccount?.parent_account_id) {
        expandParentChain(createdAccount.parent_account_id, updatedAccounts);
      }

      setMessage("Account created successfully.");
      resetAddForm();
      setShowForm(false);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("CREATE ACCOUNT ERROR:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to create account.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  function addChildAccount(parentAccount) {
    setForm({
      ...emptyForm,
      parentAccountId: String(parentAccount.account_id),
      accountType: parentAccount.account_type || "ASSET",
    });
    setMessage("");
    setError("");
    setShowForm(true);
    expandParentChain(parentAccount.account_id);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  }

  function getDescendantIds(accountId) {
    const descendants = new Set();
    const visited = new Set();

    function collect(parentId) {
      const normalizedParentId = Number(parentId);
      if (visited.has(normalizedParentId)) return;
      visited.add(normalizedParentId);

      accounts.forEach((account) => {
        const parentIdOfAccount = account.parent_account_id
          ? Number(account.parent_account_id)
          : null;

        if (parentIdOfAccount === normalizedParentId) {
          const childId = Number(account.account_id);
          if (!descendants.has(childId)) {
            descendants.add(childId);
            collect(childId);
          }
        }
      });
    }

    collect(accountId);
    return descendants;
  }

  function editAccount(account) {
    setMessage("");
    setError("");
    setEditingAccount(account);

    setEditForm({
      accountCode: account.account_code || "",
      accountName: account.account_name || "",
      accountType: account.account_type || "ASSET",
      isSummary: Boolean(account.is_group),
      parentAccountId: account.parent_account_id
        ? String(account.parent_account_id)
        : "",
      openingBalance:
        account.opening_balance !== null &&
        account.opening_balance !== undefined
          ? String(account.opening_balance)
          : "",
      isActive: account.is_active !== false,
      isCashBank: Boolean(account.is_cash_bank),
    });
  }

  function closeEdit() {
    if (updating) return;
    setEditingAccount(null);
    setEditForm({ ...emptyForm });
  }

  async function updateAccount(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (!editingAccount || updating) return;

    if (!editForm.accountCode.trim()) {
      setError("Account code is required.");
      return;
    }

    if (!editForm.accountName.trim()) {
      setError("Account name is required.");
      return;
    }

    const openingBalance = Number(editForm.openingBalance || 0);

    if (!Number.isFinite(openingBalance) || openingBalance < 0) {
      setError("Opening balance must be a valid non-negative number.");
      return;
    }

    setUpdating(true);
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/accounts", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          account_id: editingAccount.account_id,
          account_code: editForm.accountCode.trim(),
          account_name: editForm.accountName.trim(),
          account_type: editForm.accountType,
          parent_account_id: editForm.parentAccountId || null,
          opening_balance: openingBalance,
          is_active: editForm.isActive,
          is_group: editForm.isSummary,
          is_cash_bank: editForm.isCashBank,
        }),
      });

      const data = await readApiResponse(response);
      const updatedAccount = data.account;
      const updatedAccounts = await loadAccounts(false);

      if (updatedAccount?.parent_account_id) {
        expandParentChain(updatedAccount.parent_account_id, updatedAccounts);
      }

      setEditingAccount(null);
      setEditForm({ ...emptyForm });
      setMessage("Account updated successfully.");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("UPDATE ACCOUNT ERROR:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to update account.");
    } finally {
      setUpdating(false);
    }
  }

  const accountTree = useMemo(() => {
    const accountMap = new Map();

    accounts.forEach((account) => {
      accountMap.set(Number(account.account_id), {
        ...account,
        children: [],
      });
    });

    accounts.forEach((account) => {
      const id = Number(account.account_id);
      const parentId = account.parent_account_id
        ? Number(account.parent_account_id)
        : null;

      if (
        parentId !== null &&
        parentId !== id &&
        accountMap.has(parentId)
      ) {
        accountMap.get(parentId).children.push(accountMap.get(id));
      }
    });

    function sortNode(node) {
      node.children.sort((a, b) =>
        String(a.account_code).localeCompare(String(b.account_code), undefined, {
          numeric: true,
        })
      );
      node.children.forEach(sortNode);
    }

    accountMap.forEach(sortNode);

    const roots = accounts
      .filter((account) => {
        const id = Number(account.account_id);
        const parentId = account.parent_account_id
          ? Number(account.parent_account_id)
          : null;

        return (
          parentId === null ||
          parentId === id ||
          !accountMap.has(parentId)
        );
      })
      .map((account) => accountMap.get(Number(account.account_id)));

    const renderedIds = new Set();

    function safeNode(node, path = new Set()) {
      if (!node) return null;

      const id = Number(node.account_id);
      if (path.has(id)) return null;

      const nextPath = new Set(path);
      nextPath.add(id);
      renderedIds.add(id);

      return {
        ...node,
        children: node.children
          .map((child) => safeNode(child, nextPath))
          .filter(Boolean),
      };
    }

    const tree = roots.map((root) => safeNode(root)).filter(Boolean);

    accounts.forEach((account) => {
      const id = Number(account.account_id);

      if (!renderedIds.has(id)) {
        const orphan = safeNode(accountMap.get(id));
        if (orphan) tree.push(orphan);
      }
    });

    return tree.sort((a, b) =>
      String(a.account_code).localeCompare(String(b.account_code), undefined, {
        numeric: true,
      })
    );
  }, [accounts]);

  function toggleAccount(accountId) {
    setExpandedAccounts((previous) => {
      const next = new Set(previous);
      const id = Number(accountId);

      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);

      return next;
    });
  }

  function expandAll() {
    setExpandedAccounts(
      new Set(
        accounts
          .filter((account) => account.is_group)
          .map((account) => Number(account.account_id))
      )
    );
  }

  function collapseAll() {
    setExpandedAccounts(new Set());
  }

  const normalizedSearch = search.trim().toLowerCase();

  function accountMatchesSearch(account) {
    if (!normalizedSearch) return true;

    return (
      String(account.account_code || "").toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch) ||
      String(account.account_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch) ||
      String(account.account_type || "").toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch)
    );
  }

  function filterTree(items) {
    if (!normalizedSearch) return items;

    return items
      .map((account) => {
        const children = filterTree(account.children || []);

        if (accountMatchesSearch(account) || children.length > 0) {
          return { ...account, children };
        }

        return null;
      })
      .filter(Boolean);
  }

  const filteredAccountTree = filterTree(accountTree);

  const editParentOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!editingAccount) return [];

    const editingId = Number(editingAccount.account_id);
    const descendantIds = getDescendantIds(editingId);

    return accounts.filter((account) => {
      const accountId = Number(account.account_id);

      return (
        account.is_group &&
        accountId !== editingId &&
        !descendantIds.has(accountId)
      );
    });
  }, [accounts, editingAccount]);

  const parentOptions = useMemo(
    () => accounts.filter((account) => account.is_group),
    [accounts]
  );

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const active = accounts.filter(
      (account) => account.is_active !== false
    ).length;
    const summary = accounts.filter((account) => Boolean(account.is_group)).length;
    const cashBank = accounts.filter(
      (account) => Boolean(account.is_cash_bank)
    ).length;

    return {
      total: accounts.length,
      active,
      summary,
      ledger: accounts.length - summary,
      cashBank,
    };
  }, [accounts]);

  async function handleRefresh() {
    if (refreshing || loading) return;
    setRefreshing(true);
    await loadAccounts(false);
    setRefreshing(false);
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-4 text-slate-900 transition-colors sm:p-6 lg:p-8 dark:bg-[#070d19] dark:text-slate-100">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1700px] space-y-6">
        <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#0b1b3a] via-[#12366a] to-[#075e50] p-6 shadow-xl shadow-blue-950/10 sm:p-8">
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-12 -top-24 -z-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-blue-400/15 blur-3xl" />
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-32 right-1/4 -z-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-emerald-400/15 blur-3xl" />

          <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
            <div className="max-w-3xl">
              <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/15 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-blue-100 backdrop-blur-sm">
                <Activity size={14} />
                FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                <div className="hidden h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-white/15 bg-white/10 text-white shadow-lg backdrop-blur-sm sm:flex">
                  <BookOpen size={28} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl">
                    Chart of Accounts
                  </h1>
                  <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-blue-100/85 sm:text-base">
                    Organize your company&apos;s financial structure, manage
                    ledger accounts, and maintain a clear accounting hierarchy.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleRefresh}
                disabled={loading || refreshing}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white backdrop-blur-sm transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <RefreshCw
                  size={17}
                  className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
                />
                Refresh
              </button>

              {!showForm && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={openAddForm}
                  className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-400 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-emerald-950 shadow-lg transition hover:bg-emerald-300 active:scale-[0.98]"
                >
                  <Plus size={18} />
                  Add Account
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-7 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-white/15 pt-5 sm:grid-cols-4">
            {[
              ["Total Accounts", stats.total, "text-white"],
              ["Active Accounts", stats.active, "text-emerald-300"],
              ["Summary Accounts", stats.summary, "text-white"],
              ["Ledger Accounts", stats.ledger, "text-cyan-200"],
            ].map(([title, value, color]) => (
              <div key={title}>
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-blue-100/70">{title}</p>
                <p className={`mt-1.5 text-2xl font-bold ${color}`}>
                  {formatCount(value)}
                </p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>

        {message && (
          <div
            role="status"
            className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3.5 text-sm font-medium text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-800/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 dark:text-emerald-300"
          >
            <CheckCircle2 size={20} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            <span className="flex-1">{message}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMessage("")}
              className="rounded-lg p-1 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/40"
              aria-label="Dismiss success message"
            >
              <X size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {error && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-4 py-3.5 text-sm font-medium text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-800/60 dark:bg-rose-950/30 dark:text-rose-300"
          >
            <AlertCircle size={20} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            <span className="flex-1">{error}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setError("")}
              className="rounded-lg p-1 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/40"
              aria-label="Dismiss error message"
            >
              <X size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          <SummaryCard
            title="Total Accounts"

            tone="green"

            title="Cash & Bank"
            value={formatCount(stats.cashBank)}
            description="Accounts for cash and banking"
            icon={Wallet}
            tone="cyan"
          />
          <SummaryCard
            title="Summary Accounts"
            value={formatCount(stats.summary)}
            description="Parent and grouping accounts"
            icon={FolderOpen}
            tone="violet"
          />
        </section>

        {showForm && (
          <section className={`${panelClass} overflow-hidden`}>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50/80 to-emerald-50/50 px-5 py-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-7 dark:border-slate-800 dark:from-blue-950/30 dark:to-emerald-950/20">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500/15 dark:text-blue-300">
                  <FilePlus2 size={24} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    Create New Account
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Add an account to your chart of accounts.
                  </p>
                  {form.parentAccountId && (
                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-medium text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">

                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"

                disabled={saving}

                form={form}

                  type="submit"
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-700 to-blue-600 px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-lg transition hover:from-blue-600 hover:to-blue-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  {saving ? (
                    <>
                      <LoaderCircle size={17} className="animate-spin" />

                    </>

                    <>
                      <Check size={18} />
                      Save Account
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </section>
        )}

        {!showForm && (
          <section className={`${panelClass} overflow-hidden`}>
            <div className="border-b border-slate-200 p-5 sm:p-6 dark:border-slate-800">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 xl:flex-row xl:items-center xl:justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">

                    <BookOpen size={21} />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                        Account Directory
                      </h2>
                      <span className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                        {formatCount(accounts.length)}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                      Create your first account to start building your financial

                      type="button"

              <BookOpen size={17} />

              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-blue-950 dark:text-blue-200">

                Use summary accounts to organize your chart. Select the expand

              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {editingAccount && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/75 p-3 backdrop-blur-sm sm:p-5"
          onMouseDown={(event) => {
            if (event.target === event.currentTarget) closeEdit();
          }}
        >
          <div className="max-h-[94vh] w-full max-w-3xl overflow-y-auto rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900">
            <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 bg-white/95 px-5 py-5 backdrop-blur sm:px-7 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900/95">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500/15 dark:text-blue-300">
                  <Pencil size={22} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    Edit Account
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Account ID: {editingAccount.account_id}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={closeEdit}
                disabled={updating}
                className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-slate-500 transition hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:text-white"
                aria-label="Close edit form"
              >
                <X size={19} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={updateAccount} className="p-5 sm:p-7">
              <AccountFormFields
                form={editForm}
                onChange={handleEditChange}
                parentOptions={editParentOptions}
                mode="edit"
              />

              <div className="mt-7 flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 pt-5 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end dark:border-slate-800">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={closeEdit}
                  disabled={updating}
                  className={buttonSecondary}
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={updating}
                  className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-700 to-blue-600 px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-lg transition hover:from-blue-600 hover:to-blue-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  {updating ? (
                    <>
                      <LoaderCircle size={17} className="animate-spin" />
                      Updating Account...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Check size={18} />
                      Update Account
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  AlertCircle,
  ArrowDownLeft,
  ArrowUpRight,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronDown,
  CircleDollarSign,
  Clock3,
  Download,
  FileSearch,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  TrendingDown,
  TrendingUp,
  UserRound,
  Users,
  Wallet,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";

// =========================================================
// STYLES
// =========================================================

const cardClass =
  "rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900";

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white py-3 pl-11 pr-4 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-300 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 dark:hover:border-slate-600";

const headingClass =
  "text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400";

// =========================================================
// HELPERS
// =========================================================

function formatAmount(value) {
  const amount = Number(value ?? 0);

  return (Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });
}

function formatInteger(value) {
  return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK");
}

function getInitials(name) {
  return String(name || "Customer")
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0])
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase();
}

function getBalanceStatus(balance) {
  if (balance > 0) {
    return {
      label: "Receivable",
      className:
        "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 ring-1 ring-inset ring-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400 dark:ring-rose-500/20",
      dotClass: "bg-rose-500",
    };
  }

  if (balance < 0) {
    return {
      label: "Advance",
      className:
        "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 ring-1 ring-inset ring-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400 dark:ring-blue-500/20",
      dotClass: "bg-blue-500",
    };
  }

  return {
    label: "Settled",
    className:
      "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 ring-1 ring-inset ring-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:ring-emerald-500/20",
    dotClass: "bg-emerald-500",
  };
}

// =========================================================
// SUMMARY CARD
// Kept outside the main component for React ESLint rules.
// =========================================================

function SummaryCard({
  title,
  value,
  description,
  icon: Icon,
  iconColor,
  iconBg,
  valueColor,
  isCount = false,
}) {
  return (
    <div className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900">
      <div className="absolute -right-8 -top-8 h-28 w-28 rounded-full bg-slate-100/70 transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-125 dark:bg-slate-800/60" />

      <div className="relative flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className={headingClass}>{title}</p>

          <p
            className={`mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-3xl ${
              valueColor || "text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            {isCount ? formatInteger(value) : formatAmount(value)}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div
          className={`relative flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl ${iconBg}`}
        >
          <Icon className={`h-6 w-6 ${iconColor}`} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// =========================================================
// LOADING SKELETON
// =========================================================

function LoadingSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="animate-pulse space-y-3 p-5">
      {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, index) => (
        <div
          key={index}
          className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-7"
        >
          {Array.from({ length: index === 0 ? 7 : 7 }).map(
            (__, cellIndex) => (
              <div
                key={cellIndex}
                className={`h-10 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 ${
                  cellIndex === 1 ? "col-span-1 sm:col-span-1" : ""
                }`}
              />
            )
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// =========================================================
// MAIN PAGE
// =========================================================

export default function CustomerBalancePage() {
  const [balances, setBalances] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState(null);

  // =======================================================
  // LOAD CUSTOMER BALANCES
  // =======================================================

  const loadBalances = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    try {
      setError("");

      const response = await fetch("/api/customers/balance", {
        cache: "no-store",
        signal,
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Failed to load customer balances.");
      }

      const data = await response.json();
      setBalances(Array.isArray(data.balances) ? data.balances : []);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.name !== "AbortError") {
        console.error(err);
        setError(err.message || "Unable to load customer balances.");
      }
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    // Defer the request to a microtask so the effect itself
    // does not synchronously call a state-updating function.
    Promise.resolve().then(() => {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        loadBalances(controller.signal);
      }
    });

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [loadBalances]);


  // =======================================================
  // SEARCH AND FILTER
  // =======================================================

  const filteredBalances = useMemo(() => {
    const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    return balances.filter((customer) => {
      const matchesSearch =
        !query ||
        String(customer.customer_name || "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(query) ||
        String(customer.customer_code || "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(query) ||
        String(customer.phone || "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(query);

      const balance = Number(customer.balance || 0);

      const matchesStatus =
        statusFilter === "ALL" ||
        (statusFilter === "RECEIVABLE" && balance > 0) ||
        (statusFilter === "ADVANCE" && balance < 0) ||
        (statusFilter === "SETTLED" && balance === 0);

      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
    });
  }, [balances, search, statusFilter]);

  // =======================================================
  // SUMMARY TOTALS
  // =======================================================

  const summary = useMemo(() => {
    return balances.reduce(
      (totals, customer) => {
        const opening = Number(customer.opening_balance || 0);
        const sales = Number(customer.total_sales || 0);
        const paid = Number(customer.total_paid || 0);
        const balance = Number(customer.balance || 0);

        totals.opening += Number.isFinite(opening) ? opening : 0;
        totals.sales += Number.isFinite(sales) ? sales : 0;
        totals.paid += Number.isFinite(paid) ? paid : 0;
        totals.balance += Number.isFinite(balance) ? balance : 0;

        if (balance > 0) totals.receivableCount += 1;
        else if (balance < 0) totals.advanceCount += 1;
        else totals.settledCount += 1;

        return totals;
      },
      {
        opening: 0,
        sales: 0,
        paid: 0,
        balance: 0,
        receivableCount: 0,
        advanceCount: 0,
        settledCount: 0,
      }
    );
  }, [balances]);

  // =======================================================
  // EXPORT CSV
  // =======================================================

  function exportCSV() {
    if (filteredBalances.length === 0) {
      setError("There are no customer balances to export.");
      return;
    }

    const headers = [
      "Customer Code",
      "Customer Name",
      "Phone",
      "Opening Balance",
      "Total Sales",
      "Total Paid",
      "Balance",
      "Status",
    ];

    const rows = filteredBalances.map((customer) => {
      const balance = Number(customer.balance || 0);

      return [
        customer.customer_code || "",
        customer.customer_name || "",
        customer.phone || "",
        Number(customer.opening_balance || 0).toFixed(2),
        Number(customer.total_sales || 0).toFixed(2),
        Number(customer.total_paid || 0).toFixed(2),
        balance.toFixed(2),
        getBalanceStatus(balance).label,
      ];
    });

    // Escape CSV cells so commas and quotes in names remain valid.
    const escapeCSV = (value) =>
      `"${String(value ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;

    const csvContent = [headers, ...rows]
      .map((row) => row.map(escapeCSV).join(","))
      .join("\r\n");

    const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF", csvContent], {
      type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;",
    });

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");

    link.href = url;
    link.download = `customer-balances-${new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .slice(0, 10)}.csv`;

    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  // =======================================================
  // RENDER
  // =======================================================

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen space-y-6 bg-slate-50/70 pb-8 dark:bg-slate-950">
      {/* HERO HEADER */}

      <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-950 via-blue-950 to-indigo-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-blue-950/10 sm:p-8">
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-16 -top-24 h-72 w-72 rounded-full border border-white/10" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-4 -top-12 h-52 w-52 rounded-full border border-white/10" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-28 left-1/3 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 blur-3xl" />

        <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
          <div className="max-w-2xl">
            <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-blue-300/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-blue-100">
              <Activity className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              CUSTOMER FINANCIALS
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
              Customer Balance
            </h1>

            <p className="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-blue-100/80 sm:text-base">
              Monitor customer receivables, sales, payments and outstanding
              balances from one organized financial dashboard.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-3 text-xs text-blue-100/90 sm:text-sm">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 px-3 py-2">
                <Users className="h-4 w-4" />
                {formatInteger(balances.length)} customers
              </span>

              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 px-3 py-2">
                <Clock3 className="h-4 w-4" />
                {lastUpdated
                  ? `Updated ${lastUpdated.toLocaleTimeString("en-PK", {
                      hour: "2-digit",
                      minute: "2-digit",
                    })}`
                  : "Waiting for data"}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 lg:max-w-xs lg:justify-end">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={exportCSV}
              disabled={loading || filteredBalances.length === 0}
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
              Export CSV
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => loadBalances({ silent: true })}
              disabled={loading || refreshing}
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-blue-950 shadow-lg transition hover:bg-blue-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              <RefreshCw
                className={`h-4 w-4 ${
                  refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""
                }`}
              />
              Refresh
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* SUMMARY CARDS */}

      <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <SummaryCard
          title="Total Customers"
          value={balances.length}
          isCount
          description="Customers in this report"
          icon={Users}
          iconColor="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"
          iconBg="bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/10"
        />

        <SummaryCard
          title="Total Sales"
          value={summary.sales}
          description="Combined customer sales"
          icon={TrendingUp}
          iconColor="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
          iconBg="bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10"
          valueColor="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
        />

        <SummaryCard
          title="Total Payments"
          value={summary.paid}
          description="Payments received from customers"
          icon={ArrowDownLeft}
          iconColor="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"
          iconBg="bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/10"
          valueColor="text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400"
        />

        <SummaryCard
          title="Outstanding Balance"
          value={summary.balance}
          description="Net balance from the API records"
          icon={Wallet}
          iconColor="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400"
          iconBg="bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10"
          valueColor="text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400"
        />
      </section>

      {/* BALANCE STATUS STRIP */}

      <section className={`${cardClass} p-4 sm:p-5`}>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-50/80 p-4 dark:bg-rose-500/5">
            <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400">
              <TrendingUp className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
                Customers with Receivables
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300">
                {formatInteger(summary.receivableCount)}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-blue-50/80 p-4 dark:bg-blue-500/5">
            <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400">
              <ArrowUpRight className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                Customers with Advances
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300">
                {formatInteger(summary.advanceCount)}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50/80 p-4 dark:bg-emerald-500/5">
            <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400">
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                Settled Customers
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">
                {formatInteger(summary.settledCount)}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* ERROR MESSAGE */}

      {error && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800 dark:border-red-900/70 dark:bg-red-950/30 dark:text-red-300"
        >
          <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />

          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="font-semibold">Unable to complete request</p>
            <p className="mt-1 break-words text-sm">{error}</p>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setError("")}
            aria-label="Dismiss error"
            className="rounded-lg p-1 transition hover:bg-red-100 dark:hover:bg-red-900/50"
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* CUSTOMER TABLE */}

      <section className={`${cardClass} overflow-hidden`}>
        {/* TABLE HEADER */}

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:p-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-400">
                <FileSearch className="h-5 w-5" />
              </div>

              <div>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Customer Balances
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Search and review individual customer accounts
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <span className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
              {filteredBalances.length} result
              {filteredBalances.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* SEARCH AND STATUS FILTER */}

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_220px_auto]">
            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />

              <input
                type="search"
                value={search}
                onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search by customer name, code or phone..."
                className={inputClass}
              />

              {search && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSearch("")}
                  aria-label="Clear search"
                  className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-md p-1 text-slate-400 transition hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white"
                >
                  <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="relative">
              <select
                value={statusFilter}
                onChange={(event) => setStatusFilter(event.target.value)}
                className={`${inputClass} appearance-none pr-10`}
                aria-label="Filter customers by balance status"
              >
                <option value="ALL">All balances</option>
                <option value="RECEIVABLE">Receivables only</option>
                <option value="ADVANCE">Advances only</option>
                <option value="SETTLED">Settled only</option>
              </select>

              <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setSearch("");
                setStatusFilter("ALL");
              }}
              disabled={!search && statusFilter === "ALL"}
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              Clear filters
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* TABLE BODY */}

        {loading ? (
          <LoadingSkeleton />
        ) : error && balances.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center px-6 py-14 text-center">
            <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-500/10">
              <AlertCircle className="h-7 w-7 text-red-500" />
            </div>

            <h3 className="mt-4 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              Could not load customer balances
            </h3>

            <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Check your connection and try loading the customer balance report
              again.
            </p>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => loadBalances()}
              className="mt-5 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
              Try again
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : filteredBalances.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center px-6 py-14 text-center">
            <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">
              <Search className="h-7 w-7 text-slate-400" />
            </div>

            <h3 className="mt-4 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              No customers found
            </h3>

            <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              {balances.length === 0
                ? "No customer balance records are available yet."
                : "Try another search term or change the balance status filter."}
            </p>

            {(search || statusFilter !== "ALL") && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearch("");
                  setStatusFilter("ALL");
                }}
                className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700"
              >
                Show all customers
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full min-w-[1050px] border-collapse text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80">
                  <th className="px-5 py-4 text-left text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Customer
                  </th>

                  <th className="px-5 py-4 text-left text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Phone
                  </th>

                  <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Opening
                  </th>

                  <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Sales
                  </th>

                  <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Paid
                  </th>

                  <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Balance
                  </th>

                  <th className="px-5 py-4 text-left text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Status
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody>
                {filteredBalances.map((customer) => {
                  const opening = Number(customer.opening_balance || 0);
                  const sales = Number(customer.total_sales || 0);
                  const paid = Number(customer.total_paid || 0);
                  const balance = Number(customer.balance || 0);
                  const status = getBalanceStatus(balance);

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={customer.customer_id}
                      className="border-t border-slate-100 transition-colors hover:bg-blue-50/40 dark:border-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50"
                    >
                      {/* CUSTOMER */}

                      <td className="px-5 py-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-sm">
                            {getInitials(customer.customer_name)}
                          </div>

                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <p className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                              {customer.customer_name || "Unnamed customer"}
                            </p>

                            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                              {customer.customer_code || "No customer code"}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* PHONE */}

                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                        {customer.phone || "â€”"}
                      </td>

                      {/* OPENING */}

                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                        {formatAmount(opening)}
                      </td>

                      {/* SALES */}

                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-medium tabular-nums text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                        {formatAmount(sales)}
                      </td>

                      {/* PAID */}

                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-medium tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        {formatAmount(paid)}
                      </td>

                      {/* BALANCE */}

                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right">
                        <span
                          className={`font-bold tabular-nums ${
                            balance > 0
                              ? "text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400"
                              : balance < 0
                                ? "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400"
                                : "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {formatAmount(balance)}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* STATUS */}

                      <td className="px-5 py-4">
                        <span
                          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold ${status.className}`}
                        >
                          <span
                            className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${status.dotClass}`}
                          />
                          {status.label}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>

              {/* TOTALS */}

              <tfoot>
                <tr className="border-t-2 border-slate-200 bg-slate-100/80 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800">
                  <td
                    colSpan={2}
                    className="px-5 py-5 text-right font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200"
                  >
                    Filtered Total
                  </td>

                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-5 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                    {formatAmount(
                      filteredBalances.reduce(
                        (sum, customer) =>
                          sum + Number(customer.opening_balance || 0),
                        0
                      )
                    )}
                  </td>

                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-5 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-800 dark:text-white">
                    {formatAmount(
                      filteredBalances.reduce(
                        (sum, customer) =>
                          sum + Number(customer.total_sales || 0),
                        0
                      )
                    )}
                  </td>

                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-5 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                    {formatAmount(
                      filteredBalances.reduce(
                        (sum, customer) =>
                          sum + Number(customer.total_paid || 0),
                        0
                      )
                    )}
                  </td>

                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-5 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400">
                    {formatAmount(
                      filteredBalances.reduce(
                        (sum, customer) =>
                          sum + Number(customer.balance || 0),
                        0
                      )
                    )}
                  </td>

                  <td className="px-5 py-5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    {filteredBalances.length} customers
                  </td>
                </tr>
              </tfoot>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TABLE FOOTER */}

        {!loading && !error && balances.length > 0 && (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 px-5 py-4 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-6">
            <span>
              Showing {filteredBalances.length} of {balances.length} customers
            </span>

            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
              Customer balances loaded
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* FOOTNOTE */}

      <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-blue-100 bg-blue-50/70 px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-5 text-blue-800 dark:border-blue-900/40 dark:bg-blue-500/5 dark:text-blue-300">
        <CircleDollarSign className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
        <p>
          <span className="font-semibold">Balance guide:</span> A positive
          balance is shown as receivable, a negative balance as an advance, and
          zero as settled. Figures are displayed using the values returned by
          your existing customer balance API.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== app\dashboard\customer-ledger\page.js =====

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  ArrowDownLeft,
  ArrowLeftRight,
  ArrowUpRight,
  CalendarDays,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronDown,
  CircleDollarSign,
  ClipboardList,
  FileSearch,
  FileText,
  Filter,
  RefreshCw,
  RotateCcw,
  Search,
  UserRound,
  Wallet,
  AlertCircle,
  TrendingUp,
} from "lucide-react";

// =========================================================
// DATE HELPERS
// =========================================================

function getToday() {
  const date = new Date();

  return [
    date.getFullYear(),
    String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0"),
    String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0"),
  ].join("-");
}

function getFirstDayOfMonth() {
  const date = new Date();

  return [
    date.getFullYear(),
    String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0"),
    "01",
  ].join("-");
}

// =========================================================
// FORMAT HELPERS
// =========================================================

function formatAmount(value) {
  const amount = Number(value ?? 0);

  return (Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });
}

function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return "-";

  // Prevent timezone shifts for date-only values such as YYYY-MM-DD.
  const dateOnly = String(value).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);

  const date = dateOnly
    ? new Date(
        Number(dateOnly[1]),
        Number(dateOnly[2]) - 1,
        Number(dateOnly[3])
      )
    : new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return String(value);

  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function getInitials(name) {
  return String(name || "Customer")
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0])
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase();
}

// =========================================================
// STYLES
// =========================================================

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-300 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 dark:hover:border-slate-600 dark:focus:border-blue-500";

const labelClass =
  "mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300";

const cardClass =
  "rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900";

// =========================================================
// SUMMARY CARD
// IMPORTANT: Keep this component outside CustomerLedgerPage.
// =========================================================

function SummaryCard({
  title,
  value,
  description,
  icon: Icon,
  iconColor,
  iconBg,
  valueColor,
}) {
  return (
    <div className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900">
      <div className="absolute -right-7 -top-7 h-24 w-24 rounded-full bg-slate-100/70 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-125 dark:bg-slate-800/60" />

      <div className="relative flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {title}
          </p>

          <p
            className={`mt-3 break-words text-xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-2xl ${
              valueColor || "text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            {formatAmount(value)}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div
          className={`relative flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${iconBg}`}
        >
          {Icon && <Icon className={`h-5 w-5 ${iconColor}`} />}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// =========================================================
// MAIN PAGE
// =========================================================

export default function CustomerLedgerPage() {
  // Filters
  const [fromDate, setFromDate] = useState(getFirstDayOfMonth);
  const [toDate, setToDate] = useState(getToday);
  const [customerId, setCustomerId] = useState("");
  const [subsidiary, setSubsidiary] = useState("");

  // Customers
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState([]);
  const [loadingCustomers, setLoadingCustomers] = useState(false);

  // Report
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState(null);
  const [ledger, setLedger] = useState([]);
  const [openingBalance, setOpeningBalance] = useState(0);
  const [totalDebit, setTotalDebit] = useState(0);
  const [totalCredit, setTotalCredit] = useState(0);
  const [closingBalance, setClosingBalance] = useState(0);
  const [loadingReport, setLoadingReport] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [hasGeneratedReport, setHasGeneratedReport] = useState(false);

  // =========================================================
  // LOAD CUSTOMERS
  // =========================================================

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    async function loadCustomers() {
      setLoadingCustomers(true);

      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/customers", {
          cache: "no-store",
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load customers.");
        }

        const customerList = Array.isArray(data)
          ? data
          : Array.isArray(data.customers)
            ? data.customers
            : [];

        setCustomers(customerList);
      } catch (err) {
        if (err.name !== "AbortError") {
          setError(err.message || "Failed to load customers.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoadingCustomers(false);
        }
      }
    }

    loadCustomers();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  // =========================================================
  // RESET REPORT DATA
  // =========================================================

  function resetReportData() {
    setCustomer(null);
    setLedger([]);
    setOpeningBalance(0);
    setTotalDebit(0);
    setTotalCredit(0);
    setClosingBalance(0);
  }

  // =========================================================
  // GENERATE REPORT
  // =========================================================

  async function generateReport(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");

    if (!fromDate) {
      setError("Please select a From Date.");
      return;
    }

    if (!toDate) {
      setError("Please select a To Date.");
      return;
    }

    if (fromDate > toDate) {
      setError("From Date cannot be greater than To Date.");
      return;
    }

    if (!customerId) {
      setError("Please select a customer.");
      return;
    }

    setLoadingReport(true);

    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        fromDate,
        toDate,
        customerId,
      });

      // Keep the existing report API.
      // Subsidiary remains a UI-only filter until the API supports it.
      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/reports/customer-ledger?${params.toString()}`,
        {
          cache: "no-store",
        }
      );

      const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.message || "Failed to generate customer ledger."
        );
      }

      setCustomer(data.customer || null);
      setLedger(Array.isArray(data.ledger) ? data.ledger : []);
      setOpeningBalance(Number(data.opening_balance || 0));
      setTotalDebit(Number(data.total_debit || 0));
      setTotalCredit(Number(data.total_credit || 0));
      setClosingBalance(Number(data.closing_balance || 0));
      setHasGeneratedReport(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to generate customer ledger.");
      resetReportData();
      setHasGeneratedReport(false);
    } finally {
      setLoadingReport(false);
    }
  }

  // =========================================================
  // CLEAR REPORT
  // =========================================================

  function clearReport() {
    resetReportData();
    setError("");
    setHasGeneratedReport(false);
  }

  // =========================================================
  // RENDER
  // =========================================================

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen space-y-6 bg-slate-50/70 pb-8 dark:bg-slate-950">
      {/* HERO HEADER */}

      <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-950 via-blue-950 to-indigo-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-blue-950/10 sm:p-8">
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-16 -top-24 h-72 w-72 rounded-full border border-white/10" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-4 -top-12 h-52 w-52 rounded-full border border-white/10" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-28 left-1/3 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 blur-3xl" />

        <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
          <div className="max-w-2xl">
            <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-blue-300/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-blue-100">
              <Activity className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              FINANCIAL REPORTING
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
              Customer Ledger
            </h1>

            <p className="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-blue-100/80 sm:text-base">
              Track customer invoices, payments, debit, credit and running
              balances in one clear financial statement.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs text-blue-100/80 sm:text-sm">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 px-3 py-2">
                <CalendarDays className="h-4 w-4" />
                {formatDate(fromDate)} â€“ {formatDate(toDate)}
              </span>

              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 px-3 py-2">
                <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
                Detailed transaction history
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="hidden shrink-0 items-center justify-center lg:flex">
            <div className="flex h-28 w-28 items-center justify-center rounded-3xl border border-white/15 bg-white/10 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur">
              <div className="flex h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-white text-blue-950 shadow-lg">
                <ClipboardList className="h-10 w-10" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* FILTER PANEL */}

      <section className={`${cardClass} overflow-hidden`}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
