            <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400">
              <Filter className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>

            <div>
              <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Report Filters
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Choose a customer and reporting period
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <span className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
            {customers.length} customer{customers.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}{" "}
            available
          </span>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={generateReport} className="p-5 sm:p-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            {/* FROM DATE */}

            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>
                <CalendarDays className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-500" />
                From Date
              </label>

              <input
                type="date"
                value={fromDate}
                max={toDate || undefined}
                onChange={(event) => setFromDate(event.target.value)}
                className={inputClass}
                required
              />
            </div>

            {/* TO DATE */}

            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>
                <CalendarDays className="h-4 w-4 text-violet-500" />
                To Date
              </label>

              <input
                type="date"
                value={toDate}
                min={fromDate || undefined}
                onChange={(event) => setToDate(event.target.value)}
                className={inputClass}
                required
              />
            </div>

            {/* CUSTOMER */}

            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>
                <UserRound className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500" />
                Customer
              </label>

              <div className="relative">
                <select
                  value={customerId}
                  onChange={(event) => setCustomerId(event.target.value)}
                  className={`${inputClass} appearance-none pr-10`}
                  required
                >
                  <option value="">Select a customer</option>

                  {customers.map((item) => (
                    <option
                      key={item.customer_id}
                      value={item.customer_id}
                    >
                      {item.customer_code
                        ? `${item.customer_code} - `
                        : ""}
                      {item.customer_name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>

                <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
              </div>

              {loadingCustomers && (
                <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                  <RefreshCw className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                  Loading customers...
                </p>
              )}

              {!loadingCustomers && customers.length === 0 && (
                <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                  No customers found. Check your customer records.
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* SUBSIDIARY */}

            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>
                <ArrowLeftRight className="h-4 w-4 text-orange-500" />
                Subsidiary
              </label>

              <div className="relative">
                <select
                  value={subsidiary}
                  onChange={(event) => setSubsidiary(event.target.value)}
                  className={`${inputClass} appearance-none pr-10`}
                >
                  <option value="">All Subsidiaries</option>
                  <option value="main">Main Subsidiary</option>
                </select>

                <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
              </div>

              <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                Available report filters
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* FILTER ACTIONS */}

          <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
            <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Tip:
              </span>{" "}
              Select a customer and date range to view the ledger statement.
            </p>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={clearReport}
                disabled={loadingReport}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4" />
                Clear Report
              </button>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={loadingReport || loadingCustomers}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20 transition hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-indigo-700 hover:shadow-blue-600/30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                {loadingReport ? (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                    Generating Report...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Search className="h-4 w-4" />
                    Generate Report
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </section>

      {/* ERROR MESSAGE */}

      {error && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800 dark:border-red-900/70 dark:bg-red-950/30 dark:text-red-300"
        >
          <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />

          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="font-semibold">Unable to complete request</p>
            <p className="mt-1 break-words text-sm">{error}</p>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setError("")}
            aria-label="Dismiss error"
            className="rounded-lg p-1 transition hover:bg-red-100 dark:hover:bg-red-900/50"
          >
            <span className="text-lg leading-none">Ã—</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* LOADING STATE */}

      {loadingReport && (
        <div
          className={`${cardClass} flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-6 py-14 text-center`}
        >
          <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/10">
            <RefreshCw className="h-7 w-7 animate-spin text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
          </div>

          <h3 className="mt-4 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            Preparing your ledger
          </h3>

          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Retrieving customer transactions and balances...
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* REPORT */}

      {!loadingReport && customer && (
        <section className="space-y-5">
          {/* REPORT TITLE CARD */}

          <div className={`${cardClass} overflow-hidden`}>
            <div className="border-b border-slate-100 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:p-6">
              <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-5 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <div className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 text-lg font-bold text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20">
                    {getInitials(customer.customer_name)}
                  </div>

                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-2xl">
                        Customer Ledger Report
                      </h2>

                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        Generated
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <p className="mt-1.5 break-words text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                        {customer.customer_name}
                      </span>

                      {customer.customer_code && (
                        <span className="ml-2 inline-flex rounded-md bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                          {customer.customer_code}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-4 py-3 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800/70">
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Reporting Period
                  </p>

                  <p className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    <CalendarDays className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-500" />
                    {formatDate(fromDate)}
                    <span className="text-slate-400">to</span>
                    {formatDate(toDate)}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* FINANCIAL SUMMARY */}

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 bg-slate-50/70 p-4 dark:bg-slate-950/30 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4 sm:p-5">
              <SummaryCard
                title="Opening Balance"
                value={openingBalance}
                description="Balance brought forward"
                icon={Wallet}
                iconColor="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"
                iconBg="bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/10"
              />

              <SummaryCard
                title="Total Debit"
                value={totalDebit}
                description="Debit transactions"
                icon={ArrowDownLeft}
                iconColor="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                iconBg="bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10"
                valueColor="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
              />

              <SummaryCard
                title="Total Credit"
                value={totalCredit}
                description="Credit transactions"
                icon={ArrowUpRight}
                iconColor="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400"
                iconBg="bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10"
                valueColor="text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400"
              />

              <SummaryCard
                title="Closing Balance"
                value={closingBalance}
                description="Balance at period end"
                icon={TrendingUp}
                iconColor="text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400"
                iconBg="bg-violet-50 dark:bg-violet-500/10"
                valueColor="text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-400"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* TRANSACTION TABLE */}

          <div className={`${cardClass} overflow-hidden`}>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-6">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-400">
                  <FileSearch className="h-5 w-5" />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    Transaction Details
                  </h3>

                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Opening balance and all ledger entries
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <span className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500" />
                {ledger.length} transaction{ledger.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full min-w-[1050px] border-collapse text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80">
                    <th className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-left text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Trans. Date
                    </th>

                    <th className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-left text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Transaction Number
                    </th>

                    <th className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-left text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Reference No.
                    </th>

                    <th className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-left text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Memo
                    </th>

                    <th className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Debit
                    </th>

                    <th className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Credit
                    </th>

                    <th className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Running Total
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                <tbody>
                  {/* OPENING BALANCE */}

                  <tr className="border-b border-blue-100 bg-blue-50/70 dark:border-blue-900/40 dark:bg-blue-500/5">
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                      {formatDate(fromDate)}
                    </td>

                    <td className="px-5 py-4">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400">
                        <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-500/15">
                          <Wallet className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </span>
                        Opening Balance
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    <td className="px-5 py-4 text-slate-400">â€”</td>

                    <td className="px-5 py-4 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Balance brought forward
                    </td>

                    <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-medium tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                      {openingBalance > 0
                        ? formatAmount(openingBalance)
                        : "â€”"}
                    </td>

                    <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-slate-400">â€”</td>

                    <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      {formatAmount(openingBalance)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>

                  {/* TRANSACTIONS */}

                  {ledger.map((row, index) => {
                    const isInvoice = row.transaction_type === "INVOICE";

                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={`${row.transaction_type}-${row.transaction_id}-${index}`}
                        className="border-b border-slate-100 transition-colors hover:bg-blue-50/40 dark:border-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60"
                      >
                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                          {formatDate(row.transaction_date)}
                        </td>

                        <td className="px-5 py-4">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                            <span
                              className={`flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${
                                isInvoice
                                  ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400"
                                  : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400"
                              }`}
                            >
                              {isInvoice ? (
                                <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
                              ) : (
                                <CircleDollarSign className="h-4 w-4" />
                              )}
                            </span>

                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <p className="whitespace-nowrap font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                                {row.transaction_number || "â€”"}
                              </p>

                              <span
                                className={`mt-1 inline-flex rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide ${
                                  isInvoice
                                    ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400"
                                    : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400"
                                }`}
                              >
                                {row.transaction_type || "Transaction"}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        <td className="px-5 py-4 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          {row.reference_no || "â€”"}
                        </td>

                        <td className="max-w-[260px] px-5 py-4 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                          <span className="line-clamp-2">
                            {row.memo || "â€”"}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-medium tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                          {Number(row.debit) > 0
                            ? formatAmount(row.debit)
                            : "â€”"}
                        </td>

                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-medium tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                          {Number(row.credit) > 0
                            ? formatAmount(row.credit)
                            : "â€”"}
                        </td>

                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                          {formatAmount(row.running_total)}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}

                  {/* EMPTY TRANSACTIONS */}

                  {ledger.length === 0 && (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={7} className="px-5 py-14 text-center">
                        <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">
                          <FileSearch className="h-7 w-7 text-slate-400" />
                        </div>

                        <p className="mt-4 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                          No transactions found
                        </p>

                        <p className="mx-auto mt-1 max-w-sm text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          There are no transactions for this customer within
                          the selected reporting period.
                        </p>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                </tbody>

                {/* TOTALS */}

                <tfoot>
                  <tr className="border-t-2 border-slate-200 bg-slate-100/80 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800">
                    <td
                      colSpan={4}
                      className="px-5 py-5 text-right font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200"
                    >
                      Period Total
                    </td>

                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-5 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                      {formatAmount(totalDebit)}
                    </td>

                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-5 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400">
                      {formatAmount(totalCredit)}
                    </td>

                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-5 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      {formatAmount(closingBalance)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                </tfoot>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* TABLE FOOTER */}

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 px-5 py-4 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-6">
              <span>
                Showing {ledger.length} ledger transaction
                {ledger.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
              </span>

              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                Report generated successfully
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {/* INITIAL EMPTY STATE */}

      {!customer && !loadingReport && !error && !hasGeneratedReport && (
        <section className={`${cardClass} overflow-hidden`}>
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center px-6 py-14 text-center sm:py-16">
            <div className="relative flex h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-indigo-100 dark:from-blue-500/10 dark:to-indigo-500/10">
              <ClipboardList className="h-10 w-10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />

              <span className="absolute -right-2 -top-2 flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-4 border-white bg-emerald-500 text-white dark:border-slate-900">
                <Search className="h-3 w-3" />
              </span>
            </div>

            <h3 className="mt-6 text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              Your customer ledger starts here
            </h3>

            <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Select a customer and choose the reporting dates above. Generate
              a report to view the opening balance, transactions, debit, credit
              and closing balance.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
              <span className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                Opening balance
              </span>

              <span className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                Debit &amp; credit
              </span>

              <span className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                Running balance
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {/* EMPTY RESULT AFTER REPORT */}

      {!customer && !loadingReport && hasGeneratedReport && !error && (
        <section
          className={`${cardClass} flex flex-col items-center px-6 py-12 text-center`}
        >
          <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/10">
            <FileSearch className="h-7 w-7 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
          </div>

          <h3 className="mt-4 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            No report data available
          </h3>

          <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            The request completed, but no customer information was returned.
            Please verify the customer and try again.
          </p>
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== app\dashboard\customers\page.js =====
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Plus,
  Search,
  Users,
  Pencil,
  Trash2,
  X,
  ArrowLeft,
  LoaderCircle,
  RefreshCw,
  UserRound,
  Phone,
  Mail,
  MapPin,
  Wallet,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  Building2,
  UserPlus,
  TrendingUp,
  ArrowUpRight,
  ChevronDown,
  ShieldCheck,
  CreditCard,
  Sparkles,
  CircleDollarSign,
} from "lucide-react";

const emptyForm = {
  customerCode: "",
  customerName: "",
  phone: "",
  email: "",
  address: "",
  openingBalance: "",
  creditLimit: "",
  isActive: true,
};

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-300 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-white dark:placeholder:text-slate-500 dark:hover:border-slate-600 dark:focus:border-blue-500";

const labelClass =
  "mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300";

function formatAmount(value) {
  const amount = Number(value ?? 0);

  return (Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : 0).toLocaleString(
    "en-PK",
    {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    }
  );
}

async function readResponse(response) {
  const text = await response.text();
  let data = {};

  if (text) {
    try {
      data = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      throw new Error(
        `Invalid server response (HTTP ${response.status}).`
      );
    }
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      data.message || `Request failed (HTTP ${response.status}).`
    );
  }

  return data;
}

function StatCard({
  title,
  value,
  description,
  icon: Icon,
  color,
  accent,
}) {
  return (
    <div className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
      <div className={`absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1 ${accent}`} />

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {title}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
            {value}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div
          className={`flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl transition group-hover:scale-110 ${color}`}
        >
          <Icon className="h-6 w-6" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StatusBadge({ active }) {
  return active ? (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300">
      <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
      Active
    </span>
  ) : (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
      <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-slate-400" />
      Inactive
    </span>
  );
}

function CustomerAvatar({ name }) {
  const initials = String(name || "Customer")
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
    .join("");

  return (
    <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm shadow-blue-600/20">
      {initials || "C"}
    </div>
  );
}

function LoadingState() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
      <div className="h-52 animate-pulse rounded-3xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800" />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        {[1, 2, 3].map((item) => (
          <div
            key={item}
            className="h-32 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800"
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="h-96 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800" />

      <p className="text-center text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
        Loading customer management...
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function CustomersPage() {
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm);

  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState(null);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState(null);

  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all");

  const loadCustomers = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/customers", {
        method: "GET",
        cache: "no-store",
        headers: {
          Accept: "application/json",
        },
      });

      const data = await readResponse(response);

      setCustomers(
        Array.isArray(data.customers) ? data.customers : []
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load customers.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    async function fetchCustomers() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/customers", {
          method: "GET",
          cache: "no-store",
          headers: {
            Accept: "application/json",
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        const data = await readResponse(response);

        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setCustomers(
            Array.isArray(data.customers) ? data.customers : []
          );
          setError("");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setError(err.message || "Failed to load customers.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    fetchCustomers();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  function handleChange(event) {
    const { name, value, type, checked } = event.target;

    setForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [name]: type === "checkbox" ? checked : value,
    }));

    setError("");
    setSuccess("");
  }

  function openAddForm() {
    setForm({ ...emptyForm });
    setEditingId(null);
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");
    setShowForm(true);

    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  }

  function editCustomer(customer) {
    setEditingId(customer.customer_id);

    setForm({
      customerCode: customer.customer_code ?? "",
      customerName: customer.customer_name ?? "",
      phone: customer.phone ?? "",
      email: customer.email ?? "",
      address: customer.address ?? "",
      openingBalance: customer.opening_balance ?? "",
      creditLimit: customer.credit_limit ?? "",
      isActive: customer.is_active !== false,
    });

    setError("");
    setSuccess("");
    setShowForm(true);

    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  }

  function closeForm() {
    setShowForm(false);
    setEditingId(null);
    setForm({ ...emptyForm });
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");
  }

  async function saveCustomer(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    setSaving(true);
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");

    try {
      const url = editingId
        ? `/api/customers/${editingId}`
        : "/api/customers";

      const method = editingId ? "PUT" : "POST";

      const response = await fetch(url, {
        method,
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Accept: "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...form,
          customerCode: form.customerCode.trim(),
          customerName: form.customerName.trim(),
          phone: form.phone.trim(),
          email: form.email.trim(),
          address: form.address.trim(),
          openingBalance:
            form.openingBalance === ""
              ? 0
              : Number(form.openingBalance),
          creditLimit:
            form.creditLimit === ""
              ? 0
              : Number(form.creditLimit),
        }),
      });

      const data = await readResponse(response);

      if (!data.customer) {
        throw new Error(
          "The API did not return the saved customer."
        );
      }

      if (editingId) {
        setCustomers((current) =>
          current.map((customer) =>
            String(customer.customer_id) === String(editingId)
              ? { ...customer, ...data.customer }
              : customer
          )
        );

        setSuccess("Customer updated successfully.");
      } else {
        setCustomers((current) => [
          data.customer,
          ...current,
        ]);

        setSuccess("Customer added successfully.");
      }

      setShowForm(false);
      setEditingId(null);
      setForm({ ...emptyForm });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save customer.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function deleteCustomer(id) {
    const customer = customers.find(
      (item) => String(item.customer_id) === String(id)
    );

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Delete customer "${customer?.customer_name || "this customer"}"?`
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    setDeletingId(id);
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/customers/${id}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: {
          Accept: "application/json",
        },
      });

      await readResponse(response);

      setCustomers((current) =>
        current.filter(
          (item) => String(item.customer_id) !== String(id)
        )
      );

      setSuccess("Customer deleted successfully.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete customer.");
    } finally {
      setDeletingId(null);
    }
  }

  const filteredCustomers = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedSearch = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    return customers.filter((customer) => {
      const matchesSearch = [
        customer.customer_code,
        customer.customer_name,
        customer.phone,
        customer.email,
        customer.address,
      ].some((value) =>
        String(value ?? "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(normalizedSearch)
      );

      const matchesStatus =
        statusFilter === "all" ||
        (statusFilter === "active" && customer.is_active) ||
        (statusFilter === "inactive" && !customer.is_active);

      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
    });
  }, [customers, search, statusFilter]);

  const activeCount = customers.filter(
    (customer) => customer.is_active
  ).length;

  const inactiveCount = customers.length - activeCount;

  const totalBalance = customers.reduce(
    (total, customer) =>
      total + (Number(customer.customer_balance) || 0),
    0
  );

  const totalSales = customers.reduce(
    (total, customer) =>
      total + (Number(customer.total_sales) || 0),
    0
  );

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1700px] space-y-6 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:space-y-8 lg:p-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <header className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-700 via-indigo-700 to-violet-800 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-indigo-900/10 sm:p-8">
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-16 -top-24 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-white/10 blur-2xl" />
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-32 right-1/3 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-cyan-300/20 blur-3xl" />

          <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 xl:flex-row xl:items-center">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
              <div className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white/15 shadow-inner backdrop-blur-sm sm:h-16 sm:w-16">
                <Users className="h-7 w-7 sm:h-8 sm:w-8" />
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="mb-2 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-blue-50">
                  <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Customer Relationship Management
                </div>

                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl">
                  Customers
                </h1>

                <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-blue-100 sm:text-base">
                  Manage your customer directory, contact information,
                  account balances, and credit limits in one place.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="relative flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              {!showForm ? (
                <>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={loadCustomers}
                    disabled={loading}
                    className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/25 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw
                      className={`h-4 w-4 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`}
                    />
                    Refresh
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={openAddForm}
                    className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-800 shadow-lg transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-blue-50"
                  >
                    <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4" />
                    Add Customer
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={closeForm}
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/25 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Back to Customers
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="relative mt-7 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 border-t border-white/20 pt-5 sm:grid-cols-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white/10">
                <Users className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-100" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-blue-100">Total customers</p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-lg font-bold">
                  {customers.length.toLocaleString("en-PK")}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white/10">
                <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-200" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-blue-100">Active accounts</p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-lg font-bold">
                  {activeCount.toLocaleString("en-PK")}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white/10">
                <Building2 className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-100" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-blue-100">Inactive accounts</p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-lg font-bold">
                  {inactiveCount.toLocaleString("en-PK")}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* Alerts */}
        {error && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-800 dark:border-red-900/60 dark:bg-red-950/30 dark:text-red-300"
          >
            <XCircle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />

            <p className="flex-1">{error}</p>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setError("")}
              aria-label="Dismiss error"
              className="rounded-lg p-1 transition hover:bg-red-100 dark:hover:bg-red-900/40"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {success && (
          <div
            role="status"
            className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-4 text-sm text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 dark:text-emerald-300"
          >
            <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />

            <p className="flex-1">{success}</p>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSuccess("")}
              aria-label="Dismiss success message"
              className="rounded-lg p-1 transition hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/40"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {loading && customers.length === 0 && !showForm ? (
          <LoadingState />
        ) : showForm ? (
          /* Add/Edit Form */
          <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
            <div className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50 to-indigo-50 px-5 py-6 dark:border-slate-800 dark:from-slate-900 dark:to-indigo-950/30 sm:px-8">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20">
                  {editingId ? (
                    <Pencil className="h-5 w-5" />
                  ) : (
                    <UserPlus className="h-5 w-5" />
                  )}
                </div>

                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    {editingId ? "Edit Customer" : "Create Customer"}
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    {editingId
                      ? "Update customer details and account settings."
                      : "Add a new customer to your ERP customer directory."}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={saveCustomer} className="p-5 sm:p-8">
              <div className="mb-6 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                <UserRound className="h-4 w-4" />
                Basic Information
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customerCode" className={labelClass}>
                    Customer Code <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customerCode"
                    name="customerCode"
                    value={form.customerCode}
                    onChange={handleChange}
                    placeholder="CUS-001"
                    className={inputClass}
                    maxLength={100}
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customerName" className={labelClass}>
                    Customer Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customerName"
                    name="customerName"
                    value={form.customerName}
                    onChange={handleChange}
                    placeholder="Enter customer name"
                    className={inputClass}
                    maxLength={200}
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="phone" className={labelClass}>
                    Phone Number
                  </label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Phone className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
                    <input
                      id="phone"
                      name="phone"
                      type="tel"
                      value={form.phone}
                      onChange={handleChange}
                      placeholder="03XX XXXXXXX"
                      className={`${inputClass} pl-10`}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="email" className={labelClass}>
                    Email Address
                  </label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Mail className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
                    <input
                      id="email"
                      name="email"
                      type="email"
                      value={form.email}
                      onChange={handleChange}
                      placeholder="customer@example.com"
                      className={`${inputClass} pl-10`}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="md:col-span-2 xl:col-span-1">
                  <label htmlFor="address" className={labelClass}>
                    Address
                  </label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <MapPin className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-3.5 h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" />
                    <textarea
                      id="address"
                      name="address"
                      value={form.address}
                      onChange={handleChange}
                      rows={3}
                      maxLength={1000}
                      placeholder="Street, city, or business address"
                      className={`${inputClass} resize-y pl-10`}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mb-6 mt-9 flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 pt-7 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-blue-600 dark:border-slate-800 dark:text-blue-400">
                <CreditCard className="h-4 w-4" />
                Financial Information
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="openingBalance" className={labelClass}>
                    Opening Balance
                  </label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <CircleDollarSign className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
                    <input
                      id="openingBalance"
                      name="openingBalance"
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      step="0.01"
                      value={form.openingBalance}
                      onChange={handleChange}
                      placeholder="0.00"
                      className={`${inputClass} pl-10`}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Initial balance for this customer.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="creditLimit" className={labelClass}>
                    Credit Limit
                  </label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Wallet className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
                    <input
                      id="creditLimit"
                      name="creditLimit"
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      step="0.01"
                      value={form.creditLimit}
                      onChange={handleChange}
                      placeholder="0.00"
                      className={`${inputClass} pl-10`}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Maximum credit allowed for this customer.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center">
                  <label className="flex w-full cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4 transition hover:border-blue-200 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800/60 dark:hover:border-blue-800">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      name="isActive"
                      checked={form.isActive}
                      onChange={handleChange}
                      className="mt-1 h-4 w-4 rounded border-slate-300 accent-blue-600"
                    />

                    <span>
                      <span className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-white">
                        Active Customer
                      </span>
                      <span className="mt-1 block text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        Enable this customer for normal ERP operations.
                      </span>
                    </span>
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-9 flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-6 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={closeForm}
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                >
                  <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Cancel
                </button>

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20 transition hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-indigo-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  {saving ? (
                    <LoaderCircle className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                  )}
                  {saving
                    ? "Saving..."
                    : editingId
                      ? "Update Customer"
                      : "Save Customer"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </section>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Summary */}
            <section>
              <div className="mb-4">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-xl">
                  Customer Overview
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  A quick snapshot of your customer accounts and balances.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                <StatCard
                  title="Total Customers"
                  value={customers.length.toLocaleString("en-PK")}
                  description="All customer records"
                  icon={Users}
                  color="bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-950/50 dark:text-blue-300"
                  accent="bg-blue-500"
                />

                <StatCard
                  title="Active Customers"
                  value={activeCount.toLocaleString("en-PK")}
                  description="Accounts currently active"
                  icon={CheckCircle2}
                  color="bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300"
                  accent="bg-emerald-500"
                />

                <StatCard
                  title="Customer Balance"
                  value={formatAmount(totalBalance)}
                  description="Combined balance from customer records"
                  icon={Wallet}
                  color="bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/50 dark:text-amber-300"
                  accent="bg-amber-500"
                />

                <StatCard
                  title="Total Sales"
                  value={formatAmount(totalSales)}
                  description="Combined recorded customer sales"
                  icon={TrendingUp}
                  color="bg-violet-50 text-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-950/50 dark:text-violet-300"
                  accent="bg-violet-500"
                />
              </div>
            </section>

            {/* Customer list */}
            <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
              <div className="border-b border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:p-6">
                <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 xl:flex-row xl:items-center">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/50">
                        <Users className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300" />
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                          Customer Directory
                        </h2>
                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          Search and manage your customer records.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                      {filteredCustomers.length} of {customers.length} records
                    </span>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={loadCustomers}
                      disabled={loading}
                      className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                    >
                      <RefreshCw
                        className={`h-4 w-4 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`}
                      />
                      Refresh
                    </button>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={openAddForm}
                      className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700"
                    >
                      <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
                      Add Customer
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_220px_auto]">
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />

                    <input
                      type="search"
                      value={search}
                      onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Search name, code, phone, or email..."
                      aria-label="Search customers"
                      className={`${inputClass} pl-10`}
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="relative">
                    <select
                      value={statusFilter}
                      onChange={(event) => setStatusFilter(event.target.value)}
                      aria-label="Filter customer status"
                      className={`${inputClass} appearance-none pr-10`}
                    >
                      <option value="all">All Statuses</option>
                      <option value="active">Active Customers</option>
                      <option value="inactive">Inactive Customers</option>
                    </select>
                    <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSearch("");
                      setStatusFilter("all");
                    }}
                    disabled={!search && statusFilter === "all"}
                    className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                  >
                    <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                    Clear Filters
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {loading && customers.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="flex min-h-64 items-center justify-center gap-3 p-8 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  <LoaderCircle className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin text-blue-600" />
                  Loading customers...
                </div>
              ) : filteredCustomers.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="flex min-h-72 flex-col items-center justify-center px-6 py-14 text-center">
                  <div className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">
                    {customers.length === 0 ? (
                      <Users className="h-8 w-8 text-slate-400" />
                    ) : (
                      <Search className="h-8 w-8 text-slate-400" />
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <h3 className="mt-5 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    {customers.length === 0
                      ? "No customers yet"
                      : "No matching customers"}
                  </h3>

                  <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    {customers.length === 0
                      ? "Create your first customer to start managing customer accounts and balances."
                      : "Try another search term or clear the filters to see more customers."}
                  </p>

                  {customers.length === 0 ? (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={openAddForm}
                      className="mt-5 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700"
                    >
                      <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
                      Add First Customer
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSearch("");
                        setStatusFilter("all");
                      }}
                      className="mt-5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                    >
                      Clear Filters
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {/* Desktop table */}
                  <div className="hidden overflow-x-auto md:block">
                    <table className="w-full min-w-[1050px] text-left text-sm">
                      <thead className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80">
                        <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                          <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300">
                            Customer
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300">
                            Contact Details
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300">
                            Sales
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300">
                            Paid
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300">
                            Balance
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300">
                            Status
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300">
                            Actions
                          </th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>

                      <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                        {filteredCustomers.map((customer) => (
                          <tr
                            key={customer.customer_id}
                            className="transition-colors hover:bg-blue-50/50 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/20"
                          >
                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                              <div className="flex min-w-[210px] items-center gap-3">
                                <CustomerAvatar name={customer.customer_name} />
                                <div className="min-w-0">
                                  <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                    {customer.customer_name || "Unnamed Customer"}
                                  </p>
                                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                    Code: {customer.customer_code || "â€”"}
                                  </p>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </td>

                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                              <div className="min-w-[180px] space-y-1.5">
                                <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                                  <Phone className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-slate-400" />
                                  {customer.phone || "No phone"}
                                </p>
                                <p className="flex items-center gap-2 break-all text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                  <Mail className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                                  {customer.email || "No email"}
                                </p>
                              </div>
                            </td>

                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-medium tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                              {formatAmount(customer.total_sales)}
                            </td>

                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-medium tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                              {formatAmount(customer.total_paid)}
                            </td>

                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right">
                              <span className="font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                {formatAmount(customer.customer_balance)}
                              </span>
                            </td>

                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                              <StatusBadge active={customer.is_active} />
                            </td>

                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => editCustomer(customer)}
                                  aria-label={`Edit ${customer.customer_name}`}
                                  title="Edit customer"
                                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:border-blue-200 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:border-blue-900 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/40 dark:hover:text-blue-300"
                                >
                                  <Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                                  Edit
                                </button>

                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => deleteCustomer(customer.customer_id)}
                                  disabled={
                                    String(deletingId) ===
                                    String(customer.customer_id)
                                  }
                                  aria-label={`Delete ${customer.customer_name}`}
                                  title="Delete customer"
                                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-red-600 transition hover:bg-red-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-red-900/50 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-red-300 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                                >
                                  {String(deletingId) ===
                                  String(customer.customer_id) ? (
                                    <LoaderCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                                  ) : (
                                    <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                                  )}
                                  Delete
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>

                  {/* Mobile customer cards */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 p-4 md:hidden">
                    {filteredCustomers.map((customer) => (
                      <article
                        key={customer.customer_id}
                        className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 transition hover:border-blue-200 hover:shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:hover:border-blue-900"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
                            <CustomerAvatar name={customer.customer_name} />
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <h3 className="break-words font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                {customer.customer_name || "Unnamed Customer"}
                              </h3>
                              <p className="mt-1 break-all text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                {customer.customer_code || "No customer code"}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          <StatusBadge active={customer.is_active} />
                        </div>

                        <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3 text-sm dark:bg-slate-800/70">
                          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 break-all text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                            <Phone className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-slate-400" />
                            {customer.phone || "No phone"}
                          </p>
                          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 break-all text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                            <Mail className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-slate-400" />
                            {customer.email || "No email"}
                          </p>
                          {customer.address && (
                            <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                              <MapPin className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-slate-400" />
                              <span className="break-words">{customer.address}</span>
                            </p>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                          <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-100 p-3 dark:border-slate-800">
                            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                              Total Sales
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 break-words font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                              {formatAmount(customer.total_sales)}
                            </p>
                          </div>

                          <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-100 p-3 dark:border-slate-800">
                            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                              Total Paid
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 break-words font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                              {formatAmount(customer.total_paid)}
                            </p>
                          </div>

                          <div className="col-span-2 rounded-xl border border-blue-100 bg-blue-50/60 p-3 dark:border-blue-900/50 dark:bg-blue-950/20">
                            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                              Customer Balance
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 break-words text-lg font-bold text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300">
                              {formatAmount(customer.customer_balance)}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4 dark:border-slate-800">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => editCustomer(customer)}
                            className="inline-flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/40 dark:hover:text-blue-300"
                          >
                            <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />
                            Edit
                          </button>

                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => deleteCustomer(customer.customer_id)}
                            disabled={
                              String(deletingId) ===
                              String(customer.customer_id)
                            }
                            className="inline-flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-red-200 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-red-600 transition hover:bg-red-50 disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-red-900/50 dark:text-red-300 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                          >
                            {String(deletingId) ===
                            String(customer.customer_id) ? (
                              <LoaderCircle className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                            ) : (
                              <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                            )}
                            Delete
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </article>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-5 py-4 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800/40 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                    <p>
                      Showing{" "}
                      <strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                        {filteredCustomers.length}
                      </strong>{" "}
                      customer{filteredCustomers.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
                    </p>

                    <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <ArrowUpRight className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-500" />
                      Customer directory
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </section>
          </>
        )}

        <footer className="flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-2 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 sm:flex-row sm:text-left">
          <p>Customer Management Â· ERP Administration</p>
          <p>Customer details and balances</p>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
