"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

const INITIAL_DATA = {
    challans: [],
    permissions: {},
    company: null,
};

const money = (value, currency = "PKR") => {
    try {
        return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
            style: "currency",
            currency: currency || "PKR",
            maximumFractionDigits: 2,
        }).format(Number(value || 0));
    } catch {
        return `PKR ${Number(value || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
            maximumFractionDigits: 2,
        })}`;
    }
};

const dateText = (value) => {
    if (!value) return "â€”";

    const date = new Date(value);

    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        return String(value).slice(0, 10);
    }

    return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
        day: "2-digit",
        month: "short",
        year: "numeric",
    });
};

function normalizeData(result) {
    return {
        challans: Array.isArray(result?.challans)
            ? result.challans
            : [],
        permissions: result?.permissions || {},
        company: result?.company || null,
    };
}

export default function DeliveryChallansPage() {
    const [data, setData] = useState(INITIAL_DATA);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("ALL");
    const [view, setView] = useState("table");
    const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);
    const [requesting, setRequesting] = useState(false);

    /*
     * Initial data loading.
     * State updates happen after the fetch resolves, not synchronously
     * in the effect body.
     */
    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;

        async function fetchChallans() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch("/api/delivery-challans", {
                    cache: "no-store",
                });

                const result = await response.json();

                if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                    throw new Error(
                        result.message ||
                            "Could not load Delivery Challans."
                    );
                }

                if (cancelled) return;

                setData(normalizeData(result));
                setError("");
            } catch (err) {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setError(
                        err.message ||
                            "Could not load Delivery Challans."
                    );
                }
            } finally {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setLoading(false);
                }
            }
        }

        fetchChallans();

        return () => {
            cancelled = true;
        };
    }, [refreshKey]);

    /*
     * Manual refresh for the Retry and Refresh buttons.
     * This uses the same API and response structure as initial loading.
     */
    const load = useCallback(async () => {
        if (requesting) return;

        setRequesting(true);
        setError("");

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/delivery-challans", {
                cache: "no-store",
            });

            const result = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                throw new Error(
                    result.message ||
                        "Could not load Delivery Challans."
                );
            }

            setData(normalizeData(result));
        } catch (err) {
            setError(
                err.message || "Could not load Delivery Challans."
            );
        } finally {
            setRequesting(false);
        }
    }, [requesting]);

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

        return (data.challans || []).filter((row) => {
            const matchesStatus =
                statusFilter === "ALL" ||
                String(row.status || "").toUpperCase() === statusFilter;

            const searchable = [
                row.transaction_number,
                row.customer_name,
                row.warehouse_name,
                row.source_order_number,
                row.status,
                row.document_status,
                row.driver_name,
                row.vehicle_no,
            ]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(" ")
                .toLowerCase();

            return (
                matchesStatus &&
                (!query || searchable.includes(query))
            );
        });
    }, [data.challans, search, statusFilter]);

    const totals = useMemo(() => {
        const challans = data.challans || [];

        return {
            count: challans.length,
            pending: challans.filter(
                (row) =>
                    String(row.document_status || "").toLowerCase() ===
                    "pending invoice"
            ).length,
            approved: challans.filter(
                (row) =>
                    String(row.status || "").toUpperCase() === "APPROVED"
            ).length,
            amount: challans.reduce(
                (sum, row) => sum + Number(row.gross_amount || 0),
                0
            ),
        };
    }, [data.challans]);

    function printReport(row) {
        window.open(
            `/dashboard/delivery-challans/${row.delivery_challan_id}?print=1`,
            "_blank",
            "noopener,noreferrer"
        );
    }

    async function deleteDraft(row) {
        const confirmed = window.confirm(
            `Are you sure you want to delete ${row.transaction_number}?`
        );

        if (!confirmed) return;

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                `/api/delivery-challans/${row.delivery_challan_id}`,
                { method: "DELETE" }
            );

            const result = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                throw new Error(
                    result.message || "Could not delete the challan."
                );
            }

            await load();
        } catch (err) {
            window.alert(
                err.message || "Could not delete the challan."
            );
        }
    }

    const inputClass =
        "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 dark:placeholder:text-slate-500";

    const statusClass = (status) => {
        const normalized = String(status || "").toUpperCase();

        if (normalized === "APPROVED") {
            return "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300";
        }

        if (normalized === "VOID") {
            return "bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950 dark:text-red-300";
        }

        return "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-300";
    };

    const summaryCards = [
        {
            label: "Total Challans",
            value: totals.count,
            icon: "â–¤",
            style: "from-blue-500 to-indigo-600",
        },
        {
            label: "Pending Invoice",
            value: totals.pending,
            icon: "â—·",
            style: "from-amber-400 to-orange-500",
        },
        {
            label: "Approved",
            value: totals.approved,
            icon: "âœ“",
            style: "from-emerald-500 to-green-600",
        },
        {
            label: "Gross Amount",
            value: money(totals.amount, data.company?.currency),
            icon: "â‚¨",
            style: "from-violet-500 to-purple-600",
        },
    ];

    return (
        <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-4 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
            <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-6">
                {/* Page header */}
                <header className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-700 via-blue-600 to-emerald-600 p-6 text-white shadow-xl sm:p-8">
                    <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
                        <div>
                            <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-blue-100">
                                Sales Â· Logistics
                            </p>

                            <h1 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-black tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
                                Delivery Challans
                            </h1>

                            <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm text-blue-50 sm:text-base">
                                Manage outbound deliveries, track pending
                                invoices, and print delivery documents.
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                            <Link
                                href="/dashboard/delivery-challans/new"
                                className="rounded-xl bg-white px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-blue-700 shadow transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-blue-50"
                            >
                                + Create Manually
                            </Link>

                            <Link
                                href="/dashboard/delivery-challans/pending"
                                className="rounded-xl border border-white/40 bg-white/10 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-white/20"
                            >
                                Pending Delivery Challans â†’
                            </Link>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                {/* Summary cards */}
                <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">

                        >
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                    {card.label}
                                </p>

                                <span
                                    className={`grid h-11 w-11 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br ${card.style} text-xl font-bold text-white shadow-sm`}
                                >
                                    {card.icon}
                                </span>
                            </div>

                            <p className="mt-4 break-words text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">

                            </p>
                        </div>

                                        view === "table"
                                            ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm"
                                            : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700"

                                        view === "cards"

                                            setSearch("");
                                            setStatusFilter("ALL");

                                >
                                    + Create Challan
                                </Link>
                            </div>

                    ) : view === "cards" ? (

                        <div className="grid gap-4 p-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                            {filtered.map((row) => (
                                <article

                                        <span

                                        >
                                            {row.status || "UNKNOWN"}
                                        </span>
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                        <p>
                                            Date:{" "}
                                            <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                                                {dateText(row.transaction_date)}
                                            </span>
                                        </p>

                                            Location:{" "}

                                            href={`/dashboard/delivery-challans/${row.delivery_challan_id}`}
                                        >
                                            View
                                        </Link>

                                        {row.status === "DRAFT" &&
                                            data.permissions?.canUpdate && (
                                                <Link
                                                    className="rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-emerald-700"
                                                    href={`/dashboard/delivery-challans/${row.delivery_challan_id}?edit=1`}
                                                >

                                        <button

                                            className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700"
                                        >
                                            Report / Print
                                        </button>

                                                            <Link
                                                                title="Edit challan"
                                                                className="rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300"
                                                                href={`/dashboard/delivery-challans/${row.delivery_challan_id}?edit=1`}
                                                            >
                                                                Edit
                                                            </Link>
                                                        )}

                                                    <button
                                                        type="button"
                                                        title="Print challan"
                                                        onClick={() => printReport(row)}
                                                        className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-3 py-2 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200"
                                                    >
                                                        Print
                                                    </button>

                                                    {row.status === "DRAFT" &&
                                                        data.permissions?.canDelete &&
                                                        !row.source_order_id && (
                                                            <button
                                                                type="button"
                                                                onClick={() => deleteDraft(row)}
                                                                className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 font-bold text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300"
                                                            >
                                                                Delete
                                                            </button>
                                                        )}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4">
                                                {dateText(row.transaction_date)}
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400">
                                                {row.transaction_number || "â€”"}
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold">
                                                {row.customer_name || "â€”"}
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                                                {row.warehouse_name || "â€”"}
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                                                {row.source_order_number || "Manual"}
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                                                <span
                                                    className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${statusClass(row.status)}`}
                                                >
                                                    {row.status || "UNKNOWN"}
                                                </span>
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                                                {row.document_status || "â€”"}
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold">
                                                {money(row.gross_amount, row.currency)}
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    ))}
                                </tbody>
                            </table>
                        </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Footer */}
                    <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 p-5 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                        <span>
                            Showing {filtered.length} of{" "}
                            {data.challans.length} challans
                        </span>

                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={load}
                            disabled={requesting}
                            className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                        >
                            {requesting ? "Refreshingâ€¦" : "â†» Refresh"}
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </section>
            </div>
        </main>
    );
}

===== app\dashboard\delivery-challans\pending\page.js =====

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

export default function PendingDeliveryChallansPage() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
    const [selected, setSelected] = useState({});
    const [quantities, setQuantities] = useState({});
    const [entity, setEntity] = useState("");
    const [transactionNumber, setTransactionNumber] = useState("");
    const [items, setItems] = useState("");
    const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const [success, setSuccess] = useState("");

    const inputClass =
        "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100";

    const load = useCallback(async () => {
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");

        try {
            const params = new URLSearchParams({
                type: "SALES_ORDER",
                entity,
                transactionNumber,
                items,
            });

            const response = await fetch(
                `/api/delivery-challans/pending?${params.toString()}`,
                { cache: "no-store" }
            );
            const result = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                throw new Error(result.message || "Could not load pending lines.");
            }

            setRows(result.rows || []);
            setSelected({});
            setQuantities(
                Object.fromEntries(
                    (result.rows || []).map((row) => [
                        String(row.order_item_id),
                        Number(row.pending_quantity),
                    ])
                )
            );
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Could not load pending lines.");
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, [entity, transactionNumber, items]);

    useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function fetchPendingChallans() {
        try {
            setLoading(true);
            setError("");

            const response = await fetch(
                "/api/delivery-challans/pending",
                {
                    cache: "no-store",
                }
            );

            const result = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                throw new Error(
                    result.message ||
                        "Failed to load pending delivery challans."
                );
            }

            if (cancelled) return;

            setRows(result.rows || result.pending || []);
        } catch (err) {
            if (!cancelled) {
                setError(
                    err.message ||
                        "Failed to load pending delivery challans."
                );
            }
        } finally {
            if (!cancelled) {
                setLoading(false);
            }
        }
    }

    fetchPendingChallans();

    return () => {
        cancelled = true;
    };
}, []);

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!q) return rows;

        return rows.filter((row) =>
            [
                row.order_number,
                row.customer_name,
                row.warehouse_name,
                row.item_name,
                row.item_description,
                row.uom,
            ]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(" ")
                .toLowerCase()
                .includes(q)
        );
    }, [rows, search]);

    const selectedRows = useMemo(
        () => filtered.filter((row) => selected[String(row.order_item_id)]),
        [filtered, selected]
    );

    const selectedOrderIds = useMemo(
        () => [...new Set(selectedRows.map((row) => Number(row.order_id)))],
        [selectedRows]
    );

    const totalQuantity = selectedRows.reduce(
        (sum, row) =>
            sum + Number(quantities[String(row.order_item_id)] || 0),
        0
    );

    function toggleRow(row) {
        const key = String(row.order_item_id);

        setSelected((previous) => {
            const next = { ...previous };

            if (next[key]) {
                delete next[key];
                return next;
            }

            const currentlySelected = rows.filter(
                (item) => previous[String(item.order_item_id)]
            );

            if (
                currentlySelected.length > 0 &&
                Number(currentlySelected[0].order_id) !== Number(row.order_id)
            ) {
                setError(
                    "Select lines from one Sales Order at a time. Create the challan, then select another order."
                );
                return previous;
            }

            setError("");
            next[key] = true;
            return next;
        });
    }

    function toggleAll() {
        if (filtered.length === 0) return;

        const currentlySelected = filtered.every(
            (row) => selected[String(row.order_item_id)]
        );

        if (currentlySelected) {
            const next = { ...selected };
            filtered.forEach((row) => delete next[String(row.order_item_id)]);
            setSelected(next);
            return;
        }

        const firstSelected = rows.find(
            (row) => selected[String(row.order_item_id)]
        );

        const orderId = firstSelected
            ? Number(firstSelected.order_id)
            : Number(filtered[0].order_id);

        const sameOrderRows = filtered.filter(
            (row) => Number(row.order_id) === orderId
        );

        setSelected((previous) => {
            const next = { ...previous };
            sameOrderRows.forEach((row) => {
                next[String(row.order_item_id)] = true;
            });
            return next;
        });

        if (filtered.some((row) => Number(row.order_id) !== orderId)) {
            setError(
                "Select All selects lines from the same Sales Order only."
            );
        } else {
            setError("");
        }
    }

    function updateQuantity(row, value) {
        const number = value === "" ? "" : Number(value);
        const pending = Number(row.pending_quantity);

        if (number !== "" && (!Number.isFinite(number) || number < 0)) {
            return;
        }

        if (number !== "" && number > pending) {
            setError(`Quantity cannot exceed ${pending} for ${row.item_name}.`);
            return;
        }

        setError("");
        setQuantities((previous) => ({
            ...previous,
            [String(row.order_item_id)]: number,
        }));
    }

    async function createChallan() {
        setError("");
        setSuccess("");

        if (!selectedRows.length) {
            setError("Select at least one Sales Order line.");
            return;
        }

        if (selectedOrderIds.length !== 1) {
            setError("Select lines from one Sales Order at a time.");
            return;
        }

        const order = selectedRows[0];

        const challanItems = selectedRows.map((row) => ({
            source_order_item_id: Number(row.order_item_id),
            product_id: row.product_id ? Number(row.product_id) : null,
            item_name: row.item_name,
            item_description: row.item_description || "",
            item_balance: Number(row.item_balance || 0),
            uom: row.uom || "",
            quantity: Number(quantities[String(row.order_item_id)]),
            unit_price: Number(row.unit_price ?? row.retail_price ?? 0),
            tax_code: row.tax_code || "",
            tax_rate: Number(row.tax_rate || 0),
            memo: row.line_memo || "",
        }));

        for (const item of challanItems) {
            const original = selectedRows.find(
                (row) => Number(row.order_item_id) === item.source_order_item_id
            );

            if (
                !Number.isFinite(item.quantity) ||
                item.quantity <= 0 ||
                item.quantity > Number(original.pending_quantity)
            ) {
                setError(
                    `Enter a delivery quantity greater than zero and no more than the pending quantity for ${item.item_name}.`
                );
                return;
            }
        }

        setSaving(true);

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/delivery-challans", {
                method: "POST",
                headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    source_order_id: Number(order.order_id),
                    customer_id: Number(order.customer_id),
                    warehouse_id: Number(order.warehouse_id),
                    transaction_date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
                    status: "APPROVED",
                    challan_class: "Outbound Shipment",
                    items: challanItems,
                }),
            });

            const result = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                throw new Error(
                    result.message || "Could not create Delivery Challan."
                );
            }

            setSuccess(result.message || "Delivery Challan created.");
            router.push(
                `/dashboard/delivery-challans/${result.challan.delivery_challan_id}`
            );
            router.refresh();
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Could not create Delivery Challan.");
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    return (
        <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-4 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
            <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1700px] space-y-6">
                <header className="rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-700 via-blue-600 to-emerald-600 p-6 text-white shadow-xl sm:p-8">
                    <Link
                        href="/dashboard/delivery-challans"
                        className="text-sm font-semibold text-blue-100 hover:text-white"
                    >
                        â† Delivery Challans
                    </Link>
                    <h1 className="mt-4 text-3xl font-black sm:text-4xl">
                        Pending Delivery Challans
                    </h1>
                    <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm text-blue-50 sm:text-base">
                        Select an approved Sales Order, confirm the pending
                        quantities, and create an outbound delivery document.
                    </p>
                </header>

                <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
                    <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold">
                            Type
                            <select className={`${inputClass} mt-2`} value="SALES_ORDER" disabled>
                                <option value="SALES_ORDER">Sales Order</option>
                            </select>
                        </label>

                        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold">
                            Entity / Customer
                            <input
                                className={`${inputClass} mt-2`}
                                value={entity}
                                onChange={(event) => setEntity(event.target.value)}
                                placeholder="Search customer..."
                            />
                        </label>

                        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold">
                            Transaction Number
                            <input
                                className={`${inputClass} mt-2`}
                                value={transactionNumber}
                                onChange={(event) => setTransactionNumber(event.target.value)}
                                placeholder="e.g. SO-000030"
                            />
                        </label>

                        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold">
                            Items
                            <input
                                className={`${inputClass} mt-2`}
                                value={items}
                                onChange={(event) => setItems(event.target.value)}
                                placeholder="Search item name..."
                            />
                        </label>
                    </div>

                    <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                        <button
                            onClick={load}
                            className="rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-blue-700"
                        >
                            Apply Filters
                        </button>
                        <button
                            onClick={() => {
                                setEntity("");
                                setTransactionNumber("");
                                setItems("");
                                setSearch("");
                            }}
                            className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold dark:border-slate-700"
                        >
                            Clear Filters
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </section>

                <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
                        <div>
                            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">Pending Sales Order Lines</h2>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                Select lines from the same Sales Order for each challan.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                            <input
                                className={`${inputClass} min-w-64`}
                                value={search}
                                onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                                placeholder="Search displayed rows..."
                            />
                            <button
                                onClick={toggleAll}
                                className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold dark:border-slate-700"
                            >
                                Select All
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {error && (
                        <div className="m-5 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-700 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300">
                            {error}
                        </div>
                    )}

                    {success && (
                        <div className="m-5 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-4 text-sm text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300">
                            {success}
                        </div>
                    )}

                    {loading ? (
                        <div className="p-12 text-center text-slate-500">
                            Loading pending quantitiesâ€¦
                        </div>
                    ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="p-12 text-center">
                            <div className="text-4xl">âœ“</div>
                            <h3 className="mt-3 text-lg font-bold">No pending lines found</h3>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                All matching approved Sales Order quantities may already have been delivered.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                            <table className="w-full min-w-[1450px] text-left text-sm">
                                <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-400">
                                    <tr>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4">Select</th>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4">Seq. ID</th>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4">SO Date</th>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4">Transaction No</th>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4">Customer</th>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4">Location</th>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4">Item Name</th>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4">Item Description</th>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4">UOM</th>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4 text-right">Item Balance</th>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4 text-right">Line Qty.</th>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4 text-right">Pending Qty.</th>
                                        <th className="px-4 py-4">Do Qty.</th>
                                    </tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                                    {filtered.map((row) => {
                                        const key = String(row.order_item_id);
                                        const isSelected = Boolean(selected[key]);

                                        return (
                                            <tr
                                                key={key}
                                                className={isSelected ? "bg-blue-50/70 dark:bg-blue-950/30" : "hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50"}
                                            >
                                                <td className="px-4 py-4">
                                                    <input
                                                        type="checkbox"
                                                        checked={isSelected}
                                                        onChange={() => toggleRow(row)}
                                                        className="h-4 w-4 accent-blue-600"
                                                        aria-label={`Select ${row.item_name}`}
                                                    />
                                                </td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-4">{row.sequence_id}</td>
                                                <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-4">
                                                    {String(row.transaction_date || "").slice(0, 10)}
                                                </td>
                                                <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-4 font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400">
                                                    {row.order_number}
                                                </td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-4 font-semibold">{row.customer_name}</td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-4">{row.warehouse_name || "â€”"}</td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-4 font-semibold">{row.item_name}</td>
                                                <td className="max-w-56 px-4 py-4">{row.item_description || "â€”"}</td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-4">{row.uom || "â€”"}</td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-4 text-right">{Number(row.item_balance || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK")}</td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-4 text-right">{Number(row.line_quantity).toLocaleString("en-PK")}</td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-4 text-right font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                                                    {Number(row.pending_quantity).toLocaleString("en-PK")}
                                                </td>
                                                <td className="px-4 py-4">
                                                    <input
                                                        type="number"
                                                        min="0"
                                                        max={row.pending_quantity}
                                                        step="0.001"
                                                        value={quantities[key] ?? ""}
                                                        onChange={(event) => updateQuantity(row, event.target.value)}
                                                        className="w-28 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-right text-sm dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900"
                                                        aria-label={`Delivery quantity for ${row.item_name}`}
                                                    />
                                                </td>
                                            </tr>
                                        );
                                    })}
                                </tbody>
                            </table>
                        </div>
                    )}

                    <footer className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                        <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                {selectedRows.length}
                            </span>{" "}
                            line(s) selected Â· Total delivery quantity{" "}
                            <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                {totalQuantity.toLocaleString("en-PK")}
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                            <Link
                                href="/dashboard/delivery-challans"
                                className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold dark:border-slate-700"
                            >
                                Back
                            </Link>
                            <button
                                disabled={saving || selectedRows.length === 0}
                                onClick={createChallan}
                                className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-emerald-600 px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-lg transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                            >
                                {saving ? "Creating Challanâ€¦" : "Create Delivery Challan"}
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </footer>
                </section>
            </div>
        </main>
    );
}

===== app\dashboard\help-support\page.js =====
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Building2,
  Headphones,
  FileText,
  CircleHelp,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  Send,
  RotateCcw,
  LoaderCircle,
  ShieldCheck,
} from "lucide-react";

const CATEGORIES = [
  { value: "password_reset", label: "Password Reset" },
  { value: "account_unlock", label: "Account Unlock" },
  { value: "company_access", label: "Company Access" },
  { value: "new_company", label: "Register Another Company" },
  { value: "technical_support", label: "Technical Support" },
  { value: "data_recovery", label: "Data Recovery" },
  { value: "license_renewal", label: "License Renewal" },
  { value: "feature_request", label: "Feature Request" },
  { value: "other", label: "Other" },
];

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-300 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10";

const labelClass =
  "mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700";

function getUniqueCompanies(companies) {
  const uniqueCompanies = new Map();

  for (const company of companies) {
    const companyId = String(company?.companyId ?? "").trim();
    const companyName = String(company?.companyName ?? "")
      .trim()
      .replace(/\s+/g, " ");

    if (!companyId || !companyName) continue;

    // Ignore capitalization and repeated spaces when checking names.
    const normalizedName = companyName.toLocaleLowerCase();

    if (!uniqueCompanies.has(normalizedName)) {
      uniqueCompanies.set(normalizedName, {
        ...company,
        companyId,
        companyName,
      });
    }
  }

  return Array.from(uniqueCompanies.values()).sort((a, b) =>
    a.companyName.localeCompare(b.companyName)
  );
}

export default function HelpSupportPage() {
  const [companies, setCompanies] = useState([]);
  const [companyId, setCompanyId] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("technical_support");
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadCompanies() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/support-requests", {
          method: "GET",
          credentials: "same-origin",
          cache: "no-store",
        });

        const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data.error || "Unable to load your companies."
          );
        }

        if (cancelled) return;

        const availableCompanies = Array.isArray(data.companies)
          ? data.companies
          : [];

        const uniqueCompanies = getUniqueCompanies(availableCompanies);

        setCompanies(uniqueCompanies);

        if (uniqueCompanies.length > 0) {
          setCompanyId(uniqueCompanies[0].companyId);
        } else {
          setCompanyId("");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setError(err.message || "Unable to load your companies.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    loadCompanies();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  async function handleSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");

    if (!companyId) {
      setError("Please select a company.");
      return;
    }

    if (!companies.some((company) => company.companyId === companyId)) {
      setError("The selected company is invalid. Please select again.");
      return;
    }

    if (!subject.trim() || !description.trim()) {
      setError("Please enter both a subject and a description.");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/support-requests", {
        method: "POST",
        credentials: "same-origin",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          companyId: Number(companyId),
          category,
          subject: subject.trim(),
          description: description.trim(),
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.error || "Unable to submit your request."
        );
      }

      const requestId = data.request?.request_id;

      setSuccess(
        requestId
          ? `Support request #${requestId} was submitted successfully.`
          : "Your support request was submitted successfully."
      );

      setSubject("");
      setDescription("");
      setCategory("technical_support");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Unable to submit your request.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  function clearForm() {
    setSubject("");
    setDescription("");
    setCategory("technical_support");
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");
  }

  const selectedCompany = companies.find(
    (company) => company.companyId === companyId
  );

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-white">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-5 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
          <Link
            href="/dashboard"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 transition hover:text-blue-700"
          >
            <ArrowLeft size={17} />
            Back to Dashboard
          </Link>

          <div className="mt-6 flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20">
              <Headphones size={28} />
            </div>

            <div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 sm:text-3xl">
                Help & Support
              </h1>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 sm:text-base">
                We&apos;re here to help you resolve your ERP issues.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_300px]">
          {/* Main form */}
          <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
            <div className="border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-6 sm:px-8">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-700">
                  <FileText size={22} />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                    Create a support request
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">
                    Describe your issue and our ERP administrator can
                    review your request.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-5 sm:p-8">
              {error && (
                <div
                  role="alert"
                  className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-800"
                >
                  <AlertCircle
                    size={19}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
