const INPUT_CLASS =
  "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 dark:placeholder:text-slate-500 dark:focus:border-indigo-400";

const LABEL_CLASS =
  "mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200";

const EMPTY_TOTALS = {
  opening_quantity: 0,
  received_quantity: 0,
  issued_quantity: 0,
  receive_amount: 0,
  issue_amount: 0,
  current_stock: 0,
};

function formatNumber(value) {
  return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 3,
  });
}

function formatAmount(value) {
  return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });
}

function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return "â€”";

  const date = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return String(value);
  }

  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function getErrorMessage(data, fallback) {
  return data?.message || data?.error || fallback;
}

function SummaryCard({
  title,
  value,
  description,
  icon: Icon,
  color = "indigo",
}) {
  const styles = {
    indigo:
      "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-300",
    emerald:
      "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300",
    rose:
      "bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-300",
    violet:
      "bg-violet-50 text-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-500/10 dark:text-violet-300",
    amber:
      "bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-300",
  };

  return (
    <div className="group rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {title}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-2 break-words text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            {value}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className={`shrink-0 rounded-xl p-3 ${styles[color] || styles.indigo}`}>
          <Icon size={21} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TransactionBadge({ type }) {
  const value = String(type || "Transaction").toLowerCase();

  const isReceive =
    value.includes("receive") ||
    value.includes("purchase") ||
    value.includes("increase") ||
    value.includes("opening");

  const isIssue =
    value.includes("issue") ||
    value.includes("sale") ||
    value.includes("decrease");

  const styles = isReceive
    ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300"
    : isIssue
      ? "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-300"
      : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300";

  const Icon = isReceive
    ? ArrowDownRight
    : isIssue
      ? ArrowUpRight
      : Activity;

  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold ${styles}`}>
      <Icon size={14} />
      {type || "Transaction"}
    </span>
  );
}

export default function ItemsLedgerPage() {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [selectedProductId, setSelectedProductId] = useState("");

  const [fromDate, setFromDate] = useState("2026-09-29");
  const [toDate, setToDate] = useState("2026-10-07");
  const [location, setLocation] = useState("");

  const [productSearch, setProductSearch] = useState("");
  const [selectedProduct, setSelectedProduct] = useState(null);
  const [ledger, setLedger] = useState([]);
  const [totals, setTotals] = useState(EMPTY_TOTALS);

  const [loadingProducts, setLoadingProducts] = useState(true);
  const [loadingLedger, setLoadingLedger] = useState(false);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [hasSearched, setHasSearched] = useState(false);

  const [transactionFilter, setTransactionFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [tableSearch, setTableSearch] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function fetchProducts() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/products", {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

        const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";

        if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) {
          throw new Error("Products API did not return JSON.");
        }

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
          throw new Error(
            getErrorMessage(data, "Failed to load products.")
          );
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setProducts(
            Array.isArray(data.products) ? data.products : []
          );
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("LOAD PRODUCTS ERROR:", err);

        if (!cancelled) {
          setError(err.message || "Failed to load products.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoadingProducts(false);
        }
      }
    }

    fetchProducts();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const loadLedger = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!selectedProductId) {
      setError("Please select an item first.");
      return;
    }

    if (fromDate && toDate && fromDate > toDate) {
      setError("From Date cannot be greater than To Date.");
      return;
    }

    setLoadingLedger(true);
    setError("");
    setHasSearched(false);
    setSelectedProduct(null);
    setLedger([]);
    setTotals(EMPTY_TOTALS);

    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();

      params.set("productId", selectedProductId);

      if (fromDate) params.set("fromDate", fromDate);
      if (toDate) params.set("toDate", toDate);
      if (location) params.set("location", location);

      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/items-ledger?${params.toString()}`,
        { cache: "no-store" }
      );

      const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";

      if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) {
        throw new Error(
          "Items Ledger API did not return JSON. Please check the API route."
        );
      }

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
        throw new Error(
          getErrorMessage(data, "Failed to load item ledger.")
        );
      }

      setSelectedProduct(data.product || null);
      setLedger(Array.isArray(data.transactions) ? data.transactions : []);

      setTotals({
        opening_quantity: Number(data.totals?.opening_quantity) || 0,
        received_quantity: Number(data.totals?.received_quantity) || 0,
        issued_quantity: Number(data.totals?.issued_quantity) || 0,
        receive_amount: Number(data.totals?.receive_amount) || 0,
        issue_amount: Number(data.totals?.issue_amount) || 0,
        current_stock: Number(data.totals?.current_stock) || 0,
      });

      setHasSearched(true);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("LOAD ITEM LEDGER ERROR:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load item ledger.");
      setSelectedProduct(null);
      setLedger([]);
      setTotals(EMPTY_TOTALS);
    } finally {
      setLoadingLedger(false);
    }
  }, [selectedProductId, fromDate, toDate, location]);

  const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => {
    const search = productSearch.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!search) return products;

    return products.filter((product) => {
      const name = String(product.product_name || "").toLowerCase();
      const sku = String(product.sku || "").toLowerCase();
      const barcode = String(product.barcode || "").toLowerCase();

      return (
        name.includes(search) ||
        sku.includes(search) ||
        barcode.includes(search)
      );
    });
  }, [products, productSearch]);

  const filteredLedger = useMemo(() => {
    const search = tableSearch.trim().toLowerCase();

    return ledger.filter((row) => {
      const type = String(row.transaction_type || "").toLowerCase();
      const number = String(row.transaction_number || "").toLowerCase();
      const memo = String(row.memo || "").toLowerCase();

      const matchesSearch =
        !search ||
        type.includes(search) ||
        number.includes(search) ||
        memo.includes(search);

      const matchesType =
        transactionFilter === "ALL" ||
        (transactionFilter === "RECEIVE" &&
          (type.includes("receive") ||
            type.includes("purchase") ||
            type.includes("increase") ||
            type.includes("opening"))) ||
        (transactionFilter === "ISSUE" &&
          (type.includes("issue") ||
            type.includes("sale") ||
            type.includes("decrease")));

      return matchesSearch && matchesType;
    });
  }, [ledger, tableSearch, transactionFilter]);

  async function refreshProducts() {
    setRefreshing(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/products", {
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";

      if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) {
        throw new Error("Products API did not return JSON.");
      }

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
        throw new Error(
          getErrorMessage(data, "Failed to refresh products.")
        );
      }

      setProducts(Array.isArray(data.products) ? data.products : []);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to refresh products.");
    } finally {
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }

  function handleProductChange(event) {
    setSelectedProductId(event.target.value);
    setSelectedProduct(null);
    setLedger([]);
    setTotals(EMPTY_TOTALS);
    setHasSearched(false);
    setError("");
  }

  function clearFilters() {
    setFromDate("");
    setToDate("");
    setLocation("");
    setProductSearch("");
    setTableSearch("");
    setTransactionFilter("ALL");
    setError("");
  }

  function exportCSV() {
    if (filteredLedger.length === 0) {
      setError("There are no ledger transactions to export.");
      return;
    }

    const columns = [
      ["Transaction Date", (row) => formatDate(row.transaction_date)],
      ["Transaction Type", (row) => row.transaction_type || ""],
      ["Transaction Number", (row) => row.transaction_number || ""],
      ["UOM", (row) => row.uom || ""],
      ["Memo", (row) => row.memo || ""],
      ["Transaction Rate", (row) => row.transaction_rate ?? 0],
      ["Old Rate", (row) => row.old_rate ?? 0],
      ["Actual Rate", (row) => row.actual_rate ?? 0],
      ["New Rate", (row) => row.new_rate ?? 0],
      ["Receive Quantity", (row) => row.receive_quantity ?? 0],
      ["Receive Rate", (row) => row.receive_rate ?? 0],
      ["Receive Amount", (row) => row.receive_amount ?? 0],
      ["Issue Quantity", (row) => row.issue_quantity ?? 0],
      ["Issue Rate", (row) => row.issue_rate ?? 0],
      ["Issue Amount", (row) => row.issue_amount ?? 0],
      ["Running Total", (row) => row.running_total ?? 0],
    ];

    const escapeCSV = (value) =>
      `"${String(value ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;

    const lines = [
      columns.map(([heading]) => escapeCSV(heading)).join(","),
      ...filteredLedger.map((row) =>
        columns.map(([, getter]) => escapeCSV(getter(row))).join(",")
      ),
    ];

    const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF" + lines.join("\r\n")], {
      type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;",
    });

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `items-ledger-${selectedProduct?.sku || selectedProductId}.csv`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  const transactionColumns = [
    {
      key: "date",
      label: "Transaction date",
      className: "whitespace-nowrap",
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
          {formatDate(row.transaction_date)}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "type",
      label: "Transaction type",
      render: (row) => <TransactionBadge type={row.transaction_type} />,
    },
    {
      key: "number",
      label: "Transaction no.",
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
          {row.transaction_number || "â€”"}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "uom",
      label: "UOM",
      render: (row) => row.uom || "â€”",
    },
    {
      key: "memo",
      label: "Memo",
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="block min-w-40 max-w-64 truncate" title={row.memo || ""}>
          {row.memo || "â€”"}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "transaction_rate",
      label: "Transaction rate",
      numeric: true,
      render: (row) => formatAmount(row.transaction_rate),
    },
    {
      key: "old_rate",
      label: "Old rate",
      numeric: true,
      render: (row) => formatAmount(row.old_rate),
    },
    {
      key: "actual_rate",
      label: "Actual rate",
      numeric: true,
      render: (row) => formatAmount(row.actual_rate),
    },
    {
      key: "new_rate",
      label: "New rate",
      numeric: true,
      render: (row) => formatAmount(row.new_rate),
    },
    {
      key: "receive_quantity",
      label: "Receive quantity",
      numeric: true,
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
          {formatNumber(row.receive_quantity)}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "receive_rate",
      label: "Receive rate",
      numeric: true,
      render: (row) => formatAmount(row.receive_rate),
    },
    {
      key: "receive_amount",
      label: "Receive amount",
      numeric: true,
      render: (row) => formatAmount(row.receive_amount),
    },
    {
      key: "issue_quantity",
      label: "Issue quantity",
      numeric: true,
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="font-semibold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
          {formatNumber(row.issue_quantity)}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "issue_rate",
      label: "Issue rate",
      numeric: true,
      render: (row) => formatAmount(row.issue_rate),
    },
    {
      key: "issue_amount",
      label: "Issue amount",
      numeric: true,
      render: (row) => formatAmount(row.issue_amount),
    },
    {
      key: "running_total",
      label: "Running total",
      numeric: true,
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
          {formatNumber(row.running_total)}
        </span>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen space-y-6 bg-slate-50/70 pb-10 dark:bg-slate-950">
      {/* Hero header */}
      <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-700 via-indigo-600 to-violet-700 px-6 py-7 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-900/10 sm:px-8 sm:py-9">
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-10 -top-24 -z-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-white/10 blur-3xl" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-32 right-1/3 -z-10 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-violet-300/20 blur-3xl" />

        <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
          <div className="max-w-2xl">
            <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-50 backdrop-blur">
              <Activity size={15} />
              INVENTORY ANALYTICS
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
              Items Ledger
            </h1>

            <p className="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-indigo-100 sm:text-base">
              Track every item movement, review stock balances, and analyze
              receiving and issuing transactions from one place.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm text-indigo-100">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <Package size={16} />
                Item transaction history
              </span>
              <span className="hidden h-1 w-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-200 sm:block" />
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <Warehouse size={16} />
                Warehouse movement
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={refreshProducts}
              disabled={refreshing || loadingProducts}
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/25 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={17} className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
              Refresh items
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={exportCSV}
              disabled={filteredLedger.length === 0}
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-indigo-700 shadow-sm transition hover:bg-indigo-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              <Download size={17} />
              Export CSV
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Alerts */}
      {error && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-4 py-4 text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/30 dark:text-rose-300"
        >
          <AlertCircle size={19} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <p className="flex-1 text-sm font-medium">{error}</p>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Dismiss error"
            onClick={() => setError("")}
            className="rounded-lg p-1 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/40"
          >
            <X size={17} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Filters */}
      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
        <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:px-7">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 p-2.5 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-300">
              <SlidersHorizontal size={21} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Ledger filters
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Select an item and date range to view its transaction history.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={clearFilters}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 self-start rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 transition hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:text-white sm:self-auto"
          >
            <X size={16} />
            Clear filters
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:p-7 xl:grid-cols-4">
          <div>
            <label className={LABEL_CLASS}>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <CalendarDays size={15} />
                From date
              </span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={fromDate}
              max={toDate || undefined}
              onChange={(event) => setFromDate(event.target.value)}
              className={INPUT_CLASS}
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className={LABEL_CLASS}>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <CalendarDays size={15} />
                To date
              </span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={toDate}
              min={fromDate || undefined}
              onChange={(event) => setToDate(event.target.value)}
              className={INPUT_CLASS}
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className={LABEL_CLASS}>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <Warehouse size={15} />
                Location
              </span>
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <select
                value={location}
                onChange={(event) => setLocation(event.target.value)}
                className={`${INPUT_CLASS} appearance-none pr-10`}
              >
                <option value="">All locations</option>
                <option value="Main Warehouse">Main Warehouse</option>
                <option value="Secondary Warehouse">Secondary Warehouse</option>
                <option value="Store">Store</option>
                <option value="Godown">Godown</option>
              </select>
              <ChevronDown
                size={16}
                className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className={LABEL_CLASS}>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <Package size={15} />
                Item
              </span>
            </label>

            <div className="relative mb-2">
              <Search
                size={16}
                className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
              />
              <input
                type="search"
                value={productSearch}
                onChange={(event) => setProductSearch(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search item or SKU..."
                className={`${INPUT_CLASS} pl-10`}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="relative">
              <select
                value={selectedProductId}
                onChange={handleProductChange}
                disabled={loadingProducts}
                className={`${INPUT_CLASS} appearance-none pr-10`}
              >
                <option value="">
                  {loadingProducts ? "Loading items..." : "Select an item"}
                </option>
                {filteredProducts.map((product) => (
                  <option
                    key={product.product_id}
                    value={product.product_id}
                  >
                    {product.sku ? `${product.sku} â€” ` : ""}
                    {product.product_name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <ChevronDown
                size={16}
                className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70 px-5 py-4 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800/30 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-7">
          <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {selectedProductId
              ? "Filters are ready. Select View ledger to load the latest results."
              : "Choose an item before loading its ledger."}
          </p>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={loadLedger}
            disabled={loadingLedger || loadingProducts || !selectedProductId}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm shadow-indigo-600/20 transition hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {loadingLedger ? (
              <>
                <LoaderCircle size={18} className="animate-spin" />
                Loading ledger...
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Filter size={17} />
                View ledger
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Selected item */}
      {selectedProduct && (
        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 sm:p-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
            <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-4">
              <div className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-violet-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/20">
                <Package size={27} />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300">
                  Selected item
                </p>
                <h2 className="mt-1 break-words text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {selectedProduct.product_name || "Unnamed product"}
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  SKU: {selectedProduct.sku || "â€”"}
                  {selectedProduct.unit ? ` Â· Unit: ${selectedProduct.unit}` : ""}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 px-5 py-4 dark:bg-emerald-500/10">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                Closing stock
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                {formatNumber(totals.current_stock)}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {/* Summary cards */}
      {selectedProduct && (
        <>
          <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            <SummaryCard
              title="Opening stock"
              value={formatNumber(totals.opening_quantity)}
              description="Quantity at the start of the period"
              icon={Layers3}
              color="indigo"
            />
            <SummaryCard
              title="Received quantity"
              value={formatNumber(totals.received_quantity)}
              description="Stock received during the period"
              icon={ArrowDownRight}
              color="emerald"
            />
            <SummaryCard
              title="Issued quantity"
              value={formatNumber(totals.issued_quantity)}
              description="Stock issued during the period"
              icon={ArrowUpRight}
              color="rose"
            />
            <SummaryCard
              title="Closing stock"
              value={formatNumber(totals.current_stock)}
              description="Closing balance from the API"
              icon={Warehouse}
              color="violet"
            />
          </section>

          <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 p-3 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  <ArrowDownRight size={21} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Total receive amount
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    {formatAmount(totals.receive_amount)}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-rose-50 p-3 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-300">
                  <ArrowUpRight size={21} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Total issue amount
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    {formatAmount(totals.issue_amount)}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>
        </>
      )}

      {/* Ledger table */}
      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
        <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:px-7">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="rounded-xl bg-violet-50 p-2.5 text-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-500/10 dark:text-violet-300">
              <FileSpreadsheet size={21} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Transaction history
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Detailed stock movement, rates, amounts, and running balance.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
              {filteredLedger.length} records
            </span>

              type="button"
              onClick={exportCSV}
              disabled={filteredLedger.length === 0}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
            >
              <Download size={15} />
              Export
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Table controls */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 p-4 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-5">
          <div className="relative w-full sm:max-w-sm">
            <Search
              size={17}
              className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"

            <input
              type="search"
              value={tableSearch}
              onChange={(event) => setTableSearch(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search transaction, number or memo..."
              className={`${INPUT_CLASS} pl-10`}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {[
              { value: "ALL", label: "All transactions" },
              { value: "RECEIVE", label: "Received" },
              { value: "ISSUE", label: "Issued" },
            ].map((option) => (
              <button
                key={option.value}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTransactionFilter(option.value)}
                className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition ${
                  transactionFilter === option.value
                    ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white"
                    : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700"
                }`}
              >
                {option.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[1900px] border-collapse text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/70">
                {transactionColumns.map((column) => (
                  <th
                    key={column.key}
                    className={`whitespace-nowrap border-b border-slate-200 px-4 py-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400 ${
                      column.numeric ? "text-right" : "text-left"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {column.label}
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
              {loadingLedger ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={transactionColumns.length} className="px-5 py-16">
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      <LoaderCircle size={30} className="animate-spin text-indigo-500" />
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium">Loading item ledger...</p>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : filteredLedger.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={transactionColumns.length} className="px-5 py-16">
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
                      <div className="mb-4 flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-500">
                        <FileSpreadsheet size={25} />
                      </div>
                      <p className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                        {hasSearched
                          ? "No transactions found"
                          : "Your ledger is ready"}
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        {hasSearched
                          ? "Try changing the date range, location, or transaction search filters."
                          : "Select an item and click View ledger to display its transaction history."}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filteredLedger.map((row, index) => (
                  <tr
                    key={
                      row.inventory_transaction_id ??
                      `${row.transaction_number || "transaction"}-${row.transaction_date || index}-${index}`
                    }
                    className="transition hover:bg-indigo-50/40 dark:hover:bg-indigo-500/5"
                  >
                    {transactionColumns.map((column) => (
                      <td
                        key={column.key}
                        className={`whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-4 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 ${
                          column.numeric ? "text-right tabular-nums" : "text-left"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {column.render(row)}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {!loadingLedger && filteredLedger.length > 0 && (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70 px-5 py-4 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800/30 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Showing {filteredLedger.length} of {ledger.length} transaction records
            </p>
            <p className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              <CheckCircle2 size={15} className="text-emerald-500" />
              Ledger data loaded from your ERP
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <p className="px-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
        Quantities, rates, amounts, and running totals are displayed using the
        values returned by your Items Ledger API.
      </p>
    </main>
  );
}

function getApiMessage(data, fallback) {
  if (data && typeof data.message === "string") {
    return data.message;
  }

  if (data && typeof data.error === "string") {
    return data.error;
  }

  return fallback;
}

async function readResponse(response) {
  const text = await response.text();

  if (!text) return {};

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(
      "The server returned an invalid response. Please check your API route."
    );
  }
}

function normalizeAccounts(data) {
  if (Array.isArray(data)) return data;
  if (Array.isArray(data?.accounts)) return data.accounts;
  return [];
}

function normalizeJournals(data) {
  if (Array.isArray(data)) return data;
  if (Array.isArray(data?.journals)) return data.journals;
  return [];
}

function money(value) {
  return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });
}

function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return "â€”";

  const dateString = String(value).substring(0, 10);
  const date = new Date(`${dateString}T00:00:00`);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return dateString;

  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-PK", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function todayString() {
  const now = new Date();
  const year = now.getFullYear();
  const month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const day = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");

  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

function isAccountSelectable(account) {
  return (
    account.is_active !== false &&
    account.is_active !== 0 &&
    account.is_group !== true &&
    account.is_group !== 1 &&
    account.is_summary !== true &&
    account.is_summary !== 1
  );
}

function statusClasses(status) {
  const normalized = String(status || "POSTED").toUpperCase();

  if (normalized === "POSTED" || normalized === "APPROVED") {
    return "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300";
  }

  if (normalized === "DRAFT" || normalized === "PENDING") {
    return "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:border-amber-900/60 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300";
  }

  if (normalized === "CANCELLED" || normalized === "VOID") {
    return "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:border-red-900/60 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300";
  }

  return "border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:border-blue-900/60 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:text-blue-300";
}

function StatusBadge({ status }) {
  const normalized = String(status || "POSTED").toUpperCase();
  const isPosted =
    normalized === "POSTED" || normalized === "APPROVED";

  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${statusClasses(
        status
      )}`}
    >
      {isPosted ? (
        <CheckCircle2 size={13} />
      ) : (
        <Clock3 size={13} />
      )}
      {normalized}
    </span>
  );
}

function SectionTitle({ icon: Icon, title, description, action }) {
  return (

        <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:text-blue-400">

              {description}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      {action}
    </div>
  );
}

function SummaryCard({
  title,
  value,
  description,
  icon: Icon,
  color = "blue",
}) {
  const colors = {
    blue: {
      icon: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:text-blue-400",
      accent: "from-blue-500 to-indigo-500",
    },
    green: {
      icon: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400",
      accent: "from-emerald-500 to-green-500",
    },
    teal: {
      icon: "bg-teal-50 text-teal-600 dark:bg-teal-950/60 dark:text-teal-400",
      accent: "from-teal-500 to-cyan-500",
    },
    violet: {
      icon: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-400",
      accent: "from-violet-500 to-purple-500",
    },
  };

  const selected = colors[color] || colors.blue;

  return (
    <div className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
      <div
        className={`absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r ${selected.accent}`}
      />

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {title}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            {value}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div
          className={`flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${selected.icon}`}
        >
          <Icon size={21} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Notice({ type = "error", message, onClose }) {
  if (!message) return null;

  const styles =
    type === "success"
      ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-200"
      : "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-800 dark:border-red-900/60 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-200";

  const Icon = type === "success" ? CheckCircle2 : CircleAlert;

  return (
    <div
      role="alert"
      className={`mb-5 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border px-4 py-3.5 ${styles}`}
    >
      <Icon size={19} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />

      <p className="flex-1 text-sm font-medium">{message}</p>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onClose}
        className="rounded-lg p-1 opacity-70 transition hover:bg-black/5 hover:opacity-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10"
        aria-label="Dismiss notification"
      >
        <X size={17} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function JournalEntriesPage() {
  const [accounts, setAccounts] = useState([]);
  const [journals, setJournals] = useState([]);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({ ...emptyForm });
  const [items, setItems] = useState([
    { ...emptyLine },
    { ...emptyLine },
  ]);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editingJournalId, setEditingJournalId] = useState(null);

  const [selectedJournal, setSelectedJournal] = useState(null);
  const [selectedJournalLines, setSelectedJournalLines] = useState([]);
  const [showPopup, setShowPopup] = useState(false);
  const [loadingDetails, setLoadingDetails] = useState(false);

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("ALL");

  // -----------------------------------------------------
  // LOAD ACCOUNTS AND JOURNAL HISTORY
  // -----------------------------------------------------

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    const [accountsResponse, journalsResponse] = await Promise.all([
      fetch("/api/accounts", { cache: "no-store" }),
      fetch("/api/journal-entries", { cache: "no-store" }),
    ]);

    const accountsData = await readResponse(accountsResponse);
    const journalsData = await readResponse(journalsResponse);

    if (!accountsResponse.ok || accountsData.success === false) {
      throw new Error(
        getApiMessage(accountsData, "Failed to load accounts.")
      );
    }

    if (!journalsResponse.ok || journalsData.success === false) {
      throw new Error(
        getApiMessage(journalsData, "Failed to load journal history.")
      );
    }

    setAccounts(normalizeAccounts(accountsData));
    setJournals(normalizeJournals(journalsData));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function initialLoad() {
      try {
        const [accountsResponse, journalsResponse] = await Promise.all([
          fetch("/api/accounts", { cache: "no-store" }),
          fetch("/api/journal-entries", { cache: "no-store" }),
        ]);

        const accountsData = await readResponse(accountsResponse);
        const journalsData = await readResponse(journalsResponse);

        if (!accountsResponse.ok || accountsData.success === false) {
          throw new Error(
            getApiMessage(accountsData, "Failed to load accounts.")
          );
        }

        if (!journalsResponse.ok || journalsData.success === false) {
          throw new Error(
            getApiMessage(journalsData, "Failed to load journal history.")
          );
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setAccounts(normalizeAccounts(accountsData));
          setJournals(normalizeJournals(journalsData));
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setError(err.message || "Unable to load accounting data.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    initialLoad();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  // -----------------------------------------------------
  // REFRESH JOURNAL HISTORY
  // -----------------------------------------------------

  async function refreshJournals() {
    setRefreshing(true);

    try {
      await loadData();
      setError("");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to refresh journal history.");
    } finally {
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------
  // ADD JOURNAL
  // -----------------------------------------------------

  function addJournal() {
    setForm({
      ...emptyForm,
      journalDate: todayString(),
    });

    setItems([
      { ...emptyLine },
      { ...emptyLine },
    ]);

    setEditingJournalId(null);
    setMessage("");
    setError("");
    setShowForm(true);
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------
  // CANCEL FORM
  // -----------------------------------------------------

  function cancelForm() {
    if (saving) return;

    setForm({ ...emptyForm });
    setItems([
      { ...emptyLine },
      { ...emptyLine },
    ]);

    setEditingJournalId(null);
    setShowForm(false);
    setError("");
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------
  // UPDATE FORM FIELDS
  // -----------------------------------------------------

  function updateForm(field, value) {
    setForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [field]: value,
    }));
  }

  function updateItem(index, field, value) {
    setItems((current) =>
      current.map((item, itemIndex) => {
        if (itemIndex !== index) return item;

        const updated = { ...item, [field]: value };

        // Debit and credit cannot both have a positive amount.
        if (field === "debit" && Number(value) > 0) {
          updated.credit = "";
        }

        if (field === "credit" && Number(value) > 0) {
          updated.debit = "";
        }

        return updated;
      })
    );
  }

  function addLine() {
    setItems((current) => [
      ...current,
      { ...emptyLine },
    ]);
  }

  function removeLine(index) {
    setItems((current) => {
      if (current.length <= 2) return current;

      return current.filter((_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index);
    });
  }

  function resetForm() {
    setForm({ ...emptyForm });
    setItems([
      { ...emptyLine },
      { ...emptyLine },
    ]);

    setEditingJournalId(null);
    setShowForm(false);
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------
  // TOTALS AND BALANCE VALIDATION
  // -----------------------------------------------------

  const totalDebit = useMemo(
    () =>
      items.reduce(
        (sum, item) => sum + (Number(item.debit) || 0),
        0
      ),
    [items]
  );

  const totalCredit = useMemo(
    () =>
      items.reduce(
        (sum, item) => sum + (Number(item.credit) || 0),
        0
      ),
    [items]
  );

  const difference = Math.abs(totalDebit - totalCredit);
  const balanced = difference < 0.01;

  const selectableAccounts = useMemo(
    () => accounts.filter(isAccountSelectable),
    [accounts]
  );

  const totalJournalDebit = useMemo(
    () =>
      journals.reduce(
        (sum, journal) => sum + (Number(journal.total_debit) || 0),
        0
      ),
    [journals]
  );

  const totalJournalCredit = useMemo(
    () =>
      journals.reduce(
        (sum, journal) => sum + (Number(journal.total_credit) || 0),
        0
      ),
    [journals]
  );

  const filteredJournals = useMemo(() => {
    const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    return journals.filter((journal) => {
      const matchesSearch =
        !query ||
        String(journal.journal_number || "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(query) ||
        String(journal.description || "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(query) ||
        String(journal.journal_date || "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(query) ||
        String(journal.journal_id || "")
          .includes(query);

      const status = String(journal.status || "POSTED").toUpperCase();

      const matchesStatus =
        statusFilter === "ALL" || status === statusFilter;

      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
    });
  }, [journals, search, statusFilter]);

  const postedCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      journals.filter((journal) => {
        const status = String(journal.status || "POSTED").toUpperCase();
        return status === "POSTED" || status === "APPROVED";
      }).length,
    [journals]
  );

  // -----------------------------------------------------
  // SAVE OR UPDATE JOURNAL
  // -----------------------------------------------------

  async function saveJournal(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    setSaving(true);
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    try {
      if (items.length < 2) {
        throw new Error("A journal must contain at least two lines.");
      }

      if (!form.journalDate) {
        throw new Error("Please select the journal date.");
      }

      if (selectableAccounts.length === 0) {
        throw new Error(
          "No active posting accounts were found. Please check your Chart of Accounts."
        );
      }

      const validItems = items.every((item) => {
        const debit = Number(item.debit) || 0;
        const credit = Number(item.credit) || 0;

        return (
          Boolean(item.accountId) &&
          (debit > 0 || credit > 0) &&
          !(debit > 0 && credit > 0) &&
          debit >= 0 &&
          credit >= 0
        );
      });

      if (!validItems) {
        throw new Error(
          "Every journal line needs an account and a positive debit or credit amount. A line cannot have both."
        );
      }

      if (!balanced) {
        throw new Error(
          "Total debit and total credit must be equal before posting."
        );
      }

      const method = editingJournalId ? "PUT" : "POST";

      const body = {
        ...form,
        items: items.map((item) => ({
          ...item,
          accountId: String(item.accountId),
          debit: Number(item.debit) || 0,
          credit: Number(item.credit) || 0,
        })),
      };

      if (editingJournalId) {
        body.journalId = editingJournalId;
      }

      const response = await fetch("/api/journal-entries", {
        method,
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });

      const data = await readResponse(response);

      if (!response.ok || data.success === false || !data.success) {
        throw new Error(
          getApiMessage(data, "Failed to save journal entry.")
        );
      }

      const wasEditing = Boolean(editingJournalId);

      resetForm();

      await loadData();

      setMessage(
        wasEditing
          ? "Journal entry updated successfully."
          : "Journal entry posted successfully."
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save journal entry.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------
  // FETCH JOURNAL DETAILS
  // -----------------------------------------------------

  async function fetchJournalDetails(journalId) {
    const response = await fetch(
      `/api/journal-entries?id=${encodeURIComponent(journalId)}`,
      { cache: "no-store" }
    );

    const data = await readResponse(response);

    if (!response.ok || data.success === false || !data.success) {
      throw new Error(
        getApiMessage(data, "Failed to load journal details.")
      );
    }

    if (!data.journal) {
      throw new Error("The requested journal entry was not found.");
    }

    return data;
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------
  // VIEW JOURNAL
  // -----------------------------------------------------

  async function viewJournal(journalId) {
    setLoadingDetails(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const data = await fetchJournalDetails(journalId);

      setSelectedJournal(data.journal);
      setSelectedJournalLines(
        Array.isArray(data.lines) ? data.lines : []
      );
      setShowPopup(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load journal details.");
    } finally {
      setLoadingDetails(false);
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------
  // EDIT JOURNAL
  // -----------------------------------------------------

  async function editJournal(journalId) {
    setLoadingDetails(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const data = await fetchJournalDetails(journalId);
      const journal = data.journal;
      const lines = Array.isArray(data.lines) ? data.lines : [];

      setForm({
        journalNumber: journal.journal_number || "",
        journalDate: journal.journal_date
          ? String(journal.journal_date).substring(0, 10)
          : todayString(),
        description: journal.description || "",
      });

      setItems(
        lines.length >= 2
          ? lines.map((line) => ({
              entityName: line.entity_name || "",
              accountId: String(line.account_id ?? ""),
              description: line.description || "",
              debit:
                Number(line.debit) > 0
                  ? String(line.debit)
                  : "",
              credit:
                Number(line.credit) > 0
                  ? String(line.credit)
                  : "",
            }))
          : [
              { ...emptyLine },
              { ...emptyLine },
            ]
      );

      setEditingJournalId(journal.journal_id);
      setShowPopup(false);
      setShowForm(true);

      window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: "smooth",
      });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to edit journal.");
    } finally {
      setLoadingDetails(false);
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------
  // CLOSE VOUCHER
  // -----------------------------------------------------

  function closePopup() {
    setShowPopup(false);
    setSelectedJournal(null);
    setSelectedJournalLines([]);
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------
  // PRINT JOURNAL VOUCHER
  // -----------------------------------------------------

  function printJournal() {
    if (!selectedJournal) return;

    const journal = selectedJournal;
    const lines = selectedJournalLines;

    const escapeHtml = (value) =>
      String(value ?? "")
        .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
        .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
        .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
        .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
        .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");

    const rows = lines
      .map(
        (line) => `
          <tr>
            <td>${escapeHtml(line.entity_name || "-")}</td>
            <td>
              <strong>${escapeHtml(line.account_code || "")}</strong><br />
              ${escapeHtml(line.account_name || "")}
            </td>
            <td>${escapeHtml(line.description || "-")}</td>
            <td class="number">${money(line.debit)}</td>
            <td class="number">${money(line.credit)}</td>
          </tr>
        `
      )
      .join("");

    const printWindow = window.open(
      "",
      "_blank",
      "width=1000,height=800"
    );

    if (!printWindow) {
      setError(
        "The print window was blocked. Please allow popups for this site."
      );
      return;
    }

    printWindow.document.write(`
      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html>
      <head>
        <meta charset="UTF-8" />
        <title>Journal Voucher - ${escapeHtml(
          journal.journal_number || journal.journal_id
        )}</title>
        <style>
          * { box-sizing: border-box; }
          body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 30px;
            font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
            color: #0f172a;
            background: #ffffff;
          }
          .document { max-width: 1000px; margin: auto; }
          .top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
            border-bottom: 3px solid #2563eb;
            padding-bottom: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
          }
          .company { font-size: 25px; font-weight: 800; color: #1d4ed8; }
          .subtitle { margin-top: 5px; font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; }
          .title { text-align: right; }
          .title h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 24px; }
          .title p { margin-bottom: 0; color: #64748b; }
          .info {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
          }
          .info-box {
            border: 1px solid #dbe3ee;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 13px;
          }
          .label {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: #64748b;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-bottom: 7px;
          }
          .value { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
          table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
          th {
            background: #eff6ff;
            color: #1e40af;
            border: 1px solid #dbe3ee;
            padding: 11px;
            text-align: left;
            font-size: 11px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
          }
          td {
            border: 1px solid #dbe3ee;
            padding: 11px;
            font-size: 12px;
            vertical-align: top;
          }
          .number { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
          .total td { font-weight: 800; background: #f8fafc; }
          .footer {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-top: 30px;
            border-top: 1px solid #dbe3ee;
            padding-top: 13px;
            color: #64748b;
            font-size: 10px;
          }
          @media print {
            body { padding: 8px; }
            .document { max-width: none; }
          }
        </style>
      </head>
      <body>
        <div class="document">
          <div class="top">
            <div>
              <div class="company">ERP SOFTWARE</div>
              <div class="subtitle">Accounting &amp; Financial Management</div>
            </div>
            <div class="title">
              <h1>Journal Voucher</h1>
              <p>${escapeHtml(
                journal.journal_number || `JV-${journal.journal_id}`
              )}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="info">
            <div class="info-box">
              <div class="label">Journal Number</div>
              <div class="value">${escapeHtml(
                journal.journal_number || `JV-${journal.journal_id}`
              )}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="info-box">
              <div class="label">Journal Date</div>
              <div class="value">${escapeHtml(
                String(journal.journal_date || "").substring(0, 10)
              )}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="info-box">
              <div class="label">Description</div>
              <div class="value">${escapeHtml(
                journal.description || "-"
              )}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="info-box">
              <div class="label">Status</div>
              <div class="value">${escapeHtml(
                journal.status || "POSTED"
              )}</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Entity Name</th>
                <th>Account</th>
                <th>Description</th>
                <th class="number">Debit</th>
                <th class="number">Credit</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
            <tfoot>
              <tr class="total">
                <td colspan="3" style="text-align:right">TOTAL</td>
                <td class="number">${money(journal.total_debit)}</td>
                <td class="number">${money(journal.total_credit)}</td>
              </tr>
            </tfoot>
          </table>

          <div class="footer">
            <span>Generated from ERP Software</span>
            <span>Journal Voucher</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </body>
      </html>
    `);

    printWindow.document.close();
    printWindow.focus();

    printWindow.onload = () => {
      printWindow.print();
    };
  }

  // The browser print dialog provides "Save as PDF".
  function downloadPDF() {
    printJournal();

                                  type="number"

                                  min="0"

                                    )
                                  }

                              </div>

              {/* BALANCE SUMMARY */}
              <section
                className={`rounded-2xl border p-5 transition ${
                  balanced
                    ? "border-emerald-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-50 to-green-50 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:from-emerald-950/30 dark:to-green-950/20"

              >
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                    <div
                      className={`flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${
                        balanced
                          ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/60 dark:text-emerald-300"
                          : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/60 dark:text-amber-300"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {balanced ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 size={23} />
                      ) : (
                        <CircleAlert size={23} />
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <h3
                        className={`text-base font-extrabold ${
                          balanced
                            ? "text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200"
                            : "text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {balanced
                          ? "Journal is balanced"
                          : "Journal needs balancing"}
                      </h3>

                      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                        {balanced
                          ? "Total debits match total credits. You can continue to post this journal."
                          : "Adjust your debit or credit entries until the difference reaches zero."}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:min-w-[540px]">
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/80 bg-white/80 p-3 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900/70">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">

                        Difference

                                </p>

                                {line.description || "â€”"}

                              <td className="px-4 py-4 text-right text-sm font-semibold tabular-nums text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                                {money(line.debit)}

                              <td className="px-4 py-4 text-right text-sm font-semibold tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                                {money(line.credit)}

        {/* LOADING JOURNAL DETAILS */}
        {loadingDetails && (
          <div className="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-[60] flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-5 py-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-2xl">
            <LoaderCircle size={19} className="animate-spin text-blue-400" />
            Loading journal...
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function ItemsLedgerPage() {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [ledger, setLedger] = useState([]);

  const [productId, setProductId] = useState("");
  const [fromDate, setFromDate] = useState("");
  const [toDate, setToDate] = useState("");
  const [location, setLocation] = useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [productsLoading, setProductsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadProducts() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/products");
        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data.message || "Failed to load products."
          );
        }

        setProducts(data.products || []);
      } catch (error) {
        setError(error.message);
      } finally {
        setProductsLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadProducts();
  }, []);

  async function loadLedger() {
    if (!productId) {
      setLedger([]);
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();

      params.set("productId", productId);

      if (fromDate) {
        params.set("fromDate", fromDate);
      }

      if (toDate) {
        params.set("toDate", toDate);
      }

      if (location) {
        params.set("location", location);
      }

      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/items-ledger?${params.toString()}`
      );

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.message || "Failed to load item ledger."
        );
      }

      setLedger(data.ledger || []);
    } catch (error) {
      setError(error.message);
      setLedger([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function formatNumber(value) {
    return Number(value || 0).toFixed(2);
  }

  const selectedProduct = products.find(
    (product) =>
      String(product.product_id) === String(productId)
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">

      {/* HEADER */}
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900">
          Items Ledger
        </h1>

        <p className="text-slate-500 mt-1">
          View item-wise stock transactions, rates and running quantity.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* ERROR */}
      {error && (
        <div className="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* FILTERS */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5">

          {/* FROM DATE */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              From Date
            </label>

            <input
              type="date"
              value={fromDate}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setFromDate(e.target.value)
              }
              className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2.5 text-sm"
            />
          </div>

          {/* TO DATE */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              To Date
            </label>

            <input
              type="date"
              value={toDate}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setToDate(e.target.value)
              }
              className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2.5 text-sm"
            />
          </div>

          {/* LOCATION */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Location
            </label>

            <select
              value={location}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setLocation(e.target.value)
              }
              className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2.5 text-sm bg-white"
            >
              <option value="">
                All Locations
              </option>

              <option value="Main Warehouse">
                Main Warehouse
              </option>

              <option value="Store">
                Store
              </option>

              <option value="Godown">
                Godown
              </option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* ITEMS */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
              Items
            </label>

            <select
              value={productId}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setProductId(e.target.value)
              }
              disabled={productsLoading}
              className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2.5 text-sm bg-white"
            >
              <option value="">
                {productsLoading
                  ? "Loading Items..."
                  : "Select Item"}
              </option>

              {products.map((product) => (
                <option
                  key={product.product_id}
                  value={product.product_id}
                >
                  {product.sku} - {product.product_name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

        </div>

        {/* BUTTON */}
        <div className="mt-5 flex justify-end">

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={loadLedger}
            disabled={!productId || loading}
            className="bg-slate-900 text-white px-6 py-2.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {loading
              ? "Loading..."
              : "View Ledger"}
          </button>

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* SELECTED ITEM */}
      {selectedProduct && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5">

          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:justify-between gap-4">

            <div>
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
                Item
              </p>

              <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-slate-900">
                {selectedProduct.product_name}
              </h2>

              <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
                {selectedProduct.sku}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="text-left md:text-right">
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
                Unit
              </p>

              <p className="font-semibold">
                {selectedProduct.unit || "PCS"}
              </p>
            </div>

          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* LEDGER TABLE */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden">

        <div className="px-6 py-5 border-b bg-slate-50">

          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-slate-900">
            Items Ledger
          </h2>

          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Stock movement and item rate history.
          </p>

        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">

          <table className="min-w-[1800px] w-full text-sm">

            <thead className="bg-slate-100">

              <tr>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left whitespace-nowrap">
                  Trandate
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left whitespace-nowrap">
                  Transaction Type
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left whitespace-nowrap">
                  Transaction Number
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                  UOM
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                  Memo
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  Transaction Rate
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  Old Rate
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  Actual Rate
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  New Rate
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  Receive Quantity
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  Receive Rate
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  Receive Amount
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  Issue Quantity
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  Issue Rate
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  Issue Amount
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  Running Total
                </th>

              </tr>

            </thead>

            <tbody>

              {ledger.map((row, index) => (

                <tr
                  key={
                    row.item_ledger_id ||
                    row.transaction_id ||
                    index
                  }
                  className="border-t hover:bg-slate-50"
                >

                  <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {row.trandate || "-"}

                    {row.transaction_type || "-"}
                  </td>

                  <td className="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {row.transaction_number || "-"}
                  </td>

                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    {row.uom || selectedProduct?.unit || "-"}
                  </td>

                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    {row.memo || "-"}

                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    {formatNumber(row.transaction_rate)}

                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">

                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">

          </table>

        </div>

              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Total Received
                </p>

                <p className="font-semibold">
                  {formatNumber(
                    ledger.reduce(
                      (total, row) =>
                        total +
                        Number(
                          row.receive_quantity || 0
                        ),
                      0
                    )
                  )}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Total Issued
                </p>

                <p className="font-semibold">
                  {formatNumber(
                    ledger.reduce(
                      (total, row) =>
                        total +
                        Number(
                          row.issue_quantity || 0
                        ),
                      0
                    )
                  )}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Transactions
                </p>

                <p className="font-semibold">
                  {ledger.length}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Current Stock
                </p>

                <p className="font-semibold">
                  {formatNumber(
                    ledger[ledger.length - 1]
                      ?.running_total
                  )}
                </p>
              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

        )}

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
