const formatCurrency = (value) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(Number(value) || 0);

const formatNumber = (value) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(Number(value) || 0);

const getPayable = (supplier) =>
  Math.max(Number(supplier.payable) || 0, 0);

const cardClass =
  "rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md dark:border-slate-700/80 dark:bg-slate-900";

const buttonClass =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 shadow-sm transition hover:border-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 dark:hover:border-blue-500/50 dark:hover:bg-blue-500/10 dark:hover:text-blue-300";

/* Keep this component outside PayablePage to satisfy ESLint. */
function SortableHeader({
  field,
  children,
  align = "left",
  sortBy,
  sortDirection,
  onSort,
}) {
  const alignmentClass =
    align === "right" ? "text-right" : "text-left";

  return (
    <th
      scope="col"
      className={`whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 ${alignmentClass} text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400`}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onSort(field)}
        aria-label={`Sort by ${String(children)}`}
        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 transition hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 ${
          align === "right" ? "ml-auto" : ""
        }`}
      >
        {children}
        <ArrowDownUp
          size={13}
          className={
            sortBy === field
              ? "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"
              : "text-slate-400"
          }
        />
        {sortBy === field && (
          <span className="sr-only">
            {sortDirection === "asc"
              ? "Sorted ascending"
              : "Sorted descending"}
          </span>
        )}
      </button>
    </th>
  );
}

export default function PayablePage() {
  const [payables, setPayables] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState("payable");
  const [sortDirection, setSortDirection] = useState("desc");

  const loadPayables = useCallback(async (showRefresh = false) => {
    if (showRefresh) {
      setRefreshing(true);
    } else {
      setLoading(true);
    }

    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/payable", {
        method: "GET",
        headers: {
          Accept: "application/json",
        },
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.message || "Failed to load supplier payables."
        );
      }

      setPayables(
        Array.isArray(data.payables) ? data.payables : []
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Something went wrong while loading payables."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
  let cancelled = false;

  async function fetchPayables() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/payable", {
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data?.error || "Failed to load payables.");
      }

      if (!cancelled) {
        setPayables(Array.isArray(data) ? data : data?.payables ?? []);
        setError("");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (!cancelled) {
        setError(err.message || "Failed to load payables.");
      }
    } finally {
      if (!cancelled) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }

  fetchPayables();

  return () => {
    cancelled = true;
  };
}, []);

  const totals = useMemo(
    () =>
      payables.reduce(
        (result, supplier) => {
          const opening = Number(supplier.opening_balance) || 0;
          const purchases = Number(supplier.total_purchases) || 0;
          const paid = Number(supplier.total_paid) || 0;
          const payable = getPayable(supplier);

          result.opening += opening;
          result.purchases += purchases;
          result.paid += paid;
          result.payable += payable;

          if (payable > 0) {
            result.outstandingSuppliers += 1;
          } else {
            result.settledSuppliers += 1;
          }

          return result;
        },
        {
          opening: 0,
          purchases: 0,
          paid: 0,
          payable: 0,
          outstandingSuppliers: 0,
          settledSuppliers: 0,
        }
      ),
    [payables]
  );

  const filteredPayables = useMemo(() => {
    const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    const filtered = payables.filter((supplier) => {
      if (!query) return true;

      return [
        supplier.supplier_code,
        supplier.supplier_name,
        supplier.supplier_id,
      ].some((value) =>
        String(value ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(query)
      );
    });

    return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
      if (
        sortBy === "supplier_name" ||
        sortBy === "supplier_code"
      ) {
        const first = String(a[sortBy] ?? "").toLowerCase();
        const second = String(b[sortBy] ?? "").toLowerCase();

        return sortDirection === "asc"
          ? first.localeCompare(second)
          : second.localeCompare(first);
      }

      const first = Number(a[sortBy]) || 0;
      const second = Number(b[sortBy]) || 0;

      return sortDirection === "asc"
        ? first - second
        : second - first;
    });
  }, [payables, search, sortBy, sortDirection]);

  const handleSort = useCallback(
    (field) => {
      if (sortBy === field) {
        setSortDirection((current) =>
          current === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc"
        );
      } else {
        setSortBy(field);
        setSortDirection(
          field === "supplier_name" || field === "supplier_code"
            ? "asc"
            : "desc"
        );
      }
    },
    [sortBy]
  );

  const exportCSV = useCallback(() => {
    const headers = [
      "Supplier Code",
      "Supplier",
      "Opening Balance",
      "Purchases",
      "Paid",
      "Payable",
    ];

    const rows = filteredPayables.map((supplier) => [
      supplier.supplier_code ?? "",
      supplier.supplier_name ?? "",
      Number(supplier.opening_balance) || 0,
      Number(supplier.total_purchases) || 0,
      Number(supplier.total_paid) || 0,
      Number(supplier.payable) || 0,
    ]);

    const escapeCSV = (value) => {
      const text = String(value ?? "");
      return `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
    };

    const csv = [headers, ...rows]
      .map((row) => row.map(escapeCSV).join(","))
      .join("\r\n");

    const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF" + csv], {
      type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;",
    });

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");

    link.href = url;
    link.download = `supplier-payables-${new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .slice(0, 10)}.csv`;

    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, [filteredPayables]);

  const filteredTotals = useMemo(
    () =>
      filteredPayables.reduce(
        (result, supplier) => {
          result.opening += Number(supplier.opening_balance) || 0;
          result.purchases += Number(supplier.total_purchases) || 0;
          result.paid += Number(supplier.total_paid) || 0;
          result.payable += Number(supplier.payable) || 0;
          return result;
        },
        { opening: 0, purchases: 0, paid: 0, payable: 0 }
      ),
    [filteredPayables]
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-[70vh] bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-950 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-6">
          <div className="h-36 animate-pulse rounded-3xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800" />

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((item) => (
              <div
                key={item}
                className="h-32 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800"
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="h-72 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800" />

          <p className="text-center text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Loading supplier payable balances...
          </p>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50/80 p-4 text-slate-800 transition-colors duration-200 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-6">
        {/* Page header */}
        <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-700 via-blue-600 to-emerald-600 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-blue-900/10 sm:p-8">
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-16 -top-24 -z-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-white/10 blur-3xl" />
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-28 right-1/4 -z-10 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-emerald-300/20 blur-3xl" />

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
            <div>
              <div className="mb-3 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-50 backdrop-blur-sm">
                <Activity size={14} />
                ACCOUNTS PAYABLE
              </div>

              <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
                Supplier Payables
              </h1>

              <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-blue-50 sm:text-base">
                Monitor outstanding supplier balances, review purchases,
                and track payments from one clear dashboard.
              </p>

              <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs font-medium text-white/90 sm:text-sm">
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 px-3 py-2">
                  <Building2 size={15} />
                  Supplier account overview
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 px-3 py-2">
                  <CheckCircle2 size={15} />
                  Live API data
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => loadPayables(true)}
                disabled={refreshing}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/25 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white backdrop-blur-sm transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <RefreshCw
                  size={17}
                  className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
                />
                {refreshing ? "Refreshing..." : "Refresh"}
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={exportCSV}
                disabled={filteredPayables.length === 0}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-blue-700 shadow-sm transition hover:bg-blue-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <ArrowDownToLine size={17} />
                Export CSV
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Error notification */}
        {error && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800 dark:border-red-900/60 dark:bg-red-950/30 dark:text-red-300 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between"
          >
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" size={20} />
              <div>
                <p className="font-bold">Unable to load payables</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm">{error}</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => loadPayables()}
              className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 self-start rounded-lg border border-red-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition hover:bg-red-100 dark:border-red-800 dark:hover:bg-red-900/40"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={14} />
              Try again
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Summary cards */}
        <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          <div className={cardClass}>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Total Payable
                </p>
                <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
                  {formatCurrency(totals.payable)}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400">
                  <Wallet size={14} />
                  Outstanding supplier balance
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 p-3 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400">
                <Banknote size={24} />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-5 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">
              <div className="h-full w-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-blue-400" />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className={cardClass}>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Total Purchases
                </p>
                <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
                  {formatCurrency(totals.purchases)}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                  <TrendingUp size={14} />
                  Recorded supplier purchases
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 p-3 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400">
                <FileSpreadsheet size={24} />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-5 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">
              <div className="h-full w-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-green-400" />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className={cardClass}>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Total Paid
                </p>
                <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
                  {formatCurrency(totals.paid)}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                  <CheckCircle2 size={14} />
                  Payments recorded
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="rounded-2xl bg-green-50 p-3 text-green-600 dark:bg-green-500/10 dark:text-green-400">
                <CheckCircle2 size={24} />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-5 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">
              <div
                className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-green-600 to-emerald-400"
                style={{
                  width: `${
                    totals.purchases > 0
                      ? Math.min(
                          100,
                          (totals.paid / totals.purchases) * 100
                        )
                      : 0
                  }%`,
                }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className={cardClass}>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Outstanding Suppliers
                </p>
                <p className="mt-3 text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {totals.outstandingSuppliers}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                  <Clock3 size={14} />
                  Suppliers with a balance due
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 p-3 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400">
                <Users size={24} />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              <span>{totals.settledSuppliers} settled</span>
              <span>{payables.length} total suppliers</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Secondary overview */}
        <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-5 dark:border-slate-700/80 dark:bg-slate-900">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-100 p-2.5 text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                <Banknote size={20} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Opening Balance
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {formatCurrency(totals.opening)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-5 dark:border-slate-700/80 dark:bg-slate-900">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-blue-50 p-2.5 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400">
                <Building2 size={20} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Suppliers Listed
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {payables.length}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-5 dark:border-slate-700/80 dark:bg-slate-900">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 p-2.5 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400">
                <CheckCircle2 size={20} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Settled Suppliers
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {totals.settledSuppliers}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Supplier table */}
        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-700/80 dark:bg-slate-900">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-700 sm:p-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
            <div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Supplier Ledger
                </h2>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-blue-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-300">
                  {filteredPayables.length} records
                </span>
              </div>

              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Review opening balances, purchases, payments, and amounts due.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row lg:w-auto">
              <div className="relative min-w-0 flex-1 sm:min-w-[280px]">
                <Search
                  size={18}
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                />
                <input
                  type="search"
                  value={search}
                  onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search supplier or code..."
                  aria-label="Search suppliers"
                  className={inputClass}
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={exportCSV}
                disabled={filteredPayables.length === 0}
                className={buttonClass}
              >
                <ArrowDownToLine size={16} />
                Export
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {filteredPayables.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex min-h-[300px] flex-col items-center justify-center px-5 py-12 text-center">
              <div className="mb-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 p-4 dark:bg-slate-800">
                {search ? (
                  <Search
                    size={30}
                    className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <Building2
                    size={30}
                    className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500"
                  />
                )}
              </div>

              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                {search ? "No matching suppliers" : "No payable records"}
              </h3>

              <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {search
                  ? "Try a different supplier name, code, or ID."
                  : "Supplier payable information will appear here when records are available."}
              </p>

              {search && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSearch("")}
                  className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700"
                >
                  Clear search
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full min-w-[950px] border-collapse text-sm">
                  <thead className="bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-slate-800/60">
                    <tr>
                      <SortableHeader
                        field="supplier_code"
                        sortBy={sortBy}
                        sortDirection={sortDirection}
                        onSort={handleSort}
                      >
                        Supplier Code
                      </SortableHeader>

                      <SortableHeader
                        field="supplier_name"
                        sortBy={sortBy}
                        sortDirection={sortDirection}
                        onSort={handleSort}
                      >
                        Supplier
                      </SortableHeader>

                      <SortableHeader
                        field="opening_balance"
                        align="right"
                        sortBy={sortBy}
                        sortDirection={sortDirection}
                        onSort={handleSort}
                      >
                        Opening
                      </SortableHeader>

                      <SortableHeader
                        field="total_purchases"
                        align="right"
                        sortBy={sortBy}
                        sortDirection={sortDirection}
                        onSort={handleSort}
                      >
                        Purchases
                      </SortableHeader>

                      <SortableHeader
                        field="total_paid"
                        align="right"
                        sortBy={sortBy}
                        sortDirection={sortDirection}
                        onSort={handleSort}
                      >
                        Paid
                      </SortableHeader>

                      <SortableHeader
                        field="payable"
                        align="right"
                        sortBy={sortBy}
                        sortDirection={sortDirection}
                        onSort={handleSort}
                      >
                        Payable
                      </SortableHeader>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                    {filteredPayables.map((supplier, index) => {
                      const outstanding = getPayable(supplier) > 0;

                      return (
                        <tr
                          key={
                            supplier.supplier_id ??
                            `${supplier.supplier_code}-${index}`
                          }
                          className="group transition-colors hover:bg-blue-50/50 dark:hover:bg-blue-500/[0.04]"
                        >
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4">
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                              {supplier.supplier_code || "â€”"}
                            </span>
                          </td>

                          <td className="px-5 py-4">
                            <div className="flex min-w-[190px] items-center gap-3">
                              <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-100 to-emerald-100 text-sm font-extrabold text-blue-700 dark:from-blue-500/20 dark:to-emerald-500/20 dark:text-blue-300">
                                {String(supplier.supplier_name || "S")
                                  .trim()
                                  .charAt(0)
                                  .toUpperCase()}
                              </div>

                              <div className="min-w-0">
                                <p className="truncate font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                                  {supplier.supplier_name || "Unnamed supplier"}
                                </p>
                                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                  ID: {supplier.supplier_id ?? "â€”"}
                                </p>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </td>

                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {formatNumber(supplier.opening_balance)}
                          </td>

                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-medium tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                            {formatNumber(supplier.total_purchases)}
                          </td>

                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-medium tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                            {formatNumber(supplier.total_paid)}
                          </td>

                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right">
                            <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1.5">
                              <span
                                className={`font-extrabold tabular-nums ${
                                  outstanding
                                    ? "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300"
                                    : "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
                                }`}
                              >
                                {formatNumber(supplier.payable)}
                              </span>

                              <span
                                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide ${
                                  outstanding
                                    ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-300"
                                    : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300"
                                }`}
                              >
                                {outstanding ? (
                                  <Clock3 size={11} />
                                ) : (
                                  <CheckCircle2 size={11} />
                                )}
                                {outstanding ? "Due" : "Settled"}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>

                  <tfoot className="border-t-2 border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/90 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800/70">
                    <tr>
                      <td
                        colSpan={2}
                        className="px-5 py-4 font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                      >
                        Total ({filteredPayables.length} suppliers)
                      </td>

                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                        {formatNumber(filteredTotals.opening)}
                      </td>

                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                        {formatNumber(filteredTotals.purchases)}
                      </td>

                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        {formatNumber(filteredTotals.paid)}
                      </td>

                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-extrabold tabular-nums text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                        {formatNumber(filteredTotals.payable)}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  </tfoot>
                </table>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-slate-200 px-5 py-4 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                <p>
                  Showing{" "}
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                    {filteredPayables.length}
                  </span>{" "}
                  of{" "}
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                    {payables.length}
                  </span>{" "}
                  supplier records
                </p>

                <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                  Amounts displayed in PKR
                </p>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </section>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 px-1 pb-3 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <p>Accounts Payable Â· Supplier Balance Overview</p>

          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Activity size={13} />
            Balance information retrieved from your ERP API
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

function todayLocal() {
    const date = new Date();

    return `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(
        2,
        "0"
    )}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function rowsFrom(data, key) {
    return Array.isArray(data) ? data : data?.[key] || [];
}

function cartKey(item) {
    return `${item.product_id}:${item.sub_product_id ?? "main"}`;
}

function formatDate(value) {
    if (!value) return "â€”";

    const date = new Date(value);

    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
        ? String(value)
        : date.toLocaleDateString("en-PK", {
              day: "2-digit",
              month: "short",
              year: "numeric",
          });
}

function formatDateTime(value) {
    if (!value) return "â€”";

    const date = new Date(value);

    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
        ? String(value)
        : date.toLocaleString("en-PK", {
              dateStyle: "medium",
              timeStyle: "short",
          });
}

function Modal({ children, onClose, className = "", zIndex = "z-50" }) {
    useEffect(() => {
        function handleKeyDown(event) {
            if (event.key === "Escape") onClose?.();
        }

        window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);

        return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    }, [onClose]);

    return (
        <div
            className={`fixed inset-0 ${zIndex} flex items-center justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-slate-950/60 p-3 backdrop-blur-sm sm:p-6`}
            onMouseDown={(event) => {
                if (event.target === event.currentTarget) onClose?.();
            }}
        >
            <div
                className={`my-auto w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white shadow-2xl ${className}`}
            >
                {children}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function ModalHeader({
    icon: Icon,
    title,
    subtitle,
    onClose,
    accent = "indigo",
}) {
    const colors = {
        indigo: "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600",
        emerald: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600",
        rose: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-600",
        violet: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-600",
        slate: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600",
    };

    return (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-4 sm:px-6">
            <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
                <div
                    className={`flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${
                        colors[accent] || colors.indigo
                    }`}
                >
                    {Icon && <Icon size={21} />}
                </div>

                <div className="min-w-0">
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                        {title}
                    </h2>
                    {subtitle && (
                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500 sm:text-sm">
                            {subtitle}
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>
            </div>

            <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-slate-400 transition hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-700"
                aria-label="Close dialog"
            >
                <X size={19} />
            </button>
        </div>
    );
}

function SummaryCard({ icon: Icon, label, value, detail, color }) {
    const themes = {
        indigo: "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600",
        emerald: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600",
        violet: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-600",
        amber: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-600",
    };

    return (
        <div className={`${panelClass} group p-4 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md sm:p-5`}>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                        {label}
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                        {value}
                    </p>
                    {detail && (
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{detail}</p>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div
                    className={`flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${
                        themes[color] || themes.indigo
                    }`}
                >
                    {Icon && <Icon size={21} />}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

    );
}

    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;

        async function loadData() {
            try {
                const [pRes, cRes, wRes, aRes] = await Promise.all([
                    fetch("/api/products", { cache: "no-store" }),
                    fetch("/api/customers", { cache: "no-store" }),
                    fetch("/api/warehouses", { cache: "no-store" }),
                    fetch("/api/accounts", { cache: "no-store" }).catch(
                        () => null
                    ),
                ]);

                const [pData, cData, wData] = await Promise.all([
                    pRes.json(),
                    cRes.json(),
                    wRes.json(),
                ]);

                if (!pRes.ok || !cRes.ok || !wRes.ok) {
                    throw new Error(
                        "Could not load products, customers, or warehouses."
                    );
                }

                let accountRows = [];

                if (aRes?.ok) {
                    const aData = await aRes.json();

                    accountRows = rowsFrom(aData, "accounts").filter(
                        (account) =>
                            account.is_active === true &&
                            account.is_group === false &&
                            account.is_cash_bank === true

                }

                if (cancelled) return;

                const warehouseRows = rowsFrom(wData, "warehouses");

                setProducts(rowsFrom(pData, "products"));
                setCustomers(rowsFrom(cData, "customers"));
                setWarehouses(warehouseRows);
                setAccounts(accountRows);

                if (warehouseRows.length) {
                    setWarehouseId((current) =>
                        current || String(warehouseRows[0].warehouse_id)
                    );
                }
            } catch (err) {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setError(err.message || "Failed to load POS data.");
                }
            } finally {
                if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
            }
        }

        loadData();

        return () => {
            cancelled = true;

    }, [cart, showCashMovement, showHeldSales, showOrders, reviewingInvoice]);

   useEffect(() => {
    // No warehouse means there is no stock request to make.
    // Keep state updates inside async request callbacks.
    if (!warehouseId) return;

    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadStock() {
        try {

                `/api/stock?warehouseId=${encodeURIComponent(warehouseId)}`,
                { cache: "no-store" }

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {

            if (!cancelled) {

            }
        } catch (err) {
            if (!cancelled) {
                console.error("Failed to load warehouse stock:", err);
                setStock([]);
                setError(
                    err.message || "Could not load warehouse stock."
                );
            }

    loadStock();

    return () => {
        cancelled = true;
    };
}, [warehouseId]);

        let cancelled = false;

    const selectedCustomer = customers.find(
        (customer) => String(customer.customer_id) === String(customerId)
    );

    const selectedWarehouse = warehouses.find(
        (warehouse) =>
            String(warehouse.warehouse_id) === String(warehouseId)
    );

    const availableProducts = useMemo(() => {
        const stockMap = new Map(
            stock.map((row) => [
                String(row.product_id),
                Number(row.warehouse_stock ?? row.quantity ?? 0),
            ])
        );

        const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();
        const result = [];

        for (const product of products) {
            if (product.is_active === false) continue;

            const parentStock =
                stockMap.get(String(product.product_id)) ?? 0;

            const productName = String(product.product_name || "");
            const productSku = String(product.sku || "");
            const category = String(product.category || "");
            const productBarcode = String(
                product.barcode ?? product.product_barcode ?? ""
            ).trim();

            const parentMatches =
                !term ||
                productName.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                productSku.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                category.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                productBarcode.toLowerCase().includes(term);

            if (parentMatches) {
                result.push({
                    ...product,
                    barcode: productBarcode,
                    sub_product_id: null,
                    display_name: productName,
                    display_sku: productSku,
                    display_unit: product.unit || "",
                    display_price: Number(product.sale_price || 0),
                    parent_stock: parentStock,
                    quantity: parentStock,
                    units_per_parent: 1,
                    is_sub_product: false,
                });
            }

            const subProducts =
                product.sub_products ||
                product.subProducts ||
                product.variants ||
                [];

            for (const sub of subProducts) {
                if (sub.is_active === false) continue;

                const conversion = Number(sub.units_per_parent || 0);

                if (!Number.isFinite(conversion) || conversion <= 0) {
                    continue;
                }

                const subName = String(
                    sub.sub_product_name ||
                        sub.variant_name ||
                        sub.name ||
                        ""
                );

                const subSku = String(sub.sku || sub.variant_sku || "");
                const subUnit = String(sub.unit || product.unit || "");

                const subBarcode = String(
                    sub.barcode ??
                        sub.variant_barcode ??
                        sub.sub_product_barcode ??
                        ""
                ).trim();

                const matches =
                    !term ||
                    parentMatches ||
                    subName.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                    subSku.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                    productName.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                    subBarcode.toLowerCase().includes(term);

                if (!matches) continue;

                result.push({
                    ...product,
                    barcode: subBarcode,
                    sub_product_id:
                        sub.sub_product_id ?? sub.variant_id ?? sub.id,
                    display_name: `${productName} â€” ${subName || "Sub-product"}`,
                    display_sku: subSku || productSku,
                    display_unit: subUnit,
                    display_price: Number(
                        sub.sale_price ??
                            sub.unit_price ??
                            product.sale_price ??
                            0
                    ),
                    parent_stock: parentStock,
                    quantity:
                        Math.floor(parentStock * conversion * 1000000) /
                        1000000,
                    units_per_parent: conversion,
                    is_sub_product: true,
                    sub_product_name: subName,
                });
            }
        }

        return result.filter((item) => {
            if (!term) return true;

            return (
                String(item.display_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                String(item.display_sku || "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                String(item.barcode || "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                String(item.category || "").toLowerCase().includes(term)
            );
        });
    }, [products, stock, search]);

    const subtotal = cart.reduce(
        (sum, item) =>
            sum + Number(item.quantity) * Number(item.unit_price),
        0
    );

    const totalQuantity = cart.reduce(
        (sum, item) => sum + Number(item.quantity || 0),
        0
    );

    const discountAmount = Math.max(0, Number(discount) || 0);
    const taxAmount = Math.max(0, Number(tax) || 0);
    const total = Math.max(0, subtotal - discountAmount + taxAmount);
    const receivedAmount = Math.max(0, Number(received) || 0);
    const changeDue = Math.max(0, receivedAmount - total);
    const balanceDue = Math.max(0, total - receivedAmount);

    function addToCart(product) {
        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        if (reviewingOrder) {
            setError("Exit order review before starting a new sale.");
            return;
        }

        if (Number(product.quantity) <= 0) {
            setError("This item has no available stock in this warehouse.");
            return;
        }

        const key = cartKey(product);

        setCart((current) => {
            const existing = current.find((item) => cartKey(item) === key);

            if (existing) {
                if (
                    existing.quantity + 1 >
                    Number(existing.available_quantity)
                ) {
                    setError("You cannot sell more than the available stock.");
                    return current;
                }

                return current.map((item) =>
                    cartKey(item) === key
                        ? { ...item, quantity: item.quantity + 1 }
                        : item
                );
            }

            return [
                ...current,
                {
                    product_id: product.product_id,
                    sub_product_id: product.sub_product_id ?? null,
                    product_name: product.product_name,
                    sub_product_name: product.sub_product_name || null,
                    display_name: product.display_name,
                    sku: product.display_sku,
                    barcode: product.barcode || "",
                    unit: product.display_unit,
                    unit_price: Number(product.display_price || 0),
                    quantity: 1,
                    available_quantity: Number(product.quantity || 0),
                    units_per_parent: Number(product.units_per_parent || 1),
                    is_sub_product: Boolean(product.is_sub_product),
                },
            ];
        });
    }

    function handleBarcodeScan(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        const scannedBarcode = barcode.trim();

        if (!scannedBarcode) {
            barcodeRef.current?.focus();
            return;
        }

        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        if (reviewingOrder) {
            setError("Exit order review before scanning a new item.");
            setBarcode("");
            return;
        }

        const normalizedBarcode = scannedBarcode.toLowerCase();

        const matchedProduct = availableProducts.find((product) => {
            const productBarcode = String(product.barcode || "")
                .trim()
                .toLowerCase();

            return (
                productBarcode !== "" &&
                productBarcode === normalizedBarcode
            );
        });

        if (!matchedProduct) {
            setError(
                `No product found with barcode: ${scannedBarcode}. Check that the barcode is saved on the product or sub-product.`
            );
            setBarcode("");
            barcodeRef.current?.focus();
            return;
        }

        if (Number(matchedProduct.quantity) <= 0) {
            setError(
                `${matchedProduct.display_name} has no available stock in this warehouse.`
            );
            setBarcode("");
            barcodeRef.current?.focus();
            return;
        }

        addToCart(matchedProduct);
        setBarcode("");
    }

    function changeQuantity(itemKey, value) {
        const quantity = Number(value);

        if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0) return;

        setCart((current) =>
            current.map((item) =>
                cartKey(item) === itemKey
                    ? {
                          ...item,
                          quantity: Math.min(
                              quantity,
                              Number(item.available_quantity)
                          ),
                      }
                    : item
            )
        );
    }

    function removeCartItem(itemKey) {
        setCart((current) =>
            current.filter((item) => cartKey(item) !== itemKey)
        );
    }

    function clearCart() {
        setCart([]);
        setDiscount("0");
        setTax("0");
        setReceived("0");
        setReviewingOrder(false);
        setError("");
        setMessage("");
        setBarcode("");
    }

    function holdSale() {
        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        if (reviewingOrder) {
            setError("Exit order review before holding a new sale.");
            return;
        }

        if (!cart.length) {
            setError("Add at least one item before holding a sale.");
            return;
        }

        if (!customerId) {
            setError("Select a customer before holding this sale.");
            return;
        }

        if (!warehouseId) {
            setError("Select a warehouse before holding this sale.");
            return;
        }

        const heldSale = {
            id: `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
            customerId,
            customerName: selectedCustomer?.customer_name || "Customer",
            warehouseId,
            warehouseName: selectedWarehouse?.warehouse_name || "Warehouse",
            accountId,
            cart: cart.map((item) => ({ ...item })),
            discount,
            tax,
            received,
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };

        setHeldSales((current) => [heldSale, ...current]);
        setCart([]);
        setCustomerId("");
        setDiscount("0");
        setTax("0");
        setReceived("0");
        setAccountId("");
        setSearch("");
        setBarcode("");
        setReviewingOrder(false);
        setMessage(`Sale held for ${heldSale.customerName}.`);
    }

    function resumeHeldSale(heldSaleId) {
        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        if (cart.length) {
            setError(
                "Hold or clear the current sale before resuming another."
            );
            return;
        }

        const sale = heldSales.find((item) => item.id === heldSaleId);

        if (!sale) {
            setError("This held sale could not be found.");
            return;
        }

        setCustomerId(sale.customerId);
        setWarehouseId(sale.warehouseId);
        setAccountId(sale.accountId || "");
        setCart(sale.cart.map((item) => ({ ...item })));
        setDiscount(sale.discount);
        setTax(sale.tax);
        setReceived(sale.received);
        setSearch("");
        setBarcode("");
        setReviewingOrder(false);

        setHeldSales((current) =>
            current.filter((item) => item.id !== heldSaleId)
        );

        setShowHeldSales(false);
        setMessage(`Sale for ${sale.customerName} restored.`);
    }

    function removeHeldSale(heldSaleId) {
        setHeldSales((current) =>
            current.filter((item) => item.id !== heldSaleId)
        );

        setMessage("Held sale removed.");
        setError("");
    }

    async function loadOrders() {
        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/sales-invoices", {
                cache: "no-store",
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Could not load orders.");
            }

            setOrders(rowsFrom(data, "invoices"));
            setShowOrders(true);
            setShowHeldSales(false);
            setReviewingInvoice(null);
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Could not load orders.");
        }
    }

    async function editOrder(order) {
        setError("");
        setMessage("");
        setLoadingInvoice(true);

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                `/api/sales-invoices/${encodeURIComponent(order.invoice_id)}`,
                { cache: "no-store" }
            );

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Could not load this invoice.");
            }

            const invoice = data.invoice || order;
            const items = Array.isArray(data.items)
                ? data.items
                : Array.isArray(invoice.items)
                  ? invoice.items
                  : [];

            setReviewingInvoice({ invoice, items });
            setShowOrders(false);
            setShowHeldSales(false);
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Could not load invoice.");
        } finally {
            setLoadingInvoice(false);
        }
    }

    function printInvoice() {
        if (reviewingInvoice) window.print();
    }

    function downloadInvoicePdf() {
        if (reviewingInvoice) window.print();
    }

    async function checkout() {
        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        if (reviewingOrder) {
            setError(
                "This saved order is in review mode only. Exit review before creating a new sale."
            );
            return;
        }

        if (!customerId) {
            setError("Please select a customer.");
            return;
        }

        if (!warehouseId) {
            setError("Please select a warehouse.");
            return;
        }

        if (!cart.length) {
            setError("Please add at least one item.");
            return;
        }

        const receivedValue = Number(received);
        const discountValue = Number(discount);
        const taxValue = Number(tax);

        if (
            received.trim() === "" ||
            !Number.isFinite(receivedValue) ||
            receivedValue < 0
        ) {
            setError("Received amount must be a valid non-negative amount.");
            return;
        }

        if (
            discount.trim() === "" ||
            tax.trim() === "" ||
            !Number.isFinite(discountValue) ||
            !Number.isFinite(taxValue) ||
            discountValue < 0 ||
            taxValue < 0
        ) {
            setError("Discount and tax must be valid non-negative amounts.");
            return;
        }

        if (discountValue > subtotal) {
            setError("Discount cannot exceed the subtotal.");
            return;
        }

        if (receivedValue > 0 && !accountId) {
            setError(
                "Select a Cash/Bank account before recording the received payment."
            );
            return;
        }

        if (
            receivedValue > 0 &&
            !accounts.some(
                (account) =>
                    String(account.account_id) === String(accountId) &&
                    account.is_active === true &&
                    account.is_group === false &&
                    account.is_cash_bank === true
            )
        ) {
            setError(
                "The selected Cash/Bank account is invalid or inactive. Please select another account."
            );
            return;
        }

        setCheckingOut(true);

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/pos", {
                method: "POST",
                headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    customerId: Number(customerId),
                    warehouseId: Number(warehouseId),
                    invoiceDate: todayLocal(),
                    discount: discountValue,
                    tax: taxValue,
                    notes: "Created from POS",
                    receivedAmount: receivedValue,
                    accountId: receivedValue > 0 ? Number(accountId) : null,
                    paymentMethod: "CASH",
                    referenceNumber: null,
                    items: cart.map((item) => ({
                        productId: Number(item.product_id),
                        subProductId:
                            item.sub_product_id != null
                                ? Number(item.sub_product_id)
                                : null,
                        quantity: Number(item.quantity),
                        unitPrice: Number(item.unit_price),
                        discount: 0,
                        tax: 0,
                    })),
                }),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message || data.error || "Checkout failed."
                );
            }

            const invoice = data.invoice || {};
            const recordedPayment = Number(
                data.payment?.amount ?? data.receivedAmount ?? 0
            );
            const returnedChange = Number(
                data.changeAmount ?? Math.max(0, receivedValue - total)
            );
            const remainingBalance = Number(
                invoice.balance_amount ?? Math.max(0, total - recordedPayment)
            );

            const invoiceNumber =
                invoice.invoice_number || invoice.invoice_id || "created";

            setMessage(
                `Invoice ${invoiceNumber} created successfully.` +
                    (recordedPayment > 0
                        ? ` Payment recorded: Rs. ${money(recordedPayment)}.`
                        : " No payment was recorded.") +
                    (returnedChange > 0
                        ? ` Change to return: Rs. ${money(returnedChange)}.`
                        : "") +
                    (remainingBalance > 0
                        ? ` Remaining due: Rs. ${money(remainingBalance)}.`
                        : "")
            );

            setCart([]);
            setDiscount("0");
            setTax("0");
            setReceived("0");
            setCustomerId("");
            setAccountId("");
            setSearch("");
            setBarcode("");
            setReviewingOrder(false);

            const stockResponse = await fetch(
                `/api/stock?warehouseId=${encodeURIComponent(warehouseId)}`,
                { cache: "no-store" }
            );

            if (stockResponse.ok) {
                const stockData = await stockResponse.json();
                setStock(rowsFrom(stockData, "stock"));
            }
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Could not complete the sale.");
        } finally {
            setCheckingOut(false);
        }
    }

    async function openCashMovement(type) {
        setError("");
        setMessage("");
        setCashMovementType(type);
        setCashAmount("");
        setCashDate(todayLocal());
        setCashReference("");
        setCashDescription("");
        setCashAccountId("");
        setCounterAccountId("");
        setShowCashMovement(true);
        setShowOrders(false);
        setShowHeldSales(false);
        setLoadingCashAccounts(true);

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/cash-movements", {
                cache: "no-store",
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error || "Could not load cash/bank accounts."
                );
            }

            const cashRows = data.cashAccounts || [];
            const counterRows = data.counterAccounts || [];

            setCashAccounts(cashRows);
            setCounterAccounts(counterRows);

            const preferred = cashRows.find(
                (account) => String(account.account_id) === String(accountId)
            );

            setCashAccountId(
                String(preferred?.account_id || cashRows[0]?.account_id || "")
            );

            setCounterAccountId(String(counterRows[0]?.account_id || ""));
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Could not load cash/bank accounts.");
        } finally {
            setLoadingCashAccounts(false);
        }
    }

    async function submitCashMovement(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        if (!cashAccountId) {
            setError("Select a cash or bank account.");
            return;
        }

        if (!counterAccountId) {
            setError("Select a counter account.");
            return;
        }

        if (
            !cashAmount ||
            !Number.isFinite(Number(cashAmount)) ||
            Number(cashAmount) <= 0
        ) {
            setError("Enter an amount greater than zero.");
            return;
        }

        if (!cashDate) {
            setError("Select a transaction date.");
            return;
        }

        if (!cashDescription.trim()) {
            setError("Enter a transaction description.");
            return;
        }

        setSavingCashMovement(true);

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/cash-movements", {
                method: "POST",
                headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    accountId: Number(cashAccountId),
                    counterAccountId: Number(counterAccountId),
                    transactionType: cashMovementType,
                    amount: Number(cashAmount),
                    date: cashDate,
                    referenceNumber: cashReference.trim(),
                    description: cashDescription.trim(),
                }),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error ||
                        data.message ||
                        "Could not save transaction."
                );
            }

            setShowCashMovement(false);

            setMessage(
                `${data.message || "Transaction recorded successfully."} ${
                    data.journalNumber || data.journalId
                        ? `Journal: ${data.journalNumber || data.journalId}`
                        : ""
                }`
            );
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Could not save cash movement.");
        } finally {
            setSavingCashMovement(false);
        }
    }

    const invoice = reviewingInvoice?.invoice;
    const invoiceItems = reviewingInvoice?.items || [];

    const invoiceSubtotal =
        Number(invoice?.subtotal ?? invoice?.subtotal_amount ?? 0) ||
        invoiceItems.reduce(
            (sum, item) =>
                sum +
                Number(item.quantity || 0) *
                    Number(item.unit_price ?? item.unitPrice ?? 0),
            0
        );

    const invoiceDiscount = Number(
        invoice?.discount_amount ?? invoice?.discount ?? 0
    );

    const invoiceTax = Number(invoice?.tax_amount ?? invoice?.tax ?? 0);

    const invoiceTotal = Number(
        invoice?.total_amount ??
            invoice?.grand_total ??
            invoiceSubtotal - invoiceDiscount + invoiceTax
    );

    const invoicePaid = Number(
        invoice?.paid_amount ?? invoice?.received_amount ?? 0
    );

    const invoiceBalance = Number(
        invoice?.balance_amount ?? Math.max(0, invoiceTotal - invoicePaid)
    );

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <div className="flex min-h-[70vh] items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 p-6">
                <div className="text-center">
                    <div className="mx-auto flex h-16 w-16 animate-pulse items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600">
                        <ShoppingCart size={30} />
                    </div>
                    <h2 className="mt-5 text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900">
                        Preparing your POS
                    </h2>
                    <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">
                        Loading products, customers and warehouse data...
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }

    return (
        <div
    data-pos-page
    className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-3 text-slate-900 sm:p-5 lg:p-7"
>
            <style jsx global>{`
                @keyframes pos-fade-up {
                    from {
                        opacity: 0;
                        transform: translateY(8px);
                    }
                    to {
                        opacity: 1;
                        transform: translateY(0);
                    }
                }

                .pos-animate {
                    animation: pos-fade-up 0.25s ease-out both;
                }

                @media print {
                    body * {
                        visibility: hidden !important;
                    }

                    #pos-invoice-print,
                    #pos-invoice-print * {
                        visibility: visible !important;
                    }

                    #pos-invoice-print {
                        position: absolute !important;
                        left: 0 !important;
                        top: 0 !important;
                        width: 100% !important;
                        max-width: none !important;
                        margin: 0 !important;
                        padding: 20px !important;
                        border: none !important;
                        box-shadow: none !important;
                        overflow: visible !important;
                        background: white !important;
                        color: #111827 !important;
                    }

                    .invoice-no-print {
                        display: none !important;
                    }

                    table {
                        width: 100% !important;
                        border-collapse: collapse !important;
                    }

                    th,
                    td {
                        border: 1px solid #d1d5db !important;
                        padding: 8px !important;
                        text-align: left !important;
                    }

                    thead {
                        display: table-header-group;
                    }

                    tr {
                        page-break-inside: avoid;
                    }
                }
            `}</style>

            <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px]">
                {/* Header */}
                <header className="pos-animate relative mb-6 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-950 via-indigo-950 to-indigo-800 p-5 text-white shadow-xl shadow-indigo-950/10 sm:p-7">
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-16 -top-24 h-64 w-64 rounded-full border-[35px] border-white/[0.06]" />
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-28 right-1/4 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-indigo-400/10 blur-3xl" />

                    <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 xl:flex-row xl:items-center">
                        <div>
                            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-indigo-200">
                                <Sparkles size={15} />
                                Sales workspace
                            </div>

                            <h1 className="text-3xl font-black tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
                                Point of Sale
                            </h1>

                            <p className="mt-2 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-indigo-100/80">
                                A smarter checkout experience for managing
                                products, inventory, payments and customer
                                invoices.
                            </p>

                            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-50">

                                    POS ready

                {message && (

                        <button

                {reviewingOrder && (

                                        setError("");

                                    {warehouses.map((warehouse) => (

                                    ))}
                                </select>
                                <ChevronDown
                                    size={16}
                                    className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                                />
