"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import JsBarcode from "jsbarcode";

const inputClass =
    "w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500";

const labelClass = "mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700";

function generateBarcodeValue() {
    const timestamp = Date.now().toString();
    const random = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000)
        .toString()
        .padStart(5, "0");

    return `ERP${timestamp}${random}`;
}

function escapeHtml(value) {
    return String(value ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => {
        const entities = {
            "&": "&amp;",
            "<": "&lt;",
            ">": "&gt;",
            '"': "&quot;",
            "'": "&#39;",
        };

        return entities[character];
    });
}

export default function ProductUnitsPage() {
    const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
    const [warehouses, setWarehouses] = useState([]);
    const [units, setUnits] = useState([]);

    const [productId, setProductId] = useState("");
    const [warehouseId, setWarehouseId] = useState("");

    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [optionsLoading, setOptionsLoading] = useState(true);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
    const [barcodeSearch, setBarcodeSearch] = useState("");

    const barcodeRef = useRef(null);

    const [unitForm, setUnitForm] = useState({
        unitName: "",
        barcode: "",
        conversionFactor: "1",
    });

    const [adjustment, setAdjustment] = useState({
        unitId: "",
        type: "INCREASE",
        quantity: "1",
    });

    const [conversion, setConversion] = useState({
        fromUnitId: "",
        toUnitId: "",
        quantity: "1",
    });

    // Load products and warehouses.
    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;

        async function loadOptions() {
            try {
                const [productsResponse, warehousesResponse] = await Promise.all([
                    fetch("/api/products"),
                    fetch("/api/warehouses"),
                ]);

                const productsData = await productsResponse.json();
                const warehousesData = await warehousesResponse.json();

                if (!productsResponse.ok || !warehousesResponse.ok) {
                    throw new Error(
                        productsData.message ||
                        warehousesData.message ||
                        "Could not load products or warehouses."
                    );
                }

                if (cancelled) return;

                const productList = productsData.products || [];
                const warehouseList = warehousesData.warehouses || [];

                setProducts(productList);
                setWarehouses(warehouseList);

                if (productList.length) {
                    setProductId(String(productList[0].product_id));
                }

                if (warehouseList.length) {
                    setWarehouseId(String(warehouseList[0].warehouse_id));
                }
            } catch (error) {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setMessage(error.message || "Failed to load page options.");
                }
            } finally {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setOptionsLoading(false);
                }
            }
        }

        loadOptions();

        return () => {
            cancelled = true;
        };
    }, []);

    // Load stock for the selected product and warehouse.
    const loadUnits = useCallback(async () => {
        if (!productId || !warehouseId) {
            setUnits([]);
            setLoading(false);
            return;
        }

        setLoading(true);

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                `/api/unit-stock?productId=${encodeURIComponent(
                    productId
                )}&warehouseId=${encodeURIComponent(warehouseId)}`
            );

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load packaging stock.");
            }

            setUnits(data.stock || []);
        } catch (error) {
            setMessage(error.message || "Failed to load packaging stock.");
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, [productId, warehouseId]);

    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;

        async function fetchUnits() {
            if (!productId || !warehouseId) {
                setUnits([]);
                return;
            }

            setLoading(true);

            try {
                const response = await fetch(
                    `/api/unit-stock?productId=${encodeURIComponent(
                        productId
                    )}&warehouseId=${encodeURIComponent(warehouseId)}`
                );

                const data = await response.json();

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load packaging stock.");
                }

                if (!cancelled) {
                    setUnits(data.stock || []);
                }
            } catch (error) {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setMessage(error.message || "Failed to load packaging stock.");
                }
            } finally {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setLoading(false);
                }
            }
        }

        fetchUnits();

        return () => {
            cancelled = true;
        };
    }, [productId, warehouseId]);

    // Render the barcode preview whenever the barcode changes.
    useEffect(() => {
        const svg = barcodeRef.current;

        if (!svg) return;

        svg.innerHTML = "";

        const value = unitForm.barcode.trim();

        if (!value) return;

        try {
            JsBarcode(svg, value, {
                format: "CODE128",
                displayValue: true,
                fontSize: 14,
                fontOptions: "bold",
                textMargin: 6,
                height: 65,
                margin: 10,
                background: "#ffffff",
                lineColor: "#000000",
            });
        } catch {
            svg.innerHTML = "";
        }
    }, [unitForm.barcode]);

    function updateUnitField(field, value) {
        setUnitForm((previous) => ({
            ...previous,
            [field]: value,
        }));
    }

    function generateBarcode() {
        setMessage("");
        updateUnitField("barcode", generateBarcodeValue());
    }

    // Add a packaging unit and save its barcode.
    async function addUnit(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setMessage("");

        if (!productId) {
            setMessage("Please select a product.");
            return;
        }

        if (!unitForm.unitName.trim()) {
            setMessage("Please enter a unit name.");
            return;
        }

        const conversionFactor = Number(unitForm.conversionFactor);

        if (!Number.isFinite(conversionFactor) || conversionFactor <= 0) {
            setMessage("Base units per unit must be greater than zero.");
            return;
        }

        setSaving(true);

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/product-units", {
                method: "POST",
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    productId: Number(productId),
                    unitName: unitForm.unitName.trim(),
                    barcode: unitForm.barcode.trim() || null,
                    conversionFactor,
                }),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Could not add packaging unit.");
            }

            setMessage(data.message || "Packaging unit added successfully.");

            setUnitForm({
                unitName: "",
                barcode: "",
                conversionFactor: "1",
            });

            await loadUnits();
        } catch (error) {
            setMessage(error.message || "Failed to add packaging unit.");
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    // Increase or decrease packaging stock.
    async function submitAdjustment(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setMessage("");

        if (!warehouseId) {
            setMessage("Please select a warehouse.");
            return;
        }

        const quantity = Number(adjustment.quantity);

        if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0) {
            setMessage("Quantity must be greater than zero.");
            return;
        }

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/unit-stock/adjust", {
                method: "POST",
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    ...adjustment,
                    unitId: Number(adjustment.unitId),
                    warehouseId: Number(warehouseId),
                    quantity,
                }),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Stock adjustment failed.");
            }

            setMessage(data.message || "Stock adjusted successfully.");

            await loadUnits();
        } catch (error) {
            setMessage(error.message || "Stock adjustment failed.");
        }
    }

    // Convert quantities between two units of the same product.
    async function submitConversion(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setMessage("");

        if (conversion.fromUnitId === conversion.toUnitId) {
            setMessage("Choose two different packaging units.");
            return;
        }

        const quantity = Number(conversion.quantity);

        if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0) {
            setMessage("Conversion quantity must be greater than zero.");
            return;
        }

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/unit-stock", {
                method: "POST",
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    ...conversion,
                    warehouseId: Number(warehouseId),
                    fromUnitId: Number(conversion.fromUnitId),
                    toUnitId: Number(conversion.toUnitId),
                    quantity,
                }),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Stock conversion failed.");
            }

            setMessage(
                `${data.message || "Stock converted successfully."}${data.destinationQuantity != null
                    ? ` Converted quantity: ${data.destinationQuantity} ${data.destinationUnit || ""
                    }.`
                    : ""
                }`
            );

            await loadUnits();
        } catch (error) {
            setMessage(error.message || "Stock conversion failed.");
        }
    }

    // Search for a saved barcode.
    async function findBarcode(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setMessage("");

        const barcode = barcodeSearch.trim();

        if (!barcode) {
            setMessage("Enter or scan a barcode first.");
            return;
        }

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                `/api/product-units?barcode=${encodeURIComponent(barcode)}`
            );

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !data.units?.length) {
                throw new Error("No packaging unit found for this barcode.");
            }

            const match =
                data.units.find(
                    (unit) =>
                        !warehouseId ||
                        String(unit.warehouse_id) === String(warehouseId)
                ) || data.units[0];

            setProductId(String(match.product_id));

            if (match.warehouse_id != null) {
                setWarehouseId(String(match.warehouse_id));
            }

            setMessage(
                `Found ${match.product_name || "product"} â€” ${match.unit_name || "packaging unit"
                }.`
            );
        } catch (error) {
            setMessage(error.message || "Barcode lookup failed.");
        }
    }

    // Delete a non-base packaging unit.
    async function deleteUnit(unit) {
        if (unit.is_base_unit) {
            setMessage("The base unit cannot be deleted.");
            return;
        }

        const confirmed = window.confirm(
            `Delete the ${unit.unit_name} unit?`
        );

        if (!confirmed) return;

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                `/api/product-units/${unit.unit_id}`,
                {
                    method: "DELETE",
                }
            );

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Could not delete unit.");
            }

            setMessage(data.message || "Packaging unit deleted.");

            await loadUnits();
        } catch (error) {
            setMessage(error.message || "Failed to delete unit.");
        }
    }

    // Print the barcode currently shown in the preview.
    function printBarcode(barcode, unitName) {
        const svg = barcodeRef.current;

        if (!svg || !barcode.trim()) {
            setMessage("Generate a barcode before printing.");
            return;
        }

        const printWindow = window.open(
            "",
            "_blank",
            "width=600,height=450"
        );

        if (!printWindow) {
            setMessage("Allow pop-ups in your browser to print barcodes.");
            return;
        }

        const productName = escapeHtml(
            selectedProduct?.product_name || "Product"
        );
        const safeSku = escapeHtml(selectedProduct?.sku || "");
        const safeUnit = escapeHtml(unitName);
        const safeBarcode = escapeHtml(barcode);

        printWindow.document.write(`
      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html>
        <head>
          <title>Product Barcode</title>
          <meta charset="UTF-8" />
          <style>
            body {
              font-family: Arial, sans-serif;

            .label {
              display: inline-block;

              margin: 0 0 6px;

            }

              max-width: 100%;

              body { padding: 0; }

            }

    const selectedProduct = products.find(
        (product) => String(product.product_id) === String(productId)

    const money = (value) =>
        Number(value || 0).toLocaleString(undefined, {

    return (

                    >

                        {products.map((product) => (

                        ))}

                            required
                        />
                    </div>

                        <label className={labelClass}>Barcode (unique)</label>
                        <input
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={unitForm.barcode}

                                updateUnitField("barcode", event.target.value)
                            }
                            placeholder="Generate, scan, or enter barcode"

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={generateBarcode}
                                className="rounded-lg bg-blue-700 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-blue-800"
                            >
                                Generate Barcode
                            </button>

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() =>
                                    printBarcode(unitForm.barcode, unitForm.unitName)
                                }

                                className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                            >
                                Print Barcode
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        {unitForm.barcode.trim() && (
                            <div className="mt-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
                                <p className="mb-3 text-center text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">
                                    Barcode Preview
                                </p>
                                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                                    <svg
                                        ref={barcodeRef}
                                        className="mx-auto max-w-full"
                                        role="img"
                                        aria-label="Barcode preview"
                                    />
                                </div>
                                <p className="mt-2 break-all text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
                                    {unitForm.barcode}
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        )}

                        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                            The barcode will be saved when you click Add Unit.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label className={labelClass}>
                            Base units per unit
                        </label>
                        <input
                            type="number"
                            min="0.001"
                            step="0.001"
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={unitForm.conversionFactor}
                            onChange={(event) =>
                                updateUnitField("conversionFactor", event.target.value)
                            }
                            required
                        />
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                            If Packet is the base unit, set Box to 24 and Packet to 1.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <button
                        type="submit"
                        disabled={!productId || saving}
                        className="w-full rounded-lg bg-slate-900 px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 sm:w-auto"
                    >
                        {saving ? "Saving..." : "Add Unit"}
                    </button>
                </form>

                {/* Adjust unit stock */}
                <form
                    onSubmit={submitAdjustment}
                    className="space-y-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5"
                >
                    <div>
                        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                            Adjust Unit Stock
                        </h2>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                            Increase or decrease a unit&apos;s quantity in the selected
                            warehouse.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label className={labelClass}>Packaging unit</label>
                        <select
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={adjustment.unitId}
                            onChange={(event) =>
                                setAdjustment({
                                    ...adjustment,
                                    unitId: event.target.value,
                                })
                            }
                            required
                        >
                            <option value="">Select unit</option>
                            {units.map((unit) => (
                                <option key={unit.unit_id} value={unit.unit_id}>
                                    {unit.unit_name} â€” current: {money(unit.quantity)}
                                </option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label className={labelClass}>Adjustment type</label>
                        <select
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={adjustment.type}
                            onChange={(event) =>
                                setAdjustment({
                                    ...adjustment,
                                    type: event.target.value,
                                })
                            }
                        >
                            <option value="INCREASE">Receive / Increase</option>
                            <option value="DECREASE">Remove / Decrease</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label className={labelClass}>Quantity</label>
                        <input
                            type="number"
                            min="0.001"
                            step="0.001"
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={adjustment.quantity}
                            onChange={(event) =>
                                setAdjustment({
                                    ...adjustment,
                                    quantity: event.target.value,
                                })
                            }
                            required
                        />
                    </div>

                    <button
                        type="submit"
                        disabled={!warehouseId || !units.length}
                        className="rounded-lg bg-slate-900 px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                        Update Stock
                    </button>
                </form>
            </div>

            {/* Convert units */}
            <form
                onSubmit={submitConversion}
                className="grid gap-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 md:grid-cols-4"
            >
                <div className="md:col-span-4">
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                        Convert Packaging Stock
                    </h2>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                        Convert quantities between units of the same product in the
                        selected warehouse.
                    </p>
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label className={labelClass}>Convert from</label>
                    <select
                        className={inputClass}
                        value={conversion.fromUnitId}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                            setConversion({
                                ...conversion,
                                fromUnitId: event.target.value,
                            })
                        }
                        required
                    >
                        <option value="">Select source</option>
                        {units.map((unit) => (
                            <option key={unit.unit_id} value={unit.unit_id}>
                                {unit.unit_name} ({money(unit.quantity)} available)
                            </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label className={labelClass}>Convert to</label>
                    <select
                        className={inputClass}
                        value={conversion.toUnitId}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                            setConversion({
                                ...conversion,
                                toUnitId: event.target.value,
                            })
                        }
                        required
                    >
                        <option value="">Select destination</option>
                        {units.map((unit) => (
                            <option key={unit.unit_id} value={unit.unit_id}>
                                {unit.unit_name}
                            </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label className={labelClass}>Source quantity</label>
                    <input
                        type="number"
                        min="0.001"
                        step="0.001"
                        className={inputClass}
                        value={conversion.quantity}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                            setConversion({
                                ...conversion,
                                quantity: event.target.value,
                            })
                        }
                        required
                    />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-end">
                    <button
                        type="submit"
                        disabled={!warehouseId || units.length < 2}
                        className="w-full rounded-lg bg-blue-700 px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-blue-800 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                        Convert Stock
                    </button>
                </div>
            </form>

            {/* Packaging stock table */}
            <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white">
                <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 px-5 py-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                    <div>
                        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                            Packaging Stock
                        </h2>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                            {loading
                                ? "Loading stock..."
                                : `${units.length} packaging unit(s)`}
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={loadUnits}
                        disabled={loading || !productId || !warehouseId}
                        className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                        Refresh
                    </button>
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                    <table className="w-full min-w-[760px] text-left text-sm">
                        <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-600">
                            <tr>
                                <th className="px-5 py-3 font-semibold">Unit</th>
                                <th className="px-5 py-3 font-semibold">Barcode</th>
                                <th className="px-5 py-3 font-semibold">Base Units</th>
                                <th className="px-5 py-3 font-semibold">
                                    Warehouse Quantity
                                </th>
                                <th className="px-5 py-3 font-semibold">Type</th>
                                <th className="px-5 py-3 font-semibold">Action</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>

                        <tbody>
                            {units.map((unit) => (
                                <tr
                                    key={unit.unit_id}
                                    className="border-t border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50"
                                >
                                    <td className="px-5 py-3 font-medium text-slate-900">
                                        {unit.unit_name}
                                    </td>

                                    <td className="px-5 py-3">
                                        {unit.barcode ? (
                                            <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
                                                <span className="font-mono text-xs">
                                                    {unit.barcode}
                                                </span>
                                                <button
                                                    type="button"
                                                    onClick={() => {
                                                        setUnitForm((previous) => ({
                                                            ...previous,
                                                            unitName: unit.unit_name,
                                                            barcode: unit.barcode,
                                                            conversionFactor: String(
                                                                unit.conversion_factor
                                                            ),
                                                        }));
                                                        window.scrollTo({
                                                            top: 0,
                                                            behavior: "smooth",
                                                        });
                                                    }}
                                                    className="text-xs font-medium text-blue-700 hover:underline"
                                                >
                                                    Preview barcode above
                                                </button>
                                            </div>
                                        ) : (
                                            <span className="text-slate-400">No barcode</span>
                                        )}
                                    </td>

                                    <td className="px-5 py-3">
                                        {money(unit.conversion_factor)}
                                    </td>

                                    <td className="px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-slate-900">
                                        {money(unit.quantity)}
                                    </td>

                                    <td className="px-5 py-3">
                                        <span
                                            className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium ${unit.is_base_unit
                                                    ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700"
                                                    : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700"
                                                }`}
                                        >
                                            {unit.is_base_unit ? "Base unit" : "Packaging unit"}
                                        </span>
                                    </td>


                                    <td className="px-5 py-3">
                                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                            {unit.barcode && (
                                                <button
                                                    type="button"
                                                    onClick={() => {
                                                        setUnitForm((previous) => ({
                                                            ...previous,
                                                            unitName: unit.unit_name,
                                                            barcode: unit.barcode,
                                                            conversionFactor: String(unit.conversion_factor),
                                                        }));

                                                        window.scrollTo({
                                                            top: 0,
                                                            behavior: "smooth",
                                                        });

                                                        setMessage(
                                                            "Barcode loaded into the preview form. Use Print Barcode to print its label."
                                                        );
                                                    }}
                                                    className="rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100"
                                                >
                                                    Load
                                                </button>
                                            )}

                                            {!unit.is_base_unit && (
                                                <button
                                                    type="button"
                                                    onClick={() => deleteUnit(unit)}
                                                    className="rounded-md bg-red-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-red-700 hover:bg-red-100"
                                                >
                                                    Delete
                                                </button>
                                            )}
                                        </div>
                                    </td>

                                </tr>
                            ))}

                            {!loading && units.length === 0 && (
                                <tr>
                                    <td
                                        colSpan={6}
                                        className="px-5 py-10 text-center text-slate-500"
                                    >
                                        {optionsLoading
                                            ? "Loading products and warehouses..."
                                            : !productId || !warehouseId
                                                ? "Select a product and warehouse to see stock."
                                                : "No packaging units found for this product and warehouse."}
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            )}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function getArray(data, keys = []) {
  if (Array.isArray(data)) return data;

  for (const key of keys) {
    if (Array.isArray(data?.[key])) {
      return data[key];
    }
  }

  return [];
}

function getProductId(product) {
  return (
    product?.product_id ??
    product?.productId ??
    product?.id ??
    null
  );
}

function getVariantId(variant) {
  return (
    variant?.sub_product_id ??
    variant?.subProductId ??
    variant?.variant_id ??
    variant?.id ??
    null
  );
}

function normalizeProduct(product) {
  return {
    ...product,

    product_id: getProductId(product),

    sku: product?.sku ?? "",
    barcode: product?.barcode ?? "",

    product_name:
      product?.product_name ??
      product?.productName ??
      product?.name ??
      "",

    description: product?.description ?? "",
    category: product?.category ?? "",
    unit: product?.unit ?? "PCS",

    item_type:
      product?.item_type ??
      product?.itemType ??
      "Stock Item",

    brand: product?.brand ?? "",
    model: product?.model ?? "",
    color: product?.color ?? "",
    size: product?.size ?? "",
    design: product?.design ?? "",

    sales_unit:
      product?.sales_unit ??
      product?.salesUnit ??
      "PCS",

    sale_price:
      product?.sale_price ??
      product?.salePrice ??
      0,

    sales_description:
      product?.sales_description ??
      product?.salesDescription ??
      "",

    sales_account:
      product?.sales_account ??
      product?.salesAccount ??
      "",

    receivable_account:
      product?.receivable_account ??
      product?.receivableAccount ??
      "",

    purchase_unit:
      product?.purchase_unit ??
      product?.purchaseUnit ??
      "PCS",

    cost_price:
      product?.cost_price ??
      product?.costPrice ??
      0,

    purchase_description:
      product?.purchase_description ??
      product?.purchaseDescription ??
      "",

    purchase_account:
      product?.purchase_account ??
      product?.purchaseAccount ??
      "",

    inventory_account:
      product?.inventory_account ??
      product?.inventoryAccount ??
      "",

    cogs_account:
      product?.cogs_account ??
      product?.cogsAccount ??
      "",

    minimum_stock:
      product?.minimum_stock ??
      product?.minimumStock ??
      0,

    is_active:
      product?.is_active ??
      product?.isActive ??
      true,

    image:
      product?.image ??
      product?.image_url ??
      "",

    banner_sequence:
      product?.banner_sequence ??
      product?.bannerSequence ??
      0,
  };
}

function normalizeVariant(variant) {
  return {
    ...variant,

    sub_product_id: getVariantId(variant),

    sku:
      variant?.sku ??
      variant?.variant_sku ??
      variant?.sub_product_code ??
      "",

    sub_product_name:
      variant?.sub_product_name ??
      variant?.variant_name ??
      variant?.name ??
      "",

    barcode: variant?.barcode ?? "",
    unit: variant?.unit ?? "PCS",

    units_per_parent:
      variant?.units_per_parent ??
      1,

    parent_available_stock:
      variant?.parent_available_stock ??
      0,

    stock_source:
      variant?.stock_source ??
      "conversion",

    color: variant?.color ?? "",
    size: variant?.size ?? "",
    design: variant?.design ?? "",

    cost_price:
      variant?.cost_price ??
      variant?.costPrice ??
      0,

    sale_price:
      variant?.sale_price ??
      variant?.salePrice ??
      0,

    available_stock:
      variant?.available_stock ??
      variant?.availableStock ??
      variant?.quantity ??
      0,
  };
}

function getErrorMessage(data, fallback) {
  return data?.message || data?.error || fallback;
}

function money(value) {
  const amount = Number(value ?? 0);

  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : 0);
}

function formatQuantity(value) {
  const quantity = Number(value ?? 0);

  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 3,
  }).format(Number.isFinite(quantity) ? quantity : 0);
}

function isActiveProduct(product) {
  return !(
    product?.is_active === false ||
    product?.is_active === "false" ||
    product?.is_active === 0
  );
}

/* =========================================================
   REUSABLE UI COMPONENTS
========================================================= */

function Field({
  label,
  children,
  className = "",
  required = false,
  hint,
}) {
  return (
    <div className={`min-w-0 ${className}`}>
      <label className={labelClass}>
        {label}

        {required && (
          <span className="ml-1 text-rose-500">*</span>
        )}
      </label>

      {children}

      {hint && (
        <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
          {hint}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Input({ className = "", ...props }) {
  return (
    <input
      {...props}
      className={`${inputClass} ${className}`}
    />
  );
}

function Select({ children, className = "", ...props }) {
  return (
    <select
      {...props}
      className={`${inputClass} cursor-pointer ${className}`}
    >
      {children}
    </select>
  );
}

function TextArea({ className = "", ...props }) {
  return (
    <textarea
      {...props}
      className={`${inputClass} min-h-[100px] resize-y ${className}`}
    />
  );
}

function SectionHeading({
  eyebrow,
  title,
  description,
  icon: Icon,
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
      {Icon && (
        <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600">
          <Icon size={21} />
        </div>
      )}

      <div>
        {eyebrow && (
          <p className="mb-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-indigo-600">
            {eyebrow}
          </p>
        )}

        <h3 className="text-base font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
          {title}
        </h3>

        {description && (
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">
            {description}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SummaryCard({
  title,
  value,
  description,
  icon: Icon,
  color,
}) {
  const themes = {
    blue: {
      icon: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700",
      glow: "from-blue-500/10",
      bar: "bg-blue-500",
    },

    purple: {
      icon: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-700",
      glow: "from-violet-500/10",
      bar: "bg-violet-500",
    },

    green: {
      icon: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700",
      glow: "from-emerald-500/10",
      bar: "bg-emerald-500",
    },
  };

  const theme = themes[color] || themes.blue;

  return (
    <div className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-indigo-200 hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-slate-200/60">
      <div
        className={`pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br ${theme.glow} via-transparent to-transparent opacity-70`}
      />

      <div className="relative flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500">
            {title}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-3 text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
            {value}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className={`rounded-2xl p-3.5 ${theme.icon}`}>
          <Icon size={23} strokeWidth={1.8} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="relative mt-5 h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-100">
        <div className={`h-full w-1/3 rounded-full ${theme.bar}`} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ActionButton({
  children,
  onClick,
  variant = "secondary",
  disabled = false,
  className = "",
  type = "button",
  title,
}) {
  const variants = {
    primary:
      "border border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm hover:border-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-700 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-indigo-600/20 focus:ring-indigo-500/20",

    secondary:
      "border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 shadow-sm hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 focus:ring-slate-300/30",

    danger:
      "border border-rose-100 bg-white text-rose-600 hover:border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50 focus:ring-rose-500/10",
  };

  return (
    <button
      type={type}
      title={title}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold transition duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${variants[variant]} ${className}`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

function Notification({ type, message, onClose }) {
  if (!message) return null;

  const success = type === "success";
  const Icon = success ? CheckCircle2 : AlertCircle;

  return (
    <div
      role={success ? "status" : "alert"}
      className={`mb-5 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border p-4 shadow-sm ${
        success
          ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/90 text-emerald-900"
          : "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/90 text-rose-900"
      }`}
    >
      <Icon
        size={20}
        className={`mt-0.5 shrink-0 ${
          success ? "text-emerald-600" : "text-rose-600"
        }`}
      />

      <p className="flex-1 text-sm font-medium leading-6">
        {message}
      </p>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onClose}
        aria-label="Dismiss message"
        className="rounded-lg p-1 transition hover:bg-black/5"
      >
        <X size={17} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function EmptyState({

    <div className="flex flex-col items-center px-6 py-14 text-center">

        <Icon size={30} strokeWidth={1.6} />
      </div>

      <h4 className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
        {title}
      </h4>

      <p className="mt-1 max-w-sm text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">
        {description}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

/* =========================================================
   PRODUCTS PAGE
========================================================= */

export default function ProductsPage() {
  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     STATE
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [accounts, setAccounts] = useState([]);
  const [stockRows, setStockRows] = useState([]);

  const [variants, setVariants] = useState([]);
  const [subProductsByProduct, setSubProductsByProduct] =
    useState({});

  const [form, setForm] = useState({ ...EMPTY_FORM });
  const [variantForm, setVariantForm] = useState({
    ...EMPTY_VARIANT,
  });

  const [editingProduct, setEditingProduct] = useState(null);
  const [editingVariantId, setEditingVariantId] = useState(null);

  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState("primary");

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all");

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [savingVariant, setSavingVariant] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");

  const [manualCategory, setManualCategory] = useState("");
  const [showManualCategory, setShowManualCategory] =
    useState(false);

  const [manualUnit, setManualUnit] = useState("");
  const [showManualUnit, setShowManualUnit] = useState(false);

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     FORM HELPERS
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const setField = (name, value) => {
    setForm((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      [name]: value,
    }));
  };

  const setVariantField = (name, value) => {
    setVariantForm((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      [name]: value,
    }));
  };

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     API REQUEST HELPER

     Uses the existing Next.js API routes.
     Does not create PostgreSQL connections directly.
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const request = useCallback(async (url, options = {}) => {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      ...options,

      headers: {
        ...(options.body
          ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
          : {}),

        ...options.headers,
      },

      cache: "no-store",
    });

    const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(
        getErrorMessage(
          data,
          `Request failed (${response.status})`
        )
      );
    }

    return data;
  }, []);

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     LOAD STOCK

     This is independent of product and account loading.
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const loadStock = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await request("/api/stock");

      const rows = getArray(data, [
        "stock",
        "stocks",
        "data",
        "items",
      ]);

      setStockRows(rows);

      return rows;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Could not load stock:", err);

      setStockRows([]);

      throw err;
    }
  }, [request]);

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     LOAD ACCOUNTS

     Only active, non-group accounts are selectable.
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const loadAccounts = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await request("/api/accounts");

      const rows = getArray(data, [
        "accounts",
        "data",
        "items",
      ]);

      const activeAccounts = rows.filter((account) => {
        const isActive =
          account.is_active !== false &&
          account.is_active !== "false" &&
          account.is_active !== 0;

        const isGroup =
          account.is_group === true ||
          account.is_group === "true" ||
          account.is_group === 1;

        return isActive && !isGroup;
      });

      setAccounts(activeAccounts);

      return activeAccounts;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Could not load chart of accounts:", err);

      setAccounts([]);

      throw err;
    }
  }, [request]);

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     LOAD VARIANTS FOR ONE PRODUCT

     IMPORTANT:
     This request is made when opening/editing a product,
     not once for every product during initial catalogue load.

     The response also updates the local variant cache.
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const loadVariants = useCallback(
    async (productId) => {
      if (productId == null) {
        setVariants([]);
        return [];
      }

      const requestedProductId = String(productId);

      try {
        const data = await request(
          `/api/products/${productId}/variants`
        );

        const rows = getArray(data, [
          "variants",
          "subProducts",
          "sub_products",
          "data",
          "items",
        ]).map(normalizeVariant);

        setVariants(rows);

        setSubProductsByProduct((previous) => ({
          ...previous,
          [requestedProductId]: rows,
        }));

        return rows;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(
          `Could not load variants for product ${productId}:`,
          err
        );

        setVariants([]);

        setError(
          `Could not load sub-products: ${err.message}`
        );

        return [];
      }
    },
    [request]
  );

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     LOAD PRODUCTS

     PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT:
     1. Makes one /api/products request.
     2. Uses embedded sub_products when available.
     3. Does not fetch /variants for every product.
     4. Preserves previously fetched variants when the API
        does not include them in the catalogue response.
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const loadProducts = useCallback(async () => {
    const data = await request("/api/products");

    const rows = getArray(data, [
      "products",
      "data",
      "items",
    ]).map(normalizeProduct);

    const grouped = {};

    for (const product of rows) {
      const productId = getProductId(product);

      if (productId == null) continue;

      const embeddedVariants = Array.isArray(
        product.sub_products
      )
        ? product.sub_products.map(normalizeVariant)
        : [];

      grouped[String(productId)] = embeddedVariants;
    }

    // Update the catalogue from this single request.
    setProducts(rows);

    // Merge cached variants so a catalogue refresh does not
    // erase variants previously fetched from their own API.
    setSubProductsByProduct((previous) => {
      const merged = { ...grouped };

      for (const [productId, cachedVariants] of Object.entries(
        previous
      )) {
        if (
          Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            merged,
            productId
          ) &&
          merged[productId].length === 0 &&
          cachedVariants.length > 0
        ) {
          merged[productId] = cachedVariants;
        }
      }

      return merged;
    });

    return rows;
  }, [request]);

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     INITIAL LOADING

     Products, accounts and stock load concurrently.

     A failed accounts or stock request no longer prevents
     the product catalogue from loading.
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadInitialData() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const results = await Promise.allSettled([
        loadProducts(),
        loadAccounts(),
        loadStock(),
      ]);

      if (cancelled) return;

      const productResult = results[0];
      const accountResult = results[1];
      const stockResult = results[2];

      const errors = [];

      if (productResult.status === "rejected") {
        errors.push(
          productResult.reason?.message ||
            "Could not load products."
        );
      }

      if (accountResult.status === "rejected") {
        console.error(
          "Account loading failed. Product catalogue is still available."
        );
      }

      if (stockResult.status === "rejected") {
        console.error(
          "Stock loading failed. Stock figures may be unavailable."
        );
      }

      if (errors.length > 0) {
        setError(errors.join(" "));
      }

      setLoading(false);
    }

    loadInitialData();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [loadProducts, loadAccounts, loadStock]);

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     PRODUCT STOCK MAP

     Build the stock map once per stockRows change instead
     of repeatedly scanning the entire stock array per row.
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const productStock = useMemo(() => {
    const totals = new Map();

    for (const row of stockRows) {
      const id =
        row?.product_id ??
        row?.productId ??
        row?.id;

      if (id == null) continue;

      const quantity = Number(
        row?.available_stock ??
          row?.availableStock ??
          row?.quantity ??
          row?.stock_quantity ??
          0
      );

      const safeQuantity = Number.isFinite(quantity)
        ? quantity
        : 0;

      if (
        row?.available_stock != null ||
        row?.availableStock != null
      ) {
        // Some APIs return a pre-aggregated stock quantity.
        if (!totals.has(String(id))) {
          totals.set(String(id), safeQuantity);
        }
      } else {
        // Otherwise aggregate stock across warehouses.
        totals.set(
          String(id),
          (totals.get(String(id)) || 0) + safeQuantity
        );
      }
    }

    return totals;
  }, [stockRows]);

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     FILTERED PRODUCTS
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => {
    const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    return products.filter((product) => {
      const matchesQuery =
        !query ||
        [
          product.sku,
          product.barcode,
          product.product_name,
          product.category,
          product.brand,
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .some((value) =>
            String(value).toLowerCase().includes(query)
          );

      const active = isActiveProduct(product);

      const matchesStatus =
        statusFilter === "all" ||
        (statusFilter === "active" && active) ||
        (statusFilter === "inactive" && !active);

      return matchesQuery && matchesStatus;
    });
  }, [products, search, statusFilter]);

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     DERIVED VALUES
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const currentProductId = getProductId(editingProduct);

  const currentProductStock =
    currentProductId != null
      ? productStock.get(String(currentProductId)) ?? 0
      : 0;

  const totalSubProducts = useMemo(() => {
    return Object.values(subProductsByProduct).reduce(
      (total, items) => total + items.length,
      0
    );
  }, [subProductsByProduct]);

  const activeProducts = useMemo(() => {
    return products.filter(isActiveProduct).length;
  }, [products]);

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     FORM RESET
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const resetForm = () => {
    setForm({ ...EMPTY_FORM });
    setVariantForm({ ...EMPTY_VARIANT });

    setEditingProduct(null);
    setEditingVariantId(null);

    setVariants([]);

    setActiveSection("primary");

    setManualCategory("");
    setShowManualCategory(false);

    setManualUnit("");
    setShowManualUnit(false);
  };

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     OPEN NEW PRODUCT
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const openNewProduct = () => {
    resetForm();

    setError("");
    setNotice("");

    setShowForm(true);
  };

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     OPEN EDIT PRODUCT

     Only the selected product's variants are fetched.
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const openEditProduct = async (product) => {
    const normalized = normalizeProduct(product);

    setEditingProduct(normalized);

    setForm({
      sku: String(normalized.sku ?? ""),
      barcode: String(normalized.barcode ?? ""),
      productName: String(
        normalized.product_name ?? ""
      ),
      description: String(
        normalized.description ?? ""
      ),
      category: String(normalized.category ?? ""),
      unit: String(normalized.unit ?? "PCS"),
      itemType: String(
        normalized.item_type ?? "Stock Item"
      ),
      brand: String(normalized.brand ?? ""),
      model: String(normalized.model ?? ""),
      color: String(normalized.color ?? ""),
      size: String(normalized.size ?? ""),
      design: String(normalized.design ?? ""),
      salesUnit: String(
        normalized.sales_unit ?? "PCS"
      ),
      salePrice: String(
        normalized.sale_price ?? 0
      ),
      salesDescription: String(
        normalized.sales_description ?? ""
      ),
      salesAccount: String(
        normalized.sales_account ?? ""
      ),
      receivableAccount: String(
        normalized.receivable_account ?? ""
      ),
      purchaseUnit: String(
        normalized.purchase_unit ?? "PCS"
      ),
      costPrice: String(
        normalized.cost_price ?? 0
      ),
      purchaseDescription: String(
        normalized.purchase_description ?? ""
      ),
      purchaseAccount: String(
        normalized.purchase_account ?? ""
      ),
      inventoryAccount: String(
        normalized.inventory_account ?? ""
      ),
      cogsAccount: String(
        normalized.cogs_account ?? ""
      ),
      minimumStock: String(
        normalized.minimum_stock ?? 0
      ),
      isActive: isActiveProduct(normalized),
      image: String(normalized.image ?? ""),
      bannerSequence: String(
        normalized.banner_sequence ?? 0
      ),
    });

    setVariantForm({ ...EMPTY_VARIANT });
    setEditingVariantId(null);

    setActiveSection("primary");

    setError("");
    setNotice("");

    setShowForm(true);

    // Fetch variants only for this selected product.
    if (normalized.product_id != null) {
      await loadVariants(normalized.product_id);
    }
  };

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     CLOSE FORM
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const closeForm = () => {
    setShowForm(false);

    resetForm();

    setError("");
    setNotice("");
  };

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     SAVE PRODUCT
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const submitProduct = async (event) => {
    event?.preventDefault?.();

    setError("");
    setNotice("");

    if (!form.productName.trim()) {
      setError("Please enter the product name.");
      setActiveSection("primary");
      return;
    }

    if (!form.unit) {
      setError(
        "Please select a unit of measurement."
      );
      setActiveSection("primary");
      return;
    }

    const numericFields = [
      ["Sale Price", form.salePrice],
      ["Cost Price", form.costPrice],
      ["Minimum Stock", form.minimumStock],
      ["Banner Sequence", form.bannerSequence],
    ];

    for (const [label, value] of numericFields) {
      if (
        value !== "" &&
        !Number.isFinite(Number(value))
      ) {
        setError(`${label} must be a valid number.`);
        return;
      }

      if (
        value !== "" &&
        Number(value) < 0
      ) {
        setError(`${label} cannot be negative.`);
        return;
      }
    }

    setSaving(true);

    try {
      const payload = {
        sku: form.sku.trim(),
        barcode: form.barcode.trim() || null,

        productName: form.productName.trim(),
        description: form.description.trim(),

        category: form.category,
        unit: form.unit,
        itemType: form.itemType,

        brand: form.brand.trim(),
        model: form.model.trim(),
        color: form.color.trim(),
        size: form.size.trim(),
        design: form.design.trim(),

        salesUnit: form.salesUnit,
        salePrice: Number(form.salePrice || 0),

        salesDescription:
          form.salesDescription.trim(),

        salesAccount:
          form.salesAccount || null,

        receivableAccount:
          form.receivableAccount || null,

        purchaseUnit: form.purchaseUnit,
        costPrice: Number(form.costPrice || 0),

        purchaseDescription:
          form.purchaseDescription.trim(),

        purchaseAccount:
          form.purchaseAccount || null,

        inventoryAccount:
          form.inventoryAccount || null,

        cogsAccount:
          form.cogsAccount || null,

        minimumStock:
          Number(form.minimumStock || 0),

        isActive: Boolean(form.isActive),

        image: form.image.trim(),

        bannerSequence:
          Number(form.bannerSequence || 0),
      };

      const productId = getProductId(editingProduct);
      const isEditing = productId != null;

      const data = await request(
        isEditing
          ? `/api/products/${productId}`
          : "/api/products",
        {
          method: isEditing ? "PUT" : "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify(payload),
        }
      );

      const returnedProduct =
        data?.product ??
        data?.data?.product ??
        data?.data ??
        data;

      const returnedId =
        getProductId(returnedProduct) ?? productId;

      // Reload the catalogue and stock concurrently.
      const refreshResults = await Promise.allSettled([
        loadProducts(),
        loadStock(),
      ]);

      if (
        refreshResults[0].status === "rejected"
      ) {
        console.error(
          "Product saved, but catalogue refresh failed:",
          refreshResults[0].reason
        );
      }

      if (
        refreshResults[1].status === "rejected"
      ) {
        console.error(
          "Product saved, but stock refresh failed:",
          refreshResults[1].reason
        );
      }

      if (returnedId != null) {
        const normalized = normalizeProduct({
          ...returnedProduct,

          product_id: returnedId,

          sku:
            returnedProduct?.sku ??
            payload.sku,

          product_name:
            returnedProduct?.product_name ??
            returnedProduct?.productName ??
            payload.productName,

          unit:
            returnedProduct?.unit ??
            payload.unit,
        });

        setEditingProduct(normalized);

        // Refresh variants for the saved product only.
        await loadVariants(returnedId);

        setNotice(
          isEditing
            ? "Product updated successfully."
            : "Product saved successfully. You can now add sub-products."
        );
      } else {
        // Some APIs do not return the inserted product ID.
        // Reuse the already-refreshed catalogue where possible.
        const refreshed = await request("/api/products");

        const rows = getArray(refreshed, [
          "products",
          "data",
          "items",
        ]).map(normalizeProduct);

        setProducts(rows);

        const found = rows.find(
          (product) =>
            payload.sku &&
            String(product.sku).toLowerCase() ===
              payload.sku.toLowerCase()
        );

        if (found) {
          setEditingProduct(found);

          await loadVariants(found.product_id);
        }

        setNotice(
          found
            ? "Product saved successfully."
            : "Product saved. The API did not return the product ID, so confirm the product before adding sub-products."
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err.message || "Could not save the product."
      );
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     RESET VARIANT FORM
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const clearVariantForm = () => {
    setVariantForm({ ...EMPTY_VARIANT });
    setEditingVariantId(null);
  };

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     EDIT VARIANT
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const editVariant = (variant) => {
    setEditingVariantId(getVariantId(variant));

    setVariantForm({
      code: String(
        variant.sku ??
          variant.variant_sku ??
          variant.sub_product_code ??
          ""
      ),

      name: String(
        variant.sub_product_name ??
          variant.variant_name ??
          variant.name ??
          ""
      ),

      barcode: String(variant.barcode ?? ""),
      unit: String(variant.unit ?? "PCS"),

      units_per_parent: String(
        variant.units_per_parent ?? 1
      ),

      color: String(variant.color ?? ""),
      size: String(variant.size ?? ""),
      design: String(variant.design ?? ""),

      cost_price: String(
        variant.cost_price ?? 0
      ),

      sale_price: String(
        variant.sale_price ?? 0
      ),
    });

    setError("");
    setNotice("");
  };

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     SAVE VARIANT

     PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT:
     Previously, saving a variant triggered:
       1. GET variants
       2. GET stock
       3. GET products

     The full catalogue request is unnecessary because the
     variant form already identifies the affected product.

     This version refreshes variants and stock only.
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const submitVariant = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    setError("");
    setNotice("");

    const productId = getProductId(editingProduct);

    if (productId == null) {
      setError(
        "Save the main product first, then add sub-products."
      );

      setActiveSection("primary");
      return;
    }

    const code = variantForm.code.trim();
    const name = variantForm.name.trim();

    if (!code) {
      setError("Sub-product code is required.");
      return;
    }

    if (!name) {
      setError("Sub-product name is required.");
      return;
    }

    if (!variantForm.unit) {
      setError(
        "Please select a UOM for the sub-product."
      );
      return;
    }

    const unitsPerParent = Number(
      variantForm.units_per_parent
    );

    const costPrice = Number(
      variantForm.cost_price
    );

    const salePrice = Number(
      variantForm.sale_price
    );

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(unitsPerParent) ||
      unitsPerParent <= 0
    ) {
      setError(
        "Units per Main Product must be greater than zero."
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(costPrice) ||
      costPrice < 0 ||
      !Number.isFinite(salePrice) ||
      salePrice < 0
    ) {
      setError(
        "Cost price and sale price must be valid non-negative numbers."
      );
      return;
    }

    setSavingVariant(true);

    try {
      const payload = {
        variant_sku: code,
        variant_name: name,

        sku: code,
        sub_product_code: code,
        sub_product_name: name,

        barcode:
          variantForm.barcode.trim() || null,

        unit: variantForm.unit,

        units_per_parent: unitsPerParent,

        color: variantForm.color.trim(),
        size: variantForm.size.trim(),
        design: variantForm.design.trim(),

        cost_price: costPrice,
        sale_price: salePrice,
      };

      const baseUrl =
        `/api/products/${productId}/variants`;

      const variantId = editingVariantId;

      const data = await request(
        variantId
          ? `${baseUrl}/${variantId}`
          : baseUrl,
        {
          method: variantId ? "PUT" : "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify(payload),
        }
      );

      // No complete catalogue reload here.
      await Promise.all([
        loadVariants(productId),
        loadStock(),
      ]);

      clearVariantForm();

      setNotice(
        data?.message ||
          (variantId
            ? "Sub-product updated successfully."
            : "Sub-product added successfully.")
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err.message || "Could not save the sub-product."
      );
    } finally {
      setSavingVariant(false);
    }
  };

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     DELETE VARIANT
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const deleteVariant = async (variant) => {
    const productId = getProductId(editingProduct);
    const variantId = getVariantId(variant);

    if (
      productId == null ||
      variantId == null
    ) {
      setError(
        "Could not identify this sub-product."
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      !window.confirm(
        `Delete sub-product "${variant.sub_product_name}"?`
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    setError("");
    setNotice("");

    try {
      await request(
        `/api/products/${productId}/variants/${variantId}`,
        { method: "DELETE" }
      );

      // Only the affected variant list needs refreshing.
      await loadVariants(productId);

      setNotice(
        "Sub-product deleted successfully."
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err.message || "Could not delete the sub-product."
      );
    }
  };

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     DELETE PRODUCT
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const deleteProduct = async (product) => {
    const id = getProductId(product);

    if (id == null) {
      setError("Could not identify this product.");
      return;
    }

    if (
      !window.confirm(
        `Delete product "${product.product_name}"?`
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    setError("");
    setNotice("");

    try {
      await request(`/api/products/${id}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
      });

      await Promise.all([
        loadProducts(),
        loadStock(),
      ]);

      setNotice(
        "Product deleted successfully."
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err.message || "Could not delete product."
      );
    }
  };

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     ACCOUNT OPTIONS
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const accountOptions = (filter) =>
    accounts.filter((account) => {
      const text = [
        account.account_type,
        account.type,
        account.account_name,
        account.name,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase();

      if (filter === "cash-bank") {
        return (
          account.is_cash_bank === true ||
          text.includes("cash") ||
          text.includes("bank")
        );
      }

      return true;
    });

  const renderAccountSelect = (
    label,
    fieldName,
    options = accounts
  ) => (
    <Field label={label}>
      <Select
        value={String(form[fieldName] ?? "")}
        onChange={(event) =>
          setField(fieldName, event.target.value)
        }
      >
        <option value="">
          {accounts.length === 0
            ? "No accounts available"
            : "Select account"}
        </option>

        {options.map((account) => {
          const id =
            account.account_id ??
            account.accountId ??
            account.id;

          const code =
            account.account_code ??
            account.accountCode ??
            account.code ??
            "";

          const name =
            account.account_name ??
            account.accountName ??
            account.name ??
            "Unnamed Account";

          if (id == null) return null;

          return (
            <option
              key={id}
              value={String(id)}
            >
              {code ? `${code} - ` : ""}
              {name}
            </option>
          );
        })}
      </Select>

      {accounts.length === 0 && (
        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-700">
          No accounts were loaded. Check the chart of
          accounts and browser console.
        </p>
      )}
    </Field>
  );

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     MAIN PRODUCT STOCK CARD
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const mainStockCard = (
    <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-indigo-100 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-50 via-white to-blue-50 p-5">
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-6 -top-10 h-36 w-36 rounded-full bg-indigo-100/50 blur-2xl" />

      <div className="relative flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="rounded-xl bg-indigo-100 p-3 text-indigo-700">
            <PackageCheck size={23} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <p className="font-bold text-slate-900">
              Main Product Available Stock
            </p>

            <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
              Stock is displayed in the main product&apos;s
              unit of measurement.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 bg-white/90 px-5 py-3 text-right shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-indigo-700">
            {formatQuantity(currentProductStock)}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
            {form.unit || "PCS"}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     MANUAL REFRESH

     Refresh products and stock without refetching accounts.
  ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const refreshProducts = async () => {
    if (loading) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    setNotice("");

    const results = await Promise.allSettled([
      loadProducts(),
      loadStock(),
    ]);

    const errors = results
      .filter((result) => result.status === "rejected")
      .map(
        (result) =>
          result.reason?.message ||
          "A refresh request failed."
      );

    if (errors.length > 0) {
      setError(errors.join(" "));
    } else {
      setNotice("Product catalogue refreshed.");
    }

    setLoading(false);
  };

  /* =========================================================
     RENDER
  ========================================================= */

  return (
    <div className="products-page min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 via-white to-indigo-50/40 p-4 text-slate-900 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 dark:text-slate-100">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px]">

        {/* PAGE HEADING */}

        <div className="mb-8 flex flex-col justify-between gap-5 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="relative flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-600 to-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/20">
              <Package
                size={27}
                strokeWidth={1.8}
              />

              <span className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 h-4 w-4 rounded-full border-[3px] border-white bg-emerald-400" />
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="mb-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 sm:text-3xl">
                  Product Master
                </h1>

                <span className="rounded-full border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-700">
                  Inventory
                </span>
              </div>

              <p className="max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">
                Manage your product catalogue, variants,
                pricing, accounting and inventory in one place.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {!showForm && (
            <ActionButton
              variant="primary"
              onClick={openNewProduct}
              className="min-h-12 px-5"
            >
              <Plus size={19} />
              Add New Product
              <ArrowUpRight
                size={16}
                className="ml-1 opacity-70"
              />
            </ActionButton>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* NOTIFICATIONS */}

        <Notification
          type="error"
          message={error}
          onClose={() => setError("")}
        />

        <Notification
          type="success"
          message={notice}
          onClose={() => setNotice("")}
        />

        {!showForm ? (
          <>
            {/* SUMMARY CARDS */}

            <div className="mb-7 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
              <SummaryCard
                title="Total Products"
                value={products.length}
                description="All registered products"
                icon={Package}
                color="blue"
              />
