              <SummaryCard
                title="Total Sub-Products"
                value={totalSubProducts}
                description="Variants across your catalogue"
                icon={Boxes}
                color="purple"
              />

              <SummaryCard
                title="Active Products"
                value={activeProducts}
                description={`${Math.max(
                  0,
                  products.length - activeProducts
                )} inactive product(s)`}
                icon={CheckCircle2}
                color="green"
              />
            </div>

            {/* PRODUCT CATALOGUE */}

            <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white shadow-sm shadow-slate-200/50">

              {/* TABLE HEADER */}

              <div className="border-b border-slate-100 p-5 sm:p-6">
                <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-5 xl:flex-row xl:items-center">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <h2 className="text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                        Product Catalogue
                      </h2>

                      <span className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                        {filteredProducts.length}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-slate-500">
                      View, search, edit and maintain your products.
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">

                    {/* SEARCH */}

                    <div className="relative min-w-0 sm:w-72">
                      <Search
                        size={18}
                        className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                      />

                      <Input
                        value={search}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          setSearch(event.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="Search code, name, barcode..."
                        className="pl-10"
                      />
                    </div>

                    {/* STATUS FILTER */}

                    <div className="relative sm:w-40">
                      <SlidersHorizontal
                        size={15}
                        className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                      />

                      <Select
                        value={statusFilter}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          setStatusFilter(event.target.value)
                        }
                        className="pl-9"
                        aria-label="Filter products by status"
                      >
                        <option value="all">
                          All statuses
                        </option>

                        <option value="active">
                          Active only
                        </option>

                        <option value="inactive">
                          Inactive only
                        </option>
                      </Select>
                    </div>

                    {/* REFRESH */}

                    <ActionButton
                      onClick={refreshProducts}
                      disabled={loading}
                    >
                      <RefreshCw
                        size={16}
                        className={
                          loading ? "animate-spin" : ""
                        }
                      />

                      Refresh
                    </ActionButton>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* TABLE */}

              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full min-w-[1100px] text-left text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/90 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-slate-500">
                      <th className="px-5 py-4 font-bold">
                        Product
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-4 py-4 font-bold">
                        Category
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-4 py-4 font-bold">
                        UOM
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-4 py-4 text-right font-bold">
                        Available Stock
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-4 py-4 text-right font-bold">
                        Cost Price
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-4 py-4 text-right font-bold">
                        Sale Price
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-4 py-4 font-bold">
                        Status
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold">
                        Actions
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                    {loading ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td
                          colSpan={8}
                          className="px-5 py-16 text-center"
                        >
                          <RefreshCw
                            size={23}
                            className="mx-auto mb-3 animate-spin text-indigo-500"
                          />

                          <p className="font-medium text-slate-700">
                            Loading product catalogue...
                          </p>

                          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">
                            Fetching products and inventory.
                          </p>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : filteredProducts.length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={8}>
                          <EmptyState
                            icon={Package}
                            title={
                              search || statusFilter !== "all"
                                ? "No matching products"
                                : "Your catalogue is empty"
                            }
                            description={
                              search || statusFilter !== "all"
                                ? "Try another search term or change the status filter."
                                : "Create your first product to start managing inventory."
                            }
                          />
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      filteredProducts.map((product) => {
                        const id = getProductId(product);

                        const stock =
                          productStock.get(String(id)) ?? 0;

                        const active =
                          isActiveProduct(product);

                        const lowStock =
                          Number(product.minimum_stock || 0) > 0 &&
                          stock <=
                            Number(product.minimum_stock || 0);

                        return (
                          <tr
                            key={id ?? product.sku}
                            className="group transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-indigo-50/40"
                          >
                            {/* PRODUCT */}

                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 transition group-hover:border-indigo-100 group-hover:from-indigo-50 group-hover:to-blue-50">
                                  <Package
                                    size={20}
                                    strokeWidth={1.8}
                                  />
                                </div>

                                <div className="min-w-0">
                                  <p className="max-w-[260px] truncate font-bold text-slate-900">
                                    {product.product_name ||
                                      "Unnamed Product"}
                                  </p>

                                  <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-indigo-600">
                                      <Hash size={12} />

                                      {product.sku || "No SKU"}
                                    </span>

                                    {product.barcode && (
                                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                        <Barcode size={12} />

                                        {product.barcode}
                                      </span>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </td>

                            {/* CATEGORY */}

                            <td className="px-4 py-4">
                              <span className="inline-flex rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600">
                                {product.category ||
                                  "Uncategorized"}
                              </span>
                            </td>

                            {/* UOM */}

                            <td className="px-4 py-4">
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">
                                <Ruler
                                  size={13}
                                  className="text-slate-400"
                                />

                                {product.unit || "PCS"}
                              </span>
                            </td>

                            {/* STOCK */}

                            <td className="px-4 py-4 text-right">
                              <div
                                className={`inline-flex flex-col items-end rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 ${
                                  lowStock
                                    ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-800"
                                    : "text-slate-800"
                                }`}
                              >
                                <span className="font-bold tabular-nums">
                                  {formatQuantity(stock)}
                                </span>

                                <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider opacity-70">
                                  {product.unit || "PCS"}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            </td>

                            {/* COST */}

                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-4 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                              {money(product.cost_price)}
                            </td>

                            {/* SALE */}

                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-4 text-right">
                              <span className="font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900">
                                {money(product.sale_price)}
                              </span>
                            </td>

                            {/* STATUS */}

                            <td className="px-4 py-4">
                              <span
                                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold ${
                                  active
                                    ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
                                    : "border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-slate-500"
                                }`}
                              >
                                <span
                                  className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${
                                    active
                                      ? "bg-emerald-500"
                                      : "bg-slate-400"
                                  }`}
                                />

                                {active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                              </span>
                            </td>

                            {/* ACTIONS */}

                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() =>
                                    openEditProduct(product)
                                  }
                                  title="Edit product"
                                  aria-label={`Edit ${product.product_name}`}
                                  className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2.5 text-slate-500 shadow-sm transition hover:border-indigo-200 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-500/10"
                                >
                                  <Edit size={16} />
                                </button>

                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() =>
                                    deleteProduct(product)
                                  }
                                  title="Delete product"
                                  aria-label={`Delete ${product.product_name}`}
                                  className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2.5 text-slate-500 shadow-sm transition hover:border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-rose-500/10"
                                >
                                  <Trash2 size={16} />
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>

              {/* TABLE FOOTER */}

              <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70 px-5 py-4 text-xs text-slate-500 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                <span>
                  Showing{" "}

                  <strong className="text-slate-800">
                    {filteredProducts.length}
                  </strong>{" "}

                  of{" "}

                  <strong className="text-slate-800">
                    {products.length}
                  </strong>{" "}

                  products
                </span>

                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Package size={13} />
                  Product Master
                </span>
              </div>
            </section>
          </>
        ) : (
          /* =================================================
             PRODUCT FORM
          ================================================= */

          <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white shadow-lg shadow-slate-200/40">

            {/* FORM HEADER */}

            <div className="relative overflow-hidden border-b border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-indigo-50/40 to-blue-50/50 px-5 py-6 sm:px-7">
              <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-10 -top-20 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-indigo-100/40 blur-3xl" />

              <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={closeForm}
                    className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2.5 text-slate-600 shadow-sm transition hover:border-indigo-200 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-600"
                    title="Back to product list"
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft size={20} />
                  </button>

                  <div>
                    <div className="mb-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                        {editingProduct
                          ? "Edit Product"
                          : "Create New Product"}
                      </h2>

                      <span className="rounded-full border border-indigo-100 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-600">
                        {editingProduct
                          ? "Editing"
                          : "New Entry"}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
                      {currentProductId != null
                        ? `Product ID: ${currentProductId}`
                        : "Enter product details and save before adding sub-products."}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <ActionButton onClick={closeForm}>
                  <X size={16} />
                  Close Form
                </ActionButton>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-6 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-7">
              {currentProductId != null && mainStockCard}

              {/* SECTION TABS */}

              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 p-2">
                <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto">
                  {SECTIONS.map((section, index) => {
                    const Icon = section.icon;

                    const selected =
                      activeSection === section.id;

                    const sectionVariants =
                      subProductsByProduct[
                        String(currentProductId)
                      ] || [];

                    return (
                      <button
                        key={section.id}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setActiveSection(section.id)
                        }
                        className={`relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold transition duration-200 ${
                          selected
                            ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/20"
                            : "border border-transparent bg-white/60 text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-200 hover:bg-white hover:text-slate-900"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <Icon size={17} />

                        {section.label}

                        {section.id === "subproducts" && (
                          <span
                            className={`min-w-5 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                              selected
                                ? "bg-white/20 text-white"
                                : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {variants.length ||
                              sectionVariants.length}
                          </span>
                        )}

                        {selected && (
                          <span className="absolute inset-x-4 -bottom-2 h-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-300" />
                        )}

                        <span className="sr-only">
                          Section {index + 1}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* =================================================
                  PRIMARY SECTION
              ================================================= */}

              {activeSection === "primary" && (
                <div className="space-y-6">
                  <SectionHeading
                    eyebrow="Product details"
                    title="Primary Information"
                    description="Set up the product identity, classification, measurements and general details."
                    icon={Package}
                  />

                  {/* IDENTIFICATION */}

                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-4 sm:p-6">
                    <div className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
                      <div className="h-5 w-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-500" />

                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
                        Identification
                      </h4>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-5 gap-y-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">

                      <Field label="Product Code / SKU">
                        <Input
                          value={form.sku}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField("sku", event.target.value)
                          }
                          placeholder="e.g. ITEM-001"
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field
                        label="Product Name"
                        required
                      >
                        <Input
                          value={form.productName}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField(
                              "productName",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          placeholder="Enter product name"
                          required
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Barcode">
                        <div className="relative">
                          <Barcode
                            size={17}
                            className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                          />

                          <Input
                            value={form.barcode}
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              setField(
                                "barcode",
                                event.target.value
                              )
                            }
                            placeholder="Scan or enter barcode"
                            className="pl-10"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </Field>

                      {/* CATEGORY */}

                      <Field label="Category">
                        {showManualCategory ? (
                          <div className="flex gap-2">
                            <Input
                              value={manualCategory}
                              onChange={(event) =>
                                setManualCategory(
                                  event.target.value
                                )
                              }
                              placeholder="New category"
                              autoFocus
                              onKeyDown={(event) => {
                                if (event.key === "Enter") {
                                  event.preventDefault();

                                  const value =
                                    manualCategory.trim();

                                  if (value) {
                                    setField(
                                      "category",
                                      value
                                    );

                                    setManualCategory("");
                                    setShowManualCategory(false);
                                  }
                                }

                                if (event.key === "Escape") {
                                  setShowManualCategory(false);
                                }
                              }}
                            />

                            <ActionButton
                              variant="primary"
                              onClick={() => {
                                const value =
                                  manualCategory.trim();

                                if (value) {
                                  setField(
                                    "category",
                                    value
                                  );

                                  setManualCategory("");
                                  setShowManualCategory(false);
                                }
                              }}
                              className="shrink-0"
                            >
                              Add
                            </ActionButton>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <Select
                            value={form.category}
                            onChange={(event) => {
                              if (
                                event.target.value ===
                                "__add_category__"
                              ) {
                                setShowManualCategory(true);
                                return;
                              }

                              setField(
                                "category",
                                event.target.value
                              );
                            }}
                          >
                            <option value="">
                              Select category
                            </option>

                            {CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
                              <option
                                key={category}
                                value={category}
                              >
                                {category}
                              </option>
                            ))}

                            {form.category &&
                              !CATEGORIES.includes(
                                form.category
                              ) && (
                                <option value={form.category}>
                                  {form.category}
                                </option>
                              )}

                            <option value="__add_category__">
                              + Add category
                            </option>
                          </Select>
                        )}
                      </Field>

                      {/* UNIT */}

                      <Field
                        label="Unit of Measurement"
                        required
                      >
                        {showManualUnit ? (
                          <div className="flex gap-2">
                            <Input
                              value={manualUnit}
                              onChange={(event) =>
                                setManualUnit(
                                  event.target.value
                                )
                              }
                              placeholder="New unit"
                              autoFocus
                              onKeyDown={(event) => {
                                if (event.key === "Enter") {
                                  event.preventDefault();

                                  const value =
                                    manualUnit.trim();

                                  if (value) {
                                    setField("unit", value);

                                    setManualUnit("");
                                    setShowManualUnit(false);
                                  }
                                }

                                if (event.key === "Escape") {
                                  setShowManualUnit(false);
                                }
                              }}
                            />

                            <ActionButton
                              variant="primary"
                              onClick={() => {
                                const value =
                                  manualUnit.trim();

                                if (value) {
                                  setField("unit", value);

                                  setManualUnit("");
                                  setShowManualUnit(false);
                                }
                              }}
                              className="shrink-0"
                            >
                              Add
                            </ActionButton>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <Select
                            value={form.unit}
                            onChange={(event) => {
                              if (
                                event.target.value ===
                                "__add_unit__"
                              ) {
                                setShowManualUnit(true);
                                return;
                              }

                              setField(
                                "unit",
                                event.target.value
                              );
                            }}
                            required
                          >
                            {UNITS.map((unit) => (
                              <option
                                key={unit}
                                value={unit}
                              >
                                {unit}
                              </option>
                            ))}

                            {form.unit &&
                              !UNITS.includes(form.unit) && (
                                <option value={form.unit}>
                                  {form.unit}
                                </option>
                              )}

                            <option value="__add_unit__">
                              + Add unit
                            </option>
                          </Select>
                        )}
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Item Type">
                        <Select
                          value={form.itemType}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField(
                              "itemType",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                        >
                          <option value="Stock Item">
                            Stock Item
                          </option>

                          <option value="Service">
                            Service
                          </option>

                          <option value="Non Stock Item">
                            Non Stock Item
                          </option>
                        </Select>
                      </Field>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* PRODUCT ATTRIBUTES */}

                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-4 sm:p-6">
                    <div className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
                      <div className="h-5 w-1 rounded-full bg-violet-500" />

                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
                        Product Attributes
                      </h4>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-5 gap-y-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                      <Field label="Brand">
                        <Input
                          value={form.brand}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField("brand", event.target.value)
                          }
                          placeholder="Brand"
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Model">
                        <Input
                          value={form.model}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField("model", event.target.value)
                          }
                          placeholder="Model"
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Color">
                        <Input
                          value={form.color}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField("color", event.target.value)
                          }
                          placeholder="Color"
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Size">
                        <Input
                          value={form.size}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField("size", event.target.value)
                          }
                          placeholder="Size"
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Design">
                        <Input
                          value={form.design}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField("design", event.target.value)
                          }
                          placeholder="Design"
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field
                        label="Minimum Stock"
                        hint="Used as a reference for low-stock monitoring."
                      >
                        <Input
                          type="number"
                          min="0"
                          step="0.001"
                          value={form.minimumStock}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField(
                              "minimumStock",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                        />
                      </Field>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* ADDITIONAL INFORMATION */}

                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-4 sm:p-6">
                    <div className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
                      <div className="h-5 w-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />

                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
                        Additional Information
                      </h4>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-5 gap-y-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">

                      <Field label="Image URL">
                        <div className="relative">
                          <ImageIcon
                            size={17}
                            className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                          />

                          <Input
                            value={form.image}
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              setField(
                                "image",
                                event.target.value
                              )
                            }
                            placeholder="Optional image URL"
                            className="pl-10"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Banner Sequence">
                        <Input
                          type="number"
                          min="0"
                          value={form.bannerSequence}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField(
                              "bannerSequence",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Status">
                        <Select
                          value={
                            form.isActive
                              ? "active"
                              : "inactive"
                          }
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField(
                              "isActive",
                              event.target.value === "active"
                            )
                          }
                        >
                          <option value="active">
                            Active
                          </option>

                          <option value="inactive">
                            Inactive
                          </option>
                        </Select>
                      </Field>

                      <Field
                        label="Description"
                        className="md:col-span-2 xl:col-span-3"
                      >
                        <TextArea
                          rows={3}
                          value={form.description}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField(
                              "description",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          placeholder="Enter product details, specifications or notes..."
                        />
                      </Field>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* =================================================
                  SUB-PRODUCTS SECTION
              ================================================= */}

              {activeSection === "subproducts" && (
                <div className="space-y-6">
                  <SectionHeading
                    eyebrow="Product variations"
                    title="Sub-Products & Variants"
                    description="Create variant codes and barcodes, define unit conversions, and manage variant-level prices."
                    icon={Layers3}
                  />

                  {currentProductId == null && (
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4 text-sm text-amber-900">
                      <AlertCircle
                        size={19}
                        className="mt-0.5 shrink-0"
                      />

                      <div>
                        <p className="font-bold">
                          Save the main product first
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-1 leading-5 text-amber-800">
                          Sub-products can be added after
                          the main product has been saved
                          and has an ID.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* VARIANT FORM */}

                  <form
                    onSubmit={submitVariant}
                    className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm"
                  >
                    <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/80 px-5 py-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="rounded-xl bg-indigo-100 p-2.5 text-indigo-700">
                          {editingVariantId != null ? (
                            <Edit size={19} />
                          ) : (
                            <Plus size={19} />
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div>
                          <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                            {editingVariantId != null
                              ? "Edit Sub-Product"
                              : "Add a Sub-Product"}
                          </h4>

                          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                            Fields marked with * are required.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {editingVariantId != null && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={clearVariantForm}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 transition hover:text-rose-600"
                        >
                          <X size={15} />
                          Cancel edit
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-5 gap-y-5 p-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">

                      <Field
                        label="Sub-Product Code"
                        required
                      >
                        <Input
                          value={variantForm.code}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setVariantField(
                              "code",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          placeholder="e.g. ITEM-001-PCS"
                          required
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field
                        label="Sub-Product Name"
                        required
                      >
                        <Input
                          value={variantForm.name}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setVariantField(
                              "name",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          placeholder="e.g. Single Piece"
                          required
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Barcode">
                        <Input
                          value={variantForm.barcode}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setVariantField(
                              "barcode",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          placeholder="Scan or enter barcode"
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field
                        label="Sub-Product Unit"
                        required
                      >
                        <Select
                          value={variantForm.unit}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setVariantField(
                              "unit",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          required
                        >
                          {UNITS.map((unit) => (
                            <option
                              key={unit}
                              value={unit}
                            >
                              {unit}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </Select>
                      </Field>

                      <Field
                        label="Units per Main Product"
                        required
                        hint={`Example: one ${
                          form.unit || "BOX"
                        } contains 10 PCS, so enter 10.`}
                      >
                        <Input
                          type="number"
                          min="0.001"
                          step="0.001"
                          value={
                            variantForm.units_per_parent
                          }
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setVariantField(
                              "units_per_parent",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          required
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Color">
                        <Input
                          value={variantForm.color}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setVariantField(
                              "color",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          placeholder="Color"
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Size">
                        <Input
                          value={variantForm.size}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setVariantField(
                              "size",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          placeholder="Size"
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Design">
                        <Input
                          value={variantForm.design}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setVariantField(
                              "design",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          placeholder="Design"
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Cost Price">
                        <Input
                          type="number"
                          min="0"
                          step="0.01"
                          value={variantForm.cost_price}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setVariantField(
                              "cost_price",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                        />
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Sale Price">
                        <Input
                          type="number"
                          min="0"
                          step="0.01"
                          value={variantForm.sale_price}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setVariantField(
                              "sale_price",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                        />
                      </Field>
                    </div>

                    {/* VARIANT ACTIONS */}

                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/50 px-5 py-4">
                      <ActionButton
                        type="submit"
                        variant="primary"
                        disabled={
                          savingVariant ||
                          currentProductId == null
                        }
                      >
                        {savingVariant ? (
                          <RefreshCw
                            size={16}
                            className="animate-spin"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <Save size={16} />
                        )}

                        {savingVariant
                          ? "Saving..."
                          : editingVariantId != null
                            ? "Update Sub-Product"
                            : "Save Sub-Product"}
                      </ActionButton>

                      <ActionButton
                        onClick={clearVariantForm}
                      >
                        <X size={16} />
                        Clear Fields
                      </ActionButton>
                    </div>
                  </form>

                  {/* SAVED VARIANTS */}

                  <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-4">
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                          Saved Sub-Products
                        </h4>

                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                          {variants.length} variant(s) registered
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      <span className="rounded-xl bg-violet-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-violet-700">
                        {variants.length} total
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                      <table className="w-full min-w-[1100px] text-left text-sm">
                        <thead>
                          <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                            <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold">
                              Code
                            </th>

                            <th className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold">
                              Sub-Product
                            </th>

                            <th className="px-3 py-3.5 font-bold">
                              UOM
                            </th>

                            <th className="px-3 py-3.5 font-bold">
                              Color
                            </th>

                            <th className="px-3 py-3.5 font-bold">
                              Size
                            </th>

                            <th className="px-3 py-3.5 font-bold">
                              Barcode
                            </th>

                            <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-bold">
                              Available Stock
                            </th>

                            <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-bold">
                              Conversion
                            </th>

                            <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-bold">
                              Cost
                            </th>

                            <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-bold">
                              Sale
                            </th>

                            <th className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-bold">
                              Actions
                            </th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>

                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                          {currentProductId == null ? (
                            <tr>
                              <td colSpan={11}>
                                <EmptyState
                                  title="Main product not saved"
                                  description="Save the main product before creating variants."
                                />
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          ) : variants.length === 0 ? (
                            <tr>
                              <td colSpan={11}>
                                <EmptyState
                                  icon={Boxes}
                                  title="No sub-products yet"
                                  description="Add your first sub-product using the form above."
                                />
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          ) : (
                            variants.map((variant) => (
                              <tr
                                key={
                                  getVariantId(variant) ??
                                  `${variant.sku}-${variant.barcode}`
                                }
                                className="transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50/40"
                              >
                                <td className="px-4 py-3.5 font-bold text-indigo-700">
                                  {variant.sku || "â€”"}
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3.5 font-semibold text-slate-800">
                                  {variant.sub_product_name ||
                                    "â€”"}
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-3 py-3.5">
                                  <span className="rounded-md bg-slate-100 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">
                                    {variant.unit || "PCS"}
                                  </span>
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-3 py-3.5 text-slate-600">
                                  {variant.color || "â€”"}
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-3 py-3.5 text-slate-600">
                                  {variant.size || "â€”"}
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-3 py-3.5 text-slate-600">
                                  {variant.barcode || "â€”"}
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right">
                                  <span className="font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-800">
                                    {formatQuantity(
                                      variant.available_stock
                                    )}
                                  </span>

                                  <span className="ml-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                                    {variant.unit || "PCS"}
                                  </span>

                                  {variant.stock_source ===
                                    "conversion" && (
                                    <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                                      From main stock
                                    </div>
                                  )}
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                                  {formatQuantity(
                                    variant.units_per_parent ?? 1
                                  )}

                                  <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                                    per {form.unit || "main unit"}
                                  </span>
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                                  {money(variant.cost_price)}
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-800">
                                  {money(variant.sale_price)}
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3.5">
                                  <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                                    <button
                                      type="button"
                                      onClick={() =>
                                        editVariant(variant)
                                      }
                                      title="Edit sub-product"
                                      className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2 text-slate-500 transition hover:border-indigo-200 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-600"
                                    >
                                      <Edit size={15} />
                                    </button>

                                    <button
                                      type="button"
                                      onClick={() =>
                                        deleteVariant(variant)
                                      }
                                      title="Delete sub-product"
                                      className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2 text-slate-500 transition hover:border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600"
                                    >
                                      <Trash2 size={15} />
                                    </button>
                                  </div>
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                            ))
                          )}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* =================================================
                  SALES SECTION
              ================================================= */}

              {activeSection === "sales" && (
                <div className="space-y-6">
                  <SectionHeading
                    eyebrow="Selling configuration"
                    title="Sales Information"
                    description="Configure the selling unit, price and accounts used by sales transactions."
                    icon={ShoppingCart}
                  />

                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-4 sm:p-6">
                    <div className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
                      <div className="h-5 w-1 rounded-full bg-blue-500" />

                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
                        Pricing & Accounts
                      </h4>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-5 gap-y-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">

                      <Field label="Sales Unit">
                        <Select
                          value={form.salesUnit}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField(
                              "salesUnit",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                        >
                          {UNITS.map((unit) => (
                            <option
                              key={unit}
                              value={unit}
                            >
                              {unit}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </Select>
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Sale Price">
                        <div className="relative">
                          <CircleDollarSign
                            size={17}
                            className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-emerald-600"
                          />

                          <Input
                            type="number"
                            min="0"
                            step="0.01"
                            value={form.salePrice}
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              setField(
                                "salePrice",
                                event.target.value
                              )
                            }
                            className="pl-10"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </Field>

                      {renderAccountSelect(
                        "Sales Account",
                        "salesAccount"
                      )}

                      {renderAccountSelect(
                        "Receivable Account",
                        "receivableAccount"
                      )}

                      <Field
                        label="Sales Description"
                        className="md:col-span-2 xl:col-span-3"
                      >
                        <TextArea
                          rows={3}
                          value={form.salesDescription}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField(
                              "salesDescription",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          placeholder="Description shown on sales documents"
                        />
                      </Field>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-blue-100 bg-blue-50/60 p-4">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                      <div className="rounded-xl bg-white p-2.5 text-blue-600 shadow-sm">
                        <ShoppingCart size={19} />
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-blue-950">
                          Sales configuration
                        </h4>

                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-blue-800/80">
                          Check your sales unit, selling price
                          and linked accounts before saving
                          product changes.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* =================================================
                  PURCHASE SECTION
              ================================================= */}

              {activeSection === "purchase" && (
                <div className="space-y-6">
                  <SectionHeading
                    eyebrow="Purchasing configuration"
                    title="Purchase Information"
                    description="Set purchase units, costs and purchase accounting details."
                    icon={Truck}
                  />

                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-4 sm:p-6">
                    <div className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
                      <div className="h-5 w-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500" />

                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
                        Purchase Pricing & Accounts
                      </h4>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-5 gap-y-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">

                      <Field label="Purchase Unit">
                        <Select
                          value={form.purchaseUnit}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField(
                              "purchaseUnit",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                        >
                          {UNITS.map((unit) => (
                            <option
                              key={unit}
                              value={unit}
                            >
                              {unit}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </Select>
                      </Field>

                      <Field label="Cost Price">
                        <div className="relative">
                          <CircleDollarSign
                            size={17}
                            className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-amber-600"
                          />

                          <Input
                            type="number"
                            min="0"
                            step="0.01"
                            value={form.costPrice}
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              setField(
                                "costPrice",
                                event.target.value
                              )
                            }
                            className="pl-10"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </Field>

                      {renderAccountSelect(
                        "Purchase Account",
                        "purchaseAccount"
                      )}

                      <Field
                        label="Purchase Description"
                        className="md:col-span-2 xl:col-span-3"
                      >
                        <TextArea
                          rows={3}
                          value={form.purchaseDescription}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            setField(
                              "purchaseDescription",
                              event.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          placeholder="Description shown on purchase documents"
                        />
                      </Field>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-amber-100 bg-amber-50/60 p-4">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                      <div className="rounded-xl bg-white p-2.5 text-amber-600 shadow-sm">
                        <Truck size={19} />
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-950">
                          Purchase configuration
                        </h4>

                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-amber-900/75">
                          Confirm your purchase unit, cost
                          and purchase account so purchase
                          transactions use the correct
                          product information.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* =================================================
                  ACCOUNTS SECTION
              ================================================= */}

              {activeSection === "accounts" && (
                <div className="space-y-6">
                  <SectionHeading
                    eyebrow="Accounting setup"
                    title="Accounting Information"
                    description="Link the product to the appropriate chart-of-accounts entries."
                    icon={Wallet}
                  />

                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-4 sm:p-6">
                    <div className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
                      <div className="h-5 w-1 rounded-full bg-violet-500" />

                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
                        General Ledger Accounts
                      </h4>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-5 gap-y-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                      {renderAccountSelect(
                        "Sales Account",
                        "salesAccount"
                      )}

                      {renderAccountSelect(
                        "Receivable Account",
                        "receivableAccount"
                      )}

                      {renderAccountSelect(
                        "Purchase Account",
                        "purchaseAccount"
                      )}

                      {renderAccountSelect(
                        "Inventory Account",
                        "inventoryAccount"
                      )}

                      {renderAccountSelect(
                        "Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Account",
                        "cogsAccount"
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-violet-100 bg-violet-50/60 p-4">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                      <div className="rounded-xl bg-white p-2.5 text-violet-600 shadow-sm">
                        <Wallet size={19} />
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-violet-950">
                          Accounting reminder
                        </h4>

                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-violet-900/75">
                          Select the correct accounts according
                          to your company&apos;s chart of accounts.
                          Your account selections are saved
                          with the product.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* =================================================
                FOOTER ACTIONS
            ================================================= */}

            <div className="sticky bottom-0 z-10 border-t border-slate-200 bg-white/95 px-4 py-4 backdrop-blur-md sm:px-6 lg:px-7">
              <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-slate-100 text-slate-500">
                    <Package size={14} />
                  </span>

                  <span>
                    {currentProductId != null ? (
                      <>
                        Product ID:{" "}

                        <strong className="text-slate-800">
                          {currentProductId}
                        </strong>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      "Save the main product before adding sub-products."
                    )}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">

                  {activeSection !== "primary" && (
                    <ActionButton
                      onClick={() => {
                        const index =
                          SECTIONS.findIndex(
                            (section) =>
                              section.id === activeSection
                          );

                        setActiveSection(
                          SECTIONS[
                            Math.max(0, index - 1)
                          ].id
                        );
                      }}
                    >
                      <ChevronLeft size={16} />
                      Previous
                    </ActionButton>
                  )}

                  {activeSection !== "accounts" && (
                    <ActionButton
                      onClick={() => {
                        const index =
                          SECTIONS.findIndex(
                            (section) =>
                              section.id === activeSection
                          );

                        setActiveSection(
                          SECTIONS[
                            Math.min(
                              SECTIONS.length - 1,
                              index + 1
                            )
                          ].id
                        );
                      }}
                    >
                      Next Section
                      <ChevronRight size={16} />
                    </ActionButton>
                  )}

                  <ActionButton
                    variant="primary"
                    onClick={() =>
                      submitProduct({
                        preventDefault() {},
                      })
                    }
                    disabled={saving}
                    className="min-w-[190px]"
                  >
                    {saving ? (
                      <RefreshCw
                        size={17}
                        className="animate-spin"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <Save size={17} />
                    )}

                    {saving
                      ? "Saving Product..."
                      : editingProduct
                        ? "Save Changes"
                        : "Save Main Product"}
                  </ActionButton>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* =========================================================
   DATE AND FORM HELPERS
========================================================= */

const getToday = () => {
    const date = new Date();

    return `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(
        date.getMonth() + 1
    ).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
};

const createEmptyForm = () => ({
    paymentNumber: "",
    purchaseId: "",
    paymentDate: getToday(),
    amount: "",
    paymentMethod: "CASH",
    referenceNumber: "",
    notes: "",
});

const formatAmount = (value) =>
    Number(value || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
        minimumFractionDigits: 2,
        maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    });

const getPaymentAmount = (payment) => Number(payment?.amount || 0);

const getPurchaseBalance = (purchase) =>
    Number(purchase?.balance_amount || 0);

const getPaymentIdentifier = (payment) =>
    payment?.payment_number || `PAY-${payment?.payment_id ?? "-"}`;

const getPaymentMethodLabel = (method) => {
    const methods = {
        CASH: "Cash",
        BANK: "Bank",
        CHEQUE: "Cheque",
        CARD: "Card",
        OTHER: "Other",
    };

    return methods[String(method || "").toUpperCase()] || method || "â€”";
};
