                <path d="M6 18H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h16a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2" />
                <path d="M6 14h12v7H6z" />
                <path d="M18 12h.01" />
            </>
        ),
        save: (
            <>
                <path d="M19 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h11l5 5v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2Z" />
                <path d="M17 21v-8H7v8M7 3v5h8" />
            </>
        ),
        arrowLeft: (
            <>
                <path d="m12 19-7-7 7-7" />
                <path d="M19 12H5" />
            </>
        ),
        chevronDown: <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" />,
        building: (
            <>
                <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" />
                <path d="M9 21V9h6v12M7 7h.01M17 7h.01M7 11h.01M17 11h.01M7 15h.01M17 15h.01" />
            </>
        ),
        clock: (
            <>
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
                <path d="M12 7v5l3 2" />
            </>
        ),
        creditCard: (
            <>
                <rect x="2" y="5" width="20" height="14" rx="2" />
                <path d="M2 10h20M6 15h4" />
            </>
        ),
        note: (
            <>
                <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8Z" />
                <path d="M14 2v6h6M8 13h8M8 17h6" />
            </>
        ),
    };

    return (
        <svg
            xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
            width={size}
            height={size}
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="1.8"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            className={`shrink-0 ${className}`}
            aria-hidden="true"
        >
            {icons[name] || icons.file}
        </svg>
    );
}

/* =========================================================
   REUSABLE UI COMPONENTS
========================================================= */

const inputClass =
    "block w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 dark:placeholder:text-slate-500 dark:focus:border-blue-400 dark:focus:ring-blue-400/10";

const labelClass =
    "mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200";

function SectionTitle({ icon, title, description, action }) {
    return (
        <div className="mb-6 flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400">
                    <Icon name={icon} size={22} />
                </div>

                <div>
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-xl">
                        {title}
                    </h2>

                    {description && (
                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            {description}
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>
            </div>

            {action}
        </div>
    );
}

function StatCard({ title, value, description, icon, color }) {
    const colorClasses = {
        blue: {
            icon: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400",
            glow: "from-blue-500/10",
            border: "hover:border-blue-300 dark:hover:border-blue-500/40",
        },
        green: {
            icon: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400",
            glow: "from-emerald-500/10",
            border: "hover:border-emerald-300 dark:hover:border-emerald-500/40",
        },
        indigo: {
            icon: "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-400",
            glow: "from-indigo-500/10",
            border: "hover:border-indigo-300 dark:hover:border-indigo-500/40",
        },
    };

    const selectedColor = colorClasses[color] || colorClasses.blue;

    return (
        <div
            className={`relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-br ${selectedColor.glow} to-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md dark:border-slate-800 dark:to-slate-900 ${selectedColor.border}`}
        >
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        {title}
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
                        {value}
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        {description}
                    </p>
                </div>

                <div
                    className={`flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl ${selectedColor.icon}`}
                >
                    <Icon name={icon} size={24} />
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function Field({ label, children, hint }) {
    return (
        <div className="min-w-0">
            <label className={labelClass}>{label}</label>
            {children}
            {hint && (
                <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    {hint}
                </p>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

function StatusMessage({ type, children, onClose }) {
    const isSuccess = type === "success";

    return (
        <div
            role={isSuccess ? "status" : "alert"}
            className={`mb-5 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border px-4 py-3.5 shadow-sm ${
                isSuccess
                    ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-500/30 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300"
                    : "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-800 dark:border-red-500/30 dark:bg-red-500/10 dark:text-red-300"
            }`}
        >
            <Icon
                name={isSuccess ? "check" : "alert"}
                size={20}
                className="mt-0.5"
            />

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm font-medium leading-6">
                {children}
            </div>

            {onClose && (
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onClose}
                    aria-label="Dismiss message"
                    className="rounded-lg p-1 opacity-70 transition hover:bg-black/5 hover:opacity-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10"
                >
                    <Icon name="x" size={17} />
                </button>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

function EmptyState({ title, description, action }) {
    return (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-5 py-14 text-center">
            <div className="mb-4 flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400">
                <Icon name="receipt" size={30} />
            </div>

            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {title}
            </h3>

            <p className="mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {description}
            </p>

            {action && <div className="mt-5">{action}</div>}
        </div>
    );
}

function ReceiptField({ label, value }) {
    return (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70 p-4 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800/40">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {label}
            </p>

            <p className="mt-2 break-words text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {value || "â€”"}
            </p>
        </div>
    );
}

function ReceiptAmountRow({
    label,
    value,
    highlight = false,
    last = false,
}) {
    return (
        <div
            className={`grid grid-cols-2 ${
                !last ? "border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800" : ""
            } ${
                highlight
                    ? "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10"
                    : "bg-white dark:bg-slate-900"
            }`}
        >
            <div className="p-4 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                {label}
            </div>

            <div
                className={`p-4 text-right text-sm ${
                    highlight
                        ? "font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300"
                        : "font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100"
                }`}
            >
                {formatAmount(value)}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function PaymentMethodBadge({ method }) {
    const value = String(method || "OTHER").toUpperCase();

    const styles = {
        CASH: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 ring-emerald-600/20 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:ring-emerald-500/20",
        BANK: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 ring-blue-600/20 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:ring-blue-500/20",
        CHEQUE: "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 ring-indigo-600/20 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:ring-indigo-500/20",
        CARD: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 ring-violet-600/20 dark:bg-violet-500/10 dark:text-violet-300 dark:ring-violet-500/20",
        OTHER: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 ring-slate-500/20 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:ring-slate-600/30",
    };

    return (
        <span
            className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ring-1 ring-inset ${
                styles[value] || styles.OTHER
            }`}
        >
            {getPaymentMethodLabel(value)}
        </span>
    );
}

function LoadingScreen() {
    return (
        <div className="min-h-[60vh] bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-950 sm:p-6">
            <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl animate-pulse space-y-6">
                <div className="h-32 rounded-3xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800" />

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
                    {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, index) => (
                        <div
                            key={index}
                            className="h-36 rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800"
                        />
                    ))}
                </div>

                <div className="h-80 rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800" />
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

/* =========================================================
   MAIN PAGE
========================================================= */

export default function PurchasePaymentsPage() {
    const [purchases, setPurchases] = useState([]);
    const [payments, setPayments] = useState([]);

    const [form, setForm] = useState(createEmptyForm);

    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [popupLoading, setPopupLoading] = useState(false);

    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

    const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
    const [editingPaymentId, setEditingPaymentId] = useState(null);

    const [selectedPayment, setSelectedPayment] = useState(null);
    const [showReceipt, setShowReceipt] = useState(false);

    const [search, setSearch] = useState("");

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       API RESPONSE HELPER
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    const readApiResponse = useCallback(async (response) => {
        const text = await response.text();

        let data = {};

        if (text) {
            try {
                data = JSON.parse(text);
            } catch {
                throw new Error(
                    `Invalid API response (${response.status}). Check the server logs.`
                );
            }
        }

        if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
            throw new Error(
                data.message ||
                    data.error ||
                    `Request failed (${response.status})`
            );
        }

        return data;
    }, []);

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       FETCH DATA
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    const fetchData = useCallback(
        async ({ silent = false } = {}) => {
            if (silent) {
                setRefreshing(true);
            } else {
                setLoading(true);
            }

            try {
                const [purchasesResponse, paymentsResponse] =
                    await Promise.all([
                        fetch("/api/purchases"),
                        fetch("/api/purchase-payments"),
                    ]);

                const [purchasesData, paymentsData] = await Promise.all([
                    readApiResponse(purchasesResponse),
                    readApiResponse(paymentsResponse),
                ]);

                setPurchases(purchasesData.purchases || []);
                setPayments(paymentsData.payments || []);

                if (silent) {
                    setMessage("Payment history refreshed successfully.");
                    setError("");
                }
            } catch (err) {
                setError(err.message || "Failed to load payment data.");
            } finally {
                if (silent) {
                    setRefreshing(false);
                } else {
                    setLoading(false);
                }
            }
        },
        [readApiResponse]
    );

    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;

        async function loadInitialData() {
            try {
                const [purchasesResponse, paymentsResponse] =
                    await Promise.all([
                        fetch("/api/purchases"),
                        fetch("/api/purchase-payments"),
                    ]);

                const [purchasesData, paymentsData] = await Promise.all([
                    readApiResponse(purchasesResponse),
                    readApiResponse(paymentsResponse),
                ]);

                if (!cancelled) {
                    setPurchases(purchasesData.purchases || []);
                    setPayments(paymentsData.payments || []);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setError(err.message || "Failed to load data.");
                }
            } finally {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setLoading(false);
                }
            }
        }

        loadInitialData();

        return () => {
            cancelled = true;
        };
    }, [readApiResponse]);

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       DERIVED DATA
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    const selectedPurchase = useMemo(
        () =>
            purchases.find(
                (purchase) =>
                    Number(purchase.purchase_id) ===
                    Number(form.purchaseId)
            ),
        [purchases, form.purchaseId]
    );

    const totalPayments = useMemo(
        () => payments.reduce((sum, payment) => sum + getPaymentAmount(payment), 0),
        [payments]
    );

    const totalOutstanding = useMemo(
        () =>
            purchases.reduce(
                (sum, purchase) => sum + getPurchaseBalance(purchase),
                0
            ),
        [purchases]
    );

    const filteredPayments = useMemo(() => {
        const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

        if (!query) return payments;

        return payments.filter((payment) => {
            const searchable = [
                payment.payment_number,
                payment.purchase_number,
                payment.supplier_name,
                payment.supplier_code,
                payment.reference_number,
                payment.payment_method,
                payment.payment_date,
            ]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(" ")
                .toLowerCase();

            return searchable.includes(query);
        });
    }, [payments, search]);

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       FORM ACTIONS
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    function updateForm(name, value) {
        setForm((previous) => ({
            ...previous,
            [name]: value,
        }));
    }

    function resetForm() {
        setForm(createEmptyForm());
        setEditingPaymentId(null);
    }

    function openAddForm() {
        resetForm();
        setSelectedPayment(null);
        setShowReceipt(false);
        setError("");
        setMessage("");
        setShowForm(true);

        window.scrollTo({
            top: 0,
            behavior: "smooth",
        });
    }

    function cancelForm() {
        resetForm();
        setShowForm(false);
        setError("");
        setMessage("");
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       SAVE PAYMENT
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    async function savePayment(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        setSaving(true);
        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        try {
            if (!form.purchaseId) {
                throw new Error("Please select a purchase.");
            }

            if (!form.paymentDate) {
                throw new Error("Payment date is required.");
            }

            const amount = Number(form.amount);

            if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Payment amount must be greater than zero."
                );
            }

            const isEditing = editingPaymentId !== null;

            const payload = {
                ...form,
                paymentId: editingPaymentId,
                purchaseId: Number(form.purchaseId),
                amount,
            };

            const response = await fetch("/api/purchase-payments", {
                method: isEditing ? "PUT" : "POST",
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload),
            });

            await readApiResponse(response);

            await fetchData({ silent: true });

            setMessage(
                isEditing
                    ? "Purchase payment updated successfully."
                    : "Purchase payment recorded successfully."
            );

            resetForm();
            setShowForm(false);
            setSelectedPayment(null);
            setShowReceipt(false);
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Something went wrong.");
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       VIEW PAYMENT RECEIPT
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    async function openPayment(payment) {
        try {
            setError("");
            setMessage("");
            setPopupLoading(true);

            const response = await fetch(
                `/api/purchase-payments?id=${payment.payment_id}`
            );

            const data = await readApiResponse(response);

            const detailedPayment =
                data.payment ||
                (data.payments || []).find(
                    (item) =>
                        Number(item.payment_id) ===
                        Number(payment.payment_id)
                );

            setSelectedPayment(detailedPayment || payment);
            setShowReceipt(true);
        } catch {
            setSelectedPayment(payment);
            setShowReceipt(true);

            setError(
                "Could not load additional receipt details. Showing the available payment information."
            );
        } finally {
            setPopupLoading(false);
        }
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       EDIT PAYMENT
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    async function editPayment(payment) {
        try {
            setError("");
            setMessage("");
            setPopupLoading(true);

            let detail = payment;

            try {
                const response = await fetch(
                    `/api/purchase-payments?id=${payment.payment_id}`
                );

                const data = await readApiResponse(response);

                detail =
                    data.payment ||
                    (data.payments || []).find(
                        (item) =>
                            Number(item.payment_id) ===
                            Number(payment.payment_id)
                    ) ||
                    payment;
            } catch {
                detail = payment;
            }

            setSelectedPayment(null);
            setShowReceipt(false);

            setEditingPaymentId(detail.payment_id);

            setForm({
                paymentNumber: detail.payment_number || "",
                purchaseId: String(detail.purchase_id || ""),
                paymentDate: detail.payment_date
                    ? String(detail.payment_date).split("T")[0]
                    : getToday(),
                amount:
                    detail.amount !== null &&
                    detail.amount !== undefined
                        ? String(detail.amount)
                        : "",
                paymentMethod: detail.payment_method || "CASH",
                referenceNumber: detail.reference_number || "",
                notes: detail.notes || "",
            });

            setShowForm(true);

            setMessage(
                `Editing Payment ${detail.payment_number || detail.payment_id}`
            );

            window.scrollTo({
                top: 0,
                behavior: "smooth",
            });
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Failed to open payment for editing.");
        } finally {
            setPopupLoading(false);
        }
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       RECEIPT ACTIONS
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    function closeReceipt() {
        setShowReceipt(false);
        setSelectedPayment(null);
    }

    function printReceipt() {
        window.print();
    }

    function downloadPDF() {
        if (!selectedPayment) return;

        const payment = selectedPayment;
        const doc = new jsPDF();

        const amount = Number(payment.amount || 0).toFixed(2);

        const purchaseTotal = Number(
            payment.purchase_total ?? payment.total_amount ?? 0
        ).toFixed(2);

        const paidAmount = Number(
            payment.paid_amount ??
                payment.purchase_paid_amount ??
                0
        ).toFixed(2);

        const balanceAmount = Number(
            payment.balance_amount ??
                payment.purchase_balance_amount ??
                0
        ).toFixed(2);

        doc.setFillColor(15, 40, 75);
        doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 39, "F");

        doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
        doc.setFontSize(20);
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
        doc.text("ERP SYSTEM", 105, 16, {
            align: "center",
        });

        doc.setFontSize(12);
        doc.text("PURCHASE PAYMENT RECEIPT", 105, 27, {
            align: "center",
        });

        doc.setFontSize(10);
        doc.setTextColor(60, 70, 85);
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");

        doc.text(
            `Payment #: ${payment.payment_number || "-"}`,
            20,
            51
        );

        doc.text(
            `Date: ${formatDate(payment.payment_date)}`,
            20,
            59
        );

        doc.text(
            `Purchase #: ${payment.purchase_number || "-"}`,
            20,
            67
        );

        doc.text(
            `Supplier: ${payment.supplier_name || "-"}`,
            20,
            75
        );

        doc.text(
            `Supplier Code: ${payment.supplier_code || "-"}`,
            20,
            83
        );

        autoTable(doc, {
            startY: 94,
            head: [["Description", "Amount"]],
            body: [
                ["Purchase Total", purchaseTotal],
                ["Paid Amount", paidAmount],
                ["Payment Made", amount],
                ["Remaining Balance", balanceAmount],
            ],
            theme: "grid",
            styles: {
                fontSize: 10,
                cellPadding: 4,
                textColor: [45, 55, 72],
                lineColor: [226, 232, 240],
            },
            headStyles: {
                fillColor: [30, 64, 110],
                textColor: [255, 255, 255],
                fontStyle: "bold",
            },
            alternateRowStyles: {
                fillColor: [248, 250, 252],
            },
        });

        const finalY = doc.lastAutoTable
            ? doc.lastAutoTable.finalY + 15
            : 130;

        doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
        doc.text("Payment Method:", 20, finalY);

        doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
        doc.text(getPaymentMethodLabel(payment.payment_method), 65, finalY);

        doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
        doc.text("Reference Number:", 20, finalY + 8);

        doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
        doc.text(payment.reference_number || "-", 65, finalY + 8);

        doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
        doc.text("Notes:", 20, finalY + 20);

        doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");

        const noteLines = doc.splitTextToSize(payment.notes || "-", 165);

        doc.text(noteLines, 20, finalY + 28);

        doc.setFontSize(9);
        doc.setTextColor(120, 130, 145);
        doc.text("Generated by ERP System", 105, 285, {
            align: "center",
        });

        const filename = String(
            payment.payment_number || "purchase-payment"
        ).replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*]+/g, "-");

        doc.save(`${filename}.pdf`);
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       LOADING STATE
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    if (loading) {
        return <LoadingScreen />;
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       PAGE UI
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50/80 p-4 text-slate-900 transition-colors dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
            <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px]">
                {/* PAGE HEADER */}

                <div className="relative mb-7 overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-700 via-blue-600 to-emerald-600 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-blue-900/10 sm:p-8">
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-12 -top-16 h-56 w-56 rounded-full border-[28px] border-white/10" />

/* =========================================================
   DATE FORMATTER
========================================================= */

function formatDate(value) {
    if (!value) return "â€”";

    const date = new Date(value);

    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        return String(value);
    }

    return date.toLocaleDateString("en-PK", {
        day: "2-digit",
        month: "short",
        year: "numeric",
    });
}

const today = () => {
    const date = new Date();
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");

    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
};

function formatAmount(value) {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
        minimumFractionDigits: 2,
        maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(Number(value) || 0);
}

function formatDate(value) {
    if (!value) return "-";
    return String(value).split("T")[0];
}

function getStatusClass(status) {
    const normalized = String(status || "").toLowerCase();

    if (
        normalized.includes("paid") ||
        normalized.includes("complete") ||
        normalized.includes("received")
    ) {
        return "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300";
    }

    if (
        normalized.includes("pending") ||
        normalized.includes("draft") ||
        normalized.includes("partial")
    ) {
        return "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:border-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300";
    }

    if (
        normalized.includes("cancel") ||
        normalized.includes("reject")
    ) {
        return "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:border-red-800 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300";
    }

    return "border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:border-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:text-blue-300";
}

function SectionHeading({ icon, title, description, action }) {
    return (
        <div className="mb-6 flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-sky-100 bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-50 to-emerald-50 text-blue-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:from-slate-800 dark:to-slate-800 dark:text-sky-300">
                    <Icon name={icon} size={22} />
                </div>

                <div>
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-xl">
                        {title}
                    </h2>

                    {description && (
                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            {description}
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>
            </div>

            {action}
        </div>
    );
}

function SummaryCard({ icon, label, value, accent, description }) {
    const accents = {
        blue: "from-sky-500 to-blue-600 shadow-blue-500/20",
        green: "from-emerald-400 to-green-600 shadow-emerald-500/20",
        cyan: "from-cyan-400 to-sky-600 shadow-cyan-500/20",
    };

    return (
        <div className={`${cardClass} group relative overflow-hidden p-5 sm:p-6`}>
            <div className="absolute -right-8 -top-8 h-28 w-28 rounded-full bg-slate-100/80 transition-transform group-hover:scale-125 dark:bg-slate-800/50" />

            <div className="relative flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        {label}
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
                        {value}
                    </p>

                    {description && (
                        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            {description}
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div
                    className={`flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br text-white shadow-lg ${
                        accents[accent] || accents.blue
                    }`}
                >
                    <Icon name={icon} size={24} />
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function EmptyState({ onAdd }) {
    return (
        <div className="px-6 py-16 text-center">
            <div className="mx-auto flex h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-3xl border border-sky-100 bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-50 to-emerald-50 text-blue-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:from-slate-800 dark:to-slate-800 dark:text-sky-300">
                <Icon name="package" size={36} />
            </div>

            <h3 className="mt-5 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                No purchases found
            </h3>

            <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Your purchase records will appear here. Create your first
                purchase to start managing supplier transactions and stock.
            </p>

            <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onAdd}
                className={`${primaryButton} mt-6`}
            >
                <Icon name="plus" size={18} />
                Add Your First Purchase
            </button>
        </div>
    );
}

/* =========================================================
   PURCHASES PAGE
========================================================= */

export default function PurchasesPage() {
    const [purchases, setPurchases] = useState([]);
    const [suppliers, setSuppliers] = useState([]);
    const [warehouses, setWarehouses] = useState([]);
    const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);

    const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm);
    const [items, setItems] = useState([emptyItem()]);

    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [popupLoading, setPopupLoading] = useState(false);

    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

    const [selectedPurchase, setSelectedPurchase] = useState(null);
    const [editingPurchaseId, setEditingPurchaseId] = useState(null);
    const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
    const [search, setSearch] = useState("");

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       FETCH DATA
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
        try {
            setLoading(true);
            setError("");

            const [
                purchasesResponse,
                suppliersResponse,
                warehousesResponse,
                productsResponse,
            ] = await Promise.all([
                fetch("/api/purchases"),
                fetch("/api/suppliers"),
                fetch("/api/warehouses"),
                fetch("/api/products"),
            ]);

            const [
                purchasesData,
                suppliersData,
                warehousesData,
                productsData,
            ] = await Promise.all([
                purchasesResponse.json(),
                suppliersResponse.json(),
                warehousesResponse.json(),
                productsResponse.json(),
            ]);

            if (!purchasesResponse.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    purchasesData.message ||
                        purchasesData.error ||
                        "Failed to load purchases."
                );
            }

            if (!suppliersResponse.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    suppliersData.message ||
                        suppliersData.error ||
                        "Failed to load suppliers."
                );
            }

            if (!warehousesResponse.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    warehousesData.message ||
                        warehousesData.error ||
                        "Failed to load warehouses."
                );
            }

            if (!productsResponse.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    productsData.message ||
                        productsData.error ||
                        "Failed to load products."
                );
            }

            setPurchases(purchasesData.purchases || []);
            setSuppliers(suppliersData.suppliers || []);
            setWarehouses(warehousesData.warehouses || []);
            setProducts(productsData.products || []);
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Failed to load data.");
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadPurchases() {
        try {
            await fetchData({ isCancelled: () => cancelled });
        } catch (error) {
            if (!cancelled) {
                console.error("Failed to load purchases:", error);
            }
        }
    }

    loadPurchases();

    return () => {
        cancelled = true;
    };
}, [fetchData]);

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       FORM HELPERS
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    function updateForm(name, value) {
        setForm((previous) => ({
            ...previous,
            [name]: value,
        }));
    }

    function updateItem(index, name, value) {
        setItems((previous) => {
            const updated = [...previous];

            updated[index] = {
                ...updated[index],
                [name]: value,
            };

            if (name === "productId" && value) {
                const product = products.find(
                    (entry) =>
                        Number(entry.product_id) === Number(value)
                );

                if (product) {
                    updated[index].unitCost =
                        Number(product.cost_price) || 0;
                }
            }

            return updated;
        });
    }

    function addItem() {
        setItems((previous) => [...previous, emptyItem()]);
    }

    function removeItem(index) {
        setItems((previous) => {
            if (previous.length === 1) return previous;

            return previous.filter(
                (_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index
            );
        });
    }

    function calculateLine(item) {
        const quantity = Number(item.quantity) || 0;
        const unitCost = Number(item.unitCost) || 0;
        const discount = Number(item.discount) || 0;
        const tax = Number(item.tax) || 0;

        return quantity * unitCost - discount + tax;
    }

    const subtotal = useMemo(
        () =>
            items.reduce(
                (sum, item) => sum + calculateLine(item),
                0
            ),
        [items]
    );

    const total = useMemo(
        () =>
            subtotal -
            (Number(form.discount) || 0) +
            (Number(form.tax) || 0),
        [subtotal, form.discount, form.tax]
    );

    const totalPurchaseValue = useMemo(
        () =>
            purchases.reduce(
                (sum, purchase) =>
                    sum + (Number(purchase.total_amount) || 0),
                0
            ),
        [purchases]
    );

    const totalOutstanding = useMemo(
        () =>
            purchases.reduce(
                (sum, purchase) =>
                    sum + (Number(purchase.balance_amount) || 0),
                0
            ),
        [purchases]
    );

    const filteredPurchases = useMemo(() => {
        const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

        if (!query) return purchases;

        return purchases.filter((purchase) =>
            [
                purchase.purchase_number,
                purchase.supplier_name,
                purchase.supplier_code,
                purchase.warehouse_name,
                purchase.status,
                formatDate(purchase.purchase_date),
            ].some((value) =>
                String(value || "").toLowerCase().includes(query)
            )
        );
    }, [purchases, search]);

    function resetForm() {
        setForm(emptyForm());
        setItems([emptyItem()]);
        setEditingPurchaseId(null);
    }

    function openNewPurchaseForm() {
        resetForm();
        setError("");
        setMessage("");
        setSelectedPurchase(null);
        setShowForm(true);

        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
    }

    function cancelPurchaseForm() {
        resetForm();
        setShowForm(false);
        setError("");
        setMessage("");
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       SAVE PURCHASE
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    async function savePurchase(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        setSaving(true);
        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        try {
            if (!form.purchaseNumber.trim()) {
                throw new Error("Purchase number is required.");
            }

            if (!form.supplierId) {
                throw new Error("Supplier is required.");
            }

            if (!form.warehouseId) {
                throw new Error("Warehouse is required.");
            }

            const validItems = items.filter(
                (item) =>
                    item.productId && Number(item.quantity) > 0
            );

            if (validItems.length === 0) {
                throw new Error("Add at least one valid product.");
            }

            const payload = {
                ...form,
                supplierId: Number(form.supplierId),
                warehouseId: Number(form.warehouseId),
                items: validItems.map((item) => ({
                    productId: Number(item.productId),
                    quantity: Number(item.quantity),
                    unitCost: Number(item.unitCost) || 0,
                    discount: Number(item.discount) || 0,
                    tax: Number(item.tax) || 0,
                })),
            };

            const isEditing = Boolean(editingPurchaseId);

            if (isEditing) {
                payload.purchaseId = Number(editingPurchaseId);
            }

            const response = await fetch("/api/purchases", {
                method: isEditing ? "PUT" : "POST",
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message ||
                        data.error ||
                        "Failed to save purchase."
                );
            }

            await fetchData();

            resetForm();
            setShowForm(false);
            setSelectedPurchase(null);

            setMessage(
                isEditing
                    ? "Purchase updated successfully. Stock, Items Ledger and Accounting Ledger have been updated."
                    : "Purchase created successfully. Warehouse stock has been increased."
            );

            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Something went wrong.");
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       VIEW PURCHASE
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    async function viewPurchase(purchase) {
        try {
            setError("");
            setMessage("");
            setPopupLoading(true);

            const response = await fetch(
                `/api/purchases?id=${purchase.purchase_id}`
            );

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message ||
                        data.error ||
                        "Failed to load purchase."
                );
            }

            setSelectedPurchase(data.purchase);
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Failed to load purchase.");
        } finally {
            setPopupLoading(false);
        }
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       EDIT PURCHASE
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    async function editPurchase(purchase) {
        try {
            setError("");
            setMessage("");
            setPopupLoading(true);

            const response = await fetch(
                `/api/purchases?id=${purchase.purchase_id}`
            );

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message ||
                        data.error ||
                        "Failed to load purchase."
                );
            }

            const detail = data.purchase;

            if (!detail) {
                throw new Error("Purchase details were not returned.");
            }

            setSelectedPurchase(null);
            setEditingPurchaseId(detail.purchase_id);

            setForm({
                purchaseNumber: detail.purchase_number || "",
                supplierId: detail.supplier_id
                    ? String(detail.supplier_id)
                    : "",
                warehouseId: detail.warehouse_id
                    ? String(detail.warehouse_id)
                    : "",
                purchaseDate: detail.purchase_date
                    ? formatDate(detail.purchase_date)
                    : today(),
                discount: detail.discount ?? "",
                tax: detail.tax ?? "",
                notes: detail.notes || "",
            });

            const loadedItems = (detail.items || []).map((item) => ({
                productId: String(item.product_id),
                quantity: Number(item.quantity) || 1,
                unitCost: Number(item.unit_cost) || 0,
                discount: Number(item.discount) || 0,
                tax: Number(item.tax) || 0,
            }));

            setItems(
                loadedItems.length ? loadedItems : [emptyItem()]
            );

            setShowForm(true);

            setMessage(
                `Editing Purchase ${detail.purchase_number || ""}`
            );

            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Failed to load purchase.");
        } finally {
            setPopupLoading(false);
        }
    }

    function closePurchasePopup() {
        setSelectedPurchase(null);
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       PRINT AND PDF
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    function printPurchase() {
        window.print();
    }

    function downloadPurchasePDF() {
        if (!selectedPurchase) return;

        const purchase = selectedPurchase;
        const doc = new jsPDF();

        doc.setFontSize(20);
        doc.setTextColor(30, 64, 175);
        doc.text("Purchase Report", 14, 20);

        doc.setFontSize(10);
        doc.setTextColor(80, 90, 105);

        doc.text(
            `Purchase Number: ${purchase.purchase_number || "-"}`,
            14,
            32
        );

        doc.text(
            `Purchase Date: ${formatDate(purchase.purchase_date)}`,
            14,
            40
        );

        doc.text(
            `Supplier: ${purchase.supplier_code || ""} - ${purchase.supplier_name || "-"}`,
            14,
            48
        );

        doc.text(
            `Warehouse: ${purchase.warehouse_code || ""} - ${purchase.warehouse_name || "-"}`,
            14,
            56
        );

        doc.text(`Status: ${purchase.status || "-"}`, 14, 64);

        const tableRows = (purchase.items || []).map((item) => [
            item.sku || "-",
            item.product_name || "-",
            Number(item.quantity || 0).toFixed(2),
            Number(item.unit_cost || 0).toFixed(2),
            Number(item.discount || 0).toFixed(2),
            Number(item.tax || 0).toFixed(2),
            Number(item.line_total || 0).toFixed(2),
        ]);

        autoTable(doc, {
            startY: 75,
            head: [[
                "SKU",
                "Product",
                "Qty",
                "Unit Cost",
                "Discount",
                "Tax",
                "Total",
            ]],
            body: tableRows,
            theme: "striped",
            headStyles: {
                fillColor: [37, 99, 235],
                textColor: [255, 255, 255],
            },
            styles: {
                fontSize: 8,
                cellPadding: 3,
            },
        });

        const finalY = doc.lastAutoTable
            ? doc.lastAutoTable.finalY + 10
            : 100;

        autoTable(doc, {
            startY: finalY,
            head: [["Description", "Amount"]],
            body: [
                ["Subtotal", formatAmount(purchase.subtotal)],
                ["Discount", formatAmount(purchase.discount)],
                ["Tax", formatAmount(purchase.tax)],
                ["Total", formatAmount(purchase.total_amount)],
                ["Paid", formatAmount(purchase.paid_amount)],
                ["Balance", formatAmount(purchase.balance_amount)],
            ],
            theme: "grid",
            headStyles: {
                fillColor: [5, 150, 105],
                textColor: [255, 255, 255],
            },
            styles: {
                fontSize: 9,
                cellPadding: 3,
            },
        });

        const notesY = doc.lastAutoTable
            ? doc.lastAutoTable.finalY + 15
            : finalY + 15;

        const notesLines = doc.splitTextToSize(
            `Notes: ${purchase.notes || "-"}`,
            180
        );

        if (notesY + notesLines.length * 6 > 280) {
            doc.addPage();
            doc.text(notesLines, 14, 20);
        } else {
            doc.text(notesLines, 14, notesY);
        }

        doc.save(
            `Purchase-${purchase.purchase_number || purchase.purchase_id}.pdf`
        );
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       LOADING STATE
    --------------------------------------------------------- */

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <div className="min-h-[60vh] bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-950 sm:p-8">
                <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl space-y-6">
                    <div className="h-10 w-56 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800" />

                    <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-3">
                        {[1, 2, 3].map((item) => (
                            <div
                                key={item}
                                className="h-32 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-sm dark:bg-slate-900"
                            />
                        ))}
                    </div>

                    <div className="h-72 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-sm dark:bg-slate-900" />

                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        Loading your purchase workspace...
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }

    /* =========================================================
       PAGE UI
    ========================================================= */

    return (
        <div className="min-h-full bg-slate-50/80 p-4 text-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
            <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-6">

                {/* PAGE HEADER */}

                <header className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-700 via-blue-600 to-emerald-600 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-blue-900/10 sm:p-8">
                    <div className="absolute -right-12 -top-20 h-64 w-64 rounded-full border-[35px] border-white/10" />
                    <div className="absolute -bottom-24 right-40 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-emerald-400/15 blur-2xl" />

                    <div className="relative flex flex-col gap-6 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                        <div>
                            <div className="mb-3 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-white/90 backdrop-blur">
                                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-300" />
                                INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
                            </div>

                            <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
                                Purchases
                            </h1>

                            <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-blue-50 sm:text-base">
                                Manage supplier purchases, track expenses,
                                and keep your warehouse stock organized.
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        {!showForm && (
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={openNewPurchaseForm}
                                className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-blue-700 shadow-lg transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-emerald-50"
                            >
                                <Icon name="plus" size={19} />
                                New Purchase
                            </button>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </header>

                {/* SUCCESS MESSAGE */}

                {message && (
                    <div
                        role="status"
                        className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-4 text-sm text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300"
                    >
                        <div className="flex gap-3">
                            <span className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900">
                                <Icon name="check" size={17} />
                            </span>

                            <span className="leading-6">{message}</span>
                        </div>

                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setMessage("")}
                            className="rounded-lg p-1 opacity-70 transition hover:bg-emerald-100 hover:opacity-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900"
                            aria-label="Dismiss message"
                        >
                            <Icon name="close" size={18} />
                        </button>
                    </div>
                )}

                {/* ERROR MESSAGE */}

                {error && (
                    <div
                        role="alert"
                        className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-4 text-sm text-red-800 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300"
                    >
                        <div className="flex gap-3">
                            <span className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900">
                                <Icon name="alert" size={17} />
                            </span>

                            <span className="leading-6">{error}</span>
                        </div>

                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setError("")}
                            className="rounded-lg p-1 opacity-70 transition hover:bg-red-100 hover:opacity-100 dark:hover:bg-red-900"
                            aria-label="Dismiss error"
                        >
                            <Icon name="close" size={18} />
                        </button>
                    </div>
                )}

                {/* =================================================
                    PURCHASE FORM
                ================================================= */}

                {showForm && (
                    <div className="space-y-6">
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-sky-100 bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-50 to-emerald-50 text-blue-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:from-slate-800 dark:to-slate-800 dark:text-sky-300">
                                    <Icon
                                        name={editingPurchaseId ? "edit" : "plus"}
                                        size={22}
                                    />
                                </div>

                                <div>
                                    <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-2xl">
                                        {editingPurchaseId
                                            ? "Edit Purchase"
                                            : "Create Purchase"}
                                    </h2>

                                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                        {editingPurchaseId
                                            ? "Update the purchase information and items."
                                            : "Fill in the details below to record a new purchase."}
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={cancelPurchaseForm}
                                disabled={saving}
                                className={secondaryButton}
                            >
                                <Icon name="arrowLeft" size={17} />
                                Back to History
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        {editingPurchaseId && (
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4 text-sm text-amber-800 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/30 dark:text-amber-300 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                                <p>
                                    You are editing purchase ID{" "}
                                    <strong>{editingPurchaseId}</strong>.
                                    Please review the information before saving.
                                </p>

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={cancelPurchaseForm}
                                    disabled={saving}
                                    className="self-start font-semibold underline underline-offset-4 sm:self-auto"
                                >
                                    Cancel Edit
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        )}

                        <form onSubmit={savePurchase} className="space-y-6">

                            {/* PURCHASE INFORMATION */}

                            <section className={`${cardClass} p-5 sm:p-7`}>
                                <SectionHeading
                                    icon="clipboard"
                                    title="Purchase Information"
                                    description="Enter the purchase reference, supplier, destination warehouse, and date."
                                />

                                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
                                    <div>
                                        <label className={labelClass}>
                                            Purchase Number
                                            <span className="ml-1 text-red-500">*</span>
                                        </label>

                                        <input
                                            value={form.purchaseNumber}
                                            onChange={(event) =>
                                                updateForm(
                                                    "purchaseNumber",
                                                    event.target.value
                                                )
                                            }
                                            placeholder="e.g. PUR-001"
                                            className={inputClass}
                                            required
                                        />

                                        <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                                            Enter a unique purchase reference.
                                        </p>
                                    </div>

                                    <div>
                                        <label className={labelClass}>
                                            Purchase Date
                                            <span className="ml-1 text-red-500">*</span>
                                        </label>

                                        <div className="relative">
                                            <input
                                                type="date"
                                                value={form.purchaseDate}
                                                onChange={(event) =>
                                                    updateForm(
                                                        "purchaseDate",
