"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  AlertCircle,
  ArrowDownRight,
  ArrowUpRight,
  CheckCircle2,
  CircleDollarSign,
  Clock,
  Download,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Users,
  Wallet,
  X,
  RotateCcw,
  FileText,
  UserRound,
  TrendingUp,
  Landmark,
} from "lucide-react";

const cardClass =
  "rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm transition-colors dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900";

function formatAmount(value) {
  const amount = Number(value ?? 0);

  return (Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });
}

function formatCount(value) {
  return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK");
}

function StatCard({ title, value, subtitle, icon: Icon, tone }) {
  const tones = {
    blue: {
      icon: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 ring-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400 dark:ring-blue-500/20",
      bar: "from-blue-600 to-cyan-400",
      glow: "bg-blue-500/5 dark:bg-blue-400/5",
    },
    green: {
      icon: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 ring-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:ring-emerald-500/20",
      bar: "from-emerald-500 to-green-400",
      glow: "bg-emerald-500/5 dark:bg-emerald-400/5",
    },
    violet: {
      icon: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-600 ring-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-500/10 dark:text-violet-400 dark:ring-violet-500/20",
      bar: "from-violet-500 to-blue-400",
      glow: "bg-violet-500/5 dark:bg-violet-400/5",
    },
    amber: {
      icon: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 ring-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 dark:ring-amber-500/20",
      bar: "from-amber-500 to-orange-400",
      glow: "bg-amber-500/5 dark:bg-amber-400/5",
    },
  };

  const style = tones[tone] || tones.blue;

  return (
    <div className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lg dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 sm:p-6">
      <div
        className={`pointer-events-none absolute -right-8 -top-8 h-28 w-28 rounded-full blur-2xl ${style.glow}`}
      />

      <div
        className={`absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r ${style.bar}`}
      />

      <div className="relative flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {title}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
            {value}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {subtitle}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div
          className={`flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl ring-1 ${style.icon}`}
        >
          <Icon size={23} strokeWidth={2} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Notice({ type, message, onDismiss, onRetry }) {
  if (!message) return null;

  const success = type === "success";

  return (
    <div
      role={success ? "status" : "alert"}
      className={`flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border p-4 ${
        success
          ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 dark:text-emerald-300"
          : "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-900/70 dark:bg-rose-950/30 dark:text-rose-300"
      }`}
    >
      <div className="mt-0.5 shrink-0">
        {success ? (
          <CheckCircle2 size={19} />
        ) : (
          <AlertCircle size={19} />
        )}
      </div>

      <p className="flex-1 text-sm font-medium leading-6">{message}</p>

      {!success && onRetry && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRetry}
          className="rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold underline underline-offset-2"
        >
          Retry
        </button>
      )}

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onDismiss}
        aria-label="Dismiss notification"
        className="rounded-lg p-1 transition hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10"
      >
        <X size={17} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ReceivablePage() {
  const [receivables, setReceivables] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [balanceFilter, setBalanceFilter] = useState("OUTSTANDING");

  const loadReceivables = useCallback(async () => {
    const response = await fetch("/api/receivable", {
      cache: "no-store",
    });

    const data = await response.json();

    if (!response.ok || data?.success === false) {
      throw new Error(data?.message || "Failed to load receivables.");
    }

    const list = Array.isArray(data)
      ? data
      : Array.isArray(data?.receivables)
        ? data.receivables
        : [];

    setReceivables(list);
    return list;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function initialize() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/receivable", {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || data?.success === false) {
          throw new Error(
            data?.message || "Failed to load receivables."
          );
        }

        if (cancelled) return;

        const list = Array.isArray(data)
          ? data
          : Array.isArray(data?.receivables)
            ? data.receivables
            : [];

        setReceivables(list);
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setError(err.message || "Unable to load receivables.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    initialize();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const summary = useMemo(() => {
    return receivables.reduce(
      (result, customer) => {
        const opening = Number(customer.opening_balance || 0);
        const sales = Number(customer.total_sales || 0);
        const paid = Number(customer.total_paid || 0);
        const outstanding = Math.max(
          Number(customer.receivable) || 0,
          0
        );

        result.opening += Number.isFinite(opening) ? opening : 0;
        result.sales += Number.isFinite(sales) ? sales : 0;
        result.paid += Number.isFinite(paid) ? paid : 0;
        result.outstanding += outstanding;

        if (outstanding > 0) {
          result.outstandingCustomers += 1;
        } else {
          result.settledCustomers += 1;
        }

        return result;
      },
      {
        opening: 0,
        sales: 0,
        paid: 0,
        outstanding: 0,
        outstandingCustomers: 0,
        settledCustomers: 0,
      }
    );
  }, [receivables]);

  const filteredReceivables = useMemo(() => {
    const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    return receivables.filter((customer) => {
      const balance = Number(customer.receivable) || 0;

      const matchesBalance =
        balanceFilter === "ALL" ||
        (balanceFilter === "OUTSTANDING" && balance > 0) ||
        (balanceFilter === "SETTLED" && balance <= 0);

      const searchableText = [
        customer.customer_code,
        customer.customer_name,
        customer.customer_id,
      ]
        .filter((value) => value !== null && value !== undefined)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase();

      return matchesBalance && (!query || searchableText.includes(query));
    });
  }, [receivables, search, balanceFilter]);

  async function handleRefresh() {
    setRefreshing(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      await loadReceivables();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Unable to refresh receivables.");
    } finally {
      setRefreshing(false);
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function resetFilters() {
    setSearch("");
    setBalanceFilter("OUTSTANDING");
  }

  function exportCsv() {
    const headers = [
      "Customer Code",
      "Customer Name",
      "Opening Balance",
      "Total Sales",
      "Total Paid",
      "Receivable",
    ];

    const escapeCsv = (value) => {
      const text = String(value ?? "");
      return `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
    };

    const rows = filteredReceivables.map((customer) => [
      customer.customer_code,
      customer.customer_name,
      Number(customer.opening_balance || 0).toFixed(2),
      Number(customer.total_sales || 0).toFixed(2),
      Number(customer.total_paid || 0).toFixed(2),
      Number(customer.receivable || 0).toFixed(2),
    ]);

    const csv = [headers, ...rows]
      .map((row) => row.map(escapeCsv).join(","))
      .join("\r\n");

    const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF" + csv], {
      type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;",
    });

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");

    link.href = url;
    link.download = `receivables-${new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .slice(0, 10)}.csv`;

    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();

    window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
  }

  const hasFilters =
    search.trim() !== "" || balanceFilter !== "OUTSTANDING";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-4 text-slate-900 transition-colors dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-6">
        {/* HERO HEADER */}
        <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-700 via-blue-600 to-emerald-600 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-blue-900/10 sm:p-8">
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-12 -top-20 h-64 w-64 rounded-full border-[32px] border-white/10" />
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-24 right-1/3 h-52 w-52 rounded-full bg-emerald-300/10 blur-3xl" />

          <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
              <div className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white/15 shadow-inner backdrop-blur-sm sm:h-16 sm:w-16">
                <Wallet size={30} strokeWidth={1.8} />
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/15 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide">
                    ACCOUNTING
                  </span>

                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-300/20 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-50">
                    <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-300" />
                    Customer Balances
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
                  Receivables
                </h1>

                <p className="mt-2 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-blue-50 sm:text-base">
                  Monitor outstanding customer balances, review sales and
                  payments, and keep track of money owed to your business.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleRefresh}
                disabled={refreshing || loading}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/25 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white backdrop-blur-sm transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <RefreshCw
                  size={17}
                  className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
                />
                Refresh
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={exportCsv}
                disabled={filteredReceivables.length === 0 || loading}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-blue-700 shadow-lg transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-blue-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <Download size={17} />
                Export CSV
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="relative mt-7 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-3 border-t border-white/20 pt-5 text-sm text-blue-50">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Users size={17} />
              <span>{formatCount(receivables.length)} customers</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Clock size={17} />
              <span>
                {formatCount(summary.outstandingCustomers)} with outstanding
                balances
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Activity size={17} />
              <span>Customer receivables overview</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* ERROR MESSAGE */}
        <Notice
          type="error"
          message={error}
          onDismiss={() => setError("")}
          onRetry={handleRefresh}
        />

        {/* SUMMARY CARDS */}
        <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          <StatCard
            title="Total Receivable"
            value={`PKR ${formatAmount(summary.outstanding)}`}
            subtitle="Outstanding balances above zero"
            icon={CircleDollarSign}
            tone="blue"
          />

          <StatCard
            title="Total Customer Sales"
            value={`PKR ${formatAmount(summary.sales)}`}
            subtitle="Sales recorded for listed customers"
            icon={TrendingUp}
            tone="green"
          />

          <StatCard
            title="Total Paid"
            value={`PKR ${formatAmount(summary.paid)}`}
            subtitle="Payments recorded for listed customers"
            icon={ArrowDownRight}
            tone="violet"
          />

          <StatCard
            title="Outstanding Customers"
            value={formatCount(summary.outstandingCustomers)}
            subtitle={`${formatCount(summary.settledCustomers)} customers with zero or negative balances`}
            icon={Users}
            tone="amber"
          />
        </section>

        {/* MAIN TABLE CARD */}
        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
          {/* TABLE TITLE */}
          <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:p-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400">
                <Landmark size={23} />
              </div>

              <div>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-xl">
                  Customer Receivables
                </h2>

                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Review opening balances, sales, payments, and amounts due.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-950">
              <FileText size={16} className="text-slate-500" />

              <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Showing
              </span>

              <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {filteredReceivables.length}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* SEARCH AND FILTERS */}
          <div className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950/40 sm:px-6">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
              <div className="relative flex-1">
                <Search
                  size={18}
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                />

                <input
                  type="search"
                  value={search}
                  onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search customer code or name..."
                  aria-label="Search customers"
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-sm text-slate-800 shadow-sm outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 dark:placeholder:text-slate-500 dark:focus:border-blue-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span className="mr-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  <SlidersHorizontal size={15} />
                  Filter
                </span>

                {[
                  { value: "OUTSTANDING", label: "Outstanding" },
                  { value: "ALL", label: "All Customers" },
                  { value: "SETTLED", label: "Settled" },
                ].map((filter) => (
                  <button
                    key={filter.value}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setBalanceFilter(filter.value)}
                    className={`rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold transition ${
                      balanceFilter === filter.value
                        ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm shadow-blue-600/20"
                        : "border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {filter.label}
                  </button>
                ))}

                {hasFilters && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={resetFilters}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 transition hover:bg-slate-200 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:text-white"
                  >
                    <RotateCcw size={15} />
                    Reset
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              <span>
                Showing{" "}
                <strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                  {filteredReceivables.length}
                </strong>{" "}
                of{" "}
                <strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                  {receivables.length}
                </strong>{" "}
                customers
              </span>

              {hasFilters && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Search size={13} />
                  Filters applied
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* LOADING STATE */}
          {loading ? (
            <div className="flex min-h-[300px] flex-col items-center justify-center p-10">
              <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/10">
                <RefreshCw
                  size={25}
                  className="animate-spin text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"
                />
              </div>

              <p className="mt-4 font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                Loading receivables
              </p>

              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Retrieving customer balance information...
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : filteredReceivables.length === 0 ? (
            /* EMPTY STATE */
            <div className="flex min-h-[300px] flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 text-center sm:p-12">
              <div className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-emerald-50 text-blue-600 ring-1 ring-blue-100 dark:from-blue-950/50 dark:to-emerald-950/40 dark:text-blue-400 dark:ring-slate-700">
                {hasFilters ? <Search size={28} /> : <Users size={28} />}
              </div>

              <h3 className="mt-5 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {hasFilters
                  ? "No matching customers"
                  : "No receivables found"}
              </h3>

              <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {hasFilters
                  ? "Try another customer name or code, or change the balance filter."
                  : "Customer receivable records will appear here when returned by your API."}
              </p>

              {hasFilters && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={resetFilters}
                  className="mt-5 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                >
                  <RotateCcw size={16} />
                  Clear Filters
                </button>
              )}

              {!hasFilters && error && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleRefresh}
                  disabled={refreshing}
                  className="mt-5 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <RefreshCw
                    size={16}
                    className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
                  />
                  Try Again
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* RECEIVABLES TABLE */
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full min-w-[1000px] text-left text-sm">
                <thead className="bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-slate-800/70">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Customer Code
                    </th>

                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Customer
                    </th>

                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Opening
                    </th>

                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Sales
                    </th>

                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Paid
                    </th>

                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Receivable
                    </th>

                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-center text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Status
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                  {filteredReceivables.map((customer, index) => {
                    const opening = Number(customer.opening_balance || 0);
                    const sales = Number(customer.total_sales || 0);
                    const paid = Number(customer.total_paid || 0);
                    const receivable = Number(customer.receivable || 0);
                    const outstanding = receivable > 0;

                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={
                          customer.customer_id ??
                          `${customer.customer_code}-${index}`
                        }
                        className="group transition-colors hover:bg-blue-50/50 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/20"
                      >
                        {/* CUSTOMER CODE */}
                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {customer.customer_code || "-"}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* CUSTOMER */}
                        <td className="px-5 py-4">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-100 to-emerald-100 text-blue-700 dark:from-blue-500/20 dark:to-emerald-500/20 dark:text-blue-300">
                              <UserRound size={19} />
                            </div>

                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <p className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                                {customer.customer_name || "Unnamed Customer"}
                              </p>

                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                Customer ID: {customer.customer_id ?? "-"}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* OPENING */}
                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right">
                          <span className="font-medium tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {formatAmount(opening)}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* SALES */}
                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right">
                          <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400">
                            {formatAmount(sales)}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* PAID */}
                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right">
                          <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                            {formatAmount(paid)}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* RECEIVABLE */}
                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right">
                          <span
                            className={`font-bold tabular-nums ${
                              outstanding
                                ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400"
                                : "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {formatAmount(receivable)}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* STATUS */}
                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-center">
                          <span
                            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold ring-1 ${
                              outstanding
                                ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 ring-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 dark:ring-amber-500/20"
                                : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 ring-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:ring-emerald-500/20"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {outstanding ? (
                              <ArrowUpRight size={13} />
                            ) : (
                              <CheckCircle2 size={13} />
                            )}

                            {outstanding ? "Outstanding" : "Settled"}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>

                {/* TOTALS FOOTER */}
                <tfoot className="border-t-2 border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800/60">
                  <tr>
                    <td
                      colSpan={2}
                      className="px-5 py-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100"
                    >
                      Totals for all customers
                    </td>

                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                      {formatAmount(
                        filteredReceivables.reduce(
                          (sum, item) =>
                            sum + (Number(item.opening_balance) || 0),
                          0
                        )
                      )}
                    </td>

                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400">
                      {formatAmount(
                        filteredReceivables.reduce(
                          (sum, item) =>
                            sum + (Number(item.total_sales) || 0),
                          0
                        )
                      )}
                    </td>

                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                      {formatAmount(
                        filteredReceivables.reduce(
                          (sum, item) =>
                            sum + (Number(item.total_paid) || 0),
                          0
                        )
                      )}
                    </td>

                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
                      {formatAmount(
                        filteredReceivables.reduce(
                          (sum, item) =>
                            sum + Math.max(Number(item.receivable) || 0, 0),
                          0
                        )
                      )}
                    </td>

                    <td className="px-5 py-4 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      {filteredReceivables.length} shown
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                </tfoot>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TABLE FOOTER */}
          {!loading && filteredReceivables.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 border-t border-slate-200 bg-white px-5 py-4 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:px-6">
              <p>
                Displaying {filteredReceivables.length} of{" "}
                {receivables.length} customers.
              </p>

              <p className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <CheckCircle2
                  size={14}
                  className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                />
                Customer balances are based on the API response.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>

        {/* INFORMATION PANEL */}
        {!loading && receivables.length > 0 && (
          <section className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-blue-100 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50 to-emerald-50 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 dark:from-blue-950/30 dark:to-emerald-950/20 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
            <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-sm dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-blue-400">
              <CircleDollarSign size={24} />
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                Keep track of customer outstanding balances
              </h3>

              <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Search by customer name or code, filter settled and
                outstanding accounts, and export the displayed results to CSV
                for further analysis.
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={exportCsv}
              disabled={filteredReceivables.length === 0}
              className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Download size={16} />
              Export Results
            </button>
          </section>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

async function readResponse(response) {
    const text = await response.text();
    let data = {};

    if (text) {
        try {
            data = JSON.parse(text);
        } catch {
            throw new Error(
                `Invalid server response (HTTP ${response.status}). Check the API route.`
            );
        }
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            data.message || `Request failed (HTTP ${response.status}).`
        );
    }

    return data;
}

function getCompanyLogo(company) {
    const rawLogo =
        company?.logo_url ||
        company?.logoUrl ||
        company?.company_logo_url ||
        company?.companyLogoUrl ||
        company?.company_logo ||
        company?.logo_path ||
        company?.logoPath ||
        company?.logo ||
        "";

    if (typeof rawLogo !== "string" || !rawLogo.trim()) {
        return "";
    }

    const logo = rawLogo.trim();

    if (/^(data:image\/|blob:)/i.test(logo)) {
        return logo;
    }

    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(logo)) {
        return logo;
    }

    if (logo.startsWith("//")) {
        return `${window.location.protocol}${logo}`;
    }

    return `/${logo.replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/^\/+/, "")}`;
}

function SectionHeading({ icon: Icon, title, description }) {
    return (
        <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 ring-1 ring-blue-100">
                <Icon size={21} />
            </div>

            <div>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                    {title}
                </h2>

                {description && (
                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">
                        {description}
                    </p>
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function Alert({ type = "error", children }) {
    const styles =
        type === "success"
            ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800"
            : "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-800";

    return (
        <div
            role={type === "success" ? "status" : "alert"}
            className={`flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border p-4 text-sm ${styles}`}
        >
            {type === "success" ? (
                <CheckCircle2 size={19} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            ) : (
                <X size={19} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            )}

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">{children}</div>
        </div>
    );
}

/* Company list logo: fills the entire image container. */
function CompanyLogo({ company }) {
    const logoUrl = getCompanyLogo(company);
    const [failedUrl, setFailedUrl] = useState("");

    const failed = Boolean(logoUrl && failedUrl === logoUrl);

    return (
        <div className="relative h-full w-full overflow-hidden bg-white">
            {logoUrl && !failed ? (
                <Image
                    key={logoUrl}
                    src={logoUrl}
                    alt={`${company.company_name || "Company"} logo`}
                    fill
                    unoptimized
                    sizes="(max-width: 640px) 100vw, 400px"
                    className="object-cover"
                    onError={() => setFailedUrl(logoUrl)}
                />
            ) : (
                <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-blue-50 text-blue-600">
                    <Building2 size={48} strokeWidth={1.4} />

                    <span className="mt-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
                        {failed ? "Logo unavailable" : "No company logo"}
                    </span>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

function CompanySelectionView({ onRegister }) {
    const [companies, setCompanies] = useState([]);
    const [loadingCompanies, setLoadingCompanies] = useState(true);
    const [companyError, setCompanyError] = useState(false);
    const [companyErrorMessage, setCompanyErrorMessage] = useState("");

    const loadCompanies = useCallback(async (signal) => {
        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/settings/list", {
                method: "GET",
                cache: "no-store",
                headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
                signal,
            });

            const data = await readResponse(response);

            if (signal?.aborted) return;

            setCompanies(
                Array.isArray(data.companies) ? data.companies : []
            );
            setCompanyError(false);
            setCompanyErrorMessage("");
        } catch (error) {
            if (error.name !== "AbortError" && !signal?.aborted) {
                setCompanyError(true);
                setCompanyErrorMessage(
                    error.message || "Unable to load companies."
                );
            }
        } finally {
            if (!signal?.aborted) {
                setLoadingCompanies(false);
            }
        }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    Promise.resolve().then(() => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
            loadCompanies(controller.signal);
        }
    });

    return () => controller.abort();
}, [loadCompanies]);

    function retryLoadingCompanies() {
        const controller = new AbortController();

        setLoadingCompanies(true);
        setCompanyError(false);
        setCompanyErrorMessage("");

        loadCompanies(controller.signal);
    }

    return (
        <main className="relative min-h-screen bg-slate-50 text-slate-900">
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-72 bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-100/70 via-indigo-50/40 to-transparent" />

            <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 lg:py-12">
                <header className="mb-9 flex flex-col gap-5 md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-blue-100 bg-white/90 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-700 shadow-sm">
                            <Sparkles size={14} />
                            ERP Company Portal
                        </div>

                        <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-950 sm:text-4xl">
                            Your Companies
                        </h1>

                        <p className="mt-3 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600 sm:text-base">
                            Manage your company profiles, access your ERP
                            workspace, and configure company information from
                            one place.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={onRegister}
                        className="inline-flex min-h-12 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-blue-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/20"
                    >
                        <Plus size={19} />
                        Register New Company
                    </button>
                </header>

                <div className="mb-7 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
                        <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-700">
                            <Building2 size={23} />
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
                                Registered companies
                            </p>

                            <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-900">
                                {loadingCompanies ? "â€”" : companies.length}
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
                        <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700">
                            <ShieldCheck size={23} />
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">
                                Company access
                            </p>

                            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                                Sign in using the relevant company account.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {companyError && (
                    <div className="mb-6">
                        <Alert>{companyErrorMessage}</Alert>

                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={retryLoadingCompanies}
                            className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
                        >
                            <RefreshCw size={15} />
                            Try again
                        </button>
                    </div>
                )}

                {loadingCompanies ? (
                    <div className="flex min-h-72 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
                        <LoaderCircle
                            size={34}
                            className="animate-spin text-blue-600"
                        />

                        <p className="mt-4 font-semibold text-slate-800">
                            Loading companies
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                            Please wait while we retrieve your company list.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                ) : companies.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white px-6 py-16 text-center shadow-sm">
                        <div className="mx-auto flex h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-100 to-indigo-100 text-blue-700">
                            <Building2 size={36} />
                        </div>

                        <h2 className="mt-6 text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-900">
                            Start with your first company
                        </h2>

                        <p className="mx-auto mt-3 max-w-lg text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">
                            Create a company profile to begin managing users,
                            inventory, sales, purchases, and accounts in your
                            ERP system.
                        </p>

                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={onRegister}
                            className="mt-7 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-5 py-3 font-bold text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20 hover:bg-blue-700"
                        >
                            <Plus size={18} />
                            Register Your First Company
                        </button>
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                        {companies.map((company) => (

                                key={company.company_id}
                                className="group overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-blue-200 hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-slate-200/60"
                            >
                                <div className="relative h-44 w-full overflow-hidden border-b border-slate-100">

                                    <div className="absolute left-3 top-3 z-10 rounded-full border border-white/70 bg-white/90 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 shadow-sm backdrop-blur">
                                        Company #{company.company_id}
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div className="p-5">
                                    <h2
                                        title={company.company_name}
                                        className="truncate text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900"
                                    >
                                        {company.company_name}
                                    </h2>

                                    <div className="mt-4 space-y-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
                                        {(company.address ||
                                            company.city ||
                                            company.location) && (
                                            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                                                <MapPin
                                                    size={17}
                                                    className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-blue-600"
                                                />

                                                <span className="leading-5">

                                                        company.address,
                                                        company.city,
                                                        company.location,
                                                    ]
                                                        .filter(Boolean)
                                                        .filter(
                                                            (value, index, array) =>
                                                                array.indexOf(value) === index
                                                        )
                                                        .join(", ")}
                                                </span>
                                            </div>
                                        )}

                                        {company.phone && (
                                            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                                                <Phone
                                                    size={16}
                                                    className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-slate-400"

                                                    size={16}

                                                />

                </footer>

export default function RegisterCompanyPage() {
    const [showRegistrationForm, setShowRegistrationForm] = useState(false);
    const [form, setForm] = useState(initialForm);
    const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);
    const [roles, setRoles] = useState([]);
    const [logoFile, setLogoFile] = useState(null);
    const [logoPreview, setLogoPreview] = useState("");
    const [loadingOptions, setLoadingOptions] = useState(true);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const [success, setSuccess] = useState("");

    useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController();

        async function fetchOptions() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch("/api/companies/register", {
                    method: "GET",
                    cache: "no-store",
                    headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
                    signal: controller.signal,
                });

                const data = await readResponse(response);

                if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

                const availableUsers = Array.isArray(data.users)
                    ? data.users
                    : [];
                const availableRoles = Array.isArray(data.roles)
                    ? data.roles
                    : [];

                setUsers(availableUsers);
                setRoles(availableRoles);

                setForm((current) => {
                    const currentRoleExists = availableRoles.some(
                        (role) =>
                            String(role.role_id) === current.existingRoleId
                    );

                    const defaultRole =
                        availableRoles.find(
                            (role) =>
                                role.role_name?.toUpperCase() === "USER"
                        ) || availableRoles[0];

                    return {
                        ...current,
                        existingRoleId: currentRoleExists
                            ? current.existingRoleId
                            : String(defaultRole?.role_id ?? ""),
                    };
                });
            } catch (err) {
                if (
                    err.name !== "AbortError" &&
                    !controller.signal.aborted
                ) {
                    setError(
                        err.message ||
                            "Unable to load existing users and roles."
                    );
                }
            } finally {
                if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
                    setLoadingOptions(false);
                }
            }
        }

        fetchOptions();

        return () => controller.abort();
    }, []);

    function updateField(event) {
        const { name, value } = event.target;

        setForm((current) => ({
            ...current,
            [name]: value,
        }));

        setError("");
        setSuccess("");
    }

    function changeAssignmentMode(mode) {
        setForm((current) => ({
            ...current,
            assignmentMode: mode,
        }));

        setError("");
        setSuccess("");
    }

    function handleLogoChange(event) {
        const input = event.currentTarget;
        const file = input.files?.[0];

        if (!file) return;

        if (!allowedLogoTypes.includes(file.type)) {
            setError("Choose a PNG, JPG, or WebP image.");
            input.value = "";
            return;
        }

        if (file.size > MAX_LOGO_SIZE) {
            setError("Company logo must be 2 MB or smaller.");
            input.value = "";
            return;
        }

        const reader = new FileReader();

        reader.onload = () => {
            if (typeof reader.result === "string") {
                setLogoFile(file);
                setLogoPreview(reader.result);
                setError("");
                setSuccess("");
            }
        };

        reader.onerror = () => {
            setError("Unable to read this image. Please try another file.");
            input.value = "";
        };

        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }

    function removeLogo() {
        setLogoFile(null);
        setLogoPreview("");

        const input = document.getElementById("companyLogo");
        if (input) input.value = "";

        setError("");
        setSuccess("");
    }

    function validateForm() {
        if (!form.companyName.trim()) {
            return "Company name is required.";
        }

        if (form.assignmentMode === "existingUser") {
            if (!form.existingUserId || !form.existingRoleId) {
                return "Select an existing user and their role.";
            }

            if (!form.companyPassword || !form.confirmCompanyPassword) {
                return "Enter and confirm the password for this company.";
            }

            if (form.companyPassword.length < 8) {
                return "Company password must be at least 8 characters long.";
            }

            if (form.companyPassword !== form.confirmCompanyPassword) {
                return "Company passwords do not match.";
            }
        } else {
            if (
                !form.fullName.trim() ||
                !form.username.trim() ||
                !form.adminEmail.trim() ||
                !form.password ||
                !form.confirmPassword
            ) {
                return "Complete all required administrator fields.";
            }

            if (form.password.length < 8) {
                return "Password must be at least 8 characters long.";
            }

            if (form.password !== form.confirmPassword) {
                return "Passwords do not match.";
            }
        }

        return "";
    }

    async function handleSubmit(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setError("");
        setSuccess("");

        const validationError = validateForm();

        if (validationError) {
            setError(validationError);
            return;
        }

        setLoading(true);

        try {
            const body = new FormData();

            Object.entries(form).forEach(([key, value]) => {
                body.append(key, value);
            });

            body.set(
                "existingUserId",
                form.assignmentMode === "existingUser"
                    ? form.existingUserId
                    : ""
            );

            body.set(
                "existingRoleId",
                form.assignmentMode === "existingUser"
                    ? form.existingRoleId
                    : ""
            );

            if (form.assignmentMode !== "existingUser") {
                body.set("companyPassword", "");
                body.set("confirmCompanyPassword", "");
            }

            if (logoFile) {
                body.append("companyLogo", logoFile, logoFile.name);
            }

            const response = await fetch("/api/companies/register", {
                method: "POST",
                headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
                body,
            });

            const data = await readResponse(response);

            setSuccess(
                data.message || "Company registered successfully."
            );

            setForm({
                ...initialForm,
                assignmentMode: form.assignmentMode,
                existingRoleId: form.existingRoleId,
            });

            setLogoFile(null);
            setLogoPreview("");

            const logoInput = document.getElementById("companyLogo");
            if (logoInput) logoInput.value = "";
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Company registration failed.");
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    const selectedRole = roles.find(
        (role) => String(role.role_id) === form.existingRoleId
    );

    if (!showRegistrationForm) {
        return (
            <CompanySelectionView
                onRegister={() => {
                    setError("");
                    setSuccess("");
                    setShowRegistrationForm(true);
                }}
            />
        );
    }

    return (
        <main className="relative min-h-screen bg-slate-50 text-slate-900">
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-80 bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-100/70 via-indigo-50/40 to-transparent" />

            <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-5xl px-4 py-7 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                        setShowRegistrationForm(false);
                        setError("");
                        setSuccess("");
                    }}
                    className="mb-7 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 shadow-sm transition hover:border-blue-200 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-700"
                >
                    <ArrowLeft size={17} />
                    Back to Companies
                </button>

                <header className="mb-8">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                        <div className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20">
                            <Building2 size={29} />
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <div className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-700">
                                <Sparkles size={14} />
                                Company setup
                            </div>

                            <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-950 sm:text-4xl">
                                Register Your Company
                            </h1>

                            <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600 sm:text-base">
                                Create your company profile, upload its logo,
                                and configure initial access to your ERP.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </header>

                <form
                    onSubmit={handleSubmit}
                    encType="multipart/form-data"
                    className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-xl shadow-slate-200/50"
                >
                    <div className="space-y-9 p-5 sm:p-8 lg:p-10">
                        {error && <Alert>{error}</Alert>}

                        {success && (
                            <Alert type="success">
                                <p>{success}</p>

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => {
                                        setShowRegistrationForm(false);
                                        setSuccess("");
                                    }}
                                    className="mt-2 font-bold underline underline-offset-4"
                                >
                                    Return to company list
                                </button>
                            </Alert>
                        )}

                        <section>
                            <SectionHeading
                                icon={Building2}
                                title="Company Information"
                                description="Add your company's identity and primary contact details."
                            />

                            <div className="mb-7 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-blue-100 bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50/80 via-white to-indigo-50/70 p-5 sm:p-6">
                                <div className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-3">
                                    <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white text-blue-700 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-blue-100">
                                        <ImagePlus size={20} />
                                    </div>

                                    <div>
                                        <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                                            Company logo
                                        </h3>

                                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                                            PNG, JPG, or WebP Â· Maximum 2 MB
                                        </p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.3fr)] md:items-center">
                                    {/* Registration preview: fills the entire preview container. */}
                                    <div className="relative h-48 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-inner sm:h-56">
                                        {logoPreview ? (
                                            <Image
                                                key={logoPreview}
                                                src={logoPreview}
                                                alt="Company logo preview"
                                                fill
                                                unoptimized
                                                sizes="(max-width: 768px) 100vw, 500px"
                                                className="object-cover"
                                                onError={() =>
                                                    setError(
                                                        "The selected image could not be displayed."
                                                    )
                                                }
                                            />
                                        ) : (
                                            <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-400">
                                                <Building2
                                                    size={44}
                                                    strokeWidth={1.3}
                                                />

                                                <span className="mt-3 text-xs font-semibold">
                                                    Logo preview
                                                </span>
                                            </div>
                                        )}

                                        {logoPreview && (
                                            <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 z-10 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-white/95 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 shadow-sm">
                                                Preview ready
                                            </div>
                                        )}
                                    </div>

                                    <div>

                                            will immediately appear in the

                                        <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-3">

                                                htmlFor="companyLogo"
                                                className="inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 transition hover:bg-blue-700"
                                            >

                        </section>
                    </div>

                        <button
                            type="submit"
                            disabled={
                                loading ||

                                (form.assignmentMode === "existingUser" &&

                        <p className="mt-4 text-center text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
                            Review your company information before submitting.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                </form>

                <footer className="py-6 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
                    Company Management Portal
                </footer>
            </div>
        </main>
    );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

const moneyFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
  minimumFractionDigits: 2,
  maximumFractionDigits: 2,
});

function toNumber(value) {
  const number = Number(value ?? 0);
  return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : 0;
}

function formatAmount(value) {
  return moneyFormatter.format(toNumber(value));
}

function formatCurrency(value) {
  return `PKR ${formatAmount(value)}`;
}

function getAccountKey(account, index) {
  return (
    account.account_id ??
    account.account_code ??
    `${account.account_name ?? "account"}-${index}`
  );
}

function getErrorMessage(error) {
  return error instanceof Error
    ? error.message
    : "Unable to load the balance sheet. Please try again.";
}

function downloadCSV(filename, rows) {
  const escapeCSV = (value) =>
    `"${String(value ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;

  const csv = rows
    .map((row) => row.map(escapeCSV).join(","))
    .join("\r\n");

  const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF", csv], {
    type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;",
  });

  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement("a");

  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;

  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();

  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

function SummaryCard({
  title,
  value,
  description,
  icon: Icon,
  color = "blue",
  loading,
}) {
  const themes = {
    blue: {
      icon: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500/15 dark:text-blue-300",
      gradient: "from-blue-500/10",
      hover: "hover:border-blue-300 dark:hover:border-blue-500/40",
      bar: "bg-blue-500",
    },
    green: {
      icon: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-300",
      gradient: "from-emerald-500/10",
      hover: "hover:border-emerald-300 dark:hover:border-emerald-500/40",
      bar: "bg-emerald-500",
    },
    violet: {
      icon: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-500/15 dark:text-violet-300",
      gradient: "from-violet-500/10",
      hover: "hover:border-violet-300 dark:hover:border-violet-500/40",
      bar: "bg-violet-500",
    },
  };

  const theme = themes[color] || themes.blue;

  return (
    <div
      className={`group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-br ${theme.gradient} via-white to-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg dark:border-slate-700 dark:via-slate-900 dark:to-slate-900 ${theme.hover}`}
    >
      <div className="absolute -right-7 -top-7 h-24 w-24 rounded-full bg-current opacity-[0.025] transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-125" />

      <div className="relative flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
            {title}
          </p>

          {loading ? (
            <div className="mt-4 h-8 w-36 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700" />
          ) : (
            <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
              {formatAmount(value)}
            </p>
          )}

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>

        >
          <Icon size={23} strokeWidth={2.1} />

        <div className={`h-full w-2/3 rounded-full ${theme.bar}`} />

    </div>
