function AccountSection({
  title,
  subtitle,
  accounts,
  total,
  color = "blue",
  search,
}) {
  const themes = {
    blue: {
      icon: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500/15 dark:text-blue-300",
      badge:
        "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 ring-blue-600/20 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:ring-blue-400/20",
      amount: "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300",
      dot: "bg-blue-500",
    },
    green: {
      icon: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-300",
      badge:
        "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 ring-emerald-600/20 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:ring-emerald-400/20",
      amount: "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300",
      dot: "bg-emerald-500",
    },
    violet: {
      icon: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-500/15 dark:text-violet-300",
      badge:
        "bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 ring-violet-600/20 dark:bg-violet-500/10 dark:text-violet-300 dark:ring-violet-400/20",
      amount: "text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-300",
      dot: "bg-violet-500",
    },
  };

  const theme = themes[color] || themes.blue;
  const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();

  const filteredAccounts = accounts.filter((account) => {
    const code = String(account.account_code ?? "").toLowerCase();
    const name = String(account.account_name ?? "").toLowerCase();

    return !term || code.includes(term) || name.includes(term);
  });

  const filteredTotal = filteredAccounts.reduce(
    (sum, account) => sum + toNumber(account.balance),
    0
  );

  return (
    <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm transition-shadow duration-300 hover:shadow-md dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-700 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div
            className={`flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${theme.icon}`}
          >
            <Landmark size={22} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-lg">
              {title}
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              {subtitle}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 sm:justify-end">
          <span
            className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold ring-1 ring-inset ${theme.badge}`}
          >
            {filteredAccounts.length}{" "}
            {filteredAccounts.length === 1 ? "account" : "accounts"}
          </span>

          <div className="text-right">
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Section total
            </p>
            <p
              className={`mt-1 text-sm font-extrabold tabular-nums ${theme.amount}`}
            >
              {formatAmount(filteredTotal)}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full min-w-[560px] border-collapse text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:bg-slate-800/80 dark:text-slate-400">
              <th className="px-5 py-4 text-left font-bold">Account code</th>
              <th className="px-5 py-4 text-left font-bold">Account name</th>
              <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold">
                Balance (PKR)
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>

          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
            {filteredAccounts.map((account, index) => (
              <tr
                key={getAccountKey(account, index)}
                className="transition-colors hover:bg-blue-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60"
              >
                <td className="px-5 py-4">
                  <span className="inline-flex rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                    {account.account_code || "â€”"}
                  </span>
                </td>

                <td className="px-5 py-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className={`h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${theme.dot}`} />
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                      {account.account_name || "Unnamed account"}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </td>

                <td
                  className={`px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums ${theme.amount}`}
                >
                  {formatAmount(account.balance)}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}

            {filteredAccounts.length === 0 && (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={3} className="px-5 py-12 text-center">
                  <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-500">
                    <Search size={22} />
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-3 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                    No accounts found
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Try a different account code or name.
                  </p>
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>

          {filteredAccounts.length > 0 && (
            <tfoot>
              <tr className="border-t-2 border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800/70">
                <td
                  colSpan={2}
                  className="px-5 py-4 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200"
                >
                  Total {title}
                </td>
                <td
                  className={`px-5 py-4 text-right font-extrabold tabular-nums ${theme.amount}`}
                >
                  {formatAmount(filteredTotal)}
                </td>
              </tr>
            </tfoot>
          )}
        </table>
      </div>

      <div className="border-t border-slate-100 px-5 py-3 dark:border-slate-800">
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          Full section balance:{" "}
          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
            {formatAmount(total)}
          </span>
        </p>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function LoadingSection() {
  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900">
      <div className="h-6 w-40 animate-pulse rounded bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700" />
      <div className="mt-5 space-y-4">
        {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((item) => (
          <div
            key={item}
            className="h-10 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800"
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function BalanceSheetPage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState(null);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/reports/balance-sheet", {
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      let result;

      try {
        result = await response.json();
      } catch {
        throw new Error("The server returned an invalid response.");
      }

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          result?.message ||
            result?.error ||
            "Failed to load the Balance Sheet report."
        );
      }

      setData(result);
      setError("");
      setLastUpdated(new Date());
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function fetchReport() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/reports/balance-sheet", {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

        let result;

        try {
          result = await response.json();
        } catch {
          throw new Error("The server returned an invalid response.");
        }

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            result?.message ||
              result?.error ||
              "Failed to load the Balance Sheet report."
          );
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setData(result);
          setError("");
          setLastUpdated(new Date());
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setError(getErrorMessage(err));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    fetchReport();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const assets = useMemo(
    () => (Array.isArray(data?.assets) ? data.assets : []),
    [data]
  );

  const liabilities = useMemo(
    () => (Array.isArray(data?.liabilities) ? data.liabilities : []),
    [data]
  );

  const equity = useMemo(
    () => (Array.isArray(data?.equity) ? data.equity : []),
    [data]
  );

  const totals = data?.totals || {};

  const totalAssets = toNumber(totals.totalAssets);
  const totalLiabilities = toNumber(totals.totalLiabilities);
  const totalEquity = toNumber(totals.totalEquityWithProfit);
  const difference = toNumber(totals.difference);

  const isBalanced = Math.abs(difference) < 0.01;
  const liabilitiesAndEquity = totalLiabilities + totalEquity;

  const assetCoverage =
    totalAssets > 0
      ? Math.min(100, (liabilitiesAndEquity / totalAssets) * 100)
      : liabilitiesAndEquity === 0
        ? 100
        : 0;

  const handleRefresh = () => {
    loadData();
  };

  const handleExport = () => {
    const rows = [
      ["Balance Sheet Report"],
      ["Generated at", new Date().toLocaleString("en-PK")],
      [],
      ["Financial Summary"],
      ["Metric", "Amount (PKR)"],
      ["Total Assets", formatAmount(totalAssets)],
      ["Total Liabilities", formatAmount(totalLiabilities)],
      ["Total Equity", formatAmount(totalEquity)],
      ["Liabilities + Equity", formatAmount(liabilitiesAndEquity)],
      ["Balance Difference", formatAmount(difference)],
      ["Status", isBalanced ? "Balanced" : "Difference detected"],
      [],
      ["Assets"],
      ["Account Code", "Account Name", "Balance (PKR)"],
      ...assets.map((account) => [
        account.account_code ?? "",
        account.account_name ?? "",
        formatAmount(account.balance),
      ]),
      ["", "Total Assets", formatAmount(totalAssets)],
      [],
      ["Liabilities"],
      ["Account Code", "Account Name", "Balance (PKR)"],
      ...liabilities.map((account) => [
        account.account_code ?? "",
        account.account_name ?? "",
        formatAmount(account.balance),
      ]),
      ["", "Total Liabilities", formatAmount(totalLiabilities)],
      [],
      ["Equity"],
      ["Account Code", "Account Name", "Balance (PKR)"],
      ...equity.map((account) => [
        account.account_code ?? "",
        account.account_name ?? "",
        formatAmount(account.balance),
      ]),
      ["", "Total Equity", formatAmount(totalEquity)],
      [],
      ["Liabilities + Equity", formatAmount(liabilitiesAndEquity)],
      ["Balance Difference", formatAmount(difference)],
    ];

    downloadCSV("balance-sheet-report.csv", rows);
  };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-4 text-slate-900 transition-colors duration-300 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-700 via-blue-600 to-emerald-600 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-blue-900/10 sm:p-8">
          <div className="absolute -right-16 -top-20 -z-10 h-64 w-64 rounded-full border-[36px] border-white/10" />
          <div className="absolute -bottom-24 right-1/3 -z-10 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-emerald-300/10 blur-3xl" />
          <div className="absolute right-10 top-10 -z-10 hidden rotate-12 opacity-10 sm:block">
            <BarChart3 size={150} strokeWidth={1} />
          </div>

          <div className="relative flex flex-col gap-6 xl:flex-row xl:items-center xl:justify-between">
            <div className="max-w-2xl">
              <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-50 backdrop-blur">
                <Activity size={14} />
                Financial reporting
              </div>

              <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
                Balance Sheet
              </h1>

              <p className="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-blue-50 sm:text-base">
                View your financial position through assets, liabilities, and
                equity, all in one clear overview.
              </p>

              <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs font-medium text-white/90">
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 px-3 py-2">
                  <Landmark size={14} />
                  Financial position
                </span>

                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 px-3 py-2">
                  <ShieldCheck size={14} />
                  Balance verification
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleRefresh}
                disabled={loading || refreshing}
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/25 bg-white/10 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <RefreshCw
                  size={17}
                  className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
                />
                {refreshing ? "Refreshing..." : "Refresh"}
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExport}
                disabled={!data || loading}
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-blue-700 shadow-lg transition hover:bg-blue-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <Download size={17} />
                Export CSV
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Error */}
        {error && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-4 dark:border-rose-500/30 dark:bg-rose-500/10 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
          >
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-500/15 dark:text-rose-300">
                <AlertCircle size={21} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="font-bold text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200">
                  Unable to load the balance sheet
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300">
                  {error}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRefresh}
              disabled={refreshing}
              className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-rose-700 transition hover:bg-rose-100 disabled:opacity-60 dark:border-rose-500/30 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-rose-300 dark:hover:bg-rose-500/10"
            >
              <RefreshCw
                size={16}
                className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
              />
              Try again
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Summary cards */}
        <section>
          <div className="mb-4 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Financial summary
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                An overview of your company&apos;s assets, liabilities, and
                equity.
              </p>
            </div>

            {lastUpdated && (
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Updated {lastUpdated.toLocaleTimeString("en-PK")}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
            <SummaryCard
              title="Total Assets"
              value={totalAssets}
              description="Resources owned by the business"
              icon={Wallet}
              color="green"
              loading={loading}
            />

            <SummaryCard
              title="Total Liabilities"
              value={totalLiabilities}
              description="Obligations owed by the business"
              icon={ArrowLeftRight}
              color="blue"
              loading={loading}
            />

            <SummaryCard
              title="Total Equity"
              value={totalEquity}
              description="Equity including reported profit"
              icon={CircleDollarSign}
              color="violet"
              loading={loading}
            />
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Position comparison */}
        <section className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 lg:col-span-2">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Financial position overview
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Assets compared with liabilities and equity
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="rounded-xl bg-blue-50 p-2.5 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-300">
                <BarChart3 size={21} />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-6 space-y-5">
              <div>
                <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                    Total assets
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                    {formatAmount(totalAssets)}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="h-3 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">
                  <div className="h-full w-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-500 to-green-400" />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                    Liabilities + equity
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-bold tabular-nums text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                    {formatAmount(liabilitiesAndEquity)}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="h-3 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">
                  <div
                    className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-sky-400 transition-all duration-700"
                    style={{ width: `${assetCoverage}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-6 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-800/70">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Assets
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 break-words text-xl font-extrabold tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  {formatAmount(totalAssets)}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-800/70">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Liabilities + equity
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 break-words text-xl font-extrabold tabular-nums text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                  {formatAmount(liabilitiesAndEquity)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div
            className={`relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl p-6 text-white shadow-lg ${
              isBalanced
                ? "bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-600 via-emerald-600 to-teal-700 shadow-emerald-900/10"
                : "bg-gradient-to-br from-rose-600 via-rose-600 to-red-700 shadow-rose-900/10"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="absolute -right-8 -top-8 h-36 w-36 rounded-full border-[22px] border-white/10" />
            <div className="absolute -bottom-12 -left-10 h-40 w-40 rounded-full bg-white/5 blur-xl" />

            <div className="relative">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10">
                  {isBalanced ? (
                    <BadgeCheck size={24} />
                  ) : (
                    <AlertCircle size={24} />
                  )}
                </div>

                <span className="rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold">
                  {isBalanced ? "Balanced" : "Review needed"}
                </span>
              </div>

              <p className="mt-6 text-sm font-medium text-white/80">
                Balance verification
              </p>

              <h2 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
                {isBalanced ? "Books are balanced" : "Difference detected"}
              </h2>

              <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-white/85">
                {isBalanced
                  ? "Total assets match liabilities plus equity within the configured 0.01 tolerance."
                  : "Assets do not currently match liabilities plus equity. Review the balances and accounting entries."}
              </p>

              <div className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-white/10 p-4 backdrop-blur">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-white/80">
                  Balance difference
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 break-words text-2xl font-extrabold tabular-nums">
                  {formatCurrency(difference)}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white/90">
                {isBalanced ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
                ) : (
                  <AlertCircle size={16} />
                )}
                <span>
                  {isBalanced
                    ? "Accounting equation verified"
                    : "Please investigate the discrepancy"}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Account search */}
        <section className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Account breakdown
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Browse the balances for each account category.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="relative w-full sm:max-w-xs">
              <Search
                size={18}
                className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
              />

              <input
                type="search"
                value={search}
                onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search code or account..."
                aria-label="Search balance sheet accounts"
                className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white pl-10 pr-10 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-white dark:placeholder:text-slate-500 dark:focus:border-blue-400"
              />

              {search && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSearch("")}
                  aria-label="Clear account search"
                  className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-md p-1 text-slate-400 transition hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:text-slate-200"
                >
                  <X size={15} />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {loading ? (
            <div className="grid gap-5 xl:grid-cols-2">
              <LoadingSection />
              <LoadingSection />
              <LoadingSection />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid items-start gap-5 xl:grid-cols-2">
              <AccountSection
                title="Assets"
                subtitle="Resources owned by the business"
                accounts={assets}
                total={totalAssets}
                color="green"
                search={search}
              />

              <AccountSection
                title="Liabilities"
                subtitle="Obligations owed by the business"
                accounts={liabilities}
                total={totalLiabilities}
                color="blue"
                search={search}
              />

              <div className="xl:col-span-2">
                <AccountSection
                  title="Equity"
                  subtitle="Owner's equity and retained earnings, including reported profit"
                  accounts={equity}
                  total={totalEquity}
                  color="violet"
                  search={search}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>

        {/* Accounting equation */}
        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900">
          <div className="border-b border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-700">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500/15 dark:text-blue-300">
                <ArrowLeftRight size={21} />
              </div>

              <div>
                <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Accounting equation
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Assets = Liabilities + Equity
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-4 p-5 md:grid-cols-3 md:items-center">
            <div className="rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 p-4 dark:bg-emerald-500/10">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                Assets
              </p>
              <p className="mt-2 break-words text-xl font-extrabold tabular-nums text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200">
                {formatAmount(totalAssets)}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-xl bg-blue-50 p-4 dark:bg-blue-500/10">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                Liabilities + Equity
              </p>
              <p className="mt-2 break-words text-xl font-extrabold tabular-nums text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200">
                {formatAmount(liabilitiesAndEquity)}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div
              className={`rounded-xl p-4 ${
                isBalanced
                  ? "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10"
                  : "bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10"
              }`}
            >
              <p
                className={`text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider ${
                  isBalanced
                    ? "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300"
                    : "text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300"
                }`}
              >
                Difference
              </p>
              <p
                className={`mt-2 break-words text-xl font-extrabold tabular-nums ${
                  isBalanced
                    ? "text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200"
                    : "text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200"
                }`}
              >
                {formatAmount(difference)}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Footer */}
        <footer className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-slate-200 pt-5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-300">
              <FileSpreadsheet size={16} />
            </div>

            <span>
              Balance Sheet Report
              <span className="mx-2 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700">
                |
              </span>
              PKR
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Layers3 size={14} />
            <span>
              {assets.length} asset accounts Â· {liabilities.length} liability
              accounts Â· {equity.length} equity accounts
            </span>
          </div>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}


===== app\dashboard\reports\payments\page.js =====
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

const panelClass =
  "overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white shadow-sm shadow-slate-200/40 transition-colors dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:shadow-black/10";

const buttonClass =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-blue-700 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-blue-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/20";

export default function PaymentReportPage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [methodFilter, setMethodFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState("newest");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadData() {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");

        const response = await fetch("/api/reports/payments", {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

        const result = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            result.message || "Failed to load payment report."
          );
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setData(result);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          console.error("PAYMENT REPORT ERROR:", err);
          setError(err.message || "Failed to load payment report.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    loadData();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const payments = Array.isArray(data?.payments) ? data.payments : [];
  const summary = data?.summary || {};

  const methods = useMemo(() => {
    return [
      ...new Set(
        payments
          .map((payment) =>
            String(payment.payment_method || "").trim()
          )
          .filter(Boolean)
      ),
    ].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  }, [payments]);

  const filteredPayments = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedSearch = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    const result = payments.filter((payment) => {
      const searchable = [
        payment.payment_number,
        payment.transaction_type,
        payment.party_name,
        payment.payment_method,
        payment.reference_number,
        payment.payment_date,
      ]
        .map((value) => String(value ?? ""))
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase();

      const matchesSearch =
        !normalizedSearch || searchable.includes(normalizedSearch);

      const matchesType =
        typeFilter === "ALL" ||
        String(payment.transaction_type || "").toUpperCase() === typeFilter;

      const matchesMethod =
        methodFilter === "ALL" ||
        String(payment.payment_method || "").trim() === methodFilter;

      return matchesSearch && matchesType && matchesMethod;
    });

    return result.sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortOrder === "amount-high") {
        return Number(b.amount || 0) - Number(a.amount || 0);
      }

      if (sortOrder === "amount-low") {
        return Number(a.amount || 0) - Number(b.amount || 0);
      }

      const dateA = new Date(a.payment_date || 0).getTime();
      const dateB = new Date(b.payment_date || 0).getTime();

      if (sortOrder === "oldest") {
        return dateA - dateB;
      }

      return dateB - dateA;
    });
  }, [payments, search, typeFilter, methodFilter, sortOrder]);

  const filteredTotal = useMemo(
    () =>
      filteredPayments.reduce(
        (total, payment) => total + Number(payment.amount || 0),
        0
      ),
    [filteredPayments]
  );

  function formatMoney(value) {
    return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    });
  }

  function formatDate(value) {
    if (!value) return "-";

    const dateText = String(value);

    // Preserve date-only values without shifting the day through time zones.
    const match = dateText.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);

    if (match) {
      return new Date(
        Number(match[1]),
        Number(match[2]) - 1,
        Number(match[3])
      ).toLocaleDateString("en-PK", {
        day: "2-digit",
        month: "short",
        year: "numeric",
      });
    }

    const date = new Date(value);

    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return dateText;

    return date.toLocaleDateString("en-PK", {
      day: "2-digit",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric",
    });
  }

  function clearFilters() {
    setSearch("");
    setTypeFilter("ALL");
    setMethodFilter("ALL");
    setSortOrder("newest");
  }

  const totalReceipts = Number(summary.totalReceipts || 0);
  const totalPayments = Number(summary.totalPayments || 0);
  const netMovement = totalReceipts - totalPayments;

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50/80 p-4 text-slate-900 transition-colors duration-300 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 xl:p-8">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-7">
        {/* PAGE HEADER */}
        <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 sm:p-8">
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-12 -top-20 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 blur-3xl" />
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-24 right-1/3 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 blur-3xl" />

          <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
              <div className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-emerald-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20">
                <PaymentIcon className="h-7 w-7" />
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="rounded-full border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-blue-700 dark:border-blue-900 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:text-blue-300">
                    Financial Reports
                  </span>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300">
                    <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                    Payment overview
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-950 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
                  Payment Report
                </h1>

                <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 sm:text-base">
                  Review sales receipts and purchase payments, monitor cash
                  movement, and find individual transactions quickly.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
              disabled={loading}
              className={`${buttonClass} disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50`}
            >
              <RefreshIcon
                className={`h-4 w-4 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`}
              />
              Refresh Report
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="relative mt-7 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:grid-cols-3">
            <HeaderInfo
              icon={<ArrowDownIcon className="h-4 w-4" />}
              title="Sales receipts"
              subtitle="Money received from customers"
            />
            <HeaderInfo
              icon={<ArrowUpIcon className="h-4 w-4" />}
              title="Purchase payments"
              subtitle="Payments made to suppliers"
            />
            <HeaderInfo
              icon={<SearchIcon className="h-4 w-4" />}
              title="Transaction lookup"
              subtitle="Search and filter payment records"
            />
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* ERROR */}
        {error && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800 dark:border-red-900/70 dark:bg-red-950/30 dark:text-red-300"
          >
            <AlertIcon className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="font-bold">Unable to load payment report</p>
              <p className="mt-1 break-words text-sm">{error}</p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setError("")}
              aria-label="Dismiss error"
              className="rounded-lg p-1 text-lg leading-none transition hover:bg-red-100 dark:hover:bg-red-900/40"
            >
              Ã—
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* SUMMARY CARDS */}
        <section>
          <div className="mb-4">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              Payment summary
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Overview of receipts, payments, and net movement
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
            <Stat
              title="Total Receipts"
              value={loading ? "..." : `Rs. ${formatMoney(totalReceipts)}`}
              description="Sales receipts recorded"
              icon={<ArrowDownIcon className="h-5 w-5" />}
              color="green"
              loading={loading}
            />

            <Stat
              title="Total Payments"
              value={loading ? "..." : `Rs. ${formatMoney(totalPayments)}`}
              description="Purchase payments recorded"
              icon={<ArrowUpIcon className="h-5 w-5" />}
              color="blue"
              loading={loading}
            />

            <Stat
              title="Net Movement"
              value={
                loading
                  ? "..."
                  : `${netMovement < 0 ? "-" : ""}Rs. ${formatMoney(
                      Math.abs(netMovement)
                    )}`
              }
              description="Receipts minus payments"
              icon={<BalanceIcon className="h-5 w-5" />}
              color={netMovement < 0 ? "blue" : "emerald"}
              loading={loading}
            />
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* TRANSACTION TABLE */}
        <section className={panelClass}>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:p-6">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/40 dark:text-blue-300">
                  <DocumentIcon className="h-5 w-5" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    Payment Transactions
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Detailed sales receipts and purchase payments
                  </p>

              <span className="w-fit rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                {loading
                  ? "Loading records..."
                  : `${filteredPayments.length} of ${payments.length} records`}

              >
                <RefreshIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Reset filters

          {loading ? (

              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((item) => (
                <div

          ) : filteredPayments.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              title={
                payments.length === 0
                  ? "No payment transactions found"
                  : "No matching transactions"
              }
              description={
                payments.length === 0
                  ? "There are no payment records available in this report."
                  : "Try changing your search text or filters to see more records."
              }
              icon={<SearchIcon className="h-7 w-7" />}
            />
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full min-w-[1050px] text-sm">
                  <thead className="bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-slate-950/70">
                    <tr>
                      <TableHeader>Date</TableHeader>
                      <TableHeader>Payment Number</TableHeader>
                      <TableHeader>Transaction Type</TableHeader>
                      <TableHeader>Party</TableHeader>
                      <TableHeader align="right">Amount (PKR)</TableHeader>
                      <TableHeader>Method</TableHeader>
                      <TableHeader>Reference</TableHeader>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                    {filteredPayments.map((payment, index) => {
                      const isReceipt =
                        String(payment.transaction_type || "").toUpperCase() ===
                        "RECEIPT";

                      return (
                        <tr
                          key={`${payment.transaction_type}-${payment.payment_id ?? payment.payment_number ?? index}`}
                          className="group transition-colors hover:bg-blue-50/50 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/20"
                        >
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {formatDate(payment.payment_date)}
                          </td>

                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4">
                            <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                              {payment.payment_number || "-"}
                            </span>
                          </td>

                          <td className="px-5 py-4">
                            <span
                              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold ${
                                isReceipt
                                  ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300"
                                  : "border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:border-blue-900 dark:bg-blue-950/50 dark:text-blue-300"
                              }`}
                            >
                              {isReceipt ? (
                                <ArrowDownIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                              ) : (
                                <ArrowUpIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                              )}
                              {payment.transaction_type || "-"}
                            </span>
                          </td>

                          <td className="px-5 py-4">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                              <div
                                className={`flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold ${
                                  isReceipt
                                    ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 dark:text-emerald-300"
                                    : "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/40 dark:text-blue-300"
                                }`}
                              >
                                {getInitials(payment.party_name)}
                              </div>
                              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                                {payment.party_name || "-"}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </td>

                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-extrabold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                            {formatMoney(payment.amount)}
                          </td>

                          <td className="px-5 py-4">
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500" />
                              {payment.payment_method || "-"}
                            </span>
                          </td>

                          <td className="px-5 py-4 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            {payment.reference_number ? (
                              <span className="rounded-md bg-slate-100 px-2 py-1 font-mono text-xs dark:bg-slate-800">
                                {payment.reference_number}
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              "-"
                            )}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>

                  <tfoot className="border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950/70">
                    <tr>

                        {formatMoney(filteredTotal)}
                      </td>
                      <td colSpan={2} className="px-5 py-4 text-right">
                        <span className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300">
                          {filteredPayments.length} records
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  </tfoot>
                </table>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 px-5 py-3 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950/40 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                <span>
                  Showing {filteredPayments.length} of {payments.length} records
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                  Amounts are displayed in PKR
                </span>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </section>

        <footer className="flex flex-col gap-2 pb-2 text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <span>Payments &amp; Financial Analytics</span>
          <span>Receipts and payments are shown separately.</span>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

function Stat({ title, value, description, icon, color, loading }) {
  const colors = {
    green: {
      icon: "bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/40 dark:text-green-300",
      glow: "from-green-500/10",
      bar: "bg-green-500",
    },
    blue: {
      icon: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/40 dark:text-blue-300",
      glow: "from-blue-500/10",
      bar: "bg-blue-500",
    },
    emerald: {
      icon: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 dark:text-emerald-300",
      glow: "from-emerald-500/10",
      bar: "bg-emerald-500",
    },
  };

  const theme = colors[color] || colors.blue;

  return (
    <article className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm shadow-slate-200/30 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-blue-200 hover:shadow-lg dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:shadow-black/10 dark:hover:border-slate-700 sm:p-6">
      <div
        className={`pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br ${theme.glow} via-transparent to-transparent`}
      />

      <div className="relative">

              ) : (
                value
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

            className={`flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${theme.icon} transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-110`}

            {icon}

          <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">

          </p>

        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

function getInitials(name) {
  const words = String(name || "Party")
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);

  return words
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((word) => word[0].toUpperCase())
    .join("");
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

const currencyFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
  minimumFractionDigits: 2,
  maximumFractionDigits: 2,
});

function formatAmount(value) {
  const amount = Number(value ?? 0);

  return currencyFormatter.format(Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : 0);
}

function formatCurrency(value) {
  return `PKR ${formatAmount(value)}`;
}

function safeNumber(value) {
  const number = Number(value ?? 0);
  return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : 0;
}

function getAccountKey(account, index) {
  return (
    account.account_id ??
    account.account_code ??
    `${account.account_name ?? "account"}-${index}`
  );
}

function normalizeAccounts(accounts) {
  return Array.isArray(accounts) ? accounts : [];
}

function getErrorMessage(error) {
  return error instanceof Error
    ? error.message
    : "Something went wrong while loading the report.";
}

function downloadCSV(filename, rows) {
  const csvValue = (value) => {
    const text = String(value ?? "");
    return `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  };

  const content = rows
    .map((row) => row.map(csvValue).join(","))
    .join("\r\n");

  const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF", content], {
    type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;",
  });

  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement("a");

  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();

  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

function AccountSection({
  title,
  subtitle,
  accounts,
  type,
  search,
}) {
  const isRevenue = type === "revenue";
  const accent = isRevenue
    ? {
        icon: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-300",
        badge:
          "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 ring-emerald-600/20 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:ring-emerald-400/20",
        amount: "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300",
        bar: "bg-emerald-500",
      }
    : {
        icon: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500/15 dark:text-blue-300",
        badge:
          "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 ring-blue-600/20 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:ring-blue-400/20",
        amount: "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300",
        bar: "bg-blue-500",
      };

  const normalizedSearch = search.trim().toLowerCase();

  const filteredAccounts = accounts.filter((account) => {
    const code = String(account.account_code ?? "").toLowerCase();
    const name = String(account.account_name ?? "").toLowerCase();

    return (
      !normalizedSearch ||
      code.includes(normalizedSearch) ||
      name.includes(normalizedSearch)
    );
  });

  const total = filteredAccounts.reduce(
    (sum, account) => sum + safeNumber(account.amount),
    0
  );

  return (
    <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm transition-shadow duration-300 hover:shadow-md dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-700 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className={`flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${accent.icon}`}>
            {isRevenue ? (
              <TrendingUp size={22} />
            ) : (
              <ReceiptText size={22} />
            )}
          </div>

          <div>
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-lg">
              {title}
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              {subtitle}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 sm:justify-end">
          <span
            className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold ring-1 ring-inset ${accent.badge}`}
          >
            {filteredAccounts.length}{" "}
            {filteredAccounts.length === 1 ? "account" : "accounts"}
          </span>

          <div className="text-right">
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Section total
            </p>
            <p className={`mt-1 text-sm font-extrabold tabular-nums ${accent.amount}`}>
              {formatAmount(total)}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full min-w-[560px] border-collapse text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:bg-slate-800/80 dark:text-slate-400">
              <th className="px-5 py-4 text-left font-bold">Account code</th>
              <th className="px-5 py-4 text-left font-bold">Account name</th>
              <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold">Amount (PKR)</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>

          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
            {filteredAccounts.map((account, index) => (
              <tr
                key={getAccountKey(account, index)}
                className="group transition-colors hover:bg-blue-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60"
              >
                <td className="px-5 py-4">
                  <span className="inline-flex rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                    {account.account_code || "â€”"}
                  </span>
                </td>

                <td className="px-5 py-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className={`h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${accent.bar}`} />
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                      {account.account_name || "Unnamed account"}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </td>

                <td className={`px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums ${accent.amount}`}>
                  {formatAmount(account.amount)}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}

            {filteredAccounts.length === 0 && (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={3} className="px-5 py-12 text-center">
                  <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-500">
                    <Search size={22} />
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-3 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                    No accounts found
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Try another search term.
                  </p>
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>

          {filteredAccounts.length > 0 && (
            <tfoot>
              <tr className="border-t-2 border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800/70">
                <td
                  colSpan={2}
                  className="px-5 py-4 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200"
                >
                  Total {title}
                </td>
                <td className={`px-5 py-4 text-right font-extrabold tabular-nums ${accent.amount}`}>
                  {formatAmount(total)}
                </td>
              </tr>
            </tfoot>
          )}
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default function ProfitLossPage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState(null);

  const loadData = useCallback(async ({ silent = false } = {}) => {
    if (silent) {
      setRefreshing(true);
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/reports/profit-loss", {
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      let result;

      try {
        result = await response.json();
      } catch {
        throw new Error("The server returned an invalid response.");
      }

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          result?.message || result?.error || "Failed to load the Profit & Loss report."
        );
      }

      setData(result);
      setError("");
      setLastUpdated(new Date());
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function fetchReport() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/reports/profit-loss", {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

        let result;

        try {
          result = await response.json();
        } catch {
          throw new Error("The server returned an invalid response.");
        }

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            result?.message ||
              result?.error ||
              "Failed to load the Profit & Loss report."
          );
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setData(result);
          setError("");
          setLastUpdated(new Date());
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setError(getErrorMessage(err));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    fetchReport();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const revenue = useMemo(
    () => normalizeAccounts(data?.revenue),
    [data]
  );

  const expenses = useMemo(
    () => normalizeAccounts(data?.expenses),
    [data]
  );

  const totals = data?.totals || {};

  const revenueTotal = safeNumber(totals.totalRevenue);
  const expensesTotal = safeNumber(totals.totalExpenses);
  const netProfit = safeNumber(totals.netProfit);

  const isProfitable = netProfit >= 0;

  const profitMargin =
    revenueTotal !== 0 ? (netProfit / revenueTotal) * 100 : 0;

  const visibleRevenue = useMemo(
    () =>
      revenue.filter((account) => {
        const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();

        return (
          !term ||
          String(account.account_code ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          String(account.account_name ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(term)
        );
      }),
    [revenue, search]
  );

  const visibleExpenses = useMemo(
    () =>
      expenses.filter((account) => {
        const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();

        return (
          !term ||
          String(account.account_code ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          String(account.account_name ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(term)
        );
      }),
    [expenses, search]
  );

  const handleExport = () => {
    const rows = [
      ["Profit & Loss Report"],
      ["Generated at", new Date().toLocaleString("en-PK")],
      [],
      ["Summary"],
      ["Metric", "Amount (PKR)"],
      ["Total Revenue", formatAmount(revenueTotal)],
      ["Total Expenses", formatAmount(expensesTotal)],
      ["Net Profit / Loss", formatAmount(netProfit)],
      ["Profit Margin (%)", profitMargin.toFixed(2)],
      [],
      ["Revenue Accounts"],
      ["Account Code", "Account Name", "Amount (PKR)"],
      ...revenue.map((account) => [
        account.account_code ?? "",
        account.account_name ?? "",
        formatAmount(account.amount),
      ]),
      ["", "Total Revenue", formatAmount(revenueTotal)],
      [],
      ["Expense Accounts"],
      ["Account Code", "Account Name", "Amount (PKR)"],
      ...expenses.map((account) => [
        account.account_code ?? "",
        account.account_name ?? "",
        formatAmount(account.amount),
      ]),
      ["", "Total Expenses", formatAmount(expensesTotal)],
      [],
      ["Net Profit / Loss", formatAmount(netProfit)],
    ];

    downloadCSV("profit-loss-report.csv", rows);
  };

  const handleRefresh = () => {
    loadData({ silent: true });
  };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-4 text-slate-900 transition-colors duration-300 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-700 via-blue-600 to-emerald-600 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-blue-900/10 sm:p-8">
          <div className="absolute -right-16 -top-20 -z-10 h-64 w-64 rounded-full border-[36px] border-white/10" />
          <div className="absolute -bottom-24 right-1/3 -z-10 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-emerald-300/10 blur-3xl" />
          <div className="absolute right-10 top-10 -z-10 hidden rotate-12 opacity-10 sm:block">
            <BarChart3 size={150} strokeWidth={1} />
          </div>

          <div className="relative flex flex-col gap-6 xl:flex-row xl:items-center xl:justify-between">
            <div className="max-w-2xl">
              <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-50 backdrop-blur">
                <Activity size={14} />
                Financial reporting
              </div>

              <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
                Profit &amp; Loss
              </h1>

              <p className="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-blue-50 sm:text-base">
                Understand your business performance with a clear overview of
                revenue, expenses, and net profit.
              </p>

              <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs font-medium text-white/90">
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 px-3 py-2">
                  <Landmark size={14} />
                  Financial overview
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 px-3 py-2">
                  <CheckCircle2 size={14} />
                  {loading ? "Loading report..." : "Report summary"}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleRefresh}
                disabled={loading || refreshing}
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/25 bg-white/10 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <RefreshCw
                  size={17}
                  className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
                />
                {refreshing ? "Refreshing..." : "Refresh"}
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExport}
                disabled={!data || loading}
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-blue-700 shadow-lg transition hover:bg-blue-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <Download size={17} />

              disabled={refreshing}
              className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-rose-700 transition hover:bg-rose-100 disabled:opacity-60 dark:border-rose-500/30 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-rose-300 dark:hover:bg-rose-500/10"
            >

            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Summary cards */}
        <section>

            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">

              </p>

          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">

const today = () => {
    const date = new Date();
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
};

function formatAmount(value) {
    return Number(value ?? 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
        minimumFractionDigits: 2,
        maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    });
}

function formatDate(value) {
    if (!value) return "-";
    const normalized = String(value).split("T")[0];
    return normalized === "Invalid Date" ? "-" : normalized;
}

function safeNumber(value) {
    const number = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : 0;
}

function getPurchaseTotal(purchase) {
    return safeNumber(purchase?.total_amount);
}

function getPurchasePaid(purchase) {
    return safeNumber(purchase?.paid_amount);
}

function getPurchaseBalance(purchase) {
    return safeNumber(purchase?.balance_amount);
}

function getStatusStyle(status) {
    const normalized = String(status || "").toLowerCase();

    if (
        normalized.includes("paid") &&
        !normalized.includes("unpaid") &&
        !normalized.includes("partial")
    ) {
        return "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300";
    }

    if (normalized.includes("partial")) {
        return "border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:border-sky-900 dark:bg-sky-950/50 dark:text-sky-300";
    }

    if (
        normalized.includes("pending") ||
        normalized.includes("unpaid") ||
        normalized.includes("due")
    ) {
        return "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/50 dark:text-amber-300";
    }

    if (normalized.includes("cancel")) {
        return "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:border-rose-900 dark:bg-rose-950/50 dark:text-rose-300";
    }

    return "border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300";
}

function SummaryCard({ title, value, description, icon, tone }) {
    const tones = {
        green: {
            icon: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300",
            accent: "from-emerald-500 to-teal-500",
        },
        blue: {
            icon: "bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950 dark:text-sky-300",
            accent: "from-sky-500 to-blue-600",
        },
        cyan: {
            icon: "bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-700 dark:bg-cyan-950 dark:text-cyan-300",
            accent: "from-cyan-500 to-teal-500",
        },
        amber: {
            icon: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-300",
            accent: "from-amber-400 to-orange-500",
        },
    };

    const style = tones[tone] || tones.green;

    return (
        <div className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950">
            <div className={`absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r ${style.accent}`} />
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        {title}
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                        {value}
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        {description}
                    </p>
                </div>
                <div className={`rounded-xl p-3 ${style.icon}`}>
                    <Icon name={icon} size={22} />
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function StatusBadge({ status }) {
    return (
        <span
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${getStatusStyle(status)}`}
        >
            <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-current" />
            {status || "Unknown"}
        </span>
    );
}
