    const [warehouses, setWarehouses] = useState([]);
    const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);

    const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm());
    const [items, setItems] = useState([emptyItem()]);

    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
    const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);

    const [selectedPurchase, setSelectedPurchase] = useState(null);
    const [editingPurchaseId, setEditingPurchaseId] = useState(null);
    const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all");
    const [viewLoadingId, setViewLoadingId] = useState(null);

    const loadPurchases = useCallback(async () => {
        const response = await fetch("/api/purchases", {
            cache: "no-store",
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load purchases.");
        }

        setPurchases(data.purchases || []);
    }, []);

    const refreshAll = useCallback(async (showSpinner = true) => {
        if (showSpinner) setRefreshing(true);
        setError("");

        try {
            const [
                purchasesResponse,
                suppliersResponse,
                warehousesResponse,
                productsResponse,
            ] = await Promise.all([
                fetch("/api/purchases", { cache: "no-store" }),
                fetch("/api/suppliers", { cache: "no-store" }),
                fetch("/api/warehouses", { cache: "no-store" }),
                fetch("/api/products", { cache: "no-store" }),
            ]);

            const [
                purchasesData,
                suppliersData,
                warehousesData,
                productsData,
            ] = await Promise.all([
                purchasesResponse.json(),
                suppliersResponse.json(),
                warehousesResponse.json(),
                productsResponse.json(),
            ]);

            if (!purchasesResponse.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    purchasesData.message || "Failed to load purchases."
                );
            }

            if (!suppliersResponse.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    suppliersData.message || "Failed to load suppliers."
                );
            }

            if (!warehousesResponse.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    warehousesData.message || "Failed to load warehouses."
                );
            }

            if (!productsResponse.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    productsData.message || "Failed to load products."
                );
            }

            setPurchases(purchasesData.purchases || []);
            setSuppliers(suppliersData.suppliers || []);
            setWarehouses(warehousesData.warehouses || []);
            setProducts(productsData.products || []);
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Failed to load purchase data.");
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
            setRefreshing(false);
        }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;

        async function fetchInitialData() {
            try {
                const responses = await Promise.all([
                    fetch("/api/purchases", { cache: "no-store" }),
                    fetch("/api/suppliers", { cache: "no-store" }),
                    fetch("/api/warehouses", { cache: "no-store" }),
                    fetch("/api/products", { cache: "no-store" }),
                ]);

                const data = await Promise.all(
                    responses.map(async (response) => {
                        const json = await response.json();
                        return { response, json };
                    })
                );

                const [
                    purchasesResult,
                    suppliersResult,
                    warehousesResult,
                    productsResult,
                ] = data;

                const failedResult = data.find(
                    (result) => !result.response.ok
                );

                if (failedResult) {
                    throw new Error(
                        failedResult.json.message || "Failed to load purchase data."
                    );
                }

                if (!cancelled) {
                    setPurchases(purchasesResult.json.purchases || []);
                    setSuppliers(suppliersResult.json.suppliers || []);
                    setWarehouses(warehousesResult.json.warehouses || []);
                    setProducts(productsResult.json.products || []);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setError(err.message || "Failed to load purchase data.");
                }
            } finally {
                if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
            }
        }

        fetchInitialData();

        return () => {
            cancelled = true;
        };
    }, []);

    function openAddForm() {
        setForm(emptyForm());
        setItems([emptyItem()]);
        setEditingPurchaseId(null);
        setSelectedPurchase(null);
        setError("");
        setMessage("");
        setShowForm(true);
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
    }

    function closeForm() {
        setShowForm(false);
        setForm(emptyForm());
        setItems([emptyItem()]);
        setEditingPurchaseId(null);
        setError("");
    }

    function updateForm(name, value) {
        setForm((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: value }));
    }

    function updateItem(index, name, value) {
        setItems((previous) => {
            const updated = previous.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
            updated[index][name] = value;

            if (name === "productId" && value) {
                const product = products.find(
                    (p) => Number(p.product_id) === Number(value)
                );

                if (product) {
                    updated[index].unitCost = product.cost_price ?? 0;
                }
            }

            return updated;
        });
    }

    function addItem() {
        setItems((previous) => [...previous, emptyItem()]);
    }

    function removeItem(index) {
        setItems((previous) =>
            previous.length === 1
                ? previous
                : previous.filter((_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index)
        );
    }

    function calculateLine(item) {
        return (
            (Number(item.quantity) || 0) * (Number(item.unitCost) || 0) -
            (Number(item.discount) || 0) +
            (Number(item.tax) || 0)
        );
    }

    const subtotal = useMemo(
        () => items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + calculateLine(item), 0),
        [items]
    );

    const total = useMemo(
        () =>
            subtotal -
            (Number(form.discount) || 0) +
            (Number(form.tax) || 0),
        [subtotal, form.discount, form.tax]
    );

    async function savePurchase(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setSaving(true);
        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        try {
            if (!form.supplierId || !form.warehouseId) {
                throw new Error("Select a supplier and warehouse.");
            }

            if (!form.purchaseDate) {
                throw new Error("Select a purchase date.");
            }

            const validItems = items.filter(
                (item) =>
                    item.productId &&
                    Number(item.quantity) > 0 &&
                    Number(item.unitCost) >= 0
            );

            if (validItems.length === 0) {
                throw new Error("Add at least one valid product.");
            }

            const requestBody = {
                ...form,
                supplierId: Number(form.supplierId),
                warehouseId: Number(form.warehouseId),
                discount: Number(form.discount) || 0,
                tax: Number(form.tax) || 0,
                items: validItems.map((item) => ({
                    productId: Number(item.productId),
                    quantity: Number(item.quantity),
                    unitCost: Number(item.unitCost) || 0,
                    discount: Number(item.discount) || 0,
                    tax: Number(item.tax) || 0,
                })),
            };

            const wasEditing = Boolean(editingPurchaseId);

            const response = await fetch("/api/purchases", {
                method: wasEditing ? "PUT" : "POST",
                headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                body: JSON.stringify(
                    wasEditing
                        ? { ...requestBody, purchaseId: editingPurchaseId }
                        : requestBody
                ),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to save purchase.");
            }

            await loadPurchases();

            setForm(emptyForm());
            setItems([emptyItem()]);
            setEditingPurchaseId(null);
            setShowForm(false);
            setSelectedPurchase(null);
            setMessage(
                wasEditing
                    ? "Purchase updated successfully."
                    : "Purchase created successfully. Warehouse stock has been increased."
            );
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Failed to save purchase.");
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    async function fetchPurchaseDetails(purchase) {
        const response = await fetch(
            `/api/purchases?id=${purchase.purchase_id}`,
            { cache: "no-store" }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load purchase.");
        }

        return data.purchase;
    }

    async function viewPurchase(purchase) {
        try {
            setError("");
            setViewLoadingId(purchase.purchase_id);
            const completePurchase = await fetchPurchaseDetails(purchase);
            setSelectedPurchase(completePurchase);
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Failed to load purchase.");
        } finally {
            setViewLoadingId(null);
        }
    }

    async function editPurchase(purchase) {
        try {
            setError("");
            setMessage("");

            const completePurchase = await fetchPurchaseDetails(purchase);

            setEditingPurchaseId(completePurchase.purchase_id);

            setForm({
                purchaseNumber: completePurchase.purchase_number || "",
                supplierId: completePurchase.supplier_id
                    ? String(completePurchase.supplier_id)
                    : "",
                warehouseId: completePurchase.warehouse_id
                    ? String(completePurchase.warehouse_id)
                    : "",
                purchaseDate:
                    formatDate(completePurchase.purchase_date) === "-"
                        ? today()
                        : formatDate(completePurchase.purchase_date),
                discount: completePurchase.discount ?? "",
                tax: completePurchase.tax ?? "",
                notes: completePurchase.notes || "",
            });

            if (
                Array.isArray(completePurchase.items) &&
                completePurchase.items.length > 0
            ) {
                setItems(
                    completePurchase.items.map((item) => ({
                        productId: String(item.product_id),
                        quantity: Number(item.quantity) || 0,
                        unitCost: Number(item.unit_cost) || 0,
                        discount: Number(item.discount) || 0,
                        tax: Number(item.tax) || 0,
                    }))
                );
            } else {
                setItems([emptyItem()]);
            }

            setSelectedPurchase(null);
            setShowForm(true);
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Failed to load purchase for editing.");
        }
    }

    function cancelEdit() {
        closeForm();
        setMessage("");
    }

    function printPurchase() {
        window.print();
    }

    function downloadPurchasePDF() {
        if (!selectedPurchase) return;

        const purchase = selectedPurchase;
        const doc = new jsPDF();

        doc.setFillColor(6, 78, 59);
        doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 30, "F");
        doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
        doc.setFontSize(19);
        doc.text("Purchase Report", 14, 19);

        doc.setTextColor(30, 41, 59);
        doc.setFontSize(10);
        doc.text(
            `Purchase Number: ${purchase.purchase_number || purchase.purchase_id || "-"}`,
            14,
            41
        );
        doc.text(`Purchase Date: ${formatDate(purchase.purchase_date)}`, 14, 48);
        doc.text(
            `Supplier: ${purchase.supplier_code || ""} - ${purchase.supplier_name || "-"}`,
            14,
            55
        );
        doc.text(
            `Warehouse: ${purchase.warehouse_code || ""} - ${purchase.warehouse_name || "-"}`,
            14,
            62
        );
        doc.text(`Status: ${purchase.status || "-"}`, 14, 69);

        autoTable(doc, {
            startY: 77,
            head: [["Product", "Qty", "Unit Cost", "Discount", "Tax", "Total"]],
            body: (purchase.items || []).map((item) => [
                `${item.sku || ""} - ${item.product_name || ""}`,
                Number(item.quantity || 0).toFixed(2),
                Number(item.unit_cost || 0).toFixed(2),
                Number(item.discount || 0).toFixed(2),
                Number(item.tax || 0).toFixed(2),
                Number(item.line_total || 0).toFixed(2),
            ]),
            headStyles: { fillColor: [6, 78, 59] },
            styles: { fontSize: 8, cellPadding: 3 },
            alternateRowStyles: { fillColor: [240, 249, 255] },
        });

        const summaryStart = (doc.lastAutoTable?.finalY || 80) + 10;

        autoTable(doc, {
            startY: summaryStart,
            head: [["Description", "Amount"]],
            body: [
                ["Subtotal", Number(purchase.subtotal || 0).toFixed(2)],
                ["Discount", Number(purchase.discount || 0).toFixed(2)],
                ["Tax", Number(purchase.tax || 0).toFixed(2)],
                ["Total", Number(purchase.total_amount || 0).toFixed(2)],
                ["Paid", Number(purchase.paid_amount || 0).toFixed(2)],
                ["Balance", Number(purchase.balance_amount || 0).toFixed(2)],
            ],
            headStyles: { fillColor: [14, 116, 144] },
            styles: { fontSize: 9, cellPadding: 3 },
        });

        const notesY = (doc.lastAutoTable?.finalY || summaryStart + 40) + 10;

        if (notesY > 270) doc.addPage();

        doc.setTextColor(51, 65, 85);
        const finalNotesY = notesY > 270 ? 20 : notesY;
        const notes = doc.splitTextToSize(
            `Notes: ${purchase.notes || "-"}`,
            180
        );
        doc.text(notes, 14, finalNotesY);

        doc.save(
            `Purchase-${purchase.purchase_number || purchase.purchase_id}.pdf`
        );
    }

    const filteredPurchases = useMemo(() => {
        const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

        return purchases.filter((purchase) => {
            const matchesSearch =
                !query ||
                [
                    purchase.purchase_number,
                    purchase.supplier_name,
                    purchase.supplier_code,
                    purchase.warehouse_name,
                    purchase.status,
                ]
                    .filter(Boolean)
                    .join(" ")
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .includes(query);

            const normalizedStatus = String(purchase.status || "").toLowerCase();
            const matchesStatus =
                statusFilter === "all" ||
                (statusFilter === "paid" &&
                    normalizedStatus.includes("paid") &&
                    !normalizedStatus.includes("unpaid") &&
                    !normalizedStatus.includes("partial")) ||
                (statusFilter === "partial" &&
                    normalizedStatus.includes("partial")) ||
                (statusFilter === "unpaid" &&
                    (normalizedStatus.includes("unpaid") ||
                        normalizedStatus.includes("pending") ||
                        normalizedStatus.includes("due")));

            return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
        });
    }, [purchases, search, statusFilter]);

    const summary = useMemo(() => {
        return filteredPurchases.reduce(
            (result, purchase) => {
                result.count += 1;
                result.total += getPurchaseTotal(purchase);
                result.paid += getPurchasePaid(purchase);
                result.balance += getPurchaseBalance(purchase);
                return result;
            },
            { count: 0, total: 0, paid: 0, balance: 0 }
        );
    }, [filteredPurchases]);

    const activeSuppliers = useMemo(
        () => suppliers.filter((supplier) => supplier.is_active),
        [suppliers]
    );

    const activeWarehouses = useMemo(
        () => warehouses.filter((warehouse) => warehouse.is_active),
        [warehouses]
    );

    const activeProducts = useMemo(
        () => products.filter((product) => product.is_active),
        [products]
    );

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <div className="min-h-[70vh] bg-slate-50 p-5 dark:bg-slate-950 sm:p-8">
                <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-6">
                    <div className="h-40 animate-pulse rounded-3xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800" />
                    <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                        {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((item) => (
                            <div
                                key={item}
                                className="h-32 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800"
                            />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                    <div className="h-80 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800" />
                    <p className="text-center text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        Loading purchase management...
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-4 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
            <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-6">
                {/* Header */}
                <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-950 via-emerald-800 to-sky-800 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-emerald-950/10 sm:p-8">
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-12 -top-24 h-72 w-72 rounded-full border-[36px] border-white/5" />
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-36 right-1/4 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-sky-400/10 blur-3xl" />

                    <div className="relative flex flex-col gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
                        <div className="max-w-2xl">
                            <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/15 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-emerald-100">
                                <Icon name="chart" size={15} />
                                Procurement analytics
                            </div>
                            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
                                Purchase Management
                            </h1>
                            <p className="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-emerald-50/85 sm:text-base">
                                Review purchase transactions, monitor supplier
                                balances, manage stock receipts, and generate
                                detailed purchase reports.
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => refreshAll(true)}
                                disabled={refreshing}
                                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:opacity-50"
                            >
                                <Icon
                                    name="refresh"
                                    size={18}
                                    className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
                                />
                                {refreshing ? "Refreshing..." : "Refresh"}
                            </button>

                            {!showForm && (
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={openAddForm}
                                    className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-emerald-900 shadow-lg transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-sky-50"
                                >
                                    <Icon name="plus" size={19} />
                                    Add Purchase
                                </button>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="relative mt-7 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-white/15 pt-5 sm:grid-cols-4">
                        <div>
                            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-100/75">
                                Total records
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold">
                                {purchases.length}
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-100/75">
                                Active suppliers
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold">
                                {activeSuppliers.length}
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-100/75">
                                Warehouses
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold">
                                {activeWarehouses.length}
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-100/75">
                                Products available
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold">
                                {activeProducts.length}
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </section>

                {/* Feedback */}
                {message && (
                    <div
                        role="status"
                        className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3.5 text-sm text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-200"
                    >
                        <Icon name="check" size={19} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                        <span className="flex-1">{message}</span>
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setMessage("")}
                            aria-label="Dismiss success message"
                            className="rounded-lg p-1 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900"
                        >
                            <Icon name="close" size={16} />
                        </button>
                    </div>
                )}

                {error && !showForm && (
                    <div
                        role="alert"
                        className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-4 py-3.5 text-sm text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-900 dark:bg-rose-950/30 dark:text-rose-200"
                    >
                        <Icon name="alert" size={19} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                        <span className="flex-1">{error}</span>
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setError("")}
                            aria-label="Dismiss error message"
                            className="rounded-lg p-1 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-900"
                        >
                            <Icon name="close" size={16} />
                        </button>
                    </div>
                )}

                {/* KPI cards */}
                {!showForm && (
                    <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                        <SummaryCard
                            title="Purchase value"
                            value={formatAmount(summary.total)}
                            description="Total value of filtered purchases"
                            icon="shopping"
                            tone="green"
                        />
                        <SummaryCard
                            title="Amount paid"
                            value={formatAmount(summary.paid)}
                            description="Payments recorded against purchases"
                            icon="check"
                            tone="blue"
                        />
                        <SummaryCard
                            title="Outstanding balance"
                            value={formatAmount(summary.balance)}
                            description="Remaining amount payable"
                            icon="money"
                            tone="amber"
                        />
                        <SummaryCard
                            title="Matching purchases"
                            value={summary.count.toLocaleString("en-PK")}
                            description="Transactions matching your filters"
                            icon="file"
                            tone="cyan"
                        />
                    </section>
                )}

                {/* Purchase form */}
                {showForm ? (
                    <form onSubmit={savePurchase} className="space-y-6">
                        <section className={`${panelClass} overflow-hidden`}>
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-50 to-sky-50 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 dark:from-emerald-950/30 dark:to-sky-950/30 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:p-6">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-emerald-100 p-3 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-900/60 dark:text-emerald-200">
                                        <Icon name="shopping" size={23} />
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                            {editingPurchaseId
                                                ? "Edit purchase"
                                                : "Create purchase"}
                                        </h2>
                                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                            Complete the purchase details and add
                                            the items received.
                                        </p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={cancelEdit}
                                    disabled={saving}
                                    className={buttonSecondary}
                                >
                                    <Icon name="close" size={17} />
                                    Cancel
                                </button>
                            </div>

                            {error && (
                                <div
                                    role="alert"
                                    className="mx-5 mt-5 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-900 dark:bg-rose-950/30 dark:text-rose-200 sm:mx-6"
                                >
                                    {error}
                                </div>
                            )}

                            <div className="p-5 sm:p-6">
                                <div className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span className="h-6 w-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-600" />
                                    <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                        Purchase information
                                    </h3>
                                </div>

                                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                                    <div>
                                        <label className={labelClass}>
                                            Purchase number
                                        </label>
                                        <input
                                            value={form.purchaseNumber}
                                            onChange={(e) =>
                                                updateForm("purchaseNumber", e.target.value)
                                            }
                                            placeholder="Auto-generated or enter number"
                                            className={inputClass}
                                        />

                                        [
                                            "Supplier",
                                            `${selectedPurchase.supplier_code || ""}${selectedPurchase.supplier_code ? " - " : ""}${selectedPurchase.supplier_name || "-"}`,
                                        ],
                                        [
                                            "Warehouse",
                                            `${selectedPurchase.warehouse_code || ""}${selectedPurchase.warehouse_code ? " - " : ""}${selectedPurchase.warehouse_name || "-"}`,
                                        ],
                                        ["Status", selectedPurchase.status],
                                    ].map(([label, value]) => (
                                        <div
                                            key={label}
                                            className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900"
                                        >
                                            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                                {label}
                                            </p>
                                            <p className="mt-2 break-words font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                                {value || "-"}
                                            </p>
                                        </div>
                                    ))}
                                </div>

                                <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 bg-sky-50 px-4 py-4 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-sky-950/30 sm:px-5">
                                        <Icon name="package" size={20} className="text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-300" />
                                        <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                            Purchase items
                                        </h3>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                                        <table className="w-full min-w-[700px] text-left text-sm">
                                            <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400">
                                                <tr>
                                                    <th className="p-3">Product</th>
                                                    <th className="p-3 text-right">Quantity</th>
                                                    <th className="p-3 text-right">Unit cost</th>
                                                    <th className="p-3 text-right">Discount</th>
                                                    <th className="p-3 text-right">Tax</th>
                                                    <th className="p-3 text-right">Total</th>
                                                </tr>
                                            </thead>
                                            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                                                {(selectedPurchase.items || []).map((item, index) => (
                                                    <tr key={item.purchase_item_id ?? index}>
                                                        <td className="p-3 font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                                                            {item.sku ? `${item.sku} - ` : ""}
                                                            {item.product_name || "-"}
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="p-3 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                                                            {formatAmount(item.quantity)}
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="p-3 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                                                            {formatAmount(item.unit_cost)}
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="p-3 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                                                            {formatAmount(item.discount)}
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="p-3 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                                                            {formatAmount(item.tax)}
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="p-3 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                                                            {formatAmount(item.line_total)}
                                                        </td>
                                                    </tr>
                                                ))}
                                                {(!selectedPurchase.items ||
                                                    selectedPurchase.items.length === 0) && (
                                                    <tr>
                                                        <td colSpan={6} className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                                            No purchase items found.
                                                        </td>
                                                    </tr>
                                                )}
                                            </tbody>
                                        </table>
                                    </div>
                                </section>

                                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2">
                                    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-800">
                                        <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                            Purchase notes
                                        </h3>
                                        <p className="mt-3 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                                            {selectedPurchase.notes || "No notes were added to this purchase."}
                                        </p>
                                    </section>

                                    <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                                        <div className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-4 py-3 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                            Financial summary
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                                            {[
                                                ["Subtotal", selectedPurchase.subtotal],
                                                ["Discount", selectedPurchase.discount],
                                                ["Tax", selectedPurchase.tax],
                                                ["Total", selectedPurchase.total_amount],
                                                ["Paid", selectedPurchase.paid_amount],
                                                ["Balance", selectedPurchase.balance_amount],
                                            ].map(([label, value]) => (
                                                <div
                                                    key={label}
                                                    className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3 ${
                                                        label === "Total"
                                                            ? "bg-sky-50 font-bold text-sky-900 dark:bg-sky-950/40 dark:text-sky-200"
                                                            : label === "Balance"
                                                              ? "font-bold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300"
                                                              : "text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300"
                                                    }`}
                                                >
                                                    <span>{label}</span>
                                                    <span className="tabular-nums">
                                                        {formatAmount(value)}
                                                    </span>
                                                </div>
                                            ))}
                                        </div>
                                    </section>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div className="sticky bottom-0 flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 bg-white/95 px-5 py-4 backdrop-blur dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950/95 sm:px-7">
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={printPurchase}
                                    className={buttonSecondary}
                                >
                                    <Icon name="print" size={17} />
                                    Print
                                </button>
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={downloadPurchasePDF}
                                    className={buttonPrimary}
                                >
                                    <Icon name="download" size={17} />
                                    Download PDF
                                </button>
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => setSelectedPurchase(null)}
                                    className={buttonSecondary}
                                >
                                    Close
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                )}

                <style jsx global>{`
                    @media print {
                        body * {
                            visibility: hidden !important;
                        }

                        #purchase-report,
                        #purchase-report * {
                            visibility: visible !important;
                        }

                        #purchase-report {
                            position: absolute !important;
                            left: 0 !important;
                            top: 0 !important;
                            width: 100% !important;
                            padding: 16px !important;
                            background: white !important;
                            color: #0f172a !important;
                        }

                        #purchase-report table,
                        #purchase-report tr,
                        #purchase-report td,
                        #purchase-report th {
                            color: #0f172a !important;
                            border-color: #cbd5e1 !important;
                        }

                        #purchase-report section,
                        #purchase-report div {
                            background: white !important;
                            box-shadow: none !important;
                        }
                    }
                `}</style>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

const styles = {
  panel:
    "overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white shadow-sm shadow-slate-200/40 transition-colors dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:shadow-black/10",
  label:
    "mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300",
  input:
    "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 dark:placeholder:text-slate-500 dark:focus:border-blue-400",
  primaryButton:
    "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-blue-700 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-blue-600 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-blue-600/25 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 disabled:hover:translate-y-0",
  secondaryButton:
    "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-slate-500/10 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800",
};

export default function SalesReportPage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [reportLoading, setReportLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [showReportForm, setShowReportForm] = useState(false);
  const [from, setFrom] = useState("");
  const [to, setTo] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function fetchSalesReport() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/reports/sales", {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

        const result = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            result.message || "Failed to load sales dashboard."
          );
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setData(result);
          setError("");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          console.error("SALES REPORT ERROR:", err);
          setError(err.message || "Failed to load sales dashboard.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    fetchSalesReport();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  function openReportForm() {
    setError("");
    setShowReportForm(true);
  }

  function cancelReportForm() {
    setError("");
    setShowReportForm(false);
  }

  async function loadReport(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");

    if (from && to && from > to) {
      setError("The From date cannot be later than the To date.");
      return;
    }

    setReportLoading(true);

    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();

      if (from) params.set("from", from);
      if (to) params.set("to", to);

      const query = params.toString();
      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/reports/sales${query ? `?${query}` : ""}`,
        { cache: "no-store" }
      );

      const result = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          result.message || "Failed to generate sales report."
        );
      }

      setData(result);
      setError("");
      setShowReportForm(false);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("SALES REPORT ERROR:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to generate sales report.");
    } finally {
      setReportLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function resetFilters() {
    setFrom("");
    setTo("");
    setError("");
  }

  function formatMoney(value) {
    return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    });
  }

  const summary = data?.summary || {};
  const topCustomers = Array.isArray(data?.topCustomers)
    ? data.topCustomers
    : [];

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50/80 p-4 text-slate-900 transition-colors duration-300 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 xl:p-8">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-7">
        {/* PAGE HEADER */}
        <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 sm:p-8">
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-12 -top-20 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 blur-3xl" />
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-24 right-1/3 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 blur-3xl" />

          <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
              <div className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-emerald-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20">
                <ChartIcon className="h-7 w-7" />
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="rounded-full border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-blue-700 dark:border-blue-900 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:text-blue-300">
                    Reports & Analytics
                  </span>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300">
                    <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                    Sales overview
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-950 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
                  Sales Dashboard
                </h1>
                <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 sm:text-base">
                  Monitor invoice activity, revenue, collected payments, and
                  customer receivables in one place.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {!showReportForm && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={openReportForm}
                className={styles.primaryButton}
              >
                <CalendarIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                Generate Report
                <ArrowRightIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="relative mt-7 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:grid-cols-3">
            <HeaderInfo
              icon={<DocumentIcon className="h-4 w-4" />}
              title="Invoice insights"
              subtitle="Review sales volume"
            />
            <HeaderInfo
              icon={<WalletIcon className="h-4 w-4" />}
              title="Payment tracking"
              subtitle="Monitor collected amounts"
            />
            <HeaderInfo
              icon={<UsersIcon className="h-4 w-4" />}
              title="Customer performance"
              subtitle="Understand outstanding balances"
            />
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* ERROR MESSAGE */}
        {error && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800 dark:border-red-900/70 dark:bg-red-950/30 dark:text-red-300"
          >
            <AlertIcon className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="font-bold">Something went wrong</p>
              <p className="mt-1 break-words text-sm">{error}</p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setError("")}
              aria-label="Dismiss error"
              className="rounded-lg p-1 text-lg leading-none transition hover:bg-red-100 dark:hover:bg-red-900/40"
            >
              Ã—
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* REPORT FILTER FORM */}
        {showReportForm && (
          <form
            onSubmit={loadReport}
            className={`${styles.panel} animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2 duration-300`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-start gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50 via-white to-emerald-50 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 dark:from-blue-950/40 dark:via-slate-900 dark:to-emerald-950/20 sm:p-6">
              <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/50 dark:text-blue-300">
                <CalendarIcon className="h-6 w-6" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-xl">
                  Generate Sales Report
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Choose a date range to update the sales summary and customer
                  performance.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-5 p-5 sm:p-6">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="report-from" className={styles.label}>
                    From Date
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="report-from"
                    type="date"
                    value={from}
                    max={to || undefined}
                    onChange={(e) => setFrom(e.target.value)}
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Start of the reporting period
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="report-to" className={styles.label}>
                    To Date
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="report-to"
                    type="date"
                    value={to}
                    min={from || undefined}
                    onChange={(e) => setTo(e.target.value)}
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    End of the reporting period
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-blue-100 bg-blue-50/70 p-4 dark:border-blue-900/60 dark:bg-blue-950/30">
                <InfoIcon className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                <p className="text-sm leading-6 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200">
                  Leave both dates empty to use the API&apos;s default reporting
                  date range.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 pt-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={reportLoading}
                  onClick={resetFilters}
                  className={styles.secondaryButton}
                >
                  <RefreshIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Clear Dates
                </button>

                <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 sm:flex-row">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={reportLoading}
                    onClick={cancelReportForm}
                    className={styles.secondaryButton}
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={reportLoading}
                    className={styles.primaryButton}
                  >
                    {reportLoading ? (
                      <SpinnerIcon className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      <ChartIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                    )}
                    {reportLoading ? "Generating Report..." : "Generate Report"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}

        {/* DASHBOARD CONTENT */}
        {!showReportForm && (
          <>
            <section>
              <div className="mb-4 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    Sales at a glance
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Key figures from your current report
                  </p>
                </div>
                <span className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300">
                  <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                  {loading ? "Updating figures" : "Report summary"}

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">

                  title="Invoices"
                  value={loading ? "..." : summary.invoice_count ?? 0}
                  description="Total sales invoices"
                  icon={<DocumentIcon className="h-5 w-5" />}
                  color="blue"
                  loading={loading}
                />
                <Stat
                  title="Total Sales"
                  value={
                    loading ? "..." : `Rs. ${formatMoney(summary.total_sales)}`
                  }
                  description="Total invoiced sales"
                  icon={<ChartIcon className="h-5 w-5" />}
                  color="green"
                  loading={loading}
                />
                <Stat
                  title="Paid"
                  value={
                    loading ? "..." : `Rs. ${formatMoney(summary.paid_amount)}`
                  }
                  description="Payments received"
                  icon={<WalletIcon className="h-5 w-5" />}
                  color="emerald"
                  loading={loading}
                />
                <Stat
                  title="Receivable"
                  value={
                    loading
                      ? "..."
                      : `Rs. ${formatMoney(summary.balance_amount)}`
                  }
                  description="Outstanding customer balance"
                  icon={<ClockIcon className="h-5 w-5" />}
                  color="sky"
                  loading={loading}
                />
              </div>
            </section>

            {/* CUSTOMERS TABLE */}
            <section className={styles.panel}>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:p-6">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 dark:text-emerald-300">
                    <UsersIcon className="h-5 w-5" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      Top Customers
                    </h2>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Customer sales, payments, and outstanding balances
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                    {loading ? "Loading..." : `${topCustomers.length} Customers`}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={openReportForm}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-blue-700 transition hover:bg-blue-100 dark:border-blue-900 dark:bg-blue-950/50 dark:text-blue-300 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50"
                  >
                    <CalendarIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                    Filter Dates
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {loading ? (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                  {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((item) => (
                    <div
                      key={item}
                      className="h-24 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800"
                    />
                  ))}
                  <p className="col-span-full py-5 text-center text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Loading customer sales data...
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : !data ? (
                <div className="px-5 py-14 text-center sm:px-8">
                  <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-950/50 dark:text-blue-300">
                    <ChartIcon className="h-7 w-7" />
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="mt-4 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    Sales data unavailable
                  </h3>
                  <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Check your connection or report API, then try generating the
                    report again.
                  </p>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={openReportForm}
                    className={`${styles.primaryButton} mt-5`}
                  >
                    Generate Report
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : topCustomers.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="px-5 py-14 text-center sm:px-8">
                  <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300">
                    <UsersIcon className="h-7 w-7" />
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="mt-4 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    No customer sales found
                  </h3>
                  <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    There are no customers with sales in this report. Try
                    selecting a different date range.
                  </p>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={openReportForm}
                    className={`${styles.primaryButton} mt-5`}
                  >
                    Generate Report
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[900px] text-sm">
                    <thead className="bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-slate-950/70">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="px-5 py-4 text-left text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          Code
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-5 py-4 text-left text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          Customer
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          Invoices
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          Sales (PKR)
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          Paid (PKR)
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          Balance (PKR)
                        </th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>

                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                      {topCustomers.map((customer, index) => (
                        <tr
                          key={customer.customer_id ?? `${customer.customer_code ?? "customer"}-${index}`}
                          className="group transition-colors hover:bg-blue-50/50 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/20"
                        >
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4">
                            <span className="rounded-md bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                              {customer.customer_code || "-"}
                            </span>
                          </td>

                          <td className="px-5 py-4">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                              <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-100 to-emerald-100 text-xs font-extrabold text-blue-800 dark:from-blue-950 dark:to-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300">
                                {getInitials(customer.customer_name)}
                              </div>
                              <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                                {customer.customer_name || "-"}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </td>

                          <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {customer.invoice_count ?? 0}
                          </td>

                          <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                            {formatMoney(customer.total_sales)}
                          </td>

                          <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                            {formatMoney(customer.paid_amount)}
                          </td>

                          <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold tabular-nums text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                            {formatMoney(customer.balance_amount)}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>

                    <tfoot className="border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950/70">
                      <tr>
                        <td
                          colSpan={2}
                          className="px-5 py-4 font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100"
                        >
                          Customers shown: {topCustomers.length}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                          {topCustomers.reduce(
                            (total, customer) =>
                              total + Number(customer.invoice_count || 0),
                            0
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                          {formatMoney(
                            topCustomers.reduce(
                              (total, customer) =>
                                total + Number(customer.total_sales || 0),
                              0
                            )
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-extrabold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                          {formatMoney(
                            topCustomers.reduce(
                              (total, customer) =>
                                total + Number(customer.paid_amount || 0),
                              0
                            )
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-extrabold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                          {formatMoney(
                            topCustomers.reduce(
                              (total, customer) =>
                                total + Number(customer.balance_amount || 0),
                              0
                            )
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    </tfoot>
                  </table>
                </div>
              )}

              {data && topCustomers.length > 0 && (
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 px-5 py-3 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950/40 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                  <span>
                    Showing {topCustomers.length} customer
                    {topCustomers.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
                  </span>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                    Values are displayed in PKR
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
          </>
        )}

        <footer className="flex flex-col gap-2 pb-2 text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <span>Sales &amp; Analytics</span>
          <span>Amounts are formatted in Pakistani Rupees (PKR).</span>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

function getInitials(name) {
  const words = String(name || "Customer")
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);

  return words
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((word) => word[0].toUpperCase())
    .join("");
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

  Boxes,

const numberFormat = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
  minimumFractionDigits: 0,
  maximumFractionDigits: 3,
});

const amountFormat = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
  minimumFractionDigits: 2,
  maximumFractionDigits: 2,
});

function formatNumber(value) {
  const number = Number(value ?? 0);
  return numberFormat.format(Number.isFinite(number) ? number : 0);
}

function formatAmount(value) {
  const number = Number(value ?? 0);
  return amountFormat.format(Number.isFinite(number) ? number : 0);
}

function getStatusInfo(status) {
  const normalized = String(status ?? "").toLowerCase().trim();

  if (
    normalized.includes("out of stock") ||
    normalized.includes("out_of_stock") ||
    normalized.includes("zero stock") ||
    normalized.includes("no stock")
  ) {
    return {
      label: status || "Out of Stock",
      className:
        "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:border-red-900/60 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300",
      dotClass: "bg-red-500",
      icon: XCircle,
    };
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("low") ||
    normalized.includes("critical") ||
    normalized.includes("reorder")
  ) {
    return {
      label: status || "Low Stock",
      className:
        "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:border-amber-900/60 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300",
      dotClass: "bg-amber-500",
      icon: AlertTriangle,
    };
  }

  if (
    normalized.includes("normal") ||
    normalized.includes("in stock") ||
    normalized.includes("available") ||
    normalized.includes("healthy")
  ) {
    return {
      label: status || "In Stock",
      className:
        "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300",
      dotClass: "bg-emerald-500",
      icon: CheckCircle2,
    };
  }

  return {
    label: status || "Unknown",
    className:
      "border-gray-200 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300",
    dotClass: "bg-gray-400",
    icon: Boxes,
  };
}

            {value}

          {subtitle && (

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
