export default function StockReportPage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [warehouseFilter, setWarehouseFilter] = useState("all");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all");
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState("product_name");
  const [sortDirection, setSortDirection] = useState("asc");

  const loadData = useCallback(async ({ silent = false } = {}) => {
    if (silent) {
      setRefreshing(true);
    } else {
      setLoading(true);
    }

    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/reports/stock", {
        method: "GET",
        cache: "no-store",
        headers: {
          Accept: "application/json",
        },
      });

      const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";

      if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) {
        throw new Error(
          "The server returned an invalid response. Please check your stock report API."
        );
      }

      const result = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          result?.message || "Unable to load the stock report."
        );
      }

      setData(result);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Stock report error:", err);
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Something went wrong while loading the stock report."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function fetchInitialData() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/reports/stock", {
          method: "GET",
          cache: "no-store",
          headers: {
            Accept: "application/json",
          },
        });

        const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";

        if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) {
          throw new Error(
            "The server returned an invalid response. Please check your stock report API."
          );
        }

        const result = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            result?.message || "Unable to load the stock report."
          );
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setData(result);
          setError("");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Stock report error:", err);

        if (!cancelled) {
          setError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err.message
              : "Something went wrong while loading the stock report."
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    fetchInitialData();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const stock = useMemo(
    () => (Array.isArray(data?.stock) ? data.stock : []),
    [data]
  );

  const warehouses = useMemo(() => {
    return [
      ...new Set(
        stock
          .map((item) => item.warehouse_name)
          .filter(
            (warehouse) =>
              typeof warehouse === "string" && warehouse.trim() !== ""
          )
      ),
    ].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  }, [stock]);

  const summary = useMemo(() => {
    const productCount = Number(data?.summary?.product_count ?? 0);
    const totalQuantity = Number(data?.summary?.total_quantity ?? 0);

    const lowStockCount = stock.filter((item) => {
      const status = String(item.stock_status ?? "").toLowerCase();
      return (
        status.includes("low") ||
        status.includes("critical") ||
        status.includes("reorder")
      );
    }).length;

    const outOfStockCount = stock.filter((item) => {
      const quantity = Number(item.quantity ?? 0);
      const status = String(item.stock_status ?? "").toLowerCase();

      return (
        quantity <= 0 ||
        status.includes("out of stock") ||
        status.includes("out_of_stock") ||
        status.includes("zero stock")
      );
    }).length;

    const totalCostValue = stock.reduce(
      (total, item) => total + (Number(item.stock_cost_value) || 0),
      0
    );

    const totalSaleValue = stock.reduce(
      (total, item) => total + (Number(item.stock_sale_value) || 0),
      0
    );

    return {
      productCount: Number.isFinite(productCount) ? productCount : 0,
      totalQuantity: Number.isFinite(totalQuantity) ? totalQuantity : 0,
      lowStockCount,
      outOfStockCount,
      totalCostValue,
      totalSaleValue,
    };
  }, [data, stock]);

  const filteredStock = useMemo(() => {
    const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    const filtered = stock.filter((item) => {
      const matchesSearch =
        !query ||
        [
          item.sku,
          item.product_name,
          item.warehouse_name,
          item.stock_status,
        ].some((value) => String(value ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(query));

      const matchesWarehouse =
        warehouseFilter === "all" ||
        item.warehouse_name === warehouseFilter;

      const quantity = Number(item.quantity ?? 0);
      const status = String(item.stock_status ?? "").toLowerCase();

      const isOutOfStock =
        quantity <= 0 ||
        status.includes("out of stock") ||
        status.includes("out_of_stock") ||
        status.includes("zero stock");

      const isLowStock =
        status.includes("low") ||
        status.includes("critical") ||
        status.includes("reorder");

      const matchesStatus =
        statusFilter === "all" ||
        (statusFilter === "out" && isOutOfStock) ||
        (statusFilter === "low" && !isOutOfStock && isLowStock) ||
        (statusFilter === "normal" &&
          !isOutOfStock &&
          !isLowStock &&
          (status.includes("normal") ||
            status.includes("in stock") ||
            status.includes("available") ||
            status.includes("healthy")));

      return matchesSearch && matchesWarehouse && matchesStatus;
    });

    return filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      const first = a?.[sortBy];
      const second = b?.[sortBy];

      let comparison;

      if (
        ["quantity", "stock_cost_value", "stock_sale_value"].includes(sortBy)
      ) {
        comparison = (Number(first) || 0) - (Number(second) || 0);
      } else {
        comparison = String(first ?? "").localeCompare(String(second ?? ""), undefined, {
          numeric: true,
          sensitivity: "base",
        });
      }

      return sortDirection === "asc" ? comparison : -comparison;
    });
  }, [stock, search, warehouseFilter, statusFilter, sortBy, sortDirection]);

  const handleSort = (column) => {
    if (sortBy === column) {
      setSortDirection((current) => (current === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc"));
    } else {
      setSortBy(column);
      setSortDirection("asc");
    }
  };

  const exportCSV = () => {
    if (filteredStock.length === 0) {
      setError("There are no stock records to export with the current filters.");
      return;
    }

    const columns = [
      ["SKU", "sku"],
      ["Product", "product_name"],
      ["Warehouse", "warehouse_name"],
      ["Quantity", "quantity"],
      ["Cost Value", "stock_cost_value"],
      ["Sale Value", "stock_sale_value"],
      ["Status", "stock_status"],
    ];

    const escapeCSV = (value) => {
      let text = String(value ?? "");

      if (/^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(text)) {
        text = `'${text}`;
      }

      return `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
    };

    const csv = [
      columns.map(([heading]) => escapeCSV(heading)).join(","),
      ...filteredStock.map((item) =>
        columns.map(([, key]) => escapeCSV(item[key])).join(",")
      ),
    ].join("\r\n");

    const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF" + csv], {
      type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;",
    });

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");

    link.href = url;
    link.download = `stock-report-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;

    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();

    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearch("");
    setWarehouseFilter("all");
    setStatusFilter("all");
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <LoadingState />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 text-gray-900 dark:bg-gray-950 dark:text-gray-100">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1800px] space-y-6 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:space-y-8 lg:p-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-700 via-blue-700 to-cyan-700 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-blue-900/10 sm:p-8">
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-16 -top-24 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-white/10 blur-2xl" />
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-28 right-1/4 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-cyan-300/20 blur-3xl" />

          <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 xl:flex-row xl:items-center">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
              <div className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white/15 shadow-inner backdrop-blur-sm sm:h-16 sm:w-16">
                <BarChart3 className="h-7 w-7 sm:h-8 sm:w-8" />
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="mb-2 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-blue-50">
                  <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-300" />
                  Inventory Management
                </div>

                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl">
                  Stock Report
                </h1>

                <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-blue-100 sm:text-base">
                  Monitor current inventory, warehouse quantities, stock
                  status, and estimated inventory values from one place.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white backdrop-blur-sm">
                <Clock3 className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>
                  Updated{" "}
                  {new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-PK", {
                    day: "2-digit",
                    month: "short",
                    year: "numeric",
                  })}
                </span>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => loadData({ silent: true })}
                disabled={refreshing}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/25 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-blue-800 shadow-md transition hover:bg-blue-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-70"
              >
                <RefreshCw
                  className={`h-4 w-4 ${refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}`}
                />
                {refreshing ? "Refreshing..." : "Refresh"}
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={exportCSV}
                disabled={filteredStock.length === 0}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/25 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
                Export CSV
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="relative mt-7 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 border-t border-white/20 pt-5 sm:grid-cols-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Package className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-100" />
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-blue-100">Product count</p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-lg font-bold">
                  {formatNumber(summary.productCount)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Warehouse className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-100" />
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-blue-100">Warehouses represented</p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-lg font-bold">
                  {formatNumber(warehouses.length)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Layers3 className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-100" />
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-blue-100">Inventory records</p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-lg font-bold">
                  {formatNumber(stock.length)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Error message */}
        {error && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800 dark:border-red-900/60 dark:bg-red-950/30 dark:text-red-300 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
          >
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
              <p className="text-sm">{error}</p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setError("")}
              className="self-start rounded-lg p-1 transition hover:bg-red-100 dark:hover:bg-red-900/40 sm:self-center"
              aria-label="Dismiss error"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Summary cards */}
        <section>
          <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white sm:text-xl">
                Inventory Overview
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                A quick snapshot of your current stock position.
              </p>
            </div>

            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900 dark:text-gray-300">
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500" />
              Live report data
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            <StatCard
              title="Total Products"
              value={formatNumber(summary.productCount)}
              subtitle="Products in the report summary"
              icon={Package}
              iconClass="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300"
              iconBackground="bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/50"
              accentClass="bg-blue-500"
            />

            <StatCard
              title="Total Quantity"
              value={formatNumber(summary.totalQuantity)}
              subtitle="Combined quantity from report summary"
              icon={Boxes}
              iconClass="text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-300"
              iconBackground="bg-violet-50 dark:bg-violet-950/50"
              accentClass="bg-violet-500"
            />

            <StatCard
              title="Low Stock Records"
              value={formatNumber(summary.lowStockCount)}
              subtitle="Records marked low, critical, or reorder"
              icon={AlertTriangle}
              iconClass="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300"
              iconBackground="bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/50"
              accentClass="bg-amber-500"
            />

            <StatCard
              title="Out of Stock Records"
              value={formatNumber(summary.outOfStockCount)}
              subtitle="Records with zero or negative quantity"
              icon={XCircle}
              iconClass="text-red-600 dark:text-red-300"
              iconBackground="bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/50"
              accentClass="bg-red-500"
            />
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Inventory value cards */}
        <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-50 to-white p-5 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:from-emerald-950/40 dark:to-gray-900 sm:p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  Total Stock Cost Value
                </p>
                <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-gray-900 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
                  {formatAmount(summary.totalCostValue)}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                  Sum of cost values for the stock records
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/60">
                <DollarSign className="h-6 w-6 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <TrendingUp className="absolute -bottom-5 -right-4 h-28 w-28 text-emerald-600/5 dark:text-emerald-300/10" />
          </div>

          <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 to-white p-5 dark:border-indigo-900/60 dark:from-indigo-950/40 dark:to-gray-900 sm:p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-300">
                  Total Potential Sale Value
                </p>
                <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-gray-900 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
                  {formatAmount(summary.totalSaleValue)}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                  Sum of sale values for the stock records
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-900/60">
                <ShoppingCart className="h-6 w-6 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <TrendingDown className="absolute -bottom-5 -right-4 h-28 w-28 text-indigo-600/5 dark:text-indigo-300/10" />
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Stock table */}
        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
          <div className="border-b border-gray-200 p-5 dark:border-gray-800 sm:p-6">
            <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 xl:flex-row xl:items-center">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/50">
                    <FileSpreadsheet className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                      Stock Details
                    </h2>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                      Search, filter, and review inventory by warehouse.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-100 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300">
                <Boxes className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>
                  Showing{" "}
                  <strong className="text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                    {formatNumber(filteredStock.length)}
                  </strong>{" "}
                  of {formatNumber(stock.length)} records
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(240px,1.5fr)_minmax(180px,1fr)_minmax(180px,1fr)_auto]">
              <div className="relative">
                <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
                <input
                  type="search"
                  value={search}
                  onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search SKU, product, warehouse..."
                  aria-label="Search stock"
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-sm text-gray-900 outline-none transition placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:border-blue-500 focus:bg-white focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-white dark:focus:border-blue-500 dark:focus:bg-gray-800"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="relative">
                <Warehouse className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
                <select
                  value={warehouseFilter}
                  onChange={(event) => setWarehouseFilter(event.target.value)}
                  aria-label="Filter by warehouse"
                  className="w-full appearance-none rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 py-3 pl-10 pr-10 text-sm text-gray-800 outline-none transition focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100"
                >
                  <option value="all">All Warehouses</option>
                  {warehouses.map((warehouse) => (
                    <option key={warehouse} value={warehouse}>
                      {warehouse}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
              </div>

              <div className="relative">
                <Filter className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
                <select
                  value={statusFilter}
                  onChange={(event) => setStatusFilter(event.target.value)}
                  aria-label="Filter by stock status"
                  className="w-full appearance-none rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 py-3 pl-10 pr-10 text-sm text-gray-800 outline-none transition focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100"
                >
                  <option value="all">All Statuses</option>
                  <option value="normal">Normal Stock</option>
                  <option value="low">Low Stock</option>
                  <option value="out">Out of Stock</option>
                </select>
                <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={clearFilters}
                disabled={
                  !search && warehouseFilter === "all" && statusFilter === "all"
                }
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-600 transition hover:border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 dark:border-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:bg-gray-800"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                Clear Filters
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {filteredStock.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex min-h-72 flex-col items-center justify-center px-6 py-14 text-center">
              <div className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800">
                {stock.length === 0 ? (
                  <Package className="h-8 w-8 text-gray-400" />
                ) : (
                  <Search className="h-8 w-8 text-gray-400" />
                )}
              </div>

              <h3 className="mt-5 text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                {stock.length === 0
                  ? "No stock records available"
                  : "No matching stock records"}
              </h3>

              <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                {stock.length === 0
                  ? "Your stock report does not contain any inventory records yet."
                  : "Try a different search term or clear your filters to see more results."}
              </p>

              {stock.length > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={clearFilters}
                  className="mt-5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700"
                >
                  Clear all filters
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* Desktop and tablet table */}
              <div className="hidden overflow-x-auto md:block">
                <table className="w-full min-w-[950px] border-collapse text-left text-sm">
                  <thead className="bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/80">
                    <tr className="border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800">
                      <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleSort("sku")}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400"
                        >
                          SKU
                          <ArrowUpDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleSort("product_name")}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400"
                        >
                          Product
                          <ArrowUpDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                        Warehouse
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleSort("quantity")}
                          className="ml-auto inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400"
                        >
                          Quantity
                          <ArrowUpDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleSort("stock_cost_value")}
                          className="ml-auto inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400"
                        >
                          Cost Value
                          <ArrowUpDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleSort("stock_sale_value")}
                          className="ml-auto inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400"
                        >
                          Sale Value
                          <ArrowUpDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </th>

                      <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                        <button
                          type="button"

                        <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/50">
                          <Package className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300" />
                        </div>

                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <h3 className="break-words font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                            {item.product_name || "Unnamed Product"}
                          </h3>
                          <p className="mt-1 break-all font-mono text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                            SKU: {item.sku || "â€”"}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <StatusBadge status={item.stock_status} />
                    </div>

                    <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 p-3 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300">
                      <Warehouse className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-gray-400" />

                          {formatAmount(item.stock_cost_value)}

                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                          Potential Sale Value
                        </p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold tabular-nums text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300">
                          {formatAmount(item.stock_sale_value)}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </article>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-5 py-4 text-xs text-gray-500 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-800/50 dark:text-gray-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                <p>
                  Displaying{" "}
                  <strong className="text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200">
                    {formatNumber(filteredStock.length)}
                  </strong>{" "}
                  inventory records
                </p>

                <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                  Stock report loaded
                </p>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </section>

        <footer className="flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-2 text-center text-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 sm:flex-row sm:text-left">
          <p>Inventory Management Â· Stock Report</p>
          <p>Use Refresh to retrieve the latest report data.</p>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

const inputClass =
    "w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--erp-border)] bg-[var(--erp-input)] px-4 py-3 text-sm text-[var(--erp-text)] outline-none transition placeholder:text-[var(--erp-muted)] hover:border-blue-400 focus:border-[var(--erp-primary)] focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10";

const panelClass =
    "rounded-2xl border border-[var(--erp-border)] bg-[var(--erp-surface)] shadow-sm";

const mutedText = "text-[var(--erp-muted)]";
const headingText = "text-[var(--erp-text)]";

const buttonBase =
    "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold transition duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50";

const primaryButton =
    `${buttonBase} bg-[var(--erp-primary)] text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-[var(--erp-primary-hover)] hover:shadow-md focus:ring-blue-500/20 active:scale-[0.98]`;

const outlineButton =
    `${buttonBase} border border-[var(--erp-border)] bg-[var(--erp-surface)] text-[var(--erp-text)] hover:border-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-50/60 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:hover:bg-blue-400/10`;

function getErrorMessage(error, fallback) {
    return error instanceof Error && error.message
        ? error.message
        : fallback;
}

async function readResponse(response) {
    try {
        return await response.json();
    } catch {
        throw new Error("The server returned an invalid response.");
    }
}

function Notice({ type, children, onDismiss }) {
    const success = type === "success";
    const Icon = success ? CheckCircle2 : AlertCircle;

    return (
        <div
            role={success ? "status" : "alert"}
            className={`flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border p-4 ${
                success
                    ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-500/30 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 dark:text-emerald-200"
                    : "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-500/30 dark:bg-rose-950/30 dark:text-rose-200"
            }`}
        >
            <div
                className={`flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${
                    success
                        ? "bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-500/15"
                        : "bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-500/15"
                }`}
            >
                <Icon size={19} />
            </div>

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 pt-1">
                <p className="text-sm font-bold">
                    {success ? "Success" : "Something went wrong"}
                </p>
                <div className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6">{children}</div>
            </div>

            <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onDismiss}
                aria-label="Dismiss notification"
                className="rounded-lg p-1.5 transition hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10"
            >
                <X size={17} />
            </button>
        </div>
    );
}

function StatCard({ icon: Icon, label, value, description, accent }) {
    const accents = {
        blue: {
            icon: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 ring-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:ring-blue-400/20",
            bar: "bg-blue-500",
        },
        green: {
            icon: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 ring-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-400/10 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:ring-emerald-400/20",
            bar: "bg-emerald-500",
        },
        teal: {
            icon: "bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 ring-teal-100 dark:bg-teal-400/10 dark:text-teal-300 dark:ring-teal-400/20",
            bar: "bg-teal-500",
        },
        sky: {
            icon: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 ring-sky-100 dark:bg-sky-400/10 dark:text-sky-300 dark:ring-sky-400/20",
            bar: "bg-sky-500",
        },
    };

    const style = accents[accent] || accents.blue;

    return (
        <div className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[var(--erp-border)] bg-[var(--erp-surface)] p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md sm:p-6">
            <div
                className={`absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1 ${style.bar} opacity-80 transition group-hover:opacity-100`}
            />

            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className={`text-sm font-semibold ${mutedText}`}>
                        {label}
                    </p>

                    <p className={`mt-3 text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight ${headingText}`}>
                        {value}
                    </p>

                    <p className={`mt-2 text-xs leading-5 ${mutedText}`}>
                        {description}
                    </p>
                </div>

                <div
                    className={`flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl ring-1 transition duration-200 group-hover:scale-105 ${style.icon}`}
                >
                    <Icon size={23} />
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function RoleBadge({ system }) {
    return (
        <span
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold ${
                system
                    ? "border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:border-blue-400/30 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300"
                    : "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-400/30 dark:bg-emerald-400/10 dark:text-emerald-300"
            }`}
        >
            {system ? <ShieldCheck size={13} /> : <Shield size={13} />}
            {system ? "System role" : "Custom role"}
        </span>
    );
}

function FieldLabel({ htmlFor, children, required = false }) {

        <label
            htmlFor={htmlFor}

        >
            {children}
            {required && <span className="ml-1 text-rose-500">*</span>}
        </label>

}

}

const filterOptions = [
    { value: "all", label: "All roles" },
    { value: "system", label: "System roles" },
    { value: "custom", label: "Custom roles" },
];

export default function RolesPage() {
    const [roles, setRoles] = useState([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
    const [editingRole, setEditingRole] = useState(null);
    const [roleName, setRoleName] = useState("");
    const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
    const [authPassword, setAuthPassword] = useState("");
    const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState(null);
    const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
    const [filter, setFilter] = useState("all");
    const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState(null);

    const loadRoles = useCallback(async (showRefresh = false) => {
        if (showRefresh) {
            setRefreshing(true);
        }

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/roles", {
                method: "GET",
                cache: "no-store",
            });

            const data = await readResponse(response);

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load roles.");
            }

            setRoles(Array.isArray(data.roles) ? data.roles : []);
            setError("");
        } catch (err) {
            setError(
                getErrorMessage(err, "Could not connect to the server.")
            );
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
            setRefreshing(false);
        }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;

        async function initializeRoles() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch("/api/roles", {
                    method: "GET",
                    cache: "no-store",
                });

                const data = await readResponse(response);

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load roles.");
                }

                if (!cancelled) {
                    setRoles(Array.isArray(data.roles) ? data.roles : []);
                    setError("");
                }
            } catch (err) {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setError(
                        getErrorMessage(
                            err,
                            "Could not connect to the server."
                        )
                    );
                }
            } finally {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setLoading(false);
                }
            }
        }

        initializeRoles();

        return () => {
            cancelled = true;
        };
    }, []);

    const stats = useMemo(() => {
        const systemRoles = roles.filter(
            (role) => role.is_system_role
        ).length;

        const customRoles = roles.length - systemRoles;

        const assignedUsers = roles.reduce(
            (total, role) => total + (Number(role.user_count) || 0),
            0
        );

        return {
            total: roles.length,
            system: systemRoles,
            custom: customRoles,
            users: assignedUsers,
        };
    }, [roles]);

    const filteredRoles = useMemo(() => {
        const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();

        return roles.filter((role) => {
            const matchesSearch =
                !term ||
                String(role.role_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                String(role.description || "").toLowerCase().includes(term);

            const matchesFilter =
                filter === "all" ||
                (filter === "system" && role.is_system_role) ||
                (filter === "custom" && !role.is_system_role);

            return matchesSearch && matchesFilter;
        });
    }, [roles, search, filter]);

    function clearForm() {
        setShowForm(false);
        setEditingRole(null);
        setRoleName("");
        setDescription("");
        setAuthPassword("");
    }

    function openCreate() {
        setEditingRole(null);
        setRoleName("");
        setDescription("");
        setAuthPassword("");
        setError("");
        setMessage("");
        setShowForm(true);
    }

    function openEdit(role) {
        if (role.is_system_role) return;

        setEditingRole(role);
        setRoleName(role.role_name || "");
        setDescription(role.description || "");
        setAuthPassword("");
        setError("");
        setMessage("");
        setShowForm(true);
    }

    function closeForm() {
        if (saving) return;
        clearForm();
        setError("");
    }

    async function submitForm(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        if (saving) return;

        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        const trimmedName = roleName.trim();

        if (!trimmedName) {
            setError("Role name is required.");
            return;
        }

        if (!editingRole && !authPassword) {
            setError("Enter your current account password to create a role.");
            return;
        }

        setSaving(true);

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                editingRole
                    ? `/api/roles/${editingRole.role_id}`
                    : "/api/roles",
                {
                    method: editingRole ? "PUT" : "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        roleName: trimmedName,
                        description: description.trim(),
                        ...(editingRole ? {} : { authPassword }),
                    }),
                }
            );

            const data = await readResponse(response);

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Role operation failed.");
            }

            const wasEditing = Boolean(editingRole);

            clearForm();

            setMessage(
                wasEditing
                    ? "Role updated successfully."
                    : "Role created successfully. You can now assign it to a user."
            );

            await loadRoles();
        } catch (err) {
            setError(
                getErrorMessage(err, "Could not connect to the server.")
            );
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    async function deleteRole() {
        if (!deleteTarget || deletingId !== null) return;

        const id = deleteTarget.role_id;

        setError("");
        setMessage("");
        setDeletingId(id);

        try {
            const response = await fetch(`/api/roles/${id}`, {
                method: "DELETE",
                cache: "no-store",
            });

            const data = await readResponse(response);

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to delete role.");
            }

            setDeleteTarget(null);
            setMessage("Role deleted successfully.");
            await loadRoles();
        } catch (err) {
            setError(
                getErrorMessage(err, "Could not connect to the server.")
            );
        } finally {
            setDeletingId(null);
        }
    }

    function clearFilters() {
        setSearch("");
        setFilter("all");
    }

    const refreshButtonClass =
        `${outlineButton} shadow-sm`;

    return (
        <div className="erp-page min-h-full p-3 sm:p-5 lg:p-6">
            <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1800px] space-y-6">
                {/* Page header */}
                <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[var(--erp-border)] bg-[var(--erp-surface)] shadow-sm">
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-0 w-1/2 bg-gradient-to-l from-blue-500/[0.07] to-transparent" />
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-12 -top-20 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-emerald-400/[0.10] blur-3xl" />

                    <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 p-5 sm:p-7 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:p-8">
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--erp-primary)]">
                                <ShieldCheck size={15} />
                                Administration
                                <ChevronRight size={13} />
                                <span className={mutedText}>
                                    Role management
                                </span>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                                <div className="hidden h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 ring-1 ring-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:ring-blue-400/20 sm:flex">
                                    <UserRoundCog size={28} />
                                </div>

                                <div>
                                    <h1 className={`text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight sm:text-3xl ${headingText}`}>
                                        Roles &amp; Access
                                    </h1>

                                    <p className={`mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 sm:text-base ${mutedText}`}>
                                        Organize your team, define user roles,
                                        and manage access across your ERP.
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-800 dark:border-blue-400/25 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300">
                                    <LockKeyhole size={13} />
                                    Protected system roles
                                </span>

                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-400/25 dark:bg-emerald-400/10 dark:text-emerald-300">
                                    <Fingerprint size={13} />
                                    Role administration
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => loadRoles(true)}
                                disabled={loading || refreshing}
                                className={refreshButtonClass}
                            >
                                <RefreshCw
                                    size={17}
                                    className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
                                />
                                Refresh
                            </button>

                            {!showForm && (
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={openCreate}
                                    className={`${primaryButton} px-5 py-3`}
                                >
                                    <Plus size={19} />
                                    Create new role
                                    <ArrowUpRight size={16} />
                                </button>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </section>

                {/* Notifications */}
                {message && (
                    <Notice
                        type="success"
                        onDismiss={() => setMessage("")}
                    >
                        {message}
                    </Notice>
                )}

                {error && (
                    <Notice type="error" onDismiss={() => setError("")}>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                            <span>{error}</span>

                            {!showForm && (
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => loadRoles(true)}
                                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-bold underline underline-offset-2"
                                >
                                    <RotateCcw size={14} />
                                    Try again
                                </button>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </Notice>
                )}

                {/* Statistics */}
                <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                    <StatCard
                        icon={ShieldCheck}
                        label="Total roles"
                        value={loading ? "â€”" : stats.total}
                        description="All available role definitions"
                        accent="blue"
                    />

                    <StatCard
                        icon={Shield}
                        label="System roles"
                        value={loading ? "â€”" : stats.system}
                        description="Built-in protected roles"
                        accent="sky"
                    />

                    <StatCard
                        icon={Sparkles}
                        label="Custom roles"
                        value={loading ? "â€”" : stats.custom}
                        description="Roles created for your workflow"
                        accent="green"
                    />

                    <StatCard
                        icon={Users}
                        label="Role assignments"
                        value={loading ? "â€”" : stats.users}
                        description="Sum of users assigned across roles"
                        accent="teal"
                    />
                </section>

                {/* Create / Edit form */}
                {showForm && (
                    <section className={`${panelClass} overflow-hidden`}>
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[var(--erp-border)] bg-blue-50/60 px-5 py-5 dark:bg-blue-400/[0.05] sm:px-7">
                            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                                <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300">
                                    {editingRole ? (
                                        <Pencil size={22} />
                                    ) : (
                                        <Plus size={23} />
                                    )}
                                </div>

                                <div>
                                    <h2 className={`text-xl font-bold ${headingText}`}>
                                        {editingRole
                                            ? "Edit role"
                                            : "Create a new role"}
                                    </h2>

                                    <p className={`mt-1 text-sm leading-6 ${mutedText}`}>
                                        {editingRole
                                            ? "Update the name or description of this custom role."
                                            : "Create a custom role for your team's responsibilities."}
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={closeForm}
                                disabled={saving}
                                aria-label="Close form"
                                className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--erp-border)] bg-[var(--erp-surface)] p-2.5 text-[var(--erp-muted)] transition hover:border-blue-300 hover:text-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50"
                            >
                                <X size={19} />
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <form onSubmit={submitForm}>
                            <div className="grid gap-6 p-5 sm:p-7 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_280px]">
                                <div className="space-y-5">
                                    <div>
                                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="roleName" required>
                                            Role name
                                        </FieldLabel>

                                        <div className="relative">
                                            <Shield
                                                size={18}
                                                className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--erp-muted)]"
                                            />

                                            <input
                                                id="roleName"
                                                type="text"
                                                value={roleName}
                                                onChange={(event) =>
                                                    setRoleName(event.target.value)
                                                }
                                                placeholder="e.g. SALES_MANAGER"
                                                maxLength={100}
                                                className={`${inputClass} pl-11`}
                                                autoComplete="off"
                                                required
                                            />
                                        </div>

                                        <p className={`mt-2 text-xs leading-5 ${mutedText}`}>
                                            Use a clear name that reflects this role&apos;s responsibilities.
                                        </p>
                                    </div>

                                    <div>
                                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="description">
                                            Description
                                        </FieldLabel>

                                        <div className="relative">
                                            <FileText
                                                size={18}
                                                className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-4 text-[var(--erp-muted)]"
                                            />

                                            <textarea
                                                id="description"
                                                value={description}
                                                onChange={(event) =>
                                                    setDescription(event.target.value)
                                                }
                                                placeholder="Describe what this role is responsible for..."
                                                maxLength={1000}
                                                rows={5}
                                                className={`${inputClass} resize-y pl-11`}
                                            />
                                        </div>

                                        <p className={`mt-2 text-right text-xs ${mutedText}`}>
                                            {description.length}/1000 characters
                                        </p>
                                    </div>

                                    {!editingRole && (
                                        <div>
                                            <FieldLabel
                                                htmlFor="authPassword"
                                                required
                                            >
                                                Confirm your password
                                            </FieldLabel>

                                            <div className="relative">
                                                <KeyRound
                                                    size={18}
                                                    className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--erp-muted)]"
                                                />

                                                <input
                                                    id="authPassword"
                                                    type="password"
                                                    value={authPassword}
                                                    onChange={(event) =>
                                                        setAuthPassword(event.target.value)
                                                    }
                                                    autoComplete="current-password"
                                                    placeholder="Enter your current account password"
                                                    className={`${inputClass} pl-11`}
                                                    required
                                                />
                                            </div>

                                            <p className={`mt-2 flex items-start gap-2 text-xs leading-5 ${mutedText}`}>
                                                <LockKeyhole
                                                    size={14}
                                                    className="mt-0.5 shrink-0"
                                                />
                                                Confirm your identity before creating a new role.
                                            </p>
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </div>

                                <aside className="h-fit rounded-2xl border border-blue-200/80 bg-blue-50/60 p-5 dark:border-blue-400/20 dark:bg-blue-400/[0.05]">
                                    <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[var(--erp-surface)] text-blue-700 shadow-sm dark:text-blue-300">
                                        <ShieldAlert size={21} />
                                    </div>

                                    <h3 className={`mt-4 font-bold ${headingText}`}>
                                        Role management tips
                                    </h3>

                                    <ul className={`mt-4 space-y-3 text-sm leading-6 ${mutedText}`}>
                                        <li className="flex items-start gap-2">
                                            <CheckCircle2
                                                size={16}
                                                className="mt-1 shrink-0 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                                            />
                                            Choose a descriptive role name.
                                        </li>

                                        <li className="flex items-start gap-2">
                                            <CheckCircle2
                                                size={16}
                                                className="mt-1 shrink-0 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                                            />
                                            Explain the role&apos;s responsibilities.
                                        </li>

                                        <li className="flex items-start gap-2">
                                            <CheckCircle2
                                                size={16}
                                                className="mt-1 shrink-0 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                                            />
                                            Assign appropriate user rights separately.
                                        </li>
                                    </ul>

                                    <div className="mt-5 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-blue-200/70 bg-[var(--erp-surface)] p-3 text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--erp-muted)]">

                                            size={15}

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={closeForm}
                                    disabled={saving}
                                    className={outlineButton}
                                >
                                    Cancel
                                </button>

                                <button
                                    type="submit"
                                    disabled={saving}
                                    className={`${primaryButton} px-6`}
                                >
                                    {saving ? (
                                        <LoaderCircle
                                            size={18}
                                            className="animate-spin"
                                        />
                                    ) : editingRole ? (
                                        <CheckCircle2 size={18} />
                                    ) : (
                                        <Plus size={19} />
                                    )}

                                    {saving
                                        ? "Saving role..."
                                        : editingRole
                                          ? "Save changes"
                                          : "Create role"}
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </form>
                    </section>
                )}

                {/* Roles table */}
                {!showForm && (
                    <section className={`${panelClass} overflow-hidden`}>
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 border-b border-[var(--erp-border)] p-5 sm:p-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300">

                                        {loading
                                            ? "Loading your role directory..."
                                            : `${filteredRoles.length} of ${roles.length} roles shown`}
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
                                <div className="relative min-w-0 sm:min-w-[240px]">
                                    <Search
                                        size={18}
                                        className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[var(--erp-muted)]"

                                        type="search"
                                        value={search}
                                        onChange={(event) =>
                                            setSearch(event.target.value)
                                        }
                                        placeholder="Search roles..."
                                        aria-label="Search roles"
                                        className={`${inputClass} py-2.5 pl-10`}
                                    />
                                </div>

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => loadRoles(true)}
                                    disabled={loading || refreshing}
                                    className={refreshButtonClass}
                                >
                                    <RefreshCw
                                        size={16}
                                        className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
                                    />
                                    Refresh
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-[var(--erp-border)] px-5 py-3 sm:px-6">
                            {filterOptions.map((option) => (
                                <button
                                    key={option.value}
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => setFilter(option.value)}
                                    aria-pressed={filter === option.value}
                                    className={`rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition duration-200 ${
                                        filter === option.value
                                            ? "bg-[var(--erp-primary)] text-white shadow-sm"
                                            : "text-[var(--erp-muted)] hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-800 dark:hover:bg-blue-400/10 dark:hover:text-blue-300"
                                    }`}
                                >
                                    {option.label}
                                    {filter === option.value && (
                                        <span className="ml-2 rounded-full bg-white/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs">
                                            {filteredRoles.length}
                                        </span>
                                    )}
                                </button>
                            ))}
                        </div>

                        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                            <table className="w-full min-w-[850px] text-left text-sm">
                                <thead className="bg-[var(--erp-page)]/70 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--erp-muted)]">
                                    <tr>
                                        <th className="px-5 py-4 font-bold">
                                            Role
                                        </th>
                                        <th className="px-5 py-4 font-bold">
                                            Description

                                            Users
                                        </th>
                                        <th className="px-5 py-4 font-bold">
                                            Type
                                        </th>
                                        <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold">
                                            Actions
                                        </th>
                                    </tr>

                                <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--erp-border)]">
                                    {loading ? (
                                        <LoadingRows />
                                    ) : filteredRoles.length === 0 ? (
                                        <tr>
                                            <td colSpan={5} className="px-6 py-16">
                                                <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-sm flex-col items-center text-center">
                                                    <div className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300">
                                                        <Search size={28} />
                                                    </div>

                                                    <h3 className={`mt-4 text-base font-bold ${headingText}`}>
                                                        {roles.length === 0
                                                            ? "No roles created yet"
                                                            : "No matching roles"}
                                                    </h3>

                                                    <p className={`mt-2 text-sm leading-6 ${mutedText}`}>
                                                        {roles.length === 0
                                                            ? "Create a custom role to organize responsibilities for your team."
                                                            : "Try another search term or change the selected filter."}
                                                    </p>

                                                    {roles.length === 0 ? (
                                                        <button
                                                            type="button"
                                                            onClick={openCreate}
                                                            className={`${primaryButton} mt-5`}

                                                            <Plus size={17} />

                                                        </button>
                                                    ) : (

                                                            type="button"
                                                            onClick={clearFilters}

                                    ) : (

                                            return (
                                                <tr
                                                    key={role.role_id}
                                                    className="group transition-colors hover:bg-blue-50/50 dark:hover:bg-blue-400/[0.04]"

                                                    <td className="px-5 py-5">

                                                                className={`flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${

                                                                        ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300"
                                                                        : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-400/10 dark:text-emerald-300"
                                                                }`}

                                                                {system ? (
                                                                    <ShieldCheck size={21} />
                                                                ) : (
                                                                    <Shield size={21} />
                                                                )}
                                                            </div>
