                                                                <p className={`font-bold ${headingText}`}>
                                                                    {role.role_name}
                                                                </p>

                                                                <p className={`mt-1 text-xs ${mutedText}`}>
                                                                    Role ID: {role.role_id}
                                                                </p>
                                                            </div>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </td>

                                                    <td className="max-w-[300px] px-5 py-5">
                                                        <p className="line-clamp-2 leading-6 text-[var(--erp-muted)]">
                                                            {role.description || "No description provided"}
                                                        </p>
                                                    </td>

                                                    <td className="px-5 py-5">
                                                        <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--erp-border)] bg-[var(--erp-page)]/60 px-3 py-2">
                                                            <Users
                                                                size={16}
                                                                className="text-[var(--erp-muted)]"
                                                            />

                                                            <span className={`font-bold tabular-nums ${headingText}`}>
                                                                {userCount}
                                                            </span>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </td>

                                                    <td className="px-5 py-5">
                                                        <RoleBadge system={system} />
                                                    </td>

                                                    <td className="px-5 py-5">
                                                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                                                            {system ? (
                                                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-[var(--erp-border)] bg-[var(--erp-page)]/70 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--erp-muted)]">
                                                                    <LockKeyhole size={14} />
                                                                    Protected
                                                                </span>
                                                            ) : (
                                                                <>
                                                                    <button
                                                                        type="button"
                                                                        onClick={() => openEdit(role)}
                                                                        title={`Edit ${role.role_name}`}
                                                                        aria-label={`Edit ${role.role_name}`}
                                                                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-blue-700 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-100 hover:shadow-sm dark:border-blue-400/25 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:hover:bg-blue-400/20"
                                                                    >
                                                                        <Pencil size={14} />
                                                                        Edit
                                                                    </button>

                                                                    <button
                                                                        type="button"
                                                                        onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(role)}
                                                                        disabled={deletingId !== null}
                                                                        title={`Delete ${role.role_name}`}
                                                                        aria-label={`Delete ${role.role_name}`}
                                                                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-rose-700 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-100 hover:shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-rose-400/25 dark:bg-rose-400/10 dark:text-rose-300 dark:hover:bg-rose-400/20"
                                                                    >
                                                                        <Trash2 size={14} />
                                                                        Delete
                                                                    </button>
                                                                </>
                                                            )}
                                                        </div>
                                                    </td>
                                                </tr>
                                            );
                                        })
                                    )}
                                </tbody>
                            </table>
                        </div>

                        {!loading && roles.length > 0 && (
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-[var(--erp-border)] bg-[var(--erp-page)]/50 px-5 py-4 text-xs text-[var(--erp-muted)] sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-6">
                                <span>
                                    Showing {filteredRoles.length} of {roles.length} roles
                                </span>

                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <LockKeyhole
                                        size={13}
                                        className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300"
                                    />
                                    System roles are protected in this interface.
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </section>
                )}

                {/* Delete confirmation dialog */}
                {deleteTarget && (
                    <div
                        className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/50 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm dark:bg-black/70"
                        onMouseDown={(event) => {
                            if (
                                event.target === event.currentTarget &&
                                deletingId === null
                            ) {
                                setDeleteTarget(null);
                            }
                        }}
                    >
                        <div
                            role="dialog"
                            aria-modal="true"
                            aria-labelledby="delete-role-title"
                            className="w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[var(--erp-border)] bg-[var(--erp-surface)] shadow-2xl"
                        >
                            <div className="p-6 sm:p-7">
                                <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 ring-1 ring-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-400/10 dark:text-rose-300 dark:ring-rose-400/20">
                                    <Trash2 size={25} />
                                </div>

                                <h2
                                    id="delete-role-title"
                                    className={`mt-5 text-xl font-extrabold ${headingText}`}
                                >
                                    Delete this role?
                                </h2>

                                <p className={`mt-2 text-sm leading-6 ${mutedText}`}>
                                    You are about to delete{" "}
                                    <strong className={headingText}>
                                        {deleteTarget.role_name}
                                    </strong>
                                    . This action may be blocked if the role is
                                    still assigned to users or protected by
                                    server rules.
                                </p>

                                <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs leading-5 text-amber-800 dark:border-amber-400/25 dark:bg-amber-400/10 dark:text-amber-200">
                                    Check user assignments and permissions
                                    before continuing. This operation may not
                                    be reversible.
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 border-t border-[var(--erp-border)] bg-[var(--erp-page)]/50 p-5 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}
                                    disabled={deletingId !== null}
                                    className={outlineButton}
                                >
                                    Cancel
                                </button>

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={deleteRole}
                                    disabled={deletingId !== null}
                                    className={`${buttonBase} bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-rose-700 hover:shadow-md focus:ring-rose-500/20`}
                                >
                                    {deletingId !== null ? (
                                        <LoaderCircle
                                            size={17}
                                            className="animate-spin"
                                        />
                                    ) : (
                                        <Trash2 size={17} />
                                    )}

                                    {deletingId !== null
                                        ? "Deleting..."
                                        : "Delete role"}
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import jsPDF from "jspdf";
import autoTable from "jspdf-autotable";

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 dark:placeholder:text-slate-400 dark:focus:border-blue-400 dark:focus:ring-blue-400/10";

const labelClass =
  "mb-1.5 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200";

const primaryButton =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50";

const secondaryButton =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700";

function formatMoney(value) {
  return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });
}

function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return "-";

  const date = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return value;

  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB");
}

function StatusBadge({ status }) {
  const normalized = String(status || "").toLowerCase();

  let colors =
    "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 ring-slate-600/20 dark:bg-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 dark:ring-slate-500/30";

  if (normalized.includes("paid") || normalized.includes("complete")) {
    colors =
      "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 ring-emerald-600/20 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:ring-emerald-500/30";
  } else if (
    normalized.includes("partial") ||
    normalized.includes("pending")
  ) {
    colors =
      "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 ring-amber-600/20 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300 dark:ring-amber-500/30";
  } else if (
    normalized.includes("overdue") ||
    normalized.includes("cancel")
  ) {
    colors =
      "bg-red-50 text-red-700 ring-red-600/20 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300 dark:ring-red-500/30";
  }

  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ring-1 ring-inset ${colors}`}
    >
      <span className="mr-1.5 h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-current" />
      {status || "Unknown"}
    </span>
  );
}

function Modal({ children, onClose, wide = false }) {
  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/65 p-3 backdrop-blur-sm sm:p-6"
      onMouseDown={(event) => {
        if (event.target === event.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div
        className={`max-h-[94vh] w-full ${wide ? "max-w-6xl" : "max-w-xl"
          } overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900`}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ModalHeader({ title, subtitle, onClose }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 bg-white px-5 py-4 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 sm:px-7">
      <div>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
          {title}
        </h2>

        {subtitle && (
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {subtitle}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onClose}
        aria-label="Close dialog"
        className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-slate-100 text-xl text-slate-500 transition hover:bg-slate-200 hover:text-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white"
      >
        Ã—
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function SalesInvoicesPage() {
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState([]);
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState([]);
  const [warehouses, setWarehouses] = useState([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [deliveryChallans, setDeliveryChallans] = useState([]);
  const [deliveryChallanId, setDeliveryChallanId] = useState("");
  const [loadingChallan, setLoadingChallan] = useState(false);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showInvoiceForm, setShowInvoiceForm] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState("");

  const [customerId, setCustomerId] = useState("");
  const [warehouseId, setWarehouseId] = useState("");
  const [invoiceNumber, setInvoiceNumber] = useState("");
  const [invoiceDate, setInvoiceDate] = useState(
    new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]
  );

  const [discount, setDiscount] = useState(0);
  const [tax, setTax] = useState(0);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [editingInvoiceId, setEditingInvoiceId] = useState(null);

  const [selectedInvoice, setSelectedInvoice] = useState(null);
  const [invoiceLoading, setInvoiceLoading] = useState(false);

  const [accountingInvoice, setAccountingInvoice] = useState(null);
  const [accountingLines, setAccountingLines] = useState([]);
  const [accountingLoading, setAccountingLoading] = useState(false);
  const [accountingError, setAccountingError] = useState("");

  const [showCashPopup, setShowCashPopup] = useState(false);
  const [cashTransactionType, setCashTransactionType] =
    useState("RECEIPT");
  const [cashAccounts, setCashAccounts] = useState([]);
  const [cashAccountId, setCashAccountId] = useState("");
  const [cashAmount, setCashAmount] = useState("");
  const [cashDescription, setCashDescription] = useState("");
  const [cashSaving, setCashSaving] = useState(false);
  const [cashError, setCashError] = useState("");
  const [cashMessage, setCashMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadData() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      try {
        const [
          invoiceRes,
          customerRes,
          warehouseRes,
          productRes,
          challanRes,
        ] = await Promise.all([
          fetch("/api/sales-invoices", { cache: "no-store" }),
          fetch("/api/customers", { cache: "no-store" }),
          fetch("/api/warehouses", { cache: "no-store" }),
          fetch("/api/products", { cache: "no-store" }),
          fetch("/api/delivery-challans", { cache: "no-store" }),
        ]);

        const [
          invoiceData,
          customerData,
          warehouseData,
          productData,
          challanData,
        ] = await Promise.all([
          invoiceRes.json(),
          customerRes.json(),
          warehouseRes.json(),
          productRes.json(),
          challanRes.json().catch(() => ({})),
        ]);

        if (!invoiceRes.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            invoiceData.message || "Failed to load invoices."
          );
        }

        if (!customerRes.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            customerData.message || "Failed to load customers."
          );
        }

        if (!warehouseRes.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            warehouseData.message || "Failed to load warehouses."
          );
        }

        if (!productRes.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            productData.message || "Failed to load products."
          );
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setInvoices(invoiceData.invoices || []);
          setCustomers(customerData.customers || []);
          setWarehouses(warehouseData.warehouses || []);
          setProducts(productData.products || []);
          setDeliveryChallans(challanData.challans || []);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          console.error(err);
          setError(err.message || "Failed to load page data.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadData();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const accountingJournals = Object.values(
    accountingLines.reduce((groups, line) => {
      const key = String(line.journal_id);

      if (!groups[key]) {
        groups[key] = {
          journal_id: line.journal_id,
          journal_number: line.journal_number,
          journal_date: line.journal_date,
          reference_type: line.reference_type,
          journal_description: line.journal_description,
          lines: [],
          debit: 0,
          credit: 0,
        };
      }

      groups[key].lines.push(line);
      groups[key].debit += Number(line.debit || 0);
      groups[key].credit += Number(line.credit || 0);

      return groups;
    }, {})
  );

  const accountingTotalDebit = accountingLines.reduce(
    (sum, line) => sum + Number(line.debit || 0),
    0
  );

  const accountingTotalCredit = accountingLines.reduce(
    (sum, line) => sum + Number(line.credit || 0),
    0
  );

  const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => {
    return sum + calculateLineTotal(item);
  }, 0);

  const total =
    subtotal - (Number(discount) || 0) + (Number(tax) || 0);

  async function openAccountingLines(invoice) {
    setAccountingInvoice(invoice);
    setAccountingLines([]);
    setAccountingError("");
    setAccountingLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/sales-invoices/${invoice.invoice_id}/accounting`,
        { cache: "no-store" }
      );

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
        throw new Error(
          data.message || "Failed to load accounting lines."
        );
      }

      setAccountingLines(data.lines || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setAccountingError(
        err.message || "Failed to load accounting lines."
      );
    } finally {
      setAccountingLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function openCashPopup() {
    setCashError("");
    setCashMessage("");
    setCashAmount("");
    setCashDescription("");
    setCashAccountId("");
    setShowCashPopup(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/accounts", {
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
        throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load accounts.");
      }

      const allAccounts = Array.isArray(data)
        ? data
        : data.accounts || data.data || [];

      const availableAccounts = allAccounts.filter((account) => {
        const isCashBank =
          account.is_cash_bank === true ||
          account.is_cash_bank === "true";

        const isActive =
          account.is_active === undefined ||
          account.is_active === true ||
          account.is_active === "true";

        const isGroup =
          account.is_group === true ||
          account.is_group === "true";

        return isCashBank && isActive && !isGroup;
      });

      setCashAccounts(availableAccounts);

      if (availableAccounts.length) {
        setCashAccountId(String(availableAccounts[0].account_id));
      } else {
        setCashError(
          "No active Cash/Bank accounts found. Check Chart of Accounts and ensure a posting account is marked as Cash/Bank."
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setCashError(
        err.message || "Failed to load Cash/Bank accounts."
      );
    }
  }

  async function saveCashTransaction(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setCashError("");
    setCashMessage("");

    const amount = Number(cashAmount);

    if (!cashAccountId) {
      setCashError("Please select a Cash/Bank account.");
      return;
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) {
      setCashError("Please enter an amount greater than zero.");
      return;
    }

    if (!cashDescription.trim()) {
      setCashError("Please enter a transaction description.");
      return;
    }

    setCashSaving(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/cash-bank", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          accountId: Number(cashAccountId),
          transactionType: cashTransactionType,
          date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
          amount,
          description: cashDescription.trim(),
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
        throw new Error(
          data.message || "Failed to save Cash/Bank transaction."
        );
      }

      setShowCashPopup(false);
      setCashMessage(
        `${cashTransactionType === "RECEIPT" ? "Cash In" : "Cash Out"
        } transaction saved successfully and posted to the Financial Ledger.`
      );

      setCashAmount("");
      setCashDescription("");
      setCashAccountId("");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setCashError(err.message || "Failed to save transaction.");
    } finally {
      setCashSaving(false);
    }
  }

  function addItem() {
    setItems((current) => [
      ...current,
      {
        productId: "",
        quantity: 1,
        unitPrice: 0,
        discount: 0,
        tax: 0,
      },
    ]);
  }

  function removeItem(index) {
    setItems((current) =>
      current.filter((_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index)
    );
  }

  function updateItem(index, field, value) {
    setItems((current) => {
      const updated = current.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
      updated[index][field] = value;

      if (field === "productId") {
        const product = products.find(
          (entry) => String(entry.product_id) === String(value)
        );

        if (product) {
          updated[index].unitPrice = Number(product.sale_price) || 0;
        }
      }

      return updated;
    });
  }

  function calculateLineTotal(item) {
    const quantity = Number(item.quantity) || 0;
    const unitPrice = Number(item.unitPrice) || 0;
    const itemDiscount = Number(item.discount) || 0;
    const itemTax = Number(item.tax) || 0;

    return quantity * unitPrice - itemDiscount + itemTax;
  }

  function resetForm() {
    setEditingInvoiceId(null);
    setDeliveryChallanId("");
    setInvoiceNumber("");
    setCustomerId("");
    setWarehouseId("");
    setInvoiceDate(new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]);
    setDiscount(0);
    setTax(0);
    setNotes("");
    setItems([]);
    setShowInvoiceForm(false);
  }

  async function openInvoice(invoiceId) {
    try {
      setInvoiceLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/sales-invoices/${invoiceId}`,
        { cache: "no-store" }
      );

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load invoice.");
      }

      const invoiceFromRegister = invoices.find(
        (entry) => String(entry.invoice_id) === String(invoiceId)
      );

      setSelectedInvoice({
        invoice: {
          ...data.invoice,
          delivery_challan_number:
            data.invoice?.delivery_challan_number ||
            invoiceFromRegister?.delivery_challan_number ||
            null,
        },
        items: data.items || [],
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load invoice.");
    } finally {
      setInvoiceLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function editInvoice(invoiceId) {
    try {
      setInvoiceLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/sales-invoices/${invoiceId}`,
        { cache: "no-store" }
      );

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load invoice.");
      }

      const invoice = data.invoice;
      const invoiceItems = data.items || [];

      setEditingInvoiceId(invoice.invoice_id);
      setDeliveryChallanId(
        invoice.delivery_challan_id ? String(invoice.delivery_challan_id) : ""
      );
      setInvoiceNumber(invoice.invoice_number || "");
      setCustomerId(String(invoice.customer_id || ""));
      setWarehouseId(String(invoice.warehouse_id || ""));

      setInvoiceDate(
        invoice.invoice_date
          ? String(invoice.invoice_date).slice(0, 10)
          : new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]
      );

      setDiscount(Number(invoice.discount) || 0);
      setTax(Number(invoice.tax) || 0);
      setNotes(invoice.notes || "");

      setItems(
        invoiceItems.map((item) => ({
          productId: String(item.product_id),
          quantity: Number(item.quantity) || 1,
          unitPrice: Number(item.unit_price) || 0,
          discount: Number(item.discount) || 0,
          tax: Number(item.tax) || 0,
        }))
      );

      setSelectedInvoice(null);
      setShowInvoiceForm(true);

      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to edit invoice.");
    } finally {
      setInvoiceLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function loadDeliveryChallan(challanId) {
    setDeliveryChallanId(challanId);
    if (!challanId) return;

    setLoadingChallan(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/delivery-challans/${challanId}`,
        { cache: "no-store" }
      );
      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
        throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load Delivery Challan.");
      }

      const challan = data.challan || data.deliveryChallan || data;
      const challanItems = data.items || challan.items || [];
      const status = String(challan.status || "").trim().toUpperCase();
      const documentStatus = String(challan.document_status || "").trim().toUpperCase();

      if (status !== "APPROVED") {
        throw new Error("Only approved Delivery Challans can be converted to invoices.");
      }
      if (documentStatus === "INVOICED") {
        throw new Error("This Delivery Challan has already been invoiced.");
      }

      setCustomerId(String(challan.customer_id || ""));
      setWarehouseId(String(challan.warehouse_id || ""));
      setInvoiceDate(
        challan.transaction_date
          ? String(challan.transaction_date).slice(0, 10)
          : new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]
      );
      setNotes(
        challan.memo || challan.notes
          ? `Converted from Delivery Challan ${challan.transaction_number || ""}. ${challan.memo || challan.notes || ""}`.trim()
          : `Converted from Delivery Challan ${challan.transaction_number || ""}.`
      );
      setItems(
        challanItems.map((item) => ({
          productId: String(item.product_id ?? item.productId ?? ""),
          subProductId: item.sub_product_id ?? item.subProductId ?? null,
          quantity: Number(item.quantity) || 1,
          unitPrice: Number(item.unit_price ?? item.unitPrice ?? item.rate ?? 0) || 0,
          discount: Number(item.discount) || 0,
          tax: Number(item.tax ?? item.tax_amount ?? 0) || 0,
        }))
      );
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setDeliveryChallanId("");
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load Delivery Challan.");
    } finally {
      setLoadingChallan(false);
    }
  }

  const availableDeliveryChallans = deliveryChallans.filter((challan) => {
    const status = String(challan.status || "").trim().toUpperCase();
    const documentStatus = String(challan.document_status || "").trim().toUpperCase();
    const alreadyInvoiced = invoices.some(
      (invoice) =>
        String(invoice.delivery_challan_id || "") ===
        String(challan.delivery_challan_id || "")
    );

    return (
      status === "APPROVED" &&
      documentStatus !== "INVOICED" &&
      !alreadyInvoiced
    );
  });

  function startManualInvoice() {
    resetForm();
    setError("");
    setSuccessMessage("");
    setDeliveryChallanId("");
    setShowInvoiceForm(true);
  }

  async function startInvoiceFromDeliveryChallan() {
    setError("");
    setSuccessMessage("");
    setEditingInvoiceId(null);
    setInvoiceNumber("");
    setCustomerId("");
    setWarehouseId("");
    setInvoiceDate(new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]);
    setDiscount(0);
    setTax(0);
    setNotes("");
    setItems([]);
    setDeliveryChallanId("");
    setShowInvoiceForm(true);
  }

  async function saveInvoice(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setSuccessMessage("");

    if (!customerId) {
      setError("Please select a customer.");
      return;
    }

    if (!warehouseId) {
      setError("Please select a warehouse.");
      return;
    }

    if (!items.length) {
      setError("Please add at least one product.");
      return;
    }

    for (const item of items) {
      if (!item.productId) {
        setError("Please select a product for every item.");
        return;
      }

      if (
        !Number.isFinite(Number(item.quantity)) ||
        Number(item.quantity) <= 0
      ) {
        setError("Quantity must be greater than zero.");
        return;
      }
    }

    setSaving(true);

    try {
      const isEditing = Boolean(editingInvoiceId);

      const url = isEditing
        ? `/api/sales-invoices/${editingInvoiceId}`
        : "/api/sales-invoices";

      const method = isEditing ? "PUT" : "POST";

      const payload = {
        invoiceNumber: invoiceNumber.trim(),
        customerId: Number(customerId),
        warehouseId: Number(warehouseId),
        invoiceDate,
        deliveryChallanId: deliveryChallanId ? Number(deliveryChallanId) : null,
        discount: Number(discount) || 0,
        tax: Number(tax) || 0,
        notes,
        items: items.map((item) => ({
          productId: Number(item.productId),
          subProductId: item.subProductId ? Number(item.subProductId) : null,
          quantity: Number(item.quantity),
          unitPrice: Number(item.unitPrice) || 0,
          discount: Number(item.discount) || 0,
          tax: Number(item.tax) || 0,
        })),
      };

      const response = await fetch(url, {
        method,
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Accept: "application/json",
        },
        cache: "no-store",
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      const responseText = await response.text();
      let data;

      try {
        data = responseText ? JSON.parse(responseText) : {};
      } catch {
        throw new Error(
          `The server returned an invalid response (HTTP ${response.status}). Check the Next.js terminal for errors.`
        );
      }

      if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
        throw new Error(
          data.message ||
          `Failed to ${isEditing ? "update" : "create"} invoice (HTTP ${response.status}).`
        );
      }

      resetForm();

      const [invoiceResponse, challanResponse] = await Promise.all([
        fetch("/api/sales-invoices", {
          cache: "no-store",
          headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
        }),
        fetch("/api/delivery-challans", { cache: "no-store" }),
      ]);

      const [invoiceText, challanText] = await Promise.all([
        invoiceResponse.text(),
        challanResponse.text(),
      ]);

      let invoiceData;
      let challanData;

      try {
        invoiceData = invoiceText ? JSON.parse(invoiceText) : {};
      } catch {
        throw new Error(
          "Invoice saved, but the refreshed invoice list returned invalid JSON."
        );
      }

      try {
        challanData = challanText ? JSON.parse(challanText) : {};
      } catch {
        challanData = {};
      }

      if (!invoiceResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          invoiceData.message ||
          "Invoice saved, but the invoice list could not be refreshed."
        );
      }

      setInvoices(invoiceData.invoices || []);
      setDeliveryChallans(challanData.challans || []);
      setSuccessMessage(
        isEditing
          ? "Sales invoice updated successfully."
          : deliveryChallanId
            ? "Delivery Challan converted to Sales Invoice successfully."
            : "Sales invoice created successfully."
      );
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("SAVE INVOICE ERROR:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save invoice.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }
  function downloadInvoicePDF() {
    if (!selectedInvoice) return;

    const invoice = selectedInvoice.invoice;
    const invoiceItems = selectedInvoice.items || [];
    const doc = new jsPDF();
    const pageWidth = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();

    doc.setFontSize(20);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.text("GOLDENLAKE", 14, 20);

    doc.setFontSize(10);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.text("Sales Invoice", 14, 27);
    doc.text(`Invoice #: ${invoice.invoice_number}`, pageWidth - 70, 18);
    doc.text(`Date: ${formatDate(invoice.invoice_date)}`, pageWidth - 70, 25);
    doc.text(`Status: ${invoice.status || "-"}`, pageWidth - 70, 32);
    doc.line(14, 36, pageWidth - 14, 36);

    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.text("Bill To:", 14, 47);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.text(invoice.customer_name || "-", 14, 54);

    if (invoice.customer_code) {
      doc.text(`Code: ${invoice.customer_code}`, 14, 61);
    }

    if (invoice.customer_phone) {
      doc.text(`Phone: ${invoice.customer_phone}`, 14, 68);
    }

    if (invoice.customer_email) {
      doc.text(`Email: ${invoice.customer_email}`, 14, 75);
    }

    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.text("Warehouse:", pageWidth / 2, 47);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.text(invoice.warehouse_name || "-", pageWidth / 2, 54);

    if (invoice.warehouse_code) {
      doc.text(`Code: ${invoice.warehouse_code}`, pageWidth / 2, 61);
    }

    const tableRows = invoiceItems.map((item, index) => [
      index + 1,
      `${item.sku || ""} - ${item.product_name || ""}`,
      item.quantity,
      item.unit || "",
      Number(item.unit_price || 0).toFixed(2),
      Number(item.discount || 0).toFixed(2),
      Number(item.tax || 0).toFixed(2),
      Number(item.line_total || 0).toFixed(2),
    ]);

    autoTable(doc, {
      startY: 85,
      head: [[
        "#",
        "Product",
        "Qty",
        "Unit",
        "Price",
        "Discount",
        "Tax",
        "Total",
      ]],
      body: tableRows,
      theme: "grid",
      styles: {
        fontSize: 8,
        cellPadding: 3,
      },
      headStyles: {
        fontStyle: "bold",
      },
      columnStyles: {
        0: { cellWidth: 10 },
        2: { halign: "right" },
        4: { halign: "right" },
        5: { halign: "right" },
        6: { halign: "right" },
        7: { halign: "right" },
      },
    });

    let finalY = doc.lastAutoTable.finalY + 10;
    const totalsX = pageWidth - 75;

    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.text("Subtotal:", totalsX, finalY);
    doc.text(formatMoney(invoice.subtotal), pageWidth - 14, finalY, {
      align: "right",
    });

    finalY += 7;
    doc.text("Discount:", totalsX, finalY);
    doc.text(`-${formatMoney(invoice.discount)}`, pageWidth - 14, finalY, {
      align: "right",
    });

    finalY += 7;
    doc.text("Tax:", totalsX, finalY);
    doc.text(`+${formatMoney(invoice.tax)}`, pageWidth - 14, finalY, {
      align: "right",
    });

    finalY += 8;
    doc.line(totalsX, finalY, pageWidth - 14, finalY);
    finalY += 8;

    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(12);
    doc.text("TOTAL:", totalsX, finalY);
    doc.text(formatMoney(invoice.total_amount), pageWidth - 14, finalY, {
      align: "right",
    });

    finalY += 10;
    doc.setFontSize(10);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.text(`Paid: ${formatMoney(invoice.paid_amount)}`, totalsX, finalY);

    finalY += 7;
    doc.text(`Balance: ${formatMoney(invoice.balance_amount)}`, totalsX, finalY);

    if (invoice.notes) {
      finalY += 15;
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
      doc.text("Notes:", 14, finalY);

      finalY += 6;
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");

      const noteLines = doc.splitTextToSize(
        invoice.notes,
        pageWidth - 28
      );

      doc.text(noteLines, 14, finalY);
    }

    const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight();

    doc.setFontSize(8);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.text(
      "Thank you for your business.",
      pageWidth / 2,
      pageHeight - 15,
      { align: "center" }
    );

    doc.save(`Invoice-${invoice.invoice_number}.pdf`);
  }

    window.print();

                      : "border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700"
                    }`}

              Thank you for your business.
            </div>

                editInvoice(selectedInvoice.invoice.invoice_id)

              Edit Invoice
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={printInvoice}
              className={secondaryButton}

              Print
            </button>

              type="button"
              onClick={downloadInvoicePDF}
              className={primaryButton}
            >
              Download PDF
            </button>

              type="button"

              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-slate-900 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-600"
            >
              Close
            </button>

      )}

        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[120] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/50 p-4 backdrop-blur-[2px]">

              Loading invoice...
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

const inputClass =
    "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none transition focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100";
const labelClass =
    "mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400";

function today() {
    const date = new Date();
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

function money(value, currency = "PKR") {
    const number = Number(value || 0);
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
        style: "currency",
        currency,
        minimumFractionDigits: 2,
        maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(Number.isFinite(number) ? number : 0);
}

function dateLabel(value) {
    if (!value) return "â€”";
    const date = new Date(`${String(value).slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00`);
    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return String(value);
    return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
        day: "2-digit",
        month: "short",
        year: "numeric",
    }).toUpperCase();
}

function newLine(products = []) {
    const product = products[0];
    return {
        product_id: product?.product_id ? String(product.product_id) : "",
        item_name: product?.product_name || "",
        item_description: product?.description || "",
        item_balance: 0,
        uom: product?.sales_unit || product?.unit || "",
        quantity: 1,
        retail_price: Number(product?.sale_price || 0),
        discount_percent: 0,
        unit_price: Number(product?.sale_price || 0),
        amount: Number(product?.sale_price || 0),
        tax_code: "",
        tax_rate: 0,
        tax_amount: 0,
        gross_amount: Number(product?.sale_price || 0),
        memo: "",
    };
}

function blankForm(products = [], company = null) {
    return {
        order_id: null,
        order_number: "TO BE GENERATED",
        source_quotation_id: "",
        transaction_date: today(),
        status: "APPROVED",
        customer_id: "",
        warehouse_id: "",
        department: "",
        project: "",
        order_class: "",
        sales_rep: "",
        payment_term: "",
        memo: "",
        terms_conditions: "",
        currency: company?.currency || "PKR",
        exchange_rate: 1,
        customer_credit_limit: 0,
        customer_balance: 0,
        available_credit_limit: 0,
        items: [newLine(products)],
    };
}

function normalizeOrderItem(item) {
    const retailPrice = Number(item.retail_price ?? item.unit_price ?? 0);
    const discount = Number(item.discount_percent || 0);
    const quantity = Number(item.quantity || 0);
    const unitPrice =
        Number(item.unit_price ?? retailPrice * (1 - discount / 100));
    const amount = Number(item.amount ?? quantity * unitPrice);
    const taxAmount = Number(item.tax_amount || 0);

    return {
        product_id: item.product_id ? String(item.product_id) : "",
        item_name: item.item_name || "",
        item_description: item.item_description || "",
        item_balance: Number(item.item_balance || 0),
        uom: item.uom || "",
        quantity,
        retail_price: retailPrice,
        discount_percent: discount,
        unit_price: unitPrice,
        amount,
        tax_code: item.tax_code || "",
        tax_rate: Number(item.tax_rate || 0),
        tax_amount: taxAmount,
        gross_amount: Number(item.gross_amount ?? amount + taxAmount),
        memo: item.memo || "",
    };
}

function Button({
    children,
    onClick,
    variant = "secondary",
    disabled = false,
    title,
    type = "button",
}) {
    const styles = {
        primary:
            "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-blue-700 focus:ring-blue-500/30",
        secondary:
            "border border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800",
        success:
            "bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 focus:ring-emerald-500/30",
        danger:
            "border border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 hover:bg-red-100 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300",
    };

    return (
        <button
            type={type}
            title={title}
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={onClick}
            className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold transition focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${styles[variant]}`}
        >
            {children}
        </button>
    );
}

function Field({ label, children, className = "" }) {
    return (
        <div className={className}>
            <label className={labelClass}>{label}</label>
            {children}
        </div>
    );
}

function Section({ title, description, children, action }) {
    return (
        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 px-5 py-4 dark:border-slate-800">
                <div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
                        {title}
                    </h3>
                    {description ? (
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            {description}
                        </p>
                    ) : null}
                </div>
                {action}
            </div>
            <div className="p-5">{children}</div>
        </section>
    );
}

function StatusBadge({ status }) {
    const value = String(status || "DRAFT").toUpperCase();
    const styles =
        value === "APPROVED"
            ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300"
            : value === "CANCELLED"
              ? "bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-950 dark:text-red-300"
              : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-300";

    return (
        <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold ${styles}`}>
            {value}
        </span>
    );
}

function SummaryCard({ label, value, accent = "blue" }) {
    const accents = {
        blue: "from-blue-600 to-indigo-600",
        green: "from-emerald-600 to-teal-600",
        purple: "from-violet-600 to-fuchsia-600",
    };

    return (
        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950">
            <div className={`h-1 bg-gradient-to-r ${accents[accent]}`} />
            <div className="p-4">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    {label}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 break-words text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    {value}
                </p>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

export default function SalesOrdersPage() {
    const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
    const [customers, setCustomers] = useState([]);
    const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
    const [warehouses, setWarehouses] = useState([]);
    const [company, setCompany] = useState(null);
    const [permissions, setPermissions] = useState({
        canView: false,
        canCreate: false,
        canUpdate: false,
        canDelete: false,
    });

    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("ALL");
    const [view, setView] = useState("list");
    const [mode, setMode] = useState("edit");
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("lines");
    const [form, setForm] = useState(null);
    const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
    const [error, setError] = useState("");

    const currency = form?.currency || company?.currency || "PKR";
    const isReadOnly = mode === "view";

    const notifyError = (text) => {
        setError(text);
        setMessage("");
    };

    const notifySuccess = (text) => {
        setMessage(text);
        setError("");
    };

    const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/sales-orders", {
                cache: "no-store",
            });
            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Unable to load Sales Orders.");
            }

            setOrders(data.orders || []);
            setCustomers(data.customers || []);
            setProducts(data.products || []);
            setWarehouses(data.warehouses || []);
            setCompany(data.company || null);
            setPermissions(
                data.permissions || {
                    canView: true,
                    canCreate: false,
                    canUpdate: false,
                    canDelete: false,
                }
            );
        } catch (err) {
            notifyError(err.message || "Unable to load Sales Orders.");
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function initialize() {
        try {
            if (!cancelled) {
                await loadData();
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Failed to initialize Sales Orders:", error);
        }
    }

    initialize();

    return () => {
        cancelled = true;
    };
}, [loadData]);
    const totals = useMemo(() => {
        const items = form?.items || [];
        let subtotal = 0;
        let taxAmount = 0;

        for (const item of items) {
            const quantity = Number(item.quantity || 0);
            const retailPrice = Number(item.retail_price || 0);
            const discount = Number(item.discount_percent || 0);
            const taxRate = Number(item.tax_rate || 0);

            const unitPrice = retailPrice * (1 - discount / 100);
            const amount = quantity * unitPrice;
            const tax = amount * taxRate / 100;

            subtotal += amount;
            taxAmount += tax;
        }

        subtotal = Math.round(subtotal * 100) / 100;
        taxAmount = Math.round(taxAmount * 100) / 100;

        return {
            subtotal,
            taxAmount,
            grossAmount: Math.round((subtotal + taxAmount) * 100) / 100,
        };
    }, [form?.items]);

    const filteredOrders = useMemo(() => {
        const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();

        return orders.filter((order) => {
            const statusMatches =
                statusFilter === "ALL" ||
                String(order.status || "").toUpperCase() === statusFilter;

            const text = [
                order.order_number,
                order.customer_name,
                order.warehouse_name,
                order.status,
                order.document_status,
                order.source_quotation_number,
                order.department,
                order.project,
                order.sales_rep,
            ]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(" ")
                .toLowerCase();

            return statusMatches && (!term || text.includes(term));
        });
    }, [orders, search, statusFilter]);

    function updateForm(field, value) {
        setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
    }

    function updateLine(index, field, value) {
        setForm((current) => {
            const items = [...current.items];
            const item = { ...items[index], [field]: value };

            if (field === "product_id") {
                const product = products.find(
                    (entry) => String(entry.product_id) === String(value)
                );

                if (product) {
                    item.item_name = product.product_name || "";
                    item.item_description = product.description || "";
                    item.uom = product.sales_unit || product.unit || "";
                    item.retail_price = Number(product.sale_price || 0);
                    item.unit_price = Number(product.sale_price || 0);
                }
            }

            const quantity = Number(item.quantity || 0);
            const retailPrice = Number(item.retail_price || 0);
            const discount = Number(item.discount_percent || 0);
            const taxRate = Number(item.tax_rate || 0);
            item.unit_price = retailPrice * (1 - discount / 100);
            item.amount = quantity * item.unit_price;
            item.tax_amount = item.amount * taxRate / 100;
            item.gross_amount = item.amount + item.tax_amount;

            items[index] = item;
            return { ...current, items };
        });
    }

    function addLine() {
        setForm((current) => ({
            ...current,
            items: [...current.items, newLine(products)],
        }));
    }

    function removeLine(index) {
        setForm((current) => ({
            ...current,
            items:
                current.items.length <= 1
                    ? [newLine(products)]
                    : current.items.filter((_, i) => i !== index),
        }));
    }

    function openCreate() {
        if (!permissions.canCreate) {
            notifyError("You do not have permission to create Sales Orders.");
            return;
        }

        setForm(blankForm(products, company));
        setMode("edit");
        setActiveTab("lines");
        setView("form");
        setMessage("");
        setError("");
    }

    async function openOrder(order, nextMode = "view") {
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        try {
            const response = await fetch(`/api/sales-orders/${order.order_id}`, {
                cache: "no-store",
            });
            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Unable to open the Sales Order.");
            }

            const record = data.order;

            setForm({
                ...record,
                order_id: record.order_id,
                order_number: record.order_number,
                transaction_date: String(record.transaction_date || today()).slice(0, 10),
                customer_id: record.customer_id ? String(record.customer_id) : "",
                warehouse_id: record.warehouse_id ? String(record.warehouse_id) : "",
                currency: record.currency || company?.currency || "PKR",
                exchange_rate: Number(record.exchange_rate || 1),
                items: (data.items || []).map(normalizeOrderItem),
            });

            setMode(nextMode);
            setActiveTab("lines");
            setView("form");
        } catch (err) {
            notifyError(err.message || "Unable to open the Sales Order.");
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    function goBack() {
        setView("list");
        setForm(null);
        setMessage("");
        setError("");
        loadData();
    }

    async function saveOrder() {
        if (!form) return;

        if (mode === "view") {
            setMode("edit");
            return;
        }

        if (!form.customer_id) {
            notifyError("Please select a customer.");
            return;
        }

        if (!form.warehouse_id) {
            notifyError("Please select a From Location.");
            return;
        }

        if (!form.items?.length || !form.items.some((item) => item.item_name.trim())) {
            notifyError("Add at least one transaction line.");
            return;
        }

        for (const [index, item] of form.items.entries()) {
            if (!String(item.item_name || "").trim()) {
                notifyError(`Enter an item name on line ${index + 1}.`);
                return;
            }

            if (Number(item.quantity) <= 0) {
                notifyError(`Quantity must be greater than zero on line ${index + 1}.`);
                return;
            }
        }

        setSaving(true);
        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        try {
            const payload = {
                ...form,
                customer_id: Number(form.customer_id),
                warehouse_id: Number(form.warehouse_id),
                exchange_rate: Number(form.exchange_rate || 1),
                subtotal: totals.subtotal,
                tax_amount: totals.taxAmount,
                gross_amount: totals.grossAmount,
                items: form.items.filter((item) => item.item_name.trim()),
            };

            const url = form.order_id
                ? `/api/sales-orders/${form.order_id}`
                : "/api/sales-orders";
            const method = form.order_id ? "PUT" : "POST";

            const response = await fetch(url, {
                method,
                headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload),
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Unable to save Sales Order.");
            }

            notifySuccess(data.message || "Sales Order saved successfully.");

            await loadData();

            if (data.order?.order_id) {
                await openOrder(data.order, "edit");
            } else if (form.order_id) {
                const current = { order_id: form.order_id };
                await openOrder(current, "edit");
            } else {
                setView("list");
                setForm(null);
            }
        } catch (err) {
            notifyError(err.message || "Unable to save Sales Order.");
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    async function deleteOrder() {
        if (!form?.order_id) return;

        const confirmed = window.confirm(
            `Delete Sales Order ${form.order_number}? This cannot be undone.`
        );

        if (!confirmed) return;

        try {
            setSaving(true);

            const response = await fetch(`/api/sales-orders/${form.order_id}`, {
                method: "DELETE",
            });
            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Unable to delete the order.");
            }

            notifySuccess(data.message || "Sales Order deleted.");
            setView("list");
            setForm(null);
            await loadData();
        } catch (err) {
            notifyError(err.message || "Unable to delete the order.");
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    async function convertQuotation() {
        if (!permissions.canCreate) {
            notifyError("You do not have permission to create Sales Orders.");
            return;
        }

        const rawId = window.prompt(
            "Enter the ID of the approved Sales Quotation to convert:"
        );

        if (rawId === null) return;

        const quotationId = Number(rawId.trim());

        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(quotationId) || quotationId <= 0) {
            notifyError("Enter a valid quotation ID.");
            return;
        }

        try {
            setSaving(true);

            const response = await fetch(
                `/api/sales-orders/from-quotation/${quotationId}`,
                { method: "POST" }
            );
            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Could not convert the quotation.");
            }

            await loadData();
            if (data.order?.order_id) {
                await openOrder({ order_id: data.order.order_id }, "view");
            } else {
                notifySuccess(data.message || "Quotation converted.");
            }
        } catch (err) {
            notifyError(err.message || "Could not convert the quotation.");
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    function printReport(orderForm = form) {

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (char) => ({
            "&": "&amp;",
            "<": "&lt;",
            ">": "&gt;",
            '"': "&quot;",
            "'": "&#39;",
        })[char]);
    }

                        </div>

                        <Section
                            title="Sales Order Details"
                            description="Enter the transaction header information."
                            action={
                                <StatusBadge status={form.status} />
                            }
                        >
                            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                                <Field label="Transaction Number">
                                    <input className={`${inputClass} bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800`} readOnly value={form.order_number || "TO BE GENERATED"} />
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Transaction Date">
                                    <input
                                        className={inputClass}
                                        type="date"
                                        disabled={isReadOnly}
                                        value={String(form.transaction_date || today()).slice(0, 10)}
                                        onChange={(event) => updateForm("transaction_date", event.target.value)}
                                    />
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Status">
                                    <select
                                        className={inputClass}
                                        disabled={isReadOnly}
                                        value={form.status || "DRAFT"}
                                        onChange={(event) => updateForm("status", event.target.value)}
                                    >
                                        <option value="DRAFT">DRAFT</option>
                                        <option value="APPROVED">APPROVED</option>
                                        <option value="CANCELLED">CANCELLED</option>
                                    </select>
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Subsidiary / Company">
                                    <input
                                        className={`${inputClass} bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800`}
                                        readOnly
                                        value={company?.company_name || "Current Company"}
                                    />
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Customer">
                                    <select
                                        className={inputClass}
                                        disabled={isReadOnly}
                                        value={form.customer_id || ""}
                                        onChange={(event) => {
                                            const customerId = event.target.value;
                                            const customer = customers.find(
                                                (item) => String(item.customer_id) === customerId
                                            );

                                            setForm((current) => ({
                                                ...current,
                                                customer_id: customerId,
                                                customer_credit_limit: Number(customer?.credit_limit || 0),
                                            }));
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        <option value="">Select Customer</option>
                                        {customers.map((customer) => (
                                            <option key={customer.customer_id} value={customer.customer_id}>
                                                {customer.customer_name} ({customer.customer_code})
                                            </option>
                                        ))}
                                    </select>
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="From Location">
                                    <select
                                        className={inputClass}
                                        disabled={isReadOnly}
                                        value={form.warehouse_id || ""}
                                        onChange={(event) => updateForm("warehouse_id", event.target.value)}
                                    >
                                        <option value="">Select Location</option>
                                        {warehouses.map((warehouse) => (
                                            <option key={warehouse.warehouse_id} value={warehouse.warehouse_id}>
                                                {warehouse.warehouse_name}
                                            </option>
                                        ))}
                                    </select>
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Project">
                                    <input className={inputClass} disabled={isReadOnly} value={form.project || ""} onChange={(event) => updateForm("project", event.target.value)} placeholder="Project name" />
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Department">
                                    <input className={inputClass} disabled={isReadOnly} value={form.department || ""} onChange={(event) => updateForm("department", event.target.value)} placeholder="Department" />
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Sales Rep">
                                    <input className={inputClass} disabled={isReadOnly} value={form.sales_rep || ""} onChange={(event) => updateForm("sales_rep", event.target.value)} placeholder="Sales representative" />
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Class">
                                    <input className={inputClass} disabled={isReadOnly} value={form.order_class || ""} onChange={(event) => updateForm("order_class", event.target.value)} placeholder="Class" />
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Payment Terms">
                                    <input className={inputClass} disabled={isReadOnly} value={form.payment_term || ""} onChange={(event) => updateForm("payment_term", event.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 60 DAYS" />
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Currency">
                                    <select
                                        className={inputClass}
                                        disabled={isReadOnly}
                                        value={form.currency || "PKR"}
                                        onChange={(event) => updateForm("currency", event.target.value)}
                                    >
                                        <option value="PKR">Rupees (PKR)</option>
                                        <option value="USD">US Dollar (USD)</option>
                                        <option value="AED">UAE Dirham (AED)</option>
                                        <option value="SAR">Saudi Riyal (SAR)</option>
                                        <option value="GBP">British Pound (GBP)</option>
                                        <option value="EUR">Euro (EUR)</option>
                                    </select>
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Exchange Rate">
                                    <input className={inputClass} type="number" min="0.000001" step="0.000001" disabled={isReadOnly} value={form.exchange_rate ?? 1} onChange={(event) => updateForm("exchange_rate", event.target.value)} />
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Customer Credit Limit">
                                    <input className={`${inputClass} bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800`} readOnly value={money(form.customer_credit_limit, currency)} />
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Customer Balance">
                                    <input className={`${inputClass} bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800`} readOnly value={money(form.customer_balance || 0, currency)} />
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Available Credit Limit">
                                    <input className={`${inputClass} bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800`} readOnly value={money(Number(form.customer_credit_limit || 0) - Number(form.customer_balance || 0), currency)} />
                                </Field>

                                <Field label="Memo" className="sm:col-span-2 xl:col-span-4">
                                    <textarea className={inputClass} rows={2} disabled={isReadOnly} value={form.memo || ""} onChange={(event) => updateForm("memo", event.target.value)} placeholder="Enter transaction notesâ€¦" />
                                </Field>
                            </div>
                        </Section>

                        <Section
                            title="Transaction Workspace"
                            description="Manage transaction lines, related transactions, and supporting information."
                            action={
                                <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                                    {isReadOnly ? "View mode" : "Edit mode"}
                                </span>
                            }
                        >
                            <div className="mb-5 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto border-b border-slate-200 pb-3 dark:border-slate-800">
                                {tabs.map((tab) => (
                                    <button
                                        key={tab.id}
                                        onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                                        className={`whitespace-nowrap rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition ${
                                            activeTab === tab.id
                                                ? "bg-blue-600 text-white"
                                                : "text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                                        }`}
                                    >
                                        {tab.label}
                                    </button>
                                ))}
                            </div>

                            {activeTab === "lines" ? (
                                <>
                                    <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                                        <div>
                                            <h4 className="font-bold">Transaction Lines</h4>
                                            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                                                Line amounts and taxes are calculated automatically.
                                            </p>
                                        </div>
                                        {!isReadOnly ? (
                                            <Button variant="primary" onClick={addLine}>
                                                + Add Item
                                            </Button>
                                        ) : null}
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                                        <table className="w-full min-w-[1550px] text-left text-xs">
                                            <thead className="bg-slate-100 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400">
                                                <tr>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">#</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Item Name</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Item Description</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Item Balance</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">UOM</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Quantity</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Retail Price</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Discount %</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Unit Price</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Amount</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Tax Code</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Tax %</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Tax Amount</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Gross Amount</th>
                                                    <th className="px-3 py-3">Memo</th>
                                                    {!isReadOnly ? <th className="px-3 py-3">Action</th> : null}
                                                </tr>
                                            </thead>
                                            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                                                {form.items.map((item, index) => (
