                                                        <td className="px-3 py-3 font-bold">{index + 1}</td>
                                                        <td className="min-w-[190px] px-2 py-2">
                                                            <select
                                                                className={inputClass}
                                                                disabled={isReadOnly}
                                                                value={item.product_id || ""}
                                                                onChange={(event) => updateLine(index, "product_id", event.target.value)}
                                                            >
                                                                <option value="">Custom item / select product</option>
                                                                {products.map((product) => (
                                                                    <option key={product.product_id} value={product.product_id}>
                                                                        {product.product_name} ({product.sku})
                                                                    </option>
                                                                ))}
                                                            </select>
                                                            <input
                                                                className={`${inputClass} mt-2`}
                                                                disabled={isReadOnly}
                                                                value={item.item_name || ""}
                                                                onChange={(event) => updateLine(index, "item_name", event.target.value)}
                                                                placeholder="Item name"
                                                            />
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="min-w-[170px] px-2 py-2">
                                                            <input className={inputClass} disabled={isReadOnly} value={item.item_description || ""} onChange={(event) => updateLine(index, "item_description", event.target.value)} />
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="min-w-[100px] px-2 py-2">
                                                            <input className={inputClass} type="number" disabled={isReadOnly} value={item.item_balance ?? 0} onChange={(event) => updateLine(index, "item_balance", event.target.value)} />
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="min-w-[90px] px-2 py-2">
                                                            <input className={inputClass} disabled={isReadOnly} value={item.uom || ""} onChange={(event) => updateLine(index, "uom", event.target.value)} />
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="min-w-[100px] px-2 py-2">
                                                            <input className={inputClass} type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" disabled={isReadOnly} value={item.quantity ?? 1} onChange={(event) => updateLine(index, "quantity", event.target.value)} />
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="min-w-[115px] px-2 py-2">
                                                            <input className={inputClass} type="number" min="0" step="0.01" disabled={isReadOnly} value={item.retail_price ?? 0} onChange={(event) => updateLine(index, "retail_price", event.target.value)} />
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="min-w-[100px] px-2 py-2">
                                                            <input className={inputClass} type="number" min="0" max="100" step="0.001" disabled={isReadOnly} value={item.discount_percent ?? 0} onChange={(event) => updateLine(index, "discount_percent", event.target.value)} />
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-4 font-semibold">
                                                            {Number(item.unit_price || 0).toFixed(2)}
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-4 font-semibold">
                                                            {Number(item.amount || 0).toFixed(2)}
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="min-w-[100px] px-2 py-2">
                                                            <input className={inputClass} disabled={isReadOnly} value={item.tax_code || ""} onChange={(event) => updateLine(index, "tax_code", event.target.value)} />
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="min-w-[90px] px-2 py-2">
                                                            <input className={inputClass} type="number" min="0" step="0.001" disabled={isReadOnly} value={item.tax_rate ?? 0} onChange={(event) => updateLine(index, "tax_rate", event.target.value)} />
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-4">
                                                            {Number(item.tax_amount || 0).toFixed(2)}
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-4 font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                                                            {Number(item.gross_amount || 0).toFixed(2)}
                                                        </td>
                                                        <td className="min-w-[140px] px-2 py-2">
                                                            <input className={inputClass} disabled={isReadOnly} value={item.memo || ""} onChange={(event) => updateLine(index, "memo", event.target.value)} />
                                                        </td>
                                                        {!isReadOnly ? (
                                                            <td className="px-2 py-3">
                                                                <button
                                                                    className="rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 dark:text-red-400 dark:hover:bg-red-950"
                                                                    onClick={() => removeLine(index)}
                                                                    title="Remove line"
                                                                >
                                                                    Remove
                                                                </button>
                                                            </td>
                                                        ) : null}
                                                    </tr>
                                                ))}
                                            </tbody>
                                        </table>
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-5">
                                        <div className="max-w-xl text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                            Saving a Sales Order records the order and its lines only. It does not deduct inventory or create accounting journals.
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-900">
                                            <div className="flex justify-between py-2 text-sm">
                                                <span className="text-slate-500">Total Amount</span>
                                                <strong>{money(totals.subtotal, currency)}</strong>
                                            </div>
                                            <div className="flex justify-between py-2 text-sm">
                                                <span className="text-slate-500">Tax Amount</span>
                                                <strong>{money(totals.taxAmount, currency)}</strong>
                                            </div>
                                            <div className="mt-2 flex justify-between border-t border-slate-200 pt-3 text-base dark:border-slate-700">
                                                <span className="font-bold">Gross Amount</span>
                                                <strong className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                                                    {money(totals.grossAmount, currency)}
                                                </strong>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </>
                            ) : null}

                            {activeTab === "accounting" ? (
                                <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 p-8 text-center dark:border-slate-700">
                                    <h4 className="font-bold">Accounting Lines</h4>
                                    <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                        Sales Orders do not post accounting entries. Accounting entries should be generated by your configured invoicing workflow.
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                            ) : null}

                            {activeTab === "related" ? (
                                <div className="space-y-3">
                                    <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-900">
                                        <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-500">Created From</p>
                                        <p className="mt-1 font-semibold">
                                            {form.source_quotation_number ||
                                                (form.source_quotation_id
                                                    ? `Quotation ID ${form.source_quotation_id}`
                                                    : "Direct Sales Order")}
                                        </p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-900">
                                        <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-500">Document Status</p>
                                        <p className="mt-1 font-semibold">{form.document_status || "Pending Delivery Challan"}</p>
                                    </div>
                                    {form.order_id && form.status === "APPROVED" ? (
                                        <Button
                                            variant="success"
                                            onClick={() => notifyError("Delivery Challan creation has not been implemented yet. The order has not been changed.")}
                                        >
                                            Create Delivery Challan
                                        </Button>
                                    ) : null}
                                </div>
                            ) : null}

                            {activeTab === "system" ? (
                                <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                                    <Field label="Internal Order ID">
                                        <input className={inputClass} readOnly value={form.order_id || "Assigned when saved"} />
                                    </Field>
                                    <Field label="Created At">
                                        <input className={inputClass} readOnly value={form.created_at ? new Date(form.created_at).toLocaleString() : "Assigned when saved"} />
                                    </Field>
                                    <Field label="Updated At">
                                        <input className={inputClass} readOnly value={form.updated_at ? new Date(form.updated_at).toLocaleString() : "â€”"} />
                                    </Field>
                                    <Field label="Created From">
                                        <input className={inputClass} readOnly value={form.source_quotation_number || (form.source_quotation_id ? `Quotation ${form.source_quotation_id}` : "Direct entry")} />
                                    </Field>
                                </div>
                            ) : null}

                            {activeTab === "attachments" ? (
                                <div className="space-y-3">
                                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                        Attachment storage has not been wired to this page yet.
                                    </p>
                                    {form.attachment_url ? (
                                        <a
                                            href={form.attachment_url}
                                            target="_blank"
                                            rel="noreferrer"
                                            className="font-semibold text-blue-600 underline"
                                        >
                                            {form.attachment_name || "Open attachment"}
                                        </a>
                                    ) : (
                                        <p className="text-sm">No attachment saved.</p>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            ) : null}

                            {activeTab === "terms" ? (
                                <Field label="Terms & Conditions">
                                    <textarea
                                        className={inputClass}
                                        rows={7}
                                        disabled={isReadOnly}
                                        value={form.terms_conditions || ""}
                                        onChange={(event) => updateForm("terms_conditions", event.target.value)}
                                        placeholder="Enter the terms and conditions for this Sales Orderâ€¦"
                                    />
                                </Field>
                            ) : null}
                        </Section>

                        <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950">
                            {mode === "edit" ? (
                                <Button variant="primary" onClick={saveOrder} disabled={saving}>
                                    {saving ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Save Sales Order"}
                                </Button>
                            ) : permissions.canUpdate ? (
                                <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setMode("edit")}>
                                    Edit Sales Order
                                </Button>
                            ) : null}
                            <Button onClick={() => printReport()}>Report / Print / Save PDF</Button>
                            <Button onClick={goBack}>Back to History</Button>
                        </div>
                    </>
                ) : null}
            </div>
        </main>
    );
}

      <>
        <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8Z" />
        <path d="M14 2v6h6M8 13h8M8 17h8" />
      </>
    ),
  };

  return <svg {...common}>{paths[name] || paths.file}</svg>;
}

function PaymentMethodBadge({ method }) {
  const normalized = String(method || "OTHER").toUpperCase();

  const styles = {
    CASH: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 ring-emerald-600/15 dark:bg-emerald-400/10 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:ring-emerald-400/20",
    BANK: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 ring-blue-600/15 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:ring-blue-400/20",
    CHEQUE:
      "bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 ring-violet-600/15 dark:bg-violet-400/10 dark:text-violet-300 dark:ring-violet-400/20",
    CARD: "bg-cyan-50 text-cyan-700 ring-cyan-600/15 dark:bg-cyan-400/10 dark:text-cyan-300 dark:ring-cyan-400/20",
    OTHER:
      "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 ring-slate-600/10 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:ring-slate-700",
  };

  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold ring-1 ring-inset ${
        styles[normalized] || styles.OTHER
      }`}
    >
      <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-current" />
      {normalized}
    </span>
  );
}

function SummaryCard({ title, value, description, icon, accent }) {
  const accents = {
    blue: {
      icon: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300",
      line: "from-blue-500 to-cyan-400",
    },
    green: {
      icon: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-400/10 dark:text-emerald-300",
      line: "from-emerald-500 to-teal-400",
    },
    violet: {
      icon: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-400/10 dark:text-violet-300",
      line: "from-violet-500 to-fuchsia-400",
    },
  };

  const theme = accents[accent] || accents.blue;

  return (
    <div
      className={`${cardClass} group relative overflow-hidden p-5 transition duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg`}
    >
      <div
        className={`absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r ${theme.line}`}
      />

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {title}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
            {value}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div
          className={`flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl ${theme.icon}`}
        >
          <Icon name={icon} className="h-6 w-6" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function SalesPaymentsPage() {
  const [payments, setPayments] = useState([]);
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState([]);

  const [invoiceId, setInvoiceId] = useState("");
  const [paymentNumber, setPaymentNumber] = useState("");
  const [paymentDate, setPaymentDate] = useState(
    new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]
  );
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = useState("CASH");
  const [referenceNumber, setReferenceNumber] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const [showPaymentForm, setShowPaymentForm] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPayment, setSelectedPayment] = useState(null);
  const [paymentLoading, setPaymentLoading] = useState(false);
  const [editingPaymentId, setEditingPaymentId] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [methodFilter, setMethodFilter] = useState("ALL");

  // Load payments and invoices.
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadData() {
      setLoading(true);

      try {
        const [paymentResponse, invoiceResponse] = await Promise.all([
          fetch("/api/sales-payments", { cache: "no-store" }),
          fetch("/api/sales-invoices", { cache: "no-store" }),
        ]);

        const paymentData = await paymentResponse.json();
        const invoiceData = await invoiceResponse.json();

        if (!paymentResponse.ok) {
          throw new Error(paymentData.message || "Failed to load payments.");
        }

        if (!invoiceResponse.ok) {
          throw new Error(invoiceData.message || "Failed to load invoices.");
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setPayments(paymentData.payments || []);
          setInvoices(invoiceData.invoices || []);
          setError("");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          console.error(err);
          setError(err.message || "Failed to load data.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadData();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const selectedInvoice = invoices.find(
    (invoice) => String(invoice.invoice_id) === String(invoiceId)
  );

  const totalCollected = useMemo(
    () =>
      payments.reduce(
        (total, payment) => total + Number(payment.amount || 0),
        0
      ),
    [payments]
  );

  const paymentMethodsUsed = useMemo(
    () => new Set(payments.map((payment) => payment.payment_method)).size,
    [payments]
  );

  const filteredPayments = useMemo(() => {
    const query = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();

    return payments.filter((payment) => {
      const matchesMethod =
        methodFilter === "ALL" ||
        String(payment.payment_method || "OTHER").toUpperCase() ===
          methodFilter;

      const searchableText = [
        payment.payment_number,
        payment.invoice_number,
        payment.customer_name,
        payment.reference_number,
        payment.payment_method,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase();

      return matchesMethod && (!query || searchableText.includes(query));
    });
  }, [payments, searchTerm, methodFilter]);

  function formatDate(value) {
    if (!value) return "-";

    const date = new Date(value);

    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return value;

    return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB");
  }

  function formatMoney(value) {
    return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    });
  }

  function resetForm() {
    setEditingPaymentId(null);
    setInvoiceId("");
    setPaymentNumber("");
    setPaymentDate(new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]);
    setAmount("");
    setPaymentMethod("CASH");
    setReferenceNumber("");
    setNotes("");
    setShowPaymentForm(false);
  }

  function addPayment() {
    setError("");
    setSelectedPayment(null);
    setEditingPaymentId(null);
    setInvoiceId("");
    setPaymentNumber("");
    setPaymentDate(new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]);
    setAmount("");
    setPaymentMethod("CASH");
    setReferenceNumber("");
    setNotes("");
    setShowPaymentForm(true);
  }

  async function refreshData() {
    const [paymentResponse, invoiceResponse] = await Promise.all([
      fetch("/api/sales-payments", { cache: "no-store" }),
      fetch("/api/sales-invoices", { cache: "no-store" }),
    ]);

    const paymentData = await paymentResponse.json();
    const invoiceData = await invoiceResponse.json();

    if (!paymentResponse.ok) {
      throw new Error(paymentData.message || "Failed to refresh payments.");
    }

    if (!invoiceResponse.ok) {
      throw new Error(invoiceData.message || "Failed to refresh invoices.");
    }

    setPayments(paymentData.payments || []);
    setInvoices(invoiceData.invoices || []);
  }

  async function savePayment(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");

    if (!invoiceId) {
      setError("Please select an invoice.");
      return;
    }

    if (!amount || Number(amount) <= 0) {
      setError("Payment amount must be greater than zero.");
      return;
    }

    if (
      !editingPaymentId &&
      selectedInvoice &&
      Number(amount) > Number(selectedInvoice.balance_amount)
    ) {
      setError("Payment cannot be greater than invoice balance.");
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    try {
      const method = editingPaymentId ? "PUT" : "POST";

      const response = await fetch("/api/sales-payments", {
        method,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...(editingPaymentId ? { paymentId: editingPaymentId } : {}),
          paymentNumber,
          invoiceId: Number(invoiceId),
          paymentDate,
          amount: Number(amount),
          paymentMethod,
          referenceNumber,
          notes,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.message ||
            (editingPaymentId
              ? "Failed to update payment."
              : "Failed to save payment.")
        );
      }

      await refreshData();
      resetForm();
      setError("");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save payment.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function viewPayment(paymentId) {
    try {
      setPaymentLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/sales-payments?paymentId=${encodeURIComponent(paymentId)}`,
        { cache: "no-store" }
      );

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load payment.");
      }

      if (!data.payment) throw new Error("Payment not found.");

      setSelectedPayment(data.payment);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load payment.");
    } finally {
      setPaymentLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function editPayment(paymentId) {
    try {
      setPaymentLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/sales-payments?paymentId=${encodeURIComponent(paymentId)}`,
        { cache: "no-store" }
      );

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load payment.");
      }

      if (!data.payment) throw new Error("Payment not found.");

      const payment = data.payment;

      setEditingPaymentId(payment.payment_id);
      setPaymentNumber(payment.payment_number || "");
      setInvoiceId(
        payment.invoice_id ? String(payment.invoice_id) : ""
      );
      setPaymentDate(
        payment.payment_date
          ? String(payment.payment_date).slice(0, 10)
          : new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]
      );
      setAmount(
        payment.amount !== null && payment.amount !== undefined
          ? String(payment.amount)
          : ""
      );
      setPaymentMethod(payment.payment_method || "CASH");
      setReferenceNumber(payment.reference_number || "");
      setNotes(payment.notes || "");

      setSelectedPayment(null);
      setShowPaymentForm(true);

      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load payment.");
    } finally {
      setPaymentLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function printPayment() {
    window.print();
  }

  function downloadPaymentPDF() {
    if (!selectedPayment) return;

    const payment = selectedPayment;
    const doc = new jsPDF();
    const pageWidth = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();

    doc.setFillColor(15, 23, 42);
    doc.rect(0, 0, pageWidth, 42, "F");

    doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
    doc.setFontSize(20);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.text("GOLDENLAKE", 14, 19);

    doc.setFontSize(10);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.text("Customer Payment Receipt", 14, 28);

    doc.setFontSize(9);
    doc.text(`Payment #: ${payment.payment_number || "-"}`, pageWidth - 80, 16);
    doc.text(`Date: ${formatDate(payment.payment_date)}`, pageWidth - 80, 23);
    doc.text(`Method: ${payment.payment_method || "-"}`, pageWidth - 80, 30);

    doc.setTextColor(30, 41, 59);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.text("RECEIVED FROM", 14, 56);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.text(payment.customer_name || "-", 14, 64);

    if (payment.customer_code) {
      doc.text(`Customer Code: ${payment.customer_code}`, 14, 71);
    }

    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.text("AGAINST INVOICE", pageWidth / 2, 56);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.text(payment.invoice_number || "-", pageWidth / 2, 64);

    autoTable(doc, {
      startY: 84,
      head: [["Payment Number", "Invoice", "Method", "Reference", "Amount"]],
      body: [
        [
          payment.payment_number || "-",
          payment.invoice_number || "-",
          payment.payment_method || "-",
          payment.reference_number || "-",
          Number(payment.amount || 0).toFixed(2),
        ],
      ],
      theme: "grid",
      styles: {
        fontSize: 9,
        cellPadding: 4,
        textColor: [51, 65, 85],
        lineColor: [226, 232, 240],
      },
      headStyles: {
        fillColor: [37, 99, 235],
        textColor: [255, 255, 255],
        fontStyle: "bold",
      },
      columnStyles: { 4: { halign: "right" } },
    });

    let finalY = doc.lastAutoTable.finalY + 16;

    doc.setFontSize(12);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.text("Payment Amount:", pageWidth - 80, finalY);

    doc.text(
      Number(payment.amount || 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
        minimumFractionDigits: 2,
        maximumFractionDigits: 2,
      }),
      pageWidth - 14,
      finalY,
      { align: "right" }
    );

    if (payment.notes) {
      finalY += 20;

      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.text("Notes:", 14, finalY);

      finalY += 7;
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");

      const noteLines = doc.splitTextToSize(payment.notes, pageWidth - 28);
      doc.text(noteLines, 14, finalY);
    }

    const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight();

    doc.setDrawColor(226, 232, 240);
    doc.line(14, pageHeight - 29, pageWidth - 14, pageHeight - 29);

    doc.setFontSize(9);
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.setTextColor(100, 116, 139);
    doc.text(
      "Thank you for your payment.",
      pageWidth / 2,
      pageHeight - 19,
      { align: "center" }
    );

    const filename = String(payment.payment_number || "Receipt").replace(
      /[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g,
      "_"
    );

    doc.save(`Payment-${filename}.pdf`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="sales-payments-page min-h-screen space-y-7 bg-slate-50/70 p-4 text-slate-800 transition-colors duration-300 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 xl:p-8">
      {/* Page header */}
      <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-700 via-blue-600 to-emerald-600 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-blue-900/10 sm:p-8">
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-12 -top-24 -z-10 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-white/10 blur-3xl" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-28 left-1/3 -z-10 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-emerald-300/20 blur-3xl" />

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
          <div className="max-w-2xl">
            <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-white/90 backdrop-blur">
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-300 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(110,231,183,0.8)]" />
              ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
              Sales Payments
            </h1>

            <p className="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-blue-50 sm:text-base">
              Record customer receipts, track invoice balances, and keep your
              payment history organized in one place.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm text-blue-50">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-white/10 px-3 py-2">
                <Icon name="shield" className="h-4 w-4" />
                Payment management
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-white/10 px-3 py-2">
                <Icon name="receipt" className="h-4 w-4" />
                Printable receipts
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {!showPaymentForm && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={addPayment}
              className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-blue-700 shadow-lg transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:shadow-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-white/30"
            >
              <Icon name="plus" className="h-5 w-5" />
              Record Payment
              <Icon name="arrow" className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Error message */}
      {error && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800 shadow-sm dark:border-red-900/70 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-200"
        >
          <div className="mt-0.5 flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/50">
            <Icon name="info" className="h-5 w-5" />
          </div>

          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="font-semibold">Something needs your attention</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm">{error}</p>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setError("")}
            className="rounded-lg p-1 text-red-700 transition hover:bg-red-100 dark:text-red-200 dark:hover:bg-red-900/60"
            aria-label="Dismiss error"
          >
            <Icon name="close" className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Summary cards */}
      {!showPaymentForm && (
        <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          <SummaryCard
            title="Total Payments Recorded"
            value={payments.length.toLocaleString("en-PK")}
            description="All receipts in payment history"
            icon="receipt"
            accent="blue"
          />
          <SummaryCard
            title="Total Amount Collected"
            value={`â‚¨ ${formatMoney(totalCollected)}`}
            description="Combined value of recorded receipts"
            icon="wallet"
            accent="green"
          />
          <SummaryCard
            title="Payment Methods Used"
            value={paymentMethodsUsed.toLocaleString("en-PK")}
            description="Distinct methods in your records"
            icon="bank"
            accent="violet"
          />
        </section>
      )}

      {/* Payment form */}
      {showPaymentForm && (
        <form
          onSubmit={savePayment}
          className={`${cardClass} overflow-hidden`}
        >
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50 via-white to-emerald-50 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 dark:from-blue-950/40 dark:via-slate-900 dark:to-emerald-950/30 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:p-6">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
              <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-emerald-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20">
                <Icon name={editingPaymentId ? "edit" : "wallet"} className="h-6 w-6" />
              </div>

              <div>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {editingPaymentId ? "Edit Payment" : "Record a Payment"}
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  {editingPaymentId
                    ? "Update the information for this customer receipt."
                    : "Enter the receipt details and link it to a sales invoice."}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {editingPaymentId && (
              <span className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-400/10 dark:text-amber-300">
                <Icon name="edit" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                EDITING PAYMENT
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-7 p-5 sm:p-7">
            <div>
              <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-blue-100 text-xs font-bold text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300">
                  1
                </span>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                  Payment details
                </h3>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>Payment Number</label>
                  <input
                    value={paymentNumber}
                    onChange={(e) => setPaymentNumber(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. PAY-001"
                    className={inputClass}
                  />
                  <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Leave blank if your API generates this number.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>
                    Sales Invoice <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={invoiceId}
                    onChange={(e) => setInvoiceId(e.target.value)}
                    required
                    className={inputClass}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select an invoice</option>
                    {invoices
                      .filter(
                        (invoice) =>
                          Number(invoice.balance_amount) > 0 ||
                          String(invoice.invoice_id) === String(invoiceId)
                      )
                      .map((invoice) => (
                        <option
                          key={invoice.invoice_id}
                          value={invoice.invoice_id}
                        >
                          {invoice.invoice_number} â€” {invoice.customer_name} â€”
                          Balance: {formatMoney(invoice.balance_amount)}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>
                    Payment Date <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={paymentDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setPaymentDate(e.target.value)}
                    required
                    className={inputClass}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>
                    Amount <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <span className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                      â‚¨
                    </span>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="0.01"
                      step="0.01"
                      value={amount}
                      onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
                      required
                      placeholder="0.00"
                      className={`${inputClass} pl-9 font-semibold tabular-nums`}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Enter a positive amount in PKR.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>
                    Payment Method <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={paymentMethod}
                    onChange={(e) => setPaymentMethod(e.target.value)}
                    required
                    className={inputClass}
                  >
                    <option value="CASH">Cash</option>

            <div>
              <p className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Loading payment
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Please wait...
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Theme-aware styling and print receipt */}
      <style jsx global>{`

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

const moneyFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
});

function money(value) {
    return moneyFormatter.format(Number(value) || 0);
}

function today() {
    const date = new Date();
    const offset = date.getTimezoneOffset();

    return new Date(date.getTime() - offset * 60 * 1000)
        .toISOString()
        .slice(0, 10);
}

function dateDisplay(value) {
    if (!value) return "â€”";

    const date = new Date(`${String(value).slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00`);

    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return value;

    return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
        day: "2-digit",
        month: "short",
        year: "numeric",
    });
}

function emptyItem() {
    return {
        productId: "",
        itemName: "",
        itemDescription: "",
        itemBalance: 0,
        uom: "PCS",
        quantity: 1,
        unitPrice: 0,
        taxCode: "",
        taxRate: 0,
        memo: "",
    };
}

function emptyForm() {
    return {
        quotationId: null,
        quotationNumber: "",
        customerId: "",
        warehouseId: "",
        quotationDate: today(),
        expiryDate: "",
        status: "Draft",
        department: "",
        project: "",
        quotationClass: "",
        salesRep: "",
        paymentTerm: "",
        memo: "",
        termsConditions: "",
        relatedTransaction: "",
        attachmentName: "",
        attachmentUrl: "",
        items: [emptyItem()],
    };
}

function getProductId(product) {
    return product.product_id ?? product.productId;
}

function getProductName(product) {
    return product.product_name ?? product.productName ?? "";
}

function getProductPrice(product) {
    return Number(product.sale_price ?? product.salePrice ?? 0);
}

function getProductUnit(product) {
    return product.sales_unit ?? product.salesUnit ?? product.unit ?? "PCS";
}

function getProductDescription(product) {
    return product.sales_description
        ?? product.salesDescription
        ?? product.description
        ?? "";
}

function statusClass(status) {
    switch (status) {
        case "Approved":
            return "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 dark:text-emerald-300";
        case "Rejected":
            return "bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-900/40 dark:text-rose-300";
        case "Expired":
            return "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-900/40 dark:text-amber-300";
        case "Converted":
            return "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900/40 dark:text-blue-300";
        default:
            return "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200";
    }
}

function Icon({ name, className = "h-5 w-5" }) {
    const common = {
        className,
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        strokeWidth: 1.8,
        strokeLinecap: "round",
        strokeLinejoin: "round",
        viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
        "aria-hidden": true,
    };

    const paths = {
        plus: <><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" /></>,
        search: <><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="m20 20-4-4" /></>,
        file: <><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z" /><path d="M14 2v6h6M8 13h8M8 17h8" /></>,
        eye: <><path d="M2 12s3.5-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-3.5 7-10 7S2 12 2 12Z" /><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" /></>,
        edit: <><path d="M12 20h9" /><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L8 18l-4 1 1-4Z" /></>,
        print: <><path d="M6 9V2h12v7M6 18H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h16a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2" /><path d="M6 14h12v8H6z" /></>,
        back: <><path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6" /><path d="M9 12h12" /></>,
        copy: <><rect x="8" y="8" width="13" height="13" rx="2" /><path d="M16 8V5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v9a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h3" /></>,
        trash: <><path d="M3 6h18M8 6V4h8v2M19 6l-1 14H6L5 6M10 11v5M14 11v5" /></>,
        refresh: <><path d="M20 7v5h-5M4 17v-5h5" /><path d="M5.6 9A7 7 0 0 1 18 6l2 6M4 12l2 6a7 7 0 0 0 12.4-3" /></>,

        package: <><path d="m12 3 9 5-9 5-9-5 9-5Z" /><path d="M3 8v9l9 5 9-5V8M12 13v9" /></>,
        calendar: <><rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="2" /><path d="M16 3v4M8 3v4M3 10h18" /></>,
    };

    return <svg {...common}>{paths[name] || paths.file}</svg>;
}

function Field({ label, children, className = "" }) {
    return (
        <label className={`block min-w-0 ${className}`}>
            <span className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                {label}
            </span>
            {children}
        </label>
    );
}

const inputClass =

function SummaryCard({ label, value, description, accent = "emerald" }) {
    const accents = {
        emerald: "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
        blue: "bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400",
        violet: "bg-violet-500/10 text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400",
    };

    return (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950">
            <div className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {label}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {value}
            </div>
            <div className={`mt-3 inline-flex rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${accents[accent]}`}>
                {description}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

export default function SalesQuotationsPage() {
    const [view, setView] = useState("list");
    const [quotations, setQuotations] = useState([]);
    const [customers, setCustomers] = useState([]);
    const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
    const [warehouses, setWarehouses] = useState([]);

    const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm);
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("lines");
    const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("");
    const [selectedQuotation, setSelectedQuotation] = useState(null);

    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");

    const totals = useMemo(() => {
        let subtotal = 0;
        let taxAmount = 0;

        for (const item of form.items) {
            const quantity = Number(item.quantity) || 0;
            const unitPrice = Number(item.unitPrice) || 0;
            const taxRate = Number(item.taxRate) || 0;

            const amount = quantity * unitPrice;
            const tax = amount * taxRate / 100;

            subtotal += amount;
            taxAmount += tax;
        }

        return {
            subtotal,
            taxAmount,
            grossAmount: subtotal + taxAmount,
        };
    }, [form.items]);

    const loadQuotations = useCallback(async () => {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();

        if (search.trim()) params.set("search", search.trim());
        if (statusFilter) params.set("status", statusFilter);

        const response = await fetch(
            `/api/sales-quotations?${params.toString()}`,
            { cache: "no-store" }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || "Unable to load quotations.");
        }

        setQuotations(data.quotations || []);
    }, [search, statusFilter]);

    const loadOptions = useCallback(async () => {
        const [customerResponse, productResponse, warehouseResponse] =
            await Promise.all([
                fetch("/api/customers", { cache: "no-store" }),
                fetch("/api/products", { cache: "no-store" }),
                fetch("/api/warehouses", { cache: "no-store" }),
            ]);

        const [customerData, productData, warehouseData] =
            await Promise.all([
                customerResponse.json(),
                productResponse.json(),
                warehouseResponse.json(),
            ]);

        if (!customerResponse.ok || !customerData.success) {
            throw new Error(customerData.message || "Unable to load customers.");
        }

        if (!productResponse.ok || !productData.success) {
            throw new Error(productData.message || "Unable to load products.");
        }

        if (!warehouseResponse.ok || !warehouseData.success) {
            throw new Error(warehouseData.message || "Unable to load warehouses.");
        }

        const customerRows = customerData.customers || [];
        const productRows = productData.products || [];

        const warehouseRows =
            warehouseData.warehouses ||
            warehouseData.data ||
            [];

        setCustomers(
            customerRows.filter((customer) => customer.is_active !== false)
        );

        setProducts(
            productRows.filter((product) => product.is_active !== false)
        );

        setWarehouses(
            warehouseRows.filter((warehouse) => warehouse.is_active !== false)
        );
    }, []);

    const reload = useCallback(async () => {
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");

        try {
            await Promise.all([
                loadQuotations(),
                loadOptions(),
            ]);
        } catch (loadError) {
            setError(loadError.message || "Unable to load the page.");
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, [loadOptions, loadQuotations]);

    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;

        async function load() {
            setLoading(true);
            setError("");

            try {
                const params = new URLSearchParams();

                if (search.trim()) params.set("search", search.trim());
                if (statusFilter) params.set("status", statusFilter);

                const [quotationResponse, customerResponse, productResponse, warehouseResponse] =
                    await Promise.all([
                        fetch(`/api/sales-quotations?${params.toString()}`, {
                            cache: "no-store",
                        }),
                        fetch("/api/customers", { cache: "no-store" }),
                        fetch("/api/products", { cache: "no-store" }),
                        fetch("/api/warehouses", { cache: "no-store" }),
                    ]);

                const [quotationData, customerData, productData, warehouseData] =
                    await Promise.all([
                        quotationResponse.json(),
                        customerResponse.json(),
                        productResponse.json(),
                        warehouseResponse.json(),
                    ]);

                if (!quotationResponse.ok || !quotationData.success) {
                    throw new Error(
                        quotationData.message || "Unable to load quotations."
                    );
                }

                if (!customerResponse.ok || !customerData.success) {
                    throw new Error(
                        customerData.message || "Unable to load customers."
                    );
                }

                if (!productResponse.ok || !productData.success) {
                    throw new Error(
                        productData.message || "Unable to load products."
                    );
                }

                if (!warehouseResponse.ok || !warehouseData.success) {
                    throw new Error(
                        warehouseData.message || "Unable to load warehouses."
                    );
                }

                if (cancelled) return;

                setQuotations(quotationData.quotations || []);

                setCustomers(
                    (customerData.customers || []).filter(
                        (customer) => customer.is_active !== false
                    )
                );

                setProducts(
                    (productData.products || []).filter(
                        (product) => product.is_active !== false
                    )
                );

                const warehouseRows =
                    warehouseData.warehouses ||
                    warehouseData.data ||
                    [];

                setWarehouses(
                    warehouseRows.filter(
                        (warehouse) => warehouse.is_active !== false
                    )
                );
            } catch (loadError) {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setError(
                        loadError.message || "Unable to load quotations."
                    );
                }
            } finally {
                if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
            }
        }

        load();

        return () => {
            cancelled = true;
        };
    }, [search, statusFilter]);

    function updateForm(field, value) {
        setForm((previous) => ({
            ...previous,
            [field]: value,
        }));
    }

    function updateItem(index, field, value) {
        setForm((previous) => ({
            ...previous,
            items: previous.items.map((item, itemIndex) =>
                itemIndex === index
                    ? { ...item, [field]: value }
                    : item
            ),
        }));
    }

    function selectProduct(index, productId) {
        const product = products.find(
            (item) => String(getProductId(item)) === String(productId)
        );

        if (!product) {
            updateItem(index, "productId", "");
            return;
        }

        setForm((previous) => ({
            ...previous,
            items: previous.items.map((item, itemIndex) =>
                itemIndex === index
                    ? {
                        ...item,
                        productId: String(getProductId(product)),
                        itemName: getProductName(product),
                        itemDescription: getProductDescription(product),
                        uom: getProductUnit(product),
                        unitPrice: getProductPrice(product),
                    }
                    : item
            ),
        }));
    }

    function addLine() {
        setForm((previous) => ({
            ...previous,
            items: [...previous.items, emptyItem()],
        }));
    }

    function removeLine(index) {
        setForm((previous) => ({
            ...previous,
            items: previous.items.length === 1
                ? previous.items
                : previous.items.filter((_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index),
        }));
    }

    function createQuotation() {
        setError("");
        setNotice("");
        setSelectedQuotation(null);
        setForm(emptyForm());
        setActiveTab("lines");
        setView("form");
    }

    function editQuotation(quotation) {
        setError("");
        setNotice("");
        setSelectedQuotation(quotation);

        setForm({
            ...emptyForm(),
            quotationId: quotation.quotation_id,
            quotationNumber: quotation.quotation_number,
            customerId: quotation.customer_id
                ? String(quotation.customer_id)
                : "",
            warehouseId: quotation.warehouse_id
                ? String(quotation.warehouse_id)
                : "",
            quotationDate: String(quotation.quotation_date || "").slice(0, 10),
            expiryDate: quotation.expiry_date
                ? String(quotation.expiry_date).slice(0, 10)
                : "",
            status: quotation.status || "Draft",
            department: quotation.department || "",
            project: quotation.project || "",
            quotationClass: quotation.quotation_class || "",
            salesRep: quotation.sales_rep || "",
            paymentTerm: quotation.payment_term || "",
            memo: quotation.memo || "",
            termsConditions: quotation.terms_conditions || "",
            relatedTransaction: quotation.related_transaction || "",
            attachmentName: quotation.attachment_name || "",
            attachmentUrl: quotation.attachment_url || "",
            items: (quotation.items || []).map((item) => ({
                productId: item.product_id
                    ? String(item.product_id)
                    : "",
                itemName: item.item_name || "",
                itemDescription: item.item_description || "",
                itemBalance: Number(item.item_balance || 0),
                uom: item.uom || "PCS",
                quantity: Number(item.quantity || 1),
                unitPrice: Number(item.unit_price || 0),
                taxCode: item.tax_code || "",
                taxRate: Number(item.tax_rate || 0),
                memo: item.memo || "",
            })),
        });

        setActiveTab("lines");
        setView("form");
    }

    async function viewQuotation(quotationId) {
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");
        setNotice("");

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                `/api/sales-quotations/${quotationId}`,
                { cache: "no-store" }
            );

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Unable to open quotation.");
            }

            setSelectedQuotation(data.quotation);
            setView("detail");
        } catch (viewError) {
            setError(viewError.message || "Unable to open quotation.");
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    async function saveQuotation(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        setError("");
        setNotice("");

        if (!form.customerId) {
            setError("Please select a customer.");
            return;
        }

        if (!form.items.length) {
            setError("Please add at least one transaction line.");
            return;
        }

        setSaving(true);

        try {
            const payload = {
                ...form,
                customerId: form.customerId || null,
                warehouseId: form.warehouseId || null,
                items: form.items.map((item) => ({
                    ...item,
                    productId: item.productId || null,
                    quantity: Number(item.quantity),
                    unitPrice: Number(item.unitPrice),
                    taxRate: Number(item.taxRate || 0),
                    itemBalance: Number(item.itemBalance || 0),
                })),
            };

            const isEditing = Boolean(form.quotationId);

            const response = await fetch(
                isEditing
                    ? `/api/sales-quotations/${form.quotationId}`
                    : "/api/sales-quotations",
                {
                    method: isEditing ? "PUT" : "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
                }
            );

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(data.message || "Unable to save quotation.");
            }

            const quotationId = isEditing
                ? form.quotationId
                : data.quotation.quotationId;

            setNotice(data.message || "Quotation saved successfully.");

            await loadQuotations();

            await viewQuotation(quotationId);
            setNotice(data.message || "Quotation saved successfully.");
        } catch (saveError) {
            setError(saveError.message || "Unable to save quotation.");
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    async function copyQuotation(quotation) {
        const items = (quotation.items || []).map((item) => ({
            productId: item.product_id ? String(item.product_id) : "",
            itemName: item.item_name || "",
            itemDescription: item.item_description || "",
            itemBalance: Number(item.item_balance || 0),
            uom: item.uom || "PCS",
            quantity: Number(item.quantity || 1),
            unitPrice: Number(item.unit_price || 0),
            taxCode: item.tax_code || "",
            taxRate: Number(item.tax_rate || 0),
            memo: item.memo || "",
        }));

        setSelectedQuotation(null);

        setForm({
            ...emptyForm(),
            customerId: quotation.customer_id
                ? String(quotation.customer_id)
                : "",
            warehouseId: quotation.warehouse_id
                ? String(quotation.warehouse_id)
                : "",
            quotationDate: today(),
            expiryDate: "",
            status: "Draft",
            department: quotation.department || "",
            project: quotation.project || "",
            quotationClass: quotation.quotation_class || "",
            salesRep: quotation.sales_rep || "",
            paymentTerm: quotation.payment_term || "",
            memo: quotation.memo || "",
            termsConditions: quotation.terms_conditions || "",
            items: items.length ? items : [emptyItem()],
        });

        setError("");
        setNotice("A new draft has been prepared from the selected quotation.");
        setActiveTab("lines");
        setView("form");
    }

    
function printQuotation() {
    const report = document.getElementById("quotation-report");

    if (!report) {
        alert("Quotation report could not be found.");
        return;
    }

    const printWindow = window.open(
        "",
        "_blank",
        "width=1100,height=800"
    );

    if (!printWindow) {
        alert("Please allow pop-ups for this website, then try printing again.");
        return;
    }

    const reportHtml = report.outerHTML;

    printWindow.document.open();

    printWindow.document.write(`
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html lang="en">
        <head>
            <meta charset="UTF-8">
            <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

            <title>Sales Quotation Report</title>

            <style>
                @page {
                    size: A4 landscape;
                    margin: 10mm;
                }

                * {
                    box-sizing: border-box;
                }

                html,
                body {
                    width: 100%;
                    margin: 0;
                    padding: 0;

            approved: quotations.filter((q) => q.status === "Approved").length,

                                                                    value={item.itemDescription}
                                                                    onChange={(event) => updateItem(index, "itemDescription", event.target.value)}
                                                                    placeholder="Description"
                                                                    className={`${inputClass} min-w-44`}
                                                                />

                                                                    type="number"
                                                                    min="0"
                                                                    step="0.0001"
                                                                    value={item.itemBalance}
                                                                    onChange={(event) => updateItem(index, "itemBalance", event.target.value)}
                                                                    className={`${inputClass} min-w-24`}
                                                                />
                                                            </td>

                                                                    placeholder="PCS"

                                                                <input

                                                                    value={item.unitPrice}

                                                                    className={`${inputClass} min-w-28`}

                                                                {money(amount)}

                                                                    value={item.memo}

                                                                    placeholder="Memo"

                                            <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                                Total Amount
                                            </div>

                                            <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                                Tax Amount

                                                Rs {money(totals.taxAmount)}

                                            <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                                                Gross Amount
                                            </div>

                                                Rs {money(totals.grossAmount)}
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </>
                            )}

                                        />
                                    </Field>
                                </div>
                            )}

                            {activeTab === "related" && (
                                <div className="p-5">
                                    <Field label="Related Transactions / Reference">
                                        <textarea
                                            rows={5}
                                            value={form.relatedTransaction}
                                            onChange={(event) => updateForm("relatedTransaction", event.target.value)}
                                            placeholder="Enter related transaction references or notes..."
                                            className={inputClass}

                                    </Field>
                                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                                        This field records reference information. Automatic conversion to sales orders will be implemented in the next stage.
                                    </p>
