                            )}

                            {activeTab === "system" && (
                                <div className="grid gap-4 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                                    <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-900">
                                        <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                            Transaction Number
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="mt-2 font-bold">
                                            {form.quotationNumber || "Assigned when saved"}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-900">
                                        <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                            Record Status
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="mt-2 font-bold">{form.status}</div>
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-900">
                                        <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                            Record ID
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="mt-2 font-bold">
                                            {form.quotationId || "Not saved yet"}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-900">
                                        <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                            Last action
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="mt-2 font-bold">
                                            {form.quotationId ? "Existing quotation" : "New quotation"}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            )}

                            {activeTab === "attachment" && (
                                <div className="grid gap-5 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                                    <Field label="Attachment Name">
                                        <input
                                            value={form.attachmentName}
                                            onChange={(event) => updateForm("attachmentName", event.target.value)}
                                            placeholder="e.g. customer-requirements.pdf"
                                            className={inputClass}
                                        />
                                    </Field>

                                    <Field label="Attachment URL">
                                        <input
                                            type="url"
                                            value={form.attachmentUrl}
                                            onChange={(event) => updateForm("attachmentUrl", event.target.value)}
                                            placeholder="https://..."
                                            className={inputClass}
                                        />
                                    </Field>

                                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 sm:col-span-2">
                                        These fields store an attachment name and reference URL. Actual file upload and secure file storage are not included in this first version.
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </section>

                        <div className="flex flex-col-reverse justify-between gap-3 sm:flex-row">
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                    setError("");
                                    setNotice("");
                                    setView("list");
                                }}
                                className={buttonSecondary}
                            >
                                <Icon name="back" />
                                Back
                            </button>

                            <button
                                type="submit"
                                disabled={saving}
                                className={buttonPrimary}
                            >
                                {saving ? "Saving..." : "Save Quotation"}
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </form>
                )}

                {view === "detail" && selectedQuotation && (
                    <section className="space-y-5">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 print:hidden">
                            {selectedQuotation.status !== "Converted" && (
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => editQuotation(selectedQuotation)}
                                    className={buttonPrimary}
                                >
                                    <Icon name="edit" />
                                    Edit
                                </button>
                            )}

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setView("list")}
                                className={buttonSecondary}
                            >
                                <Icon name="back" />
                                Back
                            </button>

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={printQuotation}
                                className={buttonSecondary}
                            >
                                <Icon name="print" />
                                Report / Print / Save PDF
                            </button>

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={createQuotation}
                                className={buttonSecondary}
                            >
                                <Icon name="plus" />
                                Create Quotation
                            </button>

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => copyQuotation(selectedQuotation)}
                                className={buttonSecondary}
                            >
                                <Icon name="copy" />
                                Copy Quotation
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <div id="quotation-report" className="space-y-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950 sm:p-8">
                            <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 pb-6 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-start">
                                <div>
                                    <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                                        Sales Management
                                    </div>
                                    <h2 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold">
                                        Quotation
                                    </h2>
                                    <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                        {selectedQuotation.company_name || "Company"}
                                    </p>
                                </div>

                                <div className="sm:text-right">
                                    <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                        Transaction Number
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                                        {selectedQuotation.quotation_number}
                                    </div>
                                    <span className={`mt-3 inline-flex rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${statusClass(selectedQuotation.status)}`}>
                                        {selectedQuotation.status}
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                                {[
                                    ["Quotation Date", dateDisplay(selectedQuotation.quotation_date)],
                                    ["Quotation End Date", dateDisplay(selectedQuotation.expiry_date)],
                                    ["Subsidiary / Company", selectedQuotation.company_name || "â€”"],
                                    ["From Location", selectedQuotation.warehouse_name || "â€”"],
                                    ["Customer", selectedQuotation.customer_name || "â€”"],
                                    ["Department", selectedQuotation.department || "â€”"],
                                    ["Project", selectedQuotation.project || "â€”"],
                                    ["Class", selectedQuotation.quotation_class || "â€”"],
                                    ["Sales Representative", selectedQuotation.sales_rep || "â€”"],
                                    ["Payment Term", selectedQuotation.payment_term || "â€”"],
                                    ["Memo", selectedQuotation.memo || "â€”"],
                                ].map(([label, value]) => (
                                    <div key={label}>
                                        <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                            {label}
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="mt-1 break-words text-sm font-semibold">
                                            {value}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>

                            {/* Amount Summary â€” Single Line in Report and PDF */}
                            <div className="border-y border-slate-200 py-5 dark:border-slate-800">
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                                    <div className="min-w-0">
                                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                            Total Amount
                                        </p>
                                        <p className="mt-2 break-words text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                            Rs {money(selectedQuotation.subtotal)}
                                        </p>
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="min-w-0 border-x border-slate-200 px-4 dark:border-slate-800">
                                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                            Tax Amount
                                        </p>
                                        <p className="mt-2 break-words text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                            Rs {money(selectedQuotation.tax_amount)}
                                        </p>
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="min-w-0">
                                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                                            Gross Amount
                                        </p>
                                        <p className="mt-2 break-words text-base font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                                            Rs {money(selectedQuotation.gross_amount)}
                                        </p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </section>
                )}
            </div>
        </main>
    );
}

===== app\dashboard\settings\page.js =====

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
    ArrowLeft,
    Building2,
    MapPin,
    Wallet,
    LoaderCircle,
    Save,
    AlertCircle,
    CheckCircle2,
    Upload,
    X,
    Mail,
    Phone,
    Globe2,
    MapPinned,
    ImagePlus,
    Sparkles,
    ShieldCheck,
    ChevronRight,
} from "lucide-react";

const MAX_LOGO_SIZE = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

const ALLOWED_LOGO_TYPES = [
    "image/png",
    "image/jpeg",
    "image/webp",
];

const INITIAL_FORM = {
    companyName: "",
    phone: "",
    email: "",
    country: "Pakistan",
    stateProvince: "",
    city: "",
    address: "",
    currency: "PKR",
};

function getErrorMessage(error, fallback) {
    return error instanceof Error && error.message
        ? error.message
        : fallback;
}

async function readResponse(response) {
    try {
        return await response.json();
    } catch {
        throw new Error("The server returned an invalid response.");
    }
}

function normalizeSettings(settings = {}) {
    return {
        companyName: settings.company_name || "",
        phone: settings.phone || "",
        email: settings.email || "",
        country: settings.country || "Pakistan",
        stateProvince:
            settings.state_province || settings.province || "",
        city: settings.city || "",
        address: settings.address || "",
        currency: settings.currency || "PKR",
    };
}

function SectionHeading({ icon: Icon, title, description }) {
    return (
        <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border erp-border bg-[var(--erp-blue-light)] text-[var(--erp-primary)]">
                <Icon size={21} />
            </div>

            <div className="min-w-0">
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold tracking-tight text-[var(--erp-text)] sm:text-lg">
                    {title}
                </h2>

                {description && (
                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-[var(--erp-muted)]">
                        {description}
                    </p>
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function Field({
    label,
    id,
    icon: Icon,
    hint,
    className = "",
    children,
}) {
    return (
        <div className={className}>
            <label
                htmlFor={id}
                className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--erp-text)]"
            >
                {Icon && (
                    <Icon
                        size={15}
                        className="text-[var(--erp-muted)]"
                    />
                )}

                {label}
            </label>

            {children}

            {hint && (
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-5 text-[var(--erp-muted)]">
                    {hint}
                </p>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

const inputClass =
    "erp-input w-full min-w-0 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-3 text-sm transition";

function Notice({ type, children, onDismiss }) {
    const success = type === "success";
    const Icon = success ? CheckCircle2 : AlertCircle;

    return (
        <div
            role={success ? "status" : "alert"}
            className={`flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border p-4 ${success
                ? "border-green-300 bg-green-50 text-green-800"
                : "border-red-300 bg-red-50 text-red-800"
                }`}
        >
            <Icon size={19} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />

            <p className="flex-1 text-sm leading-6">{children}</p>

            {onDismiss && (
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onDismiss}
                    className="rounded-lg p-1 opacity-70 transition hover:bg-black/5 hover:opacity-100"
                    aria-label="Dismiss notification"
                >
                    <X size={16} />
                </button>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

export default function SettingsPage() {
    const fileInputRef = useRef(null);
    const previewUrlRef = useRef("");

    const [form, setForm] = useState(INITIAL_FORM);
    const [logoFile, setLogoFile] = useState(null);
    const [logoPreview, setLogoPreview] = useState("");
    const [originalLogo, setOriginalLogo] = useState("");
    const [logoLoadError, setLogoLoadError] = useState(false);

    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [removingLogo, setRemovingLogo] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

    const releasePreviewUrl = useCallback(() => {
        if (previewUrlRef.current) {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrlRef.current);
            previewUrlRef.current = "";
        }
    }, []);

    const applySettings = useCallback(
        (settings = {}) => {
            setForm(normalizeSettings(settings));

            const savedLogo = settings.logo_url || "";

            releasePreviewUrl();
            setOriginalLogo(savedLogo);
            setLogoPreview(savedLogo);
            setLogoFile(null);
            setLogoLoadError(false);

            if (fileInputRef.current) {
                fileInputRef.current.value = "";
            }
        },
        [releasePreviewUrl]
    );

    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;

        async function initializeSettings() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch("/api/settings", {
                    method: "GET",
                    cache: "no-store",
                });

                const data = await readResponse(response);

                if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
                    throw new Error(
                        data.message || "Failed to load company settings."
                    );
                }

                if (cancelled) return;

                applySettings(data.settings || {});
            } catch (err) {
                if (cancelled) return;

                setError(
                    getErrorMessage(
                        err,
                        "Unable to load company settings."
                    )
                );
            } finally {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setLoading(false);
                }
            }
        }

        initializeSettings();

        return () => {
            cancelled = true;
            releasePreviewUrl();
        };
    }, [applySettings, releasePreviewUrl]);

    function updateField(field, value) {
        setForm((previous) => ({
            ...previous,
            [field]: value,
        }));

        setError("");
        setMessage("");
    }

    function handleLogoChange(event) {
        const file = event.target.files?.[0];

        if (!file) return;

        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        if (!ALLOWED_LOGO_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {
            setError("Choose a PNG, JPG, or WebP company logo.");
            event.target.value = "";
            return;
        }

        if (file.size === 0) {
            setError("The selected image is empty.");
            event.target.value = "";
            return;
        }

        if (file.size > MAX_LOGO_SIZE) {
            setError("Company logo must be 2 MB or smaller.");
            event.target.value = "";
            return;
        }

        releasePreviewUrl();

        const previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        previewUrlRef.current = previewUrl;

        setLogoFile(file);
        setLogoPreview(previewUrl);
        setLogoLoadError(false);
    }

    async function removeLogo() {
        if (saving || removingLogo || !logoPreview) return;

        setError("");
        setMessage("");
        setRemovingLogo(true);

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/settings", {
                method: "DELETE",
                cache: "no-store",
            });

            const data = await readResponse(response);

            if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message || "Failed to remove company logo."
                );
            }

            // Clear the preview only after the server confirms deletion.
            releasePreviewUrl();

            setLogoFile(null);
            setLogoPreview("");
            setOriginalLogo("");
            setLogoLoadError(false);

            if (fileInputRef.current) {
                fileInputRef.current.value = "";
            }

            setMessage(
                data.message || "Company logo removed successfully."
            );
        } catch (err) {
            setError(
                getErrorMessage(
                    err,
                    "Unable to remove company logo."
                )
            );
        } finally {
            setRemovingLogo(false);
        }
    }

    async function saveSettings(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        if (saving || removingLogo) return;

        setError("");
        setMessage("");

        if (!form.companyName.trim()) {
            setError("Company name is required.");
            return;
        }

        if (
            form.email.trim() &&
            !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(form.email.trim())
        ) {
            setError("Please enter a valid company email address.");
            return;
        }

        const body = new FormData();

        body.append("companyName", form.companyName.trim());
        body.append("phone", form.phone.trim());
        body.append("email", form.email.trim());
        body.append("country", form.country.trim());
        body.append("stateProvince", form.stateProvince.trim());
        body.append("city", form.city.trim());
        body.append("address", form.address.trim());
        body.append("currency", form.currency);

        if (logoFile) {
            body.append("companyLogo", logoFile, logoFile.name);
        }

        setSaving(true);

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/settings", {
                method: "PUT",
                body,
                cache: "no-store",
            });

            const data = await readResponse(response);

            if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message || "Failed to save company settings."
                );
            }

            applySettings(data.settings || {});

            setMessage(
                data.settings?.logo_url
                    ? "Company information and logo saved successfully."
                    : "Company settings saved successfully."
            );
        } catch (err) {
            setError(
                getErrorMessage(
                    err,
                    "Unable to save company settings."
                )
            );
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    if (loading) {
        return (
