const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 dark:placeholder:text-slate-500 dark:focus:border-blue-400";

function formatQuantity(value) {
  const number = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return value ?? "â€”";

  return number.toLocaleString("en-PK", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 4,
  });
}

function SummaryCard({ title, value, description, icon: Icon, tone }) {
  const tones = {
    blue: {
      icon: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500/15 dark:text-blue-300",
      glow: "from-blue-500/10",
    },
    emerald: {
      icon: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-300",
      glow: "from-emerald-500/10",
    },
    rose: {
      icon: "bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-500/15 dark:text-rose-300",
      glow: "from-rose-500/10",
    },
    violet: {
      icon: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-500/15 dark:text-violet-300",
      glow: "from-violet-500/10",
    },
  };

  const selected = tones[tone] || tones.blue;

  return (
    <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
      <div
        className={`pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br ${selected.glow} to-transparent`}
      />

      <div className="relative flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {title}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-3 break-words text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            {value}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div
          className={`flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl ${selected.icon}`}
        >
          <Icon size={23} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StockStatus({ lowStock, quantity }) {
  const isLow = Boolean(lowStock) || Number(quantity) <= 0;

  if (Number(quantity) <= 0) {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-700 dark:border-rose-500/30 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-300">
        <XCircle size={14} />
        Out of Stock
      </span>
    );
  }

  if (isLow) {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-700 dark:border-amber-500/30 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-300">
        <AlertTriangle size={14} />
        Low Stock
      </span>
    );
  }

  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-500/30 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300">
      <CheckCircle2 size={14} />
      Normal
    </span>
  );
}

export default function StockPage() {
  const [warehouses, setWarehouses] = useState([]);
  const [stock, setStock] = useState([]);
  const [warehouseId, setWarehouseId] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [warehouseError, setWarehouseError] = useState("");

  const loadWarehouses = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/warehouses", {
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data?.message || "Failed to load warehouses."
        );
      }

      setWarehouses(
        Array.isArray(data.warehouses) ? data.warehouses : []
      );
      setWarehouseError("");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Warehouse loading error:", err);
      setWarehouseError(
        err.message || "Unable to load warehouses."
      );
    }
  }, []);

  const loadStock = useCallback(
    async ({ showRefresh = false } = {}) => {
      if (showRefresh) {
        setRefreshing(true);
      } else {
        setLoading(true);
      }

      setError("");

      try {
        const url = warehouseId
          ? `/api/stock?warehouseId=${encodeURIComponent(warehouseId)}`
          : "/api/stock";

        const response = await fetch(url, {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data?.message || data?.error || "Failed to load stock."
          );
        }

        setStock(Array.isArray(data.stock) ? data.stock : []);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Stock loading error:", err);
        setStock([]);
        setError(err.message || "Unable to load stock.");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [warehouseId]
  );

  // Load the warehouse list once.
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function fetchWarehouses() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/warehouses", {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data?.message || "Failed to load warehouses."
          );
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setWarehouses(
            Array.isArray(data.warehouses) ? data.warehouses : []
          );
          setWarehouseError("");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Warehouse loading error:", err);

        if (!cancelled) {
          setWarehouseError(
            err.message || "Unable to load warehouses."
          );
        }
      }
    }

    fetchWarehouses();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  // Fetch stock whenever the selected warehouse changes.
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function fetchStock() {
      setError("");
      setLoading(true);

      try {
        const url = warehouseId
          ? `/api/stock?warehouseId=${encodeURIComponent(warehouseId)}`
          : "/api/stock";

        const response = await fetch(url, {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data?.message || data?.error || "Failed to load stock."
          );
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setStock(Array.isArray(data.stock) ? data.stock : []);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Stock loading error:", err);

        if (!cancelled) {
          setStock([]);
          setError(err.message || "Unable to load stock.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    fetchStock();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [warehouseId]);

  const filteredStock = useMemo(() => {
    const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    return stock.filter((item) => {
      const matchesSearch =
        !query ||
        [
          item.sku,
          item.product_name,
          item.warehouse_name,
          item.unit,
        ].some((value) =>
          String(value ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(query)
        );

      const quantity = Number(item.quantity);
      const isOutOfStock = Number.isFinite(quantity) && quantity <= 0;
      const isLowStock = Boolean(item.low_stock) || isOutOfStock;

      const matchesStatus =
        statusFilter === "all" ||
        (statusFilter === "low" && isLowStock && !isOutOfStock) ||
        (statusFilter === "normal" && !isLowStock) ||
        (statusFilter === "out" && isOutOfStock);

      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
    });
  }, [stock, search, statusFilter]);

  const summary = useMemo(() => {
    const low = stock.filter((item) => {
      const quantity = Number(item.quantity);
      return (
        (Boolean(item.low_stock) || quantity <= 0) &&
        quantity > 0
      );
    }).length;

    const out = stock.filter(
      (item) => Number(item.quantity) <= 0
    ).length;

    const normal = stock.filter((item) => {
      const quantity = Number(item.quantity);
      return quantity > 0 && !Boolean(item.low_stock);
    }).length;

    const totalQuantity = stock.reduce((total, item) => {
      const quantity = Number(item.quantity);
      return total + (Number.isFinite(quantity) ? quantity : 0);
    }, 0);

    return {
      products: stock.length,
      low,
      out,
      normal,
      totalQuantity,
    };
  }, [stock]);

  function exportCsv() {
    if (!filteredStock.length) return;

    const columns = [
      ["SKU", "sku"],
      ["Product", "product_name"],
      ["Warehouse", "warehouse_name"],
      ["Unit", "unit"],
      ["Quantity", "quantity"],
      ["Low Stock", "low_stock"],
    ];

    const escapeCsv = (value) =>
      `"${String(value ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;

    const csv = [
      columns.map(([label]) => escapeCsv(label)).join(","),
      ...filteredStock.map((item) =>
        columns
          .map(([, key]) => escapeCsv(item[key]))
          .join(",")
      ),
    ].join("\r\n");

    const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF" + csv], {
      type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;",
    });

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");

    link.href = url;
    link.download = "stock-report.csv";
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen space-y-6 bg-slate-50/70 p-4 text-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
      {/* Header */}
      <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-950 via-slate-900 to-blue-950 p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-slate-900/10 sm:p-8">
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-12 -top-20 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-blue-500/20 blur-3xl" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-24 right-1/3 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-cyan-400/10 blur-3xl" />

        <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
          <div>
            <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/15 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-100 backdrop-blur">
              <Layers3 size={15} />
              INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
              Stock Overview
            </h1>

            <p className="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-300 sm:text-base">
              Monitor product quantities across your warehouses, identify
              low-stock items, and keep your inventory organized.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm text-slate-300">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <Warehouse size={16} className="text-blue-300" />
                {warehouseId
                  ? warehouses.find(
                      (warehouse) =>
                        String(warehouse.warehouse_id) ===
                        String(warehouseId)
                    )?.warehouse_name || "Selected warehouse"
                  : "All warehouses"}
              </span>

              <span className="hidden text-slate-600 sm:inline">â€¢</span>

              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <Activity size={16} className="text-emerald-300" />
                {summary.products} stock records
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                loadWarehouses();
                loadStock({ showRefresh: true });
              }}
              disabled={refreshing}
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-white/15 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              <RefreshCw
                size={17}
                className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
              />
              Refresh
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={exportCsv}
              disabled={!filteredStock.length}
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 shadow-lg transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-blue-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <ArrowDownToLine size={18} />
              Export CSV
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Errors */}
      {warehouseError && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4 text-amber-800 dark:border-amber-500/30 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-300">
          <AlertTriangle size={20} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <div>
            <p className="font-semibold">Warehouse list unavailable</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm">{warehouseError}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-4 text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-500/30 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-300"
        >
          <AlertTriangle size={20} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="font-semibold">Unable to load stock</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm">{error}</p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => loadStock({ showRefresh: true })}
            className="rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-500/10"
          >
            Retry
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Summary */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <SummaryCard
          title="Stock Records"
          value={summary.products}
          description="Records returned by the API"
          icon={Package}
          tone="blue"
        />
        <SummaryCard
          title="Normal Stock"
          value={summary.normal}
          description="Records not marked low stock"
          icon={CheckCircle2}
          tone="emerald"
        />
        <SummaryCard
          title="Low Stock"
          value={summary.low}
          description="Records needing replenishment"
          icon={AlertTriangle}
          tone="rose"
        />
        <SummaryCard
          title="Out of Stock"
          value={summary.out}
          description="Records with zero or less quantity"
          icon={XCircle}
          tone="violet"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Warehouse selection */}
      <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 sm:p-6">
        <div className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500/15 dark:text-blue-300">
            <Warehouse size={22} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              Warehouse Selection
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Choose a location to view its stock records.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-end">
          <div className="w-full lg:max-w-md">
            <label
              htmlFor="warehouseFilter"
              className="mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200"
            >
              Select Warehouse
            </label>

            <div className="relative">
              <MapPin
                size={18}
                className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
              />

              <select
                id="warehouseFilter"
                value={warehouseId}
                onChange={(event) => setWarehouseId(event.target.value)}
                className={`${inputClass} appearance-none pl-10 pr-10`}
              >
                <option value="">All Warehouses</option>

                {warehouses.map((warehouse) => (
                  <option
                    key={warehouse.warehouse_id}
                    value={warehouse.warehouse_id}
                  >
                    {warehouse.warehouse_name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>

              <Filter
                size={16}
                className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pb-0.5">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 px-3.5 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
              <Warehouse size={16} />
              {warehouseId ? "Single warehouse" : "Combined view"}
            </span>

            {warehouseId && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setWarehouseId("")}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3.5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
              >
                <X size={15} />
                Clear selection
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Stock table */}
      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
        <div className="border-b border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:p-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 xl:flex-row xl:items-center">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-500/15 dark:text-indigo-300">
                <ClipboardList size={22} />
              </div>

              <div>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Inventory Records
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Search products and monitor stock availability.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
              <div className="relative min-w-0 sm:min-w-[260px]">
                <Search
                  size={18}
                  className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                />

                <input
                  type="search"
                  value={search}
                  onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search SKU, product..."
                  aria-label="Search stock records"
                  className={`${inputClass} pl-10 pr-10`}
                />

                {search && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSearch("")}
                    aria-label="Clear search"
                    className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white"
                  >
                    <X size={15} />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="relative">
                <Filter
                  size={16}
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                />

                <select
                  value={statusFilter}
                  onChange={(event) => setStatusFilter(event.target.value)}
                  aria-label="Filter by stock status"
                  className="w-full appearance-none rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white py-3 pl-9 pr-9 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 outline-none transition focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 sm:w-auto"
                >
                  <option value="all">All Statuses</option>
                  <option value="normal">Normal Stock</option>
                  <option value="low">Low Stock</option>
                  <option value="out">Out of Stock</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Showing{" "}
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {filteredStock.length}
              </span>{" "}
              of{" "}
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {stock.length}
              </span>{" "}
              records
            </p>

            {(search || statusFilter !== "all") && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearch("");
                  setStatusFilter("all");
                }}
                className="text-sm font-semibold text-blue-600 transition hover:text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 dark:hover:text-blue-300"
              >
                Clear filters
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex min-h-64 flex-col items-center justify-center p-8">
            <LoaderCircle
              size={36}
              className="animate-spin text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"
            />
            <p className="mt-4 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
              Loading inventory
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Fetching stock records...
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : filteredStock.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex min-h-72 flex-col items-center justify-center px-5 py-12 text-center">
            <div className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-500">
              <PackageSearch size={30} />
            </div>

            <h3 className="mt-5 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              {error
                ? "Stock could not be loaded"
                : search || statusFilter !== "all"
                  ? "No matching stock records"
                  : "No stock records found"}
            </h3>

            <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              {error
                ? "Check the API response and try refreshing the stock list."
                : search || statusFilter !== "all"
                  ? "Try another search term or clear the filters to see all available records."
                  : "There are no stock records returned for the selected warehouse. Check your stock entries and warehouse selection."}
            </p>

            {(search || statusFilter !== "all") && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearch("");
                  setStatusFilter("all");
                }}
                className="mt-5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
              >
                Clear filters
              </button>
            )}

            {error && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => loadStock({ showRefresh: true })}
                className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700"
              >
                <RefreshCw size={16} />
                Try Again
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Desktop table */}
            <div className="hidden overflow-x-auto md:block">
              <table className="w-full min-w-[850px] text-left">
                <thead className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/70">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-6 py-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Product
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Warehouse
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Unit
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Quantity
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Status
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                  {filteredStock.map((item, index) => (
                    <tr
                      key={
                        item.stock_id ??
                        `${item.sku}-${item.warehouse_id}-${index}`
                      }
                      className="transition hover:bg-blue-50/40 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50"
                    >
                      <td className="px-6 py-5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-100 to-indigo-100 text-blue-700 dark:from-blue-500/15 dark:to-indigo-500/15 dark:text-blue-300">
                            <Package size={21} />
                          </div>

                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <p className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                              {item.product_name || "Unnamed product"}
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                              SKU: {item.sku || "â€”"}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-6 py-5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                          <Warehouse
                            size={16}
                            className="shrink-0 text-slate-400"
                          />
                          <span>{item.warehouse_name || "Unassigned"}</span>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-6 py-5">
                        <span className="inline-flex rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                          {item.unit || "â€”"}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-6 py-5 text-right">
                        <span
                          className={`text-base font-bold tabular-nums ${
                            Number(item.quantity) <= 0
                              ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400"
                              : item.low_stock
                                ? "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"
                                : "text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {formatQuantity(item.quantity)}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-6 py-5">
                        <StockStatus
                          lowStock={item.low_stock}
                          quantity={item.quantity}
                        />
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* Mobile cards */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 p-4 md:hidden">
              {filteredStock.map((item, index) => (
                <article
                  key={
                    item.stock_id ??
                    `${item.sku}-${item.warehouse_id}-${index}`
                  }
                  className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                    <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-100 to-indigo-100 text-blue-700 dark:from-blue-500/15 dark:to-indigo-500/15 dark:text-blue-300">
                      <Package size={22} />
                    </div>

                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <h3 className="break-words font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                        {item.product_name || "Unnamed product"}
                      </h3>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        SKU: {item.sku || "â€”"}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <StockStatus
                      lowStock={item.low_stock}
                      quantity={item.quantity}
                    />

                    <span className="rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                      {item.unit || "â€”"}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        Warehouse
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-1 break-words text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                        {item.warehouse_name || "Unassigned"}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-right">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        Quantity
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                        {formatQuantity(item.quantity)}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </article>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {!loading && stock.length > 0 && (
          <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 px-5 py-4 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800/30 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:px-6">
            <span>
              Displaying{" "}
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                {filteredStock.length}
              </span>{" "}
              of {stock.length} stock records
            </span>

            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Activity size={14} />
              Inventory stock report
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <footer className="flex flex-col gap-2 px-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
          <Boxes size={14} />
          Stock figures reflect the data returned by your stock API.
        </span>
        <span>ERP Â· Inventory Management</span>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}


===== app\dashboard\stock-adjustment\page.js =====

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  ArrowDownToLine,
  ArrowDownUp,
  ArrowLeft,
  ArrowRight,
  ArrowUpFromLine,
  Boxes,
  CheckCircle2,
  ClipboardList,
  FileText,
  Hash,
  Layers3,
  LoaderCircle,
  MapPin,
  Package,
  PackagePlus,
  Plus,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  ShieldCheck,
  Trash2,
  TrendingDown,
  TrendingUp,
  Warehouse,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
} from "lucide-react";

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 dark:placeholder:text-slate-500 dark:focus:border-indigo-400 dark:focus:ring-indigo-400/10";

const labelClass =
  "mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200";

function formatNumber(value) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 3,
  }).format(Number(value) || 0);
}

function readError(data, fallback) {
  return data?.message || data?.error || fallback;
}

function SummaryCard({ title, value, description, icon: Icon, accent }) {
  const accents = {
    indigo:
      "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 ring-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:ring-indigo-500/20",
    emerald:
      "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 ring-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:ring-emerald-500/20",
    amber:
      "bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 ring-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-300 dark:ring-amber-500/20",
    violet:
      "bg-violet-50 text-violet-600 ring-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-500/10 dark:text-violet-300 dark:ring-violet-500/20",
  };

  return (
    <div className="group rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {title}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            {value}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div
          className={`rounded-xl p-3 ring-1 ${accents[accent] || accents.indigo}`}
        >
          <Icon size={21} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function StockAdjustmentPage() {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [warehouses, setWarehouses] = useState([]);

  const [warehouseId, setWarehouseId] = useState("");
  const [adjustmentType, setAdjustmentType] = useState("INCREASE");
  const [referenceNumber, setReferenceNumber] = useState("");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");

  const [productId, setProductId] = useState("");
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState("");
  const [productSearch, setProductSearch] = useState("");
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);

  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [messageType, setMessageType] = useState("error");
  const [loadingData, setLoadingData] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  async function fetchData(showRefresh = false) {
    if (showRefresh) {
      setRefreshing(true);
    }

    try {
      const [productsResponse, warehousesResponse] = await Promise.all([
        fetch("/api/products", { cache: "no-store" }),
        fetch("/api/warehouses", { cache: "no-store" }),
      ]);

      const [productsData, warehousesData] = await Promise.all([
        productsResponse.json(),
        warehousesResponse.json(),
      ]);

      if (!productsResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          readError(productsData, "Unable to load products.")
        );
      }

      if (!warehousesResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          readError(warehousesData, "Unable to load warehouses.")
        );
      }

      setProducts(
        Array.isArray(productsData.products)
          ? productsData.products
          : []
      );

      setWarehouses(
        Array.isArray(warehousesData.warehouses)
          ? warehousesData.warehouses
          : []
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Stock adjustment data error:", error);
      setMessage(error.message || "Unable to load page data.");
      setMessageType("error");
    } finally {
      setLoadingData(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadInitialData() {
      try {
        const [productsResponse, warehousesResponse] = await Promise.all([
          fetch("/api/products", { cache: "no-store" }),
          fetch("/api/warehouses", { cache: "no-store" }),
        ]);

        const [productsData, warehousesData] = await Promise.all([
          productsResponse.json(),
          warehousesResponse.json(),
        ]);

        if (!productsResponse.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            readError(productsData, "Unable to load products.")
          );
        }

        if (!warehousesResponse.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            readError(warehousesData, "Unable to load warehouses.")
          );
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setProducts(
            Array.isArray(productsData.products)
              ? productsData.products
              : []
          );

          setWarehouses(
            Array.isArray(warehousesData.warehouses)
              ? warehousesData.warehouses
              : []
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Stock adjustment data error:", error);

        if (!cancelled) {
          setMessage(error.message || "Unable to load page data.");
          setMessageType("error");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoadingData(false);
        }
      }
    }

    loadInitialData();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const selectedWarehouse = useMemo(
    () =>
      warehouses.find(
        (warehouse) =>
          String(warehouse.warehouse_id) === String(warehouseId)
      ),
    [warehouses, warehouseId]
  );

  const selectedProduct = useMemo(
    () =>
      products.find(
        (product) => String(product.product_id) === String(productId)
      ),
    [products, productId]
  );

  const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => {
    const search = productSearch.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!search) return products;

    return products.filter((product) => {
      const name = String(product.product_name || "").toLowerCase();
      const sku = String(product.sku || "").toLowerCase();
      const barcode = String(product.barcode || "").toLowerCase();

      return (
        name.includes(search) ||
        sku.includes(search) ||
        barcode.includes(search)
      );
    });
  }, [products, productSearch]);

  const totalQuantity = useMemo(
    () => items.reduce((total, item) => total + Number(item.quantity || 0), 0),
    [items]
  );

  function showMessage(text, type = "error") {
    setMessage(text);
    setMessageType(type);
  }

  function addItem() {
    setMessage("");

    if (!productId) {
      showMessage("Please select a product first.");
      return;
    }

    const parsedQuantity = Number(quantity);

    if (!quantity || !Number.isFinite(parsedQuantity) || parsedQuantity <= 0) {
      showMessage("Enter a quantity greater than zero.");
      return;
    }

    const product = products.find(
      (item) => String(item.product_id) === String(productId)
    );

    if (!product) {
      showMessage("The selected product could not be found.");
      return;
    }

    setItems((currentItems) => {
      const existingIndex = currentItems.findIndex(
        (item) => String(item.productId) === String(product.product_id)
      );

      if (existingIndex !== -1) {
        return currentItems.map((item, index) =>
          index === existingIndex
            ? {
                ...item,
                quantity: Number(item.quantity) + parsedQuantity,
              }
            : item
        );
      }

      return [
        ...currentItems,
        {
          productId: product.product_id,
          productName: product.product_name || "Unnamed product",
          sku: product.sku || "â€”",
          quantity: parsedQuantity,
        },
      ];
    });

    setProductId("");
    setQuantity("");
    setProductSearch("");
    showMessage("Product added to the adjustment list.", "success");
  }

  function removeItem(productToRemove) {
    setItems((currentItems) =>
      currentItems.filter(
        (item) => String(item.productId) !== String(productToRemove)
      )
    );
  }

  function resetForm() {
    setWarehouseId("");
    setAdjustmentType("INCREASE");
    setReferenceNumber("");
    setReason("");
    setProductId("");
    setQuantity("");
    setProductSearch("");
    setItems([]);
    setMessage("");
    setMessageType("error");
  }

  async function submitAdjustment(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setMessage("");

    if (!warehouseId) {
      showMessage("Please select a warehouse.");
      return;
    }

    if (items.length === 0) {
      showMessage("Please add at least one product.");
      return;
    }

    if (
      items.some(
        (item) =>
          !Number.isFinite(Number(item.quantity)) ||
          Number(item.quantity) <= 0
      )
    ) {
      showMessage("Every product must have a valid quantity greater than zero.");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/stock-adjustments", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          warehouseId,
          adjustmentType,
          referenceNumber: referenceNumber.trim(),
          reason: reason.trim(),
          items,
        }),
      });

      let data = {};

      try {
        data = await response.json();
      } catch {
        data = {};
      }

      if (!response.ok) {
        showMessage(
          readError(data, "Stock adjustment failed. Please try again.")
        );
        return;
      }

      showMessage(
        data.message || "Stock adjustment completed successfully.",
        "success"
      );

      setWarehouseId("");
      setAdjustmentType("INCREASE");
      setReferenceNumber("");
      setReason("");
      setProductId("");
      setQuantity("");
      setProductSearch("");
      setItems([]);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Stock adjustment submission error:", error);
      showMessage("Server connection failed. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen space-y-6 bg-slate-50/70 pb-10 dark:bg-slate-950">
      {/* Header */}
      <section className="relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-700 via-indigo-600 to-violet-700 px-6 py-7 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-900/10 sm:px-8 sm:py-9">
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-10 -top-24 -z-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-white/10 blur-3xl" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-32 right-1/3 -z-10 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-violet-300/20 blur-3xl" />

        <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
          <div className="max-w-2xl">
            <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-50 backdrop-blur">
              <ShieldCheck size={15} />
              INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
              Stock Adjustment
            </h1>

            <p className="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-indigo-100 sm:text-base">
              Keep your inventory accurate. Record stock increases or
              decreases with a clear reference, reason, and warehouse.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm text-indigo-100">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <Warehouse size={16} />
                Warehouse stock control
              </span>
              <span className="hidden h-1 w-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-200 sm:block" />
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <ClipboardList size={16} />
                Adjustment record
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => fetchData(true)}
              disabled={refreshing || loadingData}
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/25 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              <RefreshCw
                size={17}
                className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
              />
              Refresh data
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={resetForm}
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-indigo-700 shadow-sm transition hover:bg-indigo-50"
            >
              <X size={17} />
              Clear form
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Summary */}
      <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <SummaryCard
          title="Products in list"
          value={items.length}
          description="Unique products to adjust"
          icon={Package}
          accent="indigo"
        />
        <SummaryCard
          title="Total quantity"
          value={formatNumber(totalQuantity)}
          description="Combined entered quantities"
          icon={Boxes}
          accent="emerald"
        />
        <SummaryCard
          title="Adjustment direction"
          value={adjustmentType === "INCREASE" ? "Increase" : "Decrease"}
          description="Selected stock movement"
          icon={adjustmentType === "INCREASE" ? TrendingUp : TrendingDown}
          accent={adjustmentType === "INCREASE" ? "emerald" : "amber"}
        />
        <SummaryCard
          title="Warehouse"
          value={selectedWarehouse ? "Selected" : "Not selected"}
          description={
            selectedWarehouse
              ? selectedWarehouse.warehouse_name
              : "Choose a warehouse below"
          }
          icon={Warehouse}
          accent="violet"
        />
      </section>

      {/* Status message */}
      {message && (
        <div
          role="status"
          className={`flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border px-4 py-4 ${
            messageType === "success"
              ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300"
              : "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-300"
          }`}
        >
          {messageType === "success" ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" size={19} />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" size={19} />
          )}

          <p className="flex-1 text-sm font-medium">{message}</p>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMessage("")}
            aria-label="Dismiss message"
            className="rounded-lg p-1 opacity-70 transition hover:bg-black/5 hover:opacity-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10"
          >
            <X size={17} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={submitAdjustment} className="space-y-6">
        {/* General details */}
        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:px-7">
            <div className="rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 p-2.5 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-300">
              <FileText size={21} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Adjustment details
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Choose the warehouse and provide the adjustment information.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:p-7">
            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>
                Warehouse <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
              </label>

              <div className="relative">
                <Warehouse
                  size={18}
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                />
                <select
                  value={warehouseId}
                  onChange={(event) => setWarehouseId(event.target.value)}
                  className={`${inputClass} pl-11`}
                  required
                  disabled={loadingData}
                >
                  <option value="">
                    {loadingData ? "Loading warehouses..." : "Select warehouse"}
                  </option>

                  {warehouses.map((warehouse) => (
                    <option
                      key={warehouse.warehouse_id}
                      value={warehouse.warehouse_id}
                    >
                      {warehouse.warehouse_name}
                      {warehouse.warehouse_code
                        ? ` (${warehouse.warehouse_code})`
                        : ""}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              {selectedWarehouse?.location && (
                <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  <MapPin size={13} />
                  {selectedWarehouse.location}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>
                Adjustment type <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
              </label>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setAdjustmentType("INCREASE")}
                  aria-pressed={adjustmentType === "INCREASE"}
                  className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold transition ${
                    adjustmentType === "INCREASE"
                      ? "border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/15 dark:border-emerald-500 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300"
                      : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:border-emerald-300 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300"
                  }`}
                >
                  <ArrowUpFromLine size={18} />
                  Increase stock
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setAdjustmentType("DECREASE")}
                  aria-pressed={adjustmentType === "DECREASE"}
                  className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold transition ${
                    adjustmentType === "DECREASE"
                      ? "border-amber-500 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 ring-2 ring-amber-500/15 dark:border-amber-500 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-300"
                      : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:border-amber-300 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300"
                  }`}
                >
                  <ArrowDownToLine size={18} />
                  Decrease stock
                </button>
              </div>

              <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {adjustmentType === "INCREASE"
                  ? "Adds the entered quantity to the selected warehouse."
                  : "Removes the entered quantity from the selected warehouse."}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>Reference number</label>

              <div className="relative">
                <Hash
                  size={18}
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={referenceNumber}
                  onChange={(event) => setReferenceNumber(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. ADJ-001"
                  maxLength={100}
                  className={`${inputClass} pl-11`}
                />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Optional internal reference for tracking.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>Reason for adjustment</label>

              <input
                type="text"
                value={reason}
                onChange={(event) => setReason(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Damaged, missing, opening stock"
                maxLength={500}
                className={inputClass}
              />
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Describe why the stock quantity is changing.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Product selection */}
        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
          <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:px-7">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-violet-50 p-2.5 text-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-500/10 dark:text-violet-300">
                <PackagePlus size={21} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Add products
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Select products and enter the quantities to adjust.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <span className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-300">
              <Layers3 size={14} />
              {items.length} {items.length === 1 ? "product" : "products"} added
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-5 p-5 sm:p-7">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 items-end gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.5fr)_minmax(160px,0.65fr)_auto]">
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Product</label>

                <div className="relative mb-2">
                  <Search
                    size={17}
                    className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                  />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={productSearch}
                    onChange={(event) => setProductSearch(event.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Search by name, SKU or barcode..."
                    className={`${inputClass} pl-10`}
                  />
                </div>

                <select
                  value={productId}
                  onChange={(event) => setProductId(event.target.value)}
                  className={inputClass}
                  disabled={loadingData}
                >
                  <option value="">
                    {loadingData ? "Loading products..." : "Choose a product"}
                  </option>

                  {filteredProducts.map((product) => (
                    <option
                      key={product.product_id}
                      value={product.product_id}
                    >
                      {product.sku ? `${product.sku} â€” ` : ""}
                      {product.product_name || "Unnamed product"}
                      {product.barcode ? ` (${product.barcode})` : ""}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>

                {!loadingData && filteredProducts.length === 0 && (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                    No matching products found.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Quantity</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0.001"
                  step="0.001"
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  value={quantity}
                  onChange={(event) => setQuantity(event.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(event) => {
                    if (event.key === "Enter") {
                      event.preventDefault();
                      addItem();
                    }
                  }}
                  placeholder="Enter quantity"
                  className={inputClass}
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={addItem}
                disabled={loadingData}
                className="inline-flex min-h-[46px] items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm shadow-indigo-600/20 transition hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Plus size={18} />
                Add product
              </button>
            </div>

            {selectedProduct && (
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/70 p-4 dark:border-indigo-500/20 dark:bg-indigo-500/5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white text-indigo-600 shadow-sm dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-indigo-300">
                  <Package size={21} />
                </div>

                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    {selectedProduct.product_name}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    SKU: {selectedProduct.sku || "â€”"}
                    {selectedProduct.barcode
                      ? ` Â· Barcode: ${selectedProduct.barcode}`
                      : ""}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <span className="w-fit rounded-lg border border-indigo-100 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-indigo-300">
                  Selected product
                </span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Product table */}
            <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-4 py-4 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800/50 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:px-5">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    Adjustment items
                  </h3>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Review the products before saving.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                  <Boxes size={16} className="text-indigo-500" />
                  Total quantity:
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    {formatNumber(totalQuantity)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {items.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center px-5 py-12 text-center">
                  <div className="mb-4 flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-500">
                    <Package size={29} />
                  </div>

                  <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                    No products added yet
                  </h3>
                  <p className="mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Choose a product above, enter its quantity, and click
                    &quot;Add product&quot; to include it in this adjustment.
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {/* Desktop table */}
                  <div className="hidden overflow-x-auto md:block">
                    <table className="w-full min-w-[580px] text-left">
                      <thead className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900">
                        <tr className="border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                          <th className="px-5 py-3.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            #
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-5 py-3.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            Product
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-5 py-3.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            SKU
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-5 py-3.5 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            Quantity
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-5 py-3.5 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            Action
                          </th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>

                      <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                        {items.map((item, index) => (
                          <tr
                            key={item.productId}
                            className="transition hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40"
                          >
                            <td className="px-5 py-4 text-sm text-slate-400">
                              {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
                            </td>

                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                                  <Package size={18} />
                                </div>
                                <span className="max-w-[300px] truncate text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                                  {item.productName}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            </td>

                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                              <span className="rounded-md bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                                {item.sku}
                              </span>
                            </td>

                            <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right">
                              <span className="inline-flex min-w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-300">
                                {formatNumber(item.quantity)}
                              </span>
                            </td>

                            <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => removeItem(item.productId)}
                                title="Remove product"
                                aria-label={`Remove ${item.productName}`}
                                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-rose-100 p-2.5 text-rose-600 transition hover:border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:border-rose-900/40 dark:text-rose-400 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40"
                              >
                                <Trash2 size={16} />
                              </button>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>

                  {/* Mobile product cards */}
                  <div className="space-y-3 p-3 md:hidden">
                    {items.map((item, index) => (
                      <div
                        key={item.productId}
                        className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-4 dark:border-slate-800"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-300">
                            <Package size={19} />
                          </div>

                          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <p className="break-words text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                              {item.productName}
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                              SKU: {item.sku}
                            </p>
                          </div>

                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => removeItem(item.productId)}
                            aria-label={`Remove ${item.productName}`}
                            className="rounded-lg p-2 text-rose-500 transition hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40"
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={17} />
                          </button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-100 pt-3 dark:border-slate-800">
                          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            Item {index + 1} Â· Quantity
                          </span>
                          <span className="rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-300">
                            {formatNumber(item.quantity)}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-4 py-4 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800/30 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-5">
                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      {items.length} unique{" "}
                      {items.length === 1 ? "product" : "products"} included
                    </p>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 sm:justify-end">
                      <span className="text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                        Total quantity
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                        {formatNumber(totalQuantity)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Final review and actions */}
        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 p-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:p-7">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <div
                className={`rounded-xl p-3 ${
                  adjustmentType === "INCREASE"
                    ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300"
                    : "bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-300"
                }`}
              >
                <ArrowDownUp size={22} />
              </div>

              <div>
                <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Ready to save adjustment?
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 max-w-lg text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  {adjustmentType === "INCREASE"
                    ? "The submitted adjustment will increase stock for the selected warehouse."
                    : "The submitted adjustment will decrease stock for the selected warehouse."}{" "}
                  Check the warehouse, reason, and quantities before saving.
                </p>
                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                    {selectedWarehouse?.warehouse_name || "No warehouse selected"}
                  </span>
                  <span
                    className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${
                      adjustmentType === "INCREASE"
                        ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-300"
                        : "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-300"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {adjustmentType === "INCREASE" ? "Stock increase" : "Stock decrease"}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-3 sm:min-w-52">
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting || loadingData || items.length === 0}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/20 transition hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-500/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {submitting ? (
                  <>
                    <LoaderCircle size={18} className="animate-spin" />
                    Saving adjustment...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <CheckCircle2 size={18} />
                    Save adjustment
                    <ArrowRight size={17} />
                  </>
                )}
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={resetForm}
                disabled={submitting}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
              >
                <RefreshCw size={16} />
                Reset adjustment
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/80 px-5 py-4 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800/30 dark:text-slate-400 sm:px-7">
            <ShieldCheck size={15} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-indigo-500" />
            <p>
              Review all details before submitting. Stock movements should be
              supported by a valid business reason and reference when
              applicable.
            </p>
          </div>
        </section>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
