===== app\dashboard\supplier-balance\page.js =====
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

const formatAmount = (value) =>
    Number(value ?? 0).toLocaleString("en-PK", {
        minimumFractionDigits: 2,
        maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    });

function Icon({ name, size = 20, className = "" }) {
    const paths = {
        wallet: (
            <>
                <rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="15" rx="2" />
                <path d="M3 9h18" />
                <path d="M16 14h2" />
                <path d="M7 5V3h10l2 2" />
            </>
        ),
        users: (
            <>
                <path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2" />
                <circle cx="10" cy="7" r="4" />
                <path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87" />
                <path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75" />
            </>
        ),
        trending: (
            <>
                <path d="m3 17 6-6 4 4 8-9" />
                <path d="M15 6h6v6" />
            </>
        ),
        check: (
            <>
                <path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" />
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
            </>
        ),
        search: (
            <>
                <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" />
                <path d="m20 20-4-4" />
            </>
        ),
        refresh: (
            <>
                <path d="M20 7v5h-5" />
                <path d="M4 17v-5h5" />
                <path d="M5.6 9A7 7 0 0 1 17.3 6L20 12" />
                <path d="M18.4 15A7 7 0 0 1 6.7 18L4 12" />
            </>
        ),
        building: (
            <>
                <rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="18" rx="2" />
                <path d="M9 7h2M9 11h2M9 15h2M15 7h.01M15 11h.01M15 15h.01M9 21v-3h6v3" />
            </>
        ),
        alert: (
            <>
                <path d="m10.3 3.9-8 14A2 2 0 0 0 4 21h16a2 2 0 0 0 1.7-3.1l-8-14a2 2 0 0 0-3.4 0Z" />
                <path d="M12 9v4" />
                <path d="M12 17h.01" />
            </>
        ),
        close: (
            <>
                <path d="m18 6-12 12" />
                <path d="m6 6 12 12" />
            </>
        ),
        file: (
            <>
                <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8Z" />
                <path d="M14 2v6h6M8 13h8M8 17h8" />
            </>
        ),
        arrow: (
            <>
                <path d="M7 17 17 7" />
                <path d="M7 7h10v10" />
            </>
        ),
    };

    return (
        <svg
            xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
            width={size}
            height={size}
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="1.8"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            className={className}
            aria-hidden="true"
        >
            {paths[name] || paths.file}
        </svg>
    );
}

function SummaryCard({
    title,
    value,
    description,
    icon,
    color = "blue",
}) {
    const colors = {
        blue: {
            icon: "bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-400/15 dark:text-sky-300",
            border: "border-sky-200/70 dark:border-sky-900/70",
            glow: "from-sky-500/10",
        },
        green: {
            icon: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-400/15 dark:text-emerald-300",
            border: "border-emerald-200/70 dark:border-emerald-900/70",
            glow: "from-emerald-500/10",
        },
        teal: {
            icon: "bg-teal-100 text-teal-700 dark:bg-teal-400/15 dark:text-teal-300",
            border: "border-teal-200/70 dark:border-teal-900/70",
            glow: "from-teal-500/10",
        },
        slate: {
            icon: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-700/70 dark:text-slate-200",
            border: "border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700",
            glow: "from-slate-500/5",
        },
    };

    const theme = colors[color] || colors.blue;

    return (
        <div
            className={`relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border ${theme.border} bg-gradient-to-br ${theme.glow} to-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md dark:to-slate-900`}
        >
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        {title}
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                        {value}
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        {description}
                    </p>
                </div>

                <div
                    className={`flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${theme.icon}`}
                >
                    <Icon name={icon} size={22} />
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function StatusBadge({ active }) {
    return (
        <span
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold ${
                active
                    ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300"
                    : "border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300"
            }`}
        >
            <span
                className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${
                    active ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-slate-400"
                }`}
            />
            {active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
        </span>
    );
}

const inputClass =
    "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-sky-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-sky-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 dark:placeholder:text-slate-500 dark:focus:border-sky-400";

export default function SupplierBalancePage() {
    const [balances, setBalances] = useState([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all");
    const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState("balance-desc");

    async function fetchBalances({ showLoader = true } = {}) {
        if (showLoader) {
            setLoading(true);
        } else {
            setRefreshing(true);
        }

        setError("");

        try {
            const response = await fetch("/api/suppliers/balance", {
                cache: "no-store",
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message ||
                        data.error ||
                        "Failed to load supplier balances."
                );
            }

            setBalances(
                Array.isArray(data.balances) ? data.balances : []
            );
        } catch (err) {
            setError(
                err.message || "Failed to load supplier balances."
            );
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
            setRefreshing(false);
        }
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;

        async function loadInitialBalances() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(
                    "/api/suppliers/balance",
                    { cache: "no-store" }
                );

                const data = await response.json();

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(
                        data.message ||
                            data.error ||
                            "Failed to load supplier balances."
                    );
                }

                if (!cancelled) {
                    setBalances(
                        Array.isArray(data.balances)
                            ? data.balances
                            : []
                    );
                    setError("");
                }
            } catch (err) {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setError(
                        err.message ||
                            "Failed to load supplier balances."
                    );
                }
            } finally {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setLoading(false);
                }
            }
        }

        loadInitialBalances();

        return () => {
            cancelled = true;
        };
    }, []);

    const filteredBalances = useMemo(() => {
        const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

        const result = balances.filter((supplier) => {
            const supplierText =
                `${supplier.supplier_code || ""} ${supplier.supplier_name || ""}`
                    .toLowerCase();

            const matchesSearch = supplierText.includes(query);

            const matchesStatus =
                statusFilter === "all" ||
                (statusFilter === "active" && supplier.is_active) ||
                (statusFilter === "inactive" && !supplier.is_active);

            return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
        });

        result.sort((a, b) => {
            if (sortBy === "balance-desc") {
                return Number(b.balance || 0) - Number(a.balance || 0);
            }

            if (sortBy === "balance-asc") {
                return Number(a.balance || 0) - Number(b.balance || 0);
            }

            if (sortBy === "name-asc") {
                return String(a.supplier_name || "").localeCompare(
                    String(b.supplier_name || "")
                );
            }

            return String(a.supplier_code || "").localeCompare(
                String(b.supplier_code || "")
            );
        });

        return result;
    }, [balances, search, statusFilter, sortBy]);

    const summary = useMemo(() => {
        return balances.reduce(
            (totals, supplier) => {
                totals.opening += Number(supplier.opening_balance || 0);
                totals.purchases += Number(supplier.total_purchases || 0);
                totals.paid += Number(supplier.total_paid || 0);
                totals.balance += Number(supplier.balance || 0);
                totals.creditLimit += Number(supplier.credit_limit || 0);

                if (supplier.is_active) {
                    totals.activeSuppliers += 1;
                }

                return totals;
            },
            {
                opening: 0,
                purchases: 0,
                paid: 0,
                balance: 0,
                creditLimit: 0,
                activeSuppliers: 0,
            }
        );
    }, [balances]);

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-950 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
                <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] animate-pulse space-y-6">
                    <div className="h-36 rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800" />

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                        {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, index) => (
                            <div
                                key={index}
                                className="h-32 rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800"
                            />
                        ))}
                    </div>

                    <div className="h-96 rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800" />

                    <p className="text-center text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        Loading supplier balances...
                    </p>
                </div>
            </main>
        );
    }

    return (
        <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-4 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
            <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-6">
                {/* Header */}
                <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-950 via-emerald-900 to-sky-900 p-6 text-white shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/10 sm:p-8">
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-12 -top-24 h-72 w-72 rounded-full border border-white/10" />
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-2 -top-12 h-52 w-52 rounded-full border border-white/10" />
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-24 right-1/3 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-sky-400/10 blur-3xl" />

                    <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
                        <div className="max-w-2xl">
                            <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-emerald-300/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-emerald-100">
                                <Icon name="building" size={15} />
                                ACCOUNTS PAYABLE
                            </div>

                            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
                                Supplier Balance
                            </h1>

                            <p className="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-emerald-50/80 sm:text-base">
                                Monitor supplier accounts, review outstanding
                                balances, and keep track of your purchase
                                payments in one place.
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 backdrop-blur-sm">
                                <p className="text-xs text-emerald-100/75">
                                    Total suppliers
                                </p>
                                <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold">
                                    {balances.length}
                                </p>
                            </div>

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() =>
                                    fetchBalances({ showLoader: false })
                                }
                                disabled={refreshing}
                                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-white/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
                            >
                                <Icon
                                    name="refresh"
                                    size={17}
                                    className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
                                />
                                {refreshing ? "Refreshing..." : "Refresh"}
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </section>

                {/* Error message */}
                {error && (
                    <div
                        role="alert"
                        className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-800 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300"
                    >
                        <Icon
                            name="alert"
                            size={20}
                            className="mt-0.5 shrink-0"
                        />

                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <p className="font-semibold">
                                Unable to load supplier balances
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1">{error}</p>
                        </div>

                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() =>
                                fetchBalances({ showLoader: false })
                            }
                            className="shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-red-200 px-3 py-1.5 font-semibold transition hover:bg-red-100 dark:border-red-800 dark:hover:bg-red-900/50"
                        >
                            Retry
                        </button>
                    </div>
                )}

                {/* Summary cards */}
                <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                    <SummaryCard
                        title="Total Outstanding"
                        value={formatAmount(summary.balance)}
                        description="Combined balance payable to suppliers"
                        icon="wallet"
                        color="green"
                    />

                    <SummaryCard
                        title="Total Purchases"
                        value={formatAmount(summary.purchases)}
                        description="Total purchases recorded"
                        icon="trending"
                        color="blue"
                    />

                    <SummaryCard
                        title="Total Paid"
                        value={formatAmount(summary.paid)}
                        description="Payments recorded against purchases"
                        icon="check"
                        color="teal"
                    />

                    <SummaryCard
                        title="Active Suppliers"
                        value={`${summary.activeSuppliers} / ${balances.length}`}
                        description="Suppliers currently marked active"
                        icon="users"
                        color="slate"
                    />
                </section>

                {/* Supplier accounts */}
                <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
                    <div className="border-b border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:p-6">
                        <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 xl:flex-row xl:items-center">
                            <div>
                                <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                    Supplier Accounts
                                </h2>

                                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                    Search and review each supplier&apos;s
                                    financial position.
                                </p>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
                                <div className="relative min-w-0 sm:w-72">
                                    <Icon
                                        name="search"
                                        size={18}
                                        className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                                    />

                                    <input
                                        value={search}
                                        onChange={(e) =>
                                            setSearch(e.target.value)
                                        }
                                        placeholder="Search code or supplier..."
                                        aria-label="Search suppliers"
                                        className={`${inputClass} pl-10 pr-10`}
                                    />

                                    {search && (
                                        <button
                                            type="button"
                                            onClick={() => setSearch("")}
                                            aria-label="Clear search"
                                            className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 transition hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white"
                                        >
                                            <Icon name="close" size={16} />
                                        </button>
                                    )}
                                </div>

                                <select
                                    value={statusFilter}
                                    onChange={(e) =>
                                        setStatusFilter(e.target.value)
                                    }
                                    aria-label="Filter supplier status"
                                    className={`${inputClass} sm:w-36`}
                                >
                                    <option value="all">All statuses</option>
                                    <option value="active">Active only</option>
                                    <option value="inactive">Inactive only</option>
                                </select>

                                <select
                                    value={sortBy}
                                    onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value)}
                                    aria-label="Sort supplier balances"
                                    className={`${inputClass} sm:w-44`}
                                >
                                    <option value="balance-desc">
                                        Balance: highest
                                    </option>
                                    <option value="balance-asc">
                                        Balance: lowest
                                    </option>
                                    <option value="name-asc">
                                        Supplier: Aâ€“Z
                                    </option>
                                    <option value="code-asc">
                                        Code: Aâ€“Z
                                    </option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-3 py-2 dark:bg-slate-800">
                                    <Icon name="users" size={15} />
                                    {filteredBalances.length} results
                                </span>

                                {search && (
                                    <span className="rounded-lg bg-sky-50 px-3 py-2 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/50 dark:text-sky-300">
                                        Search: {search}
                                    </span>
                                )}
                            </div>

                            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                                Amounts shown to 2 decimal places
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                        <table className="w-full min-w-[1050px] text-left text-sm">
                            <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:bg-slate-800/70 dark:text-slate-400">
                                <tr>
                                    <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold">
                                        Supplier Code
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold">
                                        Supplier
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold">
                                        Opening
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold">
                                        Purchases
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold">
                                        Paid
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold">
                                        Balance
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-semibold">
                                        Credit Limit
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-5 py-4 text-center font-semibold">
                                        Status
                                    </th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>

                            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                                {filteredBalances.map((supplier) => {
                                    const balance = Number(
                                        supplier.balance || 0
                                    );

                                    const creditLimit = Number(
                                        supplier.credit_limit || 0
                                    );

                                    const limitReached =
                                        creditLimit > 0 &&
                                        balance >= creditLimit;

                                    return (
                                        <tr
                                            key={supplier.supplier_id}
                                            className="transition-colors hover:bg-sky-50/60 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60"
                                        >
                                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4">
                                                <span className="inline-flex rounded-lg border border-sky-100 bg-sky-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-sky-800 dark:border-sky-900 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300">
                                                    {supplier.supplier_code || "-"}
                                                </span>
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="px-5 py-4">
                                                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                                    <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-100 to-sky-100 text-sm font-bold text-emerald-800 dark:from-emerald-950 dark:to-sky-950 dark:text-emerald-300">
                                                        {String(
                                                            supplier.supplier_name || "S"
                                                        )
                                                            .trim()
                                                            .charAt(0)
                                                            .toUpperCase()}
                                                    </div>

                                                    <div className="min-w-0">
                                                        <p className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                                                            {supplier.supplier_name || "-"}
                                                        </p>

                                                        {limitReached && (
                                                            <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-medium text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                                                                Credit limit reached
                                                            </p>
                                                        )}
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                                                {formatAmount(
                                                    supplier.opening_balance
                                                )}
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right tabular-nums font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                                                {formatAmount(
                                                    supplier.total_purchases
                                                )}
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right tabular-nums font-medium text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                                                {formatAmount(
                                                    supplier.total_paid
                                                )}
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right">
                                                <span
                                                    className={`font-bold tabular-nums ${
                                                        balance > 0
                                                            ? "text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300"
                                                            : balance < 0
                                                            ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400"
                                                            : "text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"
                                                    }`}
                                                >
                                                    {formatAmount(balance)}
                                                </span>
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                                                {formatAmount(
                                                    supplier.credit_limit
                                                )}
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-center">
                                                <StatusBadge
                                                    active={Boolean(
                                                        supplier.is_active
                                                    )}
                                                />
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    );
                                })}

                                {filteredBalances.length === 0 && (
                                    <tr>
                                        <td colSpan={8} className="px-6 py-16">
                                            <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-sm flex-col items-center text-center">
                                                <div className="mb-4 flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-500">
                                                    <Icon name="search" size={26} />
                                                </div>

                                                <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-white">
                                                    No suppliers found
                                                </h3>

                                                <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                                    {balances.length === 0
                                                        ? "There are currently no supplier balances to display."
                                                        : "Try changing your search term or status filter."}
                                                </p>

                                                {(search || statusFilter !== "all") && (
                                                    <button
                                                        type="button"
                                                        onClick={() => {
                                                            setSearch("");
                                                            setStatusFilter("all");
                                                        }}
                                                        className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-sky-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-sky-700"
                                                    >
                                                        Clear filters
                                                    </button>
                                                )}
                                            </div>
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                )}
                            </tbody>

                            {filteredBalances.length > 0 && (
                                <tfoot className="border-t-2 border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800/70">
                                    <tr>
                                        <td
                                            colSpan={2}
                                            className="px-5 py-4 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-white"
                                        >
                                            Filtered totals
                                        </td>

                                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                                            {formatAmount(
                                                filteredBalances.reduce(
                                                    (sum, supplier) =>
                                                        sum +
                                                        Number(
                                                            supplier.opening_balance || 0
                                                        ),
                                                    0
                                                )
                                            )}
                                        </td>

                                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                                            {formatAmount(
                                                filteredBalances.reduce(
                                                    (sum, supplier) =>
                                                        sum +
                                                        Number(
                                                            supplier.total_purchases || 0
                                                        ),
                                                    0
                                                )
                                            )}
                                        </td>

                                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                                            {formatAmount(
                                                filteredBalances.reduce(
                                                    (sum, supplier) =>
                                                        sum +
                                                        Number(
                                                            supplier.total_paid || 0
                                                        ),
                                                    0
                                                )
                                            )}
                                        </td>

                                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">
                                            {formatAmount(
                                                filteredBalances.reduce(
                                                    (sum, supplier) =>
                                                        sum +
                                                        Number(supplier.balance || 0),
                                                    0
                                                )
                                            )}
                                        </td>

                                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                                            {formatAmount(
                                                filteredBalances.reduce(
                                                    (sum, supplier) =>
                                                        sum +
                                                        Number(supplier.credit_limit || 0),
                                                    0
                                                )
                                            )}
                                        </td>

                                        <td className="px-5 py-4" />
                                    </tr>
                                </tfoot>
                            )}
                        </table>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 border-t border-slate-200 px-5 py-4 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                        <p>
                            Showing{" "}
                            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                                {filteredBalances.length}
                            </span>{" "}
                            of{" "}
                            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                                {balances.length}
                            </span>{" "}
                            suppliers
                        </p>

                        <p className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <Icon
                                name="check"
                                size={14}
                                className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                            />
                            Supplier balance overview
                        </p>
                    </div>
                </section>
            </div>
        </main>
    );
}

===== app\dashboard\supplier-ledger\page.js =====
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  BookOpenCheck,
  Search,
  RefreshCw,
  Wallet,
  TrendingUp,
  CreditCard,
  ShoppingCart,
  CalendarDays,
  Building2,
  ArrowDownLeft,
  ArrowUpRight,
  CircleDollarSign,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  Filter,
  X,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  ReceiptText,
  Download,
  Printer,
} from "lucide-react";

const money = (value) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(Number(value || 0));

const dateLabel = (value) => {
  if (!value) return "-";

  const date = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "-";

  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    timeZone: "UTC",
  });
};

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3.5 py-3 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-300 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 dark:placeholder:text-slate-500 dark:hover:border-slate-600 dark:focus:border-blue-400 dark:focus:ring-blue-400/10";

const labelClass =
  "mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300";

export default function SupplierLedgerPage() {
  const [suppliers, setSuppliers] = useState([]);
  const [supplierId, setSupplierId] = useState("");
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState("");
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState("");
  const [ledger, setLedger] = useState(null);

  const [loadingSuppliers, setLoadingSuppliers] = useState(true);
  const [loadingLedger, setLoadingLedger] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [transactionSearch, setTransactionSearch] = useState("");
  const [transactionType, setTransactionType] = useState("all");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadSuppliers() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/supplier-ledger", {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
          throw new Error(data.message || "Could not load suppliers.");
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setSuppliers(data.suppliers || []);
          setError("");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setError(err.message || "Could not load suppliers.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoadingSuppliers(false);
        }
      }
    }

    loadSuppliers();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  async function searchLedger(event) {
    event?.preventDefault();

    if (!supplierId) {
      setError("Please select a supplier before viewing the ledger.");
      setLedger(null);
      return;
    }

    if (startDate && endDate && startDate > endDate) {
      setError("Start date cannot be after end date.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setLoadingLedger(true);
      setError("");
      setNotice("");

      const params = new URLSearchParams({ supplierId });

      if (startDate) params.set("startDate", startDate);
      if (endDate) params.set("endDate", endDate);

      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/supplier-ledger?${params.toString()}`,
        { cache: "no-store" }
      );

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
        throw new Error(data.message || "Could not load supplier ledger.");
      }

      setLedger(data);
      setTransactionSearch("");
      setTransactionType("all");
      setNotice("Supplier ledger loaded successfully.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Could not load supplier ledger.");
      setLedger(null);
    } finally {
      setLoadingLedger(false);
    }
  }

  function resetFilters() {
    setSupplierId("");
    setStartDate("");
    setEndDate("");
    setLedger(null);
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    setTransactionSearch("");
    setTransactionType("all");
  }

  function setDateRange(range) {
    const now = new Date();
    const end = new Date(now);
    const start = new Date(now);

    if (range === "month") {
      start.setDate(1);
    } else if (range === "7days") {
      start.setDate(start.getDate() - 6);
    } else if (range === "30days") {
      start.setDate(start.getDate() - 29);
    }

    const toInputDate = (date) => {
      const year = date.getFullYear();
      const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
      const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");

      return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
    };

    setStartDate(toInputDate(start));
    setEndDate(toInputDate(end));
    setLedger(null);
    setNotice("");
    setError("");
  }

  const summary = ledger?.summary;

  const transactions = useMemo(() => {
    const rows = ledger?.transactions || [];
    const query = transactionSearch.trim().toLowerCase();

    return rows.filter((transaction) => {
      const matchesType =
        transactionType === "all" ||
        String(transaction.transaction_type || "").toLowerCase() ===
          transactionType.toLowerCase();

      const searchableText = [
        transaction.reference,
        transaction.transaction_type,
        transaction.transaction_id,
        transaction.transaction_date,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase();

      return matchesType && (!query || searchableText.includes(query));
    });
  }, [ledger, transactionSearch, transactionType]);

  function exportCSV() {
    if (!ledger) return;

    const rows = [
      [
        "Date",
        "Reference",
        "Transaction Type",
        "Debit (PKR)",
        "Credit (PKR)",
        "Balance (PKR)",
      ],
      [
        "",
        "OPENING",
        "Opening Balance",
        "",
        "",
        Number(ledger.openingBalance || 0).toFixed(2),
      ],
      ...transactions.map((transaction) => [
        dateLabel(transaction.transaction_date),
        transaction.reference || "-",
        transaction.transaction_type || "-",
        Number(transaction.debit || 0).toFixed(2),
        Number(transaction.credit || 0).toFixed(2),
        Number(transaction.balance || 0).toFixed(2),
      ]),
    ];

    const csv = rows
      .map((row) =>
        row
          .map((value) => `"${String(value ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`)
          .join(",")
      )
      .join("\r\n");

    const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF", csv], {
      type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;",
    });

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");

    link.href = url;
    link.download = `supplier-ledger-${supplierId}.csv`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  function printLedger() {
    window.print();
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-100 px-3 py-5 transition-colors sm:px-5 sm:py-7 lg:px-8 dark:bg-[#080f1d]">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-6">
        {/* PAGE HEADER */}
        <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#0f172a] via-[#122b49] to-[#075b52] p-6 text-white shadow-xl shadow-slate-900/10 sm:p-8">
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-12 -top-20 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-sky-400/10 blur-3xl" />
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-24 right-1/3 h-52 w-52 rounded-full bg-emerald-400/10 blur-3xl" />

          <div className="relative flex flex-col gap-6 xl:flex-row xl:items-center xl:justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/15 bg-white/10 p-3.5 shadow-lg backdrop-blur-sm">
                <BookOpenCheck size={30} strokeWidth={1.8} />
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="rounded-full border border-emerald-300/25 bg-emerald-400/10 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-emerald-200">
                    Accounting
                  </span>
                  <span className="rounded-full border border-sky-300/25 bg-sky-400/10 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-sky-100">
                    Supplier Management
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl">
                  Supplier Ledger
                </h1>

                <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-300 sm:text-base">
                  Track supplier purchases, payments, and outstanding balances
                  in one organized financial statement.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              {ledger && (
                <>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={exportCSV}
                    className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-white/20"
                  >
                    <Download size={17} />
                    Export CSV
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={printLedger}
                    className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-400 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-emerald-950 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/10 transition hover:bg-emerald-300"
                  >
                    <Printer size={17} />
                    Print Ledger
                  </button>
                </>
              )}

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={resetFilters}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-white/5 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-white/15"
              >
                <RefreshCw size={16} />
                Reset
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="relative mt-7 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 border-t border-white/10 pt-5 sm:grid-cols-3">
            <HeaderDetail
              icon={Building2}
              label="Suppliers Available"
              value={loadingSuppliers ? "Loading..." : suppliers.length}
            />
            <HeaderDetail
              icon={CalendarDays}
              label="Reporting Period"
              value={
                startDate || endDate
                  ? `${startDate || "Beginning"} â†’ ${endDate || "Today"}`
                  : "All dates"
              }
            />
            <HeaderDetail
              icon={ReceiptText}
              label="Statement Status"
              value={ledger ? "Generated" : "Awaiting filters"}
            />
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* NOTIFICATIONS */}
        {error && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-4 text-sm text-red-800 dark:border-red-900/60 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-200"
          >
            <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" size={19} />
            <span>{error}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setError("")}
              aria-label="Dismiss error"
              className="ml-auto rounded-lg p-1 transition hover:bg-red-100 dark:hover:bg-red-900/40"
            >
              <X size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {notice && !error && (
          <div
            role="status"
            className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 dark:text-emerald-200"
          >
            <CheckCircle2 size={18} />
            {notice}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* FILTER PANEL */}
        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-5 sm:px-6 dark:border-slate-800">
            <div className="rounded-xl bg-sky-50 p-2.5 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-400/10 dark:text-sky-300">
              <Filter size={21} />
            </div>

            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Ledger Filters
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Choose a supplier and reporting period to generate a statement.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={searchLedger} className="space-y-5 p-5 sm:p-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="supplier" className={labelClass}>
                  Select Supplier <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>

                <select
                  id="supplier"
                  value={supplierId}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setSupplierId(event.target.value);
                    setLedger(null);
                    setError("");
                    setNotice("");
                  }}
                  required
                  disabled={loadingSuppliers}
                  className={inputClass}
                >
                  <option value="">
                    {loadingSuppliers
                      ? "Loading suppliers..."
                      : "Choose a supplier"}
                  </option>

                  {suppliers.map((supplier) => (
                    <option
                      key={supplier.supplier_id}
                      value={supplier.supplier_id}
                    >
                      {supplier.supplier_code
                        ? `${supplier.supplier_code} - ${supplier.supplier_name}`
                        : supplier.supplier_name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Select the supplier whose transactions you want to review.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="startDate" className={labelClass}>
                  From Date
                </label>

                <div className="relative">
                  <CalendarDays
                    size={17}
                    className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                  />
                  <input
                    id="startDate"
                    type="date"
                    value={startDate}
                    max={endDate || undefined}
                    onChange={(event) => {
                      setStartDate(event.target.value);
                      setLedger(null);
                      setError("");
                    }}
                    className={`${inputClass} pl-10`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="endDate" className={labelClass}>
                  To Date
                </label>

                <div className="relative">
                  <CalendarDays
                    size={17}
                    className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                  />
                  <input
                    id="endDate"
                    type="date"
                    value={endDate}
                    min={startDate || undefined}
                    onChange={(event) => {
                      setEndDate(event.target.value);
                      setLedger(null);
                      setError("");
                    }}
                    className={`${inputClass} pl-10`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-end">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={loadingLedger || loadingSuppliers}
                  className="inline-flex min-h-[46px] w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-sky-500 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20 transition hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-sky-600 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  {loadingLedger ? (
                    <RefreshCw size={18} className="animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <Search size={18} />
                  )}
                  {loadingLedger ? "Generating..." : "View Ledger"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between dark:border-slate-800">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Quick date ranges
              </p>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <QuickDateButton onClick={() => setDateRange("7days")}>
                  Last 7 days
                </QuickDateButton>
                <QuickDateButton onClick={() => setDateRange("month")}>
                  This month
                </QuickDateButton>
                <QuickDateButton onClick={() => setDateRange("30days")}>
                  Last 30 days
                </QuickDateButton>
                <QuickDateButton
                  onClick={() => {
                    setStartDate("");
                    setEndDate("");
                    setLedger(null);
                    setError("");
                    setNotice("");
                  }}
                >
                  All dates
                </QuickDateButton>
              </div>
            </div>
          </form>
        </section>

        {/* LEDGER CONTENT */}
        {ledger && (
          <>
            {/* SELECTED SUPPLIER */}
            <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-emerald-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-emerald-50/70 to-sky-50 p-5 shadow-sm sm:p-6 dark:border-emerald-900/50 dark:from-slate-900 dark:via-emerald-950/30 dark:to-sky-950/30">
              <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-8 -top-16 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-emerald-400/10 blur-3xl" />

              <div className="relative flex flex-col gap-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                  <div className="rounded-2xl bg-emerald-100 p-3.5 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-400/10 dark:text-emerald-300">
                    <Building2 size={27} />
                  </div>

                    <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">

                        Code: {ledger.supplier?.supplier_code || "-"}
                      </span>

                      <span className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white/80 px-2.5 py-1 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800">
                        {ledger.transactions?.length || 0} transactions
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="min-w-0 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200/80 bg-white/80 p-4 sm:min-w-[230px] dark:border-emerald-800/50 dark:bg-slate-900/70">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    <CircleDollarSign size={17} />
                    Closing Balance
                  </div>

                  <p className="mt-2 break-words text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-emerald-700 sm:text-3xl dark:text-emerald-300">
                    {money(summary?.closingBalance)}
                  </p>

                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Reporting currency: PKR
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </section>

            {/* SUMMARY CARDS */}
            <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
              <SummaryCard
                title="Opening Balance"
                value={money(ledger.openingBalance)}
                subtitle="Balance at the start"
                icon={Wallet}
                theme="blue"
              />

              <SummaryCard
                title="Total Purchases"
                value={money(summary?.totalPurchases)}
                subtitle="Purchases recorded"
                icon={ShoppingCart}
                theme="sky"
              />

              <SummaryCard
                title="Total Payments"
                value={money(summary?.totalPayments)}
                subtitle="Payments recorded"
                icon={CreditCard}
                theme="green"
              />

              <SummaryCard
                title="Closing Balance"
                value={money(summary?.closingBalance)}
                subtitle="Balance at period end"
                icon={TrendingUp}
                theme="dark"
              />
            </section>

            {/* TRANSACTIONS TABLE */}
            <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 p-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-6 dark:border-slate-800">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="rounded-xl bg-blue-50 p-2.5 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-400/10 dark:text-blue-300">
                    <ReceiptText size={21} />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      Ledger Transactions
                    </h2>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Showing {transactions.length} of{" "}
                      {ledger.transactions?.length || 0} transactions
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
                  <div className="relative min-w-0 sm:w-64">
                    <Search
                      size={17}
                      className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                    />

                      value={transactionSearch}

                    }

                  >
                    <option value="all">All transactions</option>
                    <option value="purchase">Purchases</option>
                    <option value="payment">Payments</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full min-w-[900px] text-left text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/90 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950/70 dark:text-slate-400">
                      <th className="px-5 py-4 font-bold">Date</th>
                      <th className="px-5 py-4 font-bold">Reference</th>
                      <th className="px-5 py-4 font-bold">Transaction</th>
                      <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold">Debit</th>
                      <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold">Credit</th>
                      <th className="px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold">Balance</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                    <tr className="bg-sky-50/70 dark:bg-sky-950/20">
                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        -
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-4">
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                          <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500" />
                          OPENING
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-4 font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                        Opening Balance
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-slate-400">
                        -
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right text-slate-400">
                        -
                      </td>
                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                        {money(ledger.openingBalance)}
                      </td>
                    </tr>

                    {transactions.map((transaction, index) => {
                      const isPurchase =
                        String(transaction.transaction_type || "").toLowerCase() ===
                        "purchase";

                      return (
                        <tr
                          key={`${transaction.transaction_type}-${transaction.transaction_id}-${index}`}

                                <ArrowDownLeft size={13} />
                              ) : (
                                <ArrowUpRight size={13} />

                              {transaction.transaction_type || "Transaction"}
                            </span>
                          </td>

                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-medium tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {Number(transaction.debit || 0) !== 0 ? (

                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-slate-400">-</span>
                            )}
                          </td>

                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-medium tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {Number(transaction.credit || 0) !== 0 ? (
                              money(transaction.credit)
                            ) : (

                            )}
                          </td>

                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                            {money(transaction.balance)}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}

                    {transactions.length === 0 && (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={6} className="px-5 py-14 text-center">
                          <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-sm flex-col items-center">

                              <Search size={27} />
                            </div>
                            <p className="mt-3 font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                              No matching transactions
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                              Try another search term or change the transaction
                              filter.
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                  </tbody>

                  <tfoot>
                    <tr className="border-t-2 border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-950/70">

                        Period Totals
                      </td>
                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-300">

                      </td>
                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">

                      </td>
                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 text-right font-extrabold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                        {money(summary?.closingBalance)}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  </tfoot>
                </table>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 px-5 py-4 text-xs text-slate-500 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between dark:border-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400">
                <span>All amounts are displayed in Pakistani Rupees (PKR).</span>
                <span>
                  {startDate || endDate
                    ? `Period: ${startDate || "Beginning"} to ${endDate || "Today"}`
                    : "Period: All available dates"}
                </span>
              </div>
            </section>
          </>
        )}

        {/* EMPTY STATE */}
        {!ledger && !loadingLedger && (
          <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white px-5 py-14 text-center shadow-sm dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 sm:py-20">
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute left-1/2 top-0 h-40 w-72 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-sky-100/70 blur-3xl dark:bg-sky-500/5" />

            <div className="relative mx-auto flex max-w-lg flex-col items-center">
              <div className="rounded-3xl border border-sky-100 bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-50 to-emerald-50 p-5 text-sky-700 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-700 dark:from-sky-950/60 dark:to-emerald-950/30 dark:text-sky-300">
                <BookOpenCheck size={39} strokeWidth={1.6} />
              </div>

              <h3 className="mt-5 text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Your supplier ledger is ready
              </h3>

              <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Select a supplier, choose an optional date range, and generate
                a detailed statement of purchases, payments, and balances.

              <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-sky-100 bg-sky-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:border-sky-900/60 dark:bg-sky-950/40 dark:text-sky-300">
                  <ShoppingCart size={14} />
                  Purchase history
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  <CreditCard size={14} />
                  Supplier payments
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
                  <TrendingUp size={14} />
                  Running balances
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>
        )}

        {/* LOADING OVERLAY */}
        {loadingLedger && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-blue-100 bg-blue-50 px-5 py-5 text-sm font-semibold text-blue-800 dark:border-blue-900/50 dark:bg-blue-950/30 dark:text-blue-200">
            <RefreshCw size={19} className="animate-spin" />
            Generating supplier ledger...
          </div>
        )}

        {/* PRINT STYLES */}
        <style jsx global>{`
          @media print {
            body {
              background: #ffffff !important;
              color: #000000 !important;
            }

            body * {
              visibility: hidden !important;
            }

            table,
            table * {
              visibility: visible !important;
            }

            main {
              min-height: 0 !important;
              padding: 0 !important;
              background: #ffffff !important;
            }

            main > div {
              max-width: none !important;
              margin: 0 !important;
            }

            main section {
              box-shadow: none !important;
            }

            button,
            input,
            select,
            form,
            svg,
            .no-print {
              display: none !important;
            }

            table {
              width: 100% !important;
              min-width: 0 !important;
              border-collapse: collapse !important;
            }

            th,
            td {
              padding: 7px !important;
              color: #000000 !important;
              border: 1px solid #d1d5db !important;
              font-size: 10px !important;
              background: #ffffff !important;
            }

              display: table-header-group !important;
            }

            tr {
              break-inside: avoid !important;
            }

            @page {
              size: landscape;
              margin: 12mm;
            }
          }
        `}</style>
      </div>
    </main>
  );

function HeaderDetail({ icon: Icon, label, value }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 p-2.5 text-sky-200">
        <Icon size={18} />
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">{label}</p>
        <p className="mt-0.5 break-words text-sm font-semibold text-white">
          {value}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SummaryCard({ title, value, subtitle, icon: Icon, theme = "blue" }) {
  const themes = {
    blue: {
      iconBg: "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-400/10",
      iconText: "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300",
      accent: "bg-blue-500",
      value: "text-slate-900 dark:text-white",
    },
    sky: {
      iconBg: "bg-sky-50 dark:bg-sky-400/10",
      iconText: "text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-300",
      accent: "bg-sky-500",
      value: "text-slate-900 dark:text-white",
    },
    green: {
      iconBg: "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-400/10",
      iconText: "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300",
      accent: "bg-emerald-500",
      value: "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300",
    },
    dark: {
      iconBg: "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700",
      iconText: "text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200",
      accent: "bg-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-500",
      value: "text-slate-900 dark:text-white",
    },
  };

  const colors = themes[theme] || themes.blue;

  return (
    <div className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
      <div
        className={`absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1 ${colors.accent}`}
      />

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {title}
          </p>

          <p
            className={`mt-3 break-words text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight sm:text-2xl ${colors.value}`}
          >
            {value}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {subtitle}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className={`rounded-xl p-3 ${colors.iconBg} ${colors.iconText}`}>
          <Icon size={23} strokeWidth={1.8} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function QuickDateButton({ onClick, children }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:border-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:border-blue-700 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/40 dark:hover:text-blue-300"
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

    "mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300";

const panelClass =
    "rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900";

function formatAmount(value) {
    const amount = Number(value ?? 0);

    return (Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : 0).toLocaleString(
        "en-PK",
        {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2,
            maximumFractionDigits: 2,
        }
    );
}

function getInitials(name = "") {
    return (
        name
            .trim()
            .split(/\s+/)
            .filter(Boolean)
            .slice(0, 2)
            .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase())
            .join("") || "V"
    );
}

function Icon({ name, size = 20, className = "" }) {
    const common = {
        width: size,
        height: size,
        viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        strokeWidth: 1.8,
        strokeLinecap: "round",
        strokeLinejoin: "round",
        className,
        "aria-hidden": true,
    };

    const paths = {
        building: (
            <>
                <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2" />
                <path d="M9 20V8h6v12M7 8h.01M7 12h.01M7 16h.01M17 8h.01M17 12h.01M17 16h.01" />
            </>
        ),
        users: (
            <>
                <path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2" />
                <circle cx="10" cy="7" r="4" />
                <path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75" />
            </>
        ),
        wallet: (
            <>
