                      placeholder="Explain how this unit is used (optional)"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4 transition hover:border-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-950/50 dark:hover:border-emerald-800 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/20">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  name="is_active"
                  checked={form.is_active}
                  onChange={updateField}
                  className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 dark:border-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800"
                />

                <div className="flex-1">
                  <span className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                    Active unit
                  </span>
                  <span className="mt-1 block text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Allow this unit to be selected in relevant forms.
                  </span>
                </div>

                <CheckCircle2
                  size={21}
                  className={
                    form.is_active
                      ? "text-emerald-500"
                      : "text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600"
                  }
                />
              </label>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 px-5 py-4 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end sm:px-7 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950/40">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={closeForm}
                disabled={saving}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-100 disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={saving}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 transition hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-indigo-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                {saving ? (
                  <LoaderCircle size={17} className="animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <Save size={17} />
                )}
                {saving
                  ? "Saving..."
                  : editingId
                    ? "Update Unit"
                    : "Save Unit"}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}

        {/* Units master table */}
        {!showForm && (
          <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm shadow-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:shadow-black/10">
            <div className="border-b border-slate-200 p-5 sm:p-6 dark:border-slate-800">
              <div className="mb-5 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    Units Master
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Search, review, and maintain your unit records.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-300">
                  <Package size={14} />
                  {filteredUnits.length}{" "}
                  {filteredUnits.length === 1 ? "record" : "records"}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_220px_auto_auto]">
                <div className="relative">
                  <Search
                    size={18}
                    className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                  />
                  <input
                    className={`${inputClass} pl-10`}
                    value={search}
                    onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Search code, name, or description..."
                    aria-label="Search units"
                  />

                  {search && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setSearch("")}
                      className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-md p-1 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:text-white"
                      aria-label="Clear search"
                    >
                      <X size={15} />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="relative">
                  <Filter
                    size={16}
                    className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                  />
                  <select
                    className={`${inputClass} appearance-none pl-10 pr-8`}
                    value={statusFilter}
                    onChange={(event) => setStatusFilter(event.target.value)}
                    aria-label="Filter units by status"
                  >
                    <option value="all">All statuses</option>
                    <option value="active">Active only</option>
                    <option value="inactive">Inactive only</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={loadUnits}
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:border-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 dark:hover:border-blue-800 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/30 dark:hover:text-blue-300"
                >
                  <RefreshCw
                    size={16}
                    className={loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}
                  />
                  Refresh
                </button>

                {(search || statusFilter !== "all") && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSearch("");
                      setStatusFilter("all");
                    }}
                    className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                  >
                    <RotateCcw size={15} />
                    Reset
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full min-w-[760px] text-left text-sm">
                <thead className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70">
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <th className="px-6 py-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Unit Code
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Unit Name
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Description
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Status
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-4 text-right text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Actions
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                  {loading ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={5} className="px-6 py-16 text-center">
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
                          <LoaderCircle
                            size={29}
                            className="animate-spin text-blue-600"
                          />
                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            Loading units...
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : filteredUnits.length === 0 ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={5} className="px-6 py-16 text-center">
                        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-md flex-col items-center">
                          <div className="mb-4 flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-500">
                            <Ruler size={27} />
                          </div>

                          <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                            {search || statusFilter !== "all"
                              ? "No matching units"
                              : "No units yet"}
                          </h3>

                          <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            {search || statusFilter !== "all"
                              ? "Try another search term or change the status filter."
                              : "Create your first unit to start organizing inventory."}
                          </p>

                          {!search &&
                            statusFilter === "all" &&
                            units.length === 0 && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={openAddForm}
                                className="mt-5 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700"
                              >
                                <Plus size={17} />
                                Create first unit
                              </button>
                            )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : (
                    filteredUnits.map((unit) => (
                      <tr
                        key={unit.unit_id}
                        className="group transition-colors hover:bg-blue-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50"
                      >
                        <td className="px-6 py-4">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-blue-100 bg-blue-50 px-3 py-2 font-bold tracking-wide text-blue-700 dark:border-blue-900/70 dark:bg-blue-950/50 dark:text-blue-300">
                            <Ruler size={15} />
                            {unit.unit_code}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        <td className="px-6 py-4">
                          <div>
                            <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
                              {unit.unit_name}
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                              Unit ID: {unit.unit_id}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        <td className="px-6 py-4">
                          <p className="max-w-md whitespace-pre-line break-words leading-6 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {unit.description || (
                              <span className="italic text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                                No description provided
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </p>
                        </td>

                        <td className="px-6 py-4">
                          <span
                            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold ${
                              unit.is_active
                                ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300"
                                : "border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300"
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span
                              className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${
                                unit.is_active
                                  ? "bg-emerald-500"
                                  : "bg-slate-400"
                              }`}
                            />
                            {unit.is_active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        <td className="px-6 py-4">
                          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => startEdit(unit)}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-blue-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-700 transition hover:border-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:border-blue-900 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-blue-300 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/50"
                              aria-label={`Edit ${unit.unit_name}`}
                            >
                              <Pencil size={14} />
                              Edit
                            </button>

                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => deleteUnit(unit)}
                              disabled={deletingId === unit.unit_id}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-red-600 transition hover:border-red-300 hover:bg-red-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-red-300 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                              aria-label={`Delete ${unit.unit_name}`}
                            >
                              {deletingId === unit.unit_id ? (
                                <LoaderCircle
                                  size={14}
                                  className="animate-spin"
                                />
                              ) : (
                                <Trash2 size={14} />
                              )}
                              Delete
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 px-5 py-4 text-sm sm:flex-row sm:items-center dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950/40">
              <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Showing{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                  {filteredUnits.length}
                </span>{" "}
                of{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                  {units.length}
                </span>{" "}
                units
              </p>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                <FileSpreadsheet size={15} />
                Inventory master data
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>
        )}

        <footer className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 pb-2 text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
          <CheckCircle2 size={14} />
          Unit records are managed through your ERP master data.
        </footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

function SummaryCard({
  title,
  value,
  description,
  icon: Icon,
  iconClass,
  loading,
  accent,
}) {
  const accentClasses = {
    blue: "hover:border-blue-200 dark:hover:border-blue-900",
    emerald: "hover:border-emerald-200 dark:hover:border-emerald-900",
    amber: "hover:border-amber-200 dark:hover:border-amber-900",
    violet: "hover:border-violet-200 dark:hover:border-violet-900",
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`group rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 ${
        accentClasses[accent] || ""
      }`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {title}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-3 text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            {loading ? (
              <span className="inline-block h-9 w-12 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700" />
            ) : (
              value
            )}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div
          className={`flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl transition duration-200 group-hover:scale-105 ${iconClass}`}
        >
          <Icon size={23} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 pt-3 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400">
        <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500" />
        {description}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== app\dashboard\user-rights\page.js =====

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  ShieldCheck,
  Users,
  Search,
  RefreshCw,
  Check,
  Eye,
  Plus,
  Pencil,
  Trash2,
  Layers3,
  LockKeyhole,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  LoaderCircle,
  ChevronDown,
  SlidersHorizontal,
} from "lucide-react";

const PERMISSION_FIELDS = [
  { key: "can_view", label: "View", icon: Eye },
  { key: "can_create", label: "Create", icon: Plus },
  { key: "can_update", label: "Edit", icon: Pencil },
  { key: "can_delete", label: "Delete", icon: Trash2 },
];

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-800 outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-500 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/15 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 dark:border-blue-400/50 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-white dark:placeholder:text-blue-200 dark:focus:border-blue-300 dark:focus:ring-blue-400/20";

async function readResponse(response) {
  const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      data.message || data.error || "The request could not be completed."
    );
  }

  return data;
}

function normalizePermission(permission) {
  return {
    ...permission,
    can_view: Boolean(permission.can_view),
    can_create: Boolean(permission.can_create),
    can_update: Boolean(permission.can_update),
    can_delete: Boolean(permission.can_delete),
  };
}

function PermissionCheckbox({ checked, disabled, label, onChange }) {
  return (
    <label
      title={label}
      className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center ${
        disabled ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-60" : "cursor-pointer"
      }`}
    >
      <input
        type="checkbox"
        checked={checked}
        disabled={disabled}
        aria-label={label}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.checked)}
        className="peer sr-only"
      />

      <span
        className={`flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border-2 transition-all duration-200 peer-focus-visible:outline-none peer-focus-visible:ring-4 peer-focus-visible:ring-blue-400/40 ${
          checked
            ? "border-blue-500 bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm shadow-blue-500/30 dark:border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500 dark:text-white"
            : "border-slate-400 bg-white text-transparent hover:border-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-transparent dark:hover:border-white dark:hover:bg-blue-700"
        }`}
      >
        <Check size={17} strokeWidth={3.2} />
      </span>
    </label>
  );
}

function StatCard({ icon: Icon, label, value, description, color }) {
  const styles = {
    blue: {
      icon: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-800 dark:text-blue-100",
      accent: "bg-blue-500",
    },
    green: {
      icon:
        "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-100",
      accent: "bg-emerald-500",
    },
    sky: {
      icon: "bg-sky-100 text-sky-800 dark:bg-sky-900 dark:text-sky-100",
      accent: "bg-sky-500",
    },
    amber: {
      icon: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-900 dark:text-amber-100",
      accent: "bg-amber-500",
    },
  };

  const theme = styles[color] || styles.blue;

  return (
    <div className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md dark:border-blue-500/50 dark:bg-blue-900 dark:hover:border-blue-300">
      <div className={`absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1 ${theme.accent}`} />

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-blue-100">
            {label}

            {value}
          </p>

          <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-600 dark:text-blue-100">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className={`rounded-xl p-3 ${theme.icon}`}>
          <Icon size={22} strokeWidth={2.2} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function EmptyState({ icon: Icon, title, description, children }) {

export default function UserRightsPage() {
  const [roles, setRoles] = useState([]);
  const [selectedRole, setSelectedRole] = useState("");
  const [permissions, setPermissions] = useState([]);

  const [loadingRoles, setLoadingRoles] = useState(true);
  const [loadingPermissions, setLoadingPermissions] = useState(false);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const [savingIds, setSavingIds] = useState([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [moduleFilter, setModuleFilter] = useState("all");

  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState("");

  const selectedRoleData = useMemo(
    () =>
      roles.find((role) => String(role.role_id) === String(selectedRole)),
    [roles, selectedRole]
  );

  // Load roles once when the page mounts.
  // State updates occur after the asynchronous request.
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function fetchRoles() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/roles", {
          cache: "no-store",
        });

        const data = await readResponse(response);

        if (cancelled) return;

        const nextRoles = Array.isArray(data.roles) ? data.roles : [];

        const nextSelectedRole = nextRoles.length
          ? String(nextRoles[0].role_id)
          : "";

        setRoles(nextRoles);
        setSelectedRole(nextSelectedRole);
        setLoadingPermissions(Boolean(nextSelectedRole));

        if (!nextSelectedRole) {
          setPermissions([]);
        }

        setError("");
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setError(err.message || "Unable to load roles.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoadingRoles(false);
        }
      }
    }

    fetchRoles();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  // Load permissions whenever the selected role changes.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedRole) return;

    let cancelled = false;

    async function fetchPermissions() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `/api/permissions?roleId=${encodeURIComponent(selectedRole)}`,
          { cache: "no-store" }
        );

        const data = await readResponse(response);

        if (cancelled) return;

        setPermissions(
          Array.isArray(data.permissions)
            ? data.permissions.map(normalizePermission)
            : []
        );

        setError("");
        setSuccess("");
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setPermissions([]);
          setError(err.message || "Unable to load permissions.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setLoadingPermissions(false);
        }
      }
    }

    fetchPermissions();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [selectedRole]);

  // Refresh roles and permissions together.
  const handleRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");

    try {
      const rolesResponse = await fetch("/api/roles", {
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const rolesData = await readResponse(rolesResponse);
      const nextRoles = Array.isArray(rolesData.roles)
        ? rolesData.roles
        : [];

      setRoles(nextRoles);

      const existingRoleStillExists = nextRoles.some(
        (role) => String(role.role_id) === String(selectedRole)
      );

      const nextSelectedRole = existingRoleStillExists
        ? String(selectedRole)
        : nextRoles.length
          ? String(nextRoles[0].role_id)
          : "";

      setSelectedRole(nextSelectedRole);

      if (!nextSelectedRole) {
        setPermissions([]);
        setLoadingPermissions(false);
        return;
      }

      setLoadingPermissions(true);

      const permissionsResponse = await fetch(
        `/api/permissions?roleId=${encodeURIComponent(nextSelectedRole)}`,
        { cache: "no-store" }
      );

      const permissionsData = await readResponse(permissionsResponse);

      setPermissions(
        Array.isArray(permissionsData.permissions)
          ? permissionsData.permissions.map(normalizePermission)
          : []
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Unable to refresh user rights.");
    } finally {
      setLoadingRoles(false);
      setLoadingPermissions(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [selectedRole]);

  // Save individual permission changes.
  const updatePermission = useCallback(
    async (permission, changes) => {
      if (!selectedRole) return;

      const permissionId = permission.permission_id;
      const key = String(permissionId);
      const roleIdAtStart = selectedRole;

      if (savingIds.includes(key)) return;

      const previousPermission = permissions.find(
        (item) => String(item.permission_id) === key
      );

      if (!previousPermission) return;

      const updated = normalizePermission({
        ...previousPermission,
        ...changes,
      });

      setError("");
      setSuccess("");

      // Optimistic update: immediately reflect the checkbox change.
      setPermissions((current) =>
        current.map((item) =>
          String(item.permission_id) === key ? updated : item
        )
      );

      setSavingIds((current) =>
        current.includes(key) ? current : [...current, key]
      );

      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/permissions", {
          method: "PUT",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            roleId: roleIdAtStart,
            permissionId,
            canView: updated.can_view,
            canCreate: updated.can_create,
            canUpdate: updated.can_update,
            canDelete: updated.can_delete,
          }),
        });

        await readResponse(response);

        if (roleIdAtStart === selectedRole) {
          setSuccess("Permission saved successfully.");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (roleIdAtStart === selectedRole) {
          setPermissions((current) =>
            current.map((item) =>
              String(item.permission_id) === key
                ? previousPermission
                : item
            )
          );

          setError(err.message || "Failed to save permission.");
        }
      } finally {
        setSavingIds((current) => current.filter((id) => id !== key));
      }
    },
    [permissions, savingIds, selectedRole]
  );

  function toggleAll(permission, value) {
    updatePermission(permission, {
      can_view: value,
      can_create: value,
      can_update: value,
      can_delete: value,
    });
  }

  // Build the module filter options.
  const modules = useMemo(() => {
    const names = permissions.map(
      (permission) => permission.module || "Other"
    );

    return [...new Set(names)].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  }, [permissions]);

  // Filter permissions by module, name, and description.
  const filteredPermissions = useMemo(() => {
    const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    return permissions.filter((permission) => {
      const moduleName = permission.module || "Other";

      const matchesSearch =
        !query ||
        String(moduleName).toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        String(permission.permission_name || "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(query) ||
        String(permission.description || "").toLowerCase().includes(query);

      return (
        matchesSearch &&
        (moduleFilter === "all" || moduleName === moduleFilter)
      );
    });
  }, [permissions, search, moduleFilter]);

  // Calculate summary statistics.
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = permissions.length;

    const enabled = permissions.reduce(
      (count, permission) =>
        count +
        PERMISSION_FIELDS.reduce(
          (sum, field) => sum + Number(permission[field.key]),
          0
        ),
      0
    );

    const possible = total * PERMISSION_FIELDS.length;

    return {
      total,
      enabled,
      disabled: possible - enabled,
      percentage: possible ? Math.round((enabled / possible) * 100) : 0,
    };
  }, [permissions]);

  function handleRoleChange(event) {
    const nextRole = event.target.value;

    setSelectedRole(nextRole);
    setPermissions([]);
    setLoadingPermissions(Boolean(nextRole));
    setSearch("");
    setModuleFilter("all");
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 py-6 text-slate-950 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-white">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px]">
        {/* Page header */}
        <header className="mb-8 flex flex-col justify-between gap-5 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
            <div className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-sky-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20">
              <ShieldCheck size={29} strokeWidth={2.2} />
            </div>

            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-950 dark:text-white sm:text-3xl">
                  User Rights
                </h1>

                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 px-3 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-800 dark:border-blue-300/50 dark:bg-blue-800 dark:text-white">
                  <LockKeyhole size={12} />
                  Access Control
                </span>
              </div>

              <p className="max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600 dark:text-blue-100">
                Manage role-based access to your ERP modules. Choose which
                actions users can view, create, edit, and delete.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleRefresh}
            disabled={refreshing || loadingRoles}
            className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2.5 self-start rounded-xl bg-blue-700 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-700/20 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-blue-800 active:translate-y-0 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 dark:bg-blue-600 dark:hover:bg-blue-500 lg:self-center"
          >
            <RefreshCw
              size={16}
              className={refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}
            />
            {refreshing ? "Refreshing..." : "Refresh"}
          </button>
        </header>

        {/* Error message */}
        {error && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="mb-5 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-300 bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-800 dark:border-red-400/50 dark:bg-blue-900 dark:text-red-100"
          >
            <AlertCircle size={19} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 leading-6">{error}</div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setError("")}
              aria-label="Dismiss error"
              className="rounded-lg p-1.5 hover:bg-red-100 dark:hover:bg-blue-800"
            >
              <span className="sr-only">Dismiss</span>
              Ã—
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Success message */}
        {success && (
          <div
            role="status"
            className="mb-5 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 p-4 text-sm text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-400/50 dark:bg-blue-900 dark:text-emerald-100"
          >
            <CheckCircle2 size={19} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />

            <span className="flex-1 leading-6">{success}</span>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSuccess("")}
              aria-label="Dismiss success message"
              className="rounded-lg p-1.5 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-blue-800"
            >
              <span className="sr-only">Dismiss</span>
              Ã—
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Statistics */}
        <section className="mb-7 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          <StatCard
            icon={Users}
            label="Available Roles"
            value={loadingRoles ? "â€”" : roles.length}
            description="Roles configured in your ERP"
            color="blue"
          />

          <StatCard
            icon={Layers3}
            label="Permission Entries"
            value={loadingPermissions ? "â€”" : stats.total}
            description="Entries for the selected role"
            color="sky"
          />

          <StatCard
            icon={CheckCircle2}
            label="Enabled Rights"
            value={loadingPermissions ? "â€”" : stats.enabled}
            description="Actions currently granted"
            color="green"
          />

          <StatCard
            icon={LockKeyhole}
            label="Access Coverage"
            value={loadingPermissions ? "â€”" : `${stats.percentage}%`}
            description={`${stats.disabled} rights currently disabled`}
            color="amber"
          />
        </section>

        {/* Role configuration */}
        <section className="mb-6 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-blue-500/50 dark:bg-blue-900">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 p-5 sm:p-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
              <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-800 dark:text-white">
                <Users size={22} />
              </div>

              <div>
                <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-white">
                  Role Configuration
                </h2>

                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-blue-100">
                  Select a role to configure its permissions.
                </p>

            </div>

            <div className="w-full lg:max-w-md">

                  ))}

                <ChevronDown

                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {selectedRoleData && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-5 py-4 sm:px-6 dark:border-blue-500/50 dark:bg-blue-950">
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-blue-100">
                Configuring permissions for
              </span>

              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-blue-300 bg-blue-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-blue-900 dark:border-blue-300/50 dark:bg-blue-800 dark:text-white">
                <Users size={13} />
                {selectedRoleData.role_name}
              </span>

              {selectedRoleData.is_system_role && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-300 bg-amber-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-amber-900 dark:border-amber-300/50 dark:bg-blue-800 dark:text-amber-100">

                </span>
              )}

              <span className="ml-auto inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-blue-100">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                Auto-save enabled
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>

        {/* Permission matrix */}
        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-blue-500/50 dark:bg-blue-900">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 border-b border-slate-200 p-5 sm:p-6 dark:border-blue-500/50 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-white">
                Permission Matrix
              </h2>

              <p className="mt-1 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600 dark:text-blue-100">
                Enable or disable individual actions. Use the All checkbox to
                grant or revoke all four rights for an entry.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
              <div className="relative min-w-0 sm:w-64">
                <Search
                  size={17}
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500 dark:text-blue-200"
                />

                <input
                  type="search"
                  value={search}
                  onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search permissions..."
                  aria-label="Search permissions"
                  className={`${inputClass} pl-10`}
                />

                {search && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSearch("")}
                    aria-label="Clear search"
                    className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-md p-1 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-blue-100 dark:hover:bg-blue-700 dark:hover:text-white"
                  >
                    <span className="sr-only">Clear search</span>
                    Ã—
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="relative min-w-0 sm:w-48">
                <SlidersHorizontal
                  size={16}
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500 dark:text-blue-200"
                />

                <select
                  value={moduleFilter}
                  onChange={(event) => setModuleFilter(event.target.value)}
                  aria-label="Filter by module"
                  className={`${inputClass} appearance-none pl-10 pr-9`}
                >
                  <option value="all">All modules</option>

                  {modules.map((module) => (
                    <option key={module} value={module}>
                      {module}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>

                <ChevronDown
                  size={15}
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500 dark:text-blue-100"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Permission legend */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-5 gap-y-3 border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-5 py-4 sm:px-6 dark:border-blue-500/50 dark:bg-blue-950">
            {PERMISSION_FIELDS.map(({ key, label, icon: Icon }) => (
              <div
                key={key}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-white"
              >
                <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white text-blue-800 dark:border-blue-300/50 dark:bg-blue-800 dark:text-white">
                  <Icon size={15} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                </span>

                <span>{label}</span>
              </div>
            ))}

            <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-blue-100">
              {savingIds.length ? (
                <>
                  <LoaderCircle
                    size={14}
                    className="animate-spin text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-200"
                  />
                  Saving {savingIds.length} change(s)...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <CheckCircle2
                    size={15}
                    className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-300"
                  />
                  Changes save automatically
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Loading, empty, or permission table */}
          {loadingPermissions || loadingRoles ? (
            <div className="flex min-h-72 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 bg-white p-8 dark:bg-blue-900">
              <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-800">
                <LoaderCircle
                  size={28}
                  className="animate-spin text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-100"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="text-center">
                <p className="font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-white">
                  Loading permissions
                </p>

                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-blue-100">
                  Retrieving the latest access settings...
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : !selectedRole ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={Users}
              title="No role selected"
              description="Create a role first or select an available role from the dropdown above."
            />
          ) : filteredPermissions.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={Search}
              title="No permissions found"
              description={
                permissions.length
                  ? "Try another search term or change the module filter."
                  : "No permissions are configured for this role yet."
              }
            >
              {(search || moduleFilter !== "all") && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSearch("");
                    setModuleFilter("all");
                  }}
                  className="mt-5 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-blue-300 bg-blue-100 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-blue-900 transition hover:bg-blue-200 dark:border-blue-300/50 dark:bg-blue-800 dark:text-white dark:hover:bg-blue-700"
                >
                  <span aria-hidden="true">Ã—</span>
                  Clear filters
                </button>
              )}
            </EmptyState>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full min-w-[900px] border-collapse text-left">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-blue-300 bg-blue-100 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-950 dark:border-blue-400/60 dark:bg-blue-800 dark:text-white">
                      <th className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 font-extrabold sm:px-6">
                        Module
                      </th>

                      <th className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 font-extrabold">
                        Permission
                      </th>

                      {PERMISSION_FIELDS.map(({ key, label, icon: Icon }) => (
                        <th
                          key={key}
                          className="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-4 text-center font-extrabold"
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                            <Icon
                              size={15}
                              strokeWidth={2.5}
                              className="text-blue-700 dark:text-white"
                            />
                            <span>{label}</span>
                          </div>
                        </th>
                      ))}

                      <th className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-4 text-center font-extrabold">
                        All
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200 dark:divide-blue-500/50">
                    {filteredPermissions.map((permission) => {
                      const allEnabled = PERMISSION_FIELDS.every(
                        ({ key }) => permission[key]
                      );

                      const anyEnabled = PERMISSION_FIELDS.some(
                        ({ key }) => permission[key]
                      );

                      const permissionKey = String(
                        permission.permission_id
                      );

                      const isSaving = savingIds.includes(permissionKey);

                      return (
                        <tr
                          key={permission.permission_id}
                          className="group bg-white text-slate-900 transition-colors odd:bg-white even:bg-blue-50/70 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900 dark:text-white dark:odd:bg-blue-900 dark:even:bg-blue-800/80 dark:hover:bg-blue-700"
                        >
                          <td className="px-5 py-4 sm:px-6">
                            <span className="inline-flex max-w-48 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 transition-colors dark:border-blue-200/60 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-white dark:group-hover:border-blue-200 dark:group-hover:bg-blue-600 dark:group-hover:text-white">
                              <Layers3
                                size={13}
                                className="shrink-0 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-200 dark:group-hover:text-white"
                              />

                              <span className="truncate">
                                {permission.module || "Other"}
                              </span>
                            </span>
                          </td>

                          <td className="px-5 py-4">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 transition-colors dark:text-white dark:group-hover:text-white">
                                {permission.permission_name}
                              </span>

                              {isSaving && (
                                <LoaderCircle
                                  size={14}
                                  className="shrink-0 animate-spin text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-100"
                                />
                              )}

                            {permission.description && (

                                {permission.description}
                              </p>

                          </td>

                              <div className="flex justify-center">
                                <PermissionCheckbox
                                  checked={permission[key]}
                                  disabled={isSaving}
                                  label={`${label}: ${permission.permission_name}`}
                                  onChange={(value) =>
                                    updatePermission(permission, {
                                      [key]: value,
                                    })
                                  }
                                />
                              </div>
                            </td>
                          ))}

                          <td className="px-4 py-4 text-center text-slate-900 dark:text-white">

                              <PermissionCheckbox
                                checked={allEnabled}

                                }

                            </div>

                            {!allEnabled && anyEnabled && (
                              <span className="mt-1.5 inline-block rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-300 dark:text-blue-950">
                                Partial
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>

              {/* Table summary */}
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-5 py-4 text-xs text-slate-700 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-6 dark:border-blue-500/50 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-blue-100">
                <span>
                  Showing{" "}
                  <strong className="font-extrabold text-slate-950 dark:text-white">
                    {filteredPermissions.length}
                  </strong>{" "}
                  of{" "}
                  <strong className="font-extrabold text-slate-950 dark:text-white">
                    {permissions.length}
                  </strong>{" "}
                  permission entries
                </span>

                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <CheckCircle2
                    size={15}
                    className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300"
                  />

                  <span>
                    <strong className="text-slate-950 dark:text-white">
                      {stats.enabled}
                    </strong>{" "}
                    of{" "}
                    <strong className="text-slate-950 dark:text-white">
                      {stats.total * PERMISSION_FIELDS.length}
                    </strong>{" "}
                    rights enabled
                  </span>
                </span>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </section>

        {/* Security reminder */}
        <aside className="mt-6 flex items-start gap-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-blue-300 bg-blue-50 p-4 sm:p-5 dark:border-blue-400/50 dark:bg-blue-900">
          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-blue-200 bg-white text-blue-800 dark:border-blue-300/50 dark:bg-blue-800 dark:text-white">
            <LockKeyhole size={19} />
          </div>

          <div>

            </h3>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="mt-5 flex flex-col gap-2 pb-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-500 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:text-left dark:text-blue-200">

===== app\dashboard\users\CompanyAccessManager.js =====

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

function getUniqueCompanies(companies) {
    const unique = new Map();

    for (const company of companies) {
        if (company.company_id == null) continue;

        const id = String(company.company_id);

        if (!unique.has(id)) {
            unique.set(id, company);
        }
    }

    return Array.from(unique.values()).sort(
        (a, b) =>
            String(a.company_name || "").localeCompare(
                String(b.company_name || "")
            ) ||
            Number(a.company_id) - Number(b.company_id)
    );
}

export default function CompanyAccessManager() {
    const [companies, setCompanies] = useState([]);
    const [companyId, setCompanyId] = useState("");
    const [roleId, setRoleId] = useState("");
    const [identifier, setIdentifier] = useState("");
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
    const [error, setError] = useState("");

    useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController();

        async function loadCompanies() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(
                    "/api/users/company-access",
                    {
                        cache: "no-store",
                        signal: controller.signal,
                    }
                );

                const data = await response.json();

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(
                        data.message || "Unable to load companies."
                    );
                }

                const available = getUniqueCompanies(
                    Array.isArray(data.companies) ? data.companies : []
                );

                setCompanies(available);

                if (available.length > 0) {
                    const firstCompany = available[0];

                    setCompanyId(
                        String(firstCompany.company_id)
                    );

                    const roles = firstCompany.roles || [];

                    setRoleId(
                        roles.length
                            ? String(roles[0].role_id)
                            : ""
                    );
                }
            } catch (err) {
                if (err.name !== "AbortError") {
                    setError(
                        err.message || "Unable to load companies."
                    );
                }
            } finally {
                if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
                    setLoading(false);
                }
            }
        }

        loadCompanies();

        return () => {
            controller.abort();
        };
    }, []);

    const selectedCompany = companies.find(
        (company) => String(company.company_id) === companyId
    );

    const availableRoles = selectedCompany?.roles || [];

    function handleCompanyChange(value) {
        const nextCompany = companies.find(
            (company) => String(company.company_id) === value
        );

        const nextRoles = nextCompany?.roles || [];

        setCompanyId(value);
        setRoleId(
            nextRoles.length
                ? String(nextRoles[0].role_id)
                : ""
        );
    }

    async function submitAssignment(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        setMessage("");
        setError("");

        if (!identifier.trim() || !companyId || !roleId) {
            setError(
                "Enter a username or email, company, and role."
            );
            return;
        }

        setSaving(true);

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                "/api/users/company-access",
                {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                        Accept: "application/json",
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        identifier: identifier.trim(),
                        companyId: Number(companyId),
                        roleId: Number(roleId),
                    }),
                }
            );

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message || "Assignment failed."
                );
            }

            setMessage(
                data.message || "User assigned successfully."
            );

            setIdentifier("");
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Assignment failed.");
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }



    function locationLabel(company) {
    const parts = [
        company.location,
        company.city,
        company.state_province,
        company.province,
        company.country,
    ]
        .map((value) => String(value ?? "").trim())
        .filter(Boolean);

    const uniqueParts = [...new Set(parts)];

    return (
        uniqueParts.join(", ") ||
        String(company.address ?? "").trim() ||
        "Location not provided"
    );
}


    return (
        <section className="mb-8 space-y-5">
            <div>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">
                    Multi-Company User Access
                </h2>

                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                    Assign an existing login account to another
                    company. Each company can have its own role
                    for that user.
                </p>
            </div>

            {message && (
                <div
                    role="status"
                    className="rounded-lg border border-green-200 bg-green-50 p-3 text-sm text-green-800"
                >
                    {message}
                </div>
            )}

            {error && (
                <div
                    role="alert"
                    className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-800"
                >
                    {error}
                </div>
            )}

            <form
                onSubmit={submitAssignment}
                className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 md:grid-cols-2"
            >
                <div className="md:col-span-2">
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">
                        Assign Existing User
                    </h3>

                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                        Enter the existing username or email.
                        No new password is required.
                    </p>
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label
                        htmlFor="existing-user-identifier"
                        className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium"
                    >
                        Existing Username or Email
                    </label>

                    <input
                        id="existing-user-identifier"
                        value={identifier}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                            setIdentifier(event.target.value)
                        }
                        className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3"
                        placeholder="umer or umer@example.com"
                        autoComplete="off"
                        required
                    />
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label
                        htmlFor="access-company"
                        className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium"
                    >
                        Company
                    </label>

                    <select
                        id="access-company"
                        value={companyId}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                            handleCompanyChange(event.target.value)
                        }
                        className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3"
                        required
                        disabled={!companies.length || loading}
                    >
                        <option value="" disabled>
                            Select a company
                        </option>

                        {companies.map((company, index) => (
                            <option
                                key={company.company_id}
                                value={String(company.company_id)}
                            >
                                {index + 1}. Company ID: {company.company_id} â€”{" "}
                                {company.company_name} â€” {locationLabel(company)}
                            </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>

                    {selectedCompany && (
                        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                            Your role: {selectedCompany.your_role}
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label
                        htmlFor="access-role"
                        className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium"
                    >
                        Role in Selected Company
                    </label>

                    <select
                        id="access-role"
                        value={roleId}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                            setRoleId(event.target.value)
                        }
                        className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3"
                        required
                        disabled={!availableRoles.length || loading}
                    >
                        <option value="" disabled>
                            Select a role
                        </option>

                        {availableRoles.map((role) => (
                            <option
                                key={role.role_id}
                                value={String(role.role_id)}
                            >
                                {role.role_name}
                                {role.company_id == null
                                    ? " (Global role)"
                                    : " (Company role)"}
                            </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-end">
                    <button
                        type="submit"
                        disabled={
                            saving ||
                            loading ||
                            !companyId ||
                            !roleId ||
                            !companies.length
                        }
                        className="w-full rounded-lg bg-slate-900 px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                        {saving
                            ? "Assigning..."
                            : "Assign User to Company"}
                    </button>
                </div>

                {!companies.length && !loading && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-amber-700 md:col-span-2">
                        No company is available to you for user
                        management. You must belong to a company
                        and have Users view permission.
                    </p>
                )}
            </form>
        </section>
    );
}

function firstNonEmpty(...values) {
  for (const value of values) {
    if (
      value !== null &&
      value !== undefined &&
      String(value).trim()
    ) {
      return String(value).trim();
    }
  }

  return "";
}

function normalizeLogoPath(value) {
  const logo = firstNonEmpty(value);

  if (!logo) return "";

  if (/^(https?:\/\/|\/|data:image\/)/i.test(logo)) {
    return logo;
  }

  return `/${logo.replace(/^\.?\//, "")}`;
}

function isUserActive(value) {
  return (
    value === true ||
    value === 1 ||
    value === "1" ||
    String(value).toLowerCase() === "true"
  );
}

function getCompanyFromUser(user) {
  if (user.company_id == null) return null;

  return {
    id: String(user.company_id),
    name:
      firstNonEmpty(user.company_name) ||
      `Company ${user.company_id}`,
    roleId: user.role_id ?? "",
    roleName: firstNonEmpty(user.role_name, user.role),
    logo: normalizeLogoPath(
      user.company_logo_url ||
        user.company_logo ||
        user.logo_url ||
        user.logo_path ||
        ""
    ),
    city: firstNonEmpty(
      user.company_city,
      user.company_location,
      user.company_address
    ),
  };
}

function groupUsersById(rows) {
  const grouped = new Map();

  for (const user of rows) {
    if (user.user_id == null) continue;

    const userId = String(user.user_id);

    if (!grouped.has(userId)) {
      grouped.set(userId, {
        ...user,
        companies: [],
        roleNames: [],
      });
    }

    const item = grouped.get(userId);
    const company = getCompanyFromUser(user);

    if (company) {
      const existing = item.companies.find(
        (entry) => entry.id === company.id
      );

      if (!existing) {
        item.companies.push(company);
      } else {
        if (!existing.logo && company.logo) {
          existing.logo = company.logo;
        }

        if (!existing.city && company.city) {
          existing.city = company.city;
        }

        if (!existing.roleId && company.roleId) {
          existing.roleId = company.roleId;
        }

        if (!existing.roleName && company.roleName) {
          existing.roleName = company.roleName;
        }
      }
    }

    const roleName = firstNonEmpty(user.role_name, user.role);

    if (roleName && !item.roleNames.includes(roleName)) {
      item.roleNames.push(roleName);
    }
  }

  for (const user of grouped.values()) {
    user.companies.sort(
      (a, b) =>
        a.name.localeCompare(b.name) ||
        Number(a.id) - Number(b.id)
    );
  }

  return Array.from(grouped.values()).map((user) => ({
    ...user,
    role_name: user.roleNames.join(", "),
  }));
}

function getInitials(value) {
  return (
    String(value || "U")
      .trim()
      .split(/\s+/)
      .slice(0, 2)
      .map((part) => part.charAt(0))
      .join("")
      .toUpperCase() || "U"
  );
}

function UserAvatar({ user, size = "large" }) {
  const dimensions = {
    small: "h-11 w-11 rounded-xl text-sm",
    medium: "h-14 w-14 rounded-2xl text-lg",
    large: "h-[68px] w-[68px] rounded-2xl text-xl",
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`relative flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center ${dimensions[size]} font-bold shadow-sm`}
      style={{
        background:
          "var(--erp-primary, #2563eb)",
        color: "#ffffff",
      }}
      aria-label={`Avatar for ${user.full_name || user.username || "user"}`}
    >
      {getInitials(user.full_name || user.username)}

      {isUserActive(user.is_active) && (
        <span
          className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 h-4 w-4 rounded-full border-[3px] bg-emerald-500"
          style={{
            borderColor: "var(--erp-surface, #ffffff)",
          }}
          aria-label="Active user"
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function CompanyLogo({ logo, name }) {
  const [failedLogo, setFailedLogo] = useState("");

  if (!logo || failedLogo === logo) {
    return (
      <div
        className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border text-sm font-bold"
        style={{
          background: "var(--erp-page, #f8fafc)",
          borderColor: "var(--erp-border, #e5e7eb)",
          color: "var(--erp-primary, #2563eb)",
        }}
        title={name}
      >
        {getInitials(name)}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <img
      key={logo}
      src={logo}
      alt={`${name} logo`}
      loading="lazy"
      onError={() => setFailedLogo(logo)}
      className="h-12 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-xl border bg-white p-1 object-contain"
      style={{ borderColor: "var(--erp-border, #e5e7eb)" }}
    />
  );
}

function StatusBadge({ active }) {
  return (
    <span
      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold"
      style={{
        background: active
          ? "var(--erp-green-light, #ecfdf5)"
          : "var(--erp-page, #f8fafc)",
        borderColor: active
          ? "var(--erp-green, #a7f3d0)"
          : "var(--erp-border, #e5e7eb)",
        color: active
          ? "var(--erp-green-text, #047857)"
          : "var(--erp-muted, #64748b)",
      }}
    >
      <span
        className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full"
        style={{
          background: active
            ? "var(--erp-green, #10b981)"
            : "var(--erp-muted, #94a3b8)",
        }}
      />
      {active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
    </span>
  );
}
