export default function UsersPage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);
  const [selectedUserId, setSelectedUserId] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("Roles");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [deletingKey, setDeletingKey] = useState("");

  const loadUsers = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/users", {
        method: "GET",
        cache: "no-store",
        signal,
        headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
        throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to load users.");
      }

      if (signal?.aborted) return;

      const groupedUsers = groupUsersById(
        Array.isArray(data.users) ? data.users : []
      );

      setUsers(groupedUsers);

      setSelectedUserId((currentId) => {
        if (
          currentId &&
          groupedUsers.some(
            (user) => String(user.user_id) === currentId
          )
        ) {
          return currentId;
        }

        return String(groupedUsers[0]?.user_id ?? "");
      });

      setError("");
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.name !== "AbortError" && !signal?.aborted) {
        setError(err.message || "Failed to load users.");
      }
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
  const controller = new AbortController();

  // Defer the initial load so it does not run synchronously
  // inside the effect.
  Promise.resolve().then(() => {
    if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
      void loadUsers(controller.signal);
    }
  });

  return () => {
    controller.abort();
  };
}, [loadUsers]);

  const searchTerm = search.trim().toLowerCase();

  const filteredUsers = useMemo(
    () =>
      users.filter((user) => {
        if (!searchTerm) return true;

        const values = [
          user.user_id,
          user.full_name,
          user.username,
          user.email,
          user.role_name,
          isUserActive(user.is_active) ? "active" : "inactive",
          ...(user.companies || []).flatMap((company) => [
            company.id,
            company.name,
            company.city,
            company.roleName,
          ]),
        ];

        return values.some((value) =>
          String(value ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
        );
      }),
    [users, searchTerm]
  );

  const selectedUser =
    filteredUsers.find(
      (user) => String(user.user_id) === selectedUserId
    ) ||
    filteredUsers[0] ||
    null;

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const active = users.filter((user) =>
      isUserActive(user.is_active)
    ).length;

    const memberships = users.reduce(
      (total, user) => total + user.companies.length,
      0
    );

    const roles = new Set(
      users.flatMap((user) =>
        user.companies
          .map((company) => company.roleName)
          .filter(Boolean)
      )
    );

    return {
      total: users.length,
      active,
      inactive: users.length - active,
      memberships,
      roles: roles.size,
    };
  }, [users]);

  const refreshUsers = async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    await loadUsers();
  };

  const editCompanyAccess = useCallback(
    (user, company) => {
      router.push(
        `/dashboard/users/add?id=${encodeURIComponent(user.user_id)}&companyId=${encodeURIComponent(company.id)}`
      );
    },
    [router]
  );

  const deleteUser = useCallback(
    async (user, company) => {
      const key = `${user.user_id}-${company.id}`;

      if (deletingKey) return;

      const confirmed = window.confirm(
        `Remove "${user.username}" from "${company.name}"?\n\n` +
          "This removes only this company's membership. The login account and other company memberships remain."
      );

      if (!confirmed) return;

      setDeletingKey(key);
      setError("");
      setMessage("");

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `/api/users/${encodeURIComponent(user.user_id)}?companyId=${encodeURIComponent(company.id)}`,
          {
            method: "DELETE",
            cache: "no-store",
            headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
          }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || data.success === false) {
          throw new Error(
            data.message || "Failed to remove user from company."
          );
        }

        setMessage(
          data.message || `User access removed from ${company.name}.`
        );

        await loadUsers();
      } catch (err) {
        setError(err.message || "Failed to remove user from company.");
      } finally {
        setDeletingKey("");
      }
    },
    [deletingKey, loadUsers]
  );

  const tabDescription = {
    Roles: "Review roles assigned to this user across companies.",
    Details: "View account information and company memberships.",
    "Assign Subsidiary":
      "Review the companies and subsidiaries this user can access.",
    "Assign Locations":
      "Review the locations associated with each company.",
  };

  function renderRoles() {
    if (!selectedUser.companies.length) {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          title="No company roles found"
          description="This user has no company memberships or role assignments to display."
          icon={ShieldCheck}
        />
      );
    }

    return (
      <div
        className="overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl border"
        style={{ borderColor: "var(--erp-border, #e5e7eb)" }}
      >
        <table className="w-full min-w-[650px] text-left text-sm">
          <thead
            style={{
              background: "var(--erp-page, #f8fafc)",
              color: "var(--erp-muted, #64748b)",
            }}
          >
            <tr>
              <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold">Company</th>
              <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold">Assigned role</th>
              <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold">Role ID</th>
              <th className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold">Action</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>

          <tbody>
            {selectedUser.companies.map((company) => (
              <tr
                key={company.id}
                className="border-t transition"
                style={{ borderColor: "var(--erp-border, #e5e7eb)" }}
              >
                <td className="px-5 py-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <CompanyLogo
                      logo={company.logo}
                      name={company.name}
                    />

                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="font-semibold" style={styles.text}>
                        {company.name}
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs" style={styles.muted}>
                        {company.city || "Location not provided"}
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs" style={styles.muted}>
                        ID: {company.id}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>

                <td className="px-5 py-4">
                  <span
                    className="inline-flex rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold"
                    style={styles.primarySoft}
                  >
                    {company.roleName || "No role"}
                  </span>
                </td>

                <td className="px-5 py-4" style={styles.muted}>
                  {company.roleId || "-"}
                </td>

                <td className="px-5 py-4">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      editCompanyAccess(selectedUser, company)
                    }
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition hover:opacity-80"
                    style={{
                      borderColor: "var(--erp-border, #e5e7eb)",
                      color: "var(--erp-text, #111827)",
                    }}
                  >
                    <Pencil size={14} />
                    Edit access
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    );
  }

  function renderDetails() {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-7">
        <div>
          <h4 className="font-semibold" style={styles.text}>
            Personal information
          </h4>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm" style={styles.muted}>
            Account details and current status.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          <InfoField label="User ID" value={selectedUser.user_id} />
          <InfoField
            label="Full name"
            value={selectedUser.full_name}
            icon={UserRound}
          />
          <InfoField
            label="Username"
            value={selectedUser.username}
            icon={Users}
          />
          <InfoField
            label="Email address"
            value={selectedUser.email}
            icon={Mail}
          />
          <InfoField
            label="Account status"
            value={
              isUserActive(selectedUser.is_active) ? "Active" : "Inactive"
            }
            icon={CircleCheck}
          />
          <InfoField
            label="Company memberships"
            value={selectedUser.companies.length}
            icon={Building2}
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <h4 className="font-semibold" style={styles.text}>
            Company access
          </h4>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm" style={styles.muted}>
            Review each company, its location, and its assigned role.
          </p>
        </div>

        {selectedUser.companies.length ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
            {selectedUser.companies.map((company) => (
              <CompanyCard
                key={company.id}
                company={company}
                user={selectedUser}
                onEdit={editCompanyAccess}
                onRemove={deleteUser}
                deletingKey={deletingKey}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <EmptyState
            title="No company memberships"
            description="No company access is currently assigned to this user."
            icon={Building2}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  function renderCompanyCards(title, description) {
    if (!selectedUser.companies.length) {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          title={`No ${title.toLowerCase()} available`}
          description="This user has no company memberships to display."
          icon={Building2}
        />
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className="space-y-5">
        <div>
          <h4 className="font-semibold" style={styles.text}>
            {title}
          </h4>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm" style={styles.muted}>
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
          {selectedUser.companies.map((company) => (
            <CompanyCard
              key={company.id}
              company={company}
              user={selectedUser}
              onEdit={editCompanyAccess}
              onRemove={deleteUser}
              deletingKey={deletingKey}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  function renderTabContent() {
    switch (activeTab) {
      case "Roles":
        return renderRoles();
      case "Details":
        return renderDetails();
      case "Assign Subsidiary":
        return renderCompanyCards(
          "Company / Subsidiary",
          "Review company names, logos, locations, and subsidiary access."
        );
      case "Assign Locations":
        return renderCompanyCards(
          "Company locations",
          "Review the location associated with each company this user can access."
        );
      default:
        return null;
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1700px] space-y-6 pb-10">
      <section
        className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border p-6 shadow-sm sm:p-8"
        style={styles.surface}
      >
        <div
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-12 -top-24 h-72 w-72 rounded-full opacity-10 blur-3xl"
          style={{ background: "var(--erp-primary, #2563eb)" }}
        />

        <div className="relative flex flex-col gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
          <div>
            <div
              className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm"
              style={styles.muted}
            >
              <Link href="/dashboard" className="transition hover:opacity-70">
                Dashboard
              </Link>
              <ChevronRight size={15} />
              <span style={styles.text}>Administration</span>
              <ChevronRight size={15} />
              <span style={styles.primaryText}>Users</span>
            </div>

            <div
              className="mb-3 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold"
              style={styles.primarySoft}
            >

          className="min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border shadow-sm"
          style={styles.surface}
        >
          {loading ? (
            <div className="space-y-5 p-8">
              <div
                className="h-6 w-1/3 animate-pulse rounded"
                style={{ background: "var(--erp-page, #f8fafc)" }}
              />
              <div
                className="h-4 w-2/3 animate-pulse rounded"
                style={{ background: "var(--erp-page, #f8fafc)" }}

              <div
                className="h-36 animate-pulse rounded-2xl"
                style={{ background: "var(--erp-page, #f8fafc)" }}
              />

          ) : !selectedUser ? (
            <div className="p-6 sm:p-10">
              <EmptyState
                title="Select a user"
                description="Choose a user from the team list to view their account, roles, and company access."
                icon={UserRound}

                  <Link

                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold"

            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="p-5 sm:p-7">
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-4">

===== app\dashboard\users\add\page.js =====

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";

const emptyForm = {
    fullName: "",
    username: "",
    email: "",
    password: "",
    location: "",
    roleId: "",
    isActive: true,
};

const inputClass =
    "w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100";

export default function AddUserPage() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const searchParams = useSearchParams();

    const userId = searchParams.get("id");
    const companyId = searchParams.get("companyId");

    const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm);
    const [roles, setRoles] = useState([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");

    const loadFormData = useCallback(
        async (signal) => {
            try {
                setLoading(true);
                setError("");

                if (userId && !companyId) {
                    throw new Error(
                        "Company ID is missing. Return to Users and click Edit for the required company."
                    );
                }

                const requests = [
                    fetch("/api/roles", {
                        cache: "no-store",
                        signal,
                    }),
                ];

                if (userId) {
                    requests.push(
                        fetch("/api/users", {
                            cache: "no-store",
                            signal,
                        })
                    );
                }

                const responses = await Promise.all(requests);

                const results = await Promise.all(
                    responses.map(async (response) => {
                        try {
                            return await response.json();
                        } catch {
                            return {};
                        }
                    })
                );

                if (signal.aborted) return;

                if (!responses[0].ok) {
                    throw new Error(
                        results[0].message || "Failed to load roles."
                    );
                }

                setRoles(
                    Array.isArray(results[0].roles)
                        ? results[0].roles
                        : []
                );

                if (userId) {
                    if (!responses[1].ok) {
                        throw new Error(
                            results[1].message ||
                                "Failed to load the user list."
                        );
                    }

                    const users = Array.isArray(results[1].users)
                        ? results[1].users
                        : [];

                    // Find the exact user-company membership.
                    const user = users.find(
                        (item) =>
                            String(item.user_id) === String(userId) &&
                            String(item.company_id) === String(companyId)
                    );

                    if (!user) {
                        throw new Error(
                            `User ${userId} was not found in company ${companyId}, or you do not have permission to view that membership.`
                        );
                    }

                    setForm({
                        fullName: user.full_name || "",
                        username: user.username || "",
                        email: user.email || "",
                        password: "",
                        location:
                            user.user_location ??
                            user.location ??
                            "",
                        roleId:
                            user.role_id != null
                                ? String(user.role_id)
                                : "",
                        isActive: Boolean(user.is_active),
                    });
                } else {
                    setForm(emptyForm);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                if (
                    err.name !== "AbortError" &&
                    !signal.aborted
                ) {
                    setError(
                        err.message || "Unable to load the user form."
                    );
                }
            } finally {
                if (!signal.aborted) {
                    setLoading(false);
                }
            }
        },
        [userId, companyId]
    );

    useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController();

        Promise.resolve().then(() => {
            if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
                loadFormData(controller.signal);
            }
        });

        return () => controller.abort();
    }, [loadFormData]);

    function updateField(event) {
        const { name, value, type, checked } = event.target;

        setForm((current) => ({
            ...current,
            [name]: type === "checkbox" ? checked : value,
        }));
    }

    async function submitForm(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setError("");

        if (userId && !companyId) {
            setError("Company ID is missing. Please return to Users.");
            return;
        }

        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(Number(form.roleId)) ||
            Number(form.roleId) <= 0) {
            setError("Please select a valid role.");
            return;
        }

        setSaving(true);

        try {
            const isEditing = Boolean(userId);

            const url = isEditing
                ? `/api/users/${encodeURIComponent(userId)}?companyId=${encodeURIComponent(companyId)}`
                : "/api/users";

            const payload = {
                ...form,
                location: form.location.trim(),
                roleId: Number(form.roleId),
            };

            // Tell the API which company's membership is being edited.
            if (isEditing) {
                payload.companyId = Number(companyId);
            }

            const response = await fetch(url, {
                method: isEditing ? "PUT" : "POST",
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload),
            });

            let data = {};

            try {
                data = await response.json();
            } catch {
                // Handle non-JSON server responses below.
            }

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message ||
                        (isEditing
                            ? "Failed to update user."
                            : "Failed to create user.")
                );
            }

            router.push("/dashboard/users");
            router.refresh();
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "User operation failed.");
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    return (
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-6">
            <div>
                <Link
                    href="/dashboard/users"
                    className="text-sm font-medium text-blue-700 hover:underline"
                >
                    â† Back to Users
                </Link>

                <h1 className="mt-3 text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900">
                    {userId ? "Edit User" : "Add User"}
                </h1>

                <p className="mt-1 text-slate-500">
                    {userId
                        ? `Update the user account for company ${companyId || ""}.`
                        : "Create a new user account."}
                </p>
            </div>

            {error && (
                <div
                    role="alert"
                    className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800"
                >
                    {error}
                </div>
            )}

            {loading ? (
                <div className="rounded-xl border bg-white p-6 text-slate-500">
                    Loading user form...
                </div>
            ) : (
                <form
                    onSubmit={submitForm}
                    className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 md:grid-cols-2"
                >
                    <div className="md:col-span-2">
                        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">
                            User Information
                        </h2>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label
                            htmlFor="fullName"
                            className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium"
                        >
                            Full Name
                        </label>
                        <input
                            id="fullName"
                            name="fullName"
                            value={form.fullName}
                            onChange={updateField}
                            className={inputClass}
                            maxLength={150}
                            required
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label
                            htmlFor="username"
                            className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium"
                        >
                            Username
                        </label>
                        <input
                            id="username"
                            name="username"
                            value={form.username}
                            onChange={updateField}
                            className={inputClass}
                            minLength={3}
                            maxLength={100}
                            required
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label
                            htmlFor="email"
                            className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium"
                        >
                            Email
                        </label>
                        <input
                            id="email"
                            type="email"
                            name="email"
                            value={form.email}
                            onChange={updateField}
                            className={inputClass}
                            maxLength={150}
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label
                            htmlFor="location"
                            className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium"
                        >
                            Location
                        </label>
                        <input
                            id="location"
                            name="location"
                            type="text"
                            value={form.location}
                            onChange={updateField}
                            className={inputClass}
                            maxLength={255}
                            placeholder="City, State/Province, Country"
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label
                            htmlFor="password"
                            className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium"
                        >
                            {userId
                                ? "New Password (optional)"
                                : "Password"}
                        </label>
                        <input
                            id="password"
                            type="password"
                            name="password"
                            value={form.password}
                            onChange={updateField}
                            className={inputClass}
                            placeholder={
                                userId
                                    ? "Leave blank to keep current password"
                                    : "At least 8 characters"
                            }
                            minLength={8}
                            autoComplete="new-password"
                            required={!userId}
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label
                            htmlFor="roleId"
                            className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium"
                        >
                            Role in Selected Company
                        </label>
                        <select
                            id="roleId"
                            name="roleId"
                            value={form.roleId}
                            onChange={updateField}
                            className={inputClass}
                            required
                        >
                            <option value="">Select Role</option>

                            {roles.map((role) => (
                                <option
                                    key={role.role_id}
                                    value={String(role.role_id)}
                                >
                                    {role.role_name}
                                </option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    <label className="flex items-center gap-3 self-center">
                        <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            name="isActive"
                            checked={form.isActive}
                            onChange={updateField}
                            className="h-5 w-5"
                        />
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                            Active User
                        </span>
                    </label>

                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 md:col-span-2">
                        <button
                            type="submit"
                            disabled={saving}
                            className="rounded-lg bg-slate-900 px-6 py-3 font-medium text-white hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-50"
                        >
                            {saving
                                ? "Saving..."
                                : userId
                                  ? "Update User"
                                  : "Create User"}
                        </button>

                        <Link
                            href="/dashboard/users"
                            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-6 py-3 text-center hover:bg-slate-50"
                        >
                            Cancel
                        </Link>
                    </div>
                </form>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}
