const PERMISSION_KEY_ALIASES = {
  "/dashboard/reports/stock": ["stock_report", "stock"],
  "/dashboard/reports/sales": ["sales_report", "sales_dashboard"],
  "/dashboard/reports/purchases": [
    "purchase_report",
    "purchase_dashboard",
  ],
  "/dashboard/reports/payments": ["payment_report", "payments_report"],
  "/dashboard/reports/profit-loss": ["profit_loss", "profit_and_loss"],
  "/dashboard/accounting/ledger": ["financial_ledger", "ledger"],
};

const moduleIcons = {
  administration: Users,
  inventory: Package,
  sales: ShoppingCart,
  "purchase-procurement": Truck,
  accounting: Landmark,
  reports: BarChart3,
};

const sectionIcons = {
  "user-management": UserCog,
  settings: Settings,
  "item-management": Package,
  "warehouse-stock": Warehouse,
  "customer-management": UserRound,
  "sales-processing": Receipt,
  "sales-reports": TrendingUp,
  vendors: Truck,
  procurement: FileText,
  purchase: ShoppingCart,
  payable: CreditCard,
  import: Package,
  "purchase-reports": BarChart3,
  "payable-reports": BookOpenCheck,
  accounts: BookOpen,
  "financial-reports": Scale,
  "business-reports": BarChart3,
};

function isItemActive(item, pathname) {
  return (
    pathname === item.href ||
    pathname.startsWith(`${item.href}/`)
  );
}

function isSectionActive(section, pathname) {
  return section.items.some((item) =>
    isItemActive(item, pathname)
  );
}

function isModuleActive(module, pathname) {
  return module.sections.some((section) =>
    isSectionActive(section, pathname)
  );
}

function normalizePermissionKey(value) {
  return String(value || "")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
}

function getPermissionKeysForItem(item) {
  const explicitKeys = ROUTE_PERMISSION_KEYS[item.href];

  if (explicitKeys) {
    return [
      explicitKeys,
      ...(PERMISSION_KEY_ALIASES[item.href] || []),
    ].map(normalizePermissionKey);
  }

  /*
   * Fallback for new routes. Explicit mappings above are preferred
   * because your database keys may not match URL names.
   */
  const routeName = item.href
    .replace(/^\/dashboard\/?/, "")
    .replace(/\/+/g, "_")
    .replace(/-/g, "_")
    .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "");

  return [normalizePermissionKey(routeName)];
}

function canViewItem(item, permissions) {
  const keys = getPermissionKeysForItem(item);

  return keys.some((key) => permissions.get(key) === true);
}

function filterModulesByPermission(modules, permissions) {
  return modules
    .map((module) => {
      const sections = module.sections
        .map((section) => ({
          ...section,
          items: section.items.filter((item) =>
            canViewItem(item, permissions)
          ),
        }))
        .filter((section) => section.items.length > 0);

      return {
        ...module,
        sections,
      };
    })
    .filter((module) => module.sections.length > 0);
}

function ModeSelector({
  mode,
  onModeChange,
  horizontal = false,
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={`flex w-fit shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 p-0.5 ${
        horizontal ? "" : "mx-3 mb-1"
      }`}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onModeChange("vertical")}
        aria-label="Vertical navigation"
        title="Vertical navigation"
        aria-pressed={mode === "vertical"}
        className={`flex items-center justify-center rounded-md p-1.5 transition-colors ${
          mode === "vertical"
            ? "bg-blue-600 text-white"
            : "text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white"
        }`}
      >
        <PanelLeft size={14} />
      </button>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onModeChange("horizontal")}
        aria-label="Horizontal navigation"
        title="Horizontal navigation"
        aria-pressed={mode === "horizontal"}
        className={`flex items-center justify-center rounded-md p-1.5 transition-colors ${
          mode === "horizontal"
            ? "bg-blue-600 text-white"
            : "text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white"
        }`}
      >
        <PanelsTopLeft size={14} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Sidebar({
  mode = "vertical",
  onModeChange,
}) {
  const [savedMode, setSavedMode] = useState(null);

  return (
    <SidebarContent
      mode={mode}
      onModeChange={onModeChange}
      savedMode={savedMode}
      setSavedMode={setSavedMode}
    />
  );
}

function SidebarContent({
  mode,
  onModeChange,
  savedMode,
  setSavedMode,
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const [permissions, setPermissions] = useState(new Map());
  const [permissionsLoading, setPermissionsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [permissionsError, setPermissionsError] = useState(false);

  const [openModule, setOpenModule] = useState(undefined);
  const [openSection, setOpenSection] = useState(null);
  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);
  const [compactSidebar, setCompactSidebar] = useState(false);

  const hoverCloseTimer = useRef(null);

  const layoutMode = savedMode ?? mode;
  const isHorizontal = layoutMode === "horizontal";

  /*
   * Fetch the signed-in user's effective permissions.
   * Do not trust role IDs or permissions supplied by localStorage.
   */
  
  const loadPermissions = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(PERMISSIONS_URL, {
        method: "GET",
        credentials: "same-origin",
        cache: "no-store",
        signal,
        headers: {
          Accept: "application/json",
        },
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          `Permission request failed (${response.status})`
        );
      }

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!Array.isArray(data.permissions)) {
        throw new Error(
          "Invalid permissions response: expected permissions array"
        );
      }

      const nextPermissions = new Map();

      for (const permission of data.permissions) {
        const key = normalizePermissionKey(
          permission.permission_key
        );

        if (!key) continue;

        nextPermissions.set(key, permission.can_view === true);
      }

      if (signal?.aborted) return;

      setPermissions(nextPermissions);
      setPermissionsError(false);
      setPermissionsLoading(false);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name === "AbortError" || signal?.aborted) {
        return;
      }

      console.error("Could not load sidebar permissions:", error);

      setPermissions(new Map());
      setPermissionsError(true);
      setPermissionsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    const startRequest = () => {
      void loadPermissions(controller.signal);
    };

    startRequest();

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [loadPermissions]);
  
  const visibleModules = filterModulesByPermission(
    erpModules,
    permissions
  );

  const currentModule = visibleModules.find((module) =>
    isModuleActive(module, pathname)
  );

  const effectiveOpenModule =
    openModule === undefined
      ? currentModule?.id ?? null
      : openModule;

  useEffect(() => {
    function updateSidebarDensity() {
      setCompactSidebar(
        window.innerHeight < 850 || erpModules.length > 5
      );
    }

    updateSidebarDensity();

    window.addEventListener("resize", updateSidebarDensity);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(
        "resize",
        updateSidebarDensity
      );
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const storedMode =
        window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);

      if (
        storedMode === "vertical" ||
        storedMode === "horizontal"
      ) {
        setSavedMode(storedMode);
        onModeChange?.(storedMode);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "Could not read sidebar layout:",
        error
      );
    }
  }, [onModeChange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.cookie =
      `${STORAGE_KEY}=${layoutMode}; path=/; max-age=31536000; samesite=lax`;
  }, [layoutMode]);

  const cancelHoverClose = useCallback(() => {
    if (hoverCloseTimer.current !== null) {
      clearTimeout(hoverCloseTimer.current);
      hoverCloseTimer.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  const scheduleHoverClose = useCallback(() => {
    cancelHoverClose();

    hoverCloseTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      hoverCloseTimer.current = null;
    }, 180);
  }, [cancelHoverClose]);

  const closeHoverCard = useCallback(() => {
    cancelHoverClose();
  }, [cancelHoverClose]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (hoverCloseTimer.current !== null) {
        clearTimeout(hoverCloseTimer.current);
        hoverCloseTimer.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleOutsideClick(event) {
      const target = event.target;

      if (
        target instanceof Element &&
        target.closest("[data-sidebar-root]")
      ) {
        return;
      }

      setOpenModule(null);
      setOpenSection(null);
    }

    function handleEscape(event) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        closeHoverCard();
        setOpenModule(null);
        setOpenSection(null);
        setMobileOpen(false);
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener(
      "pointerdown",
      handleOutsideClick
    );

    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEscape);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener(
        "pointerdown",
        handleOutsideClick
      );

      document.removeEventListener(
        "keydown",
        handleEscape
      );
    };
  }, [closeHoverCard]);

  function changeLayoutMode(nextMode) {
    if (
      nextMode !== "horizontal" &&
      nextMode !== "vertical"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    cancelHoverClose();
    setSavedMode(nextMode);

    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(
        STORAGE_KEY,
        nextMode
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "Could not save sidebar layout:",
        error
      );
    }

    setMobileOpen(false);
    setOpenModule(undefined);
    setOpenSection(null);

    onModeChange?.(nextMode);
  }

  function toggleModule(moduleId) {
    cancelHoverClose();

    const currentlyOpen =
      openModule === undefined
        ? currentModule?.id ?? null
        : openModule;

    setOpenSection(null);

    setOpenModule(
      currentlyOpen === moduleId ? null : moduleId
    );
  }

  function toggleSection(sectionKey) {
    setOpenSection((current) =>
      current === sectionKey ? null : sectionKey
    );
  }

  function closeDropdowns() {
    cancelHoverClose();
    setOpenModule(null);
    setOpenSection(null);
  }

  function handleNavigation() {
    closeDropdowns();
    setMobileOpen(false);
  }

  async function handleLogout() {
    let selectedCompany = null;

    try {
      const savedCompany = localStorage.getItem(
        "erp-selected-company"
      );

      if (savedCompany) {
        selectedCompany = JSON.parse(savedCompany);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "Could not read selected company:",
        error
      );
    }

    try {
      await fetch("/api/auth/logout", {
        method: "POST",
        credentials: "same-origin",
        cache: "no-store",
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Logout request failed:", error);
    } finally {
      if (selectedCompany?.companyId) {
        const params = new URLSearchParams({
          companyId: String(selectedCompany.companyId),
          companyName:
            selectedCompany.companyName || "Company Login",
        });

        window.location.replace(
          `/login?${params.toString()}`
        );
      } else {
        window.location.replace("/login");
      }
    }
  }

  function renderDashboardLink(compact = false) {
    const active = pathname === "/dashboard";

    return (
      <Link
        href="/dashboard"
        onClick={handleNavigation}
        className={`flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2 ${
          compactSidebar ? "py-1.5" : "py-2"
        } text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
          active
            ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm"
            : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white"
        } ${compact ? "whitespace-nowrap" : ""}`}
      >
        <LayoutDashboard
          size={16}
          className="shrink-0"
        />
        <span>Dashboard</span>
      </Link>
    );
  }

  function renderModeButton() {
    return (
      <ModeSelector
        mode={layoutMode}
        onModeChange={changeLayoutMode}
        horizontal={isHorizontal}
      />
    );
  }

  function renderChildLinks(section) {
    return (
      <div
        className={`pb-1 pl-5 ${
          compactSidebar ? "space-y-0" : "space-y-0.5"
        }`}
      >
        {section.items.map((item) => {
          const active = isItemActive(item, pathname);

          return (
            <Link
              key={`${item.name}:${item.href}`}
              href={item.href}
              onClick={handleNavigation}
              className={`block rounded-md px-2 ${
                compactSidebar ? "py-1" : "py-1.5"
              } text-xs transition-colors ${
                active
                  ? "bg-blue-600/20 font-medium text-blue-300"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              {item.name}
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  }

  function renderHoverCard(module) {
    return (
      <div
        className="max-h-[75dvh] w-80 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 p-3 text-white shadow-2xl"
        onMouseEnter={cancelHoverClose}
        onMouseLeave={scheduleHoverClose}
      >
        <p className="mb-2 px-2 text-sm font-semibold text-blue-300">
          {module.name}
        </p>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          {module.sections.map((section) => {
            const SectionIcon =
              sectionIcons[section.id] || FileText;

            return (
              <div
                key={section.id}
                className="rounded-lg border border-slate-800 p-2"
              >
                <p className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium text-slate-200">
                  <SectionIcon size={15} />
                  {section.name}
                </p>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  {section.items.map((item) => (
                    <Link
                      key={`${item.name}:${item.href}`}
                      href={item.href}
                      onClick={handleNavigation}
                      className={`block rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors ${
                        isItemActive(item, pathname)
                          ? "bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-300"
                          : "text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {item.name}
                    </Link>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  function renderSection(section, moduleId) {
    const SectionIcon =
      sectionIcons[section.id] || FileText;

    const sectionKey = `${moduleId}:${section.id}`;
    const sectionActive = isSectionActive(
      section,
      pathname
    );
    const sectionOpen = openSection === sectionKey;

    return (
      <div key={section.id} className="min-w-0">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => toggleSection(sectionKey)}
          aria-expanded={Boolean(sectionOpen)}
          className={`flex w-full min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-1.5 ${
            compactSidebar ? "py-1" : "py-1.5"
          } text-left text-xs transition-colors ${
            sectionActive || sectionOpen
              ? "bg-slate-800 text-blue-300"
              : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white"
          }`}
        >
          {sectionOpen ? (
            <ChevronDown
              size={12}
              className="shrink-0"
            />
          ) : (
            <ChevronRight
              size={12}
              className="shrink-0"
            />
          )}

          <SectionIcon
            size={14}
            className="shrink-0"
          />

          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 whitespace-normal break-words">
            {section.name}
          </span>
        </button>

        {sectionOpen && renderChildLinks(section)}
      </div>
    );
  }

  function renderPermissionStatus() {
    if (permissionsLoading) {
      return (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-3 text-xs text-slate-400">
          <RefreshCw
            size={14}
            className="animate-spin"
          />
          Loading permissions...
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (permissionsError) {
      return (
        <div className="mx-1 my-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-700/50 bg-amber-950/30 p-3">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 text-amber-300">
            <ShieldAlert
              size={16}
              className="mt-0.5 shrink-0"
            />

            <div className="min-w-0">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold">
                Permissions unavailable
              </p>

              <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-4 text-amber-200/80">
                Protected navigation is hidden until permissions
                can be loaded.
              </p>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => loadPermissions()}
                className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-amber-900/60 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-amber-100 hover:bg-amber-900"
              >
                <RefreshCw size={12} />
                Retry
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return null;
  }

  function renderVerticalModules() {
    return (
      <nav
        data-erp-vertical-nav
        aria-label="ERP navigation"
        className="relative z-0 min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto overscroll-y-contain px-2 py-1"
      >
        <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-1">
          <div className="w-full">
            {renderDashboardLink()}
          </div>

          {renderPermissionStatus()}

          <p className="px-2 pb-1 pt-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500">
            Modules
          </p>

          {!permissionsLoading &&
            !permissionsError &&
            visibleModules.length === 0 && (
              <p className="px-2 py-3 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
                No modules are available for your account.
              </p>
            )}

          {visibleModules.map((module) => {
            const ModuleIcon =
              moduleIcons[module.id] || Package;

            const moduleHref =
              `/dashboard/modules/${module.id}`;

            const moduleActive = isModuleActive(
              module,
              pathname
            );

            const isOpen =
              effectiveOpenModule === module.id;

            return (
              <div
                key={module.id}
                data-sidebar-root
                className="w-full min-w-0"
              >
                <div
                  className={`flex w-full min-w-0 items-center rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                    moduleActive || isOpen
                      ? "bg-slate-800 text-white"
                      : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white"
                  }`}
                >
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggleModule(module.id)}
                    aria-label={`${isOpen ? "Collapse" : "Expand"} ${module.name}`}
                    aria-expanded={Boolean(isOpen)}
                    className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-700"
                  >
                    {isOpen ? (
                      <ChevronDown size={14} />
                    ) : (
                      <ChevronRight size={14} />
                    )}
                  </button>

                  <Link
                    href={moduleHref}
                    onClick={handleNavigation}
                    className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2 py-2 pl-1 pr-2 text-xs font-medium"
                  >
                    <ModuleIcon
                      size={16}
                      className="shrink-0"
                    />

                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 whitespace-normal break-words">
                      {module.name}
                    </span>
                  </Link>
                </div>

                {isOpen && (
                  <div className="ml-3 mt-1 min-w-0 pl-1.5">
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                      {module.sections.map((section) =>
                        renderSection(section, module.id)
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </nav>
    );
  }

  function renderHorizontalModules() {
    return (
      <nav
        aria-label="ERP navigation"
        className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-stretch gap-1"
      >
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-stretch">
          <Link
            href="/dashboard"
            onClick={handleNavigation}
            title="Dashboard"
            className={`flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-1 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
              pathname === "/dashboard"
                ? "bg-blue-600 text-white"
                : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <LayoutDashboard
              size={14}
              className="shrink-0"
            />
            <span className="truncate">Dashboard</span>
          </Link>
        </div>

        {visibleModules.map((module) => {
          const ModuleIcon =
            moduleIcons[module.id] || Package;

          const moduleHref =
            `/dashboard/modules/${module.id}`;

          const moduleActive = isModuleActive(
            module,
            pathname
          );

          const isOpen =
            effectiveOpenModule === module.id;

          return (
            <div
              key={module.id}
              data-sidebar-root
              className="relative flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col"
            >
              <div
                className={`flex min-w-0 items-center rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                  moduleActive || isOpen
                    ? "bg-slate-800 text-white"
                    : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => toggleModule(module.id)}
                  aria-label={`${isOpen ? "Collapse" : "Expand"} ${module.name}`}
                  aria-expanded={Boolean(isOpen)}
                  title={`${module.name} menu`}
                  className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md p-1 hover:bg-slate-700"
                >
                  {isOpen ? (
                    <ChevronDown size={12} />
                  ) : (
                    <ChevronRight size={12} />
                  )}
                </button>

                <Link
                  href={moduleHref}
                  onClick={handleNavigation}
                  title={module.name}
                  className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1 px-1 py-2 text-xs font-medium"
                >
                  <ModuleIcon
                    size={14}
                    className="shrink-0"
                  />
                  <span className="truncate">
                    {module.name}
                  </span>
                </Link>
              </div>

              {isOpen && (
                <div className="absolute left-0 top-full z-[100] mt-1 max-h-[70dvh] w-64 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 p-2 shadow-2xl">
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                    {module.sections.map((section) =>
                      renderSection(section, module.id)
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </nav>
    );
  }

  if (isHorizontal) {
    return (
      <header
        data-sidebar-root
        data-erp-sidebar
        className="relative z-[80] w-full border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 text-white shadow-lg"
      >
        <div className="hidden min-h-12 items-center gap-1.5 px-2 lg:flex">
          <Link
            href="/dashboard"
            onClick={handleNavigation}
            className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5"
            title="ERP System"
          >
            <div className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-blue-600 text-[10px] font-bold">
              ERP
            </div>

            <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs font-bold">
              ERP System
            </span>
          </Link>

          <div className="h-6 w-px shrink-0 bg-slate-700" />

          {renderPermissionStatus()}
          {renderHorizontalModules()}

          <div className="h-6 w-px shrink-0 bg-slate-700" />

          {renderModeButton()}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleLogout}
            title="Logout"
            className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-1.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:bg-red-600 hover:text-white"
          >
            <LogOut size={14} />
            <span>Logout</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex min-h-12 items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 lg:hidden">
          <Link
            href="/dashboard"
            onClick={handleNavigation}
            className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2"
          >
            <div className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-blue-600 text-[10px] font-bold">
              ERP
            </div>

            <span className="truncate text-sm font-bold">
              ERP System
            </span>
          </Link>

          <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
            {renderModeButton()}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                setMobileOpen((current) => !current)
              }
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-700 p-1.5 text-slate-200 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-800"
              aria-label={
                mobileOpen
                  ? "Close navigation"
                  : "Open navigation"
              }
              aria-expanded={mobileOpen}
            >
              {mobileOpen ? (
                <X size={18} />
              ) : (
                <Menu size={18} />
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {mobileOpen && (
          <div className="border-t border-slate-800 p-2 lg:hidden">
            <div className="max-h-[65dvh] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                {renderDashboardLink()}
                {renderPermissionStatus()}

                {visibleModules.map((module) => {
                  const ModuleIcon =
                    moduleIcons[module.id] || Package;

                  const moduleHref =
                    `/dashboard/modules/${module.id}`;

                  const moduleActive = isModuleActive(
                    module,
                    pathname
                  );

                  const isOpen =
                    effectiveOpenModule === module.id;

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={module.id}
                      data-sidebar-root
                      className="min-w-0"
                    >
                      <div
                        className={`flex items-center rounded-lg ${
                          moduleActive || isOpen
                            ? "bg-slate-800 text-white"
                            : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() =>
                            toggleModule(module.id)
                          }
                          aria-label={`${isOpen ? "Collapse" : "Expand"} ${module.name}`}
                          aria-expanded={Boolean(isOpen)}
                          className="shrink-0 p-1.5"
                        >
                          {isOpen ? (
                            <ChevronDown size={14} />
                          ) : (
                            <ChevronRight size={14} />
                          )}
                        </button>

                        <Link
                          href={moduleHref}
                          onClick={handleNavigation}
                          className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2 py-1.5 pr-2 text-xs"
                        >
                          <ModuleIcon
                            size={15}
                            className="shrink-0"
                          />

                          <span className="truncate">
                            {module.name}
                          </span>
                        </Link>
                      </div>

                      {isOpen && (
                        <div className="ml-3 space-y-0.5 pl-1.5">
                          {module.sections.map((section) =>
                            renderSection(section, module.id)
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-2 border-t border-slate-800 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleLogout}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:bg-red-600 hover:text-white"
              >
                <LogOut size={15} />
                Logout
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </header>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style jsx global>{`
        [data-erp-vertical-nav] {
          scrollbar-width: none;
          -ms-overflow-style: none;
        }

        [data-erp-vertical-nav]::-webkit-scrollbar {
          display: none;
          width: 0;
          height: 0;
        }
      `}</style>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() =>
          setMobileOpen((current) => !current)
        }
        className="fixed left-3 top-3 z-[60] rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2 text-slate-800 shadow-lg md:hidden"
        aria-label={
          mobileOpen
            ? "Close navigation"
            : "Open navigation"
        }
        aria-expanded={mobileOpen}
      >
        {mobileOpen ? (
          <X size={19} />
        ) : (
          <Menu size={19} />
        )}
      </button>

      {mobileOpen && (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label="Close navigation overlay"
          onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-[2px] md:hidden"
        />
      )}

      <aside
        data-sidebar-root
        data-erp-sidebar
        className={`isolate fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex h-dvh max-h-dvh w-[min(320px,calc(100vw-1rem))] min-w-[220px] shrink-0 flex-col overflow-hidden overscroll-none border-r border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 text-white shadow-xl transition-transform duration-200 md:sticky md:top-0 md:h-dvh md:max-h-dvh md:translate-x-0 md:w-max md:max-w-[320px] ${
          mobileOpen
            ? "translate-x-0"
            : "-translate-x-full"
        }`}
      >
        <Link
          href="/dashboard"
          onClick={handleNavigation}
          className="relative z-20 flex h-14 shrink-0 items-center gap-2.5 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 px-4"
        >
          <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-blue-600 text-xs font-bold">
            ERP
          </div>

          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h1 className="text-base font-bold tracking-wide">
              ERP System
            </h1>

            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
              Enterprise Resource Planning
            </p>
          </div>
        </Link>

        <div className="relative z-20 shrink-0 bg-slate-950 pt-2">
          {renderModeButton()}
        </div>

        {renderVerticalModules()}

        <div className="relative z-20 shrink-0 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleLogout}
            className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:bg-red-600 hover:text-white"
          >
            <LogOut size={16} />
            <span>Logout</span>
          </button>

          <p className="mt-1.5 text-center text-[10px] text-slate-500">
            Developed for your business
          </p>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

function today() {
    const date = new Date();
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

const emptyItem = () => ({
    product_id: "",
    item_name: "",
    item_description: "",
    item_balance: 0,
    uom: "PCS",
    quantity: 1,
    unit_price: 0,
    tax_code: "",
    tax_rate: 0,
    memo: "",
});

const inputClass =
    "mt-1.5 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3.5 py-3 text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none transition focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100";

const labelClass =
    "block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300";

export default function DeliveryChallanForm({ challanId = null }) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const editing = Boolean(challanId);

    const [lookups, setLookups] = useState({
        customers: [],
        warehouses: [],
        company: null,
    });

    const [form, setForm] = useState({
        transaction_date: today(),
        customer_id: "",
        warehouse_id: "",
        status: "APPROVED",
        subsidiary_name: "",
        department: "",
        challan_class: "Outbound Shipment",
        driver_name: "",
        driver_mobile_no: "",
        vehicle_no: "",
        project: "",
        reference_no: "",
        memo: "",
        currency: "PKR",
        exchange_rate: "1",
    });

    const [lines, setLines] = useState([emptyItem()]);
    const [transactionNumber, setTransactionNumber] = useState("TO BE GENERATED");
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("Transaction Lines");
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");

    useEffect(() => {
        let cancelled = false;

        async function load() {
            setLoading(true);
            setError("");

            try {
                const lookupResponse = await fetch("/api/delivery-challans", {
                    cache: "no-store",
                });
                const lookupData = await lookupResponse.json();

                if (!lookupResponse.ok || !lookupData.success) {
                    throw new Error(lookupData.message || "Could not load form data.");
                }

                if (cancelled) return;

                setLookups({
                    customers: lookupData.customers || [],
                    warehouses: lookupData.warehouses || [],
                    company: lookupData.company || null,
                });

                setForm((previous) => ({
                    ...previous,
                    subsidiary_name:
                        previous.subsidiary_name ||
                        lookupData.company?.company_name ||
                        "",
                    currency:
                        previous.currency === "PKR" && lookupData.company?.currency
                            ? lookupData.company.currency
                            : previous.currency,
                }));

                if (editing) {
                    const response = await fetch(
                        `/api/delivery-challans/${challanId}`,
                        { cache: "no-store" }
                    );
                    const result = await response.json();

                    if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                        throw new Error(result.message || "Could not load challan.");
                    }

                    if (result.challan.status !== "DRAFT") {
                        throw new Error("Only draft challans can be edited.");
                    }

                    if (result.challan.source_order_id) {
                        throw new Error(
                            "Sales Order-based challans cannot be edited through the manual form."
                        );
                    }

                    if (cancelled) return;

                    const c = result.challan;

                    setTransactionNumber(c.transaction_number || "TO BE GENERATED");
                    setForm({
                        transaction_date: String(c.transaction_date || today()).slice(0, 10),
                        customer_id: c.customer_id ? String(c.customer_id) : "",
                        warehouse_id: c.warehouse_id ? String(c.warehouse_id) : "",
                        status: c.status || "DRAFT",
                        subsidiary_name: c.subsidiary_name || "",
                        department: c.department || "",
                        challan_class: c.challan_class || "Outbound Shipment",
                        driver_name: c.driver_name || "",
                        driver_mobile_no: c.driver_mobile_no || "",
                        vehicle_no: c.vehicle_no || "",
                        project: c.project || "",
                        reference_no: c.reference_no || "",
                        memo: c.memo || "",
                        currency: c.currency || "PKR",
                        exchange_rate: String(c.exchange_rate || 1),
                    });

                    setLines(
                        (result.items || []).map((item) => ({
                            product_id: item.product_id ? String(item.product_id) : "",
                            item_name: item.item_name || "",
                            item_description: item.item_description || "",
                            item_balance: Number(item.item_balance || 0),
                            uom: item.uom || "",
                            quantity: Number(item.quantity || 1),
                            unit_price: Number(item.unit_price || 0),
                            tax_code: item.tax_code || "",
                            tax_rate: Number(item.tax_rate || 0),
                            memo: item.memo || "",
                        }))
                    );
                }
            } catch (err) {
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setError(err.message || "Could not load the form.");
                }
            } finally {
                if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
            }
        }

        load();

        return () => {
            cancelled = true;
        };
    }, [challanId, editing]);

    function change(name, value) {
        setForm((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: value }));
    }

    function changeLine(index, name, value) {
        setLines((previous) =>
            previous.map((line, lineIndex) =>
                lineIndex === index
                    ? { ...line, [name]: value }
                    : line
            )
        );
    }

    function chooseProduct(index, productId) {
        const product = (lookups.products || []).find(
            (item) => String(item.product_id) === String(productId)
        );

        setLines((previous) =>
            previous.map((line, lineIndex) =>
                lineIndex === index
                    ? {
                          ...line,
                          product_id: productId,
                          item_name: product?.product_name || line.item_name,
                          item_description: product?.description || line.item_description,
                          uom: product?.sales_unit || product?.unit || line.uom,
                          unit_price: Number(product?.sale_price || line.unit_price || 0),
                      }
                    : line
            )
        );
    }

    const calculatedLines = lines.map((line) => {
        const quantity = Number(line.quantity || 0);
        const unitPrice = Number(line.unit_price || 0);
        const taxRate = Number(line.tax_rate || 0);
        const amount = Math.round(quantity * unitPrice * 100) / 100;
        const taxAmount = Math.round((amount * taxRate) / 100 * 100) / 100;

        return {
            ...line,
            amount,
            tax_amount: taxAmount,
            gross_amount: Math.round((amount + taxAmount) * 100) / 100,
        };
    });

    const totalAmount = calculatedLines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.amount, 0);
    const taxAmount = calculatedLines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.tax_amount, 0);
    const grossAmount = totalAmount + taxAmount;

    async function save(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setSaving(true);
        setError("");

        try {
            const payload = {
                ...form,
                customer_id: form.customer_id,
                warehouse_id: form.warehouse_id,
                exchange_rate: Number(form.exchange_rate || 1),
                items: calculatedLines.map((line) => ({
                    product_id: line.product_id || null,
                    item_name: line.item_name,
                    item_description: line.item_description,
                    item_balance: Number(line.item_balance || 0),
                    uom: line.uom,
                    quantity: Number(line.quantity),
                    unit_price: Number(line.unit_price),
                    tax_code: line.tax_code,
                    tax_rate: Number(line.tax_rate || 0),
                    memo: line.memo,
                })),
            };

            const response = await fetch(
                editing
                    ? `/api/delivery-challans/${challanId}`
                    : "/api/delivery-challans",
                {
                    method: editing ? "PUT" : "POST",
                    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
                }
            );

            const result = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                throw new Error(result.message || "Could not save Delivery Challan.");
            }

            const savedId =
                result.challan?.delivery_challan_id || challanId;

            router.push(`/dashboard/delivery-challans/${savedId}`);
            router.refresh();
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.message || "Could not save Delivery Challan.");
        } finally {
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <div className="grid min-h-64 place-items-center text-slate-500">
                Loading Delivery Challan formâ€¦
            </div>
        );
    }

    const tabs = [
        "Transaction Lines",
        "Accounting Lines",
        "Related Transactions",
        "System Information",
        "Attachments",
    ];

    return (
        <form onSubmit={save} className="space-y-6">
            <header className="rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-700 via-blue-600 to-emerald-600 p-6 text-white shadow-xl sm:p-8">
                <Link
                    href="/dashboard/delivery-challans"
                    className="text-sm font-semibold text-blue-100 hover:text-white"
                >
                    â† Delivery Challans
                </Link>

                <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-end">
                    <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-blue-100">
                            Sales Â· Outbound Shipment
                        </p>
                        <h1 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-black sm:text-4xl">
                            {editing ? "Edit Delivery Challan" : "Create Delivery Challan"}
                        </h1>
                    </div>
                    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-5 py-3 backdrop-blur">
                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-100">
                            Transaction Number
                        </p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-black">{transactionNumber}</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </header>

            {error && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-700 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300">
                    {error}
                </div>
            )}

            <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 sm:p-6">
                <div className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">Transaction Information</h2>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            Enter customer, location, and shipment details.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-blue-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/50 dark:text-blue-300">
                        {form.status}
                    </span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid gap-x-5 gap-y-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Transaction Date *
                        <input
                            required
                            type="date"
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={form.transaction_date}
                            onChange={(event) => change("transaction_date", event.target.value)}
                        />
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Customer *
                        <select
                            required
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={form.customer_id}
                            onChange={(event) => change("customer_id", event.target.value)}
                        >
                            <option value="">Select customer</option>
                            {lookups.customers.map((customer) => (
                                <option key={customer.customer_id} value={customer.customer_id}>
                                    {customer.customer_name}
                                    {customer.customer_code ? ` (${customer.customer_code})` : ""}
                                </option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Subsidiary / Company
                        <input
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={form.subsidiary_name}
                            onChange={(event) => change("subsidiary_name", event.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Company name"
                        />
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Location *
                        <select
                            required
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={form.warehouse_id}
                            onChange={(event) => change("warehouse_id", event.target.value)}
                        >
                            <option value="">Select location</option>
                            {lookups.warehouses.map((warehouse) => (
                                <option key={warehouse.warehouse_id} value={warehouse.warehouse_id}>
                                    {warehouse.warehouse_name}
                                </option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Status
                        <select
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={form.status}
                            onChange={(event) => change("status", event.target.value)}
                        >
                            <option value="DRAFT">DRAFT</option>
                            <option value="APPROVED">APPROVED</option>
                        </select>
                        {editing && (
                            <span className="mt-1 block text-xs font-normal text-amber-600">
                                Editing requires DRAFT status.
                            </span>
                        )}
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Class
                        <select
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={form.challan_class}
                            onChange={(event) => change("challan_class", event.target.value)}
                        >
                            <option>Outbound Shipment</option>
                            <option>Customer Delivery</option>
                            <option>Other</option>
                        </select>
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Department
                        <input className={inputClass} value={form.department} onChange={(event) => change("department", event.target.value)} placeholder="Department" />
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Project
                        <input className={inputClass} value={form.project} onChange={(event) => change("project", event.target.value)} placeholder="Project name" />
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Reference Number
                        <input className={inputClass} value={form.reference_no} onChange={(event) => change("reference_no", event.target.value)} placeholder="Reference number" />
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Driver Name
                        <input className={inputClass} value={form.driver_name} onChange={(event) => change("driver_name", event.target.value)} placeholder="Driver full name" />
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Driver Mobile
                        <input className={inputClass} value={form.driver_mobile_no} onChange={(event) => change("driver_mobile_no", event.target.value)} placeholder="03xx-xxxxxxx" />
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Vehicle Number
                        <input className={inputClass} value={form.vehicle_no} onChange={(event) => change("vehicle_no", event.target.value)} placeholder="Vehicle registration" />
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Currency
                        <input className={inputClass} value={form.currency} onChange={(event) => change("currency", event.target.value.toUpperCase())} maxLength={10} />
                    </label>

                    <label className={labelClass}>
                        Exchange Rate
                        <input className={inputClass} type="number" min="0.000001" step="0.000001" required value={form.exchange_rate} onChange={(event) => change("exchange_rate", event.target.value)} />
                    </label>

                    <label className={`${labelClass} md:col-span-2 xl:col-span-3`}>
                        Memo
                        <textarea
                            rows={3}
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={form.memo}
                            onChange={(event) => change("memo", event.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Additional delivery instructions..."
                        />
                    </label>
                </div>
            </section>

            <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 p-3 dark:border-slate-800">
                    {tabs.map((tab) => (
                        <button
                            key={tab}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
                            className={`rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold transition ${activeTab === tab ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow" : "text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"}`}
                        >
                            {tab}
                        </button>
                    ))}
                </div>

                {activeTab === "Transaction Lines" ? (
                    <>
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 p-5 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                            <div>
                                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">Transaction Lines</h2>
                                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                    Add items, quantities, prices, and tax rates.
                                </p>
                            </div>
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setLines((previous) => [...previous, emptyItem()])}
                                className="rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-blue-700"
                            >
                                + Add Line
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-4 p-4 sm:p-5">
                            {calculatedLines.map((line, index) => (
                                <div
                                    key={index}
                                    className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-4 dark:border-slate-700"
                                >
                                    <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                                        <h3 className="font-bold">Line {index + 1}</h3>
                                        <button
                                            type="button"
                                            disabled={lines.length === 1}
                                            onClick={() => setLines((previous) => previous.filter((_, i) => i !== index))}
                                            className="rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 disabled:opacity-30 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                                        >
                                            Remove
                                        </button>
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                                        <label className={labelClass}>
                                            Item Name *
                                            <input required className={inputClass} value={line.item_name} onChange={(event) => changeLine(index, "item_name", event.target.value)} placeholder="Item name" />
                                        </label>

                                        <label className={labelClass}>
                                            Item Description
                                            <input className={inputClass} value={line.item_description} onChange={(event) => changeLine(index, "item_description", event.target.value)} placeholder="Description" />
                                        </label>

                                        <label className={labelClass}>
                                            Item Balance
                                            <input className={inputClass} type="number" min="0" step="0.001" value={line.item_balance} onChange={(event) => changeLine(index, "item_balance", event.target.value)} />
                                        </label>

                                        <label className={labelClass}>
                                            UOM
                                            <input className={inputClass} value={line.uom} onChange={(event) => changeLine(index, "uom", event.target.value)} placeholder="PCS / BOX / KG" />
                                        </label>

                                        <label className={labelClass}>
                                            Quantity *
                                            <input required className={inputClass} type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" value={line.quantity} onChange={(event) => changeLine(index, "quantity", event.target.value)} />
                                        </label>

                                        <label className={labelClass}>
                                            Unit Price
                                            <input required className={inputClass} type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value={line.unit_price} onChange={(event) => changeLine(index, "unit_price", event.target.value)} />
                                        </label>

                                        <label className={labelClass}>
                                            Tax Rate (%)
                                            <input className={inputClass} type="number" min="0" step="0.001" value={line.tax_rate} onChange={(event) => changeLine(index, "tax_rate", event.target.value)} />
                                        </label>

                                        <label className={labelClass}>
                                            Tax Code
                                            <input className={inputClass} value={line.tax_code} onChange={(event) => changeLine(index, "tax_code", event.target.value)} placeholder="Tax code" />
                                        </label>

                                        <label className={`${labelClass} sm:col-span-2 xl:col-span-4`}>
                                            Line Memo
                                            <input className={inputClass} value={line.memo} onChange={(event) => changeLine(index, "memo", event.target.value)} placeholder="Optional line memo" />
                                        </label>
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 dark:bg-slate-950 sm:grid-cols-3">
                                        <div>
                                            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Amount</p>
                                            <p className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold">{line.amount.toLocaleString("en-PK", { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}</p>
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Tax Amount</p>
                                            <p className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold">{line.tax_amount.toLocaleString("en-PK", { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}</p>
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Gross Amount</p>
                                            <p className="mt-1 text-lg font-black text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400">{line.gross_amount.toLocaleString("en-PK", { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}</p>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    </>
                ) : (
                    <div className="p-8">
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold">{activeTab}</h3>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            {activeTab === "Accounting Lines"
                                ? "Accounting integration is not enabled for Delivery Challans. Saving this document does not post a journal entry."
                                : activeTab === "Related Transactions"
                                  ? "Sales Order references are shown on the saved challan. This form is for manual challans."
                                  : activeTab === "System Information"
                                    ? "System timestamps and transaction identifiers are assigned by the database when you save."
                                    : "Attachment upload is not connected yet. You can add an attachment workflow separately."}
                        </p>
                    </div>
                )}
            </section>

            <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 sm:p-6">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">Summary</h2>
                <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
                    {[
                        ["Total Amount", totalAmount],
                        ["Tax Amount", taxAmount],
                        ["Gross Amount", grossAmount],
                    ].map(([label, value]) => (
                        <div key={label} className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 p-5 dark:bg-slate-950">
                            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{label}</p>
                            <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black">
                                {form.currency} {Number(value).toLocaleString("en-PK", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </section>

            <footer className="sticky bottom-3 z-10 flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white/95 p-4 shadow-xl backdrop-blur dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900/95">
                <Link
                    href="/dashboard/delivery-challans"
                    className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold dark:border-slate-700"
                >
                    â† Back
                </Link>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => router.push("/dashboard/delivery-challans")}
                        className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold dark:border-slate-700"
                    >
                        Cancel
                    </button>
                    <button
                        type="submit"
                        disabled={saving}
                        className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-emerald-600 px-7 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-lg hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                        {saving ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Save Delivery Challan"}
                    </button>
                </div>
            </footer>
        </form>
    );
}
